review_text: I felt compelled to right a review because there are so many negative ones from people who clearly didn’t do their research. This is a strong retinol. It is not a good percentage for beginners. You can’t jump into using this and you absolutely have to follow the directions. All Retinols cause purging so if you start getting acne after starting this then it’s working. The purge period can last for a few weeks and then it will clear up. Strong Retinols can also cause peeling of the skin. It eventually stops. This is a good product but I deducted a star for the price since there are other ones on the market at the same percentage that are cheaper. If you are new to retinol I suggest starting with a lower percentage first. You can also buffer this by putting on moisturizer first then the retinol. Most importantly, you must wear SPF when using retinol or you’re going to negate the effects and get sun damage. That’s my two cents.

Cystic acne has recently become quite the issue for me. I would get a lump the size of a pea and it would stay there for 2 weeks at a time. Once it finally started to go down in size, another one would pop up an inch away, and then another and another. There was no stopping them. I sat in front of the mirror so many times and cried for so long. I avoided going out in public, I didn’t want to go out with the girls because I felt like everyone was looking at these hideous monstrosities on my otherwise nice face. And I swear those little monsters would look right back at them and wink. So I went on Sephora.com and started looking at all of the acne products. This one immediately caught my attention. I ordered it, and was so excited when I received it. Sure enough I had a zit halfway formed on my cheek, so I put this on when I went to bed that night. I love the fact that this is quick drying and very hard to rub off. It stayed on all night and performed a miracle! That zit was completely gone. Not even a red mark left. A few days later a cyst started to form just off to the side of my chin, and those and the ones on my chin are the biggest and the hardest to get rid of. So of course I put this on that night. By morning the cyst was still there, but had not gotten any bigger at all, and that’s amazing! I put Eradikate on that morning too, and covered it with foundation. You could see it a little tiny bit, but I didn’t care because it was acting as a shield and fighting the cyst all day. I’ve been following that routine for a few days and the spot is almost flat and gone. I can’t believe it. Nothing, NOTHING, I have ever tried has stopped a cyst from forming. I’m so very, deeply impressed. Besides that large spot, this product has gotten rid of every small “normal“ zit I’ve had in one night. Another wonderful thing about this is that it doesn’t over dry my skin at all. If something is very drying my skin has no problem letting me know, but so far so good. I’ve been using all sorts of really high end deep cleaning and acne fighting tools and products, and Eradikate is a wonderful way to fight the purging caused by deep cleaning your skin. I feel like I’m finally winning the battle I’ve been losing for so, so, so long.

This scrub/mask hybrid truly gives amazing results - if used correctly! I’m aware the directions say to use on damp skin, but DO NOT! Once you’ve left it on for desired time after a good sloughing away of dead skin cells, give your face a good rinse with warm water, then splash with cool water to close your pores, pat dry, and voila! You’re left with glowy, baby-butt smooth skin with no flakes in sight! You can go on to applying the rest of your skincare! The key really is to apply on dry skin! :) I’ve seen plenty of reviews saying this mask sucks, and it really does if you use it on wet skin, but if used on dry skin, it really is worth it’s high price point! I got a sample of this to see what the hype was about and as many different people have expressed in the reviews I washed this off and was left with extremely irritated red patches on my face! I don’t normally have sensitive skin so this was shocking to me.
I could feel the moisture sinknin my skin. As soon as I put I on my skin, it was so good. My skin felt moisturized.
Sits on top of the skin and doesn’t provide any moisture. Would not recommend for dry skin.
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: I had really bad dry lips that peeled and hurt. I read reviews on this product and went to Sephora to purchase one. I’m HOOKED! This lip balm has a minty feel, and doesn’t feel greasy or weird. My lips are now soft and don’t crack anymore, I love Jack Black’s Intense Therapy Lip Balm :)
review_title: Works great for dry, cracked lips!

review_text: Very light! Not oily, but moisturizes very well!!
review_title: exactly what it claims to be!

review_text: I figured since I love the Acne Solutions foam cleanser that I would give the toner a try as well. I’ve been using Clinique since my Mom bought me the 3 step system when I was 10 and experienced my first breakout, and I’ve NEVER had any problems, until now. This product made my breakout even worse, which shocked me because my skin isn’t normally sensitive. I tried to give it a try thinking it may be something else, but the moment I switched back to the original toner my skin cleared right up. I give it 2 stars because it made my skin feel really clean and it reduced the amount of oil that would show up on my tzone. Too bad, I really wanted to love it.

This is the best makeup removing cleansing balm hands down and I have tried a lot. It removes all of my makeup and my skin doesn’t feel dry nor oily afterwards which many balms can do. It is also not very expensive compared to other high-end skincare. Highly recommend.
review_title: Best makeup remover I have tried
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Moisturizes skin and has make up looking nice after application. However, I don’t like the smell of it and after seeing how much it cost I was turned off from the product. There are plenty of other moisturizers that can do what this does, but I just may not be a fan of balms.

A lot of people act like this is some miracle lip balm. It’s not necessarily going to cure cracked, dry lips over night, but I will agree that it’s a slight step above chapstick. Thus far I have only bought the grapefruit and ginger one (though it only smells like grapefruit), but I will probably get another one soon.
review_title: Good, but don't believe it's a cure-all

review_text: So excited to finally see this product in Sephora stores in my area of Palm Springs. I’ve been using the universal face oil religiously every morning & night for about 3 years. I have semi oily skin so was shocked that I didn’t get any breakouts or over oily skin with these product. I’m 41 and in the past few years of using these products I have gotten abundance of compliments on the youth of my skin appearance. Having a healthy face routine is essential in my eyes. This and all of the other products are top notch in my book.. After having such great results with the universal oil Ive purchased and use the entire face line. The vitamin c oil is also my very favorite. I could l literally see the biggest difference after using the products together. If you don’t decide on starting a face routine everyone needs to try the sea silk lip balm!! Living in Palm Springs & Lake arrowhead I seem to always need to apply chapstick every few hours. After my purchase of the sea silk lip balm I’ve never used anything else. I apply a few times a day. With the huge amount it comes with this product has lasted me for months.
review_title: Super excited Sephora is finally carrying Mara
product_name: Mini Algae + Moringa Universal Face Oil

review_text: This product has a very nice description. The description convinced me to purchase. I thought my face would be super glow and bright. Yet, it does NOT do what it says. The acne scars do not get any lighter. My face still looks dull and uneven texture. The package recommends to apply a thick layer on the face. Please do not do that or you will run out of it after 10 applications.
Ok for an inexpensive eye serum, but I would pay more to get better results.
product_name: All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage

review_text: Loved it at first but then as I continued to use it, my skin became irritated and red. The oil is a thick consistency and it’s perfect for anyone who wants to jade roll, but unfortunately had to return because it made my face itchy and red. The smell is light and smells like oregano, it does fade in 20 mins but can’t be quite bothersome for people with scent sensitivity. I have combo sensitive acne prone skin and I do not recommend this oil.

I had never used an energy serum before this one, and I have to say, I’m hooked! I have combination skin and was excited to see if this could handle all areas of my skin. I loved the smell and feel of this product. It went on easily and I saw a noticeable difference. My skin was firmer and brighter and the areas around my eyes were less puffy. Adding this to my morning routine was super quick and made a definite difference in my skin. I also love that the product comes in a recyclable glass bottle that has been treated to keep my product fresh and effective.
product_name: 15% Vitamin C + Clean Caffeine Energy Serum

review_text: I love the texture; it feels great. But I don’t think it’s doing any type of brightening, which I’m okay with.

I have tried several things from Sol De Janeiro and this lip butter did not disappoint. I took it with me on all my beach travels, hikes, road trips and it was even a staple in my carry-on. This butter is light on the lips but very moisturizing and IT SMELLS AMAZING!!! I didnt have the issue of my cap popping off in my bag. Definitely a repurch item/ item to have back ups off :)
Didn’t break me out, melts makeup well, smells nice, nice formula.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I used this about once a week for about a month. The first time was okay but after a few times I noticed it was drying my skin out rather horribly. And that led to breakouts. I resorted to hydrafacials to help relieve the dryness this product caused. And after a couple months of not using this my skin went back to normal.
The flavor was fine, but I never noticed a difference and it was so difficult to get all the powder to dissolve which made the drink chunky. Not a great consistency

Really wanted to love this cleanser as I’m a big fan of their Water Cream and mist. I have combo skin and I initially purchased this after trying a sample of it since I liked the way it left my skin feeling. However after about a month of using this morning and night it has left my skin peeling, flaky, red, and itchy in patches. I think it dried out my skin from over exfoliating and will need to switch to only using this 2-3x a week as a regular exfoliant instead of a daily cleanser as advertised.Also really hate the bottle since it doesn’t come in a pump for the price.
review_title: Over exfoliation left my skin dry and flaky!
product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: I LOVE IT!!!!! It’s so lightweight it works perfectly for summer. It makes my skin feel SO moisturized❤️

My skin looks amazing when I use this product. It goes on smoothly and makes my makeup looks flawless and last a long time. The best thing is that leaves my skin moisturized and not oily, maybe on warmer days I am going to use it only in my nighttime routine. It smells nice.
product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer

review_text: I generally am very happy with The Ordinary brand and really enjoy their serums, especially the Buffet. This moisturizer, however, did not sit well under makeup or play well with my sunscreen even when given time to set between applying cream and then sunscreen.

I have quite a few exfoliating products and was far from impressed by this. I’m a huge Peter Thomas Roth fan, but this product really didn’t do anything for me. I agree with a few other reviewers - the pilling effect is just a clever gimmick. Do yourself a favor and try Vasanti Brighten Up! Enzymatic Face Rejuvenator or Kate Somerville’s ExfoliKate (I mix a small amount of both products when I exfoliate).

After just the first use I got so much junk out of my pores especially in the chin area. But before using this device make sure your face is clean and washed with warm water. Wet your face with warm water also. It helps make your pores more open.
product_name: DERMAPORE Ultrasonic Pore Extractor & Serum Infuser

review_text: This product is highly fragranced, which was not compatible with my sensitive skin. It also left my skin feeling sticky instead of moisturized. If you have dry, sensitive skin, I suggest that you consider making a different choice.
product_name: Dewy Glow Moisturizer with Cherry Blossom & Niacinamide

review_text: I really wanted to like this but it made my face greasy and itchy. I gave it two stars because the packaging is super appealing and it does smell good, however if strong scents bother you then this isn’t the right product for you as the scent is like a strong perfume.
product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil

review_text: Don’t get the hype this felt so tacky on my face and didn’t soak in at all
product_name: SEA Mini Drink of H2O Hydrating Boost Moisturizer

review_text: This is a great and moisturizing cream. It smells great, but light and did not irritate my sensitive skin. It made my skin feel very soft and hydrated after wearing it each night for a week. I am able to wear this product under makeup without causing it to slide off faster, or making me look oily. It comes with a little spatula which I really liked to avoid contamination of the cream. It did not break out my skin, as many moisturizers do . I would recommend this cream those with dry or combination skin.

Loved this product! Kept my skin super moisturized especially within the winter months. The fragrance was pleasant but not heavy. The consistency of the formula was really loose and watery but thickened on the skin when smoothed in. I was really impressed with the finish!
product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I was excited for a cleansing balm without micro plastics, however this one left my skin feeling greasy and it didn’t even remove my makeup that well. Disappointed but not shocked, as the price point is so low. Didn’t take mascara off well at all. I just threw my tube in the trash after trying to make it work so many times.
Great product!!!! I will be recommending to friends!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This cleanser is wonderful to use - haven’t noticed a dramatic difference in my skin but I really enjoy the experience of using it everyday.
product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

review_text: I thought this would be a quick and easy eye treatment but I have to apply it so carefully so not too tug too much. It’s not as emollient as it should be for the under eye area,It doesn’t glide. So I use my regular eye cream and massage it in using this. Won’t be buying again.

I recieved this lip mask through Influenster. I have naturally dry lips that always crack and peel. I went into this thinking it wasn’t going to work for me. Well I was wrong. I woke up with my lips feeling hydrated and it caused the dead skin to come off. My lips haven’t felt this smooth in awhile!
Smelled nice. Easy to remove make up.
I have been using this more than 6 monthes, I am not sure if I would buy this again. My $3 soap give a same result..

Very sticky/tacky finish that doesn’t dry down to matte. I have combo normal/oily skin and this might be better as a winter sunscreen because of the residue it leaves. But we’ll see. Definitely not using it in the summer. Two stars for it being no irritating and the white casts goes away after rubbing it in a bit.

This is a great smelling, creamy gel that glides on. My skin readily absorbs it too, but feels dry soon after. I’ve needed to supplement with pure coconut oil to avoid tightness in my dry areas. Has a great matte-ifying effect on my t-zone.
I wanted to love this but it made me break out on my jawline and cheeks SO BAD!! I feel like it makes my makeup patchy and doesn’t last as long. I have very oily skin and this doesn’t help.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: I used this 2x a day religiously until the bottle finished and saw no improvement in my hyperpigmentation.

This has sneakily become my go-to everyday all purpose moisturizer. It has natural ingredients that don’t break me out. It’s moisturizing without being greasy or occlusive. It has a kind of beautiful pudding texture. It smells non offensive but a little yeasty, like beer. It wears great under tinted moisturizer during the day, and at night I put it on top of serum and then seal it in by dabbing a few drops of facial oil over the top and my skin looks plump and moisturized in the morning. This is almost half as expensive as my previous favorite moisturizer, Omorovicza’s illuminating moisturizer (which I only used for daytime). I really love and recommend this, though if you have very dry skin you might want to top it off with a few drops of a good facial oil to better seal in the moisture.
product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I got this as a deluxe sample which has 5 ml of product. This is a good amount considering you only use a small amount of it at a time. This can last me over a month using it twice a day. I didn’t realize this was considered a serum because it looks and acts just like an eye cream. It has a cool little wand with a ball at the end to apply and spread, but you need to wash it after every use otherwise it’s unhygienic. Fine lines go away, yes, but as long as the skin around your eyes is hydrated, they will pretty much disappear. Any moisturizer or eye cream helps fine lines disappear. As far as puffiness goes, I don’t have super puffy eyes, but you can visibly see that my infraorbital area sinks in a bit. My eyes barely started looking darker than they ever have. I turned 30 this year, so I do know I need to start taking care of my skin much better, but I do not think this is worth paying over $70 for a half an ounce of product. I typically just use my samples of eye creams that I get because they’re pretty much all the same honestly. I really can’t think of one that stands out due to my eyes changing for the better. I’ve only been using this for two weeks, so I will definitely update if there is any change in the weeks to come. I’m not counting on it, but who knows. For now, I say either get samples of this first or get something much cheaper. IT Cosmetics has an eye cream that’s really hydrating, and you get way more than your usual eye cream for a good price. I recommend that one instead of this one if you do want a little bit of a nicer one.
review_title: Not worth the price, average at best
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I like this a lot!! I was using Supergoop’s Tinted SPF prior, and it was okay, but would oxidate and end up feeling heavy oh my skin by the end of the day. This is very light (although it doesn’t have ayn coverage), but does offer a beautiful glow as advertised. I use this under my full coverage foundation for a beautiful finish AND sun protection... what more could you want!? Would recommend this over their tinted SPF for sure.
review_title: Awesome as a primer + sun protection
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: I expected more from this face wash. Just tried it and it was okay. A little goes a long way and it foamed you nicely however for me it smelt very soapy which I hate in a face wash. Also took a while to rinse off probably due to the fact that I used too much. It also leaves your face squeaky clean feeling which is also don’t particularly enjoy. Feels like my skin is being stripped especially because I have dry skin. Hopefully I don’t break out. Will try again though!
product_name: La Mousse OFF/ON Foaming Face Cleanser

review_text: I feel like this toner is very strong. When I first started using it, my skin hated it and I stopped for a few months. I decided to give it another try and only applied it every other day and it started working. It makes my skin feel great and I have less breakouts. Beware of the strong smell!! I like it but some may not. The smell stays even once applied. I will be buying this again.

I was having major trouble sleeping from anxiety & body aches. These definitely helped lull me to sleep and not wake up at 2am! I still woke up bright and early from morning anxiety, even when I went to bed late, but at least I could sleep through the night. This product is definitely not night and day, but it does help me on nights where I can tell it’ll be a rough night of sleep. I don’t think these are a miracle, but worth a shot if you need a little help.
product_name: Beauty zzZz Sleep Support Supplement with Melatonin

review_text: I have hormonal acne and was really hoping that these would help because nothing externally was helping. I’m not going to sugar coat this review, because these pills sure weren’t. I could barely swallow them, and I can stomach a lot. I almost threw up each time but I forced them down for weeks. I think I actually broke out more. If this works for you, I’m glad, but it doesn’t work for everyone apparently. The reviews made me so hopeful that I was very disappointed when they didn’t work.
product_name: Daily Cleanse Clear Skin and Body Detox Supplement

review_text: This product is great! Makes my lips tingle and is moisturizing as well. I also love the applicator that is built into the lid.

This La Mer hydrated is game changer! It’s extremely fast absorbing when you first apply it and smoothes out the textures on your skin. After cleansing my skin, I rub this all over my skin and layer on a moisturizer. Obsessed with it!

I normally love drunk elephant, but this product felt awful on my skin. Even a little bit felt heavy, and I was constantly aware of it on my face. I finally couldn’t take it anymore and had to wash it off.
product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Product pills so badly!! Can’t be used under makeup at all. The only reason I gave two stars is because the glow it gives is gorgeous.
product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: IT IS A STRAIGHT UP LIE. the product does not remove dead skin, the only thing that clumps up is the product itself !! Do not believe that your skin is coming off like that from a scrub. It’s a marketing lie.
product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: After trying their other products, this one is just okay. I do like that it goes on light and feels silky. Unfortunately, I didn’t find it moisturizing at all. I found that I had to apply it multiple times. I read that you can use it around your eyes and nose. I will definitely try other uses for it.
I liked this night cream! I really saw a difference in my skin when I woke up in the morning! There is a bit of a sting to it, but not so much that it ends up damaging my skin.

I enjoyed the serum, I didn’t see results on wrinkles from using it as I had just a small sample to try, but it felt nice on my skin and was unscented for those of us with sensitive skin. I would consider purchasing this product to use in my daily routine. I received this as free sample from top box circle.
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum

review_text: I got this as Sephora bday gift this year with the the Beste cleanser and I instantly fell in love with it! I have been trying to find something that satisfies my list of requirements (no smell, not greasy, light, perfectly skin quenching, no break outs) and this was IT!!!!! I bought the full size a.s.a.p.
review_title: no smell, not greasy, light, perfectly skin quench

review_text: Before I used NuBody I already have a NuFace device and have been using it to tone and tighten my face and neck. I was very curious whether this body toning device would have the same results as the facial toning one and it does make your skin tighter. Through long term repeated use I can see that it will also train the muscles to strengthen and tone. The only thing is that this is not a once a week or once a month type toning device. To see the real results, you have to use it every day.
I love this my friend recommended it to me and I absolutely love it ! Never came across something so beautiful it’s light and leaves your skin glowy !
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: This moisturizer is HEAVEN. It’s light, almost powdery—yet also rich and luxurious and really soothes my sensitive skin. I noticed a very slight reduction in fine lines but mostly just love the texture of the cream. Took off a star because it’s HELLA expensive and therefore won’t be purchasing the full size.

I received this the wrinkle correcting serum from Topbox Circle program as a complementary gift to try it and gives my honest review about it, it absorbed quickly by my skin it’s no scent no sticky as a twice of use I feel that this serum was effective recommended #freeproduct
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum

review_text: It is perfect and worth the splurge. It is super hydrating and looks like a gloss whilst giving the benefits you would get from a balm. Also, it smells amazing. Worth it!

I have loved this product so far! It is light but very moisturizing. I love that the product last for several hours, but doesn’t clog my pores or make my skin oily. I also think it helps my make go on smoother and not settle into my fine lines.

I recently received my dermalogica daily microfoliant samples and I absolutely loved it. I got it gifted by dermalogica sampling. The product is in powder form and you just add water to activate. It foams very well and made my face super clean. Will repurchase

While I enjoyed the product, I could not get over the scent. I received this product complementary of Influenster. I used every day for a week and noticed slight changes in my skin. But I dreaded the smell. I would use this product again, if the scent were removed or changed.
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: Wanted to love this, but I just couldn’t. I was hoping it smelled as good as the bum bum cream, but it doesn’t. To me the consistency was weird and not very moisturizing. Only positive is the size, it’s huge!
I received this product free for testing. Thanks Influenster for the opportunity. However, I used this for over a month and saw no real results. I’m disappointed and would not recommend.

This moisturizer is ok, but I wouldn’t recommend it for dry skin. I found it to be not moisturizing enough for dry skin, yet sort of oily feeling when it’s warm out. I needed to only use it at night and need to layer it with another moisturizer just to use it up.
product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I definitely gave this product a chance. I used an entire bottle in addition to the concentrated brightening essence and renewal night cream. I have sensitive, fair skin with obvious large sunspots that this stuff didn’t begin to touch. Also I had major pore clogging issues as i have combination skin and i had several bouts of breakouts while using this stuff. I really wanted it to work and i had high hopes based on the other reviews but alas.. nothing.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: $10 for lip balm isn’t all that outrageous here but eh, not worth it in my opinion. It works fine, not super moisturizing or anything, just...fine.

Have only used this duo a few times but not really impressed with the quality. I use a DERMALOGICA regularly but wanted to switch it up! I also do not like that you have to wait for the bar soap to dry to put it back in the package. It’s messy and annoying.
product_name: Baby Bar Travel Duo with Case

review_text: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY! This is the most DISGUSTING and DISAPPOINTING product ever!! I had such high hopes because I love the drops, but this made me look patchy and streaky for over a week. I have been scrubbing this off my body for days and days and it’s not coming off, it’s now become a joke in my house lol. I shaved, exfoliated, and evenly applied but still went on so gross, it’s so embarrassing. It’s the most blotchy, streaky product I’ve ever used. It also smells nasty too. I would recommend the drops or another product but do not try this!!!
product_name: Even Skin Tone Self-Tanning Body Butter

review_text: My favorite acne prevention product. I just got off my birth control a bit over a month ago and this has helped SO much with not getting acne. review_title: Must buy if you have acne.
product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask

review_text: I absolutely love clinique and its my ride or die face wash and moisturizer. However this product missed the mark for me. I honestly think its just high end baby oil. It does the same thing. I didn’t see any added benefit of using this for getting my make up off rather than using my go to baby pil or coconut oil. I did love the pump and packaging of this, but honestly not a product worth repurchasing. I was hoping it would smooth my skin and really help remove my eye make up easier but it didn’t do anything fancy. .
product_name: Take The Day Off  Cleansing Oil Makeup Remover

review_text: I personally find this lotion nothing actually like what an actual lotion is suppose feel like , but needless to say If you actually like lotions don’t go for this .. cause the consistency is more similar to a toner it’s light weight , leaves your skin feeing hydrated and with a slight glow .
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Fortifying Lotion Toner

review_text: Easy to use. Nothing to it. Works perfect and love the feel very soft. It smelled very nice also. Skin felt smooth and refreshed after removing!

The smell is gross. But, it quickly dissipates. It does its job as a high SPF ought to. I have acne prone skin so it’s always nerve wracking trying new SPFs on my face. I did experience a minor breakout from this product so I only use it when 100% necessary.
product_name: SUBLIME DEFENSE Ultra Lightweight UV Defense Fluid SPF 50

review_text: It cleared my acne for about a week, then suddenly I got huge breakouts on my cheeks. My pores were suddenly very clogged & I got cystic pimples I couldn’t pop. That’s another interesting thing about this product- it made my pimples very hard to pop. Like even if i used steam to open my pores, I couldn’t pop blackheads & whiteheads anymore if i had applied this product. I was using it on my face & back. There were no negative effects to my back, but my face has been doing a lot better since I stopped using this product.
I was super impressed with this eye cream. Smells great and make my eyes look smoother

review_text: This tanner has a great color. It’s not super orange looks very natural. I think the smell is a lot better than most tanners that I have tried. broke me out, it’s to exfoliating. definitely not for younger skin. if u have more mature skin you’ll like this better! i dislike it but my mom bought it not knowing that i’ve had it nor it broke me out and she loves it!!

Started to use this in the summer time and worked amazing! Super hydrating and paired well with the humidity. Not oily or greasy what so ever. I only gave it a 4 star because my dryness returned during the winter time. I have returned to using 2 products to combat my dryness. Dr. Jart Ceramidin and/or Ciapair seems works great in my troubled dry cheek area on top of this water cream!
This is some strong stuff! It worked really well for my acne. Def something to ease into. It was very drying, but if used every other day, It cleared up the maskne nicely.
doesn’t absorb. it is a salve, so that makes sense, but aquaphor does the same thing and is less sticky.
review_title: save your money, buy aquaphor instead

review_text: This was a repurchase. This product is great for days I’m especially flakey or textured but just want a simple cleanse and not my whole routine with tatcha’s rice powder. Love it and will always have it.
product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: Life changing for someone who suffers from acnea rosacea. I use this as one step in my double cleanse. Applies great as a hydrating mask.

I loved this product! It has multiple benefits—not only good for acne but also hydrates without leaving your face feeling greasy like some others. I would suggest to leave some extra space around your mouth because as it warms up it sometimes finds it’s way into my mouth. I’m glad I received this product complementary to try before actually purchasing!
product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: I was really excited to try this product. However, I see absolutely no difference whether using it or not. I actually wore it as an overnight mask....no difference. Wore it as a primer underneath my makeup....nothing. For 59$ I have to return it. Too bad because I was really hoping this would excite me!

Love to love Laneige, but they didn’t hit home with this one. Love the scent, packaging, everything but the taste, which is very important in a balm. It melts into my mouth and leaves a salty residue that you have to brush your teeth to get rid of. Very disappointed.

I thought this sunscreen would be really great but it was not. I found it to be greasy and it made my skin shiny (and stayed shiny all day). It’s alright and I’d use it as a body sunscreen but for face, it did not impress me.
product_name: PLAY Everyday Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: It’s ok. It feels nice and cool when you first apply it but then it’s like “ok??? Well, then what??“. Didn’t feel a difference on my skin and the cooling effect lasts for about a minute.

it smells nice - and that is about it. It really felt like rubbing some sugar on my face - I still gave it a try and used it to see if the benefits would come through after using it for a period of time. 2 weeks later unfortunately no great effects. I really wanted to like it but it turned out to be just another beauty product that I wasted money on

You know what I mean when I say that lip produces can add too much buildup and what u need is exfoliation. This is an exfoliating to balm product that is perfect - the only product i need to have the pinkiest lip ever that will always be so smooth
review_title: Worth Every Penny and my first sustainable lip

review_text: This did not absorb and somewhat irritated the lining of my eyes.

Gifted by Farmacy Beauty. This serum made my skin feel so fresh. It feels very lightweight and absorbs quickly. The serum itself is formulated to be a waterless serum that helps to brighten and target dark spots. I’ve been using it for a week and my sink looks healthy and more brighter.

I’ve tried this over and over and every time, it aggravates my rosacea, causes breakouts AND blackheads which I’ve never had before, and doesn’t hydrate my skin at all. I have a digital skin analyzer monitor which gave readings of LESS moisture and oil the morning after use. I got the in an influenster box and freaked out because I love this brand. I don’t have enough good things to say about this product. Not only have I not broken out but my skin is SO SOFT. I will continue purchasing this product.
product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: I had been using the original Algenist firming and lifting cream for a couple years and loved it. It’s what got me to go with Algenist for all my skin care products. Now it’s gone and replaced with a modified name and formulation. I was able to try some on the back of my hand from a tester at another retailer. I really didn’t care for the feel of this cream. Algenist has front loaded the silicones and this feels too much like a foundation primer. I could feel the slickness of the silicones, and that was about it.I like and use the new Elevate Retinol serum, but I think Algenist missed with this one. I’ll have to start looking for a replacement brand.

This wears surprisingly well under makeup, and other skincare. It absorbs into skin quickly, apply evenly, and I little goes a long way! It’s a bit early to see results but I have high hopes and am enjoying this formula so far!
product_name: Argan Bright Skin Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I love this! I’m impressed. I am at that age where I want to start preventing wrinkles and this is perfect! My skin feels amazing after putting this one. I received this product for free for tesing from influenster.
product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum

review_text: Wanted to love this product so much but unfortunately wasn’t for me. I have sensitive skin so when I put it on, it started to irritate my skin and my skin turned red. Had to wash it off because it burned. Don’t buy if you have sensitive skin.!
product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: I like DE, I like this cream, but I don’t love it. I have to add other products to actually moisturize my skin. Even in the warmer months I struggled to keep my skin from drying with this. When I add a drop each of their Vitamin C serum, Marula Oil, B Hydra and D Bronzi, only then is it moisturizing enough for me. I don’t want to spend hundreds of dollars just to make one product. I’ve found that CeraVe does the same as this cream, but is more moisturizing and less than 1/2 the price.

I was really excited about trying this product due to all the positive reviews but unfortunately my skin did not take well to it. I live in a much more humid and hot environment now than my skin is normally use to and my skin has been breaking out repeatedly. After about 2 weeks of using the product I began having increased breakouts on my cheeks. I was also using a new toner at the time so I’m not sure if that also played a factor. I continued to use it for about 5 weeks and nothing changed so I have since taken it out of my routine.
My skin feels so so soft. My skin has been super dry lately and this was so refreshing. I haven’t been using this long so I’m not sure of long term impact, but it’s such a treat.

This lippe balm has the cutest packaging and I like the size of the actual balm stick. The drawback is that using this balm overnight did nothing for my lips, actually they felt a bit more dry. I wanted to love it but it didn’t help my dry winter lips.

I’ve had great results from this brand in the past, and this new oil is no exception! I can tell a lot of time was spent making this a truly lightweight and cosmetically elegant oil. From unboxing the modern, minimalist packaging to massaging the oil into your skin, this is a delight to use.My personal favorite way to use this is mixed into my moisturizer. The combo gives my skin an added emollient characteristic and leaves my skin so glowy!One of my favorite attributes of this brand (and by extension this oil) is their botanical-based hyaluronic acid substitute. I think this is brilliant as while most people adore HA, some report issues. Additionally, there is no added fragrance nor any scent to the product, which can also be an issue for some. It’s thoughtful of the Outset to formulate for a clean and/or sensitive audience. Gifted by The Outset

I have very sensitive skin, so at first I was skeptical to try this mask but I absolutely love it! I usually do it at night before bed and it makes my skin so soft. I use it mainly to get rid of tiny forehead bumps and it has worked wonders. This will definitely be a staple in my skincare routine!
product_name: Mini Rare Earth Deep Pore Minimizing Cleansing Clay Mask

review_text: Wow! I love how weightless this is on my skin and how it instantly gives me a natural glow! I love the merit makeup products so this is perfect for prepping before putting on the minimalist!
product_name: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: This is a staple in my morning skincare routine. I buy this product over and over and use it everyday. This is the only product that I used up several bottles of. I believe it helps my combo acne-prone skin to deal with post-acne marks, redness and texture.

I honestly wanted to love this product but it just doesn’t work for my combination skin. After applying this moisturizer, my skin does not feel hydrated, fresh or glowing as claimed by the company. If anything, my skin looks dry and feels dry. It’s almost winter time in the Midwest and I need that extra moisture to my skin. Im not sure if this moisturizer will be a saving grace during the hot and humid times of the year, but it sadly doesn’t do the job for me.
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: I use this cream each morning throughout the winter months because it has no fragrance and feels comforting on my face. Most day creams have SPF which makes my sensitive skin break out, this does not. The consistency is thick and moisturizing though it absorbs quickly, very good stuff !

this eye cream is nice but if you wear contacts or suffer from dry eye and easily get irritation, then this might not be for you. Otherwise if you none of that applies to you, this is a nice silky eye cream that feels soothing and smoothing.
review_title: NOT SO GOOD FOR CONTACT WEARERS!
product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream

review_text: I got this in a set with a scrub and bath salts. I wish the directions included the ideal amount to use in a bath. There is likely an ideal amount out there. However that might make this bath product unaffordable since a lot must be used per bath to have a decent affect. I did enjoy the coconut milk bath soak. It left my skin feeling hydrated which is a good counter to the bath salts which dehydrate my skin some what drastically. The salts are nice for soothing sore muscles so with the coconut milk bath soak I don’t have to choose I can have both related muscles and hydrated skin is a total win. For the price it would be great to have more product. Also do not get the milk bath soak yet or else it will get weird and hard. Best to be avoided. I would repurchase when I feel like having a luxurious soak but wouldn’t be something I have on hand at all times.

I heard good things about this and was excited to try it, but it didn’t work for me. It wasn’t hydrating enough and gave me tiny reds dots all over my face, it also has alcohol in it which is bad for your skin.
I love this! It smells so good and feels good on the skin.

I’d say for the price it’s alright. It’s just a sunscreen and better than slapping on some coppertop on your face. Not so great under makeup as it has a white cast that even with my fair skin took a little more work to get blended out. I bet it’s more challenging on deeper skin tones. No real moisturizing benefit. Just a plain ol sunscreen but you do get a good 3 ounces for 34 bucks so feel like it would be a good choice if you don’t wear makeup. I much more prefer Josie Maran Argan Daily Moisturizer with SPF 47. Blends in much quicker, moisturizes nicely but lightly and smells nice as well. I’ve been using B-Hydra from DE under to give moisture but not as necessary with the Josie Maran.
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Used it a few times- it’s nice and it exfoliates very wellGlad I got two !

I almost bought this without getting a sample first and I’m glad I didn’t. I used this morning/night for eight days and I really didn’t see any results. It smells nice and dries quickly but it never helped with my skin texture/elasticity/oillines. Never give in to the internet hype folks. Always get your samples first!
SMELLS AMAZING. I feel like it didn’t exfoliate as much as I would like and it almost turned into a balm at the end. I found I broke out more when using this product.
review_title: eh, not worth it in my opinion

review_text: So impressed. I can’t believe how not sticky this is..it dried much faster than I was expecting which is such a plus for me. I did feel like I needed to move a bit faster than I’m used to. I didn’t have to stand in front of a fan in the buff like I usually do waiting to dress. I also usually used a powder to help cut the stickiness but I didn’t need it with this. It also didn’t make me smell putrid! The color came out more brown on me than orange even without having a base tan. The final color wasn’t too dark or too light. I was thinking also I wouldn’t approve of the mitt since I usually like one with a thumb area but its cushiony and super soft. I see why this is on the higher end in price once I used it. Color is believable and even once rinsed off which I did after about 91/2 hrs. It ticks all the boxes for me in terms of what I want in a sunless tan.
review_title: Wasn’t expecting it to be this good

review_text: I haven’t seen a noticeable difference. No plumping or decrease in fine lines. Nice consistency.
This used to be my go-to lip moisturizer. Since they changed the formula, it feels like some cheap drug store moisturizer. Time to look for a new lip moisturizer.
This has changed my skin. I can actually leave my house without putting on foundation. I was always scared to put oil on my face, in fear of looking greasy. This is the ultimate glow.
product_name: Emerald Hemp Seed Deep Moisture Glow Oil

review_text: the product is pretty decent compared to others that i have tried. i was really excited to use this product, as facemasks have always been a fun treat. plus, this brand “origins“ seems to work well with my sensitive skin the majority of the time. however, the moment i applied this facemask, my face burned quite badly. however, i wanted to give it a chance, so i let it continue to dry on my face. once it dried, the burning sensation immediately stopped. once i took it off, the burning sensation was back again. im no “beauty expert,“ but that’s not exactly a “feature“ that i want in my skincare routine. i have tried the other masks from “origins,“ and the same problems continue to reoccur. overall, this product wasn’t a win. :( however, it’s better than their “rose clay mask“ - (in which the burning sensation never stopped.) welp.review = over
product_name: Mini Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pore

review_text: I’ve only had this for a few days and can already see a difference in my skin!! My skin is brighter and much smoother. I’m definitely repurchasing this when I run out. It absorbed very quickly and is much better than any other vitamin C serum I’ve used. My skin was already nice from my old vitamin C serum but got even better within days of starting this. I also love that it has AHA because now I don’t need to use two serums to achieve the same effect. I received this product complimentary from Tatcha and Influenster for testing purposes.
product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA

review_text: Very refreshing on post-wax brows and tired eyes. A lifesaver on hot summer days.

Has a nice consistency to it and I like that the ingredients are clean, however after a few uses it made the skin a little itchy and red. My skin is sensitive especially my eye area so I was hoping the clean ingredients would be ok but unfortunately especially for the price, lack of results, and agitation, I wouldn’t buy again
product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream

review_text: Love this moisturizer. It makes my skin glow! I use it pretty much every day, except in the harsh winter months when my skin needs something stronger. It’s lightweight but leaves you skin looking dewy. It’s also been great for my dark spots.
product_name: C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: Didn’t do much for me with continued, regular use of well over a month. I have had better results with the niacinimide from The Ordinary and sunscreen.
product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum

review_text: I bought this product during the sale. I used it for a few weeks now and it has done nothing for my face. Since I started using the toner my skin peels all over. I stopped using it and the peeling stopped.

I am really sad because this product felt SO amazing on my skin and got rid of dry flakey patches within a few days of use... but it sadly broke me out pretty bad after 2 weeks of using it. I am on my last month of accutane and have had beautiful skin these past months, and this was such a bummer because my skin had such a bad reaction to it :/ I now have tons of tiny under-the-skin bumps all over my face.

review_text: Any one with fungal acne and major sensitivity to some skin irritants or allergens stay away from this . This contains some triggers that maybe cause skin problems . Look at the ingredients and do your homework .

review_text: I’m obsessed with these eye patches. They are so soothing. I use them whenever I haven’t slept enough or have puffy eyes. product_name: Bright Eyes Collagen-Infused Brightening Colloidal Silver Eye Masks

review_text: I bought this specifically for the chocolate one (even though it’s small) & it’s sooo good 🤤 I hope Laneige hears our requests and makes the chocolate flavor in a original size to purchase separately. the only little complaint id have is it can leave a brown color on your lips and for me personally brown lip products doesn’t suit me lol
I like that it has a gentle vanilla smell and is not over-powering. I have very dry/cracking lips in the winter and this has helped tremendously so far.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I have combo/oily skin and I’m not usually not overly sensitive to products. I’ve been using AHA and Vitamin C for a couple years now and haven’t had any issues but I immediately broke out with this product all over my face so I warn the people that may be prone to this. I returned it. Besides that the lightweight consistency might be enjoyable for some but I found it was extremely wasteful. A majority would absorb into my hands before I could even spread it.. it’s like try to pat a little bit of water all over your face before it goes all over your hands or between your fingers... annoying. Meaning you’ll have to use more, going through it quicker and that’s not really something I want an expensive product to do if it’s not benefiting me. If it was a little thicker i would suggest to others but no. My skin instantly cleared up after returning it and I continued to use my previous AHA vitamin C products back to back.
product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA

review_text: I have combination skin with a super oily T-zone by the end of the day. I have been using this product after Drunk Elephant’s C-Firma day serum...my skin is the best it has ever been. Seriously. This moisturizer has an interesting texture because it is lighter than most moisturizers I have used. I know this sounds weird, but it feels like I am putting water on my face. I don’t know how this works, but it must be sorcery, because it absorbs really quickly and lasts for a long time. The texture is basically magic, and I mean that in the best way possible. I have enough acne scars to share with the rest of you nice people, so you could say I have less-than-ideal skin texture. This moisturizer makes my skin feel so soft and smooth. I think I am honestly using less foundation during the day because it goes on more smoothly over this product. I literally never have to blot my face in the afternoon or re-powder late in the day because my face no longer looks like the gross sweaty version of J.Lo’s iconic dewey makeup look. I know this isn’t the cheapest moisturizer on the market, but I use the recommended pearl-size amount and it is plenty. I think it will last me a long time.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: so moisturizing! everything i have used in this line has left my face so happy and healthy. never any irritation or reactions, every morning my face is soft and ready to start the day!
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: I was gifted a sample by La Mer to try this on. La Mer products are always that good, and I am always loving their products. This milky moisturizer with a gel-like texture is really lightweight. It absorbs very quickly and it gives me hydration. I like it so much and will consider it to be part of my routine.

The applicator glides right on and the product is extremely smooth. I have very sensitive under eyes and the product did not cause any irritation. I already see a noticeable difference after two weeks of use. Sunday Riley never disappoints!
I love foreo .. i have luna mini ,tooth brush and this one. I everyday use this with eye cream. It makes me relax and feel good i also recommend to friends and family so great ~

I don’t normally write reviews unless I found an amazing product that I know everyone will love. I have always had very sensitive, problematic skin. I can’t say enough good things about all Kate Somerville products. This one, however, has been a lifesaver for me. My face started going crazy recently and this has completely cleared up my skin in just under a week. It keeps new pimples from forming also. It doesn’t irritate my skin and I love the smell. My face feels so soft and clean after using. I feel like you get a good amount of product for the price too! This is definitely a keeper!

So I received a free sample of this product from Bzz Agent. I was looking forward to trying it out. Unfortunately, I did not see many improvements with its use. I found that it had great moisturizing features. I also noticed a slight improvement in tone lines at the outer eyes. I did not see any improvements in puffiness or any other fine line areas. Of note,I have sampled other products in the past and have had better results with others (Estee Lauder, Avon, Seba Med). Was hoping to give a rave review since I received a sample, but I did not get great results, so for me it’s only a mediocre product.

Feels nice on the lips when you first put it on but I wake up in the morning and my lips feel no less dry than before. Really wanted to like this product but it does nothing for my lips. Will not be repurchasing.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I’ve been using the cleanser for about 2 weeks now and have noticed that my skin feels softer and brighter. I have yet to see if it clears my mild acne. It takes off makeup really well though and it is gentle enough to use on the eyes. Good cleanser for sensitive skin.

I did not like this product. I think it’s a great price, and the top 5 ingredients looked decent, however it felt like a film over my face, didn’t feel hydrating considering theres hyaluronic acid, and there wasnt a significant difference in clearing up blemishes or pores.
review_title: Great price, not so great product

review_text: I received a sample of this product and I definitely will be purchasing it because I love the feel, texture, and smell of this product. It gives my face a smooth, radiant, and healthy look throughout the day. Very satisfied.
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: This was gifted by benefit cosmetics. I was so excited that I got to be one of the firsts to try out the quick smoothing pore mask. it works great. leaves my pores almost invisible and my skin feeling ultra-smooth

This mask is great. It is thick and very moisturizing. I used it every night before bed adding a thicker layer under my eyes. I woke up feeling refreshed and hydrated. It was gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I highly recommend this for anyone with dry skin.

While I won’t say this is a bad product, I will say that it’s just not the product for me. What I liked about it is that it provided a lot of moisture to the skin, but it felt thick on the skin even though you don’t have to use very much of the product. Compared to some other products I’ve used; you didn’t have to use much, and I did appreciate that because that means it’ll last a while. It did feel as if it was clogging my pores though. I did not like that. I did not see much difference when it comes to wrinkles and other skin imperfections, but maybe two weeks was not long enough to see results. Overall, I would not personally use the product, but it may work for others with different skin textures. I do feel that serums work best for me, not creams, so I do not recommend.
product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I wanted this to help with wrinkles and under eye darkness. It seemed to work to help puffiness. But it wore off about 1 hour later. It wasn’t hydrating enough to last the day. I’m sure if I had waited the 10 days, I may have saw a difference. Also, there was a slight burning sensation.
review_title: Just ok, didn't have the patience to "wait
product_name: POWER Advanced Wrinkle Fighter 360° Eye Serum

review_text: This product is ok.... but overpriced. Warning! It looks like there’s a lot of formula inside but there isn’t. The whole top part is just for the press thing so it comes out and you’d think it reaches all the way to the bottom but it’s just a block at the bottom (if you get what I mean). It’s not even the whole thing. It doesn’t reach all the way to the top of the bottle and it doesn’t reach all the way to the bottom either. I’d look for another moisturizer that is worth the price for the amount of formula they’re handing you. And this makes me look like a tomato after I apply it.
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: Love that you finally have these “sweet“ lip balm pots but I’m not wild about sticking my finger in product to smear on my lips. And it doesn’t last very long on the lips. Turn this into a rich butter stick balm that has subtle shine and staying power and you got a deal!

I was really excited to try this product and I was impressed by not only the packaging but quality of the product. It has that nostalgic yet subtle sunblock scent and it doesn’t leave white marks on your face! Protected my skin while I was out in the Texas sun.
product_name: Mini Water Drench  Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45

review_text: I bought this product and originally loved it. After using it the first night my skin wasn’t very oily, and I ignored the thick layer it left on top of my skin. As it got colder, I hated this cream. My skin has always been combination, oily in some places and normal in the others. It was never a big issue. But, my skin started getting dry everywhere besides my T Zone. It was horrible, I started layering moisturizers, but my skin remained dry and just got more oily around my nose. This was very disappointing because I really wanted to love this product.

I dropped a star for it’s not-so-great ingredients for your skin. I don’t believe this should be treated as a typical face mist (a la rose water, hydration step and regular use) however I LOVE the added glow that it gives. I will use this on days I’m going more natural - after moisturizer, spritz all over and let dry. Then top with a light tint and bronzer for a super glowy, natural look. I can’t wait to use this in the summer. Overall a great product but like I said, regular use will not be good for breakout prone skin.
product_name: Self Tan Purity Bronzing Water Face Mist

review_text: This is a must have item in my skin treatment. I can feel a real difference in my skin and removes all the dead skin.

I received this complementary from Influenster for testing. I have been using it daily for a little over a week now. The serum is light and a little goes a long way , so you will get a lot of uses out of one bottle. It dries quickly and is not sticky. I do not have wrinkles quite yet, but fine lines are beginning around my eyes, so I was eager to see how this worked. Though I really haven’t noticed fewer lines, my skin feels wonderful! It is even softer than before, and I feel it looks brighter and even more healthy. So i wouldn’t recomend it for reduction of fine lines and wrinkles, but I would recomend it for skin softening brightening. It is easy to incorporate it into any skin routine and is a quality product. I am glad I had an opportunity to try this serum.
product_name: Kx Active Concentrates Bio-Mimicking Peptides Serum

review_text: I don’t have sensitive skin. For the most part I can try out products and not have a problem. I have been using OLE banana bright line and the GLOW2OH and I loved it. Once I ran out I bought the box set that included this. I immediately felt a burn. Once I finished there were little bumps all over my face. A week later I now have dry patches and horrible texture.
Filmy and broke me out. I have dry skin and never breakout :(

I’ve been using these new Watermelon Glow✨Niacinamide Dew Drops 40 mL that were kindly gifted by Glow Recipe for a few days and I am already obsessed. You know how much I love Niacinamide and the watermelon just takes this to another level. The texture is beautiful and silky, applies like a dream on the skin. It absorbs quickly into the skin and plays well with my other products. It works really great under my bb cream, concealer, and sunscreen. Keeps my skin looking glowy and helped decrease the look of my dark spots.This is truly a product that I will be repurchasing and adding into my permanent skincare routine.

Love this sunscreen! I received this in my complimentary in my vox box and when I got the email I was receiving it I was so excited. Anyone who knows me know I do not leave the house without sunscreen on my face, day or night, rain or shine it is a must. I am very particular about what I put on my face as well as I tend to break out so anything scented is a no! This stick is something I would throw in my bag and take everywhere with me! Perfect for neck area and has not scent! I love the texture and didn’t feel sticky after!

I don’t necessarily feel clean after using this balm, but it did visually remove all traces of my makeup.On first use I followed with another cleanser because the balm is very waxy and I didn’t feel like any of it rinsed of my face. The second time I used a warm cloth to remove the balm and that was much better. There is still a residue left on the skin, but my face felt comfortable and I didn’t notice clogged pores or even a buildup of oil.I would personally recommend this balm for mornings or otherwise when there is no makeup or sunscreen on the face. It’s just too waxy unless you use more product than necessary.The reason I’m rating this so low is because it really irritates my eyes when I’ve used it to remove makeup. I don’t have this issue with my regular cleansing balm or cleansing oils I’ve used previously. I have chronic dry eyes and that’s simply unacceptable to me.

This was a disappointing purchase. I bought this product because after using a very expensive vitamin C serum that left my face and neck covered with tiny bumps, I was hoping this product would reduce their appearance and maybe even make them go away. Well, I’m almost done the 120 ml bottle I bought and while the bumps have calmed down in appearance, my acne has returned. I gave this product 2 stars because despite the bumps and acne returning, I do have a more even looking skin tone (possibly even a glow) but not enough to convince me to buy this product a second time.

I loved it for straight 2 years. It was perfect for my dry acne prone skin - the only cream that felt good, did not cause irritation or rush, sit well under make-up, etc. Just perfect overall. And then one day I got this formula - I wake up with dry patches on my skin, make up doesn’t stay on and after four day of use I got acne (first time since I switched to Farmacy 2 years ago). It’s just straightforward sad Be aware, might cause you acne

review_text: Received this in the Sephora Sunscreen Kit. Put it on and immediately had to take it off and try something else. Was thicker than glue. Threw it out. Don’t waste your money

review_text: I really wanted to love this product but, this just don’t do it for me. I never felt like it “cleaned” my skin and I needed more product than usual to wash my face.

I have to admit, I purchased the product on the name alone, as well as the promise. I was told that it would take at least two months to see any signs of progress. That’s some selling tool, because some fools-- me being one in this case-- end up shelling out even more. I’m not buying anything from this line ever again (and I buy a lot of skincare products, so too bad for them) because the false promise made me angry. There was absolutely no change in the so called promise of diminishing lines. If anything, after the two months, I noticed more of them. The are many products that promise to ’blur’ lines right now, and they do so by giving the product a certain consistency that works with light, so that while you are wearing it, especially in the first half hour, it can provide an illusion of lines being diminished-- just as regular makeup can provide an illusion of skin that has less discolorations, is brighter, evener, etc. But it’s a temporary illusion, and when you wash it off, it’s gone. With a product such as this, what it promises to do is change the skin itself, and with “Needles No More“ this absolutely is not true. Even the temporary illusion that come be part of the promise-- in line with other ’blurring’ products-- is not true. Again, it is a very great name for a product, and I see why they jumped in and put the TM sign next to it. The price is ridiculous, and for buyers who are more gullible (yes, like myself) the higher price is further deception that it is expensive because it works. I am looking forward to this product being obliterated like the facial lines it promises to obliterate. There are many other options out there, and other creams and lotions that don’t overpromise or come with such a ridiculous pricetag. Of all the products I’ve bought in my time, and that’s been a huge lot-- this one made me the most mad.

review_text: Very dissapointed in my order. I ordered a lot of mini sizes because I wanted to try a brunch of new products. product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

After using it for two weeks and seeing nothing extraordinary I returned it and got my full refund. It’s not worth the investment, you can find better cleansers out there. I received this as a complimentary sample. Texturally it was great but I didn’t notice any difference. I would not purchase this for the smoothness alone. I live in AZ and didn’t find it moisturizing at all.
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I received a free sample of the Origins GinZing brightening serum a few weeks ago, and I can’t write enough good things about it. From all the serums I’ve tried in the past few months, this one was the one that gave me the best results. My skin was feeling and looking dull after the hot months of summer and after using this product every day for a couple of weeks, my skin is now glowing and my pores have shrunk in size. My only issue with the product was the fragrance. I usually prefer fragrance-free products and this one has a citric scent, which is not overpowering but you can definitely smell it. Other than that, the product does what it says.I will be buying this product again because it has really done wonders for my skin!
product_name: GinZing Into the Glow Brightening Serum

review_text: Wonderful product. It removes my makeup and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and hydrated. I’m on my second jar.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I bought the small size first because I wanted to make sure I wouldn’t break out like others that have left reviews. I have very sensitive skin but I did not have any type of reaction and definitely see a slight difference in skin. It does give a skin glow before bed and although I have no wrinkles I feel the benefits will be good for someone that might as it gives a smoothing effect.

As much as I love the smell of this moisturizer, it doesn’t really behave like one. Two hours after application, it starts peeling on my skin. Makes my skin look dull and dead. I am never buying this again and I wouldn’t even recommend getting it.
product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: For $25, this is perfect. It’s NOT worth spending $50-$100 on the ridiculously expensive versions of the SAME THING. This does the trick, is nice and cooling, and is great quality. Highly recommend.
review_title: LOVE! Don't spend $$$ on expensive ones!

review_text: This product is super gentle which is great for my sensitive skin!!! It does have a pretty orange tint to it and I’m pale so it’s very obvious on me. It’s helped with my texture, haven’t noticed much of a difference in couple pimples but they are most hormonal so those can be lawless.
product_name: Argan Beta Retinol Pink Algae Serum

review_text: I always thought I had really oily skin, but it turns out I’m getting old, and it was just oily because I was using products that were way too harsh. This is perfect. Tingles but doesn’t sting.

this vitamin c is amazing .... it doesn’t irritate my skin at all (which is what happens with every other vitamin c I try to use ... aka l ascorbic acid) this one doesn’t oxidize after being used in three weeks and it has.great ingredients ... minimal ingredients which is awesome .... if u want a good vitamin c I would recommend this one to anyone .... I’m so happy they came out with this man it’s making my skin so clear and bright. and doesn’t break the bank love it
product_name: Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% in Vitamin F

review_text: The Aqua Bomb makeup removing cleansing balm is a 3 step texture cleanser that removes the impurities and makeup smoothly from the skin. It is a really hydrating and moisturizing formula that leaves the skin feeling refreshed. It is really hydrating that makes my skin feel really smooth and soft. The citrus scent is really soothing and smells really natural. I like belif products because it is a brand that is free from harmful ingredients and is really natural for the skin.

I love love love this product! great daily either alone or under makeup! the only hang up i have is the packaging- the iridescent print comes off onto hands if you have any kind of residue from other products like moisturizer or oil so sometimes i find the little sparkles on my face but eventually the entire print “unseen sunscreen“ wore off. either way i its a small price to pay for a bomb product

You guys. I am OBSESSED with this product. I have been suffering from mild rosacea and super dry flaky skin. My skin is also very sensitive which is why I am so hesitant to try new products. My skin would burn after a shower I believe due to my skin barrier being ruined. Ever since I started consistently using this cream and its cleanser, my skin has been so much smoother. I am SO impressed with this cream. No more burning/drying of the skin after showers! I think I might’ve found my holy grail.

Best ever..I just do not understand the negative reviews. I never have pilling...goes on like a dream. I wait a few minutes for dry down and I can apply foundation or just powder over it and it looks awesome all day. I have an oily t-zone but it does not break down through the day or fight with any of my foundations.
product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Wearing a sad face because I first tried this when it didn’t come in plastic and didnt look like a generous sample. It used to do wonders for the day after partying. I bought it expecting that same efficacy. I was disappointed that this upscale luxury brand bought into the cheap is better policy and put it in a plastic tube but at luxury prices. It did nothing for me. I wasn’t particularly tired. I did expect to look even more rested. Nope. Nada. Zip nothing. It made my foundation go on smoother as a moisturizing primer but I have plenty of things to do that. I won’t buy again.
review_title: Old school was a better school
product_name: Midnight Secret Late Night Recovery Treatment Anti-Fatigue Serum

review_text: I’m genuinely surprised at the negative reviews for this product. I had tried some of the Colorescience products before this and they gave me a rash. This product has been amazing for me. I love the texture and my makeup goes on great over the top.
product_name: Daily Dose Vitamin C + SPF 40 Sunscreen Serum PA+++

review_text: I did not see any improvements after about one month of use. My face actually looked and felt way more oily after I put this on.

This product is a magical potion I have seen a change in my skin within two weeks of use, including a change in texture, lightening of dark spots and evening out of skin tone.. SKII provided this product for free, however, I’m hooked and will continue to use!!!

This product (and brand) exceeded my expectations! The texture alone of the serum is (as it says) milky, but sinks in & feels wonderful... Genuinely feels like a one & done hydrating and brightening serum!. The ingredients are wonderful, the packaging is incredible... I’m hooked!
product_name: Milk Marvel Dark Spot Serum with Niacinamide and Vitamin C

review_text: the texture was fine, but I really hate the fake coconut scent (eww...)
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: not a fan, I’ve tried this over 2 different moisturizers and it pills like crazy over both. it also offers absolutely no coverage. minus the pilling, the finish is lovely over my sahara dry skin. if this didn’t pill so badly I’d keep it to use as a sunscreen but I’ll be returning this.
product_name: C Beyond Triple Serum SPF 40 Mineral Sunscreen with Vitamin C 10% + Niacinamide

review_text: So far so good. I’ve been using this for about two weeks now as my day time moisturizer. I love using a good gel cream moisturizer when from spring to fall especially living in NYC. my favorite is definitely the Volition beauty yaupon tea moisturizer. I love that it’s packed with nutrition for the skin. It’s light weight and wears sooo well under both the physical and chemical sunscreen is I use daily. My skin never feels thigh nor do I get that oily sheen with this even with sunscreen on. It’s just a nice healthy glow. I have broken out because of this and but that’s also because I’m mindful of ingredients that I do react to and what breaks me out in products. I’m sure I’ll be using this jar till the end of summer because a little goes a long way. I just wished it had a spatula to scoop the product out with but I use one from another moisturizer I use in the night time.

I have dry dehydrated skin (even in the summer) so a ‘hydrating’ sunscreen would be nice but overall I’m looking for something light and soaks in. This sunscreen feels exactly like a thicker Smashbox Original Photo Finish Primer, heavy and like an uncomfortable layer of silicone. This did not set and made my face feel gross all day. Not that I necessarily wanted it to set (and clog my pores) but it would rub and transfer when the slightest touch of anything touched my face. I guess it worked as sun protection but I just cannot get over the feeling. If you are OK with the texture, I guess I would recommend this.

I have combo skin: sensitive, very dry spots, tendency towards oiliness in the T-zone, and frequent mild breakouts. I don’t think I could live without this cleanser...It leaves my skin CLEAN, but not one bit stripped. It removes all traces of makeup, even waterproof eyeliner and mascara with a little massaging. It’s really so gentle but so thorough at the same time. I also love the ingredient list: the abundance of beneficial oils actually helps to control skin’s oil production, and it has no parabens. I have used this for about 2.5 years and I have stopped at a couple of points but I always come back because there is just nothing better! I always wonder what made me stray, but it won’t happen again. Also love the light smell...fresh and natural. Price isn’t too bad either as it lasts quite a while.
I love this product I use it at least once a day the scent is heavenly makes skin feel soft and rejuvenated after use highly recommend (a little goes a long way)
product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: Whenever my skin gets dehydrated or if I use a product that didn’t work, my eczema breaks out. I always trust Skinfix and they never disappoints. This cream has the perfect texture and feels amazing on the skin. Contains some of my favorite ingredients: aloe, peptides, seaweed. If you’re looking for a cream that is safe for problematic skin, Skinfix got you! Received as a gift from Skinfix.
I bought this because of the vitamin C but it makes my skin feel greasy.
product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: I have dry/combo skin that is NOT sensitive. I had a travel size tube of this cream and used it as I ran out of my normal moisturizer. The first time I used it, within minutes I experienced splotchy redness all over my cheeks and forehead. I figured my skin just wasn’t used to it, so I kept giving it a go. Each time, I experienced the same redness - my skin felt slightly hot as well, and the smell of this cream is not one I enjoy. I don’t know what’s in it that made my skin react the way it did, especially because this cream is supposed to COMBAT redness, but it had a paradoxical effect on me. It’s just not for me.
review_title: Irritated my skin - not for me

review_text: I hate these. Unpacking them, getting them to stick. Every time I use them I’m annoyed enough that I wanted to leave a negative review.
review_title: My tip: Get a different kind

review_text: ! I have been using this now for several weeks and have been very impressed. I got this free from caudalie in exchange for a review and I have loved the benefits.
