product_name: Premier Cru Anti Aging Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: It’s light and not overly drying, a decent second cleanser but nothing really spectacular. I like the glass bottle, and the amount of product is a good value. Unfortunately, something in this causes very stubborn, tiny breakouts. Not for me.

Just bought this and have been using it for a week. It not only dried my super oily skin out but burned me around my mouth so I look like I have a little red mustache, I’m so disappointed because I was so excited to use this product.
This is a great mask, leaving your skin feel soft. I recommend using it 2x a week and you’ll notice fabulous results. The price is great too!
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I have dry lips in the winter and for years have had success with Carmex. But I wanted something with a tint. This seemed very promising and at the price I figured it had to work. Sad about this one.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: It does a great job as a sunscreen, it save your hand from getting sticky, keep your hand clean and easy to apply. However, it doesn’t work as it promote that can be use over makeup! I don’t know do I really recommend this product or not. I will say yes if you only want a sunscreen, but definitely no if you are buying it for its “apply over makeup“ feature!
Received this as a sample and I loved it! Buying full size for the sephora sale coming up.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

product_name: Superscreen Daily Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

review_text: I used this after a bad breakout, and all of my zits on my cheeks and chin are GONE! The smell is very potent, but I’ll deal with that if it means clear skin. I will DEFINITELY be purchasing from Sunday Riley again.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: My favorite part about this cleanser is how thick the gel is. It stays on your face well while washing, instead of running off your face like thinner liquids too. review_title: Caution if you have sensitive skin

review_text: I read some of the reviews before trying this but no one ever mentioned the taste. It’s pretty terrible in my opinion. I only did one day and couldn’t continue on. This product, even though its sort of like rubbing sand all over your face, somehow didn’t irritate my skin. My pores felt clean, tight, and appeared smaller which I love because I have lots of huge pores in my T-zone particularly on the sides of my nose. I had tried a few Ole products in the past and had always been a little “meh“ about them. However, this new “balance“ line has been great for me. I’ve used the cleanser and hydrator and I do feel as though they help control the oily areas of my combination skin. This product is definitely the best one in line though.
Love it. Refreshing clean skin. Wonderful smell. Less breakouts.
product_name: Mini Clarifying Blemish & Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: This is not recommended for women of color. Specifically black women. I had heard of others trying this product and it leaving a white cast on their skin. I wanted to try it for myself and see, so I bought the smaller jar. I do hope in the future they come out with a formula that is more inclusive. It’s a great concept, just not meant for everyone.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: This product is super thick. I feel like it just sits on top on my skin and not hydrating at all. I’ve notice if I use a very small amount it’s not as thick & film like feeling on my face.

In LOVE with this product. I was trying to simplify my beauty routine and wanted to combine my lotion/primer steps into one product. Found it! I originally had the Origins Primer, which is a couple dollars cheaper, but to have a 2 in 1 product from the same brand? sold. This lotions leaves a soft matte look that works beautifully under foundation. Doesn’t break me out - while keeping my skin moisturized. The size is small but it lasted me 5 months of daily use. Highly recommend
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: I got a sample of this moisturizer and LOVED it enough that I ended up purchasing it. Crazy thing is my skin is pretty oily

I bought this hoping it would deliver what it claims too. I have very oily skin and some adult break outs. product_name: Superfood Hydrate + Firm Peptide Eye Cream

product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: I have bad adult acne. This face wash was not very effective for me for whatever reason.

This is probably the most excited I’ve been for an Influenster VoxBox because I’ve started investing more in my skincare so I can divest some in my makeup in the last year or so. High end products have made a huge difference! When I received this, my first thought was that it smelled heavenly! It really does. It didn’t break me out, which was also a plus. But I also didn’t feel like it had any observable benefits. My skin wasn’t any softer or more moisturized. If anything, it was missing my usual hydrating toner. However, I do use actives in the evening so my skin might just require more moisture to replenish what I’m losing by way of stripping with acids and/retinoids. Overall, I think this would be great for someone who may not need a ton of extra moisture but likes a little boost under their moisturizer without feeling like an entire new layer of skincare is sitting on their face, but I wouldn’t invest in this for my skincare lineup.

review_text: This cleanser is very gentle. It has a light, sweet scent that is not overwhelming. I like to use this in the morning because it doesn’t strip my skin. A sample was all that was needed to convince me to purchase the full size! Yes, the applicator takes a bit of getting used to, but it’s definitely effective in getting rid of most of my puffiness with its cool touch. Then the serum works its magic and I’m left with brighter, tighter, younger-looking skin around my eyes!
product_name: Advanced Génifique Yeux Light-Pearl Eye Serum

review_text: This moisturizer is proving to be amazing. It feels so luxurious and hydrating on my skin. It’s important to me to use clean ingredients so this was a huge plus for me. So far I’m very impressed and can’t wait to see my skin continue to improve.

I wanted to love this product so badly. I am a licensed aesthetician and take my skincare routine very seriously. I received a sample of the Retinol Reform serum and was excited to try it. After almost 2 weeks of using it every other night (to allow for an adjustment period) I am having the worst breakouts I’ve had in my adult life. It is absolutely insane. I haven’t changed anything else in my routine or lifestyle so this is most likely the culprit. I didn’t have any other adverse reactions like stinging or peeling so I am surprised by this. It does look like maybe there was an ingredient change when this was brought to Sephora (and the price lowered) so I wonder if the quality was effected.

review_text: Smells amazing and tastes ok. My lips feel better and don’t peel and crack anymore.

Very hydrating and luxurious face lotion. I use it as the lat step of my nighttime routine and it really seals everything in. I have dry skin so I’m excited to use it during the colder months!

I have never had a product make me break out, but this one did. Before I broke though, I still wasn’t a fan of the product because it was so heavy and the solution didn’t blend in well with my skin tone.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_title: Far too drying to be called Ultra Repair

review_text: Used the entire jar, no positive difference whatsoever.

I received this as part of a promo in exchange for a review . I’ve used glycolic products before so the idea wasn’t new to me but I did not love this product... I’d pass on this product

I was gifted by[Sephora] GOOPGLOW 15 percent Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel. Absolutely loved it! My skin went from dull and lifeless to soft and glowing. Unlike some products that only leave a filmy layer of fake glow and softness, my actual skin was soft and naturally glowing.
product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_title: GoopGlow Is a YES for me!

review_text: I brought this serum after seeing the great reviews it had on Sephora. But I used it for two days and I started getting prickly heat bumps all over my face. Such a waste of time and money. Please think several time bring buying this product.
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: This product made me break out :( I ended up giving it to someone else. Wish I could’ve returned it.
product_name: Green Tea Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Serum

review_text: My first time trying this product but I am a huge fan of this brand. I love the texture of this cream as it is very moisturizing but absorbs quickly into the skin and works very well under makeup as a base. It’s light but absorbs well into the skin and nice light scent. The jar itself is very cute and girly which I love. The product was gifted by innisfree but the opinions are my own.
product_name: Dewy Glow Moisturizer with Cherry Blossom & Niacinamide

review_text: I was gifted a sample of these cream and the consistency feels like a pore minimizer by benefit. I didn’t feel like it hydrated my face at all. After applying the cream I waited several minutes to apply my foundation, my skin didn’t look good. I’ve tried other wonderful products from lamer, but this is not for me.

Love this product! I have combos skin with hormonal acne and this one is the perfect cleansing balm for my first cleanse. It removes makeup, does not leave a residue or oily feeling on my face, and does not irritate my sensitive acne-prone skin.
product_name: Clearly Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Amazing product!! I have sensitive skin and started using this 1-2 times a week. Did not have any breakouts or reactions. The product has a slight yellow tint and feels slightly sticky when applied but the feeling disappears in 30 seconds. My first retinol product and I highly recommend!

I wanted to love this product. I definitely felt the hydration and noticed that my skin was plump throughout the day. UNFORTUNATELY, being acne prone, this product BROKE ME OUT. Cystic bumps around the side of my face, chin, and forehead. If you’re not acne prone, this is a great product to try. Just didn’t work for me.
product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I received this product free from Influenster. I usually hate sunscreens, especially on my face. This is a great sunscreen and doesn’t make my face feel gross.
product_name: Every Sun Day Sun Fluid SPF 50+

review_text: the product causes so much pilling if i use it after a hyaluronic acid serum which is super disappointing because i wanted to love it
It’s simple to use, and lasts a while. I honestly don’t know if it does anything for me but I like knowing it’s there. It’s refreshing, for sure.
product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist

review_text: I was excited to try this but it really didn’t work for me. I don’t know how other ladies are loving this but I will never use it again. I normally use sunscreens with moisturizers because I have dry skin. I found that wearing this under makeup and alone will cause issues. When I wore it under makeup, it made my skin dry and caked up throughout the day. Not only that but if you sweat and the weather is hot out, it will look horrible! It basically built up my sweat and makeup and did not make me look cute at all. When I touched my forehead where I sweated, there were small clumps of sweat and makeup rolled up. Even alone it has this issue. There will be this weird texture. If you sweat or the weather is hot, it’ll look gross if you happen to touch your face. I do not recommend. Worst sunscreen I’ve used yet.
This cream is a terrible waste of money. Heavy, greasy and now that I’m stuck with it I’ll have to use it for hand cream. I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone!
review_title: No better than the cheapest item at the drugstore

review_text: I am impressed with this toner! I feel like it does take away dirt and buildup! Also I feel like my skin glows after using this.

Love the brand but this particular lip mask is so unpleasant for me — like rubbing sugar on my lips. In contrast, I really enjoyed using the rose petal lip balm. So soft with a faint and pleasant rose smell.
product_name: Sugar Recovery Lip Mask Advanced Therapy

review_text: I wanted to love this line, I really did - but nothing wowed me! This serum did nothing for the texture or the look of my skin. I was disappointed that I never noticed a difference, except that it made my cheeks more pink.

I applied this and left it on for 3 hours- nada. I’m a redhead, with truly pale skin, and my skin did not change color at all. I’ve used several tanning mousses in the past so I’m well versed on how to apply it. Absolutely returning.
It takes off makeup but the texture is soooo weird i prefer to double cleanse
I miss my sol stick. This product smells weird and no SPF

I saw Desi Perkin’s recommendation for this and thought I would give it a try since she has dry skin like me. Bad idea... SO SO drying. Made me breakout even more and have flakey patches of skin. Will be returning.
This reminds me a drugstore brand’s blurring primer. Same consistency, same results. A waste of money.

I purchased this as a “splurge” birthday present for myself because I need help in the brightening department.I honestly feel like I wasted my money, this does nothing, I’ve been using this once a week for 3 months if you want to throw away your money on a nice smelling and pretty purple mask sure buy this, but I have already dehydrated skin this makes it worse.Over hyped garbage.
Broke me out!! I use the green tea oil free ole henricksen cleanser and it works great. This one broke me out!! Don’t buy.
Oxidized. Returned. I refuse to wear products from companies who don’t know how to shade match or make oxidization not an issue.
product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40

review_text: Maybe I’m looking for the miracle face treatment but this definitely was not it. After a month, I did not notice any significant results. I’ve been treating my face for years for maybe I’m maxed out as far as over the counter products.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This cleanser is a fairly good mild exfoliant! It has the best orange scent, which I love love love smelling. It foams up really fast so you can’t use too much at once. The other GinZing products pair well with the scrub!I received this product free for testing.
I love the scent and the way my skin feels hydrated with this cleanser, not “squeaky“ like some other cleansers. A little bit goes a long way, this will last a few months. Hard to beat.
product_name: Confidence in a Cleanser Hydrating Facial Cleanser Serum

review_text: I think my expectations were too high. This does NOT foam like a cleanser. It’s more like a cleansing balm or oil. That being said, it does work well for removing makeup. The smell is a bit chemical-ish, I can’t quite place the fragrance. It’s fine, and very gentle on my sensitive skin. For the price it’s very good. I will use this, but unsure if I will purchase again. Maybe I’ll fall in love over time, we’ll see.

Received this product for free from Supergoop. Sunscreen is really important to keep your skin healthy when you are outside in the sun even when it is cloudy out! The texture is was pretty good, did not have any issues with a white cast with my skintone. Not a big fan of the shimmer though.
Too watery for my liking would not recommend personally. Wish there was a thicker consistency.
product_name: Dr. Andrew Weil for Origins Mega-Mushroom Relief & Resilience Soothing Treatment Lotion

review_text: I love the soft and dewy way my skin feels after applying, but its been a week now and I am beginning to noticeably break out. The smell and texture are nice but this product is just not agreeing with my skin. I used it many years ago with no problems but I think my mid-40’s skin is a bit more sensitive. I’m going to try the gel version out to see if that is better.
review_title: Nice product but not for me

review_text: I bought this product in the first place because I thought certain parts of my face are extremely oily. After using this cream I realized all the excess oil produced on my skin was compensating the dry skin. This product worked on my cheeks. But it turned out to be extremely drying when it came in contact with my T-zone. It got so bad that peeling and redness of skin began to occur. I would only recommend if your overall face is truly oily

WOW! This is such a great tool. I love to use it to apply my skincare - serums and creams. It’s not only feels cooling but vibrates. It helps me with Dr puffing, lifting and firming my skin. Also helps me to define the contour.

I’ve been testing this serum complimentary from Sulwhasoo for 2 weeks now and have been loving it! The texture is a thin consistency and sinks into the skin almost immediately. I love to use this while my skin is damp with an essence or mist for increased moisture. This is such a great hydrating layer underneath my moisturizer! It wears beautifully under the other products in my routine and doesn’t pill like some other hydrating serums can. I really love the instant glow boost this gives!
product_name: First Care Activating Serum 25th Anniversary Limited Edition

review_text: I do not have sensitive skin. This product burns around my eyes for hours. I wanted it to work out.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Absolutely love the new lip pops. This watermelon one is my favorite of the two, smells/tastes exactly like the watermelon mask/moisturizer/toner they launched. The texture is smoothing and juicy, just the cutest little lip balm. Its supposed to be ’exfoliating’ but it’s not a harsh scrub at all just makes them feel soft and smooth! Big fan I have purchased multiples of both the blueberry and watermelon. Did receive one gifted by Glow Recipe

I received this for free in exchange for a review. I’m trying to up my skin care game since I’m almost 30, so I’ve tried a lot of different moisturizers and serums. I like that this one doesn’t have an overwhelming smell or leave my face feeling sticky. I have noticed a firming effect after using this for a few weeks, so I would definitely recommend this to others.

I got this in a sample size and used it for a few days but I found it to be heavy and tacky. It did sink in but left my skin looking dull, not radiant. I also was turned off by the fragrance. I think there are better anti-oxidants out there than Vitamin C and Vitamin E. If I had paid full price for this stuff, it would have gone back.
product_name: C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: I have tried several cheaper brands and they seemed ok but I really wanted eye patches that worked for my mini vacation. These patches aren’t bad but I definitely didn’t see a difference between these and the ones for much cheaper.
product_name: Benefiance WrinkleResist24 Pure Retinol Express Smoothing Eye Mask

review_text: I absolutely love Belif’s various moisturizers - this one is on the lower end of the list though. Works great, but don’t think it’s really any different than their others. Also it’s a little pricey.
product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream

review_text: I honestly didn’t like this product. I don’t find it effective and I dont like the consistency. I want to like it, but I simply don’t.
review_title: I want to like it but I don't

review_text: I bought this in hopes it would clear up my acne, after a week or so of using it my acne got worse but they say sometimes it gets worse before it gets better, so I kept using it. After about a month n a half I gave up my acne was worse then ever. Didn’t remove my make up either

This is my first time trying out this brand and to be honest I was kind of skeptical about the product, it has a gel/slime like consistency and quiet creamy. You have to give this product some time to work its magic. If you have dry skin esp during this coming season, this product will be your best friend. Love how it seal in the moisture at the same time leaves your skin plump, makes it look glowy. Maybe with time you can see the brightening effect, but for now I love the moisture retention properties. Def recommend it.
product_name: Triple Vitamin C Brightening Bounce Cream Moisturizer

review_text: I received this as a sample. Wow! The texture and appearance of my skin after 3 uses is greatly improved. Definitely buying the full size this week. You need a VERY small amount. It tingles after application but doesn’t burn. Don’t get on your lips or around eyes.
product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I was pretty happy with the roller, but then the glue failed and it came apart after maybe 10 uses. Unacceptable considering the price.

I heard all good reviews so I got myself a trial size. I’m glad that I did not get the full size. I broke into hives. I am guessing I am allergic to an ingredient of this cream. So I you are thinking of purchasing this, try first before you commit to a full bottle
I received a sample of this. It hydrated pretty well and provided a smooth canvas for makeup. It’s not magic in anyway whatsoever, especially at this price point.
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I really wanted to love this product but it is too acid for my eye area so could not use it.
product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist

review_text: wanted something to deal with the redness in my cheeks forehead and nose area and the lady that was helping recommended this as well as the Dr. P cold plasma. the cold plasma smelled like old DUO eyelash glue so went for this one.Very lightweight but moisturizing. haven’t noticed a significant reduction in my redness but my skin is loving this creme. my skin feels a lot more plumper, softer and brighter. it looks as though my skin texture and tone has gotten 5 yrs younger. This is my first Caudalie product and will most definatetly be replacing all my other skincare products with theirs as soon as they run out.

Ok I’m already obsessed. I was mesmerized by the packaging! It’s so luxurious! I was afraid the product was going to leave my skin oily but it doesn’t! It also has my favorite ingredients, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. This stuff leaves my skin glowy!! So far it’s a win!
product_name: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Terrible. It hardly got anything out of my pores and felt like a burning ice etching against my skin. It’s word to use AND it doesn’t work?? Next!
product_name: DERMAPORE Ultrasonic Pore Extractor & Serum Infuser

review_text: I received this product a few days back Thanks to influester and Kiehl’s for free, and I love it , I been using this every day, Everytime I get out of the shower my face is a little dry because of the products I use to wash my face with and I use this facial cream and honestly it leaves my face so soft and smooth,I just love it , I totally recommend it
product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: I’ve been using this for almost a month and I’ve noticed a slight change as my dark circles are going away and they are starting to make my undereye look smoother not so puffy. But Retinol is 5th from last on the ingredients list and it just not really cutting it. Plus if I get it to close to my eyes not even in my eyes they start to water so I need to be careful not to do this in the dark ha. But yes it’s okay not the best is save your cash and time and take it elsewhere cuz it really does not make that good of a difference aside from brightness a bit

Iv been really loving this cream. It is so creamy but goes on smooth without feeling caked on. I only use a tiny bit to use on my whole face. It does have a strong scent it kind of reminds me of bar soap. It’s not terrible but not my favorite. I do get a little tingle after applying the cream on my face but I haven’t had any signs of irritation and it actually leaves my skin feeling so smooth and hydrated. Iv only been using this product for about a week but the results have been great so far.
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

review_text: I honestly couldn’t get past the smell. It is SO heavily scented. It smells like perfume which I am incredibly sensitive to. It gave me a headache every time I put it on. I threw the sample away after trying it twice.

Not worthy of calling the JLo glow. Save your cash, other products are more effective. I’ve been using for a month and it has no effect. I’m late 30s, and actually do have glowing, JLo-like skin and this has made it feel lackluster. The bad scent makes it feel like it’ll work too...and it doesn’t.
product_name: That Jlo Glow Brightening & Firming Serum with Niacinamide

review_text: Almost 30 days of use and no change at all. Had high expectations from all the hype and reviews. I am very Disappointed. I’ll continue to use until finished but probably won’t repurchase.
product_name: Brightening Dark Spot Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I love Farmacy products and have been wanting to try this. got a sample and used it with my evening routine,it started burning all over my face immediately. I couldn’t let it stay 5 seconds before I had to wipe it all off. I was very disappointes.
product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I got a sample size of this face serum and had it sitting around for some time, and then I decided to try it. I used it only a couple of times and was completely blown away. First of all it goes on like silk, leaving my skin with a velvety finish almost immediately. only a few small dabs cover my whole face well. I always mist my face with a toner to allow me to use less of my costly skin products. I noticed right away that my skin felt buttery soft and smooth after applying this serum. I also noticed that my fine lines were less noticeable and I was looking really closely LOL!!! I am definitely going to buy the full size of this product. I have never been a great lover of Estee Lauder products. I kind of associated EL as an older woman’s make up line, but I guess I am an older woman now so here I am. Just kidding I was really wowed by this serum and it does what it says it does. well worth the money, just apply sparingly and the full size bottle should last quite a long while. I am actually not finished with my tiny tester sized bottle yet. LOL
Was really excited about this product but after almost a month of gradual to regular usage I can say it does not work for me, my skin actually is going through a flare up right now.
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: SO SO good!! Love for transition from summer to fall, keeps my skin feeling healthy
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: I received this product from Sephora Collection in exchange for my honest review. Just what my face has been needing! After using this I’ve immediately noticed a difference in the texture of my face and the amount of significantly less dryness around my mouth area. Definitely would recommend!

I use this in the morning after applying marula oil so that it absorbs better into the skin. Minor tingling/burning, especially the first few times I used it, but I’ve noticed less cystic pimples since I’ve started using it. Plus, the price point of this entire line is unbeatable.

I read a bunch of reviews before buying this thinking it will be great, but sadly it wasn’t. It’s an ok moisturizer if the price point was 15-20 bucks I’d say it’s good for its price but $84 for just an ok moisturizer? It didn’t exceed all my expectations it was just average, maybe even below average. Also if you twist the bottom off and really look at how much product you’re getting you’re hardly getting any for $84!!! So it’s ok and you barley get any for $84. You could get Aveeno moisturizer for so much cheaper and get a lot of product. Save your money!!! I find something better!!

I had really high hopes for this product, but it didn’t even make things better. This product is not go for winter weather. I constantly had to reapply because it would dry up within mins of using. It didn’t moisturize at all. The texture for this product felt more like a gel. I rather use other products than this.
product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I wanted to love this product! It’s feels amazing when you initially put it on, but that feeling did not last with me. I found myself grabbing my old moisturizer while using this because it made me skin feel more dry after the initial intense hydration feeling wore off. I didn’t feel like it kept my skin moisturized all day like I had hoped.

I bought the blue cartridge with hydrating jelly during summer thinking it would help with my pores and uneven skin tone & texture as well as be a light weight moisturizer for my oily / combination skin. But I was super disappointed. Even though I love a few of Clinique products (esp Total turnaround night moisturizer), this one did nothing what it claimed. No difference in my skin texture and pores size and the hydrating jelly is not moisturizing at all. I even tried using it with Clinique dramatically different moisturizer, but the blue cartridge still failed to work magic (the dramatically different lotion is amazing on its own though). In short....the blue cartridge does not do what it claims.
product_name: Clinique iD:  Moisturizer + Concentrate for Pores & Uneven Texture

review_text: Absolutely have been loving this serum!! Vitamin C can be tricky and tends to smell if not done right but hyper got it done right because it does not have a weird smell. It performs like an expensive vitamin c but I think this one is at the perfect price point. I love the texture because it feels so nice. It has left my skin looking so youthful and glowy. Totally recommend!
product_name: Brightening Dark Spot Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I got a trial size of this that I’ve been using for just over a week. At first I really liked it, but eventually found it to not be very moisturizing at all. I put it on at night and would wake up with dry skin. I need to wear an oil on top if I want the moisture to last. I have combo skin, so the texture sinks in nicely and based on people’s reviews I thought this would be a home run, but overall it just doesn’t work for me.

I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica. This smart response serum is amazing. I like its smell and how light it’s. it absorbed quickly, moisture well. My skin looks healthier and bright.
In my opinion this Didn’t tan deep skin at all. There are better options for deep skin.
Very moisturizing, absorbs well. Doesn’t seem to clog pores. Doesn’t contain fake scent which is good for my skin but def need to apply only at night, doesn’t smell terrible but not good either
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: I have combination skin and was on the market for a more light weight moisturizer that I could put on under my make up. The Tatcha Water Cream is light weight for sure. When you put it on, it does absorb quickly and does feel like water. Unfortunately, like water, it did not moisturize my face adequately. It felt like it disappeared quickly and left my fine lines, wrinkles and dry spots still thirsty. It would be good for you if you don’t want much moisturizing ability but this is not for you if you have marginally dry skin or even somewhat dry patches. It would work well for you if you have oily skin.
review_title: Not Enough Moisture - Just Like Water
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Not bad for price. Does the job but is a little sticky

I knew Clinique changed the formula for superdefense, but I was hoping it would be okay. It is not. This formula has caused my face to break out and has produced dry patches. Now I’m on a search for a new moisturizer with SPF, which is always hard with sensitive skin.
product_name: Superdefense SPF 25 Fatigue + 1st Signs of Age Multi-Correcting Cream

review_text: This mask does soothe and moisturize parched skin. I think people who left negative reviews generally had high hopes for it being able to offer more than what a simple moisturizing mask can do and got disappointed. It is no miracle worker but it does the job; and I like that you can use it around the eyes and on the lips.

I don’t tend to have overt sensitive skin, but after using a patch overnight for 2 days in a row, not only did my pimple not go away, but I also had a red and dry area around it where the patch was sitting. did not notice any difference in terms of the pimple or its severity or length of time it was there.
review_title: dried out my skin with no change to the pimple

review_text: I was sent this product complimentary of Influenster so that in no way has swayed my opinion of this product. In fact I didn’t much care for this toner. I love the idea behind it and the scent alone is to die for, however, it just didn’t work for my skin. My skin has been very dry and sensitive over the winter months, and this product I felt like dried me out more and I also had small bumps all over my face. Maybe I will give it another try in the summer but as for now it didn’t work for me. The reason for the 2 stars is because I love the scent and the simplistic packaging.

I tried this out thinking it would be moisturizing but instead it just sat on top of my skin and felt gross. It actually made my dry spots around my nose even flakier. This also broke me out really badly. So I decided I would just use it for my hair instead and then it broke me out on my scalp also. I’m so disappointed in this product. I returned it. I wonder why I broke me out so much.

Did not like these. I used the nose strip and about an hour in I started to get a terrible migraine. I waited the full 4 hours and removed the strip with no noticeable improvement in my pores appearance. The sticky residue wouldn’t come off after 2 washes so I was also stuck sleeping with a sticky nose. Luckily Sephora’s customer service is awesome so I’m returning this to try something else.
review_title: Weird side effects an no visible results

review_text: Good lip mask! It has no taste or flavor and keeps my lips moisturized overnight. It is a little hard in the tub so it was more difficult for me to get out, however that does not change how the product works.

This stuff ruined my skin after one use. My skin tends to be fairly dry with the occasional breakout and I got this as a sample so I gave it a shot. It seemed fine while I was using it, and immediately after my face felt kind of tight but by the next day I looked like the victim of a severe sunburn. My whole face was red and irritated and so dry that my skin was beginning to peel. It took about 2 weeks of intensely moisturizing to get my skin back to normal. What a nightmare. This stuff is way too harsh unless you have very oily acne prone skin.
This made my normally balanced skin break out completely. I’ve used Argan oil and almond oil without similar irritation, but my face couldn’t handle this.

Lift, lift, lift! This magic formula creates a visible eye lift in 60 seconds flat. It smooths the pesky fine lines and wrinkles. My makeup goes on more smoothly without creasing. It also minimizes the appearance of dark circles and puffiness in the eye region. My eyes and face just look more rested and refreshed. It feels good with zero irritation. This uses a formula that is 94% ingredients of natural origin. It contains organic Harungana extract which I like that it has been shown to be as effective as retinol. This helps to replenish and firm my skin gently. The immediate tightening and smoothing affect comes from Cassie Flower wax. It also contains a blend of plant-based caffeine, escin from Horse Chestnut, Albizia, and Organic Guarana extracts to reduce my dark circles, shadows, and puffiness. The ingredients are really good and I love that it’s a much cleaner formula with so many organic elements that really work for me.
product_name: Total Eye Lift Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Eye Cream

review_text: This product was just so-so for me. It had a really nice consistency but did not completely absorb into my skin. It peeled off and I didn’t notice any difference after using.
Love how it exfoliates my skin and gets rid of blackheads. Makes my skin feels smooth after using it. Wish clinique carried a bigger size.

I got this product from using my insider points. I wanted to try it out before buying the full size product. I couldn’t believe how great my skin looked in the morning. This helped with hormonal acne, dark spot and pores. The price point is expensive but I think it’ll be worth it as I would use it 2-3 times a week
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I love adding the drops to my moisturIzer and applying to my face. Non-sticky and mixes perfectly with my moisturizer. It feels moisturizing. I love that healthy glow it provides! Amazing product!

Mixed feelings about this. My skin seems to react well, but every time I use it I just think a coconut oil would do the same thing. It just mostly smears around make up and is soooo oily that it leave a slick residue after you rinse it off. I have to use a make up wipe to remove that residue as well as the leftover make up. The bottle says it “helps remove make up” which I would say is true, it does help, but it doesn’t remove it well. I will not be ordering this again. Spending more and getting an actual make up removing balm would be wayyyy more practical of a purchase.

Though launched in the summer I also find it effective for these chilly winter nights! Admittedly was sold on the mass marketing for this product and brought with me during my travels this summer and it indeed helped for those moisture robbing days and nights.However come fall and winter I reach for this more as it helps lock in moisture. I like to apply it after cleansing my face and allow for it to sit for 20+ minutes. On especially dry nights, after rinsing, I will add a serum and moisturizer to keep whatever moisture benefits are left and wake up with dyrated well rested skin.
review_title: Nice weekly addition to the bedtime routine

review_text: I really didn’t want to believe that it was this toner breaking me out, but it was. And it’s not just one or 2, it’s like 30 small blemishes everywhere. So many people love this but after reading the reviews, there’s also many with a similar experience like me.

I have used a lot of Dr. Sturm’s product and I have to say that I find this one to be the most disappointing. review_text: Overall, the product works really well. It clarifies the skin, hydrates, shrinks pores, and allows products like moisturizers and serums to soak into the skin effortlessly. Unlike other Dr. Gross devices, though, this one does not come with a product warranty. I bought it from their website and thought it was an error. When I contacted to find the serial number they told me ’it should last a few years’ if using distilled water.
I so wanted to love this , but unlike her Argan I oil it’s nothing special and doesn’t own up to its claims.
product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil

review_text: I started to break out a little at the beginning of quarantine so I freaked out and bought this in hopes it would do a deep cleanse of my skin. Instead I got the worst break out I’ve ever had in my entire life. I had made it to the 27 day of taking these vitamins before I realized it was making my skin worse. I was breaking out in places I’ve never broken out before and the pimples were absolutely horrendous. It’s been about two weeks since I’ve stopped taking it and my skin looks a little better but now I have a bunch under the skin pimples that won’t go away and a lot of acne scars. Do yourself a favor and don’t buy these. The first picture is before I started taking it and the second picture is on the 26 day.
product_name: Daily Cleanse Clear Skin and Body Detox Supplement

review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster and Dr. Jart in exchange for my honest review. This product covers redness well and does leave a natural looking finish. I do feel like you have to make sure your skin is well exfoliated because I find that the product can pull on your face. It’s a thick cream so you have to work the product into your fingers and really blend. Start with a little bit at a time because a little goes a long way. There have been times when I have worn this and when I go to wash my face, I notice a little blemish. Hard to tell if the product is too thick/heavy for my face. I will continue to use this product unless I feel like it’s truly breaking me out. If you have redness, but not overly sensitive skin then yes, I would recommend this product.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: have been using this moisturizer for years, I use normal/combo in summer and dry in winter. I have very sensitive skin and have no break outs with this. It keeps my skin hydrated and glowy.
product_name: DayWear Advanced Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant Creme, Dry

review_text: Have used milky jelly for years as my makeup removing step of a double cleanse and have never had a problem. Ordered a new bottle earlier this month from sephora and immediately could tell something was different. The face wash was much more opaque than normal, and had a slightly different texture. It also left a HORRIBLE film on my face that has never happened before. Since its a first step in my two-step cleanse I said whatever and kept using it since step number 2 removed the film. Well, after using is for a week or so my face has horrible breakouts, and this is the only new part of my routine. Compared ingredients from new/old and its definitely a slightly changed formula and they removed the polyxamer aka the first key ingredient they list here on their website. So sad, not sure how I am going to find a replacement, will be returning.
review_title: Ingredient Change beware! Caused lots of breakouts

Used for three months and didn’t see any benefits. I won’t repurchase.
review_title: Would not recommend for anyone aging or dry skin

My skin look so dewy and my complexion looks great , I noticed the difference immediately.. I put it on as a day cream under my tint makeup, and my skin looks great. Its not greasy whatsoever.. love this product and love this line......
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: I really wanted to love this product but it’s more trouble than it’s worth. It’s so greasy that after rinsing I still have an oily film on my face and in my eyes. review_title: Not great for oily skin or makeup wearers.

While I usually love Fresh products and am someone who likes the scent of rose, I was unfortunately disappointed with this lip balm. I’m not sure if it smells artificial or is just too strong, but I’m not usually bothered by scents and enjoy scented lip balms, so I was shocked at how nauseating this was for me. Winter’s given my skin lot of dryness & irritation, particularly with the delicate skin under my eyes. While I don’t have many lines yet I do get puffy & dark circles under my eyes. I took to using retinol eye creams to help puffiness & avoid getting lines but had to quit this winter because they proved too drying & caused some redness. Rénergie has helped this & proved to be perfect for my skin this time of year.What I liked about it is that it’s so gentle & moisturizing. It has Hyaluronic Acid, Linseed Extract, & Cocoa Seed Butter to create a creamy & silky formula that stopped the dryness & irritation in its tracks. It also has caffeine to constrict blood vessels to help reduce puffiness & dark circles & smooth the skin. I notice an immediate plumping after application. There is some lightening up of my under-eyes & the texture around my eyes has blurred. There is a bit of a dewy finish with this eye cream so it works nicely for both day & night. It’s turned out to be a really helpful product for me, esp in the winter & also gives me an awake & radiant look. It does have a fragrance which may be an issue for some—for me it’s a lovely & light floral scent reminiscent of many other luxury brands & didn’t bother me. In fact, I love it. Beyond that the price may be a little high for some but you don’t need a lot of this to do the trick. I can foresee it lasting many months so it isn’t economically overwhelming if used properly. Overall, I’m happy with how it feels & how it makes my under eyes look & would recommend to ease darkness, bags, & help moisture retention.
review_title: Helps with dark under eyes and bags

review_text: I expected this product to work well because I currently use the Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Products. product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: Be aware that this is an OIL and it does smell ever-so-slightly of vegetable or seed oil (which doesn’t bother me at all). This is also a completely natural, organic product that works! The oil is lighter than Argan oil and really absorbs into the skin. I use a serum under this (Caudelie) and that’s it! My skin really looks younger...better...fresher...moisturized. I also use this all over my body and a few drops in my hair! I love this product!

I was going to return this because it’s so pricey and I have a similar product that’s cheaper, but I really like this. I’ve only been using it for about two weeks so there isn’t a really visible difference, but my skin feels calmer and smoother, and break outs aren’t as bad or as difficult to get through

This Clarifying Peel is amazing! I’ve been continuously using this product and just within a week have seen improved results in my skin texture. My skin is smoother and softer and no longer feels as dry but much more balanced.

I have combination skin, and this oil is amazing for my dry and oily skin areas. It is an oil that is not oily or tacky. It smells so fresh and a light algae scent. It is an excellent light moisturizer. I would recommend this to many.
product_name: Algae + Moringa Universal Hydrating Face Oil

review_text: I ordered this in Peach and Berry flavors and although it feels very nourishing on the lips, the flavor is nothing compared to the Lip Sleeping Mask. (I absolutely love the LSM but hate putting my finger into the jar to apply the product. ) Was so hyped to see these come in a tube, but sadly, they do not live up to the Lip Sleeping Mask. Maybe it is just me expecting it to be the same thing just in a tube? Other than the flavor being very mild, it feels like heaven on the lips.
review_title: Very nourishing on the lips, flavors not great.

review_text: This product is just okay. I received it free via Influenster so I can’t complain about the price. But I would not purchase this again. It leave the skin oily and I don’t notice any difference when using.
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: I received this for free through Influenster and I loveeeee it. Would I buy it again for $60? Not sure just because of the price. If you have that kinda money though, this is definitely a good product. Super thick so a little goes a long way. Also I have sensitive skin so it has been nice to not have to worry that my moisturizer is going to cause me to break out somehow. In sum, great product, I just don’t know if I will be able to sustain buying a $60 moisturizer every few months.
review_title: Quality Sensitive Skin Product (but not cheap)

review_text: I have break outs every now and then so I tried this one to see if it can get acnes under control and it turns out that it has absolutely no effect. Tried it overnight and during daytime. The only positive thing about this product is that it is invisible, people won’t notice you have a sticker on your face.
LOVE this product! It’s definitely one of my staples. I have acne prone skin with large pores and this just refines my skin and gives me a beautiful glow.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Ok so I’m not sure where to begin.... I’ve never used a “self tanner” before only a tinted moisturizer. I prefer go outside and get a real tan from the sun during the summer months however I didn’t get outside much this summer and what little tan I had faded pretty quickly. So after reading numerous reviews I decided to give this a try. I started by doing a patch test and saw no results until the next day, I was ecstatic. So I proceeded to do my whole body.... hoping for the same results.... nope. My hands turned orange while the patch test I did on my thigh was a pretty brown tan color.... and I was splotchy everywhere else. I waited several hours before getting dressed & putting on my watch, bracelet, and ring. The jewelry and watch rubbed off my tan. I know I’m new to this but I watched a tutorial from the creator of this product.... idk maybe I should of asked someone to help me rub it in or something??? I will be returning this & just be pale till next summer I guess, unless I get the courage to try a different product.
I have sensitive skin which was breaking out and I used this for 2 days and woke up with my whole face swollen red. If you have sensitive skin do not use this product. I peeled for days.
review_title: Not for Sensitive Skin that breaks out!

review_text: This moisturizer is creme deal creme. If you are dry it.is a god send and if you are anything else an excellent night cream!!! This is my second jar!
Feels nice when you apply it but evaporates verrrry quickly. Definitely could not use as an overnight lip mask.

I have always had my eye on this product, from YouTube tutorials to people raving about it through social media. I always held back bc of the price point. Anyways, I finally caved and purchased this recently. I have to admit the way the product comes out is amazing, it’s a fine mist and doesn’t leave any imprints. However, it just doesn’t work. I am normal-combo skin type and this just made me so oily throughout the day. The dew is real. It does not promote longevity for my makeup and leaves my skin oily and slick.

I do have *somewhat* sensitive skin, and my skin had a very bad reaction to this product, probably the glycolic acid. A few hours after using I had tiny little red dots all over my cheeks and was slightly itchy. I had received the serum as a birthday gift the year before and did not have any reaction to the product. If you have skin that is sensitive to peels and other acid-based products, use caution with this product
it dried out my skin and I started to breakout, sadly not for me.

Amazing! This facial roller feels very nice and the quality is great. It really works for de-puffing and the price point is great compared to other facial rollers on the market. It comes with a super cute protective pouch which I thought was a nice bonus!

The ONLY thing I liked about this product is that it’s cute packaging. The pink and design are great. I used this for a week, and it made my skin even more oily than it already is. I also don’t like that there is no scent. After a week, I ended up throwing it away because I was so disappointed. Don’t waste your money.

I use this cream on clean skin after using my toner and serum, because, yes, I draw my product down onto my neck and décolleté ALWAYS. The cream is white in color and thick in consistency. I disperse it between my hands and apply it in swift upward motions from my chest, up my neck, towards my chin. A little bit goes a long way, and it absorbs really well when you don’t use too much. I am forever trying to prevent and reverse the striations on my neckline and this cream has really helped tighten the skin and improve the texture!
review_title: Best neck and décolleté firming cream ever!

review_text: I have combination, acne prone skin and this dries me out like no tomorrow. I’m not usually flaky dry ever, but this makes me very flaky and dry, especially in my t-zone. I won’t buy again.

review_text: This is better for combo, mostly dry skin than argan oil. I find it absorbs very well and doesn’t feel greasy later in the day. Unfortunately the earthy, kitchen cupboard is not very pleasant while applying. Thankfully, it dissipates after about 5 minutes or so.

review_text: I LOVE THIS. i’ve tried and sampled “essence’s” before but I never really understood how it could be vital to my skincare routine, but I really love using this. Combined, they have smoothed out fine lines and wrinkles as well as brightened my eyes. I use this both under my eyes and up around brow bone. I will continue to purchase this time and time again! Love!
product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream

review_text: Heavily scented like Avon had to return heavily scented had to return

Lately, my skin has appeared dull and a bit dehydrated, so I was excited to try Dior’s Dreamskin. The product goes on evenly and smoothly, drying almost instantly and soaking in wholly. My skin looked noticeably brighter after the first use, and I was incredibly impressed that after just a few days, my skin was visibly improved. The other thing I really like about this product is that you can order a refill of the product, rather than having to order a completely new one, helping to cut down on waste. My only complaint is that the Dior scent is really heavy when you first pump the product. However, once applied to smell dissipate quickly.

I used it once on the face, neck, and chest and broke out in a really bad rash on my neck and chest. I think that’s because I applied it at night before bed and then added vitamin c on in the morning, so those two ingredients likely reacted poorly together. It may have been user error. The website doesn’t clearly list what the ingredients are so it makes it difficult to know what to pair this with. I’m surprised that this irritated my skin. review_text: Nice ingredients that will definitely help to exfoliate your skin over time but don’t think the balled up stuff you see when using this is dead skin. Trust me, I make my own skin-care products from time to time and have cellulose to use as a thickener but i hate that it always balls up exactly like this. Don’t be fooled.
review_title: You’re seeing cellulose, not balls of dead skin

review_text: I usually love Caudalie products. This one is terrible. I got small white pimples all over my cheeks. I don’t really breakout anymore (as I’m getting older) and never on my cheeks. Read reviews and saw others had the same problem. This was the only product I added to my skincare routine. Stopped using and within a week, skin started to clear up. Very oily, hard to wash off.

I have used this toner for years and years. I had acne prone and oily skin when I was younger and thought this was an excellent choice at the time. However, it never truly solved my acne problems, it would soothe my skin and gives it a tingly feeling so I THOUGHT it was doing something. As I grew older, I learned more about ingredients and realized that this has denatured alcohol and witch hazel in it. Both ingredients actually have caused my skin to dry a lot after years of using it, especially if you’re using the entire murad acne line since the active ingredient is salicylic acid in all of them. Not that SA is bad but only using SA without replenishing our skin with other acids just mean that our skin isn’t truly getting the nutrients we need. I still use the anti aging acne cleanser from murad but have switched to use a toner with Hyaluronic Acid, and started including niacinamide and retinol in my routine as well.

review_text: I just bought this day before yesterday and used it once yesterday. I have sensitivity with Crest Whitestrips (horrible) and this gave me zero sensitivity or zingers! YAY! Best of all, after the four treatments yesterday, my teeth were already a shade whiter. Let me give you ladies two tips that the negative review users probably didn’t try: ONE - don’t brush with flouride toothpaste before you use this! My dentist told me that flouride makes it harder for the bleach to work. I use Tom’s whitening no flouride toothpaste. TWO - dry your teeth off each time with a tissue before you put the gel on. Other tips include swishing with lemon juice just before you use this (another tip from my dentist even though they don’t condone eating lemons, etc. She said it just helps before whitening and wouldn’t harm your teeth too much to do that during a 10-day session), not putting this next to your gumline (it bubbles if you do) and charging the unit when you have done your four treatments. Also, the Sephora lady said not to give up until you have done a full ten days the first time you use it. She said she didn’t see any results until 8 days and then used it for three more to get really white. I’m using it for 10 days no matter what because I want WHITE. I am 41 and I eat blueberries in my smoothies every single day (with a straw, but still...). So, my teeth aren’t yellow, but definitely not white! :) Try my tricks and tips and this will likely work wonders for you too! I’m using it right now and did the dishes earlier while using it - it goes around your neck - so cool!!!!
product_name: GLO Brilliant White Smile - At Home Teeth Whitening Device

review_text: I was impressed with the eye makeup remover from the same line, which smells fantastic and works really well. This, however, is not as good. It only really cleans the top layer -- it does dissolve makeup but because it doesn’t foam, it milks, it just moves the dissolved makeup around on my skin. The fact it turns milky means it doesn’t work well with those special scrubbing machines either. And you wind up using a lot more product than you’d like. You can expect to go through a tube a month. It is gentle though, and doesn’t leave a burning feeling like some other cleansers do. And I found my face didn’t feel so tight when I was done. I’m a combo of oily and dry, so most of the time my skin is super tight and uncomfortable feeling after cleaning. You can also use this around your eye area too but the soy eye makeup remover is 10 times better for that (and smells better too!). However it doesn’t exfoliate -- the fact that you have to scrub and scrub to remove the makeup pretty much does all the work there. Not sure I’ll stick with this, as I’m not really that impressed with it.

I love this cleanser. It’s leaves my skin feeling so clean without dehydrating it. I have found my skin to be clearer & less oily since I’ve been using this. I have also noticed that my pores are significantly less clogged.

review_text: I had a sample of this, and while it is “moisturizing,“ it left my (oily) skin feeling greasy.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Didn’t see really any results from this serum. I had some hopes from this brand as I was looking for a new retinol serum to replace my current one. But this serum didn’t seem to do much in the nearly two months I used it. Seriously spend your money on cheaper brands that will work a lot quicker.
Horrible for sensitive skin. It is very harsh and broke my skin out badly, making it very red, itchy, and irritated.
Makes my under eyes feel awake! The sample size will last a long time. A little bit goes a long way!

After about 30 minutes of using this cream I noticed my face actually felt dryer/tighter. Smells lovely like the superfood cleaner, but I ultimately returned this as it was not particularly hydrating.
product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Despite the claim that it’s non comedogenic, one of the first ingredients is coconut oil, which is a 4 out of 5 on the comedogenic scale. Made me break out in cystic acne. Also, it has a very thick consistency that doesn’t absorb well into the skin; it sits on top of the skin more like a balm than a thin oil.

No no no! I am already combating acne and thought I would just try this. Worst mistake. My skin was already purging from the Ole Henriksen balance line. Which I am also discontinuing. Anyways, tried this ONE TIME. My skin is about 50% worse already. I now have acne on both sides of my face up to my eyes. Three huge new cystic pimples. And all the renaming acne I already had. I feel so stupid for even trying this.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: I’ve been using this for almost a year and am less than impressed. I don’t really have puffiness or circles, which could be why I didn’t really notice any difference, but I did want something that was hydrating and would help with fine lines. This was basically lotion for under my eyes, no other type of improvements were noticed (brightening, fine lines, firming, etc). I also felt this went on a bit heavy and didn’t absorb super well. I will not be repurchasing.

I love the smell of this cleanser in the morning. It really wakes you up! I don’t really notice my skin lookin any brighter but i really do enjoy how gentle of an exfoliator it is. I recieved this for free in my Influenster voxbox.
i picked this facial moisturizer for my oily, acne prone skin because it seemed to be the best deal for the price. i am happy with my choice.

I was already obsessing over the original Yo Glow scrub, but this product is even better! I have to deal with south Texas heat and using this is a treat for my skin. I’ve only used it twice and have noticed a significant improvement in my face, neck, and shoulder area. My pores are no longer visible and my skin feels amazingly soft!
product_name: Yo Detox Charcoal Face & Body Enzyme Scrub

review_text: Surprisingly made my lips dryer! I don’t recommend!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Bottle pump stopped working after 4 uses!! I’m so upset I have more than have the bottle left and it won’t work!
review_title: Bottle pump stopped working after few uses
product_name: Glow Clear, Color Correcting Self-Tanning Mousse

review_text: I seen a review on this product a couple of months ago and decided to buy it. It really is nothing special. I love the foaming part of it, other than that it seems like a usual face wash. Safe for everyday use and doesnt get any makeup off!
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: Noticed a big difference within the third day of using the product. I have acne/oily prone skin and now my skin looks brighter and more even toned. My pores look significantly smaller (but I also use Idealist from Estee Lauder) and cleaner (blackheads have diminished). I will definitely keep buying this product.

one of the best skincare products i’ve ever tried! very very gentle, but definitely effective. leaves you refreshened and glowing. does not sting, or burn, or dry out your skin. and definitely a lot better than the sephora brand version of these. will always recommend! :)

Dermalogica gifted me this product to sample and wow I’m seriously in love! It’s a fine texture scrub that kind of melts into your face when added with water. It’s so gentle but gives a great physical exfoliation as well and leaves your skin baby soft. This will be going into my regular rotation!!

I’ve been using this for a while now. What I like most about it is that it makes my skin feel clean, but not dried out, which is a huge bonus to me as I find alot of toners do that. I also really love the scent. Outside of that I don’t think I’ve noticed any remarkable changes in my skin like my pores or levels of acne. It helps my skin feel balanced though.
product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Toner

review_text: I was nervous about the retinol being in this product because I have sensitive skin but this was so calming I was so happy! A little bit goes a long was so this will literally last me forever! I will definitely buy this product again!

I’m really disappointed because I gave into the hype of this lip plumper. It definitely doesn’t do anything for me. It’s basically just a gloss. The first day I wore it, it did give me a more reddish tint but still no plumping. On subsequent uses, I don’t even have any additional tint. I get the same effect with any other lip gloss, so I feel like I wasted $50. Also, it says to put on a thick coat, but that’s pretty difficult with how little product comes out on the wand.

I didn’t compare ingredients but this stuff performs just like Dr. G brightening peeling gel which is only $15 for more product. The only thing I don’t like about this is the price. Outside of TO and Inky it seems like most of the skincare products from Sephora are $30+. If you don’t mind the price, this scrub is awesome and leaves your skin super smooth and soft.
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: I liked this cleaner but it did make my skin dry in some places so I recommend using this cleaner on your oily places but for your dry places just use a different one.

This is my first time incorporating retinol into my skincare routine, and I love the ability to mix this with different volumes of moisturizers. I saw a noticeable change in my acne scarring and overall just smoother. Great product that is worth the money.

This would have been 4 or 5 stars because I saw instant results and my skin felt amazing after, but the smell is so horrible, I’m giving it 2 stars. I can’t use this product, because the smell is so bad. Think old sweaty socks. It’s terrible.
product_name: FILLING GOOD hyaluronic acid plumping serum

review_text: I received this product to test for free and I’m so happy I did, because I love it! I have been dealing with breakouts over the past few months, which is new for me. Within days of adding this into my skincare routine, my skin has been clearing up so nicely! It goes on easily and smells so refreshing. I am a huge fan and would recommend this product.
review_title: Perfect Addition to Daily Skincare Routine
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: I wasn’t crazy about the fragrance in this product and neither was my skin. I started breaking out a few days into using it. It felt nice on the skin when applied but wasn’t worth continuing use to see if my breakouts subsided. For the price, I don’t recommend.

I bought this ages ago because of Jamie Genevieve on YouTube and I’ve repurchased it twice since then. I have normal/oily skin and I love this as an all-in-one moisturizer/primer before my makeup. Also love the smell! Only con is the price point, but seeing as I keep buying it, that’s obviously not too much of a deterrent.
product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer

review_text: I really wanted to like this product after reading all of the good reviews but unfortunately it just didn’t work for me. The product was great at melting my makeup away but because it is oil based, it left me with some breakouts that I would have preferred to not have.
product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

review_text: This stuff is extremely hydrating and lasts longer than the every 2 hours application recommended by the package. This probably lasts me a good 3-4 hours. Also, just use a tiny, tiny bit! It spreads across your lips, and makes them a tad greasy at the beginning. But about 20 minutes later, your lips are perfectly smooth and soft. I recommend putting it under your lipstick, as it produces a little too much shine for my tastes.To me, the best thing about this balm is the scent! When I apply it, it smells just like lavender essential oil! Great stuff!
review_title: Not sure how I live without it!

review_text: I’ve been using this cleanser for a few months now. I have sensitive, combo skin, and struggle with a couple patches of eczema on my face. I was worried this may be too harsh or too drying for my skin, particularly during our midwestern winters, but was pleasantly surprised to find it very balancing! It does not dry me out, cause my eczema to flair up or further irritate it, does not cause the tightening feeling after use, and it cleanses my skin very well! It even does a pretty decent job of removing makeup. It foams up pretty well, especially when I use it with my Clarisonic so you don’t need too much product. I’m on my second bottle, and have just purchased a 3rd!
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: Really good night cream, but a little “heavy“. I feel it doesn’t soak into my skin that well. I was surprised by this since it’s an oil-free cream. It has a pleasant citrus scent to it. I feel my complexion has improved somewhat since purchasing this 2 months ago.
product_name: High-Potency Night-A-Mins Oil-Free Resurfacing Cream with Fruit Derived AHAs

review_text: I really like this lipbalm as it provides moisture without being sticky and it’s strawberry scented. Granted, the strawberry smells artificial to me, but it still is a pleasant smell. The other thing I’m not a big fan of is the packaging, as it is a tin, which makes applying it at work not so convenient, as I constantly have to wash my hands just to apply it.

This product is not a need, but it is certainly that extra something to elevate your already good skincare routine. Mine was very good without it, but its a bit better with it. And I don’t want to minimize how good it is, I just want to be clear that your routine can be great without it. I have normal skin, am not acne prone, and do not currently struggle with hyperpigmentation; I cannot attest to how it, specifically the Niacinamide, would impact someone who does. The added moisture in here is great, it pairs well with all my other products, and the finish is very pretty.
review_title: You don't need it, but you want it

review_text: I found this crème to be underwhelming when stacked against the produce claims. I received a sample of this product from Influenster and tested it over a period of 3 weeks. In general, it’s a good moisturizer that kept my face supple and hydrated.
product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: Stung my sensitive witStung my sensitive skin, felt like a matte finish as opposed to a dewy hydrated feel. Returned it.

I really don’t see the hype in this product.It feels like water when you put it on but that’s about it. If you are looking for something rich feeling and creamy when you apply it then this is not the cream for you.

This is my holy grail vitamin C serum. The price might be a bit hefty but very worth it. I can see my dark spots fading since I started using it and also brought glow to my skin. I love it so much and I will continue to purchase.
product_name: C.E.O Glow Vitamin C + Turmeric Face Oil

review_text: So I received this full size serum from Guerlain & Influenster for free in exchange for my absolute honest review. That’s what I’m going to give you.This serum is very luxurious and makes you feel special when using it. The bottle is beautiful, but what matters is what’s on the inside. This formula is two different types mixed together through the pump. One side looks like straight honey, an the other side has other goodies within the formula. I think this serum is very very hydrating, but also very sticky. It sits on your skin an never melts in hardly. You don’t even have to wear a moisturizer if your normal or dry skin. I wouldn’t even recommend to the oily skin folks. You won’t like this formula. It feels like honey is on your face, so I’d advise to use this at night. I actually like how my face looks like a glazed doughnut after applying. If your sensitive to scents, this might be a bit too much for you. The scent is very strong, but does go away after a little bit. A lot of people were complaining about the scent. It reminds me of rich old lady in the best possible way. Overall, I like this product, I just need to use it longer to actually see results.
review_title: It’s not for oily skin. It is sticky also.
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Double R Advanced Serum

review_text: I really wanted to like this because I love the body butter but it dries out my slips and makes them peel.

As far as the eye cream itself goes it’s not for me. I found it to be too thick and even when applied as light as possible my eye skin area still felt tacky the following morning. I do have combination/oily skin so for those with only dry (especially around the eye) skin this might be great for you. Another issue I have is that for such a thick eye cream I feel a pump or tube application would work best since it’s hard to dip a finger in as light as need be without getting too much product out. Personally I prefer a retinol eye product to help with milia any how.
review_title: Not for oily or combo skin!

review_text: I have combo/oily skin and tons if texture with large pores. product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: Returning as the color is not white but cream. Very disappointed. Otherwise is nice quality.

As I don’t have acne on my face I’ve been using these pads on my body. I have bumps on my back and using these pads definitely helped me smooth the skin. Also I like to use them on my legs to minimize the appearance of “strawberry legs”. I would say this is great treatment to use when you have an event/occasion where you want to look your best. Use these month before and your skin will look great. Unfortunately they are way to pricey for me to keep using them as part of my regular routine.
product_name: Resurface+ AHA/BHA Niacinamide Exfoliating Pads for Face and Targeted Body

review_text: I appreciate that the company tried to make the packaging cute, but it’s not functional. product_name: Glow Daily Vitamin C Gel Cream

review_text: I have dry and sensitive skin that is always flaky so I thought this would be a home run product for me. Sadly, it was not. I used the whole tube but I didn’t observe that I ever got adequate exfoliation from this. At least it did not irritate my skin. One other thing to note that I didn’t like is that if you plan on using this in the shower, the wooden cap will come off, so you will just have the plastic top with dried glue. It doesn’t affect its functioning at all, but it doesn’t look nearly as nice.
review_title: Beads are too large to be effective

review_text: This serum is expensive but so worth it. I’m so happy I tried it out as it has helped with my hyperpigmentation a lot. I use it every night along with Kiehl’s night time recovery oil and Sunday Riley’s Tidal brightening enzyme water cream... magical combination. I’m really loving my skin right now. Thanks to the Sephora representative in the skin care department at the the King of Prussia Mall for introducing me to the Tidal cream!

It feel so smooth, shiny, vibrant and youthful with no extra oily ness or breakouts.
product_name: CC Me Vitamin C + Niacinamide Serum

review_text: Tried these--and it made no difference. Overpriced for little results.

review_text: Sooo goodd!!! It keep makeup in place & not matte !!! nice finish!!

Unfortunately, my issues haven’t completely cleared up since I stopped using it a month ago... I’ve still got marks left that I’m trying to fade, as the type of acne it caused was worse than any pimple I’ve dealt with. I wish I could say I had the same experience as the majority of these reviews, but this product caused a major skin freak out for me (which hopefully I will be able to heal), and I myself wouldn’t recommend it if you have any sensitivity.
review_title: Wish it would've worked for me!

review_text: This moisturizing cleanser makes even this oil slick feels moisturized, cleansed, toned and happy. Overall I can’t help but feel like the product is a gimmick and although it could be completely unrelated, I have had a large flare up of acne around the time I’d started using.
I’ve been struggling with very dry skin. Seeing the reviews I thought this would help.. it didn’t. This product made my face feel even more dry + made me break out even more.

At first, I did not like this product until I learned the right way to apply it. I usually apply sunscreen by dotting it on my face and then rubbing it in. This did NOT work with this formula and resulted in pilling. You have to spread your fingers together and then put it on your face, and that way it does not pill. I have light skin and it did not leave a cast on me. It felt slightly drying on my dry (Differin) skin, but much more moisturizing than other 100% mineral sunscreens I’ve tried and overall pretty comfortable. It is a bit tacky on the skin and leaves a natural finish. Lastly, I don’t think there is any fragrance added to the product, but it smelled like toasted bread to me. The smell is not strong and fades once applied. Overall, I recommend this for someone who really prefers a mineral sunscreen (someone with sensitive normal to oily skin or someone allergic to chemical filters). I would probably purchase the Unseen Sunscreen over this one because it is more moisturizing for my dry skin, and offers more protection, and is slightly cheaper.
review_title: Good mineral formula, but Unseen is better
