review_text: If Charlotte Darling had marketed this as a pre-makeup serum (like several Farsali products), instead of a skincare serum, the claims would make sense. But if you look at the ingredient deck, the main people who will benefit from this are people who (a) have dehydrated skin, (b) have no source of hydrating serums in their routine, and (c) are not already using niacinamide. The primary ingredients this promotes are golden vitamin c (but no percentage is provided, and its at the bottom of the deck), polygultamic acid (low middle of the deck), and replexium (although Sephora doesn’t mention it, and is not identified in the deck because its a peptide complex). Charlotte’s website doesn’t mention the niacinamide, which is why I think most people using it are seeing immediate results. For someone who has a routine with vitamin-c, peptides, a higher concentration of niacinamide and hydrators like hylauronic or polyglutamic acid, this isn’t doing a lot in terms of changing my lines, texture, pores, or elasticity. It doesn’t layer well with a lot of products (essentially every drunk elephant product hates this). HOWEVER. However. However. I was gifted this a week ago. And I do think that while I am skeptical about this improving my skin long term (it could happen, but I’m skeptical), it does marvelous things for my skin in terms of the way my makeup wears over it. Which makes sense because the magic cream is almost the perfect pre-makeup moisturizer. My skin is glowier, my primer and foundation sit better, and my skin looks less textured UNDER makeup. So if, for example, you are someone who loves the magic cream or the Bobbie Brown makeup base moisturizer, this is a great step. I even think it improves the appearance of skin if you just wear primer. The downside is the amount of fragrance and essential oils. Why Charlotte? Why? I will continue to use it once a day, not sure I will repurchase. #charlottetilbury #influenster #gifted #ctilburymakeup

review_text: The product is advertised as “a peeling gel that visibly rolls, lifts, and sweeps away dead skin cells...“, however, upon using it, I quickly realized that this was a myth. Although the product certainly gives the appearance of rolling dead skin away, it happens far too quickly for it to actually be your skin--i.e., you put it on, and if there’s any friction after it’s been put on your skin it rolls up into big pieces. I read the reviews and saw some people who believed this was the case as well, but I kept using it because there were some who said it really was working by chemically exfoliating that quickly. However, I have very dry skin right now--I have dry skin naturally, and I’ve been using a topical acne cream known for causing a lot of dryness--so it’s very obvious to me when exfoliation is happening and when it isn’t, and with this product, it isn’t. I would put it on and even leave it on for a few minutes as the directions say you can do for a supposedly improved exfoliating experience--however, once I took it off, I would see the exact same dry patches and even loose dry pieces of skin as before. It didn’t even get pieces that were practically off already. I’m returning this product tomorrow, and I’m really disappointed, because I usually trust a product when it gets nearly 5 stars on Sephora. Don’t waste your money on this product--I for one will be looking out for a better (and hopefully cheaper too...) exfoliant.

My favorite facial moisturizer in the world.

I’ve gotten better results from other products that were cheaper. They do work but they fall off much more easily than other brands. I’ll wake up and the patch will have fallen off at some point during the night.

Brightened and softened my skin! This light fluffy mask changed my skins texture in about 10 mins and left me feeling smooth and exfoliated. I love the clean ingredients most of all. Highly recommend. Pairs great with the Green Machine serum.
product_name: GREEN MACHINE insta-glo resurfacing acid mask

review_text: I was warned about this product when I was purchasing it. The sales person suggested that I wear it once per week until I got used to it. After 2-3 weeks, I was noticing that my skin was breaking out as soon as I wore my serums which I have been using for over one year. Needless to say, I returned it.

I like the way it feels and the way it smells. But it does nothing for me. I still wake up with chapped lips, and I’m sticking with my Nuxe lip balm. It’s all natural made with honey. It’s more sticky and dense but it is the only thing that ever worked for my chapped lips :) and they’re half the price!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: My super sensitive skin did not like this. I broke out wherever I applied it and it took a week or two for my skin to go back to normal. I’m sure it’s a good product, just not for me and my sensitive skin.
product_name: Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) Blemish + Blackhead Serum

review_text: I received this product from topbox as a sample in exchange for my honest review. It was a #freeproduct. It was a very small sample and was enough for 1 or 1.5 times applications. It applied well on my skin and smell wasn’t overwhelming but other than that cannot review about other qualities. My skin is very dry so I used it all at once and didn’t find it very hydrating. Maybe be after few uses, I might see the difference..
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream

review_text: This is one of the best skin care products I have ever used
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: I have only been using this product for a couple weeks and I have already seen a difference in my skin! At night, I wash my face with a cleanser. Next I apply the liquid collagen all over my face and neck. Finally, I apply the cream to my face. It looks thick, but a little goes a long way. I’m loving waking up to a brighter face every morning! I received this product complimentary, but I am definitely going to purchase it when I run out!
This does not tan and it has strong chemical odor mixed with fake watermelon scent. Not worth the $.
product_name: Gradual Tan Watermelon Daily Firming Lotion

review_text: Ok, I received this product complimentary from FaceGym, but I still have to be honest that I think it’s a huge ripoff. At first I thought it would be a nice addition to a skincare routine but the rollers have to be replaced after every single use, and they are TWENTY dollars a piece and come in a pack of four. If you did this once a week it would be literally $80 a month. To me, nothing is worth that. But if you don’t mind that price tag, I think it’s definitely a way to add a new level and luxury feel to your skincare routine.
product_name: Hyaluronic Acid Roller Dissolving Microneedling Tool

review_text: I have now finished one bottle and can wholeheartedly say that this is the best serum I have ever used. Not only is the smell fantastic (sweet orange juice) but it sinks into the skin within seconds and gives a plump, healthy essence to the skin. It’s hydrating and has not caused me any breakouts. My skin looks brighter, feels softer, and is calmer now -- thanks FRESH.
product_name: Vitamin Nectar Glow Juice Antioxidant Face Serum

review_text: Haven’t seen any difference,but it feels great on the skin. I think it is a good moisturizer so apply it 2x a day.

I love isle of Paradise products… I would say I am a bit disappointed in this one. First my tan took forever to develop and I even slept with it on over night. I woke up to a horrible fake tan smell and felt oily all over. The color was not dark for me. Personal I would compare it too lurching the light color. This is my color after 18hrs. I am showering off tonight.

I received this #freeproduct to review, and I have to say I was a bit surprised. I usually don’t use this brand, but I have to say I liked this cleanser and how well it cleaned my face. I did need to moisturize after since it dried my skin out a little bit. I have to say that the scent is very good, and refreshing.

I gratefully received this complimentary from Sunday Riley. I’ve been using this product for about a week now and the results are amazing. I use this in my nightly skincare routine right before my moisturizer. It has a creamy liquid texture to it which applies nicely. The herbal scent is not my favorite but it’s not too strong so it doesn’t bother me. The claims of plumping fine lines in 3 minutes is true. I noticed that my skin did almost immediately look smoother and bright. Definitely recommend this product.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: This stuff made me break out, blackheads and pimples all over. It also appears kind of blotchy and uneven, makes my face look more dirty than tanned.

At first this was working great. Has promising results BUT whatever is in this formula puts a thick film over my face. I had to use a strong acid peel like to get it off. I thought it was a fluke so once I stopped peeling I tried it again tonight. I can feel that film starting back up right away. Usually love Ordinary but not this one.

I have very dry hands - I cook a lot, and am constantly doing projects around the house - and used this lotion in hopes that it would make my hands feel better. Unfortunately, my hands are so dry that this burned briefly after application, but then that stopped and my hands felt smoother. The product absorbed quickly, and my hands felt better.I am wary of artificial fragrances, so I like that this isn’t packed with some fake floral scent... but I don’t love the strong chemical smell.
review_title: it's not pretty, but it works

review_text: I do want to put this disclaimer that receiving this complimentary does not affect my review. I’m reviewing this the same way I would if I purchased it. First time trying something from this brand as I’ve never heard of it before. This cream has the slightest rice scent to it. It smells so light I love it. This has a lightweight, gel-cream consistency to it that leaves the skin feeling moisturized. It doesn’t leave a glow/ dewy finish at all, but rather a skin like finish. As someone with dry combination skin, this feels sufficient for spring (maybe a tad much for summer?), but might not be enough for fall or winter. Only reason I’m docking a star is because it’s pretty expensive for only 50 mL, which would last me 3 months maximum with frugal usage.
product_name: Mochi Mochi Luminous Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I’ve tried a silicon scrubber before but I never liked it because it was manual. I saw that the 3rd version won the allure award so I figured I would try this since I feel like my hands can never clean my face as thoroughly. I enjoyed how this product had different cleansing modes, so if I wore makeup I can clean deeper to ensure all the gunk is out of my pores. Overall, I am really enjoying this product, and it’s definitely worth the price for me.
product_name: LUNA 4 Facial Cleansing & Firming Massage for Balanced Skin

review_text: I absolutely love this cleanser! Tacha products in general, are the best and worth the cost! I highly recommend it especially for acne prone skin. Will definitely keep buying!
product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: I like this one at first, but then it started to dry out my skin around my eyes pretty bad.
product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum

review_text: I loved this cleanser the time I was using, I was very sad to know my skin turned red when I used it. I wouldn’t recommend this product to people who have very sensitive skin. You’re better off buying Bioderma to control your oily skin.
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: i love this product, i use it everyday in my routine and it moisturizes my skin so well!
product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides

review_text: The first time I bought this lip balm was about a year or so ago. I thought I finally found my perfect lip balm and would keep buying it from then on. The original one felt very smooth and lightweight, it just melted on my lips, and the moisture effect lasted long. This time around, as my balm was running out I ordered another one and it was a completely different experience! While the scent remained the same, the formula must have changed greatly. It now feels heavy on my lips, as if I coated them with a candle wax. More than that after about 10 mins since application it starts feeling dry and needs reapplying. This was nothing close to the original formula experience! It now feels like a cheap $3 chapstick I could buy at my grocery store. I compared the leftover in my old balm to this new balm and confirmed that it felt completely different. Then I came here and read other reviews of people saying the formula has changed. Very disappointed. Will look for another lip balm now.
review_title: New formula, feels cheap, not going to buy again
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: Heavier than most body sunscreens, with a strong sunscreen scent.
product_name: Hydro UV Defense Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+

review_text: I might be in the minority here, but I didn’t like this product at all!! I love Tatcha products, and I don’t mind spending money on skincare that works. I’m also someone who takes sun care very seriously, so I’ve been using Japanese and Korean sunscreens literally my whole life. Unfortunately, this whole product was terrible for me and I returned it. The bottle is terrible designed. It’s very wide and thin, so when I shake the product it oozes out the top when I unscrew the lid. The pigment is meant to even out skin tone, but I didn’t notice that much difference and I’ve got fair skin. The application is thick and blends well, but it doesn’t necessarily feel like it absorbs. It just felt thick and just sitting on top of my skin. I gave it a fair try, but every time I’d apply it I couldn’t wait to take it off at the end of the day. I don’t recommend.
product_name: The Silk Sunscreen Mineral Broad Spectrum SPF 50 PA++++ with Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide

review_text: The sunscreen is fantastic! BUT the pump is horrible and stops working before 1/2 the bottle is gone. This has happened twice for me. Supergoop, please get a better pump mechanism so your customers can use this product!
It irritated my rosacea. Not moisturizing enough. Made my skin dry and burn.

I received Dermalogica MultiVitamin Power Recovery Mask for free thanks to BzzAgent. I would have to say it is great. I enjoyed the smell and to me that is important to masks because you have to keep it on for longer. After removing it my face felt smooth and soft. I loved how it made my face look. I felt like I was glowing! I would 100% recommend.

My skin feels nice using this oil in conjunction with the Good Genes but this product smells awful to me. I literally have to breathe through my mouth for 15 minutes after applying. My husband is offended by it as well. I’ll still continue to use it since I like the affect on my skin but I don’t think I will repurchase.

I’ve never been one to use ’gel’ type moisturizers but this stuff is something else. I’ve been using it for about 6 months and my skin has never been better. I have combination or oily prone skin so I always mix the moisturizers I use with a teeny drop of rose hip oil or castor oil or even melaleuca. Really helps the moisturizer go a long way, and this particular moisturizer mixes well with those essential oils I’ve listed. I’m in love with the texture, smell, feel. But to be honest I don’t know how it fares buy itself without mixing it with oils. I need to apply this on clean skin, not throughout the day or else it feels weird.
And worth every penny!!!!!!!

The refillable packaging is genius and I appreciate the eco-conscious approach that Glow Recipe is taking. More brands need to take a page from their book. The consistency of this luxurious gel-cream is dreamy and my combination skin loves this moisturizer.
product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

review_text: I visited a Sephora store to find an eye cream specifically for my dark circles. The store associate was very helpful and told me this was the best stuff, hands down and won’t put a dent in my wallet. It’s been four weeks and not only have I not seen an improvement, but my under eye circles look worse!! Do not spend a dime on this product, not worth it!!
product_name: White Lucent Anti-Dark Circles Eye Cream

review_text: Very good moisturizer. The first time I used too much, a little REALLY does go a long way. After that, it’s been really good. Not oily, definitely very well hydrated. I’ve been using it for a week, morning and night. The smell is nice but not overwhelming. I received this product for free to test out.

I love this sunscreen! I’m currently on accutane so I need all the sun protection I can get and I feel very protected while wearing this. I will say it has the tiniest white cast at first (and i’m quite pale) but it completely blends in after a few minutes. It definitely feels more heavy then the unseen sunscreen which is mygo-to but for days that I know i’ll be more exposed to the sun, I will be reaching for this!
Unfortunately I did get a allergic reaction with this mask!

Everything about this is misleading. An actual peeling mask starts as a gel and then dries so you can PEEL it off. This stays a gel that you wash off. For all those saying “it says to wash your face with warm water idk what you expected” just about every mask including actual peeling masks say that!! To get rid of any residue. However THIS was a waste of money. I already have an exfoliating scrub, I wanted a mask that PEELS. Stepped out of my usual peeling mask brand and I’m disappointed. Only plus is it smells good but since there are little beads in it, I wouldn’t even recommend using this more than a couple times a week as I’m sure it’s abrasive. And no it’s not a chemical peel either. Save your money.

I have been a faithful Supergoop user for years. I super from perioral dermatitis and this is the only sunscreen I have found that does not aggravate the condition. I ran out of my previous bottle of Supergoop+ Everyday UV lotion and went to my local Sephora. All they had was the Everyday Sunscreen so I purchased. 1 week later I am returning unfortunately as my forehead exploded with pimples. Too bad. I also found the smell a little off-putting. The previous version was totally free of fragrence.
product_name: PLAY Everyday Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: I love hyaluronic acid. Use it every day for moisture that doesn’t congest my skin or look greasy. HOWEVER. There is simply no reason the pay three hundred dollars for something you can get for under ten! I recommend hyaluronic acid but not at a 300% markup. That being said I had no problems with this particular brand, just didn’t see any changes that would make me spend this much on it.

I have acne prone, VERY dry skin and have tried so, so, so many products for MANY years and nothing has ever REALLY worked to my satisfaction to combat the breakouts and keep my skin from being incredibly dry. This product does both and it is my favorite product in my beauty arsenal. HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend - well worth the price.
review_title: Will never go without this product again

review_text: Meh. At first trial of this brand, which I bought the full size original bum bum cream and this balm, the scent and the branding was so impressive that I fell in love right away. But the lotion is shimmery and doesn’t really do anything special- it’s lotion, it just smells good. Then this chapstick- I mean you think for $18 that at the very least it will be moisturizing, but it worked as well if not slightly less well than a regular Burt’s Bee’s chapstick. And it’s a giant tube for less product than a Burt’s Bee’s chapstick. Only chapstick I’ve found in Sephora that’s semi worth a higher price point is the Drunk Elephant. Not knocking Sephora- the value of a product is determined by the consumer- but to me, if I’m paying 9 times what I pay for my usual product I need something more than a good scent.

This is not a setting spray for oily, combination or even normal skin. It makes you extra oily and makeup instantly melts with it on. I wouldn’t recommend it if you live anywhere that is hot and humid and I personally did not like the smell of the product.

I’ve been using this product for months and it hasn’t done anything for my skin. I heard great things from the employees at Sephora so I thought I would try it, and they told me that it just takes time. Well it’s been a while and still nothing, maybe it’s just my skin, just disappointing.

I like the texture of this eye-gel cream. Its moisturizing but not heavy feeling on my skin. Since using this I have noticed my crows feet and under eye wrinkles less noticeable. I also like that the cream does not have a scent especially since its for the eye area.

Absolutely amazing!! I’ve struggled for a long time to find a face wash that really cleanses the skin but is also extremely gentle. This face wash definitely succeeds in doing exactly that! I can’t recommend enough!!

I have oily skin so this product helps cleanse the skin and leaves it feeling soft and not irritated. Makes it really easily to exfoliate and also does a good job of removing makeup. Gifted by Dermalogica.

I really liked the mask when I put it on (though a little tingly at first), and my skin felt soft when I took it off. I must have gotten it too close to my lips (though I definitely did not put it on my lips) because the skin around my upper lip had a reaction after taking off the mask (at 4 minutes after applying). It has been sensitive/chapped for a couple days since. I don’t typically have overly sensitive skin, and on the rest of my face it was great! If I used it again, I would make extra sure to stay well away from any sensitive skin areas and I might just leave it on for three minutes.The color change when applying the mask is fun and the texture makes it easy to use! I would say it gets a “recommend” with reservations for sensitive skin. I’m not sure a spot test would have helped in my case since the rest of my face tolerated the mask well, but if you have sensitive skin in general, I would highly recommend doing that before using on your whole face (as most products recommend you do anyway).
review_title: Nice, but something didn’t sit well with my skin

review_text: I am in love with this stuff! I had purchased the other brand but the scent was slaying me. I was afraid to buy the full size in case I didn’t like it, but just wow, wow, wow. This has the softest herbal scent that goes away immediately and it really did help reduce the smile line foundation creasing. The other brand not so well. I have always had deep creases on my forehead so I did not have high hopes. I am expressive and wrinkles are a fact, I can not say oh wow I have been photo shopped, but I do feel they looked less. Less deep, less noticeable from a distance. Had I spent more time buffing and patting maybe I could have gotten them more less, IDK. But I am very pleased. Even the fine lines at the exterior corners of my eyes did not crease. So, 2 out of 3 is a huge score in my opinion. Take heed, don’t use too much, a little really does the trick. This size does not come with the metal spatula. I actually feel that is more of a bonus, because I am more tempted to be reserved when using and applying the product.
product_name: The Silk Canvas Protective Primer Mini

review_text: Too strong of a scent and my skin broke out after a few tries. My skin seems to be sensitive to it. Left my skin feeling sticky instead of hydrated.
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Fortifying Lotion Toner

review_text: This product gives a gorgeous dewy look to finish off my makeup. I have had zero issues with it breaking my foundation ect when applied on top. I have ageing skin and it has helped it look hydrated and glowing in the frigid cold winter weather. I don’t know if I would use it in the summer but it will definitely be a staple for my winter makeup routine from now on.

this was a complete no!!! the product was recommended to me by a sephora employee, and while reviews are great and the packaging is pretty- it didn’t work for me at all. it made my skin itchy and broke me out. I struggle to keep small pimples away as an adult (22) I breakout easily and i’ve got sensitive skin so I have to be careful what I’m using. I don’t recommend for sensitive skin. Everyone is different and what works for me might not work for you vice versa, but from now on i’ll stick with the paula’s choice BHA exfoliant which is my tried and true product.
product_name: Mini Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: This product didn’t do what it said it would and actually made my skin worse!!
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I’m obsessed! I’ve been using this product since May when I received a sample, and am now starting my second full-size bottle. I use it day and night (meaning the 8.5oz lasts about 4 months). I’m 31, female, and needs a product that addresses my break outs and reduces signs of aging.Here is my feedback:- Great cleanser; gets off makeup so I don’t even need a separate remover- Smells fantastic; peach aroma- Completely unclogs pores; test it yourself! I look in my 10x Simple Human mirror before and after and am sometimes shocked that my pores have all but disappeared- My face is fresh and bright after- I may be imagining this, but my forehead wrinkles seem so much more faint. I certainly am not getting anymore wrinkles!I can’t from using the Murad anti-wrinkle, anti-acne skin care set. While I still swear by his moisturizers and serums, I’m now a devout PTR follower for cleansing.Highly recommended!
review_title: Finally found a cleanser I'd rate 5 stars

review_text: Let me first start by saying if you are looking for a clean product that doesn’t break out combination skin, with the perfect balance of moisture this is it. I hate seeing all the reviews that is smells bad. It’s a clean product great for sensitive skin. Who needs a face cream that smells good if it does exactly what it’s intended for plus more. It’s a face cream not a perfume, get over it lol! I use the gel during the day since I tend to get more oily, and the cream at night to help balance my combo sometimes more dry skin! Please don’t change formula it’s perfect!
review_title: Amazing for sensitive skin that needs moisture
product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: I am on my second full size jar of this face mask. It has become a staple in my skincare. I’ve been having trouble with acne for years and while I can’t say this has cleared my skin, it does help tremendously when I get a breakout. This mask does have a tingle/sting (especially when you have active breakouts) but I don’t mind it at all. It really does smooth out my skin and helps make my breakouts go away much quicker. Another bonus, I’ve never had any irritation or dryness form using this mask, it’s actually the opposite, I find after using this mask my moisturizer really absorbs and I feel more hydrated. I usually use the mask before bed then follow up with a nice hydrating night cream like “pink cloud“ and a bit of Ren’s overnight recovery balm.
product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

review_text: Not worth the hype. It leaves a shiny residue on your face and I don’t like the smell. It’s just okay. For the price, your better off buying medical grade skin moisturizer.

I have combination skin that is very sensitive and tends to dry out easily. I get pore conjestion on my nose and chin and it is always a total pain trying to clear them out, esp due to the dry skin. Not only was I just damaging my skin at trying extractions, it wasnt working long term. I decided to give these a go becaues the reviews were great and I have to say, I kind of hate how much I love these. To be fair, I changed my total skin regim - I have incorporated using one of these either every night or every other night after washing and toning my skin. After I use this, I spray with rose water, use the Luna night oil & the Good Genes by Sunday Riley and finish with a nighttime moisterizer by Belif. Within a month of doing this (and using a vit c serum in the AM with my moisterizer and SPF) my skin has totally cleared. It isnt dry, it is SO smooth, all of the blackheads that were in my Tzone have gone away. It has worked wonders. I love love love this product and dont know if I can go back now. Must buy!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I am reviewing Cica-recover and repair by @Dior. I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review with @Influenster. I live in New York and my hands and face tend to get painfully dry. The first thing I noticed was that you didn’t need a lot to take the dryness away. I also noticed IMMEDIATELY was there was no oily residue. I mean you could rub it in and go! I used this product on my hands twice daily, as the directions stated. I could not only see a difference, I could feel a difference as well. When I applied it to my combination skin, my skin just drank it up! I would definitely recommend using this product to bring your beautiful, soft and supple skin back!
This toner smells amazing, feels soft and soothing on my dry skin and adds hydration that lasts all day. It is my go-to toner!
product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner

review_text: Started to severely irritate my second with the second use. Huge red rash and hot feeling — lots of blotchy spots like mosquito bites too. Test a very small amount at first and do not use on sensitive skin. I have no idea what ingredient I would have reacted to considering I’ve never experienced anything like this before.

SUPER disappointed considering the hype and price. I immediately fell in love with this product right after applying because of how it made my skin look by itself, but it doesn’t work well with foundation. It gets super patchy throughout the day and does not make my makeup last like other primers. It also does nothing for oil control.
product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer

review_text: This cream is amazing! I have been using it for a couple of weeks now and I already see a difference in some of the fine lines I had. It is very gentle and easy to use.
in my opinion this was a pretty average moisturizer. i didnt think anything special of it. it did have a nice texture and overall feel.

I was gifted by Rose Inc Radiant Reveal Brightening Serum. This serum is easily absorbed into the skin and effectively tightens pores. The product tightens enlarged pores and gives the face a lighter shade, evens out the skin surface, refreshes. It controls problem areas well, my dull skin with imperfections has cleared, smoothed and acquired a light and healthy color. The consumption is minimal. The smell is just magical.
product_name: Radiant Reveal Clean Brightening Vitamin C Serum

review_text: If I could give a 0 star I would. Ruined my skin barrier for years. Dried and burned my skin. Do not buy.

Ole has been hit or miss for me. Unfortunately this product didn’t do what it claims for me. The dimethicone does feel soft and smooth when applying it and it smells nice. It did not help with fine lines or crows feet. My dark circles are putting up a good fight and they have won against this creme.
product_name: Wrinkle Blur Bakuchiol Eye Gel Crème

review_text: I have used and really enjoyed many Supergoop products. This is an interesting concept. I am not fond of the dropper, as I much prefer a squeeze tube or pump, although this is probably too runny for either of those options. It has a tint, likely so you don’t end up with the typical white cast a mineral sunscreen would give. So, I appreciate that. It applies easily, although it is pretty glowy, so I would expect oily skins may not love the formula. I think it’s worth a try and the ingredients are good, but I will likely not repurchase as I love the other Supergoop SPFs. I think it’s awesome we have so many textures and formulas for SPF as the important thing is finding something you will like and use.
review_title: Another Nice SPF + Option from Supergoop!
product_name: Daily Dose Bioretinol + Mineral SPF 40 with Bakuchiol

review_text: This stuff is amazing. Skin feels so good and price is great. I will buy again.

I received a sample of this cream and was not impressed. I’m 43 with normal to dry skin and it did not moisturize enough. Texture is nice but that’s about it. Might work well under another moisturizer. Glad I tried it first as its not worth the price.
I used the entire bottle but didn’t see any effect in reducing my dark spots. Additionally, I have an acne prone skin and this product made my skin very greasy.
review_title: No effect, made my skin greasy
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: I used to LOVE this stuff, always making sure I had consistently a backup. Well I noticed this with my last bottle of good genes. They changed the formula w/out mentioning it. The original formula was bomb, but she cheapened it. This new formula’s ingredients changed from the first ingredient which is now water. The new was more like a cream, as the original ingredients, where did they go? The formula wasn’t the same it was before, the older one smelled like medicine and was runnier, the new barely had a smell and is a much more creamy. It doesn’t do what the prior one did. I don’t enjoy it when businesses change formulas for no apparent reason, didn’t reach out to consumers, acting like a shady co. I won’t be buying from Sunday Riley. I’m not gonna pay high prices on formulas that have been renormalized, and not being transparent about it. You have ruined the trust therefore no more of your products or you.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I had really high hopes for this since I tend to like the rest of Josie Maran’s products. I have extremely dry skin with patches in my T-zone and was looking for a quick fix of moisture. I will say at first the smell is fantastic and just testing it on the back of your hand it feels like a dream, but after using it for a few weeks it just didn’t do anything for me at all. It just sat on the surface of my skin and never fully sunk in or provided any moisture or results. Either that or seemed like it might work for the first 10 minutes but then I could feel the dryness coming back through it. I’ve tried using it elsewhere like on lips, cuticles, etc. and it hasn’t done a whole lot of justice there either. Unfortunately I’m disappointed overall and probably wouldn’t recommend it for extremely dry girls. :( I would pass on this and maybe try her 100% pure argan oil instead.
product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil

review_text: I absolutely adore Charlotte Tilbury lipsticks and foundation, but never tried her skincare line until now. Charlotte’s Magic Cream really lives up to its name. Everything from the box to the glass jar feels luxurious. I loved the fact that there was so much information on the very stylish box, and even the little heart in the corner made it feel so special. I am a sucker for a good packaging. The glass jar itself feels so nice, and it’s a fitting vessel for such an amazing cream! The cream doesn’t have any overwhelming scent, it just smells really clean, if that makes sense. I think because of it’s ingredients and the lack of any fragrance makes it really suitable for any skin type, even sensitive ones. It looks a bit thick at first glance, but as soon as you spread it around onnyour face, it feels really lightweight and my skin just immediately looks glowier. I have stubborn little fine lines on my forehead, and whenever I put on foundation it looked very dry and the lines looked very exaggerated. But with this amazing cream I can see how every subsequent product I put on (sunscreen, primer, foundation and powder) all seem to blend seemlessly, and my face just looks healthy and glowy. I would definitely be purchasing the refills in the future. It’s one of the other things I love about this product - you can but refills and just use the amazing jar as long as you can. Would definitely recommend!

I have to say I’m a tad disappointed in this product. I was really looking forward to using it since I love the Farmacy brand, however the results were not up to par with expectations. I always test out a product for at least two weeks before making an assumption for those who are wondering. I’ll start with the positive aspect and say that this is an AWESOME makeup remover. Super gentle with a nice fresh, but not overpowering smell, that easily loosens up all makeup (even that stubborn mascara). However, when I would try and get my eye makeup off, it left my vision a bit blurry afterwards and made my eyes a bit irritated. Not horrible but not pleasant either. The other HUGE piece that I was missing was the cleanser part. Now I think if you’re a bit older in years and just need something that helps hydrate and is gentle on your skin, then this product would be perfect for you (I gave this to my mom who is 62 and it’s been wonderful for her). I would say for those who still struggle with acne or face oil, this is not the one for you. After two weeks of washing with it, I noticed my acne coming back that I had long since gotten rid of. What I started doing was just purely using it as a makeup remover but then doing a co wash, which seemed to produce better results. So would I recommend this product? I will give a tentative yes if you are aware of your skin needs and use another cleanser as well. It is a beautiful product that has awesome ingredients and a lovely smell so it’s a win lose in my book.

And it is way too hydrating for my oily combo skin. It definitely made me break out. This may be for you, if you don’t have oily combo skin and aren’t acne prone and sensitive like I am.
Love it!!! It leaves your face hydrated and smooth, I will recommand this product. I gave it as christmas gift as well because it such a great stocking ideas!

I have combo skin in the winter and oily in the summer. I was excited to try this product because of the great reviews and the Sephora staff said they loved it. It immediately made me break out with cystic acne all over my face after the first use. I kept using it for a couple of days hoping my skin would calm down but it didn’t. I returned it and went back to my staple face wash from first aid beauty

The smell after applying it was not pleasant. It left my face oily, only to get worse when I figured I give it a try and apply moisturizer. First time application and I was so disappointed. I tried this toner because my regular toner is not in stock. How in the world did this win an award.

My first time ever trying an eye cream and was hoping this product could reduce my eye puffiness. However, my skin was never a sensitive nor an allergic type, after I tried this for a week, I’m in shock....
I love Fresh. They have so many fantastic products that really work. However, this product does absolutely nothing to my skin. It feels good going on... and useless coming off.
It’s works but is a little heavy for oily skin, turn your face very glowy without makeup
My second purchase of this amazing balm, so soothing and gentle, yet takes away every bit of makeup-love it!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I have always wanted to try this product but because of its price I picked cheaper alternatives. This was no effective for me and instead caused me to break out in two large painful pimples. I stopped all other skin care and tried to use just the essence, moisturizer, and eye cream- I broke out worse! I discontinued used after that. I was also disappointed to learn that these products are made by P&G.

I had high hopes for this SPF and have sworn by many Clinque skincare products in the past, but this one just didn’t do it for me. It was overly dewy to the point of being greasy, and did not sit well under make-up.
product_name: Pep-Start Daily UV Protector Broad Spectrum SPF 50

review_text: This does not last very long and actually feels less effective than the original. It makes my lips feel even drier

This product is more skincare than makeup, and I was hoping it would be the other way around. I have very oily skin and use mattifying primers regularly, and this one does almost nothing when it comes to keeping me matte, or even making my skin matte in the first place. I was still dewy right after I put it on, and I just got more and more throughout the day. If you’re looking for a BA serum, then this is nice, but if you want a primer, get something else. Gifted by Glow Recipe in exchange for my honest review.

I wasn’t too sure what an essence would do for my skin, but WOW I am surprised. I can already tell a difference in how smooth and hydrated my skin is. The packaging is so luxe, and the spout makes it easy to apply using a cotton pad. The formula goes on like silk, with no sticky or oily feeling after. I have combination skin (mostly dry but also acne-prone) and was worried about breakouts with a new product.. nothing but glowing skin so far! It has definitely boosted the results of my other products.
product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

review_text: I got this product to help with the dry fine lines appear on my undereye as it supposed to do the job (moisturizing). I have been using it for a week and I see no difference. I followed the instruction, apply it on my undereye morning and night. However, this eye cream does not get absorbed into your skin, it just stays on top of your skin (I can literally rub off the cream from my skin...). When you first apply, it does give you a fake impression as it makes skin looks very hydrated and smooth but it does absolutely nothing. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY.
I still had acne and more kept appearing the next morning. Also the product is very small for the price.

I got a free sample of this, and I’m glad I didn’t spend money on it because it’s super greasy and has a pretty bad smell. I washed it off my hands within minutes of using it because I can’t stand greasy lotions at all, and the smell was so bad. I have pretty dry skin all over and this did absolutely nothing to help it. I did leave it on my elbows just to see if it would eventually help and it basically did nothing except make the skin around the really dry parts slightly softer, so there’s that I guess. basically if you hate greasy, awful smelling lotions, and have really dry skin, this isn’t the product for you.
review_title: greasy, smells bad, terrible for dry skin tbh
product_name: Honey Savior All-in-One Skin Repair Salve

review_text: I was very intrigued by this product and to be honest a little confused as to just what it did at first. That being said, I’ve been using it nightly and I do notice a subtle difference in my skin. For some the scent may be too strong but I kind of like it. If scent is a big no no for you, then I’d definitely steer clear... however it somehow seems calming to me so it’s an added bonus. Overall after a week or two of using this profit my skin definitely has more of a glow and overall evenness to it. For the price point I don’t know if I’d purchase it considering the changes are so subtle.
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Fortifying Lotion Toner

review_text: I think this product is ok. It works like a lip balm. I haven’t seen any significant change and continue to deal with chap lips. I wouldn’t recommend anyone to spend that much on a lip mask that acts like a lip balm or Vaseline. I probably won’t repurchase.
review_title: Not worth the price or hype
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: LOVE this cleanser! Doesn’t sting my ultra-sensitive eyes or feel like there’s any residue after rinsing, plus doesn’t make my skin feel tight. I use this with my Clarisonic.
I love this cream, but I feel like this is not ideal for a night cream, but for days you are going glam. It helps keep the foundation in place and it is tacky like primer.
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I absolutely love the ordinary, but this product just wasn’t for me. I didn’t love the way it sat on my skin, the texture was too tacky for me, especially with combo skin. I didn’t really notice a difference with it, and much prefer a Hyaluronic acid in a moisturizer. Overall would be nice for dryer skin types though.

I tried a sample of this - my face has been nice and clear but dry considering it’s winter and I use retinol 2-3x week. Figured this brand is reputable and id try this for my thirsty skin. It felt great going on, really nice texture. But woke up the next day with 3 super deep clogged pores/ pimples :( if you have sensitive skin that breaks out easily, definitely avoid this.
I received this product from Influenster. Personally I wasn’t thrilled with it and would rather purchase other products for my skin care needs.

I absolutely love this overnight mask. By far one of the best products I have purchased at Sephora. My skin is quite dry especially in the winter months but using this makes my skin so super soft and healthy looking. You can tell by the consistency of the mask how hydrating it will be. And a little goes a long way!
product_name: Ultra Facial Overnight Hydrating Face Mask with 10.5% Squalane

review_text: I absolutely love all things PTR! This is part of my daily skin care regimen and has proved to be irreplaceable. Leaves my skin soft and refreshed for the whole day

This brand of Argan Oil is particularly nice; I’ve tried other brands that had an odd smell to them, but the Josie Maran has little to no scent at all. I like to put two or three drops on the back of my hand, then rub it into both hands and finish up with the residue on my face and throat. A little goes a long way. It quickly soaks into my dry skin and improves the appearance of my hands and face instantly.

I received a couple of samples of this and used it a total of 4 times before purchasing. Worked so amazingly that I purchased the full size. I’m multiple uses into the full size and IT DOES NOT WORK AT ALL. I don’t know if the product is old, it’s the plastic packaging or what, but I’m very disappointed. The sample delivered like a dream. The real product is ineffective white cream that let me down. Guess I’ll go back to searching for the foundation of youth, because this $89 product is defective.
review_title: Does not work like the sample!
product_name: Needles No More Wrinkle Smoothing Cream

review_text: As someone who is SUPER sensitive to fragrance, I was terrified to buy this after reading recent reviews. But - it smells super light and fresh! I use rosewater daily and that’s the notes I pick up from this cleanser. It’s gentle, leaves my skin feeling fresh and supple. Ingredient list is amazing. I love it! My ONLY con is that there is a lack of control with how much product comes out of the pump. It’s a very specific full amount of cleanser no matter how gentle you push, which is annoying because you lose or overuse product. Otherwise - it’s lovely and worth a try for sensitive skin.
product_name: Pink Cloud Rosewater + Squalane Makeup Removing Face Wash

review_text: I rarely write reviews and I really wanted to love this product for the hype but this is the second time I buy this product expecting different results. I have oily skin so dry skin is rarely an issue but immediately after using this product my skin dries out pretty badly, especially around my mouth area. it’s such a bummer but it just doesn’t work for me
Not such a good result unfortunately, there is no difference between my past skin and current skin conditions!

Credit where credit is due. I wore this to the beach for a tropical vacation on my face for a full week and barely even tanned and definitely didn’t burn the whole time I was there (I did reapply after heavy swimming or sweating). If you need strong protection this seems to truly offer that. For more regular use this is good, but not my favorite as the finish is a little heavy and drying for my dry skin type. Still, in the dog days of summer when I’m at my oiliest and the sun exposure is higher, this is a good one to have on hand. Just not great for winter for my skin type.
product_name: Max Mineral Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 45

review_text: I love Drunk Elephant products so this review is hard. This micellar water does not work as described. It does not remove make-up or cleanse. Not sure what happened here. All the other DE cleansers are great. Skip this product and choose another of DE cleanser.
Tried it for 3 days and it broke my cheeks out terribly! I tried this because Peter Thomas Roth stopped making their de spotter serum which was amazing. Big disappointment.
product_name: Potent-C Vitamin C Targeted Spot Brightener

review_text: I received the product free for testing purposes from Influenster and Tatcha.My review: I have oily skin in the t zone area and a bit drier in other areas. I used this product after my nightly cleansing routine. The next morning my face is extremely oily and heavy feeling. I think this product is for those with dry skin.
product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment

review_text: There are many nice lip treatments available, but this one is a staple because does hydrate and smooth lips with very little product so it’s good value for money. It is not sticky, not greasy. I use it at night, and also use it after showering so that by the time I get around to lipstick it has absorbed and forms a nice base for lipstick application.

I love this product. I purchased based off the recommendation of Andreea Ali. Im glad I purchased it. I literally use a nickel size amount and lathers and cleanses beautifully leaving my skin feeling so soft. Smells great to. I purchased the large bottle, I have not had issues with packaging like others. I think just handle it gently and you’ll be fine. It is a plastic top and I can see how it could break Im just gentle with it.
review_title: The product is great and would definitely repurch

review_text: Broke me out and left my face very shiny.

I was disappointed with the outcome of this product. When I started using it, my lips felt nice and soft. After prolonged usage, I noticed my lips would get dried out quickly. I had to constantly reapply to make sure my lips wouldn’t crack. With its hefty price tag, that’s not something I felt I should need to do, or want to do. I will not be repurchasing.

This product was hyped up too much. It really is just an occasional, fun mask and not so much functional. The cooling effect makes your pores shrink, but shortly after it’s washed off your skin will return to normal. Also NOT for sensitive skin!! I regret buying this.

Been using this cream for 3Months. Don’t see not even a slight difference in any discoloration issues. Feels good on skin. Expensive for not delivering results. Absorbs well in skin. Will give it a second try, but nothing/no results so far
review_title: Not happy yet, will keep trying

review_text: So good! Keeps my skin so clean and clear without drying it out! It feels like peppermint on your skin. Highly recommend.

My skin is NOT sensitive. I have combination to oily skin.. oily mainly in t-zone and I have some hyperpigmentation in my jaw area. I dont have trouble with acne other then the occasional pimple here and there but they leave behind dark marks. I’ve tried other products by olehenriksen and loved them. .. but this product broke me out. I currently have tiny bumps all over my face. from a distance probably cant tell they’re there. when looking looking in a mirror my skin is clearly irritated. I used this product one time. do a patch test even it you dont have sensitive skin.
I really wanted this product to work for my skin, but it just made my face tight and dry afterwards. ):
product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

review_text: I have very dry skin and this is the only moisturizer that truly makes my skin feel hydrated, and doesn’t leave a white cast or pill off. It feels great under my SPF and Makeup. I also use it at night under my Night Cream to give myself that extra boost of hydration. The packaging with the little pump is also super cute and way more sanitary than your average jar!
review_title: The best for super dry skin
product_name: Nourishing Rich Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: not even ordinary it was extraordinary. extraordinarily terrible for my skin i am bleached and acid has burned my pores i look like a monster my kids scream when look@me

Love this moisturizer! Really locks in the hydration in my skin without causing breakouts - I have dry sensitive skin. I also like that it does not have a strong scent. Will definitely be repurchasing when I run out!
product_name: Barrier+ Skin Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream

review_text: Really nice texture and doesn’t make my sensitive skin break out!
product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya

review_text: People’s gushing reviews of this product are, frankly, baffling. At best this product can be described as functional. It comes in a nice glass bottle and has an inoffensive smell of crushed greenery. That’s about where the list of good qualities ends.I bought this product as an upgrade from my drug-store brand face wash I’ve used without issue for over a decade. It has actively and noticeably made my skin worse in the full month that I’ve been using it. My face skin has tiny raised bumps that are new since starting use, and there’s a noticeable increase in redness all over my face from before I started using it. I’ve removed other products from my regimen thinking it was them causing this, but after swapping things out over time I’ve realised this product is the culprit. The product is runny and doesn’t foam when rubbed in your hands or applied anywhere. I find I have to use far more of this face wash as other brands of face wash to get any kind of foam in my hands before it runs offI am looking forward to switching back to my simple and affordable drug-store brand face wash and getting my unruddied and smooth skin back.

The overtime mask was a part of the Summer Fridays trio set when I had purchased it. I believe it was only $50 for all three mask set! SO WORTH IT. When I first applied it on, there was a tingling sensation, but it went away after a couple of minutes! The next morning I could tell an immediate difference. My skin looked brighter and didn’t have that morning dull. Will definitely include this in my routine once a week!

I received this product for free in exchange for a review. The company generously sent me a teaspoon of product so that in my review I could speak to the results after “consistent use.” I will not ever be purchasing from this company because they contractually bind people like me who review products online into posting a skincare product review after only ~3 uses. To me, it’s unethical and feels like they’re just trying to increase their review count. So, the product is fine but not great considering the extreme price. It feels nice and smoothing right after application, but my skin feels dry again after an hour. I can’t speak to any firming or long term properties because I was only able to use it for a few days. I would not purchase from this brand in the future.

I really like the regular Dramatically Different lotion for warmer weather, but needed something thicker for fall and winter. This is such a nice feeling cream. It glides right on and leaves my skin soft and hydrated. I have sensitive skin, and, as usual, Clinique did not cause any irritation and was soothing. No sticky feeling. No gummy film that rolls up when you apply makeup. Just a great moisturizer.
Cream was so smooth and dries quickly. Really loved it!
This gave me an allergic reaction... got tiny pimples on my face neck and arms from this (also applied on my arms to make sure that this was what caused an allergic reaction)

I keep trying this brand because I keep getting samples, and every one of their products smells like bad, stinky incense. This was also super goopy and felt like a mask even though it’s just a moisturizer. Pass.

I received a small sample of this a few months back and I used it almost every day to remove my eye make up. It took a good two minutes to sufficiently remove everything from one eye. I would not repurchase because it’s too time-consuming, expensive, and there are better products on the market.
Did nothing for my blemishes at all. I woke up every morning hoping it would work and it did nothing

I had high hopes that this would be a great base product for me, and that it would eliminate the use of concealer and maybe even foundation over time. However, this product never sinks into my oily/combo skin no matter how little I use. It sits on my skin in a greasy film, and I have found that I get milia on my skin while the product is on and even the night/next day after I wash it off. I’ve tried to use this product off and on for about two months, and I think it’s time to give it up. I would recommend that others try it like I did, with the small jar, before wasting money on the large jar.
review_title: Didn't work for my sensitive/oily skin
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I used the entire pack of these as directed and I just felt like they are overpriced blotting papers that stay on your face for 4-6 hours. Saw little oil spots but never any blackhead “gunk”. I actually thought they made the pores on my nose a lot more noticeable. Disappointing considering I love the little acne dots peace out does.
review_title: does nothing you want it to do

review_text: It’s ok. Super runny, absorbs well.. If you have dry skin, it does well over some moisturizers, others i’ve noticed pilling. If I use without a moisturizer I get noticably dry. Somehow makes it’s way to my eyeballs and is a little irritating. Don’t mind it, probably won’t repurchase.
product_name: RESIST Youth-Extending Daily Hydrating Fluid SPF 50

review_text: This product seems to work however I felt a weird burn in my skin after using it, and I also didn’t like the smell and how oily it made me feel (after already having oily skin). On the other hand it does seem to work and if you don’t have oily or sensitive skin and want your eyes to seem younger, then this is perfect for you
product_name: Advanced Génifique Wrinkle & Dark Circle Eye Cream

review_text: I have dry patches on my face and was excited to try this face cream. I’ve heard good things about Bobbi Brown products. II have a hard time finding a product that does a great job. I used to use Chanel’s Rectifiance until they quit making it. Unfortunately, this didn’t do the job and I ended up returning it. It made my dry patches even dryer, and it had a very odd odor (I think it was the algae in it). The odor disappeared after awhile but is very noticeable when applied. Thankfully, Sephora has a great return policy and took it back, no questions asked.
I hated the smell of this so much that I had to return it.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I didn’t like it at all .. its creamy and all that but my mascara didn’t come off
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Too harsh for the skin. I did not see any results and actually felt like it was making my acne worse.

Honestly I bought this product for mixing in with my moisturizer to apply to my face to even out my face to my body tan. Even though it is a clean product at Sephora, that doesn’t mean it won’t break you out. The amount of different oils and fragrance in this product is very high and the oils contained in this product on the comedogenic scale are pretty high meaning they will likely clog your pores and most likely cause breakouts if you have sensitive skin. I wish I looked at the ingredients list before I purchased. I love the colour and glow it gave me on my face but the breakouts aren’t worth it. I’ve done so much to get my skin in check and this caused very painful big pimples on my face every time I used it. I decided if I wasn’t going to use it on my face I could try on my body and it worked out decently and even. It is way more convenient mixing it in with your moisturizer and going to sleep in it rather than a tan with a colour guard. For the body I will say it most likely won’t last very long because you need to use quite a bit of drops to achieve a dark colour.

I used this product in the past and didn’t notice a difference with hyperpigmentation so then I tried a bunch of other vitamin C serum products. Fast forward a few years and every time I researched vitamin C Drunk Elephant serum came up so I thought I’d give it another try. I like the way this product has been revamped. You mix it yourself so it doesn’t oxidize before you even get a quarter of the way in! I will say this time around with the serum being fresh, I’ve seen improvements with hyperpigmentation! I’m glad that I gave this serum another try! No wonder it always make the “best“ list.

I lived trying out this affordable pores serum from Sephora Collection that is also vegan and clean. I think it did a great job of helping to decongest some of my pores, which is what it’s purpose is. I would recommend this serum!
product_name: Targeted Pores Serum with BHA + PHA

review_text: This gives you a really good clean and helps remove excess make up left behind from a remover. Just make sure you moisturize well after it does leave the skin quite blank. I use a toner, serum, eye cream and moisturizer afterwards to restore hydration.

This was a hard NO! This is a soap-free gel, which means it has natural foaming ingredients in it. My face didn’t really feel clean. I used this along with the microfoliant (it’s a fake hype, don’t believe it and the toner which is actually pretty great, surprisingly). There isn’t a “real” scent, but it reminds me of hand soap. I was still having make up in my face after using when I would use the toner. So, it really isn’t cleaning your face. Don’t waste your time. I wanted to like it so much. But, just, no!
review_title: May as Well Use Hand Soap

review_text: I Followed the instructions and didn’t miss a day. Very expensive and no results.
product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This product is just...meh. For the $, you can get a product with the same ingredients for a much better price point. It has a weird smell that I don’t mind when something works but I didn’t notice a significant difference in my skin. Save your $

It has a bit of an oily appearance after it is initially applied but truly rejuvinates my skin. I’ve given it a fair amount of time to judge and so far the area around my eyes looks incredibly smooth and fresh! Definitely recommend trying this out!
Sadly this did not work for me and my husband. We still had plenty of blackheads in our nose and didn’t see any improvement.
After using this product my face broke out in tons of little itchy bumps. I had to get a steroid from my doctor to treat. Will return. The old version seemed perfect.
product_name: Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Cream Moisturizer

I have typically oily skin but this product made my cheeks dry and textured, my forehead was super textured and you could see my expression lines (I’m 21 for heavens sake and have never seen those lines before). I discontinued using it and smothered my face in aquaphor.
Greasy, scent wasn’t good, and made my dry-combo non acne prone skin break out

I am in love with this lip balm. Have been for years. I usually stock up in bulk. I use lip balm constantly and this is the only one that relieves chapped lips and heals them. I also use it on scratches, scrapes, rashes or dry skin patches. When I get sick, use it when my nose is dry, the mint opens up my nose so I can breathe. I have the original rose too.

product_name: Bye Bye Redness Neutralizing Color-Correcting Cream

The mask is super sticky and annoying to apply but i could live with it if it was good. I have oily skin and this made me break out all over my face. Normally i only break out on my jawline and very mildly but i got pimples all over my face after using this both times. Thank god i didnt buy it.

I personally wasn’t impressed with this. The moisturizer was a little too oily the smell was a little overbearing and the exfoliater was a little too harsh on my skin. When I started to use this it made my acne worse and gave me lots of little bumps on my chin and my temple area. Also for whatever reason whenever I put it on my face it made it very itchy and was just uncomfortable.

Well I did enjoy this product i received this complimentary from influenster, this product is thick but goes on great in your skin the only problem is if your on the oily side like me it does feel a bit slippery but not greasy kinda hard to explain. product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

Love this product so much. It’s the perfect sunscreen for the summer and gives you such a beautiful glow! (Must have for the beach/or anything outdoors)
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: I received a sample of the Dr. Zenovia Skincare Retinol Recovery Eye Cream through Pinchme and I have mixed feelings about this cream. It wasn’t very easy to pump out of the tube, it almost seemed like there wasn’t much in it. It did dry out my skin a bit, I may have used too much. On a good note I did notice the bags under my eyes weren’t as noticable and the black lines did disappear. I probably would use it again, just moisturize more and use less.

Purchased this product during quarantine because I figured it would be a safe time to try out a new tan. All I can say is I am so glad I bought it during this time when I won’t be going out in public because oh-boy this is bad. I did 8 pumps for every 5 pumps of lotion to get a deeper tan and not only do I look like an Oompa Loompa, but a patchy one. The pigment is very orange, and I noticed that the tan is deeper in some places and lighter in others. No thanks, I’ll be going back to my tanning mousse.
I tried using this for a week and it irritated my skin so much !! I’ve dry skin so maybe it wasn’t meant for me. I gave it away.

It’s been interesting watching Bare Minerals get further and further into skincare over the years. I received this via an Influenster vox box in return for my honest review. The kinda scary photo of myself is with zero makeup, just my skincare and sunscreen. I am always a little wary of trying skincare through these because I have adult acne and sensitive skin that’s oily but is easily dehydrated. The fact that this has plant extract actives and isn’t an acid like vitamin C really intrigued me. So, on to usage experience. It’s a gel cream consistency, not too thick or thin. On my skin, it absorbs really nicely, and isn’t sticky or weirdly smooth like things full of silicones. A week into using it, I definitely felt more plump and glowy. Just brighter and healthy. The hydrated plumpness definitely softened fine lines on my 40 year old skin. I don’t know if it’s actually reducing them, but I look fresher and brighter. Plus it didn’t cause any irritation or breakouts, and I applied it everywhere, even around my eyes. Overall, even though I received this gratis, I do think you get a fair amount for the price, especially since it was so easy to add to my routine, which means I will keep using it and reaping the benefits.
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: It was good. It lasted me about 9 weeks (i bought the 1.7oz) used it every morning and night. Didn’t noticed the difference until I saw my before and after pic. It helped me getting rid of some acne scars and evened out my skin. Would I buy it again? Ehhh. I liked it but didn’t love it. It did its job but nothing shocking. Gotta be consistent to get results
product_name: Even Better Clinical Radical Dark Spot Corrector + Interrupter Serum

review_text: The first day I used this, my face broke out in an itchy rash with little bumps all over it. As soon as I washed it off, my face calmed. It’s a shame because I REALLY wanted to like this moisturizer. It felt so buttery and soft going on my face and the packaging is genius with its magnetic scoop included.
