I originally started with another product from this line- the regular face wash- and it had worked out better that the other face wash i was using from Alba. i started using this line because of the fact that it helps with eczema and other sensitive skin types. i used it for a while, until i started looking up other products from this line. I saw that they had some products that help with oily & acne prone skin as wella s pores. I was scared to try it just in case it didnt work, but i finally caved in considering the other products from this line worked and helped my skin. im three days into it and i actually do see a difference. my pores look a little less visible. and i havent gotten any pimples or anything since ive started, if anything its been clearing out the acne on my forehead. I dont have a pizza face or anything, but i do get a lot more acne than when i was younger and the oilyness is partly responsible for that. ive gotten a lot more oily these past few years. I do have a healthy life style i work out, eat organic, non-gmo food and drink lots of water. when i wake up in the morning im usually very oily, like i rubbed butter the night before, but today is wasnt even half as oily like it normally is. very happy about this product, i hope it keeps working. im using the face wash and the Skin rescure blemish patrol pads. waiting for next paycheck to buy the mattifying gel.

This had a irritatingly strong lemony scent whenever I opened the bottle and stung upon contact with my skin the first few times I used it. After a couple of weeks of using Glow2Oh, my skin felt dry and broke out, which made my hyperpigmentation and skin texture worse! My skin got better after I stopped using this product.I also noticed that ingredients meant to treat hyperpigmentation were at lower concentrations on the ingredient list, even lower than witch hazel and fragrance, which can be (and have been, for me at least) irritants that make issues like dryness, breakouts, and hyperpigmentation worse. Given this, I don’t think I spent my money on a product that was geared to helping my skin heal long term. Bad experience + questionable formulation = I do not recommend. For skin that is dry, sensitive, prone to breakouts, or hyper pigments easily, I would definitely steer clear.

I had high hopes for the peel. When I was a teenager I used glycolic acid pads from my dermatologist to help with acne and scars. I also purchased the microdermabrasion cream for Goop and really liked it. I tried this peel at night as the directions say and washed it off in the morning. I made sure to not combine with other creams or treatments and I’ve been in the house a lot for quarantine, so not much sun exposure. I then noticed the next day my face had broken out in a rash, not acne. Now, the directions say you can wash it off after a shorter period of time, but I’m afraid to try it again.
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: Why is this on Sephora? Really disappointed in every aspect of this. If I could give 0 stars I would
review_title: Couldn't pay me to use this
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: I received this wrinkle correcting eye cream as a #freeproduct. I only got sent a sample size so I only got a chance to use it twice. I would need to use it more times to see if it helped with any wrinkles but from what I did use I found the cream to be very thick and kind of sticky but probably the most hydrating eye cream I’ve ever used.
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream

review_text: Smells amazing, moisturizes, leaves a wonderful glow, and doesn’t break me out. Love this facial oil!

The packaging is really cute! I’ve been using it Day and night. I spray it on my face and then pat it into my skin. So far it’s been working great with my other beauty products. It doesn’t have a “fresh” smell it definitely smells like fermented sake, hence the name! So be aware of that! It doesn’t bother me tho I highly recommend it!
review_title: Great addition to my skin care routine
product_name: Sweet Biome Fermented Sake Hydrating Spray

review_text: Gave me deep, painful cystic acne. My face is normally completely clear of acne unless it’s that time of the month, but it’s all month long since I’ve started using this stuff. I regret buying it.
3 days in, so far loving it. My skin looks plump and hydrated! I have sensitive, acne prone dry skin and my face is loving this!

In my light makeup era & this is a must! It goes on super smooth but i always rub on my hand first to warm up & avoid tugging on under eyes, minimal coverage but makes you look more awake if that makes sense! Smells like but overall good product oranges
product_name: Banana Bright+ Vitamin CC Eye Sticks

review_text: I was so looking forward to this product as part of the personal skills I learnt during quarantine. I thought it would do more than a motorized razed but it did not. The images of dead skin removal are very exaggerated in the advertising and what you actually get is quite minimal. Absolutely not worth the price.
product_name: LUXE+ Advanced Sonic Dermaplaning + Peach Fuzz Removal

review_text: I have been searching for my holy grail eye serum, and I found it with Sunday Riley’s new 5 Stars retinoid!!! It’s 5/5 stars for me ;) I have dark circles and some fine lines around my eyes. After using this serum I have seen a significant improvement! My skin is more hydrated and smooth, which makes them look brighter and firm. I love how it has niacinamide and also supports natural collagen production. The texture is amazing, it’s soft and silky and melts into your skin. I enjoy using this every night as part of my routine! Plus, the packaging is super cute!!

This is definitely a MUST buy for softer and beautiful lips, specially if you’re a matte liquid lips wearin’ kinda gal. I use this lip mask after using a lip scrub before bed atleast once a week to keep my lips luscious and looking hydrated. Since it’s getting cold out and winter season makes my skin a little more dryer than the usual, I’ve also been putting this lip mask on right before going biking out in the cold wind.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This product was kindly gifted to me. First of all, I LOVE the packaging and pump dispenser. I personally hate pots/tubs as packaging because it feels unsanitary dipping my fingers straight into the product, so the pump dispenser is perfect. This moisturizer is super creamy and pretty thick - usually I’m a lightweight moisturizer girl but I will definitely reach for this in the colder months when my skin gets super dry. It’s very hydrating and makes my skin feel super soft. I also like that it’s unscented.

It seemed like this moisturizer did not soak into my skin. It felt oily and you could rub it off hours later. I also broke out a little on my forehead. However, it did seem to moisturize the skin. I would not buy again.
Broke me out so bad, I had terrible cystic acne that was painful. I recommend slowly building up the usage of this product because it definitely is a strong exfoliant. Unfortunately not for me.
product_name: Mini Skin Perfecting 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant

review_text: Feels nice upon application but doesn’t really leave a lasting moisturizing effect. As soon as it starts to fade away I feel the dryness of my lips and the balm just sitting on top.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I was hoping this would help me since I have very dry skin and one of my sisters recommended it; it was just ok, not as hydrating as I hoped it would be. I would not buy it again for me but maybe someone with more combination skin or not so dry skin.

This product was not impressive to me. I saw no visible signs of improvement over the two months of having this product. It doesn’t have a great feel on the skin, the scent is really blah and I just feel like it was a waste of time. I appreciate the plant option but honestly I don’t feel I would ever purchase this item, or recommend it to my friends. The two stars are for the packaging and the moisturizing quality. I received this product complementary from Influenster.
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: I’ll start by saying that this collagen is so pretty in the bottle. Literally, makes you want to use it daily. It comes out of the pump dispenser super easy and glides onto the skin like silk. It’s really easy to apply and leaves your skin looking and feeling really nice. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t have much of a scent. I’m about a week and a half in and I’m pretty happy with it so far. Gifted by Algenist.

It didn’t really like this product. It’s too thick compared to other cleansing balms. It didn’t really effectively remove my make up. And I broke out right after I started using it. I had to use a lot of product to get my make up off. I recommend Clean It Zero or Clinique Take The Day Off cleansing balms over this one. They are both much lighter, silkier formulas than the oat.
review_title: Not great for make up wearers

review_text: Received in my play box. It smells like STRAIGHT UP alcohol. I’m actually terrified to spray in on my face since I have dry skin.
product_name: Makeup Setting Spray Organic Sunscreen SPF 30

review_text: This is a 5 Star product to me . This works AMAZINGLY! I️ was getting terrible acne that just wouldn’t go away, and when I started using this it stated to disappear . I️ used the wash then used the acme spot treatment . Both miracle products .

The right thickness and the aloe is soothing for my face after a warm summer day. I wish there was more in the package or they sold them in a bundle as i dont think one package can last anyone a full month and that should be the goal.
review_title: Great product not enough of it

review_text: i know this is an eye cream, but i use it on my whole face because it makes me radiant! i love it and cant live without it. in the pictute i’m not wearing any makeup!

I have been gifted by Farmacy in exchange for my honest review. The texture of the product feels a bit similar to a primer - silky and smooth. Not saying you can and should use it as a primer, but just so you’d get a general idea of how it felt. It’s lightweight and hydrating. My skin texture has gotten better after a while of using the product.

All of Paula’s toners are amazing and I use most of them for different times a year. This is my summer moisturizer. It’s great on my sensitive skin. When I had a newborn and had no time for a skincare routine I would just use this after washing my face and it made my skin feel balanced and healthy and left a nice finish. Love.

This product chemically burned me. After 2 days of use my entire face got dry and itchy, then it got completely swollen and red. I’ve had a chemical peel before and my skin didn’t even react this way. So painful. Stay away!!!

I have only been using this product a little while but I can already tell I’m gonna buy it again. I decided to purchase this with the boscia detoxifying black cleanser, and let me tell you it’s a dream duo. The moisturizer is so perfect for my acne prone oily skin. It has a strange formula that makes my skin Have a healthy glow but not oily. Ever since I started using this I have been rarely oily and I highly recommend this !
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: A waste of money. Very small amount of product for the cost. Not the slightest difference after using half the container.
product_name: Black Tea Firming and De-Puffing Eye Cream

review_text: This eye cream is incredible! The smell is light and pleasant. I love how it makes my skin feel softer and tighter while having only the best ingredients. This is definitely a must have in all skin routines!
This is very drying and it really irritates around my eyes. Can not take off makeup around the eyes since it is so irritating. Would not recommend
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: Did notice it brighten my complexion slightly, but omg it’s SO DRYING. I could only use it every once in a while and it left my skin feeling stripped every time so it just wasn’t worth it. Into the garbage it went.

The most effective thing about this cream is the marketing, which I fell for once, but won’t ever again. Everyone knows there’s no miracle cream that will completely transform your skin, but some things help more than others. And there are items genuinely worth the expense--La Mer eye concentrate, a good Lancome mascara--at nearly $1.50 a day (the 1 oz bottle, used as a day cream, lasted four months), this stuff isn’t even all that good as just a moisturizer. Won’t do it again.
product_name: The Cream with TFC8 Face Moisturizer

review_text: I’ve used the dewy skin cream by Tatcha and fell in love with it so I decided to try this one out. I’m honestly disappointed that I didn’t like it, i got tiny white heads after the first few applications and I ended up giving it to my mom. She loved it. I’ll stick to the dewy skin cream from now on.

This toner definitely has some powerful ingredients which is good if you have a lot of problem areas. However, if you have sensitive skin I’d stay away. Also I don’t recommend using right after a deep cleansing mask or scrub because I find it burns. I haven’t noticed amazing results mostly because I can’t use it daily, but I think with strict use it would work well. I received this product free for testing purposes!

This is definitely not worth the money unless you have extremely dry skin, even then there are better options. I have oily skin and this broke me out every time I used it, which was about five or six times. Not worth the money. Only giving it two stars because people with dry skin could find a good use for it.
product_name: 24K Gold Mask Pure Luxury Lift & Firm

review_text: I have acne prone skin and I have tried many different masks. This is the first one that has really worked for me and it’s not messy like a charcoal mask is. I absolutely love the smell of it and it washes off easily. My skin always looks glowing after and if I get a bad break out I just use this mask for a few days and it clears right up. Will definitely buy again!
product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

review_text: Do not use this cleanser if you struggle with fungal acne. The second ingredient is sodium cocoyl isethionate, which feeds malassezia. There are other ingredients in there as well that worsen fungal acne. I made the mistake of buying this on a whim without checking the ingredients and I started to breakout again after a couple uses. The idea of oil control is cute but this product seems to do more drying than balancing. This is probably the last time I buy from Ole Henriksen as the brand doesn’t seem to understand the importance of pH and often uses comedogenic ingredients. Cute aesthetic tho.
review_title: not for fungal acne prone skin
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: WARNING WARNING WARNING! I do not recommend. In fact Sephora needs to stop selling this product. I am a dry skinned person who is not prone to acne. My skin is clear all the time. I used a bottle of this product. Did notice it was drying but I liked how I felt after. I did notice using the first bottle, a few bumps here and there near my chin but thought nothing of it. I then bought a second bottle after finishing the first. (Bad idea). I started breaking out all over my chin in hives and acne. This usually happens when I drink milk. I’m allergic to milk so I stay away. Instantly I thought it was dairy I must’ve ate without realizing. A week later more bumps were populating. It was not going away. I stopped using the cleanser and just used Irish springs to wash my face since I know that doesn’t make me break out and it keeps my skin clear. I started noticing my bumps drying up and flattening. This week I noticed they were gone. So I used the Farmavy cleanser again to see if that did anything to irritate my face. And 3 days later here is my face (photo). This cleanser ruins skin
review_title: WARNING! stay away from this product!
product_name: Clean Bee Ultra Gentle Facial Cleanser

review_text: I’ll be the first to say it, I really don’t like face serums. Never have. However, I purchased this cream along with the other new Cicapair products when they first released because the Cicapair line is my favorite and I just have to have it all! Shortly after, I also received this product complimentary for testing purposes. Guess I should have waited. This product does exactly what it claims to do, it really helps with redness and irritation, and I do feel like it protects my skin especially with the wildfires and smoke that’s been occurring in my area. But the rest of the line does that as well, and I just don’t find this serum to be a staple or must have in my collection. If you like serums though, you will probably enjoy this.
Lightweight with a beautiful, nonirritating scent. Absorbs well and very good for oily skin!

I know that packaging shouldn’t factor into how much I love a product, but this packaging is adorable. Love the size! Fits right into my purse so I can reapply on the go. This watermelon sunscreen is packed with all kinds of good stuff, plus leaves my skin feeling great! Very moisturizing and gave me a natural glow but not greasy!

I reluctantly kept this as the search for an eye cream was so hard. I should have returned it considering how expensive it was. I was looking for a replacement for he Bobbi Brown eye repair balm that was discontinued. This was not it. The forum also is thick but not like an ointment. I couldn’t put my finger on what the texture was like so I checked the ingredients again. Tons of silicone. Like the first few ingredients. It seems to sit on the skin and not like an occulant. I also wake up and my eyes are a bit red. $95 is going in the trash. Don’t recommend.

I was excited to try this product, and was disappointed when I woke up to dry lips! I couldn’t believe my lips were in worse shape, so I tried it another night and had the same outcome. I gave this product a couple stars because it feels thick, and has a great scent. I use it as a lip gloss because I cant justify throwing it out. It provides a nice shine but thats about it.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Honestly, it doesn’t do anything for me. Used (2) tubes, no results. I really wish I liked The Ordinary products, but almost all of them make me break out. The Azelaic Acid doesn’t make me break out, but it pills terribly, and it has no effect on redness, discoloration, or texture for me personally.

I received this product from influenster complementary for my review. First I’ll start by this is super nice and cold on the eyes so you get this feeling like you are de puffing the eyes and it feels really nice. But I don’t care for how sticky it gets under my eyes and takes a while to fully absorb. It leaves a really nice dewy look so I prefer to use this in my night time routine.
product_name: Glow + Get It Cooling & Brightening Eye Balm

review_text: tried this bc of how much it’s raved but omg… noticed way more break outs than I had before on my cheek that was entirely clear right after spraying it on :/ so bummed, another thing is is VERY drying, I have drying skin and it dried me up especially in my forehead area and accentuated my forehead lines big time, bummed this didn’t work for me

I love this stuff! I’ve tried the SKII essence in the past and didn’t notice much - almost gave up on essences until I found this product. Truly life-changing. It makes my skin supple and glowy. I use it on clean skin before applying my serums and moisturizers, both day and night. Only downside is how much product you get.
product_name: Pink Drink Firming Resurfacing Peptide Face Mist

review_text: I only gave this product two stars because it smelled nice. I tried this out and it didn’t clean my face as effectively as Philosophy’s Purity, it also made me break out and my skin felt tight and somewhat dry afterwards. It also has a slimy feel to it.
a little goes a long way and very moisturizing. I didn’t really find it amazing so I probably won’t purchase again.the packaging also split and oozed out the side.
product_name: Rich Bitch Cactus + Vitamin C Moisturizer

review_text: Light non-greasy cream with a slight sour aroma. It is well absorbed. My skin is prone to dryness. Applied on the whole face and neck for two weeks. The skin became more sensitive, it began to dry and peel. It seemed to me that the skin became thinner. Pores on the face became more visible and contaminated, the face turned red. After that, I stopped applying to the whole face, applied only to wrinkles. I think my wrinkles became more pronounced and my skin is very dry. Apparently this cream is not for my skin type.
Love love love! Leaves yours face feeling fresh and minty. 10/10
product_name: Cold Plunge Pore Remedy Moisturizer with BHA/LHA

review_text: I have enlarged pores on my cheeks and around my nose. I’ve been using this for two weeks and can already see a huge improvement. I have sensitive skin and debated between this and the calming polish but this hasn’t caused me any problems and I’m so glad I gave it a try!
product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

review_text: This scar gel is incredible. At first I was a bit on the skeptical side as having been disappointed in the past with other scar healing products. But this Dr. Zenovia Scar Gel Treatment works so well. I have only been using it for a few weeks and am already starting to see a difference in the scarring on my face. The product is a bit thick but once rubbed in, it soaks into the skin quickly. I can’t wait to see how my face will look a month from now. I really do love Dr. Zenovia products I have yet to be let down by any of them I have used in the past.

I so wished this lived up to the hype, but no matter how many drops I use, how much it is diluted with my moisturizer(s), I’ve tried letting it marinate in my moisturizers.... I do not recommend this product.

Scent, lightness, texture, after-feeling and in general, all good. 5/5. I’ve used this for over 3wks and I can tell that the texture on the skin got better, but the “brightness” or “spot treatment”, I don’t really see an improvement. Would I buy again? Likely, but not for brightening purpose, for light lotion purpose.
product_name: Guava Vitamin C Dark Spot Treatment Serum

review_text: I wantedddd so bad to love this product, and I do think that for less sensitive skin this would be great. BUT, i react badly to fragrance and this product has a lotttttt... I would try to sample it first and see how your skin reacts, but i’d be wary if you have sensitive skin about committing to the full bottle.
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: I love this serum!!! So far it has improved the texture of my skin and just makes my face glow! I didn’t think I’ll like this serum and was skeptical but after just a couple of uses I can see results! Overall I highly recommend it
product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

review_text: I loved the original formula of this cleanser and happily spent $50 buying it. It was the first luxury face wash I used and it made me understand the hype behind luxury products. Smelled amazing, and left my skin soft and beautiful. I was scared hearing they were changing the formula and for good reason. New formula is terrible for me! No luxurious scent, leaves my skin feeling filmy/waxy, doesn’t visibly improve my skin and I’m pretty sure is causing breakouts. Super disappointed. Not worth $35. Guess I’m in the market for a new face wash.
product_name: Ceramic Slip French Green Clay Cleanser

review_text: No one has ever complimented me on my skin until I started using this product. I mix one pump with my moisturizer (Keihl’s daily SPF 30) and it makes me look radiant! I don’t wear foundation, just a little Dr. Jart Black Label Detox BB, and I can really see the difference using this product.
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: It’s very moisturizing and feels really nice. It has a nice subtle scent which is great. The only downside is that sometimes it melts and its a huge pain to put back in the container.
I can’t say enough about these daily peels. I can literally see a difference within an hour of use. As an esthetician I was skeptical but this DOES NOT disappoint
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This gets such great reviews I was really surprised to find out I hated it. I didn’t even bother waiting for results because I didn’t like it on my skin. It was very greasy and left a residue on my hands like cheap hand lotion. On my face it took forever to sink in and stayed pretty tacky; that was no plus in my book. Going back to the store-today!
product_name: High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs

review_text: The scent on this is way too overpowering to the point that it feels like you are rubbing alcohol on your face. I don’t feel that it helped with dryness and it just seemed like a wasted step in my skincare regimen.
product_name: Soft Clean Infusion Hydrating Treatment Lotion

review_text: Lightweight and very light clean smell. It’s not irritating for my sensitive skin but a little on the watery side.
product_name: Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide

review_text: I love the way this moisturizer makes my skin feel! I have a bit of combination skin, so I’m hesitant about moisturizers.But this doesn’t over-moisturize my oily areas. My skin feels great!
product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Bought this 3 pack about a year ago and have used it 3-4x a week in the mornings.... I’m not sure it did anything? I have combo/oily skin and recently started breaking out (hormonal acne). While this didn’t cause any issues, I’m not sure it make my skin any better. I would spend my money elsewhere.
product_name: Vitamin Nectar Glow Juice Antioxidant Face Serum

review_text: Sure it’s a good cream, your skin feels soft and hydrated after, but I wouldn’t pay this much for this kind of product. I was happy to try a sample with my Sephora order.

I loved the coconut cleansing wipes, so I figured I would try this. It has two sides- super exfoliating then a much softer side. The exfoliating side actually hurts my skin, its like sandpaper. If you have sensitive skin I wouldn’t buy these.

This is probably the MVP of my skincare. I’ve been using it for around 6 months and I go through it like crazy but it’s worth the cost, which is so affordable anyway. I started breaking out a lot in my 30s and this has helped my skin clear up about 90%. I barely get any breakouts anymore, they’re much smaller, go down quickly, and heal really fast. I will not be without this!
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: Wonderful! I do love it, absorbs very fast and great hydration but it’s def not worth the money. I’ll enjoy this jar but won’t purchase again

I bought this clay mask like a week or like 2 weeks ago and have only used it like 2 times. I haven’t really noticed a difference but I’m pretty sure it’s because I have only use it like 2 times. I wanted to wait to write a review once I noticed a big difference but I couldn’t wait. It’s such an amazing clay mask and it just feels so so so GOOD. When I first was reading the reviews a-lot of people were saying it has this cooling affect and when I had it on I didn’t really feel a cooling affect only a bit but once I like took off the face mask OMG MY FACE FELT AMAZINGG!! I feel the cooling effect so much after the mask is off. I feel after more uses I’ll be able to see more of a difference in my skin but I was reading this like article like reviewing some products and in the article it said I could use this as a spot treatment and I have had these stubborn little bumps on my chin and I wasn’t expecting it to get rid of them because they have been there for so so long but the next day OMG THEY WERE literally GONE like there is still 1 or 2 bumps but this stuff is amazing as a spot treatment and as a mask.
review_title: LOVE THE FEELING AFTER AND A GREAT SPOT TREATMENT
product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask

review_text: Very thick cream but it really moisturizes your skin! The only thing that threw me off was the scent. It reminded me of hair dye.
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Cheap ingredients! I broke out and got blemish all over my face.
product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum

review_text: Tried this everyday for 9 days and saw absolutely no change in my pores whatsoever. Such a let down!
product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

review_text: Super hydrating and gentle on my sensitive skin. I sometimes add a couple of drops of oil to this for added hydration

I started using this product a number of months ago when I received a promo sample, and I immediately loved it but didn’t think it was worth the price. After trying a number of other eye creams, I finally gave in and purchased the full size because it is the only cream so far in which I notice a different! I apply it morning and night, and it definitely helps with dark circles and puffiness. I’ve also noticed that my under eyes look brighter and more taut. Would recommend.
product_name: Bye Bye Under Eye Brightening Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: I love the other Drunk Elephant products I’ve purchased but this set was disappointing. Made my face feel sticky.
product_name: Day Dream Vitamin C + Hydration Serum Duo 2.0

review_text: I have been suffering from maskne and hives due to mask allergies since December. The amount of hives and acne on my face was just insane. Before that I had fairly clear skin and a stringent skin care routine. But nothing has been working to stop the hives on my face till I tried this. It is amazing. I use a lot of things on my face because as I mentioned I’m not used to having horrible skin so this does burn when I put it on but I do not mind a little discomfort if it works. I’ve also taken to using it instead of every other day, every two days and I have noticed that it burns less. My skin is finally back on track and I am so grateful. Buy it. Don’t forget to use sunscreen!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I really wish I read the reviews more carefully. I am in the late 30s and have some fine lines, it only took me three days to see the negative shift- my under eyes area looked significantly drier and more wrinkled.
review_title: Don’t buy if you have fine lines

review_text: This moisturizer spreads easily on face and neck with just a little amount. It feels very luxurious and leaves a dewy subtle glow. The spatula is rather pointless and just adds to the costs. In general, this is a good face cream but I’m not sure if the massive price point is justifiable. Did I liked it? Yes. Would I spend another $75 for it? Absolutely not.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: It’s not bad, it’s just that you can find a moisturizer like this for a lot cheaper at a drugstore..
This smells nice. However, I did not care for this facewash. It made my oily face feel even more oily and made me break out!! Not using again.

review_text: This is my first time purchasing Glow Recipe and I wasn’t impressed. I really just found this to be an awkward formulation because, while the premise of combining exfoliating PHA+BHA with hydrating cactus water, etc., seems to make sense (so that the astringent acids are supposedly balanced out by the watermelon and hyaluronic acid), in actuality what this gives you is a strong dose of exfoliation/astringency that does strip your skin of some of its usual hydration and oils which the watermelon, cucumber, and hyaluronic acid can’t make up for because those molecules aren’t small enough to deeply penetrate your skin but will block the passage of subsequent skincare products. So, using this product as your first-step toner in the long run, you’re putting something quite aggressive on your skin and then not able to sufficiently nourish your skin afterward which makes for stressed, malnourished, and prone to wrinkling skin. The first couple weeks using this product yields good results because, yes, the PHA+BHA are doing their work, but then I started noticing progressive dryness and peeling. It just seems like this product wasn’t thought through very well.I also disliked the candy-like scent of the product and its packaging which is simply cheap and unattractive. For a product of this price and size, a bumpy glass bottle and plastic cap just seem inadequate. And, given its overall value due to the formulation, I wouldn’t buy this again and do not recommend.

review_text: I have PCOS and just genetically a lot of dark hair on fair skin. I’ve had professional laser treatments done on my face before as a comparison. This works well and truly does reduce hair growth and speed of growth for me. With the understanding that this is reduction not removal, my goal was to just shave less often and this met it. I’ve noticed good effects on my legs and underarms, arms, and those little hairs on your fingers and toe digits. It’s even worked well to clean up some spots and some finer blonde hairs that weren’t completely addressed by the pro laser treatments. Towards the end of my 6 weeks I was getting to the point where I could skip shaving all week and while I wouldn’t necessarily want a lot of scrutiny on my legs, felt comfortable wearing shorts or skirts. There more of a feel of some slight prickly stubble than an appearance of it after a week or so. It’s expensive but for the freedom to save time every day shaving and do this myself at home, and continue to do touch-ups where needed, it was worth it. My biggest complaint is that if you are treating a lot of areas, and big surface areas like your legs it can take a lot of time to do a treatment. I’d suggest maybe prioritizing some treatment areas and not treating everything at once, unless you’re cool with spending 1-2 hours every week on “flashing“.

If you want to save our oceans, don’t buy this product or ANY product that contains squalene. If it is plant-based squalene it is okay. But if they do not specify it, it is most likely from sharks. Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. There are 100 million sharks killed each year, and if we keep using products like this, there won’t be many sharks left to kill. Furthermore, do you want to rub shark liver oil on your face??? review_text: I’m just about done with my 30 days and WOW! I suffer from hormonal cystic acne and I can say my skin looks 20X better than it did before! I still get little pimples here and there, but overall my skin looks healthy! I purchased another bottle so I don’t run out! Highly recommend!

review_text: I don’t really understand the help for this product. Maybe I just don’t have the right skin type but for me this made my skin feel SO greasy. I didn’t see a glow or dewy look at all either. I gave this a try a few times and every time I couldn’t wait to wash this off my face.

review_text: This face cream is okay. There are others I like more, but I will NEVER buy this again because of the packaging. There is about 4 times the amount of plastic that is required. One it’s totally unnecessary- I’m 50 and I’ve been moisturizing just fine all my life without that. Two, while being incredibly wasteful of plastic, it ALSO manages to cause some waste of product because if you accidentally press too hard you get more cream then you need, so I end up using this expensive face moisturizer on my arms. And to top it all off, I finally got so mad about seeing that asinine packaging every day that I decided to dismantle it and put the cream in another container. Guess what? The tub has a false bottom and so there’s only about half as much product as it appears from the outside! SO even as wasteful as the design is, it’s also about twice as big as it needs to be, which means it’s double the wastefulness!!!!!!! With climate change looming, and plastics popping up in fish and women’s placentas and everything else going on, to make packaging like this is just absolutely tone deaf and unconscionable. I switched to Youth For The People- their SuperFood Air Whip Moisture Cream with Hyaluronic acid is lovely, non-greasy, and it’s PACKED IN A LITTLE GLASS TUB!!! FILLED ALL THE WAY!! review_text: So, I have been using this for about 4 to 5 days. I know that is not a lot of time to test a product out. This may be a purge that I am getting over, but this is one of the only moisturizers that I have used in years that has NOT caused me to develop new breakouts. I usually get 2-3 new breakouts every single day, but I have had ZERO in the last 4 days. I use this everyday, day and night since I’ve received it, and I am afraid to stop using it because I don’t want my results to go away. It’s amazing. I’m so hopeful.

product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: So I’ve been using this product for about 6 months and I’m pretty disappointed. I was excited to get it because of the great reviews but it leaves my skin greasy, and sticky and leaves my skin more oily throughout the day. You can feel it on top of your skin VS it being absorbed by your skin. I wouldn’t recommend for someone w oily/combo skin.

I am loving this Sunday Riley eye cream. This eye serum targets wrinkles, fine lines, supports natural collagen production and smoothes the undereye. This contains 6% Retinoid complex, Centella Asiatuca, Poppy Seed and Ceramides. This is B Corp certified, cruelty-free and energy efficient. The tip is wonderful and makes it easy to apply the eye cream. The eye cream is unscented and lightweight. I have been using this at night for almost 2 weeks and have experience no irritation. My undereyes seems well hydrated and smoother. This product is super effective and I can’t wait to see the long term results.

I have eczema and the struggle for moisture is real. I didn’t expect this to be anywhere near as hydrating as it is; gel-creams are usually too light for my skin, but this was more moisturizing than my previous routine (which was serum, serum, more serum, oil, then a heavy moisturizer, another layer of that, and maybe one more layer, and a hydrating mist to top it off). This also smoothed out some fine lines I had and didn’t irritate my skin at all or leave it greasy. HG product, honestly.

I saw immediate results the first week I used it, gave my skin a nice glow. I went out and bought a giant bottle. The second bottle smelled funny (more line spit) compared to the smaller bottle that came in the welcome kit. I use this faithfully every day and night but now all it does is irritate my skin and stink up my face. It doesn’t really do anything anymore. I still have blotchiness on my chin, brown spots, and blackheads. This product did not get rid of any of that, only tightens skin a little. I will not be repurchasing and I think I might return my giant bottle.

Peace Out Acne Serum was gifted by Peace Out Skincare!) This is a great treatment! It works well for my acne breakouts and makes my skins feel great. I really like to use this in the morning. I’d definitely recommend to anyone to try it!
I read reviews about it and expected a lot from it, it didn’t really hydrate my skin (and my skin isn’t even that dry) I won’t be repurchasing.
I was given the chance to try this full sized product had LOTS of days where it made my face feel so soft and clear took everything off ...great prouduct . One of my faves
Product made me breakout like crazy. I have acne prone and really dry skin and I used this product due to all the amazing reviews but I broke out all over my face.
I like the pressed power serum better. This did nothing. Even the liquid collagen gave me better results. I will not be buying this again.
review_title: Liquid collagen & Pressed serum is better!

review_text: This hydrates my skin in a way I’ve never felt better. AMAZING!!

Love this! I have pretty normal skin/combo, with some dryness in winter. Mostly acne-free. I got the smaller sample of this (with an open jar, not a push-top like this one has, so I can’t comment on this packaging). I was able to use it for a very long time - a little went a long way.My favourite is to put it on at night after washing my face (often using No. 9 Jelly cleanser first, but not always that one). When I woke up in the morning, my skin just looked refreshed, plump and moisturized, and brighter. My forehead is regular skin (but almost a little oily normally), so I found that my forehead area would look extra-moisturized in the morning from this product, so I would use my hands to rub the excess from my skin to the rest of my face. Or I just wouldn’t apply to my forehead. Nonetheless, it never was greasy or broke me out in forehead or anywhere else.If this product wasn’t so expensive, it would be my new go-to! Time to add it to my Xmas list..
Go to product! Always have one in my bag an absolute staple
product_name: Brumisateur Natural Mineral Water Facial Spray Travel Duo

review_text: I tried this out when I saw it in a friends bathroom and was instantly impressed! The next day my skin was so glowy and smooth. I immediately ordered it for myself. I have very sensitive skin and this is the most perfect mask I’ve tried, and I’ve tried a lot!
This product doesn’twear well under my makeup and this was a big reason why I wasn’t the biggest fan of it. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Oh man, I wanted to love this stuff so bad. After using it for one day I thought it was a miracle worker because my face felt so soft and my skin was glowing. Soon after I started breaking out really bad and did some research and thought I was going through “purgining”. I thought maybe I need to stick this out. I stuck it out for 3 months and decided to call it quits today after not using for the last 4 days and seeing my skin improve.
review_title: I wasn’t purging, my skin just hated this.

review_text: I got this product in one of those skincare bags that have different products to try and I used this and it made my face break out super bad and my boyfriend started to use it too and his face started to break out super bad and neither of us have sensitive skin and we usually don’t get bad breakouts. Not sure why this did that to us
product_name: Mini The Cult Classic Purifying Face Cleanser

review_text: Used this everyday for a month to really see how it worked on my skin. I am in love with this gentle mask! It left my face so soft, smooth, refreshed. I enjoy the light scent, too.After I rinse the mask off I apply a tiny amount of the Fresh Lotus Youth Preserve moisturizer. Perfection!

I wanted to love this product and I did until I realized it was making me breakout. I loved how rich and moisturizing it is, but I started to notice breakouts on my cheeks and jaw, which is not normal for me. I stopped using it to see if this was the culprit, and sure enough my skin cleared up.
product_name: Ultra Repair Firming Collagen Cream with Peptides and Niacinamide

review_text: I admit I was skeptical about trying this product. Based on the descriptions and reviews I wasn’t sure if this would have been the product for me. I do love a good deep scrub, working the scrub around my face and feeling like I’m getting all the dead skin and debris off. This is not a deep granulated scrub that I’m used to and love. I did as the instructions say, my face and hands are wet, I shake some out onto my fingers (a little does go a long way) and work between my hands and apply to my face. I really wanted to see if the claims were true and worked more on my forehead, nose, and under my chin and finished with whatever was left over onto my cheeks. Once I was ready to rinse, which was not long, I was shocked. My skin was smooth, tightened (in the best way), and I felt like all the oil and dead skin were removed from my face like an aggressive scrub would do. I purchased the smaller size so let’s see how long this will last, but more than likely I will invest in the larger size.
product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

review_text: I love Glow Recipe, and I really wanted to love this product but it’s so hard to work with. It pills so bad, even after I read the tips Glow Recipe posted on their Instagram on how to keep it from pilling during application. I let my skincare products set in and dry before I applied the sunscreen, and I patted the sunscreen into my skin instead of rubbing it in, and it still pilled up. I don’t know what else to do.
review_title: I really wanted to love this product...

review_text: Dermalogica gifted me the smart response serum. I call this serum magic because it literally does magic. It has made my skin so healthy and bright. I’ve noticed a huge difference in my skin, if I’m being brutally honest my skin hasn’t felt this nice in years. I use this serum in my daily, definitely my all time favorite now.
Highly recommend this product ! I have oily skin . This Primer completely blurred all my pores and made my makeup look flawless, no crease or oily cakeyness.
product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer

review_text: #trywithtopbox #freesample Love this product from Laneige! It helped fade some of my light scarring from acne and did a wonderful job of keeping my skin moist and supple. The product didn’t feel heavy on my skin. The scent was light and not too strong with a hint of citrus/orange scent. I would recommend this to my friends.
I have combo skin but at times I’m more drier than usual. I’ve been using it for about a month now & it leaves my skin feeling hydrated & soft! So far it’s the best moisturizer I’ve used!

It works well...as long as you use it alone on your face AND you don’t smile or sweat all day. If any conditions above apply you can pretty much say goodbye to any noticeable effects. Nice concept but in real life its a FAIL.
product_name: Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener

review_text: I love this!! I have dry skin in the morning and it get very oily by the afternoon. After using this my face doesn’t get oily throughout the entire day and keeps my face moisturized. I like how it instantly dries after putting it on.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Yuck. I purchased this as an impulse buy at the check out. I wouldn’t recommend it. Not a pleasant scent or taste.

I love this stuff. It smells really fresh and green, and foams up slightly, making it feel satisfying to wash my skin with. It really pairs well my Clarisonic, and leaves my skin nice and soft. It’s the smell that really does it for me, and the nice milky-gel consistency of it.

It is one of the better lip products with spf, but I hate the way it sits on my lips. It feels nice when you first apply but it doesn’t absorb well. Just kind of sits on top feeling sticky and thick and moves to the corners of my mouth, idk I’m probably not describing it well. I don’t know how so many people love this? It is mind bottling as ron burgundy would say

The price increase is outrageous. In June the single pack was $17 and 3-pack was $48, but now they are $23 and $59. It’s unbelievable the prices has gone up over 30% and 20% in two months! Won’t be purchasing again.
I just opened mine and it’s like half full.. is that normal? I feel like for $75 it should be full. I’m trying it now but still pretty upset it’s not full
This removes most of my face make up, but basically none of my eye make up. Won’t be purchasing again.
product_name: Mini GO OFF Makeup Dissolving Mist

review_text: This Foreo device is excellent for toning the skin, since I began using it I have noticed incredible changes in my skin, in addition to helping me with the absorption of the routine products and relaxing the muscles of my face. Highly recommended I love it. Gifted by Foreo

Quite the let down from Drunk Elephant. This product is slightly thick and doesn’t apply well over other serums or products. It leaves a severe white cast (especially if you’re a woc) and causes that rolling of the product. It slide off when you touch your face after applying on top of other products and small white balls form from the product. This would be wonderful if it soaked into the skin instead of sitting on top of it. Tarte makes a wonderful spf cream that DE can learn from.
review_title: A let down from a great brand
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Doesn’t absorb well or quickly. My face felt like it was still waiting for it to absorb all day. Sticky/greasy feeling almost. Not the same as the original formula, and not an improvement. Used it for a week to make sure I didn’t just need to adjust to the new product, and it never got better.

This is my current daily cleanser, and I don’t have any reason to change anytime soon. Light, fresh scent, friendly to pores, leaves my combination skin feeling fresh and renewed. Doesn’t lather up much as one might expect from a “foaming“ cleanser, but it’s effective, so I don’t care.
It’s ok, but it doesn’t seem to do for me what it does for everyone else. Perfectly acceptable lip product though.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This moisturizer smells very fresh doesn’t have a strong scent. However it does not feel very moisturizing given the price. I will probably use it under makeup but not as a part of my every day skin care routine.

The packaging is very nice. The smell can be a little strong at times, it reminds me of a cheap wine or rubbing alcohol? When I woke up after using it the night before for the first time, I noticed the pores on my nose looked smaller, which is always a bonus for me. After about a week of use my cheeks started getting some dry patches. Be careful with what moisturizer you pair it with because I found some combinations can become sticky on your face, which is very unpleasant!
product_name: PRO Strength 10% PHA Exfoliating Clarifying Liquid

review_text: I had such high hopes for this cleansing balm, but after a month of using it I’ve realized it’s been breaking me out. Returning for sure.

I loved the “Sheer” original version. It was a perfect all in one moisturizer/sunscreen/primer… and truly invisible. The new version is fine, but tinted, and leaves color on my hands after applying. I hope they bring back the oirignal or make a truly clear version again :(
product_name: Sunvisor Radiant Moisturizing Face Sunscreen SPF 35

review_text: When I pulled the SK-II Brightening Source Derm Revival Mask out of the packet, I couldn’t tell if it mattered which side went against my skin, so I just picked a side. The mask was easy to maneuver into place. I tucked the bottom under my chin, but it kept coming off and hanging down. It did not drip, though, so this did not bother me. The mask felt moist and cooling for the fifteen minutes. It was easy to remove. I then patted the essence into my skin and added moisturizer on top. I liked that it stayed moist and felt good on my skin. So many masks are designed to dry and those just make my skin feel tight and uncomfortable. I also liked that you simply pat the essence into your skin. With the aforementioned drying masks, I always feel like I’m irritating my skin as I struggle to scrub them off. Plus, it was fun looking like a serial killer from a horror film! My skin and I really enjoyed using these masks and would recommend them to friends. I received free product from SK-II in exchange for my honest review.
OMG I LOOK LIKE AN Orange CHEETOS. You’re only supposed to rub two coats of this and my arm rubbed off with it making me look like a cheetos, I’m so mad
review_title: JUST PUT TWO COATS NO MORE

review_text: I loved using it the patches the first 5 days, then all the patches dried up. Absolute waste of money, don’t bother buying.
product_name: 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

review_text: I am a huge fan of Josie’s argan oil and was really excited to see a portable version. I didn’t expect the amazing scent though, it has a really nice light citrus smell that makes it perfect for lips too. The only reason I give it a 4 is that the packaging broke on my first use! The end wasn’t sealed and it squeezed out the top of the tube the first time it was squished. Had to return it and wait for a new one because my local Sephora didn’t carry the full line of Argan Oil products. Luckily I already had the winter moisture kit on order and had a smaller version to use in the interim!
product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil

review_text: I like the cream itself, but it does take up a little bit of time to sink into the skin. I only used it for night time, but my combination skin would hate this for day time. The smell is the biggest thing that will prevent me from repurchasing. Not bad, just not worth repurchasing.
product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: I am a fan of Sunday Riley’s other products, so I got a sample of this with my beauty insider points. Needless to say, I was disappointed; Not only does it barely treat breakouts and not absorb into the skin, leaving it greasy, but it has an overpowering sweet, pungent odor. The smell is like a mustier version of the smarties candy. There are much better and more affordable products on the market for treating blemishes than this. Do not waste your money or your points.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: Only thing this has going for it is the easy applicator and hydrating. I haven’t noticed any difference in puffiness or fine lines after using it morning and night for over a month. Can’t wait to finish it up so I can move onto something else… Save your money and purchase a product that actually works if you have any real under eye concerns.
review_title: doesn’t live up to the hype
product_name: 24-7 Power Swipe Hydrating Day & Night Treatment Eye Balm

review_text: I hate this razor. No matter how gentle you are, you get a lot of little micro cuts which are then itchy and painful. Results are at best, the same as my Venus razor. Unfortunately, I did not try it right away and let it sit around at my house so I can’t return it. But I’ve tried it 2x and gotten the same results. And if your hand slips, you will a get a little cut. Not a good experience for me at all.

I can see this working for light makeup days or for light makeup users but for me personally I have to use double the amount I use with a normal cleansing balm and even then sometimes my brows are still not removed. I also would not call this a balm the consistency is more of a cream than a balm. It isn’t a terrible product but I believe it should be marketed as a cream cleanser meant for dry skin and not a makeup removing balm.

I love the new version. The smell is amazing. the trick with the exfoliation side is to pore your exfoliating cleanser or scrub onto the wipe. Don’t use it by itself to exfoliate because the serum on the wipe isn’t slippery and can hurt. but add it with your exfoliating liquid product and you get a satisfying experience.

This product was great! I have wanted to try facial oil for awhile, and this did not disappoint.The fragrance is very nice, although not light (for those with scent sensitivity). It took me a few days to figure out the right amount to use for my skin type, but once I figured it out my skin was hydrated and illuminated.
product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil

review_text: This is my second bottle and I really like this product. It has been working for my skin.

I had tried a sample size of this and really liked it - so creamy and hydrating. So I bought a full-size and it was great in the beginning. I used it twice daily, but by the time I got 2/3 through it, it started to harden into something like modeling clay (even though it was always closed tightly). The rest of the product is now unusable, it won’t spread out, won’t absorb. Very disappointed because it wasn’t cheap.
review_title: Dried and hardened with time, so disappointed
product_name: Dream Eye Cream with Vitamin C and Ceramides

review_text: This was a huge miss from Drunk Elephant. The color doesn’t really show up on most skin tones but the worst part is the formula. It feels really goopy for a liquid blush and there’s very little color payoff. It almost felt like child’s makeup. Not really sure what DE was trying to do with this...
review_title: Swing and a miss from Drunk Elephant

review_text: I tried a few times to give this product a shot but never really saw much as far as results. And on top of that it made my eyes itch every time I used it so I had to stop using it :(
I really wanted to like this but it did nothing for my skin. The two stars is for the scent and moisture.
product_name: Fat Water Niacinamide Pore-Refining Toner Serum with Barbados Cherry

review_text: I really love this product! I get dry patches on my skin a lot(probably from sitting out in the sun too much) and this gel did not disappoint! It only takes a very little to do the job. My skin instantly felt hydrated but not oily. I also store in the fridge which feels amazing after a long day in the sun. I’m really impressed!

My lips love the other FRESH lip treatments, but not this one. Immediately it felt burny when I put it on, the texture felt ick, and it left my lips even more dry. If you have sensitive skin maybe skip this one. Mind you I don’t even have sensitive skin and this happened to me.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: I love it my acne finish my face is clear now I have to buy girl

so the company has reformulated the product, downing from 12%AHA/2%BHA to 10%AHA/1%BHA while charging the same price tag. With this price tag, I probably can choose another brand. I actually like and prefer the previous formula to the current one, it worked much better for my skin. I have been using the current formula for probably 2 months now, and my skin actually has not felt that differences than not using it. Too bad. It used to be my favourite chemical exfoliation serum.
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I’m a total Herbivore lover, and I was so SO excited for this cleaner. Everything about the feel of this, from the actual product to the packaging is amazing, it lathers so nicely unlike many non-drying cleansers. I just could not do it with the smell, its bad enough that I returned it. It smells like the weird damp smell that happens when you leave a vase of flowers and the stems start to die, or like weird mushrooms. I love you Herbivore, please go back to the lab and re release this <3
product_name: Pink Cloud Rosewater + Squalane Makeup Removing Face Wash

review_text: I was influenced! Saw someone using this on instagram + really hyped it up and I got excited, finally bought it. I wouldn’t say my lips are usually chapped – I use a chapstick with Vitamin E so that takes care of it; I just wanted extra soft and plump lips! First – This was a little sticky so might get on your pillow if you’re a side/stomach sleeper. Second – my lips felt more chapped in the morning after putting this on. I felt like I had to immediately put chapstick on. It just didn’t feel like it did what it advertised. Third – My lips did seem plumper + there’s a lot of product so it’ll last a long time, so gave it a few stars. Wouldn’t buy for myself again though.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica Sampling. Love this exfoliant! It really helps with my oily skin. Super easy to use and I love how it lathers and feels on my face. It leaves my face feeling hydrated and clean and moisturized. It’s also helped with my dark spots and hyperpigmentation

I LOVE this product! I use it more as a moisturizer at night when my skin is feeling really dry, when I wake up my skin feels so hydrated and plump. I also love the scent of this product, super clean and refreshing. This is my second time repurchasing and I will continue to do so!
product_name: Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Swiss Glacier Water

review_text: I received this exfoliator from Influenster, and overall I do enjoy it! It’s gentle enough that it doesn’t irritate or bother my skin, and a little product goes a long way. Do I notice a difference in my skin after using it? No, not really. Maybe with continued use I’ll notice improvement in my skin. Would I repurchase this? Probably not, but I did enjoy this product!
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: I didn’t notice any stinging like some people but it doesn’t feel like it absorbs into my skin. It pills really bad, even when mixed with moisturizer. I definitely will not rebuy.

I absolutely love this toner! I received it complimentary for testing purposes from Influenster but I have to say I was pleasantly surprised! It has a light airy scent and formula that is super hydrating and calming on my skin. The only negative is the spout, the product comes out very slowly and I had to squeeze a few times to get the desired amount. Would definitely purchase!

I’ve been suffering with acne, new scars and old on my cheeks with a few on my forehead; I saw great reviews plus I love the EradiKate so I decided to try. This goes on smooth but stays tacky, doesnt really dry down. I didn’t see any real difference even after months of trying this. If anything the morning after use, I feel that I had bumps under my skin like it clogged my pores. Definitely regret this purchase.

I wanted to like this for the combo of SPF and color correcting but ultimately had to return it. My sensitive skin broke out and ended up redder than before. Might work well for others if you don’t have a reaction to it.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: this product dried, burned, itch and made my whole face red.
review_title: DO NOT BUY IF YOU HAVE SENSTIVE SKIN
product_name: Acne Solutions All-Over Clearing Treatment Oil-Free

review_text: Staple in my skincare routine. as someone with big pores i absolutely love this product.

I was gifted by Outset this serum and honestly I really love it. It’s definitely a maintenance product that delivers small results overtime, but more so to prevent further signs. It’s super lightweight and layers under other skincare and makeup well.
This is the best product ever! Easy to use, I love how it come with a little shovel to pick up the product, takes off heavy makeup like a dream. No time at all! Love the ingredients and company!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Loved this product! My face felt really clean and fresh without overdrying. I also loved the texture and light exfoliation I get when using. My skin tone is brighter and more even!

I know a lot of people rav about this guy...but I just wasn’t sold. I have acne prone skin, and while this product did reduce redness, almost immediately it seemed, it just didn’t do much else, and I felt like I broke out a little more. I think it’s maybe best to use a couple times a week, and I think I also prefer chemical exfoliators rather than physical ones, so that could also be why I didn’t appreciate it as much.
product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

review_text: I have tried countless cleansers from good brands and nothing makes my face feel as clean and refreshed as this cleanser. It is not harsh at all but my face feels soft and clean after using it. Love it and won’t bother using anything else anymore! Plus the company is environmentally conscious and cruelty free!

This is my new holy grail cleansing balm. I used to use cleansing oils but it’s a little tough trying to get it on your face from your hands. I used to use the IT cosmetics cleansing balm, but that one tugs on my skin. This Farmacy one glides on my skin, melts perfectly and doesn’t tug on my skin when I’m rubbing it into my face. It even gets my waterproof mascara off in one go. I recommend using another cleanser after this, just to make sure you get your skin clean, but this is a great way to take off all your makeup on the first try.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Amazing formula! So glad it is a clean product for Sephora. Absolutely adore the whipped marshmallow foam like texture. You can see a difference after just one use and this does not leave my skin feeling dry.
Wanted to love this product. I have seen no changes and this is my second bottle. Other products from the ordinary have destroyed my face and I was really hoping this would help.

Very sticky. Caked up in the corners of my mouth like little lip boogers in my mouth. Wasn’t a fan of that. Very thick feeling when you apply. I didn’t really notice any conditioning difference in my lips post wipe off but I have always had pretty hydrated lips. The smell and consistency of it reminded me of being back in the early 2000s and having the different flavored clear lip gloss tubes and trading with all my friends. Nostalgic.
product_name: Cherry Treat Conditioning + Strengthening Lip Oil

review_text: The product has revolutionized my skin care game! I’ve suffered from dark circles forever and this has helped take care of those bad boys. I also love that it is an eye cream that has been ophthalmologist tested. I feel much more comfortable applying it to such a tender are. If you’re looking for an amazing fragrance free, vegan, and cruelty free eye cream that works - this one is for you!
product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Boost 360° Brightening Eye Cream

review_text: This made my face look so pretty upon application, but I found I looked very oily the rest of the day. I will try less sprays but maybe this just doesn’t work for oily skin.I also hate the smell.

I’ve been using this moisturizer for about a week and I’m really enjoying it! It’s super lightweight and makes my skin feel baby soft. It layers under makes up nicely and doesn’t leave behind any greasy residue. The only thing I don’t like is the slight rose scent.. it reminds me of my grandmother. Would give it 5 stars if it was scent free!
product_name: Hydra Zen Glow Liquid Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: This eye cream is lovely! After using it for a few weeks, I do notice slightly less discoloration under my eyes. Immediately after applying my eyes also feel less puffy which is really nice. The consistency of this feels thick at first but as I tap it in to my skin it absorbs quickly. Applying concealer over this is also smooth and easy, no pilling at all. I love this!
product_name: Super Nova 5% THD Vitamin C + Caffeine Brightening Eye Cream

review_text: I really saw a difference with this eye cream. I saw a difference in the coloring of the skin around my eye, the moisture of the skin, everything. I’m not a Tatcha person, but this is a really great product.
product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream

review_text: For the price of this product you really can’t go wrong. I’ve been using this product daily for the past 3 weeks and the texture on my forehead and chin has visibly improved. I would definitely purchase again.

Wow! I am so happy that I received this Caudalie Vinoperfect Brightening Moisturizer as a #freeproduct! I use it in the mornings and at nights in conjunction with the gel cleanser. It has been diligently fading the dark spots on both my cheeks and my face looks more even and much brighter after every use. I love this stuff! The only drawback for me personally to replenish my present stock after it’s finished would be the cost, but it’s a sacrifice I would definitely consider making!
product_name: Vinoperfect Instant Brightening Moisturizer with Niacinamide

review_text: I re-ordered this because I noticed a difference in my fine lines after I stopped buying - not sure it helps get rid of lines but they seemed to get worse once I stopped it.

Incredibly awesome results … when my skin feels rough and dry to the point when it needs a good exfoliating rub, I always turn to Kate Somerville for the best results! The skin feels super smooth and fresh while hydrated.

I thought that i could stand the smell if i saw a difference in my skin but after a month of consistent use, i don’t feel like there was any real significant difference in my skin. I hard such good things about the OG cream but this one disappointed.
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: First bought these at a spa and am now repurchasing at Sephora. I like these pills - I definitely don’t use them daily like the bottle recommends, but rather when I’m having trouble sleeping. My boyfriend likes them too. review_text: I received this complimentary to try from Influenster. Honestly, I really wanted to love this and expected so much strictly because of the brand name. I hated that I had to place the spoon under the lid nightly. It was not a good design. Comparing this to the Tatcha brand which is cheaper the design is much better. Tatcha has a holder at the top and is with a metal spoon where Dior’s is just a plastic spatula. Dior is supposed to be a brand that is Luxe and this cream just did not scream all 5 stars. For the smell, it was not overpowering like I exoected. It was lightweight. A little bit of cream does go a long way. I did like using this, but I would not purchase it even though I am able. It does not set itself apart from the rest. A brand name cream at this price point should be amazing all around. This is not. I cannot recommend this based on price.

review_text: I have struggled with acne since puberty and was never one of the lucky ones who grew out of it in adulthood. My complexion has been one of my biggest insecurities for half my life! I have used about 9 treatments of this product and already it has changed my skin for the better. I had extremely irritated combination skin with the worst breakouts on my cheeks and chin. I still have old acne scars and redness, but each time I wake up in the morning after using this product, I notice improvement in the discoloration. i wanted to love this just as bad as everyone else does but it just doesn’t do well with my face as a moisturizer. the first time i used this it slightly irritated my skin and made me a little red and by morning i had 2 breakouts. i tried this for a week but it just made my face break out and just wasn’t working for me. i have slightly sensitive skin and rare occasional break outs.the box said i can use it for my hair ends or cuticles etc. so I’m going to try that.

Not a fan of this product. I tried it because I like the moisturizers by this brand, but this cleanser isn’t comparable. It foams up quite a lot, and has a strong fragrance. review_text: I was hesitant to try this, I typically have terrible results with Asian skincare lines as well as all natural lines but I gave it a shot for 2 weeks. Disappointed. Read the reviews and was excited for this product. I have mild rosacea on my cheeks and my skin is sensitive and dry. Unfortunately I’m almost done with the bottle and see no difference. It was not worth it for me.

review_text: I received this product for free to review and I was really looking forward to it because I’ve had some breakouts lately and was hoping this would help. I wish these worked but it’s just not for me.

review_text: I didn’t love it. I didn’t hate it. So it comes down to would I be willing to pay the price. The answer is no. Did it feel hydrating? I guess. Did it make me glow? product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: Ok I love Barbara Sturm, I use her face cream light and it’s fantastic but THIS is a stretch for a hyaluronic serum. I use the inkey list hyaloronic for 7.99 and they both contain radish root ferment and sodium hyaluronate and it’s at the TOP of the list compared to Barbara’s. I get it, I love luxury skincare. Has a weird smell and chunks of seaweed (?) which are honestly not very pleasant to work with. I don’t see much of a difference in my skin after using it. It’s maybe a little softer, but I don’t really think the effects are worth it for the strange smell and texture.

review_title: Not enough moisture for super dry skin

review_text: Those with sensitive skin, be careful, this incredibly broke me out. The next morning woke up with forehead fully broken out. It is too strong.

does it hydrate? yes. does it last? not so much. i put it on before a walk outside or before bed and it’s nearly gone -evaporated- by the time i finish my walk or wake up in the morning. watermelon scent is okay, doesn’t really linger after application. but the scent is “plasticky“, artificial smelling. no big color payoff which is nice, balm is supposed to be subtle. the design for balm pots are very unhygienic and not everyone has a spatula on hand to scoop out the balm. i expect more from a brand charging $18 for 6g of LIP BALM. glad i got mine on sale.
Love this cream. It moistens and doesn’t hurt my sensitive skin.

i purchased this a week ago from sephora queens mall. i used it for 6 days and experienced greasiness. the product did not absorb well (i had no other skin care products on my face) and i developed tiny whiteheads on my chin and cheeks. i am sure it can’t be from anything else because till now none of the other products i use made my skin greasy. the tiny pimples subsided when i stopped using it yesterday. maybe this product would fare better for dryer skins.

I wanted to love this I like that it has spf. I found that it was not rich enough for my dry skin and tugged on my skin. My skin still didn’t feel hydrated after. If you have very young or oily skin or live in a humid area this may be quite nice for you

review_text: All time best cleanser. After removing makeup this cleanser takes off any residue, is so calming and smells amazing. Favourite cleaner, have gone through 3 tubes this year alone.

As the other reviews mention, this serum is really tacky. I make sure to apply and then go make coffee or brush my teeth in between applying this and my moisturizer to make sure that it doesn’t pill (according to other reviews). I have tried other HA serums that I thought yielded better results. I can’t really see a difference in my skin using this than when I just went straight from washing to moisturizer. I have been using this in combo to the Niacinimide and saw some issues with pores getting larger and blackheads, which I have never had before. It must be one of the non-active delivery ingredients causing it. Overall kind of disappointed in this. I will likely return.

okay, let me start off by saying these work, but not in the way you think, or maybe, i don’t know.i purchased these because out of nowhere i got problematic skin. i’ve never struggled with acne before except for maybe 2-3 months when i was 18. so, i purchase these and immediately saw what they do. it opens the zit, and whatever is inside sticks to the patch and when you peel it off, all the gunk is there, easy enough. then comes the scabbing over process and whatnot. to my dismay, it leaves the zip RED and open. so then you have to take care of that issue. i used my last one two weeks ago and the old, already healed zit is stilllll red and the patch almost leaves an impression on your skin that takes time to go away. i put fake tan on where the patch was and you can see an outline of a circle from where it was placed. again, from two weeks ago and another from over a month now! i find it really weird and i don’t like how my blemishes stay obvious for weeks after when it’s whole purpose is to clear it, quickly and easily. 1/10 for me :/

I love the deep cleanse but have dry skin so it can be a little stripping sometimes, but this is perfect for me! Get the same results in addition to leaving my skin hydrated and plump. Love the smells and texture. This will be staying in my routine.

This is amazing! It smells great and leaves my face feeling super soft. It is quite abrasive but not in a bad scratchy way. Also doesn’t leave my skin looking red and sore after, which a lot of scrubs usually do to me. Overall great product! I love the whole line (:

review_text: I love this cream for daytime. It really does feel like water on the skin! My previous day cream (Burts Bees sensitive) seemed to make me oily all over and especially in the places I already am oily (between brows, top of forehead, and center of nose). The water cream doesn’t make me oily all over- it just gives me light hydration and some dewiness. When those oils come through this cream does not exaggerate those oils and an oily look. And with my previous day cream I almost always had to use extra because my skin still felt dry, but with this cream, I don’t have to use extra (woohoo!). This is also works great with makeup, regardless if it’s a luminous primer alone, tinted moisturizer, or full coverage foundation with primer. it hasn’t irritated my skin whatsoever. My pores are are appearing to look smaller and clearer. So in the morning, I will first use the Tatcha camellia cleansing oil, then pure witch hazel as toner, this cream, then some eye cream. Those who are really oily would enjoy this, but for those who are more dry I wouldn’t recommend since it provides light hydration. I don’t use this at night because I prefer a thicker cream (Tatcha dewy skin cream). Glad I went ahead and bought the full size instead of a sample... this will def be a repurchase!

I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! I am 47, and have always had issues with dry skin, on top of that I have added retinol and AHA/BHA peel to my skincare regimen. I needed a moisturizing, protective barrier to combat further dryness/dehydration. I purchased in spring and use it at night and have kept my skin feeling moisturized and rich but never greasy. I would give it a 5 stars, but have not used it over winter season which brings skin dryness issues to another level. Comparable if not better than skinceuticals triple lipid which was what I used before, but because eit was so expensive, I wanted to try this less expensive moisturizer.
review_title: SUPER MOISTURIZING FOR 45+, DRY, AGING SKIN
