In general, I love hyaluronic acid. It’s my favourite skincare ingredient of all time. I’m also a big fan of The Ordinary and they make up a HUGE part of my skincare routine. So I can say, with total honesty and impartiality, that this product is such a miss and I really don’t understand how it won allure’s Best of Beauty in 2019. It’s literally the only product of The Ordinary that I haven’t loved and immediately pledged my undying loyalty to. I’d been using a Japanese brand of HA for years, but it isn’t always available online and is generally hard to get here in Canada, so I thought I’d try out The Ordinary’s HA, and I’ve never been so disappointed in a product in my life. It’s sticky, it’s thick, and it ALWAYS pilled underneath my moisturiser, no matter how little I applied. And don’t even get me started on how it made my foundation look!! So patchy, pilly, and just straight-up ugly. I tried so many times to love this product, but every single time I would end up having to wash it off before leaving the house because it just looked *bad*. I can’t even comment on the effect it had on my skin, because I couldn’t bear to keep it on long enough for it to make a difference.It took about two weeks of troubleshooting this product before I gave up and decided to go back to my tried and true. In comparison, the Japanese brand is soo light and thin. It soaks in right away, and I can apply layer after layer with absolutely no pilling. It is truly a holy grail product, and The Ordinary’s version will unfortunately never compare :(Maybe I would’ve liked it more if I didn’t have anything else to compare it to, but once you’ve experienced perfection you just can’t go back.

If you have some CEGEP level chemistry knowledge, you probably know that, Mica is what they add to your eyeshadows to creat the peralecent look; while Titanium Oxide is the solid white paint that gives your physical suncereen the dull white look on your face. I’ll say that’s kind of cheating as a skincare product -- most of the ingredients doesn’t work on your cells at all, and the brightening effect is easily washed off. But it does its job as a moisturizer, and can be used as an not-so-bad primer (which is the only reason I’m not giving a 1 star).

review_text: On a whole, this product line was nothing impressive. Each item on it’s own lacked anything that I would call a skin improvement. And used together, I felt little benefits. It’s truly hard to rate each individual item, which is why I have grouped them all under one review.The Cleanser: the cleanser was soft and gentle, and had a nice foam to it. It strongly reminded me of the drug store cleansers I used as a teenager (Clearasil). Unfortunately, it does not do a good job cleansing. With makeup, I had to do several washes and still couldn’t remove all makeup. Without makeup, there was still a lot of dirt on the cotton pad used after toner. Clear Lotion: this is just their fancy way of saying toner. Again, nothing impressive about this toner. It did it’s basic function without leaving my face dry or sticky. Pitera Essence: this is their signature product line ingredient. The Pitera essence is meant to be patted onto your cleansed and toned skin. Not entirely sure I’m seeing the results they claim. I felt they placed a lot of emphasis on how amazing Pitera is, almost like an infomercial. Airy Milk Lotion: nothing airy or milk like about this moisturizer. It is on the thicker side, with an extremely high fragrance. Any slight cuts or open acne will burn upon application. My face was left feeling slightly sticky. Even with primer, makeup application looked streaky at best. The moisturizer truly felt like a cheap product. Overall, the product line is cheap feeling and offered very little, if any overall benefits. This Proctor and Gamble skin line is a cheap product disguised as a high end product line. Don’t be fooled. The product strongly reminds me of Proactiv, though I’d recommend the Proactiv line far over this line. The SK-II line is worth no more than $25 for the whole set, and I wouldn’t even purchase it at that price point.
review_title: Cheap product disguised as high end

This is a recnt product I’ve tried and have waited to review until I was done with my first bottle. I had a 4.5 oz bottle last me from January until now. I have very dry skin, with the white flakes. I’ve tried products like this but only for sensitive or dry skin- and they’ve dried my skin out that’s how bad my dry, pimple prone skin is! Please, try this out even if you’d like your skin to feel that much more clean, It’s the only step I use for clear& moisturized skin!

I’m a few uses in and in love! It’s a pretty basic cleanser, but perfect for keeping skin clear and letting your other products work. I have a strong pimple cream so I wasn’t looking for an acne cleanser, so this is just the right thing! smells great, like fresh natural plants and who doesn’t love a clean product. The only reason this gets 4 starts is that it doens“t DO much, will keep sin clear with other products but wouldn’t rely on it’s own. Still great!
review_title: The Clean Cleanser of my Dreams!

review_text: This product has made my skin go from dull to glowing with just a few days of regular use. It also helped fade dark spots. When used intermittently, I didn’t notice any effects, so regular use seems to be required. It gives a pleasant, tingly feeling and does not feel harsh like other peels.
review_title: Truly makes a difference when used daily

review_text: Rather than being “milky“ I found the texture of this to be more like spoiled milk: really thick and clotted. The differences between this and Murad’s gel acne cleanser are 1) creamy texture 2) wonderful smell 3) no triclosan, and therefore it doesn’t work on persistent acne and 4) more retinol, which irritated my redness-prone skin. This may be a great product for more mature skin but it does nothing for my complexion so I am returning it in favor of the other Murad cleanser.

Does do some decent color correction for redness. However, it is so, so, so dry - almost like a clay mask in texture. It clung to extra little piece of dry skin on my face and look extremely cakey (which is odd since it claims to be moisturizing). Also has a strange sheen to it - would prefer it to be more matte.

review_text: Goes on so smooth, and feels great on my skin. Light enough to layer makeup on top of, but strong enough to use as a night time moisturizer. I exclusively only used this moisturizer until it finished and it didn’t help at all with my facial redness. The first few times I used it, my whole face was burning, I kept on using it as I thought maybe this is how it works, but no. My skin got used to the burn, but I would not recommend it if you want to improve redness.

Ohhh em geee!!!! I love this product! I got this complements of influenster in my Summer glow voxbox and I’m loving it! review_title: Got it for free but will buy!!

product_name: Mini Mandelic Acid + Superfood Unity Exfoliant

review_text: It’s a cleanser. It’s not my favorite but I’m exceptionally picky. It’s decent, light, and cleans. It’s not magical. If you want to spend the money, it’s not going to be wasted.
review_title: it cleans, but not my fave

I love the consistency of this serum. It is not heavy and results are visible in a weeks. Great product!
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I started out with #2, which worked fine for me, but I wanted to try this because it’s more gentle and doesn’t have alcohol denat in it. Not the one for me, but still a good product.
review_title: Good if your skin is super sensitive

review_text: I received a free sample of this product, however that does not change my view on the product. I really enjoyed the sample I received. My face s suppler and smooth. review_title: Nice serum for my hyper-pigmented & sensitive skin
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

review_text: I received a sample size of this product and I have to say I am impressed. I tried it both in the being when I went to bed and in the morning before I put on my makeup. It kept my skin feeling moisturized through the day and night. But only set back was that I did find it slightly scented, so if you have a sensitive nose I would be careful applying it to that area. All in all I am very happy, and I plan to purchase more for myself.

I absolutely love this cleanser. I didn’t like it at first to be honest; like other reviews I felt like it wasn’t doing anything. I’ve switched to applying it to my face using a facial brush and it’s made all the difference. It really strips my makeup (even mascara!) off without drying me out or leaving any greasy residue. I use this at night and by morning my face feels naturally dewy - other facial cleansers have left me really dry with a super oily bounce back. This is one of the only cleansers I’ve used that has not only cleared up my skin, but also made a noticeable difference in the tone of it. It’s a little pricey - I use one of the smaller $20 tubes in about a month (washing once a day), but totally worth it.

I told the Sephora employee I was looking for some kind of tinted moisturizer or medium coverage foundation since my skin has cleared up within the last year. I used to use full coverage foundations but felt I can move on to something less heavy and easier/quicker to apply in the mornings. She quickly recommended this product. I was excited after purchase to only be let down at home. First, the color she matched me for was much too dark. My face and neck were two different colors. The cream is thick and heavy so its difficult to spread and work onto your skin, which means you’re having to pump and use alot of product. Also the matte finish is too matte. It makes my skin look very dull, it is not flattering at all. If you want to keep as matte as a full face deceased woman, then this product is for you. Otherwise try something different. Needless to say, will be returning.
product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40

review_text: - all opinions are my own - I used the samples I received on a long weekend trip and it kept my face feeling clean despite a long drive. Luckily, there isn’t a lingering scent! This is on my wish list this year!
product_name: Ceramic Slip French Green Clay Cleanser

review_text: Nope. Didn’t like it. Wish I did. The packaging was so elegant. Seemed like really nice product. It went on smooth and scentless, however in a few hours I could smell self tanner. It made me tan for sure, but it looked uneven and dirty. It made clogged pores more apparent and made me break out quite a bit. Will be returning this after trying it 3 times.

it definitely blurs but it didn’t work for me. I love how it felt and went on. but I’ve noticed that after I used other face products that it literally pilled up on my skin. I been using it for a month and haven’t noticed a difference. Thanks Influenster for sending it to me to review.

review_text: I don’t think this product does anything. It doesn’t fully clean your face or truly exfoliate. Wouldn’t recommend.

review_text: I waited to write this until I had used the entire tube and I just have to say I for sure love this stuff. Literally about to buy a jar. It’s light but hydrating. Perfect for during the day and made my skin so smooth. I’ve noticed a difference since I’ve been out. Worth every penny!

I am now just finishing my first tube of this lip balm. Bought it because of all the great things I’ve heard about it. Wow, talk about disappointment from a product I expected more from! I found I couldn’t use it more than once or twice a day because it caused my lips to be drier than before I used it. It is definitely not worth the money (or the hype). I will not (ever) purchase this product again!
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: I purchased the starter pack (cleanser, fat water, moisturizer w spf). The smell is nice but a little too artificial for me. It did absorb well and felt nice under my make-up (not oily). I am just a little conflicted about buying it again as I wasn’t as blown away by it as I wanted to be.
product_name: Hydra Vizor Invisible Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen with Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon

review_text: Influenster chose me to try out DermalQuench Hyaluronic Acid Treatment for free to review. I will start by saying if you have sensitive skin this is not for you. When this is applied it tingles and I could see it easily irritating sensitive skin. This is applied by spraying directly on the skin. I’m more of a fan of spraying product in my hands and patting on my face. I think the spray is too easy to spray in my eyes. I sprayed some on my lips and my lips ended up getting very chapped and uncomfortable. As for the few fine lines I have I do think it made the slightest difference but in turn it broke out my face especially on my forehead where most the product was applied. All in all I traded one problem for another so this wasn’t for me.

This is by far the best face moisturizer ever and I’ve tried many I have sensitive skin with a few breakouts but this doesn’t break me out more it feels so good on the skin like baby soft and doesn’t make me look oily throughout the day 10/10

Murad gifted me these eye masks and they are great.I love these eye masks they are cooling and hydrating .It’s very easy to apply and would highly recommend to try these beautiful eye mask. Love the packaging also
I thought the formula would be the same as the one in the tin, far from what I was expecting. It dried out my lips, leaving me to apply more. I hope they change the formula in the tube!

I cannot live without this. Simply this is a exellent cleanser. I have dry skin, and this leaves my skin clean, balanced without any irritation. It is effective but gentle and smoothing.I have been using this for 6 years and I am sure that this is a one of the top contributors that keep my skin always great.

This was gifted to me by Dermalogica Sampling. I was really surprised at this exfoliant! I’m not a fan of the texture of most of them but this allowed me to adjust how much water I added which made it easier for me to apply. The amount of acne I had diminished in the week and I’ve noticed my face is looking a lot brighter!

Literally not a makeup remover, and I guess it’s good it doesn’t advertise as one either. The texture is very creamy and milky, it does have a very light baby powder/floral sweet scent I actually really like. The directions say to use on dry or damp skin, I used on damp skin and it was VERY grippy and thick, I thought it would remove makeup because it almost felt like my oil based makeup remover balm, kinda Vaseline and residue feeling but all that washed away with the water and left nothing behind. Very easy to wash off. I still had mascara all over my eyes though. So I double washed again and still had mascara on my eyes lol. But my actual skin felt sooo soft and conditioned just as advertised. I don’t like to moisturize before I go to bed because I will break out so this is good for me because I feel moisturized without applying any extra product. My skin doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. I like it!!! Just use on bare skin or after you remove all makeup
product_name: Milky Jelly Gentle Gel Face Cleanser

review_text: It does what it says. After a couple of weeks of using this (AM and PM). I noticed the differences. My Skin is a lot more moisturized and brighter. But the best part is my acne scars are SIGNIFICANTLY diminished! I have acne prone skin, and when my skin disagrees with a certain product, I get cystic acnes instantly. With the combination of this gel creme and truth serum, I feel like I get a redo on the skin. No acne. On my way to no acne scars!Totally going to repurchase this.

I have the average oily t-zone but this product made my face GREASY to a point that it has never gotten throughout the day. Throughout the day my face would become oilier every hour to an embarrassing extent. These areas, mostly on my forehead, cheeks and nose were sticky to the touch. The product was too hydrating for my face. but the application was very light and definitely made my skin softer. Two stars because i think it would work well for someone with dry/normal skin. If you have even a little bit of an oily combination do not buy this product!!!

review_text: The tingliness can go away if you mix it with a serum, but there’s still going to be white cast. I use & love many of The ordinary products, but this one is trash. Save yourself the $7 lol

review_text: This works well: it removes the extra dirt and oil, etc. after cleansing, and doesn’t dry out my skin at all. I received this product in this year’s Sephora Favorites Skincare’s Next Big Thing kit. I have been using it as the last step in my skincare routine following oil, and in that sense I haven’t noticed its effectiveness. I do like the texture of the cream and plan on using it alone and seeing how it works. It has a pleasant smell.
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: Refreshing, nice tingly sensation, no smell, non-drying, good for sensitive acne-prone skin.However, will not repurchase as it barely does anything for acne. Also, wish it came with a dispenser/pump.

I received this in a subscription box and was super pumped about it. I never understood the Clarisonic craze as even the sensitive brushes ruined my skin and they just seemed like a great way to spread germs all over your face, even with thorough cleaning. I had looked at the PMD before, but it didn’t get rave reviews so I didn’t buy it. I use this every single night! It’s fantastic for getting makeup off. It provides gentle exfoliation. It’s water resistant and antibacterial, much easier than the maintenance of a Clarisonic. It does make my incredibly oily/combination skin feel much cleaner without being stripped. HOWEVER: I would never spend $100 on this. Well, maybe I would now that it’s become part of my ritual. But I would say it should cost like $50 and a bunch more people would buy it/find it worth it. The vibrations are also hilarious…not sure why a face cleansing devices needs vibrations with so many…different rhythms, but I only use the main high setting one. It does feel like it gets a deeper cleaning than regular washing and it has changed my life for the better, but it’s not some crazy miracle worker that will change your skin five million percent.
review_title: overpriced but a good addition to my routine

review_text: I’ve had to do a lot of traveling recently—back and forth between two states with very different climates, dry to humid—along with a very poor diet of fast food and quick snacks. The next morning, I noticed a big difference—my face seemed brighter, dry patches were hydrated, and red spots (leftover acne scars) had appeared to fade a little. So, I began using this as both a nighttime moisturizer before bed and a primer/moisturizer before applying makeup in the morning. It’s been two weeks and my skin has shown a very good improvement. I’m really impressed with this product—would have started using it sooner had I known what it could do for me!

I don’t like the texture and it smells like popcorn. Overall it’s overprice for what it is.

product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: I’ve tried and loved other Algenist products and this one did not pass the test for me. I didn’t notice any difference.

Was so excited to receive a sample. I have been hearing so many great things about this mask. Welp, too bad. This mask tore my face up. Burning almost instantly. The first time I used it I thought the burning maybe some weird affect from something I did. Then I used it again a few days later and the burning was worse. I have a Bobbi Brown mask that’s similar and I love it. I’ll still to that.
I really like putting this mask on my face because it feels like it’s tingling and after I wash it off, my skin feels super clean (without all the gunk). Great product.

The Triple Acid peel makes my skin look and feel like I’ve had a day at the spa, getting a facial, but I’m able to do it in the comfort of my home! My pores were cleaned out and I was left with glowing, luminous skin! I’m obsessed with Shani Darden’s products and this one is an amazing addition!
I have been using this product for approximately one month, my skin has never looked worse! I had to click on 1 star to submit, but its not worthy of that!
I love Tatcha, their essence is one of my favorites and this formulation is even nicer than the last. Definitely moisturizing, nourishing, and worth a try!
product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

review_text: I definitely bought into the hype surrounding this lip product. I had seen so many raves reviews about it and decided to give it a try. Unfortunately, I was displeased with the results. A goopy mask that did little to hydrate or moisturize the lips, the only redeemable thing I got out of the product was the spatula that I’ve repurposed for other skincare products. Great if it works for you, but there are other lip products on the market that will achieve better results at a fraction of the cost.
I like the Aqua Bomb but this one was super heavy and thick on my skin. I had to return it.

I’ve been a big fan of Origins for pretty much forever. I’ve tried 3 of their moisturizers and they’ve all been great. I think that this one is really great, but for me, didn’t compare to the effects I saw on my skin from their ginseng moisturizer. All in all, it smells amazing, goes on smoothly, and didn’t break me out! I received this product as a free sample.
product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: I received this product to try in my Influenster box. I have combination skin. I have tried Ratchasima products in the past and liked a few so I was excited. Unfortunately for me it left me super greasy, especially in my T zone but also on my cheeks where that is never a problem.
product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment

review_text: I ended up with this because I needed a new face wash and thought Clinique’s 3-piece set sounded like a good value. I didn’t use toner before, just cleanser and moisturizer. I didn’t realize what a difference it would make!! I used to get minor breakouts once a month or so and since I’ve been using this toner for the last 9 months I haven’t had a single pimple. I’ll probably keep buying this forever.
review_title: Really changed my skin for the better

review_text: I tried the sample from my birthday gift. I accidentally got some in my eyes and yikes it stung! Otherwise, it seemed to be a fine cleanser.
I really liked how this is making my skin feel and look. I’ve also found I’m not needing as much moisturizer. I would absolutely recommend this product!

Really like this cleanser. A very little goes a long way, so it is definitely a value. Very creamy, almost like a thick moisturizer in the beginning, and foams up slightly so you can easily cover face and decolletage.
product_name: Crème Radiance Gentle Cleansing Creamy-Foam Cleanser

review_text: This cleanser immediately left my skin dry and tight, and my minimal wrinkles far more prominent. I like DE but this did not work for my skin. Two stars because there’s no fragrance at least.
This gel-cream is very moisturizing and lightweight. My skin feels great after I put it on. I received a trial size from Influenster but will consider buying a full size after finishing this tube.

I love this cream! The scent is relaxing, it feels like silk and in the morning I can still tell its on my face, very long lasting but not greasy or heavy at all. A little goes a long way as well, and for a pricey product that is very important for me. Will definitely be purchasing again.
I like to throw this on when my skin needs a plumping primer to feel out my thin skin. It’s quite a firming primer. Makes my skin look dewy and refines the pore.
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: this is a really great product first it smells really good and it really helps my dark circles and almost blurs the under of my eyes
Wow. My face glows. Stings a bit.

I stopped using for a while just to see if it was the toner that was causing the peeling and then just used one more time and the next day my skin was peeling again! I do not recommend this product!! Too strong, if it makes my finger skin peel I don’t even want to think about it being on my face!
review_title: Makes skin peel on my fingers!

review_text: This has coconut oil in it, skip this and your pores will thank you! Also, I kept finding black specks in the tube constantly. Messaged Freck and they said it should not be happening… yuck.
product_name: Rich Bitch Cactus + Vitamin C Moisturizer

review_text: Beat makeup remover by far. Gentle on the eyes and skin. Top notch.
product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

The first time I used it I thought it was heavy like other sunscreens but afterMassaging it onto my face it felt lighter and fully and quickly absorbed by my skin. It can be white in the beginning too like other thick sunscreen but this fades nicely into your complexion and does not leave a greasy feel on your face. I feel confident going out in the sun with this SPF 50!!!
product_name: SUBLIME DEFENSE Ultra Lightweight UV Defense Fluid SPF 50

review_text: I received a free 5 day sample to test. The taste was yummy but I need more than 5 days to say for sure if it impacted my skin.
I agree with other reviewers - this product stinks. I don’t mind herbal smelling products but this turned my stomach. Also, turned my face red. Returning.
product_name: Ferulic Brew Facial Treatment Essence with Lactic Acid

review_text: Didn’t like the formula of this cleanser. Feel like it is too oily and does not clean the face. I had to use alot to clean the face. Lot of product waste. Didn’t met my expectations.
Loved the idea of this but my upper arms that saw the most sun got little white bumps all over them and they took over a week to go away.
product_name: Glow Oil Body Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: Horrible product and its over priced other than that the product is very greasy feeling and doesn’t absorb into the skin its a very uncomfortable feeling I returned it the next day
review_title: DONT SPEND YOUR COINS ON THIS

product_name: High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs

review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster and was really excited to try it, but i was pretty disappointed. May just be my skin, but i wasn’t impressed.
product_name: Goodbye Acne   Complete Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I love this cleanser and have been using it for about a year now - it’s soothing, smells amazing, and is gentily on my sensitive acne-prone skin! (Disclaimer: I signed up to receive this product as a sample recently, which motivated me to finally write this review)

It is very thick, and doesn’t spread well on the skin, weighing it down as opposed to leaving it feel light and bright. I also saw red bumps on my skin after each use. Discontinued use after 4 times of application.
review_title: Not for combination or oily skin type
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: Okay, this stuff is hella pricey, but I dont mess around with SPF. This is just like a lotion and you can use it when you go out to a lunch, to an outdoor party or whatever and its not heavy or cakey. It wont flake off like most, it doesnt smell like sunscreen and it will not stain your white clothing. I buy the large size for at home and keep a smaller size to take to the beach or park. THE BEST.
review_title: Forget any other sunscreen, you have found the one
product_name: PLAY Everyday Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: I really dislike this balm. It is very thick and goopy. What’s more is that the product separates and has a really gross feeling texture. Those could probably be overlooked if it actually removed makeup - but no, after using this, i still have a lot of makeup residue left.

I really wanted to love this product but unfortunately, because of my sensitive and acne prone skin, this product broke me out within 2 hours of putting it on my face. Now i have zits and redness that were not there this morning. I am so disappointed because i read the reviews and i heard such great things. It works great for my friend who has normal skin, but for me with acne prone and sensitive skin it was a total miss and now im doubling down on my skincare tonight to try and repair the damage this has done :( Will be returning it tomorrow
review_title: Not good for Acne Prone or Sensitive Skin
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

product_name: Mini TL Advanced  Tightening Neck Cream PLUS for Firming & Brightening

review_text: I don’t see any difference with my dark under eye skin nor do I notice and big reduction in my puffy under eye area. The cream feels good on the skin and does moisturizer the area well.

I love this product! It was gifted by glow recipe and I am so impressed. It really makes my skin glow. It feels hydrating and smells delicious! I love it over make up with or without a highlighter. And without make up, it gives my skin a healthy, Dewey glow. Highly recommend.
After using this toner I have breakout. It leave a greasy and sticky feel on the face. It is not refreshing at all. It does not match what the product description claim to be. Don’t waste your money.
product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner

review_text: I was sent a seven day sample by Influenster to try out the product. It didn’t work well for me. I don’t have overly sensitive skin, but I did find it a bit irritating. product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate

review_text: I love this serum! It makes my dry skin plump and dewy. I’m in love with this serum and I can not lie. I’m a summer Friday’s lover for life❤️
product_name: CC Me Vitamin C + Niacinamide Serum

review_text: This product is and was amazing. It used to be 40 bucks. I used it for years then bam! 180 dollars.

Omg just the best.. it’s the only thing that I will use for taking my makeup off from low on
Disappointed. Had high hopes for this but I ended up looking like a disco ball. Sooo glittery! Will be returning
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: I don’t think my skin-type is oily enough to get the best use out of this toner. In fact, this toner made my skin more oily and even made it red and patchy. Given all the good reviews, I’m sure it works wonders if you have a really oily skin-type. Otherwise, even if you’re just a bit oily or you have combination skin, I wouldn’t recommend it. The fragrance is also quite strong and minty, so if you don’t like either of those things, this isn’t for you. It disappears quite quickly, though.
review_title: Only if you have super oily skin

review_text: Alcohol is way too strong. Normally, my skin can bare products with alcohol but not for this one. Just got it yesterday, tried it once and I ended up returning it.
Have been using for 3-4 weeks. It’s nothing special. Doesn’t really moisture, plump skin, brighten. Nothing. It’s full of fragrance. Not worth the price. Buy better!!
review_title: Charlotte Tilbury Skincare is nothing special!
product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Serum with Vitamin C

review_text: I thought the SK-II Skin Lotion Toner was just average. It’s a nice toner, but the price point is a turn off for me. You can get many similar toners for wayyyy cheaper. If you don’t mind spending the extra money, you should definitely try it.

I’ve had this a few months. I have worn it every night sometime day in hopes it helps my chapped lips. My lips are still chapped and hurt. I was hoping I would fall in love with this product but for me I did not. Will be buying something different.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I’ve been using this for a couple of weeks and find it really keeps my skin feeling soft and hydrated in this cold Canadian winter.

I am unsure why, but it is making my dark spot AND the skin around my dark spot(everything that gets covered by the patch) darker!!I thought it was irritation at first, but it is now +3 days since my last dots were placed and i can see little dark circles everywhere they were. I see it worked for many people, so not sure why i am having this reaction to them.
Amazing smell! Feels so good, uplifting. Received this product as a gift from OLEHENRIKSEN skincare. Looking forward to the results! Feels glowing! Great texture!

While I love their lip balms and lip masks, I didn’t enjoy this one as much as their original lip mask. It has a tingly sensation after you apply it to your lips. I do like the scent it has but I didn’t notice much hydration like the other ones they have. Chapped my lips if anything.

I have since entering my 30s experienced some cystic acne around the time of my cycle. Luckily this sample arrived just in time . I used for a week solid forgoing my usual routine. I had no breakouts and beyond that my skin looked amazing. I love this product and will purchase a full size . With the price if you want the results
not a fan of the smells and the texture is like rough and sandy, too rough of my skin. I prefer other enzyme masks.
product_name: Yerba Mate Resurfacing + Exfoliating Energy Facial with Enzymes + Niacinamide

review_text: Used the entire bottle, but won’t be repurchasing. Didn’t make any noticeable difference, even when used with the niacinamide treatment. Still on the hunt to clear up my skin, sadly this one didn’t do the trick.
I used this a few times and my skin was more dry and VERY red. Returning!

This moisturizer is amazing and my skin loves this stuff. The cream feels thick and applies that way also but it doesn’t feel greasy after it’s on your skin; it still feels lightweight despite the consistency. I felt it to be heavily moisturizing all at the same time. I personally haven’t broken out from it which is great!
This is a really good moisturizer. Its very thick, left myskin feeling smooth but not greasy. Its very moisturizing plus there is no scent which i really like.

I was super excited to try this mask, so I bought it and on the first try it gave me like rosacea, I tuned all red and started to get bumps all over the face. And two days after, all the bumps were still there and my skin started to peel off. I would not recommend it if you have sensitive skin.

Ugh I’m so upset by this product. First off, the smell is heavenly it makes me feel like I’m at a spa, I love the fact that it heats up on your skin also simulating a spa, and my skin feels soft right after using it. HOWEVER every single time I use this I get several breakouts deep under my skin that are painful and take months to heal fully. Used it once in December and broke out but didn’t realize it was from this because I was trying a few new products, tried it again in January and broke out but thought it was from other causes, tried it in March with all my NORMAL skincare products and low and behold my skin broke out again. I wish I could give this product 5 stars but I have dry/combo skin and I’m 21 and have never had an issue with acne until using this product and frankly this product has ruined my skin the past 5 months and now I need to spend even longer trying to heal the acne scars. I had perfectly clear skin and now I have red acne scars all over my cheeks and it’s gonna take a lot to fix them. Ive tried, love, and have repurchased a lot of Ole’s products but this scrub should not be used on facial skin.
Not impressed with this eye serum. La Roche posay which is half the price of this Tilbury cryo eye serum does a better job at depuffing the eye areA. Don’t waste your money on the cryo line.

I will definitely repurchase this toner. Highly suggest this to anyone who doesn’t have one or is using one but wants something stronger. I first started using pixie glow tonic. As I was running out I noticed I wouldn’t feel that tingly sensation a chemical exfoliator (aha/bha) gives. I feel that sensation again with this. I would suggest starting with something gentler and then moving on to this if you’re new to aha’s/bha’s. This product does come with a pump dispenser. I would suggest compressed cotton pads over regular cotton pads because it will waste less product. I have been using the klairs cotton rounds, and suggest padding the face, not rubbing.
review_title: Great daily exfoliator for clear glowing skin
product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: This is absolutely the best lip mask on the market. It’s really thick and non-sticky, it feels a little like a lip balm. If you put a layer on before you go to bed every night, it takes the chapping away from your lips! It’s great and I would highly recommend!!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: not worth the price. smell is too strong and it doesn’t work as well as it should.

A very good retinol for sensitive skin. It has not caused any type of reaction or allergy as it happens with other products. I only apply a plum on my face, emphasizing where I have fine lines of expression and if I have seen changes, I have been using it for 3 weeks twice a week and it is going great. I recommend it.
The patches dried up in the container really quickly.
product_name: 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

review_text: I don’t get what all the hype is about. I’ve tried this on cuticles, face and hair-- it’s a nice enough moisturizer, but I don’t see any lasting difference. It could be anything, really-- nothing special here.

I read the reviews carefully on this but I still decided to try it out on my own, even though I shouldn’t have. This made my under eye lines that aren’t very defined, so wrinkly and it somehow made those lines puffy and kind of swollen. It also didn’t go down or away completely for about a week, maybe longer. Try at your own risk.
review_title: Made my eyes look so bad and swollen!

Pretty impressed with the drunk elephant products. Can’t wait to see what they come up with next!

I used it at night before going to bed to take the day off. It’s a super creamy formula and has a very mild light scent to it. I lathered it up with some water and it applied it all over my face. It didn’t get my eye makeup so easily but I wasn’t surprised since that’s the most stubborn to take off. But after lathering up a second time, it took everything off. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and this did not irritate my skin in any way. I would definitely recommend!

If i can give this zero stars i would . This doesn’t stick , it’s literally a waste of money. It was so hard and uncomfortable & i saw literally no results what so ever . Wish i can get a refund idc if it’s only $3

My God! Like, best purchase ever! :O I was looking for a gentle cleanser to use daily that wouldn’t be too stripping. This is it! I have sensitive skin and this product does it for me, it is soft, smells so good and does wonders for my oily skin. A little goes a long way too! Def gonna buy the bigger size one once this one is empty ^^Also gotta love the fact the bottle is made of glass :O Love love love it!

This is just an insanely overpriced and overly perfumey hyaluronic acid. There is no reason that 1oz of HA should be anywhere near $50. There are far better HA options that don’t have fragrance and are in the $6-20 range. Don’t waste your money.
product_name: Thirst Trap Juice Hyaluronic Acid & Peptide Hydrating Facial Serum

review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! I have combo/oily skin so my skin loves more lightweight gel cream textures like this one. It also has niacinamide & zinc pca which help curb my sebum production. The gel cream also feels nourishing without the tacky or greasy finish. Definitely a great all year round moisturizer. I also love the airless pump packaging so you get every drop.
product_name: Barrier+ Skin Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream

review_text: I received this free in exchange for my honest opinion from Drunk Elephant and Influenster. This eye cream is amazing as it actually hydrates. I’ve tried a ton of different eye creams but this one of my top 2 favorites. It has a soft pleasant scent, feels milky on the skin, leaves it looking hydrated, and feels moisturized for a long time after applying. Trying this makes me want to see if they also have an overall face moisturizer that hydrates so well.
product_name: Ceramighty  AF Eye Cream with Ceramides

Usually they don’t moisturize enough, leave your face feeling wet or oily, leave a layer on your face that dries and flakes off or ends up causing you to break out. I had none of those issues which is awesome. This cream is so silky, goes on easy and soks into your skin. It left my face feeling so super soft. It made it look hydrated and even helps with the wrinkles which is definitely an added bonus. This cream rocks and it is now my new daily go to. I think you will also love it!!

I am in love with this eye cream!! Makes my under eye area radiant, awake! Its great for those with wrinkles and fine lines for sure .. ( i had really dull eyes after having a baby so it did help) also for those who love scented products. It does have a little scent to it which is also why i love applying it! Do give it a try you will definetly not regret! Just buy it!!! This will be one of my permanent routine products for my skin care for sure.

I have to say I didn’t really like this produc too much. It works fine, but my skin is very sensitive and during the application I get irritation. So i prefer something more natural, but the product is not bad. It does what they claim. Just not my favorite

I was really dissapointed:((

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

I carry this even for a two-day trip. Apply good enough amount to the clean skin at night and blot with a warm cloth. The next morning, my skin is super soft and hydrated, ready to apply whatever minimum makeup I use. It doesn’t look tired even if I haven’t slept properly in 4-5 days! I can see this working perfectly for those that can get away with little moisturization.
review_title: Feels nice, but not enough moisture.

review_text: I think this product would be great for someone who’s skin isn’t as sensitive as mine. I did a skin test and couldn’t use it on my face based on the results but, it worked great for my nephew. His skin looked amazing after he used it.

review_text: I got this as a sample. I’m very happy with it, but I don’t know that it’s worth the price. It feels nice on my lips and it goes on great under my daily lipstick. I highly recommend this to everyone.
This product is inexpensive but does nothing so won’t be ordering again

review_text: I am usually on the oily side of things but since moving to the Houston side of Texas I have become more dry and so i never thought of using a moisturizer but the girls at Sephora showed me the difference on how my skin would feel and I am loving it so far.
product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I LOVE this product. I used to be a makeup wipe girl, but I can never go back. The first time I used it I had no idea how well it would work, but wow.

This mask is beautifully scented and formulated. I love how it is named Evercalm as it feels so perfectly fitting when applied to the skin. The scent is beautiful and it is completely made for those with sensitive skin. I use a chemical exfoliant once a week and I love to use this product afterwards to help calm and soothe the redness from the peel. I love that it is a clean product as well. Though the only downsize is there is truly not the much product within the bottle (there is a pouch within the plastic bottle, the entire bottle is not filled) it is on the more expensive side. If you have sensitive skin I would totally recommend this product.

I wore this product all day for a parade in scorching heat and sun. I had not even the slightest burn; it applied like a dream, and I loved that it wasn’t thick and goopy!. The next day, millions of tiny red bumps showed up every place I had applied product, particularly my chest, neck, and upper back. Even after showering and applying coconut oil (my go-to skin soother), the bumps are still visible and highly itchy/irritating two days after applying. I have never had a reaction like this before to any product!This product worked AMAZINGLY well at keeping my very pale skin from getting burnt; however, the allergic reaction it caused makes it incredibly scary.

review_text: love this stuff. my skin looks great and I am protecting from the sun. makeup goes nicely on top of it. I have oily skin and this isn’t too much for me. mineral sunscreen, good ingredients. I’m here for it.
product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: I️ really wanted to love this product. I️ have combination skin and hormonal breakouts. I️ was so excited when I️ got it due to all the great reviews I read about it. I️ normally suffer from hormonal break outs around my chin but literally the following morning after I️ had started using it I️ woke up with breakouts. product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: I always get small pimples on my lower neck/upper back that never develop into full white headed pimples. I have to buy it from the Clinique counter in Macy’s.
product_name: Acne Solutions Cleansing Bar For Face and Body

review_text: This is the only exfoliator that hasn’t been too harsh for my skin. I have very sensitive skin and exfoliators irritate me. This mask is so gentle and makes my face extremely smooth and instantly brightens. Expensive, but worth it!

I love this cream. I’ve definitely seen the difference. I even went to check with those machines with the lights and all and my skin is sooo healthy now after like a weeks use! I received this product for free.

Unlike other masks, this one does not just soak in and disappear overnight, but I take one star off as it was sticky from the moment I put it on to the moment I woke up. review_text: i think it’s good! could definitely be better but it’s a good affordable cleansing balm, especially if you’re just starting out with oil cleansing!

review_title: ok but not for sensitive skin

product_name: Ceramighty  AF Eye Cream with Ceramides

review_text: I hate that I’m leaving this such a poor review but it has to be done. This broke me out SO bad. I am talking 13 year old massive pimple breakouts all over my face along with tiny little texture bumps. This is the only OLE product that hasn’t worked for me and it took me weeks to admit that this is what it was because I don’t struggle with having sensitive skin at all. Definitely will use this til it’s gone and purchase it. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes but all my opinions are my own.

Finished my first bottle (1.7oz) which I received as a birthday gift; I used it LIBERALLY 1-2 times per day and it lasted a little over a month. I am about to purchase the 4.2 oz myself now. I wanted to leave a review because maybe it can help someone overwhelmed by all of the skincare tips floating around on here and on the rest of internet. review_text: I’ve been using this for almost 2 weeks. I was going to do before and after photos and forgot to take the before! I’m in my 30s and still have acne. made my pores huge! I noticed my skin got super oily(at a point that I could see tiny droplets of oil on my face) in the middle of the night, and in the morning my pores looked horribly big. returned!

review_text: The glycerin and shea butter in this is a NO for those who are prone to clogged pores - it’s very high up on the ingredients list. I was intrigued by the Caudalie line and was happy to see it was the birthday gift this year. I’ve used it twice with the serum - once at night and another time in the morning with no other products other than my usual cleanser. My skin texture and clogged pores started to come back after I’ve finally tamed my skin from a horrible skin congestion from a lactic acid product I was using. My skin is still recovering from the extra sensitivity and congestion from the previous product and sadly this product contributed to my congestion problem.

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Tata Harper Skincare. The cream nourishes and deeply hydrated my skin without leaving my skin greasy. It doesn’t break my skin out either. I love the sustainable refill system since it would save extra $$$ when I want to repurchase it!

After about a week of use, I didn’t notice any spectacular results with my skin. Literally felt like I just dampened my skin with water. But after 2 weeks I noticed small patches of rough, bumpy, red skin cropping up beneath my nose. I finally stopped using the product when the bumps became itchy and started to spread from under my nose to my laugh lines. Now the skin is tight, flaky, and itchy. No amount of creams, acids, or exfoliating helps and covering it with makeup seems to worsen the condition. I’ll have to make a dermatologist appointment to get this corrected. I tried calling customer service to get a refund and spoke with Cory and the supervisor Tracy, but with it being past the 60 return policy all they could do was give me points. I understand it’s the policy and I explained I had held off on using this product until I finished up another product. But this product has destroyed my skin barrier. Insider points will not cover the cost of a visit to a dermatologist to fix an issue that was caused by a product you sold. I will never buy from Fenty Beauty or Sephora again after this experience.

This mask is the only mask that does not break me out, does not create plugs and although I can’t wear foundation, it was the only time my make up actually didn’t crack. this toner works really well. I’ve received it for free for review. this does more than my other toners. This product is worth the price and I do recommend.

review_text: I got a sample of this cleanser a while back with my order. The way I test products is one at a time, introducing them or substituting them into my skin care routine, so I know almost for certain that this stuff broke me out with pimples like I haven’t had in years. For reference, my skin is combination, sensitive, and acne prone. I found that this cleanser did a good job of removing my makeup, lathered really well (a little went a LONG way), and left my face feeling squeaky clean. When I say “squeaky“ I mean like actually. Dragging my fingers down my cheeks garnered a tiny squeaking noise that was unsettling. The only thing I can compare this stuff to, as far as feeling goes, is a bar of Zest soap. It stung my eyes really badly, so I still had to use a separate eye makeup remover, smelled unpleasant, and overall just didn’t work for me. I was pretty disappointed considering how awesome the other origins products I’ve tried are, but oh well. You win some and you lose some.

review_text: I have been using this product for a few weeks now since receiving it and I’ve been absolutely loving it. If I’m not using it as a makeup remover I am reaching for it as a toner after I wash my face. It’s replaced my regular toner and my skin has been looking and feeling extremely smooth and radiant. The product has a really gentle formula so I would recommend this product especially for people with sensitive skin. You’ll also love this product if you need a reliable makeup remover but hate oil-based ones. Overall, I’ve been really enjoying using this treatment, and added it as a staple in my skin-care routine.

All of their other products that I’ve tried have this beautiful light scent that I absolutely love. This one, however, is a bit too strong for me.

I’m tossing it in the trash, which is rare for me. I hang on to stuff trying to make it work but this just defies my best efforts. review_text: Not a fan, doesnt do much and I think it broke me out :(

product_name: Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener

review_text: Sooo overpriced and not as moisturizing as I thought. I have dry skin so this winter I wanted to splurge on a nice overnight mask. After trying this I quickly realized my $15 Weleda cream is much more effective and cheaper.

I have never had any type of bad reaction to a makeup or skin product before. I received this as a sample, and should have read reviews first because experienced what several other people seem to have experienced with the sample. Not sure if a bad batch, but I put it on last night, and my face immediately became hot, slightly itchy, red, and stinging. Overnight it only became less hot, but today it’s almost like I’ve been sunburned--itchy, dry, and stinging skin all day so far. Not sure how to get rid of it, but I do NOT have sensitive skin so imagine still others are experiencing this as well. Awful.
Was super excited to try this out on my face but quickly backfired once the cream actually settled in.. PEELS SO MUCH
Great product but the packaging is terrible- I would definitely buy it in tube form!

I LOVE the peach scent. I also found this product to be hydrating, especially when I put it on at night and woke up to soft, hydrated lips in the morning. However, if I put too much on, I found it a bit sticky. I took a star off for the price. But I did really enjoy it, and would likely buy in the future if I felt like splurging or treating myself (I’m fine with buying lip balms from the drug store).

I used to think that Kate Sommerville exfolikate was the best until I got to try this! I absolutely love how this makes your skin even immediately after using it. It is very effective in unclogging pores and leaves skin feeling baby soft. I do think it might not work on sensitive skin. I have normal to dry skin and is perfect for removing dead skin. I also love that a little bit of product goes a long way. This is worth its weight in gold!
I liked this product but found it so overpriced. Similar to the drunk elephant baby facial but not as effective and it broke me out!
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: So I received this as a SAMPLE... and normally I don’t review unless I absolutely love it, and purchase the full product. But I felt the need to warn about this one! I intended to actually purchase this once I ran out of my normal moisturizer but I ended up getting the sample before then. I tried it for two nights and my skin is hating me. I woke up this morning with red blotches in the middle of my forehead (Between the brows.. I can’t even remember EVER having problems in that area..) and two zits on my cheek. I really am shocked at how my skin reacted to this, and I’m sure it was this product because my regimen has been the same. My skin is sensitive/oily but I’ve never had these annoying blotchy like reactions. My guess is its too thick for my skin and it clogged my pores, and maybe there’s some ingredient I’m not agreeing with?..Others have raved so much about it so maybe just try it for one night and wait a few days for any reaction signs. I’m so relieved I didn’t purchase before sampling. But still disappointed :/
review_title: If you have sensitive or acne prone skin...

review_text: I was told that this moisturizer is all about hydrating. It after using it for 3 weeks my skin is drier than it was originally. This would probably be a good moisturizer for oily skin but it didn’t work for me
product_name: Perfecting Day Cream Broad Spectrum SPF 30 PA+++

review_text: Love this. I have been using just a week and the blackheads on my nose are already reduced. It really picks up trace dirt after cleansing. Great product.

I can’t believe I’m writing a negative review about this super popular cleanser but it just didn’t work for me. The consistency of the cleanser was fine and the smell wasn’t too strong, but it didn’t help my skin at all. I bought the mini as a way to “test” the cleanser on my skin for the past two weeks and I have seen 0 changes. I used this twice a day and I swear my skin looked as oily as before I washed it. If you have oily skin like me and want to test this out I recommend buying the mini size, maybe you’ll have better luck then I did.

I have battled acne for over 10 years and this product cleared my skin nearly completely. I searched for years and years for anything that would help and I found this product and it changed my skin. Its lightweight, non greasy and refreshing. If you are looking for that magic product, give it a try!
Fail sadly. This made me break out and I never do. Returning this.

This is such a lovely cleanser! Wonderfully balanced and perfect for my tempermental skin. I started going “Clean at Sephora“ and what a difference that has made! This cleanser has a safe ph for the face (the face is usually about a 5.5 ph). There is not a lot of foaming with this product but it cleans my face very well. I use an oil cleanser to take off my makeup and then use this. It’s not as effective with taking off makeup on its own. The only problem I have with this item is that I dropped it a foot from the ground and the cap broke. I was so mad but I still love this cleanser.
I absolutely love this product, I used it after the belif makeup removing cleansing balm and my skin has never felt so soft. My skin feels so soft that I just want to keep touching it!

This is surprisingly my first Paula’s choice product and I will say I can see why people go to her with their acne concerns. I like the small packaging, it’s a clear gel consistency, no strong scent. It does sting on any open acne so I would avoid putting it on those areas. I appreciate that this is safe to put over a large area unlike many spot treatments that are too drying to do that. When I break out it tends to be in one general area so being able to cover the entire region without fear of over drying has been nice. It works well! My spots clear up with a couple of applications. Overall I am happy with it.

I really enjoy this cream. Initially I was worried that it would be too thick and greasy, but when I apply it it feels as though there’s nothing on my skin, in a good way. My skin feels moisturized, and I like that I can use it as a way to seal in all my other products. Would definitely repurchase
seemed to irritate my skin, and caused small itchy red bumps on my forehead. i’m returning this. would not recommend this if you have sensitive skin!!

The mochi mochi cream felt very hydrating and seemed relatively long-lasting. I appreciate that the brand uses clean ingredients. Because the cream is fragrance-free, however, it has a grassy, mochi-like smell. The cream also didn’t fully absorb into my skin, so I could feel the product for a while after. Still, it provided a lot of hydration and didn’t break me out.
product_name: Mochi Mochi Luminous Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Best facial cleanser ever

I love how lightweight this moisturizer is while still feeling hydrating! The gel consistency is wonderful, it makes my skin feel smooth and my fine lines disappear! The larger pores around my nose look a lot smaller too. I love it under makeup it keeps my skin from getting too greasy/shiny looking throughout the day. I use a small amount because a little goes a long way for me and I use it morning and night and my skin already feels smoother and more moisturized. And the packaging is so beautiful so I get excited to use it every day!!

For the Coffee one!!I’ve used every eye mask from Sephora and this one is a bit different. It felt very cool (almost chilly) which I guess is the part to make you feel refreshed. Right when I opened it, the product smelled heavily as if I just walked in a coffeeshop. The scent lasted pretty much the whole time I kept on my eyes (30 minutes). The coffee smell was every off putting for me, as I’m not a coffee person. I will continue to buy Sephora eye masks, but sadly would use the coffee one again.

I received this product as a free sample. I was only able to use it twice because the smell is nothing like pineapples. It’s more metallic and it bothered me so much. I can’t even tell you what it did for my face, the scent was that distracting.

I got this ren skincare evercalm barrier support elixir in exchange for this review. What I like about this product? It’s vegan, fragrance free and clinically proven. helps to strengthen the skin barrier in 14 days.
Love love love worked great for my skin and the price point can’t be beat
Found this item to have a peculiar scent and noticed that my foundation became blotchy after application. I love all Drunk Elephant products but this one doesn’t seem to be suitable for me.
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: This peeling gel is nothing but extraordinary!! You immediately see the dead skin come off (kinda gross, but not really) as you put on the gel, after I rinsed, my face felt so smooth, and clean. Love it!!
Love the texture, smell and how it goes on. What I don’t love is having to reapply it every 15 minutes. It seems to dry out my lips rather than moisturize. Won’t be buying again.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: It might just be me, but it did absolutely nothing for me, even after taking it consistently. Love the brand name though. ❤️

Super disappointed.

review_text: Very light consistency, no strong or offensive scent, not white cast, not sticky, smooth. Also because i did not like the thick “dimethicone“ feel it left on my skin, it felt suffocating. That being said, i can see this being a good spf under makeup because of that layer. Very smoothing. review_title: Pretty good, just not for me.

review_text: Love this moisturizer! It’s super creamy and goes on thick, but once you fully rub it into your skin it creates a beautiful hydrated, plump surface. Will definitely be incorporating this into everyday skincare routine.
product_name: Melt Moisturizer with Bakuchiol and Squalane

review_text: I love this product! Definitely removes the oil and leaves my face squeaky clean!! I love the smell of it! I do think it’s a bit pricey but it lasts for a long time!
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: God bless Hyram for introducing me to this product! This is the holy grail of cleansers!!!!
So good and refreshing. I use this before bed when my face is feeling dry and I always wake up with my skin feeling soft and moisturized. Kind of pricey but I will be repurchasing!
Worked fine, but turned greyish green with a moldy smell after just a few months.
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I received this product to try for free from Influenster, but all opinions are my own. This product impressed me from the beginning. I liked the way the pad had a spot to slide your fingers so that you would more easily spread it across your face. The smell was evident but not as chemically smelling as other peels I have tried. It did tingle a bit, but it wasn’t painful. Also, I definitely saw an enhanced glow to my skin the next day. I would recommend this product, and I am glad I got to try it.
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: This stuff is amazing. I use it every morning before I go to work and it makes my eyes look like I got more than five hours of sleep. Best anti-sleepy-eyes product Ive ever used.
This stuff is horrible.. does nothing for your lips, smells disgusting. Just do yourself a favour and buy a tub of petroleum jelly. That’s literally all this is
I loved this product and exceeded my expectations by far. It is not oily at all and left my skin looking flawless after just a week. It’s easy to apply and smells nice.
product_name: Ferulic Brew Facial Treatment Essence with Lactic Acid

review_text: I’ve been using this product for over a month now and haven’t seen a big difference in my skin, find it overrated for the price.
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: This is a great, cheap summer product! I found it really helped keep my oil under control last summer. And it sat nice under make-up. It *did* make my skin kind of tacky, but that was fine for me. Something to note for personal preference though. For the price, this is everything I wanted and more.

This gets points from me for how clean the ingredients are and the packaging being nice but honestly past that I can’t say I like it. I’ve liked most of the things he’s recommended so far but this was kind of disappointing. product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles

Also leaves a sticky film on my skin after use. I’ll use it before bed and will actually feel my cheek sticking to the pillow. Kinda strange for its “star” product. review_text: It made my breakouts a little smaller- but not much and they started to hurt after using! I wanted to love it I really did I tried for days. But alas it didn’t work for me. Smells a little strong for .5 seconds then it’s not noticeable.
These darkened my skin but I am experiencing horrible side effects

review_text: With breastfeeding I am always thirsty & my lips were always drying out. I now sleep with the collagen lip on & wear it during the day under my lipstick. It has made a night & day difference in the dry patches on my lips. This is probably one of my favorite skincare products ever.

This is perhaps the worst hyaluronic acid serum that I have ever used! I have been using hyaluronic serums for years, and this one is definitely terrible. Even after applying on damp skin it is STICY! Additionally, there are not enough hyaluronic acid weights to make this product effective. I found that this actually dried and dehydrated my skin. Do yourself a favour and upgrade to PTR’s hyaluronic, Glow Recipe’s, or Dr. Dennis Gross!

I used to have a little sample size of the pink lip sleeping mask and purchased the full size of the vanilla flavour and do not regret it at all! I apply it every night before going to bed and also throughout the day during the winter for extra moisturizing. I will never purchase another lip hydrating product, this is my holy grail!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I used to use a Shiseido product, and my eye would always feel irritated the next morning. I stopped using eye cream altogether for a while to give my eyes a break. I tried this, hoping my eyes could tolerate it and I’ve had a great experience. Absolutely no irritation, and the area around my eyes feels silky smooth and I think the appearance looks a little brighter and firmer just a week and a half after starting use. I don’t have dark circles under my eyes for the most part, so I can’t comment on that. I use a pea-sized amount twice a day.
product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream

review_text: It stings! It burns! It’s amazing. I am left a little red after for about 20-30 minutes but my face is clearer, lines are minimizing. review_title: Only product I ever re purchase

review_text: I absolutely love this, it’s so fast and easy and it looks amazing and natural
i didnt see any visible results but i like applying it and hope it is strengthening my skin barrier. the botte is small but it goes a long way

I received this product complimentary from Sunday Riley. I have used this treatment before as well and I do find it as a staple in my routine. This is great for sensitive skin and doesn’t irritate me at all. Highly recommend it.

review_text: Pros: -quick and easy application-somewhat refreshingCons: -sticky-rather unpleasant scent; smells more of old raisinsthan grapes.All in all, you can find a much better moisturizer or refreshing spritz.

this is my first product from Supergoop and I’m so in love with it. This shade “Dawn” really matches my skin tone and it looks naturally glowing and protected. No white cast and it doesn’t dry out my skin.
product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: Great cleanser! I use this as my second cleanse-I use an oil first. This leaves my skin so soft and hydrated, never dry or tight and it rinses off so easily. I love it!

I would be curious to see how this worked over a longer period of time. There is a slight scent to the product but it’s not overbearing - it might irritate those who are sensitive to smells though. The price point is kind of high so I’m sure you could find a similar product for much less. Try a sample before you purchase!

review_text: I was using the Clarifying Lotion 2, but it seemed to dry my skin out, so I decided to try the Clarifying Lotion 1. review_title: Why I like the Clarifying Lotion 1

review_text: I really wanted to love this because of all the positive reviews, but unfortunately this didn’t for me. Prior to using this I had a few acne scars I wanted to clear up. After using this for over a month, it has only caused me more whiteheads and scars. This was a let down for me.

Unfortunately it made me break out all over the chin area which NEVER happens. Also feels like the beads dissolve too quickly and then it turns into a weird consistency which doesn’t feel like it’s exfoliating whatsoever. Nice smell, but really bad breakouts. I used it once a week for 4 weeks and I broke out every single time. Be aware if you have sensitive skin/acne prone.
It seems to work as well as any other lip balm and for that reason, I definitely believe it is over priced and not much product for the price. I love Drunk Elephant products but this one not so much.
It is great makes my face feel smooth only bad comment is about the smell.
I understand that they are exfoliating wipes but they are a little harsh on the face. The smell is fine and it didn’t linger
Broke me out didn’t do much.. feel like it didn’t do nothing at all to my skin
product_name: Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: I liked this cleanser, but it wasn’t anything groundbreaking. I have dry/normal skin and it was pretty gentle and I didn’t find it to dry my skin out at all. I haven’t been using it long enough to find out if it has any effect on old acne scars. But a warning to those who are sensitive to scents: the tea tree scent is nearly eye watering, but it’ll really wake you up in the morning.

I wanted to love this. Like really really really wanted to. It smells great, applies so smoothly and just is such a game changer for sun protection buuuuuut..... after reapplying every 2-3 hours we all still got tanned and for SPF 50 I expect NO COLOR CHANGE whatsoever. I believe it’s because we were somewhere warm and we were sweating but I assumed because it absorbs into the skin it wouldn’t come off too easily. Also we were reapplying quite frequently but all got the dreaded tan lines we really didn’t want. In comparison I used another brand for SPF 50 on my face and only reapplied that ONCE during the day and didn’t tan. A for effort but not real world usable. For reference my skin tone is olive and I don’t burn easily but I abhor T-shirt tans hence the hunt for a good sunblock.
product_name: Glow Oil Body Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: Ok. Wow. Just purchased yesturday. Couldn’t wait I had to try it ok right away and I’m blown away. My face already looked better after one use and it unbelievably SOFT!!! I can’t wait to see the results in the long run.
product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: When I apply the cream, my face stays a tad shiny for 5-10 minutes, almost as if my skin is slowly drinking it up. I reach for it 2-3 times a week and would recommend it to someone who’s looking to add a booster (ie. gentle chemical exfoliant) to their weekly skincare routine.

product_name: Nomad’s Cream Purifying & Exfoliating AHA Cleanser

review_text: I’m using it as an eye make-up remover and it does a pretty good job (mascara is not waterproof). My skin is normal so I have no issues regarding sensitivity. review_text: If you are looking for a product that will visibly pull out black heads, or you already have skin that is generally OK, i.e. not super acne prone, oily skin, and clogged pores, this is not the product for you. I am 29 and have had acne since I was 23 and I went to a dermatologist a couple of times, they gave me meds they worked for a while, but as soon as I stopped it came back full force. Since I don’t want to be on meds forever I am looking for alternatives...The strips suck out gunk from your pores, and the dots help your pimples to go down. I used the product 4 nights in a row, and visibly less stuff came out night after night. Since it’s not pulling stuff, it is absorbing, you can see what comes out by the change in colour of the strip or dots, they become white in areas that it has absorbed. If there is little or no change in area it means there was nothing to absorb, so yay for you! I have tried loads of products, varying in price. If you have chronic acne, cystic acne, or very clogged pores, this stuff will help your other products be more effective because it will help get the gunk out that stops your other products from being effective. I have 2 major patches of cystic acne on my jaw line, i used the pore strips for 3 nights on each side, and then a bunch of the dots the 4th night, and those areas have improved dramatically. Again, not fixed entirely, but definitely a huge help.I would recommend skin testing this product to make sure that you are not allergic as some reviewers seem to have had a reaction to them. Personally they did nothing to aggravate my skin, but everyone is different!

I highly suggest looking at YouTube videos to get some insight on how to properly to use the PMD on your face. They have their own videos of demonstrations to guide you if the instructions on the box still have you wondering. review_text: I feel like I’ve tried every product Sephora has to offer for acne skin. I buy the smaller size near checkout but it still lasts 2-3 months (any other broke college ladies like myself, this is very affordable and still lasts). I recommend using it 3 or 4 times a week, every other day for 5 minutes. I have always been SO self conscious about the deep acne scars on my face, but using this in my regimen has helped my skin make milestones in renewing. Great for evening skin tone, fading scars, reducing fine lines or blemishes. Just a great, great product all around for the vitality of your skin. Get it! You won’t be sorry!

review_text: After 1 month of use - I have oily black head prone skin, and this product didn’t add any moisture to my skin at all. This stuff is lovely and SO nice for the price. It sinks into my skin really quickly and isn’t too matte or too dewy - just a nice natural in-between. I like moisturizers that moisturize without leaving any feeling behind - no stickiness, oiliness, or heaviness. I’ve tried the DE Protini that this seems to dupe and I like this one WAYmore.

This product helps control my skin all day long. I use it as a primer and let it sit for 2 mins before applying makeup and my skin feels less oily than usual. Thanks to influenster for choosing me to try it out for free!

Overall if you have dry skin this product is for you but not for me I have dry SENSITIVE skin and this product will make you turn beet red all over your face would recommend if you don’t have sensitive skin but if you do you better RUN for the hills

review_text: It is expensive and it broke me out. I stopped using it after two weeks. I wasted my money.

review_text: I have very fair, dry/normal skin and I wanted something to give me a little glow while providing sun protection. This product did not deliver that for me. So I don’t see this being a viable option for those who are combo or oily. This is my personal experience with my skin tone and type. I’ve used and loved many of DE’s products but am starting to get over the hype and see the products for what they are... overpriced.

review_text: It’s been 2 days so far I purchased this face cream... I got it as a suggestion along with a cleanser and serum because I been breaking out. Now.. I love the fact it give a beautiful glow which is my biggest goal in skincare.. I have used other creams like the ordinary with HYA in it and I liked it but.. this right here was the win for me... it’s not greasy my skin actually feels baby soft which (I never experienced before on my face) not sticky or greasy/oily.. I have dry/combo skin... only downfall sofar is 24$ for 50ml.. the size of my hand but you pay for what you get so I mean in another sense it’s worth the 24.. just gotta purchase frequently if used 2x a day... I found it had lasted me all day without feeling gross or feeling the need to reapply.. (I use morning and night to start and end my day with my routine) ALSO It says it’s odorless but does have a little smell but could just be the ingredients.. not a strong smell but definitely not unscented.. PROS;-HYDRATING-GLOW IN SKIN (NOT SHINY WHERE IT LOOK OILY) -LASTS ALL DAY (as mentioned on bottle)-BABY SKIN TEXTURE-NOT GREASY, A LITTLE STICKY WHEN APPLIED AT FIRST BUT WHEN DRIES LEAVES A SMOOTH DEWY (DRY THO) BABY LIKE TEXTURE... -DOESNT AGGRIVATE ACNE.. GOOD FOR USE IF YOU BREAKING OUTCONS;- $24.00 CAD FOR 50ML (But u get worth the money just gotta repurchase often)- LIGHTLY SCENTED BUT NOTHING OVER POWERING (on bottle says unscented)-SLIGHTLY STICKY WHEN FIRST APPLIED (BUT then dries perfectly and lasts all day without going gross into oily texture.. when dries feels dewy like a baby foot) I only gave 4 stars bcz little cons and it’s day 2...Its worth it tho if you have combo skin Over all I like it In pics one with flash one without flash...
review_title: ITS WORTH THE 24.. and if u have acne

I didn’t initially blame the lip mask because we were having very dry cold weather so I kept using it thinking if anything it should help more! Worst mistake. My lips the next couple days began to crack so bad they eventually split completely and would bleed. This made my lips so raw and sensitive it was painful to eat. I know it was this because after about a week of not using it and slathering my lips in medicated lip balm my lips went back normal. BEWARE, don’t believe the hype.

It goes on smooth and calms my skin down. I love how it also stops any stinging my skin is having and soothes any discomfort.

I do see, however, instant results when I use this in the evening! The morning after, my pores are noticeably smaller, redness around the nose is reduced, and my skin feels more supple! I will definitely buy this again!!

review_text: I really don’t get the hype. I got a mini size of this in a Sephora favorites kit and it’s lasted me for over a month so far with about a week or so of use left. I have felt a significant difference even overnight from much more affordable moisturizers like the Tatcha dewy skin cream. Also, this smells exactly like Nivea cream, which is just ??? I would never spend any amount of money on this. Use a good retinol and a night cream with ceramides and peptides—it’ll do far more for your skin for FAR less money.

review_text: I have very dry skin and in the Texas summer it gets even worse. I have been using this product for 2 weeks and I have noticed a great difference.
