I would highly recommend this product.

review_text: Great for removing makeup and cleansing skin but left my skin dry which got worse with each use. Will be going back to my regular.

I got fed up and threw it away within a week. It had a weird sticky, tacky, gel-liquid texture that I was not happy about. After looking at the ingredients, I realized that it has glycerin (which doesn’t clog pores and is a humectant to add moisture, is good for sensitive and dry skin, but also gives products that tacky texture), several (too many in my opinion) different oils (sunflower oil, castor oil, & soybean oil), and silica (which is essentially silicone-it can get into your pores and clog them and cause break-outs).

You can do way better for this price point. It feels and looks nice at first but not that hydrating and doesn’t really do much for redness. Also, if your redness comes from irritated skin and you’re negatively affected by essential oils, stay away. This has lots. I don’t hate it but it’s not great. I love Drunk Elephant as a brand but this did break me out. I have fairly normal skin but for whatever reason, my face disagreed with this product. I will be gifting to a friend in hopes that it works for them, as I know this is a favorite of many.
I heard this was good for pores. I used it for about 2 weeks and I think it made my pores appear larger. I also think it clogged my skin because I noticed more breakouts. Stopped using.

Thank you again Lancome and bzzagent for sending me this product for a honest review back . i really love this it smells good leave my skin feeling soft and smooth and i can see a big difference in my skin especially my dark spots and the bottle is so beautiful and easy to use
product_name: Clarifique Exfoliating & Hydrating Face Essence with Glycolic Acid

review_text: Makes skin feel tight and dry after use. Not for sensitive skin.
product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

review_text: This product is beautiful. It applies smoothly and leaves a glow, hydrates the skin before moisturizer, and has not broken me out or irritated my skin at all. I have not noticed any major brightening effects after using the product for two weeks, but I do enjoy the process of using it. I have no complaints about the product itself at all. This product is currently out of my budget, though, at $68/oz. However, if you have expendable income and are looking specifically for a luxury vitamin C serum, I do recommend this product.
product_name: 15% Vitamin C + Clean Caffeine Energy Serum

review_text: I love this sunscreen! Mineral sunscreen is my favorite because it doesn’t irritate my skin. I like that it has a dropper applicator and that it has a slight tint so that it won’t leave your skin white!
product_name: Daily Dose Bioretinol + Mineral SPF 40 with Bakuchiol

review_text: Makes my skin look and feel extremely greasy. Not what I expected at all :(
product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: This actually dried out my skin vs hydrated it. Although, I liked the gel-like formula, I don’t think this is made for an oily skinned person.
I was afraid of the ’retinol’ in it because I have heard bad things but this product is amazing. My skin is much smoother and skin is not so dull. I would recommend this for sure.

The way this worked in literally three days, normally I’d find a cleansers and it’d take a few weeks for my skin to get used to it, but with this cleanser, my skin automatically adjusted and this godsend did its job, it’s not over stripping, has a tolerable scent almost like pressed juice, but overall a really good cleanser, cant recommend this enough!!

I received a complementary sample of this product in exchange for my honest review. This cream is excellent and I plan on purchasing a full size jar. I applied it to clean, damp skin morning and night. My skin was immediately supple and hydrated. It was moisturizing, which I love, because I have normal to dry skin and usually prefer products for dry skin. While this gave me the moisture I was looking for, it was not greasy. I applied the product at night when I first received this sample and in the morning the skin around my eyes looked plumper and tighter. My fine lines were less noticeable. My skin was smooth and my Double Wear foundation wore well over the top. I definitely recommend
product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: I used this serum for a whole month and I really liked it! The texture is like a light weight gel but more liquidy. I loved how it spread so easily on my face, and that it dried pretty quickly. I had a specific acne scar on my cheek that was pretty recent I got it around the same time that I got the serum. I started using the serum and slowly but surely that acne scars started fading away! I will continue to use this because I loved the results!￼￼ I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum

review_text: The serum has a nice light consistency and a slight citrusy smell. I like using this at night as the Vitamin C will make you more sensitive to the sun. Don’t forget to put sunscreen! There is a tiny bit of a tacky feel after but you definitely can see the radiance and brightness right away when using this product.

I have extremely sensitive skin, but my skin loves this product!! This brand is so clean and it really calms my breakouts and their irritation within a few hours. Really great for extremely dry skin and don’t need too much so worth the investment!
review_title: Great for acne prone, dry skin
product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: The moisturizer is very gritty and feels like I’m spreading sand all over my face. The smell is also very intense and lingers all day.
product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F

review_text: Was looking for a lightweight, glowy moisturizer but didn’t really get that result. Didn’t absorb at all on my skin!

I had a mini of this and decided to give it a go. This cleanser is soft, gentle and minimally lathers. It does remove makeup well. Some of the times I’ve used this my skin felt just a bit tight/dry afterwards. It’s not bad, but not my favorite either. For reference I have dry sensitive skin.

I received this product 3 days ago and I don’t know how I’ve went so long without this eye cream. The very first thing I noticed when I opened the box was the absolutely STUNNING packaging! The actual cream does not disappoint. It melts completely into the delicate skin under the eyes smooth, silky and hydrated, but not the least bit sticky. The scent is fresh and not overbearing. I’m excited to use this long term and see the anti-aging benefits! I received this product as a complimentary sample for reviewing purposes.
product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream

review_text: I don’t understand what all the fuss is over these bars. They both dry out my skin and the exfoliating bar doesn’t do it’s job. If I use either for too long I break out. Also, for $22 you get 2 tiny bars. like 2inch x 2inch. Way over priced for such a basic and stripping product.I’m giving 2 stars instead of 1 because I am able to use them. I have to alternate between one of the bars and a different face wash to not break out, but they aren’t as bad as other products. *cough* glamglow *cough*
product_name: Baby Bar Travel Duo with Case

review_text: This product is amazing! It’s so light and smells amazing! It doesn’t have an oily texture! I noticed a huge difference after using this product! I looked more radiant.
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I love the creamy texture of this eye cream. It felt extremely hydrating but not too heavy. I am really excited I found this product. It feels very luxurious - and I am looking for that vibe for my skincare! Looking forward to seeing how it hydrates over time!
a little goes a long way! I feel like there are less wrinkles and crows feet and my eyes are not as dark anymore. Will definitely keep using

I love how this product smells and how smooth it is. I used this product to seal my nightly skin care routine and i had a smooth and very hydrated skin in the morning. I love how it didn’t make me oily, but it made my skin feel refreshed
This oil is hydrating and gives an amazing glow to the skin. It’s doesnt feel greasy and smells amazing. Definitely I gem from the brand that was unexpected.

I love this product. I lusted after it for quite awhile because I was unsure as to if I wanted to spend that much money on acne spray. But....the murad reputation helped push me along into at least trying it. I have been spraying this on my back and shoulders for awhile and I have noticed a decrease in break outs! I will continue to use this product, and I will probably re-purchase again.

I wish I could give this abomination negative stars. It’s absolute trash, and that’s where mine is sitting right now, is in the trash. The smell is like grandma’s sock drawer and your drunk uncle’s medicine cabinet had a demon spawn that took the form of a mediocre overpriced face cream. I literally couldn’t fully apply this because the smell is so terrible. Not to mention two out of three of the top ingredients are mineral oil and petrolatum, common ingredients you can find in the drugstore for a fraction of the price. I’m actually surprised that fragrance isn’t the first ingredient in this unholy atrocity. Just splash your face with the cheap knockoff perfumes you can buy at the gas station to get the luxury experience of Creme de la Mer.
I have eczema and when I start to get a flare up, I just rub this cream on and immediately the eczema flare up stops. I love this cream and will always have it in my life!

Product arrived rancid, so can’t give a review of it in it’s proper state. Unfortunately, it sounds like that has happened to quite a few other people.I have purchased/used other brand versions of rose hip seed oil and understand it has an earthy smell (which I don’t mind). This is not that, it is distinctly rancid. I suspect this product has a very short shelf life and has not been kept in ideal conditions. I would suggest checking out other brands.
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: I love this cleanser! It washed my face and left it clean without stripping my skin! This is a rare find when dealing with most oily skin and acne products. I can’t use all three skincare pieces on my skin at the same time though, it’s a tad too drying for my skin. But between the cleanser, toner and moisturizer - this one is by far my favorite. I love how it feels slightly tingly but not tight.I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest and unbiased review, but all opinions are my own.
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: This is a great sunscreen. I have bad acne and it didn’t break me out which is great, but I hate that it is so watery and loose. However, it rubs in nicely all over the body and the face and doesn’t make you shiny at all or even throughout the day. The price is decent but it doesn’t last long at all so maybe it isn’t so good. The serum is better but very pricey. Best of all it fires clear.
product_name: Mini PLAY Everyday Lotion SPF 50 with Sunflower Extract

review_text: Within 48 hours, I had breakouts on my nose, chin, and forehead. I rarely get breakouts and I’ve never seen so many on my face. I love the Rose moisturizer by Fresh, so I was super disappointed when this reaction happened. The product smells and feels great, but definitely not for me.
Dr. Zenovia skincare aloe vera blemish soothing moisturizer is great! Feels wonderful on my skin

I love the texture of this cleanser. I have been loving all of the FAB products. I use the cream, night cream and glycol pads... for some reason this cleanser broke my skin out. As soon as I went back to my cleansing oil, my skin returned to normal. Did do a great job of removing all makeup, there is just something in it that didn’t work for my skin.
Terrible. Blotchy and not at all even. I let it dry for half an hour before bed but still woke up with sheets covered in stains. Heading straight to the garbage.
product_name: Self Tan Purity Bronzing Water Face Mist

review_text: Horrible product ! Greasy ! Heavy ! Smells like a cheap mustard oil from! Don’t waste ur money ! Absorbs well . But not worth the price !
Best toner :) Love using this day and night! My skin has never absorbed a toner better. This plumps skin and hydrates like no other.

This is a great mask for those looking to keep up their regime and clear skin. It’s great for those with occasional pimples and blackheads, but I wouldn’t recommend it for cystic acne because it can make you break out to the point it’s not worth it. This mask naturally draws everything to the surface so it can make very very oily people break out bad. But it’s good for clearing skin for normal type people.
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I really love this stuff I don’t understand the bad reviews. It’s really moisturizing and removes makeup easily if you use it correctly. Love it for my acne prone skin.

I have tried most products from this line and the all have a way too much fragrance for me so if you are a person that hates fragrance in skin care like it do this is NOT the product for you. I will finish what I got but will not purchase again
product_name: Mini The Cult Classic Purifying Face Cleanser

review_text: I love this product because my skin is a little sensitive and acne prone, which it doesn’t irritate or cause more breakouts. It goes on super nourishing and takes off all my makeup, even hard to get off mascara. I feel my skin is softer and moisturizer after using in the shower. I highly recommend this product. I did receive it complimentary, but that doesn’t sway my review whatsoever

My old face wash was discontinued and I needed to find a new one. I ordered about 5 little trial size kits from Sephora that were recommended by others with my skin type (combo, acne prone and SUPER sensitive) I was crushed when all of them proved to either dry me out in the Midwest winter weather and/or make my cystic acne flare up. I ordered this face wash out of desperation (and the full size at that) and I am SO glad I did. This is working better than stuff I use to love for years. My skin is soft, balanced and it is not only Not causing more break outs but is quickly healing the ones I had from the other products I was trying before receiving this. I honestly didn’t start using the IT confidence in a cleanser with very high hopes after being disappointed by all the other high end skin care I had tried recently but this face wash is now my holy grail and the best purchase I have ever made at Sephora!
product_name: Confidence in a Cleanser Hydrating Facial Cleanser Serum

review_text: I got a sample of this with my order. I used it twice and it broke me out badly. I don’t think I had experienced a break out like this in at least 10 years. Would NOT purchase.

I know I have dry skin and need more hydration in the fall and winter months, but this didn’t do much of anything for me. I used this alongside the blueberry cleanser, pineapple serum, and the watermelon mask (which I liked a lot more). It’s a soft pink and comes out on the watery side (but not too watery, which I liked) and feels fine on skin. While it does go over the pineapple serum nicely, my face felt pretty dry not even two hours later. It does smell amazing, and the texture is nice, but that’s about it.That said, it might work better if you have overly oily skin and need a very, very light moisturizer. I think I’ll save it to try it out for the summer months.
Sucked! I bought it because it had a ton of celebs backing it. They must have gotten paid a ton of money to say it was good..it’s not LOL
These dew drops are like bursts of hydration for the skin! Very nice! My only dislike is it left a semi sticky texture behind. Great glass skin look though.
I will purchase this again. It is easy to use and isn’t too harsh.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Bought this because it is part of the clean line but hat ever is in it made my face so dry to the point where it felt as if it was cracking. I already have sensitive skin and this was suggested to me. I really did wish it would have worked out as I liked the consistency and the smell

This stuff is powerful and it works so well. I used Sunday Riley A+ high dose retinol for a year with no improvement, no skin peeling, no purge, no improvement in wrinkles, no nothing! Then I received a free sample of this and I could tell immediately that it was actually doing something. My skin tingled upon application which told me it was actually doing something, where as With Sunday I never felt anything for a year. I immediately bought the full size and I’m pleased to say that I can use this every night without the uglies setting in, or retinol burns. DE retinol caused burns and excessive peeling that I could not get past without burning my face off. This is definitely the one for sensitive skin that needs results!
review_title: I’ll never buy Sunday Riley again!
product_name: Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide

review_text: I have normal to dry skin most of the time. I use this in the summer on hot, humid days when I want only light moisturizing that absorbs quickly and fully leaving my face matte. I need a lot more moisture in the winter. It is great under makeup and mixes well with other products, primers, etc. And the smell..Oh! It’s like an orange popsicle scent that dissipates quickly once it is absorbed.
Luxe packaging and lightweight texture but it smells like men’s aftershave. My skin was red and hot for a while after each use. Glad I tried the mini first.

I’m a little surprised to see so many five star reviews for this! I have normal, often dry skin and this makes my face feel and look incredibly oily. I’ve been using it off and on for about 6 months, but in the past couple of weeks have been using it every night just to use it up. Definitely would not recommend for under makeup, I haven’t tried it with makeup due to its oiliness but can imagine it would make my face extremely shiny throughout the day. After applying this at night, I wake up looking oily, as if it has not absorbed and I am always happy to wash it off first thing in the morning. While there are products out there that are worse, there are many that are far better. I am glad that I did not break out from this, like many other reviews have said. Would not repurchase though and do not recommend.
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: I really wanted to like this, but it SERIOUSLY BROKE ME OUT. I’ve heard so many good things about this, but i truly think you might be better off using a retinol and skipping this. Retinol will work faster and it is very well study
review_title: Get the paula’s choice retinol instead
product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: I know lightening spots takes time, and I thought using a more expensive product would yield better results... but they didn’t work for me. This package is just 12 dots. And, the box says something like “2x/wk for 2wks should show results“. Maybe these work for folks with fresh acne scars, but they didn’t work for my old acne scars OR relatively new sun spots. Also, unlike some dots, these are not invisible, so plan to wear them at night if you do buy them.

I absolutely love this product and would definitely recommend and buy it. it has done wonders to my skin. It has made it silky soft as well as helps with blemishes and even out the redness. It is gentle enough to use everyday. I was so happy to have this product gifted by Dermalogica Sampling.

I got this as a sample and I was glad because I’d been wanting to try it because of the reviews. Glad I got the sample and didn’t purchase this because I only used it once and it made me breakout, and it took a week for my skin to clear up. It felt sticky like it never completely dried, I hate that sticky feeling and moisturizers that leave a residue.

I LOVE Green Clean!! As someone who is into very natural skin care I finally found a product I will continue to buy over and over again. It does a great job of not only melting away my makeup but leaving me feeling softer skin after washing my face. I apply this on dry then slowly add water, I follow up with my normal face wash and my skin feels great!! It does a great job of taking off even my water proof makeup and I love how it is all natural. I will continue to buy again and again.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: I noticed some difference right away on the big creases between my eyes. Time will tell if I see a long-term change but I’m happy with it so far. I’ll be interested in seeing how long a bottle lasts. I use a small amount but the bottle sure feels light, like there isn’t much in there...again, time will tell.
product_name: Needles No More Wrinkle Smoothing Cream

review_text: Hate the new formula. I’ve used this for several years but will not purchase again.
Every night I wear this, I wake up next morning and my skin broke out. I like the texture, I like how it feels when I apply it, but I am not happy about what happens next.
Great facial wipes! My face feels fresh and hydrated after use; however, the exfoliation is missing altogether for me!
This has become my holy grail mask. I use it as a night moisturizer. It gives me a rejuvenating look in the morning. The packaging is great and easy to take it anywhere. The ingredients are amazing.

Why, why, why would you change the formula?!!! I have been using this for year. It was truly amazing. Constantly getting compliments on my skin. I am 40 years old and it was perfect. I opened my new bottle and thought I got a bad one. It was rancid. Ordered a second bottle and the same. I am so upset. Why would they change it.
review_title: New formula is awful very sad

review_text: I have moderately oily skin, and I’ve heard so many great things about this product, but once using it for about a week, I’m very disappointed. It’s very stripping and makes my skin feel extremely tight and dry even after I apply serum and moisturizer. Although it smells nice and lathers up nicely, I’m sad that it didn’t work for my skin.

This product was amazing - it made my skin feel so fresh and clean. I love it because it is mildly scented and very gentle on my skin. My complexion appears brighter and healthier. I would highly recommend this product! I received this product for free for testing purposes.
review_title: A great addition to my skincare routine
product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA

review_text: This product claims to peel the top layer of your skin for a deep exfoliating experience but it dose not. The actual clumps and balls it greats are not your skin just the product it’s self. Did not notice any change in my skin. A big waste of money. St Ives apricot scrubs yields better results. SAVE YOUR MONEY!!!!!

These eye patches offer such a big amount of hydration to the eye area. They helped fix my dry under eyes in only two uses. They are pricey, but compared to the may others, it’s a very affordable price! They give you a cooling effect which is great in rough mornings.
product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

review_text: The worst scrub ever! Compared to other brands it is really messy. Even under the shower I have to use a facial wipe to get rid of the residue. It stains towels, etc. The smell is not great either. There are other scrubs out there that are not smelly or messy and do the job. Would never purchase again.
review_title: Not a lot to love about it!

review_text: The crazy winter prompted me to get this and I definitely needed it: I have very dry skin with some classic T-zone acne patches. This is a new product so the purchase was definitely a gamble, but having received it few days ago and using it since then, I’ve given it 3 stars for these reasons...PROS:My complexion’s redness has subdued significantly for me to see a difference. Even my sisters noticed the difference, which I think owes to the milk’s more alkaline and calming ingredients; and it hydrates! It goes on pretty well, not too watery and not too thick like some other products. Overall, I really like how it calmed my redness. The product also comes with two samples of the Argan face oil and light oil, which didn’t make me break out (surprisingly).CONS:The stuff is a bit difficult to get out of the bottle. It’s a dropper applicator, and because the consistency is more on the gooey/thick side, I had problems getting enough product onto my hands (the opening is also easy to get messy). Also, for those more particular with smell, this product does have hints of a milky smell. It isn’t overpowering and could possibly go unnoticed by others, but for me there was a hint of something that surprised me in an unpleasant way.Of course only time will tell, so I’ll see how it goes from here on out! It worked for my redness and thirsty skin, so my main complaint is really the architecture of the bottle and the ease of application. I probably will only use/buy this product for winter seasons.
product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment

review_text: I’ve used this while i was out of my b c & e moisturizer (love her) and I’m definitely not in love with it. It’s pretty tacky when it’s soaking in which has made it a great primer, but not for before bed. This also is probably not great for people like me with sensory issues, seeing as anything that touches it will also become sticky and tacky. It does what it’s supposed to, moisturize, but also it made me break out? So I’m again not totally sure on it. Could just not be right for my skin personally 🤷‍♀️
This shouldn’t be in a squeeze tube. Nothing comes out!

I’m definitely a shiseido fan, but their products is such a high quality, everything that I tried is nothing less than amazing, and it wouldn’t be different with this one. The texture is very fluid, it’s so easy to apply and blend so well that you only need one pump to do your whole face and neck. After use it my skin really feels like satin, it’s so soft. Smells good to me, it’s not a strong scent, what I like for skincare product.It’s one of the best serum’s I’ve ever tried, there’s a “dry touch”, it’s not oily like most of the serums, then is very comfortable to use. Just FYI my forehead and nose used to be oily while the rest of my face is dry, I don’t have problems with pimples or a sensitive skin, and I feel like the serum is great on my dry and oily skin.

Bought this jar about 6 months ago. Use once~twice a week. Result: bad breakouts occasionally, due to the thick texture that does not get absorbed. It doesn’t really help with anything, no hydrating effects even...

I love Josie Maran Argan oil, I’ve been using the milk for awhile, but my last purchase I noticed the formula wasn’t the same, it was runny and it looked yellowish, not a creamy milky white. So disappointed,
product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment

review_text: I got this as a sample, tried it out, & loved it! I went back & bought the full size. For reference, I’m approaching 30. I do not have too many wrinkles but a few bothersome areas. I like to put this around my eyes & on my lips. This stuff does wonders! The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because the effects seem to only be temporary (I’ve been using for about 3 weeks now).

I’ve been using this on and off for the last two years and every time I go back to it, I fall in love all over again. I absolutely love the cucumber smell, although it is quite strong. I have very prone red skin and this is the only cleanser that doesn’t make it redder when I get out of the shower. Although, I’d be purchasing it more frequently if the price wasn’t as high as it is.
review_title: Perfect for sensitive and rosacea skin

review_text: I got this complimentary in my Voxbox but I really like it a lot! It takes of my makeup so well, I use it everyday! The only thing I don’t like about it is that since it uses natural waxes you have you really rinse it off a lot to get the film off, but comes off with a towel. I also gave it 4 stars because I don’t feel like I like I could use it alone, only double cleanse. But that said, it’s a great makeup remover and smells great! Love that it comes with the little spoon to scoop it out, too.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: This will look great IF AND ONLY IF your skin is already smooth and blemish free. This works and I would love to be able to use this daily to cover up the redness on my cheeks however this will grab onto any imperfection whether it’s dryness, bumps, or lines. I was able to make it work with lots of blending but found that I stopped reaching for this after a 2-3 weeks. Unfortunately my skin just doesn’t agree with this product so I stopped using it.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: This stuff is so good. I got the little bottle on a impulse and had to go back for a big one. It’s pricey for me, but it does last a while. I use it every other day, or when I feel I need a bit of a deeper clean. It exfoliated a bit, but quickly turns to a paste. Skin feels soft afterwards, but not stripped which I find with harsh scrubs. I’ve tried the original, but went back for the deep clean. I didn’t notice a huge difference between the two, other than the colour. Would recommend! I have combo skin.
product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

review_text: I have very sensitive skin and have used drugstore brands for years because almost everything makes me break out. I was nervous to make the leap, but it was so worth it. I saw a positive difference almost immediately. Coupled with the Kiehl’s Ultra Facial Cream afterwards, it’s a perfect morning and night routine. Highly recommend -- a little goes a long way.

I have tried a so many moisturizers and this one is amazing and my favorite. It goes on feeling wet but sinks very fast and does not feel sticky at all like the watermelon moisturizer. Additionally, it gives the skin this velvety feel to it.
product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

review_text: I had really high expectations for this product because of the price and reviews and it was a total fail for me. The texture is not friendly. I had a very hard time applying it to my face. It takes a quite a while to become translucent. I tried the pat in method which didn’t feel like any product was getting on my face and then I tried rubbing it in even though the instructions tell you not to and that didn’t work because of the texture. It’s really difficult to use. It will eventually after some time become spreadable but it’s not worth the time. It leaves a nice sheen when it does spread. If they could fix the timing portion i would totally be all about it because the sheen/glow is really nice. The scent is okay. It’s not great but also not off putting. I will not purchase this product in the current form. I received the product complimentary from La Mer for my honest review.
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: This is a product that can easily get washed out and overlooked in your routine. I didn’t really appreciate how calming and hydrating this was to my skin until I decided to experiment and try other products. Bad idea. I’m right back to it 3 toners later. The fact that you don’t have to waste any product by using a cotton pad or splashing it on your face is great for the environment so I highly recommend this toner.
product_name: Jasmine Green Tea Oil Control Toner

review_text: I have combination skin that over-produces oil when it’s dried out, and that’s what this product did. At first my pores became smaller and I could tell my skin was going to peel, but I thought maybe I was just getting used to it. Not so much! It’s been a couple of weeks since I’ve used it and I’m still trying to clear up my forehead. Sad story, but it’s working quite well as a body wash!
review_title: If your skin is ever sensitive, don't use this. :)

review_text: Good toner but strong scent. If you like tea tree you may like this
This is not for dry skin. 24 hours moisturizing? It doesn’t last even 1 hour I start feeling so dry. And you can’t put makeup on over this cream. It’s flaky.

The product is not as thick as the sleeping mask and it’s a little more like a gel than a cream texture but but has the same beautiful glossy effect the sleeping mask has and smells just as good. Plus I love the easy tube applicator. Totally recommend if you are a fan of the sleeping mask. Also the color is extremely faint only gives the tinniest hint of pink so it’s perfect for those no makeup days.
review_title: Great daytime alternative to the sleeping mask

review_text: I got this because I came across a Tik Tok video about someone using this to achieve the sought for glass skin. I decided to try it out after looking at reviews and the comments but even after being a quarter of the way into the bottle, it hasn’t made much of a difference on my face. It does leave a film of shine and has a nice watermelon candy scent to it but that’s about it. Nothing was different with my pores etc. I’d say that this is a great product for if you want to get a nice sheen on your face or are going for that dewy look but skincare wise, I fared better with other products.
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: Smells nice, feels good when I apply it and lips look plump but when I wake up, my lips are even drier and feel rough. I would not recommend. Other than for the lovely scent, I prefer my Eucerin Healing Ointment.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Meh. J Lo said it would take 10 years off. Didn’t see any differences but did leave me with a cheek pimple. Probably not worth $18 for one mediocre mask.

i seriously am in love with rosebud salve. i drag it with me everywhere because i put it on every two hours or so! it relieves my dry lips without being too shiny, and i wear it in school all the time! it doesn’t have much color, only a light tint of pink, so i can use it whenever i want.

Eye patches are a bit tricky to put on / stay on your face. They did not do as much as I thought they would for my eyes - believe they are overpriced as I did not see a lot of impact. If you do give these a shot, I recommend storing them in the fridge.
product_name: 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

review_text: This product didn’t helped me at all ... I was already using the oil-free moisturizer and work really great so I wanted to had this to my routine but made me break-out soooo much .. I was really anticipating this product to make wonders with my oily skin under makeup but didn’t work at all and made my problem even worst then before .
This mask is great. The texture and the smell are so nice that sometimes I use it nightly. My skin feels moisturized and refreshed in the morning.
This just made me greasy and have a cystic breakout.
Did not see a difference in my skin. I started to break out after using it and my skin got better when i stopped so not worth $100 in my books.
Love the consistency and was super excited. Been using a couple days and already broke out. I’m in my 40s and never break out. And this is the only new product I’ve used. Definitely returning.

I am of medium/dark brown skin tone (Hispanic) I first purchased this in the summer when I was quite dark and even without a mixer did not do much except leave my skin nice and shiny. I held onto it knowing in the fall my skin would lose its tan. I was glad I did. As my tan faded I started mixing it with my moisturizer and it made my skin back to a summer tan. Now that I’m in winter( I live in New England) I do not mix it with moisturizer and it still gives me a natural tan look. It feels great on my skin and I don’t need bronzer or self tanners because of this product. I highly recommend.
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: I found this in the perfect time ... one of my favorite salicylic acid products was discontinued and I was in need of a new one. Although, I’m thinking this might be ever better! It also has glycolic acid and a retinoid, which is great for my skin post acne. I have a lot of redness and scarring left over that I’ve been trying to get rid of. However, most retinoid products are too harsh for me and make me break out. This one is just enough and mixed with the AHA and BHA to perfectly help my skin. Take this from a gal with sensitive and acne prone skin. However, it’s important to note (which it’s on the packaging) to WEAR SUNSCREEN when using a retinoid product or you can really hurt your skin. Keep that in mind! I would also recommend using it once a week to see how your skin reacts and then adjust from there. That’s what I always have done with a retinoid product. :)

I love this face mask! I usually don’t like to spend lots of money on face masks, as I never got results that I felt warranted shelling out more than $10. This face mask is amazing. A tiny amount goes a long way, leaving my skin smooth and even. I have very sensitive skin prone to irritation, so when I get a weird itchy breakout, I apply this mask. After a few days of using this mask for about 15 minutes at a time, my skin is soothed and completely back to normal. Without the mask, it can take more like a week to get my skin to chil. Totally worth the money!!
This product immediately works at reducing puffiness and darkness but can cause dryness under the eye. It’s important to use eye cream to avoid overdrying the eye area which would be really bad.

I wanted to like this moisturizer but it didn’t work for my skin.. it’s not hydrating and I’m not happy with the ingredients. it has a lot of fillers in it such as dimethicone that’s why it’s not hydrating to the skin. it also did not wear well under makeup and it causes acne. I know of some 12-30 dollar moisturizers that perform better than this.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Great product, it keeps my hands moisturized and it doesn’t have too strong of a smell. I like a neutral smelling hydrating moisturizer
Made me break out and itch all over, red face. Maybe not for 10 minutes but perhaps just 5 minutes. Weird smell and the texture is plain. Nothing special to me. Disappointed
I do not see a difference since I bought it.I do not recommend this product

The feel of this is amazing. It feels so light and so smooth. I bought this before the summer season and during humid (and therefore, more oily) days it does take a very long time to soak in, like some other reviews have mentioned. Now that the air (and my skin) is getting more dry I find that I like it way more.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: O V E R rated! It dries my lips! I cannot tell a difference in any fullness, just dryness. This 50+ yo was trying to avoid the needle. This isn’t the product of that.

I think this would be a great product for some, it just didn’t hit the mark for me. The makeup removing balm was nice and took away my makeup well, the issue for me was the strong smell. Any type of strong fragrance irritates my skin and it was especially strong in all of these products. If you don’t mind fragrance I think this balm is really nice. The same for the Peel and Lotion. The lotion is also very thick though. I definitely would not use it during the day but perhaps at a nightly mask once a week if you had very dry skin!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: Goop Beauty gifted me a box of the Glow Peel to test in exchange for an honest product review. The pre-moistened pad was large and contained a good amount of product and had a fresh scent. The product claims to smooth, soften and provide a luminous glow to the skin, which I would definitely agree with. The next morning, I noticed my skin looked bright, smooth, hydrated, pores minimized, and acne scars looked lighter. Overall, I do like this product because I saw immediate (overnight) results as indicated by the product claims and would continue to use it as a weekly treatment to enhance my exfoliation regimen. I like the sleek, minimalistic packaging as well. This product receives the Boog’s Beauty Room Seal of Approval!
product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: First of all, I received this product as a free sample. While I love the brand, this was not it. This cleanser does not foam at all, smells terrible, and made me breakout. These were no small pimples either, these were the painful, large ones all over my face. I had really high hopes, truly. But I can not recommend this at all.

Glad a I bought a small mini size before committing a purchase of the full size. This product just sits on top of your skin. Your skin never absorbs it. It also stains your pillowcase…so what’s the point?
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: Recieved this as a birthday present along with the age prevention cream they make and it has visibly changed the appearence of the lil wrinkles I have started to develop going into my 30’s! I love this product it has also helped my acne prone combination skin be more even in its complexion and less moody and prone to breakouts! My husband also loves it.

I went in to the store looking for a gentle cleanser that still did what it said it would do! I must say that I don’t like trying new products on my face especially because it is so sensitive but the store representative told me I would love it and in just a week I could see the difference in my face. It’s gentle and helps my skin look smooth and full of life!!!
review_title: Just what I was looking for!!!

review_text: I have been using this for at least two weeks or more and I am in love with this product. My skin looks and feels amazing. I will 100% purchase this again or the bigger sizes
product_name: Fenty Skin Travel Size Start'r Set

review_text: My skin generally does not get along with hyaluronic acid and so when I got this product free for reviewing purposes I was a bit worried. Sadly this was no exception. My skin can be relatively sensitive so when I spot tested it a few times I got a burning sensation that I generally associate with dehydration or intense chemical exfoliation. All in all, not a product for me or my skin.
I’ve suffered with acne my entire life and tried everything. Added this to my routine and saw results with a week use. I’m very happy and hope that my face clears up completely with continued use.

Love this moisturizer so much! I have normal/ dry skin and I use this moisturizer mixed with my other DE products. However, I often use it by itself also. It works really good for me. I have been searching for a moisturizer that works for over 6 months, and I have tried at least 40 different products from like 30 different brands, and non of them I liked this much. I tried some that were double the price of this one and were a horrible moisturizer. I also tried the drugstore type ones. Those actually worked better than any of the high end expensive moisturizers. All in all, I ended up liking this moisturizer the best. I’m not saying that it’s cheap but I think it’s well worth the price.
product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides

review_text: I used this product for 7 months straight , every single night . I did not see any difference at all on my melasma. I took before and after pictures and there are no changes. Do not recommend. Waste of money!
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: I ran out of this for like a week and I was suffering. I have rosacea so I am super sensitive to a lot of things that I put on my skin and this is something that 100% helps the sensitivity. After I cleanse it’s what brings my skin back to normal and it just feels amazing and I swear immediately makes my skin look so soft. I will always repurchase this
review_title: I can't live without this product

review_text: Grapefruit & Ginger smells amazing! My lips get extremely chapped so I ask a lot from this little guy. Generally works very good, not strong enough for the bitter cold winter months though. I prefer this to the Rosebud Salve based on scent (I hate rose).

I decided to give this product a try since the other toners were either too drying or irritated my skin. This one is absolutely perfect in comparison to all the others! I have acne prone skin with a lot of redness.I think this works grade morning & night after showering.It leaves my skin feeling clean and cooled down (which feels great). I then apply the Clinique smart serum and moisture surge gel and it all works so great together.I notice smaller pores and fewer break outs. I really like how it removes excess makeup that my cleansers and removers couldn’t reach.It does not irritate my skin.A great staple in my skin care regimen.I won’t switch to any other toner!
Does not make any difference. Wouldn’t recommend this product at all as I didn’t notice any results.
product_name: THE GRADUAL Illuminating Gradual Tan Lotion

review_text: I have not broken out since starting the product, but have a few concerns about it drying out my skin. My previous Murad cleanser mentioned it could be used on the eyes, but this one should Not! I made the mistake and have been recovering from dry itchy eyes. The rest of the face is great, though! Very refreshing.

This product smells EXACTLY like The Nivea Creme I use to moisturize my knee caps and elbows. I tried the sample size of this product and was really expecting something different. The formula has the same smell and thick texture as Nivea creme ($5), so I’m confused by the price point of this product. Does anyone know if the ingredients are similar? I’m a little hesitant to continue to rub an expensive Nivea Creme dupe on my face skin... I applied a little La Mer to my very dry face skin this morning. It certainly moisturizes but the smell is cheap and lingers around the nostrils. I’m hoping this won’t break me out given the thick formula.

This is such a cool product! When you use it all over you face, it makes you skin look glassy and bright but if you just focus it on the high points of your face, it gives you a “I drink 8 glasses of water a day” natural glow. I have oily skin and it never broke me out when I wore it on its own, plus it didn’t make my makeup slide around when I put foundation + concealer on top! It feels tacky when first you apply it but it dries down matte! I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for an honest review but I would 1000% repurchase this myself
I’m so in love with this product! It makes my skin so hydrated and dewy. It does exactly what it says! Love it so much.
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: After reading all the wonderful reviews for this product, I was eager to try it. However I have not noticed any of the claimed results. My pores are unchanged, I’m still experiencing blackheads and other breakouts. I’ve given this product a fair chance since using in for a month and a half. I wanted to love it, but I don’t see a difference in my skin. In fact, it may have worsened.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: I really wanted to love this but it made my face so greasy and slimy. I think I might try the serum instead.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: When applying it the smell was terrible, it was burning bad and felt gritty on my skin. I decided to wash it off after 5 minutes because the burn wasn’t getting easier. I woke up this morning with burns around my eyes.
Thick, gooey, strong odor. For me, nothing like how it is described.
product_name: Liquid Sun Shield Daily Brightening Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50

review_text: Not a Sunday Riley employee LOL. This stuff works very well. I have age related (in my 40s) hormonal pimples on my forehead & use this at night when they start to break out. The next morning I swear they are gone. It’s not fixing the inherent problem but for now is saving me a trip to the dermatologist.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: Dark is not the right word... The application is pretty foolproof and the colour is really solid, no streaks... but to call it “dark“ would be a lie. I am as pale as winter snow, and I have applied 3 coats of this and still don’t believe I’ve achieved a “dark“ tan... I would be extremely hesitant to buy “light“ or “medium“, as one coat of “dark“ hardly gave me a glow... pretty disappointed.

This is a repurchase. I absolutely loved the first bottle, the scent was stronger and the formula had a thicker consistency. The second bottle I received feels diluted. This item has become increasingly popular so it wouldn’t surprise me if the company had cut corners. So disappointing. I’ll have find a replacement.

This eye cream definitely felt good under my eyes. It almost had a cooling, calming effect, which was very nice. However, I didn’t really notice any noticeable changes with my under-eyes. My skin may have looked a little “brighter,“ but that honestly could have been because I was using a new product and I wanted to see changes. This cream is very hydrating though and feels very nice, so I may purchase again.
product_name: Bye Bye Under Eye Brightening Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: This product is fine. I’ve used it a number of times on my nose for my stubborn black heads. It didn’t diminish them much as far as I can see. However, it does pull oils out as evidenced by the change in color on the product after leaving it on for ~6-8 hours.

I’ve tried many a moisturizer, I love something that plumps, for years I used the tatcha dewy skin cream, but once I tried this it kicked tatcha right out of first place. I’d say it’s right in the middle of a thick and liquids moisturizer, so it’s light way but still packs power. I love how it absorbs into my skin quick and don’t leave a weird layer on top of my skin that never seems to settle until is wipes off my pillow while I sleep lol simple no fragrance (I believe?) light clean scent. I recommend this to all my friends :)

I was so excited for this because I hate wearing foundation but it has such a weird texture when it settles on your face and almost feels worse than foundation. It’s also super hard to put on, it sort of feels like rubbing chalk on your face. The color it changes to after application is also horrendous if you are super pale or have cooler toned skin. I had to take it off almost as soon as I put it on and it came off on my cotton pads yellow.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I want to start by saying I love the packaging, the product comes out easily but not too quickly or out of control. I am always hesitant to put a product that smells that good on my face. But I was pleasantly surprised how much I like it. The price point is not something I like, a bit expensive, but you do only need a couple drops so the bottle tends to last... just depends on you I guess. I enjoyed using the anti aging aspect as a bonus, but I noticed my skin felt like it had an extra glow to it. Although I did notice an increase in acne while using this Over the last few weeks unfortunately! I used the product only in the morning because of the increase, and another product I use in the evening on my skin cannot have anything else on. Overall I would recommend it, at the price point I’d pass on purchasing again.
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Fortifying Lotion Toner

review_text: Its okay i guess. I like that it leaves my face feeling kinda soft. I hate that this is very hard to wash off and leaves a residue even after washing with a cleanser. I probably won’t repurchase.

I bought this for the spot between my eyebrows where my eleven lines are showing up and it works well for this issue. The microneedle portion of the patch doesn’t hurt or irritate my sensitive skin. The patches have stayed on all night long with no problem and at times I wear them into the morning. I’m on my fourth patch and have already seen some shallowing of the deeper wrinkles. I look forward to seeing how these diminish my aged look over time.

Love the packaging. I put it on the back of my hand and it did smell good. Normally don’t go towards things that have fragrance in them. It was a very watery serum which I found odd. It was nice on the skin though.

I wanted to like this product so bad… unfortunately it has a lot of fragrance and it’s also a pink tint and it made my skin break out horribly all over within the 3rd day of using it. I personally don’t mind fragrance but my skin certainly does. If you have sensitive skin, I would be very cautious trying this product.
product_name: Hydra Vizor Invisible Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen with Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon

review_text: I was looking for a new night moisturizer with Vitamin C and thought I’d give this a try. Instantly regretted it. I got a mild breakout from using this twice! The smell is unpleasant and reminds me of my sons diaper rash cream/ointment. Lastly, it is way too thick. Would not recommend. Going back to my holy grail, Olehenriksen Vitamin C moisturizer.
product_name: Potent-C Vitamin C Bright & Plump Moisturizer

review_text: This is a great product! It adds the perfect amount of hydration applied on wet skin. It is also very good to use with other products since it does not make other products clump up or anything. It can also be used under makeup and it complements the foundation for a glowy skin. I would definitely recommend this product. I received this item as a free sample.
Hands down my favourite overnight moisturizer. This moisturizes and plumps my face without causing breakouts/other skin issues. I personally like the smell of it which is a bonus.
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: This barely had any effect to a point where I was not sure if it cleaned my face.It is super mild with a great smell.Also I noticed my skin has darkened a bit with usage over time.

Bought this as a stand in for my UFO oil while I’m pregnant. Ugh. It’s terrible. I mean, I don’t think I had adverse reactions to it but it didn’t do a thing. It didn’t help my hormonal acne or redness. My skin didn’t feel or look any smoother or brighter or better overall. My skin was definitely not balanced. I did give it a month to see but, nothing.
product_name: Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: I really wanted to like this brand. I love the packaging and its brand philosophy, but it just didn’t work for me. Especially, this eye serum. It actually made my eyes worse. It was drying and eventually it would form a whitish cast where applied. Also, what made it really bad was that I started getting white/translucent little bumps in my undereye. I gave the product about a week before returning it.
review_title: I hope my eyes can forgive me

review_text: Tingles nicely on the skin and leaves it feeling hydrated and refreshed, but for the price I would expect it to do a bit more in terms of actually improving my skin-- it did nothing for my acne or hyperpigmentation. There are plenty of other essences out there that contain similar ingredients for much less that I have been just as satisfied with.
Like it, but could live without it. I really enjoyed it at first, but now I’m kind of like blah to it. I feel like it was over hyped to me in the store.
I have combination dry skin and it was not moisturizing enough for my skin. Switched back to Clarins.
product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: To start, I have clear skin and not sensitive to much. I try sample products pretty regularly and have never had much issues. I got a deluxe sample of this product and within one use it was loud and clear this product wasn’t for me. I tried it in the evening and by the morning I had texture all over my face. I went back to my regular routine to allow my skin to relax, but after a week the texture was still there. I finally tried a Korean face mask and it cleared up the texture within a day. Be cautious when trying the product - get a sample and try only on part of your face.
They are a life saver! I wish these were around when I was younger! Love them!

I’ve been using this as a sample and it is an ok cleanser. It is a very thick consistency and lathers up well, however it feels a bit drying on the face once it is washed off. I have drugstore cleansers that do a better job.

I used DHC and loved it. This, in comparison, is not nearly as good. It is SUPER thick. What I mean is that it doesn’t spread on your face easily. It almost feels like it pulls. Once you add water, it emulsifies and spreads but then I don’t feel like it’s “working“ as well. I’m returning this and trying another brand.
review_title: VERY thick- not a great job at removing my mascara

review_text: I would like to completely edit my review. Update. This made me break out. I was not sure if it was this but I spaced out my use and without fail it causes severe acne. Moreover, it’s not actually broad spectrum, it’s an SPF 15 by international standards, at best. The ingredients are not clean, so the labeling is also false. Watch out for this with Sephora products in general. I would definitely save my coins for Biossance or another sunscreen instead. I would return this if I could.
product_name: Hydra Vizor Invisible Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen with Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon

review_text: I’m very impressed. It smells amazing, like oranges and honey. It didn’t tingle or burn at all (granted my skin is used to harsh products). And the result was quite noticeable the very first time I used it which not many products can boast. My skin felt very smooth and soft and I think it faded my freckles a bit even. I would recommend this to a friend.

I have very flakey, dry skin and have been using the FAB products for about 2 weeks now and I have already noticed a big difference in my skin! I suffer from eczema all over my body, and have extremely dry skin on my face. I only use these products for my face and after only a few days of using them every night I noticed a big difference- my face is no longer dry and flakey! I find it doesn’t help with acne, but with dry skin it definitely does wonders! I have been using the face cleanser every night, followed by the exfoliation pads, serum, and then the ultra repair cream last. I would recommend this product if you have very dry skin like me!
review_title: Great for very dry, flakey skin

review_text: Provides moisture, but nothing else. I felt that my fine likes and puffiness got worse with this product. Returned.

This felt nice but it didn’t do anything for my eyes. Maybe it needed more time, but I only had a small sample to work with. Like the other products in this line, I feel like you’re paying for a name that’s been stamped on products that are just okay. Just do your research before buying, try to figure out if it’s a product that will actually work for you.

Okay I really like the consistency and feel of this product, but it made my skin oily a few hours after using. I’m so bummed! Didn’t dry my skin at all though which would be nice for those with dry skin.

This is the second sleeping mask I’ve tried and it is so amazing to me. The smell is so good you literally smell like a flower and it’s such a peaceful smell. It is super hydrating it has two steps and it doesn’t take long for the gel to dry before you have to put the cream over it. I wake up with my skin feeling so soft and hydrated. This product is in pre-production and is not the final product therefore the sealing of the product is not yet final. Overall it is essential to my night time skin routine. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
This was just okay. Too small of a bottle for the price.

I received this product complimentary from Influenster. I love this moisturizer! I have dry skin that’s only accentuated in the winter. When I apply this for bed my skin is noticeably softer in the morning. It does have a fairly strong fragrance that I notice upon initial application but quickly goes away. The product sinks in fairly quickly and doesn’t leave a greasy or oily residue
It smells amazing and feels so good! Not exactly an oil but still moisturizes very well. I will definitely rebuy!

This moisturizer from Summer Fridays is very hydrating. It’s very lightweight and I think it would work on a lot of skin types. This is a great everyday moisturizer and great for under makeup. I love that it helps get rid of my dry patches but isn’t greasy threw out the day.

This “clean“ product is very misleading. How can a product containing alcohol be clean? I used it once and the smell of alcohol was so strong and it’s common sense that it dries your skin out thus creating more dullness, wrinkles and other skin ptoblems/irritations.
product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist

review_text: this cleanser is amazing. really removes mascara and stubborn sunscreen. smells like cucumber to me than soy and love that also.

I just could not get this to work on my oily skin. I felt like it didn’t cover a single pore. I don’t typically wear primers, generally I find my foundation does a good job of covering, but this made my skin look worse? I have used benefits porefessional multiple times before and found it to outperformed this primer hands down. Application was annoying, it didn’t feel like it dried? And it slid my makeup around all day. Too bad, I heard amazing reviews and love tatcha for their cleanser. Maybe would perform better on dryer skin?
review_title: wanted to like this, but really underwhelming.
product_name: The Silk Canvas Protective Primer Mini

review_text: Too drying. I was hoping for a moisturizing cleanser that worked with the entire line. This was nothing like I had hoped.
review_title: Not for dry or neutral skin.

review_text: I got a free sample and used it only one time. My forehead started stinging a tiny bit after using these wipes. My face got a bit red. Later on I noticed the product contains alcohol so I won’t be using it again. Products containing alcohol can really over dry your face as well and definitely not good for very sensitive skin such as mine
review_title: people with sensitive skin stay away!
product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I had high hopes for this product but overall i am underwhelmed. Perhaps user error but i needed to use about 1/4 -1/3 of the jar until i could see it in my bath (standard bath and shower apartment combo). Even then I could not smell it nor did I think it did much and I am an avid bather in the tub. Wanted to love but unfortunately just don’t

Bomb! I love this cleanser soooo much. I used to use soy cleanser from Fresh and was in love with the product, but now this cleanser is the winner. The price is really cheap compared to other cleansers in Sephora. I have sensitive skin; this product doesnt iritate my skin, and make my skin feel dry after using it. No foam at all!
I love this, I had never tried something like this. It is amazin
product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: Smells terrible, it’s not worth at all. The moment it starts to smell discard the product. The actual oil should not smell but shelf life is expired even if it sits in store aisle. I got mine through online purchase this time n that had a smell like expired oil.

Let’s start at the beginning. The packaging is beautiful! The blue frosted glass jar and metallic lid are stunning. It smells very fresh but fruity.
