I wouldn’t use it as a moisturizer during the day though because it does have a slight oiliness to it and I already have issues with oily skin and trying to keep my makeup matte. I received this product complementary and these are my honest opinions.

Made me breakout and feels greasy. Only use it if I’m feeling VERY dry at night. Would not recommend in the morning or under makeup unless you reallyyyyy need hydration and don’t have sensitive/acne prone skin.
product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: This product actually dried out my under eye area and I saw zero difference in lines and zero brightness
product_name: Hyaluronic Marine Dew It Right Eye Gel

review_text: I actually used a sample of this and liked it enough that I was willing to give it a try. Made the mistake and purchased. Felt like the actual product was very thick and doesn’t exactly go onto your face smoothly. If you touch or rub your face after applying this product, there’s a residue that comes off. It’s almost like it flakes. I’m usually sensitive to scents but that hasn’t bothered me like others have mentioned. I wouldn’t purchase this again and actually not even going to use the rest of this product. Very disappointing.
review_title: Too thick, leaves residue and peels off
product_name: Clinique Smart Clinical MD Multi-Dimensional Age Transformer Revolumize

review_text: I have the weirdest skin. My skin is super oily, I have to constantly worry about shine throughout the day. But my skin will break out tender pimples if I do no keep my face super hydrated. It’s bad enough to where I have to use this as a daily moisturizer and it keeps those break outs away. Thankful for this formula
product_name: Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Swiss Glacier Water

review_text: Sulfate? Fragrance? Parabens? This is complete garbage. I remember using this as a teenage. My face was so irritated, dry and filled with texture.

I thought it was possibly just me but after reading many other reviews, this product really makes you break out. I had really high hopes for this cleanser but its a very tough scrub and wasn’t what I hoped for. I have to finish it because of its pricing and I would feel bad not finishing. Luckily masks are mandatory and these pimples won’t appear. Also, I tried not using the product for a while to solidify my suspicion and my skin cleared. As soon as I used it again, I broke out.
review_title: Welcome to break out pimple city
product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: I received two little sample size to try for 10 days but I was only able to try it for 6 days before the samples ran out. So in total honesty, I can’t say I saw any difference in my skin after using it for 6 days. The serum went on smoothly and wasn’t sticky on my skin but for the price, I would expect more.
review_title: Did not make it into my skincare must-haves
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum

review_text: The first couple of times I used this, it felt extremely nice on my skin. After a couple of uses, the serum began to dry me out, so I used it as a spot treatment for blemishes. After about a week, my skin began to burn from this, as well as break out a lot more in those areas. Don’t recommend for sensitive skin!
This product has made my skin feel more hydrated and has given me a really nice glow
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

review_text: This eye cream is hydrating but that’s about it. I found the texture way too thick. I was told that you need to warm it up between your fingers before applying - which helped. For the price, I think there are more effect eye creams out there that can help with a variety of skin concerns.

Love this stuff! I apply it once a day and find it helps with fading acne scars and seems to help prevent new breakouts. The texture is fine. It’s a thin consistency, slightly tacky at first but then it dries down to a thin film on your skin –but it’s easy to even things out if you follow it with a moisturizer. I find that it’s super gentle on my skin and even works for my GF who has very sensitive, acne-prone skin.
Bright, soft and even skin after a few weeks. It is a tad oily and the colour does transfer to your pillow, but not a huge bother.
review_title: A great add on to your daily routine

review_text: Not hydrating at all. It leaves my face feeling supper dry and tacky. It pills and it looks like you’re peeling from a sunburn.y skin broke out days after I started using this, like there are bumps on my face like goose bumps. Do not buy, it’s a waste of money... even tho it’s so cheap. Returning immediately
review_title: DON’T LET THE PRICE FOOL YOU

review_text: I have combination skin. Oily on the nose and extremely dry rest of the face. This oil has helped so much with dryness. It has also cleared those bumpy pimples on my face and I feel my face now has even skin tone and looks very fresh and neat. I sometimes rub this oil on my hair as well. All in all excellent product and will exceed your expectations.
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: I had a reaction to this- gave me a scaly rash. Do not recommend for someone with sensitive skin
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: I used the whole bottle and it did a good job at keeping my skin moisturized but that’s about it. It did nothing for my acne or scars. I would not buy again because it’s just not worth the $80. Don’t waste your money.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: I’m an avid Herbivore fan, so I was excited to try this oil for my combo, acne prone skin; however after a week of using this daily, my skin broke out horribly! I’m still trying to get my skin back to normal. Maybe it was the coconut oil, I don’t know, but back to the store this goes!
product_name: Mini Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: I purchased this for my teenage son who struggles with acne. He discovered this product after seeing it on tik tok. Like MANY others, when the product arrived it was different than originally stated and had a sticker covering it. I too am frustrated with this. SKINFIX should “fix“ this! It is very misleading to your consumers.
product_name: Acne+ 2% BHA + Azelaic Acid + Niacinamide + AHA Cleanser

review_text: I never leave reviews, so I mean it when I say this .DO NOT BUY. I don’t have overly sensitive skin , so I had good expectations for this cleanser especially with all the good reviews . However, I’ve never broken out so bad from using a face wash. It also feels like it doesn’t even leave the face clean. I’m shocked at how highly rated this product is.

I applied liberally to my face and neck before a 2 hour bike ride, came home and neck and nose were not only bright red with sunburn, but I also had a bumpy rash! Keep in mind, was a cool 60 degrees and didn’t sweat at all... product failed to work!
product_name: SUBLIME DEFENSE Ultra Lightweight UV Defense Fluid SPF 50

review_text: I’ve been using this for a few weeks, but I think it takes a couple months to truly notice a difference. So far I have noticed that I think the skin around my eyes is a little firmer. I’ve had wonderful results from DE’s vitamin C eye cream, so I’m excited to pair these two together.

I tried the GOOPGLOW Overnight Peel (15 percent Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel from goop) and did not personally like it. It left me with burns on my face! I had to wash it off after a few hours because the stinging and tingling was so bad. The next morning I woke up and had small red bums all over my face and a few chemical burns. I personally do not recommend this product but everyone’s skin is different. Do a test patch first as suggested! I tried it on my hand but after about 10 minutes when I didn’t have any reaction I used it on my face. I think I should have tested it on a more sensitive patch of skin. I received the GOOPGLOW 15 percent Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel from goop gifted by Sephora in exchange for my honest opinion.
product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: I’ve tried all of community sixty-six skin care line and this seems to be the only product that I might continue to use long term. There is no fragrance in the product, it’s lightweight and not sticky. Right now the biggest con is that it contains phenoxyethanol which is dangerous in large doses (and is in so many other products). I haven’t used this long enough to have results one way or another but I will update my review if I experience anything groundbreaking (or even the slightest bit noticeable).
review_title: This product gives me hope for Community Sixty-Six

review_text: Feels great going on and absorbs into the skin very nicely, but after about ten min into it drying it made my skin feel really dry and tight. I was hoping this stuff would be amazing because there’s an ingredient in here that’s supposed to be great. Honestly just think this didn’t work for my type of skin. It’s extremely dry and sensitive. I’m the type of person that doesn’t mind feeling a little greasy after my moisturizer. I think it would work a lot better for normal to oily skin types. But besides that I really enjoy this brand and will still be purchasing other things they make.

Love Coola! I was sent this product for free from Influenster and Coola in exchange for my honest review. I love this sunscreen! I feel protected from the harmful rays of the sun and it’s lightweight without breaking me out. Thank you Coola!
product_name: Full Spectrum 360º Refreshing Water Cream Organic Face Sunscreen SPF 50

review_text: I have combination skin & i been using this for years!!! I would never have use any other moisturizer becos simply this product works for me!! It really does prevent from pimples and if i have new pimples (due to sleepless nights) it will reduce it overnight n voila its gone next day! ;)) n i don need to use a lot just 2 pumps and warm beforehand and simply softly press on face & neck... (Never use too much becos a little goes a very long way!!) am just simply amazed by this product!! Keep it up Clinique!!!

I started using this product in March, and while I do love it for my skin, I have had nothing but trouble getting it out of the bottle. I have shaken the bottle up from the beginning, so there is no reason why it shouldn’t be coming up with the included dropper. I still see product in the bottle, but the dropper isn’t picking up any of it. I have better luck wiping the outside of the dropper with my finger, and I get a lot more product. My cousin gave me a sample of the milk, and I had the best luck getting it out of the sample That lasted me a week! I bought a kit which included a small bottle, and that lasted for days, and now I have a large bottle, and I either need to dilute it with water, flip it hoping too much doesn’t come out on my hand or toss it, and I have barely had it a month. The product, when I can use it, seems to work well. I use this and then press the Argan Oil into my face. I am going to continue using the oil and hope my skin continues to look better.
product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment

review_text: I was hoping for so much more for this product. I will say it has made my skin soft but for the dull or uneven texture, it hasn’t done much. I will probably not be repurchasing.
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: I received these products for free from Influenster and Shiseido in exchange for my honest review. This is my new go to face and body SPF! I usually wear The Sun Dual Care Urban Environment on a natural freshly washed face and I enjoy how quickly it absorbs into the skin. This is definitely my go to face SPF for everyday use and will continue to stay in my skin care regimen.
review_title: I love love love this stuff!!!
product_name: Urban Environment Fresh-Moisture Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42

review_text: I use this along with Clinique’s oil cleanser as a 2 part cleansing system, and it works great. I use the oil to break up the strong, waterproof makeup, then follow with the foam cleanser to get every little bit off. You literally only need a pea-sized amount, so this tube is going to last me for a while, making it definitely worth its money.
It smelled really good! But It did not work for me. I have oily skin and it felt like it made it even worse!So yes unfortunately I had to return it.

I really like this product. It hydrates my skin and leaves it feeling hydrated and plump. If there was one thing I would change, it would be to add a scent. I’m partial to scented products but it certainly doesn’t take away from the quality and efficacy of this product. I received this product via Influenster in exchange for my review.
review_title: A great addition to my routine
product_name: Sweet Biome Fermented Sake Hydrating Spray

review_text: This product has totally transformed my skin. I now get compliments on my complexion. It also, smells amazing.
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: Please make an unflavored, unscented version, not all of us want to smell and taste like fruit or candy at bedtime. This would otherwise be a great option. Currently using the Tavha Kissu lip mask which is a great option for others whofind the scents and flavors off putting. I would definitely try this in a version without scent and flavors.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I am in the early stages of Rosacea. This is the only moisturizer that does not break my skin out nor turn my face red. I don’t leave home without it.
product_name: Redness Solutions with Probiotic Technology Daily Relief Cream

review_text: I’ve been using this eyecream for about 2 weeks now...It has an almost gluey-texture but quite spreadable around my eyes.I used it both AM and PM, noticing that my normal puffy eyes look better when I turn my camera on for meetings...especially before bedtime, some massage around my brow bone & under eyes can really give a “lift“ feeling for my eyes.Kiehl’s midnight recovery eye cream used to be my favorite, now I think this is even better!
Odd scent and very drying. Made my lips worse than before I started using! Don’t do it!

One of the few products where I notice a difference with just one use. My acne shrunk overnight after applying this mask and after using it for a week my skin feels so much smoother and more plump. I love this mask, I think it will be in my routine for a long time.
I don’t like the smell it’s expensive and make my face look oily!
product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: I figured I’d try this because the price was more reasonable than the Tatcha one. This stuff doesn’t take off eye make up well at all and after rinsing, my eyesight is foggy from make up and the cleanser. After patting my face dry my skin is dry and flaky which is what I was trying to avoid by using an oil cleanser in the first place.
It’s great for moisturizing but it does not do anything for puffiness or dark circles or anti-aging. Don’t spend your money on this if you’re looking for those solutions.
review_title: Does not do what it says
product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream

review_text: I have been using this product for a few days and my dark spots have disappeared a lot. I love this product and when I run out i will be buying more. I was sent this product to test out.
product_name: Potent-C Vitamin C Targeted Spot Brightener

review_text: If i could give this product 0 stars I definitely would...it left my skin looking very greasy and made my skin get oiler throughout the day. Also would leave my skin looking red for about 5 minutes after applying it. The worst part was that it started to clog my pores!! Haven’t dealt with acne for about 2 years and this product has ruined my skin.
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: I honestly don’t even know what this product is supposed to do because it does not do what it’s description says (for me anyways). After using this product for a week (from samples) I hoped there would be some kind of result and the only thing I noticed was lots of breakouts.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Gifted by Dermalogica but all opinions are my own. I’ve absolutely been loving this precleanse oil, I use it mostly as a makeup remover and post makeup cleansing, because I find that it helps remove my makeup and cleanse my skin so good so it’s like 2 birds with one stone & im all for anything that’s going to shorten my skincare steps. I’d definitely recommend & it’s a product I’ll be repurchasing.

I bought this because every influencer was raving about it. I have noticed absolutely no difference in my skin positively or negatively. It’s moisturizing and smells amazing but that’s not why I purchased it. It did nothing to my dark spots which aren’t even bad. I have a few spots on my cheek bones and they were still there, as dark as ever, 2 months later. I’m only writing this review because I wasted $30 on this stuff but the Peeling Solution and Glycolic Acid Toner by The ordinary have worked wonders for me! I’ve been using them for 3 weeks now and I’ve had great results so far. For the price of this toner you can buy those 2 products and still have money left over! Don’t waste your time!!
review_title: No holy grail by any means!

review_text: broke me out terribly. I received a sample from the company and I was so excited to try it. I used it before bed and woke up looking greasy and by the next afternoon, I had what looked like hormonal acne all over my chin and jawline. it took 2 weeks to disappear completely. I’m sure it was this cream as I’ve had my skin under control and clear for a long time. this was the only new cream I’ve used. I’m using my sample on my hands :(

I’m a bit new to the whole skin care world and I recieved this Serum and a complimentary gift. I was really excited to try it because of the reviews. My skin is in between oily and dry, I have a lot of red pigmentation, and it is acne prone. After using this Serum for a few weeks I feel like it has helped a lot with brightening my skin and it’s been looking very fresh and glowy but I have noticed I started to break out. I hadn’t had a pimple in almost a year ever since I did an accutane treatment. After using this I noticed that I’d start to get one or two small ones, but now it’s more like four or five. I think the price is fair, just because it is a pretty big bottle compared to other serums so you do get a lot of product. I just think if you have acne prone skin this might not be the product for you.
Love this. Usually eye cream has a very thin consistency. This does not. It has a thick consistency. So a little goes a long way. The packaging is also really nice. Will be rebuying!

For reference I have dry skin, I used this to hopefully deeply hydrate my skin but all it did was sit on the top layer of my skin, which is weird since my skin is so dry it normally soaks up moisturizer well and somehow it still managed to not fully sink into my skin. It also felt very greasy and thick. It also caused me to break out on my jaw line. It isn’t the worst moisturizer I’ve used but it’s definitely not worth the hype.
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Awful, everytime I touched my face all my skincare peeled off. I hated it

$100 for testers … Not worth it at all. I read the comments about the smell, and dismissed them because I’m used to natural products … but this is on another level. They reek … I only used them a few times because I couldn’t stand it. I thought that the products would be bigger, but they are sample size … not worth $100.

i have very red skin and After using this product, I noticed my skin had reduced redness which is very hard for me! and my skin is less oily! I definitely will be using this product in my skin care routine
I love this product! Aside from being able to use it for so many things it works amazing! My skin is glowing!
product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil

review_text: I experienced the same issue as many other reviews, leaked all over the bag during shipment.
I use these with a spin brush and am usually so lazy with skincare but these make my skin SO clear and soft!
product_name: Baby Pekee Bar + Juju Bar Travel Duo

review_text: I absolutely love the way this moisturizes my lips, the SPF 25 is great, and the dispenser tip should be the model for all lip balms. My only complaint is that at $7 a tube, I wish that there was more product...
review_title: Moisturizes well, wish it was larger

review_text: I received a full size pack of GLO Lit teeth whitening vials from pinchme to try out for a week. I was very impressed with the results! My teeth are somewhat sensitive to whitening products, but this didnt bother them at all, so thats always a plus. I read some reviews that said this was hard to keep on your teeth, and i can see how that would be so. I have a mouthpiece that I have used in the past for other whitening products, so after applying, i put the mouth piece in to help keep product in place, and that really helped. I noticed a big difference in the color of my teeth by the end of the week. The lip care was a nice added bonus in the pack. Overall i would definitely buy and use this product to help whiten my teeth.
product_name: GLO Lit Teeth Whitening Vials 7 Pack + Lip Care

review_text: Broke me out & I never have breakouts. I do not have acne prone skin at all. I can’t remember the last time I had a breakout. This product broke my forehead out & my chin area. Will be returning. IT cosmetics has a better one.
review_title: Broke me out & I never get breakouts
product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: I really like this sunscreen. It didn’t feel heavy and greasy like other sunscreens. It worked great as well, I wore it all day (with one reapply) at an outdoor event and it saved me from sunburn very well. I will definitely be using this from now on!
product_name: Invisible Physical Defense Mineral Sunscreen SPF30

review_text: This did absolutely nothing for me. I received a small sample of this product and thought I liked it. When I received the bigger bottle that I ordered I found it very unappealing. It just sat on the surface of my skin and felt very greasy. WOULD NOT ABSORB! After about an hour I literally cleansed my face again just to remove the product. After 3 tries I gave up and let my friend have it. She has had better luck. Not for everyone...

I’ve never used a cleanser with mint in the ingredients and it’s the most incredibly refreshing thing ever! What a treat on my skin! I only need one pump and it lathers nicely and is gentle enough to use around my eyes.
Seems like a standard toner. Definitely has a scent 8m not fond of. Didn’t seem to pull out any excess

As for cleansing wipes - meh. Doesn’t take much off and ends up sticky smearing anything you might have on your eyes (shadow, mascara, etc...). Leaves your face feeling raw and spoiled. I didn’t find them to be soothing at all, rather, more of a disappointment. Maybe they’ll change the formula?

I have been using Algenist anti-aging moisturizer for about a year now but decided to try their new Genius moisturizer because of the great reviews. I saw immediate results I kid you not. This cream is amazing and makes my skin look youthful and dewy. The lines around my mouth are almost gone. Lines on my forehead are still there but smoother looking. I also noticed the deep lines on my neck are less noticeable. I’m very happy with this cream and will keep buying it although it’s expensive but I used a 10% off coupon I got in email so will buy it only when I get a coupon. But less is better, you don’t have to apply a lot on your skin plus I don’t need to buy the serum now because it seems to give me the same benefits as the serum so I’m saving money there. .
I loved the moisturizer but they barely give you any in the tub of moisturizer. If you open it up, there’s no way there is 1.7 oz of moisturizer in this. It only lasted my about 2-3 weeks.
Didn’t ever absorb into my skin. Just kinda sat on top and was greasy. Bummed because I’ve heard so many good things and I like Farmacy products in general.
product_name: Honey Savior All-in-One Skin Repair Salve

review_text: I wanted to like this so much as I heard so many people rave about it. I have very dry and sensitive skin and this just dried my skin out so much.

I go tanning at a tanning booth at least twice a week and have always struggled to get my face tan and keep its color. So my body would be very dark and my face still porcelain white. I tried many things in the tanning booth as well as buying Jergens face tanning lotion and it had a horrible smell and literally peeled off my face days later when makeup was applied. So when a beauty advisor recommended this for me, I had to try it, and immediately fell in love. Mix a few drops with your lotion every week or so before bedtime and you will wake up with soft and smooth skin, that is not only tan but with NO SMELL! And the price honestly didn’t bother me because it will last a while and i’m so happy to not have this struggle anymore. Now I can go with a full face of makeup and not worry about spots I missed that show my white skin underneath, or i can go barefaced since it does such a smooth job!

This La Mer eye cream is so elegant! It has a thin consistency that works into the skin quickly. I have pretty bad dark circles so this helps the look of them in the morning. There is a fragrance to the eye cream but it’s pleasant and not too overwhelming. Also, a little goes a long way so the jar will last months!
Love the extra glow. Just be sure to mix well with moisturizer and also apply to neck and jaw line.
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: I seem to be the only person who hates this product. I bought the vanilla one after reading so many good reviews. I hate it so much. My lips are actually drier now and I find myself absent-mindedly biting and picking at the skin, so it actually looks worse than when I started. I like it as a gloss, it looks great that way, but def not as an actual moisturizing treatment the way its marketed, Ill stick with my way cheaper Burts bees chapstick.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Are my pores refined? No. But it is lovely to use this after washing my face. It smells like brown sugar and keeps my skin from feeling stripped after cleansing.
product_name: Fat Water Niacinamide Pore-Refining Toner Serum with Barbados Cherry

review_text: This moisturizer feels beautiful- it’s substantial but not greasy, has a nice light scent, and made my skin feel soft and hydrated. I didn’t notice much in terms of lasting effects, though, which is a drawback of the price point.
product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: I’m really into lip balms and lip care and I got this as a gift and I can’t stop using it!! Super soft and my lips were a little chapped prior to using. It took a day for my lips to be smooth. Highly recommend but after I saw the price I was a little upset.

I love everything from Paulas Choice so I went to Sephora to purchase vitamin C. I’m so happy that I did that instead of ordering online because I got to see what I’m actually getting for paying $50, and it’s the bottle that was the size of my thumb. Insane! I love her retinol and aha peel but this was disappointing and just too much
Made my stomach hurt, I don’t think it helped me to digest better my meals, didn’t noticed any difference. Made me nauseous and dizzy.

Its very nicely packaged with a nice orange sherbet scent (if youre into that). Texture is pretty smooth and I liked how nicely it went on at first but this is definitely not for all skin types. I really wanted to like it but it honestly left my skin a little too oily. I have combo skin so I learned that a little goes a long way with this product. I felt like it didnt melt right into my skin or absorb as nicely as i wanted it too so i definitely didnt wear make up the days i used this. It actyually left it a little sticky or like tacky. At first i started by applying a good amount all over because it does feel very moisturizing but it left me way too oily. I focused more on my cheeks and chin and barely put any on my t-zone. I also learned that this would be better as a night moisturizer because its very thick, (you definitely have to wash your face thourougly in the morning though). I also didnt notice a glow or radiance, unless they were referring to the oil it left behind. I only broke out in one little pimpe right between my brows, which i never do, so beware. It wasnt horrible but it also wasnt “OMG Holy Grail“ either. Definitely do recommend for super dry skin! I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are my own.
I have really sensitive skin and this one worked well for me. I tried first once per week then every two days or every other day
Great moisturizer. It smells good and feels good. It’s not too heavy or oily. But it’s a terrible primer. Foundation rubs off and it makes my pores look huge.
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: 100% what I’ve been looking for, a glycolic acid toner that’s affordable
Did not like. Made my skin feel tacky. Felt like it never absorbed into my skin.
product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

review_text: A good lactic acid formula requires an acidic base (pH 3.5-3.0, or less); this one is “neutral.“ When you ask a Sephora host what the pH is, you get that “deer-in-headllights“ look. Worse, when you call the company they say it’s “proprietary. Really? What’s proprietary about pH? The flattering reviews of this brand must include some quid pro quo, because no one who knows chemistry, formulas, ingredients, skin and dermatology would EVER endorse such inferior, shoddy products. I know Sephora carries it all; unfortunately, “all“ also covers poor.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I received this product as a part of the Sephora birthday gift. I’ve used it twice (just to give it a chance) and both time it has caused me to break out in a red rash that looks similar to a mild sunburn. From having a read through other reviews is it clear that there is something in this product that is an allergen to some people and not to others. so it is a gamble!
review_title: Caused red rashes on both cheekbones.

review_text: I have tried several different types of Vitamin C serums, never seeing any results at all but this product is just lovely and within days my skin was looking radiant. I have pretty sensitive skin also and haven’t had the least bit of irritation.
review_title: Truly lives up to the hype!

review_text: I love this so much. It takes a little work to figure out where it fits in your beauty/makeup routine because it didn’t seem that intuitive to me. review_text: Ok for a very expensive/heavily perfumed moisturizer appropriate for dry/normal skin. It is VERY scented. Anyone sensitive to fragrance should stay away.There are no miracle anti-aging properties here, just antioxidants available in thousands of other (better priced) products. If you like how it makes your skin look, great, but it’s not because this is unique and miraculous anti-aging creme.Also, the jar packaging is lame. First, it is hard to reach all the product. Second, any skin product with active ingredients will degrade when exposed to air. That’s why many (and it should be all) of this type of product comes in a tube you squeeze or pump: that way, the product remains effective for much longer. Third, every time your fingers go into the jar to get cream, more bacteria goes in with them. Ew. L’Occitane should know better.

Love this product! I have tried so many different kinds of cleansers and either makes me face sticky, dry, oily and makes me break out. review_text: I’m not sure who wrote the standards for “clean“ beauty but this product does not meet my personal standards. I enjoyed using it, it goes on smoothly and you don’t need a large amount, but once I actually looked up the ingredients I realized I can’t continue to use this product. It is not reef-safe, as it contains Octocrylene (can cause brain deformities in fish larva and reproductive toxicity - imagine what it could do to humans applying it regularly on their skin - and there is evidence that it can bleach coral). It also contains Homosalate, which doesn’t break down easily and has been found on sea life and corals. Bummer.

I used to use this religiously for over a year, especially during the winter. it’s great for dry skin. HOWEVER i did notice it enlargening my pores and my mother mentioned it to me as well. I now use this strictly on the body

Didn’t do anything special at all. I never breakout, and it would give me small white heads. I ended up using it on my body just to get rid of it. Don’t waist your money on this over priced cream that does nada!

I was really looking forward to this product but it was terribly disappointing. It took a lot of product to cover my face and then it didn’t emulsify well with water at all. After I washed with this I ran a make up remover wipe over my face and there was quite a bit of make up left on the wipe so I had to re-wash my face.

I loved this product until I was enlightened to the fact that it contains micro-plastics (in this case: polyethylene). I can’t go for that, no can do. I hope they reformulate because I haven’t found a better alternative.

review_text: Okay...I was super skeptical but this has 100 % helped my skin! It’s so much more hydrated and glowy!
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

review_text: This is now my favorite moisturizing face mask! At first I was skeptical just because I have very sensitive skin, I have severe eczema, meaning I have very dry skin. I wasn’t sure how my skin was going to respond to it. In the beginning when putting on the ampoule my forehead tingled a little bit that’s where my Eczema is more sensitive. After I got the mask on, the irritation stopped. When I was finished the mask, my skin felt so soft and moisturized. Even the day after my skin was supeer soft, definitely recommend this to anyone. Will be repurchasing in the future.

Really sad about this. I’ve been dying to try Murad & this was the first product of theirs that I tried. My skin is very acne prone & ever since I got pregnant with my son it’s been a real struggle. But I felt like every time I used this I got a new pimple. I recent got their vitamin c cleanser & really like it though !

When I first started using drunk elephant, the first product I ever bought was the night duo with the mini Marula oil and TLC Framboos. Upon first use, I thought that it was very greasy and didn’t absorb well into the skin and I looked sooo oily. I stuck it out however and tried to keep using it here and there to use products that were “clean“ and had better ingredients. I can’t even begin to tell you how much this oil clogged my pores, gave me acne in places I have never seen in 21 years, etc. I would not recommend this to people with oily skin. I do not have sensitive skin and normally I just get occasional breakouts. It took me forever to realize that it was the oil causing it and that this oil is in almost every DE product. Would NOT buy ever again.
review_title: DO NOT buy if you have oily skin! Will make worse!

review_text: I may actually like this better than Sunday Riley’s CEO Glow serum (blasphemy, I know). It seems less heavy that SR, and has a better smell. It is also made with the Vitamin C compound that lasts longer than the SR version. Did this brighten my skin? It’s only been a week, but so far so good. Did this break me out? No more than other vitamin C serums when introducing into my routine. It is a bit too pricey for me, but at a discounted rate, I would consider buying again.
product_name: Argan Bright Skin Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Smells horrible, like earwax!! I can’t get past the disgusting smell that still lingers hours after you’ve applied it. No thank you!
i still like the mask but this formula is still pilling, not as bad as prior but there’s still some. but it’s still great and does hydrate quite well

No, just no. I’m going to guess I have acne prone skin and this made it a million times worse. Truth is I bought it in April and barely started to use it in September as I still had moisturizer and within a few days I started breaking out. To make things worse there were like kind of ingrown pimple that hurt and make you think they might be 2-3 pimples together. I’m halfway through and I don’t think I’ll finish it because it’ll just kill my self esteem. I also want to add that you go through the bottle pretty fast even when you use a small amount which is something to consider given the price. Overall I do not think this is a good moisturizer for someone with acne prone skin and for the price I think it’s not worth for anyone.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Calming Gel Cream

review_text: I received this product for free from influenster in exchange for my honest feedback. I really liked how the consistency of this sunscreen was like a moisturizer. I despise sunscreens that feel super oily or greasy and this one was just what I was looking for!
product_name: The True Cream - Aqua Bomb Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50

review_text: I received the The Pore Fessional Deep Retreat Pore Clearing Clay Mask complimentary from Benefit to try and review. This mask has a lovely smooth texture, not like the think clay masks I’ve tried before. It is easy to spread on my skin. It leaves my oily skin feeling refreshed without the tightening over stripped feeling. This packaging is so cute and fun, and I love that the clay mask is also purple!
product_name: The POREfessional Deep Retreat Pore-Clearing Clay Mask

review_text: I love how it moisturizes the skin! With the season changing skin is getting dryer and that is my go to once it’s getting windy and colder outside! I just apply in on a clean skin twice a day before using cream and I’ve been loving it!!!!!!
product_name: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Really wanted to love this brand and the entire line, but found that the moisture retention wasn’t enough for me. Skin felt very tight and dry (despite being oily), within 15 minutes or so. Bought the moisture cream to apply afterwards hoping it would help with moisture retention and “tight“ feeling, but didn’t. Sadly I returned both products.
product_name: Emerald Hemp Seed Deep Moisture Glow Oil

review_text: Worst ACNE PRODUCT on the market! It made me break out in small bumps ALL OVER my forehead after a months use. It was absolutely insane.
review_title: don’t use if you love your skin

review_text: LOVE THIS SUNSCREEN. It’s very light weight not non-sticky. As someone with a medium-dark complexion I do not find any white-cast
product_name: Squalane + Zinc Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 PA +++

review_text: It didn’t work for me at all. It did nothing but make the pimples worse. Would not recommend it.

Huge no for me . It helped moisturizer , but didn’t do much else for my skin. It is extremely greasy and pills up if you rub your face after putting it on. Has a very strong orange scent so watch out people with sensitive skin.
product_name: High-Potency Night-A-Mins Oil-Free Resurfacing Cream with Fruit Derived AHAs

review_text: I really wanted to like this product because I do think that it lightened some of my acne scars. I was only using it on my chin since that’s where the discoloration is. I changed nothing else about my routine and after about a week I noticed that my whole chin has broken out in tiny bumps that give my skin the worst texture where I had applied this product. So unfortunately I will not be using it anymore. Shame cause so many people seem to have great things to say.

This product was gifted to me by INN BEAUTY but my review is honest and my own. This product is soo fun to use. I love that it can be used multiple ways. I tried it both under my foundation and over it too. It truly gives a subtle glow to the skin and looks very nice worn alone as well. Gentle, easy to use & blend formula. I like the pointed tip so you only dispense as much product as you need.
product_name: Face Glaze Skin Barrier Protect & Glow Moisturizer

review_text: I have rosacea and I got this to see if it would help prevent the small blocked pores on my chin (I do have a topical to help me control it but I wanted some additional help). This product did nothing to help. It did help to keep my other pores clear, but I still have hormonal breakouts. Used it religiously for three months. Will not repurchase - there are more effective k beauty products at a cheaper cost
review_title: No help, but no harm, for rosacea
product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

review_text: Didn’t like it. It leaves a white film after using it.
product_name: Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener

review_text: The Caudalie Premier Cru Anti Aging Cream Moisturizer is a wonderful product. Everything I have tried from this brand has worked great for me and this has also. I like using it at night because it is a rich, creamy consistency but not greasy or too heavy. It is slightly fragrant and pleasant. It has not caused any irritation or breakouts on my skin. When I wake up in the morning, my skin looks very hydrated and plump. It is especially perfect for me this time of year because my skin gets very dry and dull. This product has helped to restore radiance and I look forward to more results with continued use. #freeproduct
product_name: Premier Cru Anti Aging Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: This scrub is amazing from start to finish! The warm sensations from when your first put it on, and then the cooling sensation when you wash it off.. it’s so soothing, really makes you feel like you’re at a spa! I have definitely noticed a reduction in the amount of oil produced on my face throughout the day. Would highly recommend to anyone with combo to oily skin!
This product is my favorite skin care product!! It’s absolutely perfect makeup primer. Love love love!!
product_name: Invisiblur Perfecting Shield Broad Spectrum SPF 30 PA+++

review_text: Didn’t do much for my skin it didn’t irritate it or anything but it didn’t get rid of any acne or redness
product_name: Mini SOS Daily Rescue Facial Spray

review_text: This mask is amazing for acne, especially those deep pimples or ones that get super congested with pus and debris. This really works wonders on my skin in just a matter of one or two applications. Hands down one of my favorite things I’ve ever purchased for acne
review_title: DRIED UP ACNE IN ONE NIGHT!
product_name: Superclay Purify + Clear Power Mask with Niacinamide

review_text: This is my 3rd bottle of this stuff. I don’t know what I’d do without it. I’ve always had problem skin and sensitive skin. This stuff really works.
product_name: Mini Goodbye Acne  AHA/BHA Acne Clearing Gel Face Body Spot Treatment

review_text: I received a complimentary bottle of this toner from Influenster, it’s only been a few days using it, but I definitely notice results! My face looks way more refreshed and rejuvenated from just 3 days of use. Although it’s meant for dark spots, I’ve been targeting a red pigmentation on my nose, so I will give an update after I use the whole bottle. The smell is amazing. I actually look forward to putting it on my face at night before of the scent! I love how it brightens up my face, especially during the cold winter months. Great new product! I approved.
This mask is so nice, it gives your face a cooling feeling when put on, once I take it off my skin is so hydrated & smooth! The smell is also amazing! Love would recommend
Underwhelming. These pills have potential but it’s hard to see results in just 30 days (one bottles worth). I’m not sure I would pay for this multiple times without seeing significant results.
product_name: Skin Hydrator Ceramide and Hyaluronic Acid Supplement

review_text: This stuff might work like a magical miracle, but I’ll never know because it smells truly awful. The scent of Cleaning up after a pre teen party where girls have overindulged on candy, fruity sugar Schnapps mixed with fake strawberry body splash isn’t something I can tolerate on my lips while I fall asleep.
review_title: Tried sample, so “flavor” wasn’t clearly Listed
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Addicted. I love this mask. My skin feels like a baby every time I use it. There’s a decent amount of the mask in the jar - I’ve probably used it ten times so far (a little goes a long way) and there’s quite a bit left still. So yes, it’s pricey but you get prob 17-20 applications.

I don’t usually write reviews but I am so happy with the results of this product in such short time of me using it. I recently gave myself a chemical burn using tea tree oil and of course it left a scar/ discoloration. I struggled with acne my teen years and finally as an adult was able to clear up my skin so to me this bothered me so much after struggling for years to be happy with my skin. I tried several different products to get rid of it but didn’t seem to work. But after being recommended this product only after one use i could already see the difference. The smell isn’t nice but it’s not unbearable, I also want to add that my skin is extremely sensitive and this product did a good job not irritating/ breaking out my skin.
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: It’s lightweight yet powerful. You really feel the clean after rinsing. Once a week I pair this with the Daily Superfoliant. This was recommended to me by my medical spa and I’ll probably never switch my cleanser ever again. I rub it in for at least 60 seconds before rinsing. This product deep cleans and has helped me not only rid the acne I had but maintain a clear face.

I have been using Vaseline for years and wanted to treat myself to this product with such great reviews. I started using it about a month ago and I was soooo disappointed! It is not moisturizing AT ALL!!! It actually dried out my lips. I used it at night at first then several times during the day as a lip balm. Thisbtells me that even though something has great reviews, it might not be for me. Going back to Vaseline.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I used this for a week and my pores around my nose appears way smaller! Btw, I applied both morning/night in my skincare routine. I overall enjoyed it! Gave 4 stars because of the smell.
product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

review_text: Although intended for dry skin, I love using this enriched cream overnight. It goes on velvety soft and I can feel it penetrating my skin and erasing my wrinkles almost immediately. I have oily skin so I definitely don’t use this during the day but I feel that I get many benefits from it using it overnight. I have been using it about a week and although there is a slight tingle when I first apply it it makes my skin super soft and silky. I definitely recommend if you want to get results softening your fine lines and laughter lines in your face.

I live in a very hot area in the inland empire of SoCal, so it’s very dry here all the time. Especially now since there is very little rain in California. I got this little trial sample with my rewards points back in January, and I was pretty excited because I’m all about moisturizing my face. I used to have heavy acne that has since diminished in college, but really most of it is gone because of healthier-eating, my clarisonic brush (which I don’t have anymore), and lots of moisturizing!! I’ve tried Clinique moisture surge, and am currently on “belif true cream moisturizing bomb,“ both of which I totally love. I also buy a lot of Asian/Korean face masks to treat my skin every now and then. So I’m always looking for the next best moisturizer, and gel to boot. As a trial, I’ve used it here and there over the summer hoping that my skin would liven up and become soft and supple again. I don’t reccommend this product if you have super dry skin because it’s really not working for me. My skin had been SO dry that it felt flaky and not soft and smooth, putting this on was just really ’meh.’ It barely dented the “armor“ so to speak. My skin type is I guess “thick“ and that’s why it’s good to exfoliate all the time, which I do, but only helps the surface of my skin. I had a munch better time using something else like natural coconut oil and fresh-cut aloe vera from my garden, and my own fresh-cut cucumbers to help with the dryness. Probably going to stick to what I have.
review_title: Kind of average for dry skin
product_name: Cucumber Gel Mask Extreme Detoxifying Hydrator

review_text: I really wanted to like this product, but I’ve never had a product I disliked so much. It leaves my face looking and feeling like a grease ball, it also leaves my face feeling itchy. When I tried to wear this under make up, it would start peeling when I’m applying my primer (Tatcha silk canvas primer). It’s even worse than drugstore sunscreens. I wish I can return this and get my money back, but I’ve already threw the packaging away.
product_name: Superscreen Daily Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

review_text: I love the packaging and branding of Dr. Jart but the first product of there’s I tried was a disappointment. The mask doesn’t stay on so unless you have 15-20 minutes to lay on your back, this mask is not for you. The contents of the mask didn’t feel like they penetrated past the surface level. I think the only thing I did like about it is it didn’t have a bunch of strong artificial smells.
The rubber keeps all the moisture and goodness in! Definitely one of the best single use masks at Sephora, there’s also plenty of product for neck and chest.
Made my lips more dry than they were before, I love Drunk Elephant but this one did not work for me

This sunscreen moisturizer glides on easily and doesn’t get cakey or oily. I have combination skin and this is perfect for me. The ingredients are really good and this is overall just a great daily sunscreen
product_name: Advanced Retinol Daily Repair Face Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: I love that this mask comes in an opaque bottle with a pump as opposed to in a jar where you have to scoop out product every use. I feel this makes masking a less messy experience and wastes less product. This mask feels comfortable on the skin and after the 15 minutes it is supposed to sit on the skin, it doesn’t feel overly dry or like it is pulling, as some clay masks sometimes leaves your skin. The one drawback to this mask is that it does have a scent to it and I would have preferred it to be completely unscented. Overall, after washing this mask off my face, I did notice that it felt softer and smoother. This mask is supposed to also instantly exfoliate and illuminator. I would say it was a relatively mild and gentle exfoliator. I didn’t necessarily notice my skin appearing to be more radiant and brightened right away, and think it would take a more prolonged use to see those kinds of effects!

I had this product for a few months. It lasts a while. This moisturizer is way to oily and it feels so gross on my face. It ultimately did nothing for me. better off with the skinfix moisturizer! they don’t test inanimals
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: How is this sunscreen??! I got this as a deluxe sample, and I have not gone a day without using it since I received it. The formula is like a primer, and it makes my makeup look beautiful. I have never used a sunscreen like this, but this will remain a daily staple for me, no matter what time of year it is!
Smells fresh and clean. Light weight moisturizer. my skin especially under my eyes seems to retain moisturizer really good. The smell is my favorite.

Only spot treatment that works for me. As soon as I feel a breakout coming, I was my face and apply the serum with a q-tip on the spot. It usually won’t come out or if it does, it’ll be small and go away quickly.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I wasn’t too keen on the price of this considering how tiny it is but omg does it work wonders! I get really dry eczema patches under my eyes every spring and fall and this stuff has saved me. A little goes a long way! I put on a tiny bit before bed and wake up and my dry patches are gone. It’s also helped with my lines as well!
This has some kind of glitter it in. Who wants to use glitter on their face. Not I. Nor do I want it near my eyes. So disappointed. I been looking for a rollerball eye cream
product_name: All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage

review_text: The smell is actually quite good comparing to other tanners, BUT even leaving it on overnight, there isn’t much of a tan. It also transfers and smears big time. I put my hand on my arm and woke up with an orange hand and a handprint on my arm. Luckily, this tanner is pretty easy for fixing mistakes. Not my favorite. Especially for the price. I expected more.

I have been using this for about a month now, and despite having active ingredients, I honestly have seen no difference in my acne at all; it did not seem to make my acne any less visible, shrink it, or anything of the sort. It also has a very distinct, unpleasant smell (not so much that I would not use it, but enough that it is unpleasant). I did give 2 stars because it is green, so I suppose it might help with a little bit of the redness that may come with acne.

While I did receive this for free from Estee Lauder and Influenster to test in exchange for my review initially, I ended up purchasing a full sized one from Macy’s as well because I absolutely loved this moisturizer. I love how thick and creamy it is, but even more I love how great it absorbs into my skin so that I don’t have greasy looking skin afterwards. I use it morning and evening and I keep it refrigerated so my skin tightens up a bit immediately. After only a few days of using the sample sized I could see a difference in the smile lines around my cheeks so I knew I wanted to buy more. It’s a great formula and a perfect addition to my other Estee Lauder skincare products. I’ve never used anything from them that I don’t like, but this is definitely one of my favorites.
product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: As an employee I have tried almost every eye cream sold in our Sephora store. Unfortunately our smaller store no longer carries Lancome skincare. But when we did carry it, I was never able to try it because we were always out. I got it recently and I will now be buying it regularly. I’m 61 and this cream is amazing, and I mean AHMAZING. The skin under my eyes has become so much thinner and crepey and I was having a hard time find anything that rejuvenated my undereye skin. One use and the skin is firmer and stronger and no longer crepey and so soft. I use it every day now at least twice a day. I absolutely love this eye cream and I found it more effective than even La Mer eye cream for me. I cannot speak to dark circles as I do not suffer from that issue.
review_title: Lancome Nailed It with this eye cream product!
product_name: Advanced Génifique Wrinkle & Dark Circle Eye Cream

review_text: I love this stuff. The texture is gel like and not sticky, and it goes on very lightly but is still super moisturizing. I recommend it for dry skin that gets oily throughout the day.

This product is not bad or offensive in any way, but for me it didn’t really do much. It did leave my face feeling cleaner, but it did not make any noticeable changes after about a month of use. It did not break me out or dry me out, though. It has a nice smell, but I had to use quite a bit of product because it evaporates quickly. Ultimately I would not go out of my to recommend this product, because it does not yield lasting results.
product_name: Mini Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: I use this under my eyes and recently started using this on my smile lines and since I have I don’t get smile lines in my foundation anymore!! Whaaaatt!! Amazing. Worked for me! (Haven’t noticed it do anything for dark circles though)

I love DE products, but this one is not for me. I have broken out since I started using it in a way I have never experienced before. Redness, whiteheads, and irritation. Can’t recommend this cleanser.
Great consistency, does the trick -- overall love Peter Thomas Roth products :)
product_name: Max Mineral Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 45

review_text: Love this product. This has been a continuous buy for me and necessary for my skin routine. Only thing I have found to help with current and old scars.
Bought this thinking it would make my skin better and it did nothing for me. It also felt really greasy. Total waste of money
product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I am very disappointed with this product! I wore foundation on top of it and it caused the foundation to disintegrate and oxidize. It also creates a weird grayish tinge on the skin. Don’t waste your money on this one!
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I love it’s this is the most luxurious skincare it shocked me literally but the results afterwards were amazing and it was after one use
product_name: NuFACE Mini+ Petite Facial Toning Device

review_text: Feels nice until you rinse it off and realize your vision is blurry and your eyes are burning. Wouldn’t recommend getting this anywhere near your eyes unless you’re into that sort of thing. Which makes it somewhat useless as a makeup remover.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: *I paid for this product* It is so oily! I appled 1 teaspoon~ the recommended amount to get adequate protection, my face was an oily wet mess! I told myself, maybe give it 15 more minutes everything will be okay. Nothing changes. 8 hours later~ still an oily hot mess. Love Shiseido ~ but I will not repurchase this.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

review_text: I rarely wear lip products besides balm but I actually like this. the color is subtle and it isnt extremely sticky. I personally like how the stopper only let’s a small amount come out on the doe-foot applicator, I dont believe its meant to be globbed on!
best tanner I have ever tried . easy to use and gives the most healthiest glow #obsessed
The packaging is so cute, and this lotion goes on smoothly and lasts all day! I loved wearing this to garden outside, it feels like you’re wearing nothing at all.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

review_text: This toner makes me feel so clean and refreshed after each use! I have noticed my skin looking more vibrant. I like to change products once I’m done with them but I don’t think I’ll change this product in my skin care routine.
product_name: Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: This is my 2nd bottle and I will continue to purchase. My skin is definitely more even in tone which no other product I have purchased was ever able to do.I use other items from the Caudalie line and like them all. Well worth the price!
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: Used it for 4 months, and it did nothing for my acne or oiliness. If acne is not a problem for you, this cleaner does make your skin glow, but other than that not worth the money.
product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: Wow! Amazing moisture, fine lines improvement and glow! No oily touch at all!
Moisturized and that’s about it. No other benefits. Would only recommend for someone under 21 or so who doesn’t really need anti-aging benefits.
I used this for about three weeks and didn’t notice any difference. It did very little for my skin and was not worth the price for me. Oh well!

I quite like this serum. At first I thought it was meant to be a moisturizer and i wasn’t a fan... it didn’t do much. But once I started using it in conjunction with a moisturizer I was much more impressed. I don’t see this as a necessary step in my routine, but I do enjoy the extra boost of hydration when my skin is hurting from the cold or to a lighter moisturizer in the summer months. This is a product from DE where I can see how much is left in the pump by twisting and pulling the top off. The top is connected to the airless pump and the white bottom casing can come away.
product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Well, I thought the packaging was beautiful and I liked the proposal described. The aroma is very tasty, in reality surprised me, I thought it would be stronger because it was pineapple with papaya. The texture of the product Found it very different, a little strange, it has a little so as soon as you pass. Left the exfoliated and clean, scented too. I found it cool for everyday life, but not for deeper exfoliation and hydration.
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: I have used this product for over 2 years and I will always repurchase.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This review might be biased because I am totally hooked on and obsessed with Tata Harper and her beauty statement of non-toxic and natural living. As a past acne sufferer I always thought that going for gentle and sensitive skin face washes would be my best bet, which didn’t prevent my breakouts from showing up to the party. Until recently my laser genesis esthetician recommended trying something with anti-acne properties so that one pimple that comes and revisits never bothers me. This product is heaven sent, it doesn’t dry out my skin, ever since I’ve been using it, which is about a month, I didn’t get any white heads my blackheads are gone as well. Added bonus is that it’s natural and no toxins will penetrate your skin and go to your body. Although I checked EWG website and it wasn’t their top rated product but it’s pretty clean.
review_title: Non-toxic and now I’m non-acne person
product_name: Mini Clarifying Blemish & Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: Got a deluxe sample of this and wasn’t impressed. Used as directed, it leaves my dry skin feeling tight and irritated. It’s not bad if I just smooth it on and rinse it straight off, like a cleanser.
product_name: Cucumber Gel Mask Extreme Detoxifying Hydrator

review_text: Love this moisturizer! It looks heavy but is actually very light and easy to absorb. It does not leave the skin feel greasy. My skin feels smooth and I can see that it improves the overall texture already. The packaging is nice too!
product_name: Advanced Retinol Nightly Renewal Face Moisturizer with Retinol

review_text: After a week of using the pads daily, the tip of my nose- which used to be bumpy from blackheads- is now completely smooth and there’s a HUGE difference w/ the oil content of my skin production of new blackheads (nonexistent). Only things I dislike are the alcohol in the pads and the smell. Peach is nice, until the alcohol hits. I have sensitive skin, this makes it feel a little itchy very, very mild discomfort but as soon as I moisturize, it goes away. Will probably buy again.
product_name: Goodbye Acne  Max Complexion Correction Pads

review_text: Effective after 2 weeks of use. Helping to combat my postpartum undereye issues!

The eye cream feels very luxurious and absorbs right away. It has light scent which is pleasant and does not irritate. It hydrated and smooths. It could be a bit more hydrating for me; but I still give it 4 stars.

This one was a miss for me. I love Summer Fridays products but this one was just not for me. The scent is amazing; it’s light and floral and fresh. But the oils are just too overwhelming on my skin. I have acne-prone combination skin, and while this product didn’t clog my pores or make me break out, the oils just left me looking very greasy. After rinsing the mask off, you’re suppose to press in the remaining oils, but I found that the oils were too heavy. I had to wash my face off completely with cleanser to get rid of the tacky oil feeling. As for exfoliation with the rose petals and sugar, I prefer exfoliation with the Overtime Mask instead.

Absolutely adore this cleanser. I previously used the Milk jelly from Glossier, but after finding out about how they treat their Black, Indigenous + racialized employees, I decided to look for a different brand. I had a free skin consult with a professional who helped me choose products for my skin type (I did this through their website) and was happily surprised by their warm welcome. This cleanser is refreshing, takes off makeup and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean! I highly recommend.

Been wanting to try this for so long and finally caved this last VIB sale. So disappointed!! review_text: Best self tanning product I’ve ever used! I’ve tried so many different self tanners on the market and usually give up on them because they are too hard to get even, too orange, or too much upkeep. Just add a few drops to your face and/or body lotion and apply as you normally would. I was a little nervous about streaking after applying it as you can’t see where you may have missed, but was totally amazed when i woke up to an absolutely perfect “glow”! I started with 3 pumps in my face lotion and around 6-7 for my body lotion. Next time I’ll do a few more to achieve my ideal tan. Also: Does not stain sheets and the self tan smell is barely noticeable!

The first lid has a “pump” platform under it, which gives a decent size of cream to apply to face (I usually use two pumps). Once the cream gets too low for the pump, the second lid can be taken off to get the most use out of the product. • This product made my face feel VERY hydrated, and I personally loved the fact that it did not have any strong scent to it. It was a very smooth texture, and didn’t make my face feel oily.

It needs 5-6 sprays to cover the entire face and I do not notice any difference in moisture level afterwards. Would not recommend it. I am only keeping it because I do not want to return and have Sephora toss away the barely used product which is a big waste...

You’ll wake up to soft, lovely, glowing skin after just a few days of consistent use! I’m so happy I found this to get me through the winter!

i was so excited to try this moisturizer but after using it for a couple days i started breaking out

review_text: I have always had oily acne prone skin, I’m 27. I’ve struggled with cystic acne for years. This is the absolute best product I’ve found and I have dropped a lot of money on finding something that works. I learned that my acne is hormonal and mine is usually caused by clogged pores due to being so greasy. I planned to stop taking birth control and was preparing for a mess of breakouts so I did some investing. I planned this out because I scar very easily and wanted the least damage possible. First, I bought this stuff. It’s basically magic for acne. I only put it on all over at night. If I have a spot coming up I’ll use it as spot treatment in the morning but not on my entire face. I don’t care for how it does under makeup and I’m greasy enough as is. (I also bought the Sunday Riley lactic acid treatment and the C.E.O. in trial sizes and those are AWESOME too. For chemical exfoliation these two together are great. However, they are very expensive and I can’t justify spending that much money when this next step does just as good of a job!)Second, I invested in a Clarisonic Mia 2. This is one of the best things I’ve ever bought for my face. I use the sensitive brush head. If I had bought one of these years ago I could have saved myself a lot of trouble.My skin care routine at night starts with miscellar water and a cotton round. I take my makeup off with that and do a quick rinse with warm water and my hands. I wet the Mia 2 brush head and put a small squeeze of Murad time release acne cleanser right on the brush. Fire that thing up and follow the beeps. It takes a minute and BAM! Welcome to the perfect amount of exfoliation. This has been so much help with my skin. No more clogged pores and after 1 week of using it (only at night) I noticed I had silky smooth skin. After rinsing my face and patting it dry I rub in about five drops of the U.F.O. (especially around my chin area)and I’m done. My skin has never looked this good, I owe it to the U.F.O. and the brush!
review_title: Proper exfoliation and UFO fixed my cystic acne

review_text: Olehenriksen products are usually nice. So I was super excited to try this out! Unfortunately, this just didn’t work for my skin. This is good for all skin types, dry, combo, normal, acne prone, oily. Don’t t let anyone tell you that you shouldn’t use this just because you have oily or acne prone skin, in fact you might benefit the most from it! I would really appreciate if they would start filling the bottle all the way full or at least charge less for it. review_text: Been wanting to try this for months but was very nervous as my skin doesn’t like extensive skin care. My skin is happiest when I stick to basic skin care. I immediately applied my face oil to calm it down but yeah not all ’hyped’ products will work for everyone. I understand the concept of purging but this seem more like a case of aggravation to me. review_text: I find myself continuously impressed with how nice the Skinfix brand is! There is no direct coconut oil in here, but rather coconut-based ingredients; ingredients that typically work for most people, including those sensitive to pure coconut oil. I find it soothing as well, perhaps due to additions such as aloe.I’m overall very pleased and think this is yet another hit from the brand!

I received the Morning Skin Superpowder in exchange for my honest review of the product. I was super excited to try since I’ve heard of the Goop Brand and just finished their Netflix series that showed me how carefully they evaluate beauty and science in their products. These are single dose stick packs that you pour into your morning with eight ounces of water. Interestingly, the superpowder is indeed made up for super antioxidants that support beautiful skin including vitamin C, vitamin E, grape seed extracts, CoQ10, zeaxanthin and Lutein. It was easy to use, just poured it into my morning water and it tasted light in flavor—very citrusy. Not carbonated either, which I think is a huge plus and easier to drink. It made me feel good that I was drinking something that could help my body and skin glow. However, the experts say it takes eight to twelve weeks to start seeing results. I only received five samples—while it tasted good, but wasn’t enough product to really gauge if it worked or not. I do love the idea though. Goop prides itself on tackling beauty and wellness from the inside out and this product exemplifies that—saying that these antioxidants are able to reduce the negative effects of pollution, sun, and even stress. This is BY. FAR. my favorite bath soak I’ve ever used. I used a generous amount (probably about 1/4-1/3 of the container) but I feel like it’s worth it for what it did for my skin. product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: Because of my acne products, my face got severely dry during the winter. I had flaky dry patches everywhere, and my makeup made it worse, but I couldn’t just walk out the house without it... I was miserable. Since I’m always looking for a better skincare regime, I decided to find a toner. I wanted one without alcohol, because I was afraid my astringent would cause more damage to my skin. I was torn between 1 and 2 from Clinique, because normally I have oily skin, but considering how parched my face already was, I couldn’t dry it out any more, so I chose this. I didn’t even notice when my skin went back to normal, but it did. I use this 2 to 3 times a day. I’m hooked. Even now that my skin is mostly oily, this still gets the job done. When I run out I might choose the next one up, but this one did wonders. You feel the results the moment you put it on. It’s great right after the shower, before you get that tight feeling in your skin. It completely hydrates your face. And I recently discovered it does have alcohol... But at this point I don’t really care.

When I get pimples the live under the skin for a few days, growing bigger and redder. Sometimes they’re even painful. I put one of these patches on one of these almost-pimples and overnight it was half the size. After 3 nights of patches it was gone entirely. My husband has even started to steal these when he gets the errant pimple.

Wow wow wow! This is such a fantastic moisturizer! I cant believe I waited so long to try it out! It has peptides, lipids, hyaluronic acid, and lily root extract so it’s super hydrating and nourishing. It’s also really good at supporting the skin barrier. I love the thick, creamy texture! It’s perfect for everyday use for me (I have pretty balanced/sometimes a little oily skin). I also love that the container is reusable and you can buy refills!

review_title: Fresh and Moisturized skin in the morning!

review_text: Meh. Unfortunately, this didn’t really do anything for me. I was looking for a product to make me feel special, like a once and a while face mask type product. This isn’t really like a true mask, if that makes sense. You are not supposed to wash or truly wipe it off. It sits on the face and sinks in, like a moisturizer. Once on the skin though, it didn’t really feel “comfortable“ to let it skin on my skin for long periods of time, if that makes senses (and I have used other overnight masks and masks where you leave them your face for at least 10 minutes, if that makes sense. I still found this to be uncomfortable on the skin). It just didn’t feel nice on my skin, it felt sticky and not soft--like it felt like I was letting glue sit on my face. I don’t know how some people are able to sleep in it. My skin type is Normal, and I used to be an esthetician, if that helps anyone determine whether this will work for them or not. I was excited over the hype, but it didn’t do much at all for me and it wasn’t comfortable on the skin. In the future, I might re-buy the mini size of this if I am ever on an airplane, without access to a sink, or in an environment like that where the skin is in desperate need of moisturizer. I don’t mind thickness in creams, it just truly didn’t do much and didn’t feel nice once applied. I wanted to love it. But, this is why I love Sephora, for giving out such nice samples so that you can test & try and then spend your money on products that you feel really work for you and that you love.

I’m dealing with some stubborn acne lately. I opted to try this cleanser instead of a BHA product that worked in the past, La Roche’s Effaclar 2% gel cleanser. There’s no comparison between these products. This cleanser is not only significantly more expensive, but it doesn’t seem to be nearly as effective. It has no slip or lathering effect, requiring a large amount of product to be used to avoid excessive friction when rubbing it into skin. It definitely exfoliates, probably due in part to said friction. It had very little noticeable effect on active or developing acne. I switched back to my Effaclar cleanser and quickly noticed how much more effective it is, while using far less product with a less irritating process. I speculate that this poor performance could be due to packing too many active into a single cleanser, causing formulation changes that reduce the efficacy of the Salicylic acid, but I’m not an expert. I do know for sure that this was a waste of money.

review_text: It may not be the Holy Grail, but it definitely has been very helpful to me in repairing my severely compromised skin.

So for a while I thought that this might function as a slightly cheaper “dupe“ for Volition’s celery Green Cream. The marketing certainly makes it seem that way. Unfortunately I have been using it for two months and finally have to face the reality that it really isn’t working for my skin. The product has a very strong, albeit pleasant scent. It feels quite sticky on the skin, and takes a while to sink in. Personally, it makes me look a little too shiny. When I first started using it, I had a bit of a surge of breakouts, but figured that was purging from Mandelic Acid I started using a couple weeks prior. So I waited for that “purge“ to end. Unfortunately, it never did! Similar to a reviewer a few days ago, I developed a new kind of chin acne while using this. More than a dozen little bumps that never come to a head or go away. I also experienced plenty of almost cystic forehead pimples and a lot of clogged pores/blackheads in general. The texture of my skin became very rough using this. Typically my complexion is actually very clear, and I have never reacted to a product this negatively before. A couple days ago I caved and bought the celery green cream again, and my many pimples are already going away. So clearly this moisturizer was a complete failure for me... I hate to leave 1 star reviews, especially when the product works so well for so many people, but wow my skin looked bad after two months of this moisturizer.

this product doesnt really reduced my pore... it makes me breakout..

I experienced no irritation and the blackheads are already beginning to disappear! This is a good product to have to keep your skin smooth and those pesky blackheads away.

Or, you know, you could just wash your face or mist free tap water on your face.

review_text: Absolute Holy GrailBeen using this product for years and love how hydrating it keeps my lips. Would def recommend. have also introduced this product to all my friends and family.

Buying my second tube this sale... I love it and I am thankful to be a rouge member because it is a little pricy. Whenever my face starts to have a weird texture or just feels off, this 100% resets my face. I love!!

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I absolutely love that you can use this daily! I didn’t experience any peeling or anything which is usually what discourages me from trying retinol products. I will buy this again once I run out and will recommend it to my sister who suffers with texture issues as well.
product_name: Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide

review_text: Love this mask!! I love how cool it feels when you apply it every single time! Literally. Coming from someone who drinks redbull after redbull, this surprised me. review_text: I have combination skin and this light and silky cream worked great. You do not have to use much product, it is a lightweight moisturizer.
