It looks and feels smoother also. I am hoping the results continue, with the continual usage of this product. I highly recommend anyone and everyone to try this amazing anti aging product. ridiculous price for an item that has colour added. this product is gimmicky.

review_text: When Influenster notified me that I’d be receiving the Augustinus Bader Light Cream in exchange for my honest review I was confused. I routinely answer surveys indicating my skin concerns are dryness, dehydration, and aging. “Why would they send me a product who’s own website recommends for oily and combination skin?” I thought. I was sure I’d seen this product before in countless prestige skincare lines marketing “hydration” (not moisture) and typically too light, not moisturizing enough, creating a crackling effect under makeup as my skin rapidly absorbs whats there leaving a filmy pilly layer behind. The reality? I WAS WRONG. I’m pleasantly surprised by this light moisturizer. It’s been a great addition to my routine for a very hot and sweaty summer. I find the formula to be extremely lightweight, very hydrating and lightly moisturizing. If wearing foundation, I do have to prep with my Fresh oil infused serum underneath in order to prevent patchy dry makeup issues, but that’s just because my skin is chronically dehydrated and dry. With the serum under it, this moisturizer works great with makeup for me. I probably wouldn’t be able to use this during winter, but even my dry skin produces more oil and sweat in the summer, so this stuff is the perfect weight moisturizer. The only negative, as others have mentioned, is the package. The shape of the bottle is pretty, just impractical. I had to rearrange my routine to keep it in a drawer since it doesn’t stand up and thus cannot sit in my medicine cabinet with all of my other skincare products.

However, like other Herbivore products, the shelf life on this is precarious and it’s easy for bacteria and/or mold to grow in the bottle. I started to use a new product in addition to my Lapis oil that was supposed to cause some initial purging. I had a few bumps, but they went away quickly, and my skin was looking great, until one day I had cystic acne coming in, along with a bunch of small white bumps, and my skin looked ruddy. I quickly stopped using my new treatment, but nothing was improving. I was ready to go see a dermatologist, when I noticed there was a viscus yellow mold in the bottom of my Lapis bottle. After some investigation, I found that in addition to the Cloud Lotion, most Herbivore oils have the minimum amount of preservative, which means while they are usually okay, if you were to forget to screw the cap tightly one night or if the dropper came in contact with bacteria, there is a chance it could fester and grow. So, basically I was rubbing mold and bacteria into my skin twice a day...Within a few days of stopping the Lapis (and doing a lot of exfoliating and using retinol cream) my skin was looking much better and a few weeks out with some new products, my skin is back in a good place. I do love Herbivore oils - they do really absorb nicely and smell great, but I can’t really say they are worth the experience I went through. There are other “clean“ brands that are a bit more shelf stable that work just as nicely.

People looking at this serum are probably debating between The Inkey List (TIL) and The Ordinary (TO) Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%. I’ve tried both, so I wanted to compare/contrast between the two and offer my own experience. I have oily skin with visible sebaceous filaments, and I’m prone to blackheads and the occasional whitehead.Let’s start with the ingredient breakdown. Both serums contain a 10% concentration of niacinamide by volume. Both contain xanthan gum (a stabilizer that also helps oil and water mix), and both contain VERY hydrating antimicrobial alcohols that can be good for your skin - TO uses pentylene glycol, while TIL uses butylene glycol (“alcohol” in this sense refers to the chemical composition of these compounds - while it also fits the definition, we’re not dousing our faces in vodka here). This is where the similarities end. TO contains 1% Zinc (in a salt form, pyrrolidone carboxylic acid) which, in addition to regulating sebum production, also acts as a natural humectant, which means it helps your skin retain some of its natural moisture. TIL does NOT contain zinc whatsoever. It does, however, contain Squalane and Hyaluronic acid, as well as an ingredient called “Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate,” which is still being studied for its uses as a natural preservative because it has small amounts of salicylic acid. The data is still a bit inconclusive on that end, but butylene glycol acts as an antimicrobial agent anyway so it’s still shelf-stable.I used one full bottle of TO’s serum, applied nightly. I’ve been using TIL’s serum for 5 months and am currently using it. It’s HG. While I DO have shiny, oily skin, I don’t get a ton of whiteheads or cystic acne - that might be why I broke out from TO. The zinc might be too strong for me. I find TIL’s to be much more hydrating. My skin loves hyaluronic acid and TO does not contain any.People with heavier breakouts would probably love TO, but for oily skin and mild acne? This is perfect.
review_title: Better Than The Ordinary? A Comparison

Not for me. Maybe for our younger beauty consumers or for those that do not have significant signs of aging. Also - I have been using Fresh Overnight firming mask twice a week for a couple years. This cream is so similar in smell, texture and appearance - it doesn’t seem like a ’new product’ at ALL. - To me, it just seems like the product I already have - repackaged, renamed and marketed with new claims. What really took this product down was the packaging. The product leaks everywhere. I have to keep it in a separate ziplock bag no matter how much i tighten or keep in a cool dry place. I even put it in my mini fridge thinking it was the heat that caused it to melt. I cant help but feel my investment is wasted when the packaging allows for this to happen which leads me to a conclusion: for the effect of a minimal plumping and ‘pinky’ look the product is not worth the money when it leaks all over your counter

It leaves my skin feeling sticky and gross and within a couple days of using it, I had an acne problem. review_text: Wow, this is hands down the best cleanser in the world I’ve ever tried!!! I received a sample size from Sephora yesterday with my order and eagerly tried it out. I’m already a convert, because my skin never felt so clean, my pores never looked so small...overall, it’s just perfect, perfect! Can’t wait to see what it does for my skin in the long run.

Other Biossance products work well for me, especially the plain Squalane oil, but this one gives my sensitive skin a rash on my cheeks. I know many people complain about the smell, and I will admit it doesn’t have the best fragrance when you open the jar, but it goes away almost immediately after you apply it, so I don’t think that’s a big drawback. I’ve decided to use this on my hands and it has become one of my favorite hand creams! My hands are smooth and soft in the morning after applying at night before bed. I’m giving 2 stars because I wasn’t expecting a negative reaction on my face, but the rash goes away as soon as I stop using it so it can’t be that bad. review_title: Rash on cheeks, but nice hand cream

review_text: Best cleanser that I have used. Feels great on the skin, not drying at all, just a perfect clean feel :)

Most other brands give you about 4 oz of toner average, and with this one you get 8.6. Great deal!I love using this after cleaning my face, and I’m always disappointed when I forget to use it.This has done wonders for my complexion. However, I saw YTTP advertised and thought..hmm, this looks like it might be a cool new thing, I’ll try it out.Wrong! This does nothing. Maybe if it was $5 and someone didn’t wear any makeup at all? *Shrug* I don’t get the hype. I’ll stick with my $15 bottle of CeraVe.

As a male in his mid-20s with sensitive, dehydrated, oily and acne-prone skin, I’m always on the hunt for a moisturizer that leaves my skin hydrated, plump and balanced out. I got into a habit of reading ingredients before I buy items and I’ve noticed that this contains denat alcohol. review_text: I bought this in one of the value sets in the winter. I held off from using it for a couple months as I wanted to get through my other skin care value sets. After getting through the mini, I was hooked and wondered why I put it off for so long!! I have tried many other products for my big pores and bumpy skin. this product took the redness off of my cheeks just from the mini moisturizer. I read some reviews saying the amount of product isn’t worth the money, but I think a little goes a long way as the product spreads easily across the face and feels like water being absorbed into my skin. the only other products that made my skin as smooth were The Ordinary serums, but those were annoying to put on every night because i don’t like to spend a lot of time on my skin care routine at the end of the day. This one product fostered the same result as 3 The Ordinary Serums and my CeraVe moisturizer. I used to wear make up everyday, but this moisturizer makes me so confident in my own skin, I dont feel the need to cover up anymore and actually prefer not wearing make up now. This product converted me into a Tatcha fan and I will be trying the rest of their products, hoping it can replace an unnecessarily long skin care routine that use a bunch of different products. I even went out on a limb and spent $68 for the pore perfecting sunscreen. I have no regrets. I would say give it a go from one of their value sets, as i’m sure this doesn’t suffice for all skin types. But I think it’s worth the investment for a minimalistic, fast, and satisfying skincare routine. I even have to mention it comes with a cute little scooper on the lid if you don’t want to dip your finger in! LOVE IT!

Protini is so effective I think of it as more of a serum than a traditional moisturizer. Yes, it is unusually hydrating, but after using it for only about 2 weeks, I have found it has improved my skin’s resiliency and firmness, as well as my overall tone through redness reduction. I read on the brand’s instagram that the level of peptides in this product is too high to meet regulations in a lot of countries. Hence, it can only be sold in the US and a few other places.I previously used NIOD’s CAIS (for about two years), which is the only mega-peptide product I can compare it to. Although that is also a good product that gave me an immediate boost, the effects were more subtle and not particularly lasting.I switched to an all-DE routine almost a year ago, and now use all their products except Baby Facial (which seems unnecessary to me). After I made the switch, I found that I could tolerate regular use of a high level of tretinoin (.07) for the first time, and my skin was generally less reactive and more consistent. So I would recommend using the DE system as a whole if you can afford to. You only need a little of each product so for me it has proved to be cheaper than mixing a lot of high and low end products.I have been using a ReFa S Carat microcurrent roller to work on firmness issues and am hopeful that I will continue to see results now that I am using it in conjunction with the Protini. I would also recommend this combination if you are starting to see signs of sagging (like me).

review_text: I tried this balm on a couple of times at the store and was astounded at how my lips became literally perfect INSTANTLY- plump, smooth, moisturized, and pretty much perfect. A year later, I bought it after the price increase. The first couple of times using it was true love. Because it’s so pricey, I restricted my use to once a day only, in the morning before applying lipstick. I would use my regular restorative lip balm at night. My lipstick lasted forever, and it was as if I had done some treatment to my lips- they were just so full and lush! Here’s when the problem kicked in. In less than a week, my lips became EXTREMELY dry, cracked, peeling, and I just couldn’t move my lips! It really hurt that much! What I realized is that this product is mostly wax. It uses wax to form that perfect primer on your lips, which seals in moisture (whatever there already is), and preps lips for lipstick application. What it doesn’t give is moisture or any tangible benefit to your lips. Actually, it is ruining your lips in the long run. I tried to give a break to my lips (which took forever) and use the product again. Same result! What La Mer uses is a SMOKE AND MIRRORS effect to make your lips perfect from the first use- as we know, NO SUCH THING EXISTS. It takes time for benefits to develop. As you can imagine, I ended up returning this pricey lip balm and will never go back! It was by far the WORST lip product I have ever used. Listen to the negative reviews- you and your lips will hate this.

After my own intense research of “clean” products I decided to give this one a shot. I know the price will make you cringe and cry for a week, but honestly it’s worth every penny. After rinsing (I use a little silicone scrubby thing to help clean; I use it to rinse too, lightly skimming it over my face with water on it, removes all that ’residue’ people don’t like) my face felt....just perfect. I’ve been using it twice daily and love it. I think I need to try a Fresh toner (already have more face wash, moisturizer, and a mask in the mail), maybe mine is stripping too much oil off and CAUSING the small whiteheads and clogged pores idk. But this is worth the money it does what it says it’s going to AND is so gentle. I will repurchase when my bottles run out. Get the smaller size if you don’t think it’s all it’s cracked up to be. But if you’re like me, 30ish, oily problematic skin, and have tried what seems like EVERY product out there to get nice clear skin, try this. Can’t hurt.
review_title: didn't want to believe it could be so good...

review_text: I think this product would be a good cleanser for people who already have great skin that they would like to maintain. For me, with oily skin and a tendency for breakouts, it did nothing helpful. Just a fine cleanser no real strengths or weaknesses.

this serum is extremely hydrating. as the name suggests, it has a gel-like consistency - almost like a moisturizer instead of what you would consider a traditional serum. it has zero scent and would be perfect for sensitive skin. i received this product as a free sample but opinion is entirely my own!
I love this serum. It feels so good on the skin. I have dry skin. This product has helped with making it look so soft and smooth.
product_name: Vital Skin-Strengthening Hyaluronic Acid Super Serum

review_text: This is by far the best moisturizer I have ever used. I have dry, flaky, textured skin and this makes it feel nourished, soft, and smooth. I was blown away by how quickly it absorbs into the skin while deeply hydrating my skin at the same time. Such an incredible product!

I’ll start by saying that my love for Marula oil is never ending. I’ve used several brands, then decided to try The Ordinary’s Marula oil. I love it. I use it day and night, even keeping a bottle in my purse to use throughout the day to bring my makeup back to life. It’s better than any face most I’ve found. I thought that because I loved it so much, this oil, 10x the price of The Ordinary, must be 10x better. Wrong. As a matter of fact, I prefer The Ordinary. It sinks into the skin quicker, and I use less product. DE claims that because their oil is fair trade, it’s the best. I disagree. If you are using this oil and think there is nothing better, before you repurchase, try The Ordinary. If you have been eyeing this oil, but can’t get pull the trigger because of the hefty price tag, skip it. I love face oils, I’ve used them for years – even before all of the hype. I can put an oil on my face and know instantly if it’s a waste of money, or if I’ve just found a keeper. This, unfortunately, is not a keeper. I’m returning it, and when I do, I will tell all associates to invest in the cheaper option. If I know anything, I know skincare. It’s been a passion of mine since I was a teenager, over 20 years ago.
review_title: Great marketing for a subpar Marula oil.

review_text: This serum activator HAS ACTIVATED my quest for healthier, more glowy skin! I’ve been wanting to find a product that can help me in my skincare journey to more plump, moisturizer, firm skin. I’ve been using this product and I have seen a dramatic transformation take place and it’s beautiful everyone and their mother and grandmother needs this product to stay confident in their skin. This was gifted by Sulwhasoo
I love this product. It is great for the winter and summer and is super moisturizing without being oily. The only con is the price but it is worth it
product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer

review_text: I wanted to love this, since my combination skin can get so dry in the winter. Unfortunately, this lotion was so greasy. Like a lot of other people have mentioned, it doesn’t seem to sink in and penetrate the skin; it just sits on top of it for hours and leaves you feeling gloppy without actually helping your skin. Worst of all, after a week of using it, my entire face is covered in the worst break outs I’ve had in over two years. Definitely won’t be buying again, and no matter how dry your skin can get, I do not recommend this to people whose skin is any degree of oily (including combination) or acne-prone.
Didn’t help with balancing my oil skin and wearing make up

I got this as a free sample and initially didn’t think it would be that great because it’s a “lightweight” moisturizer and those are usually not very helpful for my dry skin. Just using this once, it is SO good! Had to purchase for myself!
review_title: Smells like a spa and is very hydrating!

review_text: Tried a Sephora product, which cause my acne to get worse. So, I decided to get this product.It was extremely drying to my face. It felt itchy in a few spots, but somehow, my acne wasn’t that much better than when I haven’t used this product. Bottom line, I had to return it.
product_name: Acne Solutions All-Over Clearing Treatment Oil-Free

review_text: I hate to be the one to give bad reviews, I really do, but this product just didn’t do anything for me. I have dark undereye circles gifted to me by my gene pool. They’re always there, but a lack of sleep exacerbates them. I tried the product in both circumstances. I like the rollerball because it lends a cooling effect, but the serum might just as well have been water. Sad! But returned.
product_name: All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage

review_text: I really wanted to like this. I love the idea of moisturizers with spf in it for quick morning application. Now, I’ve tried to make it work several times (especially cuz its not cheap). But, its a greasy oily mess. It highlights all my texture and pores. It has such a strong sunscreeny smell. I only gave it the 2 stars because there is no white cast. If you are looking at this because of the sunscreen, i’d just recommend using a separate sunscreen on top of your moisturizier (think shisedo, supergoop etc)
Have been using for a couple of weeks, sometimes 2x a day. See no marked improvement.
product_name: White Lucent Anti-Dark Circles Eye Cream

review_text: This cream left my skin a bit sticky, not really glowy in a good way. It’s also scented. I didn’t find it too hydrating for my combo skin given the cold weather, but I think this would work well for an oily skinned person or in the summer. I appreciate the refillable aspect but jars and sticking your fingers or a spatula into them is gross and less hygenic than a pump. This is oil free and didn’t aggravate my acne but I would not repurchase this product.
I haven’t seen an improvement in my neck area or dark spots. Will use till the end but will not purchase
product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Ultra Dark Spot Correcting Cream SPF 30

review_text: I have ance and this has helped me like no other product ever has I haven’t had one new pop up since I started using this and it’s helps heal and repair my skin

Took this to Barbados and used it a couple of times a day at the beach. I have very fair skin and with careful application, I did not turn red, as usual, and didn’t burn! Huge Shiseido fan. Wish Sephora had their full line in stores!
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protection Spray Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ For Face/Body

review_text: SkinFix is one of my fave brands for my dry sensitive skin and this cleanser takes the cake. It’s so milky, yet hydrating. When I rinse, there’s no right feeling after. Just soft hydrated skin. This is ideal if you generally find cleansers to be too harsh or if you prefer a silky feel after you cleanse. Great for your second cleanse in the evening or only cleanse in the morning!

I bought this looking for a good daily pre makeup oil and honestly it was eh. I have super dry skin and I found when I used it my skin actually felt more dry, I would have my makeup on for a few hours and my face would feel tight and dry and just very uncomfortable and I eventually realized it was this oil as it was the only thing different in my routine and when I stopped using it I went back to normal where my skin doesn’t feel tight or abnormally dry throughout the day. I was just going to keep it and then after about 3 weeks of not using it I decided $90 for something I’ll never use up bc I hate how it makes my skin feel is a waste and I returned it. Look into other oils..

Delivers. Whether skin is dry, stressed, fired up or other, this mask brings on a calm, delicious restoration. After removing, skin had a velvety feeling. Super lovely.It is quiet heavy, but I’ve experienced no breakouts or mille. Will absolutely buy again.

This product definitely does its job. It doesn’t leave any streaks or stains which is nice too. But for me, the smell is TERRIBLE! I don’t know why, maybe I’m the only one. Even if you wash your hands the smell still stays on. I hate the smell.

I received this product free from influenster in exchange for my honest review. This skin cream smelled great and made my skin feel super soft. It did not irritate my skin or make me break out, but I also didn’t notice a big difference in my pores.
I used this product consistently for over 90 days and saw zero improvement. I’m happy that others like it though but it’s not for me and my skin.

I originally purchased this product which came in a set of other Peter Thomas Roth acne clearing products. I had mild acne and was recommend this product by a sephora rep. This product was extremely harsh and striped my skin leaving it burning and dry. I used 80% of the product to ensure it wasn’t just the product “doing its magic“, when I was finished my mild acne was now intense. I went back to sephora and told a rep what I had been using and she was surprised that anyone had recommend this product to me because it is not meant for mild or hormonal acne! Don’t purchase this product if you have mild acne, there are way better purchases that can be made for half the price.
product_name: Goodbye Acne AHA/BHA Acne Clearing Gel Face Body Spot Treatment

review_text: I bought this product for its deep-cleansing properties and for that purpose, I did not like it. It is very drying and requires heavy moisturizing afterwards. It did seem to brighten my complexion after each use, but I found it to be slightly irritating on my sensitive acne-prone skin. If you’re looking for a decent deep-cleansing mask for oily skin, this isn’t it.
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I have been using AHA exfoliants for some time but lately have had more trouble with blemishes and breakouts. Because of that I was excited to try this product. It has a super smooth gel texture and a cute strawberry shortcake doll scent. It absorbed very quickly and layered well under my usual moisturizer. It is definitely a gentle product, which would be great for folks just trying out chemical exfoliants. For me, it might actually be a little too gentle. While I didn’t see any notable differences in my skin it was never irritating.
product_name: Strawberry Smooth BHA + AHA Salicylic Acid Serum

review_text: Although pricey, this does its job well and there’s just something I like about the tingly sensation, like it’s telling me everything will be alright the next day!
I have dry acne prone sensitive skin. This product was incredibly harsh and broke me out like crazy.

Best makeup cleansing balm ever. My skin is so sensitive. I was worried about trying this but once I did it was amazing. It melted away my makeup and my sunscreen and serums. It melts like butter on the skin. The scent is light, clean and not over powering. Its practically non scented. Seriously cannot be happier. Havent broken out in hives or pimples. It is seriously amazing. Will forever repurchase.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: I tried this free from influenster but didn’t notice any results and seemed to get some breakouts. im not sure why, it seems others have had good results. it could be that I didn’t see a big difference because I don’t have as much to correct yet.
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

review_text: I’m in my mid 40’s and was looking for a good moisturizer but found this is not worth the money. It’s very thick and heavy and hard to apply because it’s to hard and thick. Hard to spread it around
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: I bought this to freshen up my routine. This smells great and makes my skin feel clean. My husband also loves this product. I enjoy this and the exfolikate from the line. The only thing is my skin changes often, going from oily to dry depending on the season. I could see how this might be drying. I will continue to buy this product.

It’s definitely a lightweight moisturizer. So lightweight it feels basically like water and doesn’t actually moisturize my skin. It felt nice to put on but after a few minutes my skin felt dry again. It might work for someone else because of this but for $39 I was hoping for something more than just a pretty bottle. Kind of wish I never bought it. There are so many other moisturizers that are much cheaper and so much more worth it.
i have fairly dry skin. this mask is nice as a refresher and my skin feels soft and smooth after use. but its definitely not an intense moisture mask.

Really wanted to love this project. I use other Supergoop products so thought this one would be good as I love a glowy/dewy look. After using for 2 days I noticed my skin had 10-15 TINY white heads that seemed to be filled with oil? TMI but it is what it is. Anyways, stopped using it and my skin cleared back up. I rarely break out and this was the only product I was using on my skin when I noticed the acne. Such a bummer!
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: This toner has helped my skin SO much!! I started out by using it a few times a week to now daily and it has significantly helped to fade scarring, even skin tone, and has reduced the frequency of breakouts. its not drying at all and doesnt burn or anything, and I have incredibly sensitive skin. Absolutely worth the price 10/10
product_name: Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: I want to preface by saying I don’t have any severe under eye complaints, but for $64 I wasn’t too thrilled with this. I’m not opposed to investing in great products, but this felt very standard and normal. Applied nicely into the skin, but one pump was far too much product which I dislike - DE should be able to create packaging that helps me use their product correctly and efficiently. I didn’t see any brightening effect after finishing a bottle, and it sat fine under concealer but nothing to write home about. Overall, not a bad product, but not worth the cash and not something I’ll buy again. My quest continues!

I’ve been using for three weeks and haven’t noticed a difference. I thought I saw some new brightness at first, but whatever I did see has faded. I’ll continue to use and maybe I’ll see some results soon!
product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: Wow wow wow. Where to begin. I did not think I would ever be willing to spend this much for a moisturizer, but I think they’ve hooked me. product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I have never reviewed or repurchased a sunscreen until this one. It feels great, makes my skin glow, and doesn’t irritate my super sensitive skin.

review_text: a little luxury to have, will always have it on hand
review_title: purchase it over and over again

review_text: Leaves my face feeling fresh and clean every time!

At the end you had a sticky feeling that I don’t like it.

Very glossy, great sheer color that gives you that color after you eat a red lollipop. Smells great, but its more glossy than it is oily. It is more moisturizing than regular glosses, but it doesn’t give off the impression of an OIL.
One of my favorite lightweight moisturizers! I bring this with me when I travel to help make sure my skin stays hydrated and moisturized!

This product has a little thicker texture, which I prefer using at night. It is hydrating and helps add plumpness to my skin. I have only used it for 2 weeks and saw minimal to slight improvements. It does not irritate my skin which I like. I’ll have to continue using it to see more impactful results.

The skin around my eyes looks brighter and more rested after using Shaba Complex Eye Serum. It helps my bags under my eyes look lighter while it hydrated my skin and erases fine lines. I use it morning and night to help look and feel my best.

Broke my out... I rarely ever react this badly to skincare, but something in this caused little bumps to form on my forehead, cheeks, and jawline. Wanted to love, but unfortunately going to have to return this. I’m sure it works for some, however! I’d say give it a shot and see how it works with your own skin!

I don’t know what it is about this product, but it’s the only eye cream I’ve ever used that actually moisturizes my dry under eyes and lids, keeps them that way, and doesn’t pill up or get weird under makeup. Nothing compares.
review_title: Surprisingly, the best eye cream I've ever found.

review_text: Don’t spend your money on this product. Just don’t work…just finished the bottle and I don’t see any improvement.

With a try if you’re a fan of the brand, but not the first I’d grab based on competitor serums.

i use this every day and it makes my makeup look so dewy and pretty. a must have for summer and for people who love the no makeup look
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

I used this cream for about 1 month but I stopped.
Great moisturizing serum. Restocked multiple times. Only thing to complain about is the price (but that’s more of my poorness problem).
Got a sample. It really didn’t sink into my skin like I expect any oil to do to a certain extent.

I received this product from Influenster to try. I’ve been using retinol/retinoids for about a year now, so I didn’t have any irritation from the product. I liked the consistency of the serum. For the best results, I think you would need to use it for at least 3 months

review_text: So hydrating. I have dry skin especially in the summer and I use this every morning and it has made the best difference.

review_text: I love this moisturizer. It moisturizes my skin without leaving that oily residue most products leave on my face. My face feels soft and fresh afterwards.

I don’t have a dry skin but this product isn’t hydrating enough for me, I didn’t realized it until I tried to put makeup on and saw how dry my skin was... I would not recommend for dry skin AT ALL. But I would recommend it to you if you don’t need that much hydratation.

Amazing product! Definitely noticed a different right away. Sunday Riley is a fav around our home and this product doesn’t disappoint! I love the light weight feel of this eye cream. I also really like the fact that it doesn’t have a heavy smell! 5+ stars

I have been using this for the past week and I love this eye cream. It’s light and keeps my under eye area feeling firm. I have seen some slight improvement with less wrinkles already. I will definitely continue using this

THIS IS MY FAVORITE SUNSCREEN EVERRRR it’s colorless & scentless but it leaves your skin looking so soft! I decided to try it because my neutrogena sunscreen was making me break out and I saw this one is clean. I willKeep purchasing this sunscreen! It’s also great under makeup!

I really like this so far. It doesn’t have a strong scent which is great. Absorbs nicely, and doesn’t leave the skin looking greasy nor does it feel like it’s just sitting on the skin-like other moisturizers I’ve used. I have super sensitive skin and this so far hasn’t bothered me.

product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Feel clean after washing my face but this dried parts of my skin (I have combo skin) so I don’t use this everyday.
feel like I’m spraying oil on to my face. The feeling is so weird, not refreshing at all and it smells like grass.
I really didn’t see a difference in this after using it for weeks

Not a fan - I’ll use the little tub I got but I will not be buying any more of this product. It starts out quite lovely! The balm smells good, very fresh and citrusy and just glides over the skin. Getting it off is a nightmare. The description says that you can splash water to get it off but ohhh no. review_title: High expectations, even higher let down

review_text: Note: I don’t use this as a daily moisturizer. It’s way too greasy and thick to use under makeup. review_title: Doesn't live up to the hype

Holy grail daily cleanser!! Let me start of by saying that is the best cleanser I have ever tried!!! Smells very very heavily. I’m almost done with my container and I still haven’t exactly figured out the amount to use. Too much leaves you very greasy and too little gives you no moisture. Will not repurchase!
product_name: Superscreen Daily Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++

review_text: LOVE this cleanser!!! As an oily skinned girl I’ve never come across a cleanser that doesn’t dry out my skin and this does the trick! Totally going to invest in this again!

review_text: Got this in my Play! box and was really happy because I was considering trying this for my next eye cream. I haven’t noticed any difference in my circles or puffiness though.

Have never used a primer before. Never used to wear foundation except on special occasions. Courtney asked all the right questions and scored a winner with this product. Two in one moisturizer and primer, very light feeling, and smells phenomenal. Very happy with this product.
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: I love this serum! It really is a powerhouse for my acne-prone/scarred face. I’ve almost used one entire bottle and I have noticed a subtle improvement in my skin’s texture. I prefer this over the popular niacinamide dew drops because it still creates a beautiful glow on my skin while treating it to some amazing ingredients. I also feel that it leaves my face less sticky. I definitely recommend! My only gripe would be that if I use two pumps per use and use twice per day, I feel like the bottle disappears way too quickly for $40.
product_name: Strawberry Smooth BHA + AHA Salicylic Acid Serum

review_text: I got this in a value set and now that Sephora no longer carries the set, I’ll have to leave my comment here. This was the major thing in that set but was the one I liked the least despite it was kinda fun to use. With the suggested amount of usage, I had to change the tissue 3 times in order for the magnetic powder to not accumulate too much and tear the tissue. And once you get some magnetic powder onto the magnet, it’s stuck forever. So it’s a bit messy to use and the fun wears out pretty soon. The residual oil left on the face smelled metallic and was greasy in the most unpleasant way, so much so that I wanted to wash it off right away. Nonetheless I massaged it in, but didn’t put on any other moisturizer afterwards as suggested bcuz it felt too heavy and unbreathable already. To me, the instant smoothening effect was not due to any changes in the skin but the part of the residual oil that couldn’t be absorbed by the skin. The second morning my face was back to its normal state, not feeling extra moisturized or smoothened, but at least no breakout. So 3 stars for being a no benefit no harm product and 1 star off for the hassle in taking it off.

This product is BEAUTIFUL. Gives the perfect canvas for makeup application. My foundation applies flawlessly to it!! It is lightweight and a little goes a long way with this product! I will say I’m not crazy about the smell of it. But it most definitely doesn’t deter me from using it. I received this product for free for reviewing purposes, but that never affects my review!
review_title: Flawless canvas for foundation!! YOU NEED THIS
product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer

review_text: I wanted to love this but it made me break out like crazy! It’s very rare that I react to a product but this one surprised me. On the positive side it smells nice... but clearly that’s not why someone would purchase a product like this at this price point. Unfortunately it went right back to the store.

I recently received a beauty service and this was recommended to me. I bought it after the service because I was in need of a toner. After using it for one week, my cheeks were covered in red bumps and patches. I had acne all over my chin. I hadn’t had such bad skin since I was in my early teens. Returned.
product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner

review_text: I never write reviews but I felt like this product truly deserves it because it did wonders to my skin and I will never be without it again. I have rosecea. My checks were always red and I had little bumps on my forehead that would never go away. I have clear skin now and very little to no redness. I stopped using this product for 3 days. My skin went crazy and broke out in bumps again. It took 2 days to get it clear again. Buy it you won’t regret it!!!!
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I’m a huge fan of this sunscreen! I used it as a base to my makeup for a summer day and my face was kept oil free and free of a sunburn. It didn’t have a scent so that was really nice also.
product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42

review_text: Yes! Amazing My pores are looking small. Amazing fragrance it’s natural. My skin glows.
product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Serum

review_text: I receive a sample size of this product for Influenster. I have oily skin and this sunscreen really works with your skin to feel as weightless as possible! It seemingly disappeared right as I rubbed it in and didn’t have the strong smell of regular sunscreen. I love that it is a powerful SPF and that it is so light and workable with make up! Highly recommend!
product_name: The True Cream - Aqua Bomb Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50

review_text: Smells like baby powder. No thanks. Cleanses well, but I can not stand the smell. I’m not usually bother by fragrances but this is terrible.
product_name: The Cult Classic Purifying Face Cleanser

review_text: I’ve been interested in trying bakuchiol but never had the impetus to do it. Then I found this product which has bakuchiol AND SPF! Amazing! I love that I can pop this on in the morning and it works all day to improve my skin’s elasticity and texture. Definitely recommend!
review_title: A great piece to my daily routine
product_name: Daily Dose Bioretinol + Mineral SPF 40 with Bakuchiol

review_text: I bought this product after seeing other reviews. I needed something that went on light and stayed on for more than just a few minutes. I love the smell and I love the way it goes on. I don’t have anything bad to say about this product really but it seems to be almost do the same as a regular tube of Chapstick.

I wrote a review on the serum. Pretty much the same here. Don’t waste your money on this it doesn’t work. All the rave 5 star reviews are from people who were literally gifted this product for an “honest” review. I actually spent my money on this and can tell you it doesn’t work. Made absolutely zero difference with my skin. No changes. Buy something else, there’s plenty of products that work. Watch out for those reviews that are all made by people who didn’t even pay for this stuff. 2 stars for not irritating my sensitive skin. That’s about all it did.
product_name: Even Smoother Glycolic Retinol Resurfacing Peel Pads

review_text: I liked the daytime serum, felt like my skin looked more plump after using. The night oil was too greasy for me and made my pores look a lot bigger. Will probably return this set
product_name: Multivitamins 15% Vitamin C + Retinol Mini Set

review_text: I love that this brand doesn’t add synthetic fragrances to their products! The consistency was familiar. It almost reminded me of a drugstore face cleanser. I didn’t notice a difference using it, other than it cleaning my face. Price point is amazing for the size of product.
I liked the way this felt and smelled! It absorbed really quickly and I felt like my skin glowed after two weeks :)
product_name: 15% Vitamin C + Clean Caffeine Energy Serum

review_text: Received a sample and my 16 year old daughter tried it. She does not have sensitive skin...occasional break outs, but nothing major. She took it off after a couple minutes because it was burning her face and she said it smelled like chemicals and paint. She washed it off and her skin was red/pink. Maybe she is allergic to an ingredient, but this has never happened with any other face masks she has tried.
product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask

review_text: St. Tropez always wins the self tanner game. This mouse left me perfectly bronze (not orange) after a shower. I definitely noticed that this went on smoother than other tanners I’ve tried. I would definitely try this!

Really wanted to love this product as so many people do. Tried it 2 times and both times made my face red and splotchy within 10 minutes of applying. Also really didn’t like the smell. Texture was nice though.

It broke out on my t zone so bad. I was horrified. I couldnt believe it and i keep trying a few times more just to make sure that the serum is the culprit. I was sad that my skin reacting so bad with it. Avoid tzone area. Cheeks feels good though.

This stuff really does balance dry and oily patches, so it’s great if you have combination skin. You only need the tiniest bit and it works up into a lovely, luxurious lather. It smells really minty, so it wakes you up in the morning. My only complaint is it’s slightly too drying and tightening for me to use on a regular basis during the autumn/winter season.
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: This product is great. Just using it helps me with oil control throughout the day, but it’s not over-drying. I would definitely buy it again.
product_name: All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap

review_text: I’m obsessed with this serum. I love the ingredients and how it makes my skin feel every time I use it! I apply it after washing my face in the mornings and before the bed, following with my moisturizer. Great results in such short time.
product_name: First Care Activating Serum 25th Anniversary Limited Edition

review_text: Unfortunately, I have very little love for this product. Like many others, I had trouble dissolving the product into water. It did finally dissolve completely after frequent stirring over several minutes. The taste is less than interesting, and it really was not something I enjoyed. I don’t see the point of this product already and because of its poor performance, it’s safe to say I’ll never be buying it.

I have been dying to try a product with retinol in it! I am so excited to try this one. Its only been a day or two, but the serum is smooth and goes on so nicely. The reviews are amazing from this product so I can’t wait for the results. I received this product as a free sample but all opinions are my own.
One of the best I could have!

I wasn’t too thrilled on how the toner made my skin feel after applying it - I felt like my skin was not feeling refreshed afterwards, like it had a thin layer of something on it. But combined with the cleaners, the toner and the lotion, this has helped my skin a lot. “I received this product as a free sample“

I was excited to try this chemical SPF, but unfortunately it’s not for me. It’s advertised as a tinted moisturizer with SPF which is fine, but the texture and scent is very much like a mineral body sunscreen. It’s thick and doesn’t spread smoothly so there is a bit of tugging on the skin. The tinted moisturizer coverage is buildable (I tried two layers) and it does give a nice dewy finish. However, I feel that it does darken a bit after drying down. I’d prefer stick to my Korean sunscreens and opt for a BB cream or lightweight foundation if I need the coverage. I can see how this could be a great option for travel / on the go, but you will still need to apply additional SPF!
product_name: SHIKULIME Color Control Oil-Free Moisturizer SPF 30

review_text: Obsessed, my friends and I are in love with serum and it’s soooo inexpensive!!! Super gentle and good for sensitive skin too :)

I used this product every night for a week. First off, I noticed that the product absorbed very quickly. This is a good thing when it come to putting on a moisturizer after, but made it difficult to spread over the face. This lead to using more product then necessary. I also didn’t notice any difference in my skin after using this product. My skin looks and feels the same. I do know that it did not cause any irritations or breakout. Overall for me, this product was a miss, just an extra step in my skincare routine that didn’t add any benefits or do anything for me.
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I really wanted this to work, and have had success with Moon Juice products in the past; however, this made me more anxious, jittery, and nauseous even when I took one pill I stead of two. Thankful for Sephora’s amazing return policy, this definitely did not work for me.
When I opened it the smell so horrible..totally disappointed with this one..I don’t think so I’m going to buy again.
Amazing ! Just purchased from website and luv it...
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Too bad I got a defected razor otherwise I’d love this. It works well but I can’t replace the blades. I even followed directions, and ended up breaking my nail trying to take out the razor. I can’t even exchange it because of the 60 day return policy. Never buying this one again. Thanks Sephora
I bought 3 single pack SK-II masks. They are so fresh with 2018 manufacturing lot code. Very good for travel.
Great product. Evens out redness and face feels smoother. Will be purchasing again and again!
product_name: Cicapair  Tiger Grass Camo Drops Color Corrector SPF 35

review_text: I was gifted by herbivore thier new nova Vitamin C Serum. This is jam packed with Vitamin C and Tumeric to brighten and hydrate your skin. It is super creamy and instantly absorbed into my skin. My skin is left glowing and bright!
product_name: Nova 15% Vitamin C + Turmeric Brightening Serum

review_text: I’m so sad while I’m writing this as I wanted to love this product. Unfortunately, this product has made my lips so much worse than they were to begin with. Initially this product feels promising but once it wears off my lips are super dry, feel extremely chapped & flaky. I’ve never had a lip product do this & my skin isn’t necessarily sensitive either.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This moisturizer was pleasant and applied easily. However it was not moisturizing enough for my skin in Midwest winters. I have not not noticed any differences in the short time I have used it.
product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: The TL neck cream plus does the job, I think. It’s medicated and you only have to use a small amount when applying to the neck and jawline area. I’m still in the middle of using this product but so far what I notice is the skin under the chin shrinking and making the jawline tighter. Overall, happy with the product.
product_name: Mini TL Advanced  Tightening Neck Cream PLUS for Firming & Brightening

review_text: I was really excited about trying out this serum as it has a lot of great reviews. I have dry skin under my eyes and unfortunately this didn’t do much for that nor my fine lines. To me it’s not worth the price.. I’d rather spend double that for something that actually works for me. I recommend to sample it before spending your money to see if it works for you.
product_name: Squalane + Peptide Brightening & De-Puffing Eye Gel

review_text: It feels gentle on your skin. A small amount goes a long way! Your skin feels hydrated through out the day!
product_name: The Cream Cleansing Gel with TFC8 Gentle Cleanser

review_text: Completely changed my skin. I’ve had oily skin, cystic acne, large pores, etc my whole adolescence & adult life. This product has completely changed my skin. My niece said my skin looks great & my little holes are gone. It’s worth every penny!!
product_name: Goodbye Acne  Max Complexion Correction Pads

review_text: I wanted to love this product, but I’ve been using it for nearly half a year like every night, and I’ve seen no improvement. I get a very dry nose area, and this didn’t help hydrate at all. Only bonus is I liked the way it smelt! Hard finding nice night creams that smell great. I sadly wouldn’t buy again :(
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: After using this product, my skin feels so hydrated with a beautiful glow. 10/10

The first thing I noticed improving immediately was that my nose is not red! It diminished the redness quickly. I’ve only been using it for a week, so I can comment on the appearance of my wrinkles or lines yet.

Wanted to love, but this did absolutely nothing for me. Two stars were given because it isn’t too harsh on the skin (no peeling, redness, irritation) Product does sting a little but that about the extent to its effects. It also has a weird (slightly unpleasant) smell, but it doesn’t linger for long. Note: I used ¾ of the bottle before writing this review.
product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I tested this sunscreen for a couple of weeks and I found that I don’t enjoy the application process much. It doesn’t glide easily on my face and it does look white until I rub it in really well. After it warms up with my skin and sits for a bit, it does blend better into my face and the white cast is barely noticeable at that point.I also find that foundations don’t look natural or smooth when I use them over this sunscreen. It causes patchiness around my nose and makes pores look bigger in that area when applying cosmetics over it.However, I do think it works much better when not wearing makeup over it. I will use it on days when I am going hiking or performing outdoor activities that don’t involve wearing makeup.
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Yes the warming sensation is sensationally amazing, and could be gimmicky. However! It totally works!!! My face instantly cleaner and refreshed. It definitely gives me an extra pep to my step. I love it. Would purchase again…and again...and again!

I dont normally write reviews, but I am absolutely involve with this product. I have combination skin and rosacea around my cheeks and I’ve occasionally used this the past two weeks and it has evened out my skin, its crazy... I highly recommend you give it a try!

This VitC has a rather oily consistency despite it being oil-free (check out Deciem website for more detailed info), that to my surprise, my really dry skin actually appreciates. It dries down eventually (a bit longer than my other watery serums) but keeps me moisturized, and is great under makeup – it tames down my dry patches. Be careful of interactions with other active ingredients. I made the mistake of using AHA one day before using this and my face reacted horribly. The Deciem website lists the no-no interactions when using this (including AHA), so do give it a read cause it’s very informative! To compare, The Ordinary’s Ascorbyl Glucoside VitC was fine to use with AHA/BHA, but don’t do it with this one.
review_title: Love it, but be careful of mixing w/ other actives

review_text: This is a good basic moisturizer. I use mine in the am and it does very well under make-up. It absorbs nicely and doesn’t feel like I am suffocating my skin. Because it is a more basic moisturizer I use The Ordinary hyaluronic acid first for some deeper hydration. All in all its a good daytime moisturizer for a great price.
I didn’t mind the corse exfoliation, but I had an allergic reaction. Red bumps all over. Had to return.

I have skin that gets very oily at certain times of the year. I got this lotion as a sample and really like it. It didn’t break out my sensitive skin, smell was light and I didn’t have to blot my face throughout the day like I have done with other lotions. After I try out my other samples I may buy this, the only thing holding me back is the price tag, a bit too expensive for lotion IMO.

A for packaging. vitamin c is a very unstable ingredient and can go bad very quickly when exposed to light or air. with that being said, i’m shocked at the amount of products with dropper or clear glass packaging. so in that regard, i appreciate that this is a pump and at least is not see-through. i’ve been using it for about a month and it’s still good. (vitamin starts to darken to a reddish brown once it’s gone bad.) i only gave an A (instead of A+) for packing though because i wish there was a little more flexibility with the pump; getting 1/2 pump is basically not possible. as for the product, again A for the vitamin C. i noticed my dark spots visibly improving. i probably won’t repurchase though because it makes me pretty shiny/greasy by the end of the day. i think you’re supposed to still apply spf on top of this which sorta negates the combination for me since i prefer to have a minimal routine (and further makes me shinier haha).would recommend as an actual vitamin c serum, not so much for spf purposes. (seems like just a bit of bonus spf.) iirc you really need to load up on your spf product for it to count, and considering how shiny this makes me with one pump, i will not be repurchasing.
review_title: not my fav, but good source of vitamin c
product_name: Daily Dose Vitamin C + SPF 40 Sunscreen Serum PA+++

review_text: This and the SA cleanser saved my skin! I got an awful, full-face breakout from a new moisturizer I tried and had tiny little bumps all over my face. I was recommended this and my skin has gotten so much better in only 2-3 days! Amazing product, a little goes a long way, price is great, isn’t sticky at all, and I’ve noticed a difference in my oily skin. I used to use The Ordinary niacinamide which I found VERY sticky, but this one is awesome.
review_title: Great, way better than The Ordinary!

review_text: I read the reviews that it left your skin hydrated. I decided to try it and It did the opposite for me. It really dried out my skin. It also has a strong fragrant smell which I didn’t like. This product did not work for me.

I use this every night and morning! My skin before had been irritated after hair removal in the morning because of my PCOS, and this has helped sooo much! And my pores in my T-zone are smaller, plus my skin isn’t oily at the end of the day like it was before. I love this toner!
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: Honestly can’t tell the difference?! :/ but with So many good reviews I’m looking forward to keep testing it for a longer time to see the results. I have good skin luckily so sometimes its hard to tell
product_name: Liquid Gold Exfoliating Treatment with Glycolic acid

review_text: The active ingredient is not salicylic acid.. its God’s tear drops because that’s the only explanation for how amazing this stuff is! Face cleared up in 2 days of using this. I can’t and will not live without this product. I can’t wait to buy the rest of the set!

This product feels luxurious and extremely moisturizing on the skin without being too heavy. The scent is fresh and relaxing but it is not too overwhelming. I definitely felt rejuvenated after using this product and look forward to making it a more permanent part of my nightly routine.
I read reviews about it and expected a lot from it, it didn’t really hydrate my skin (and my skin isn’t even that dry) I won’t be repurchasing.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: YTTP has the most incredible line of products, I have been amazed with every single one, and this is no different. My skin thanks you! This sleep mask is awesome! Such an easy end of night routine (and it smells nice!) Apply before bed and add a couple drops of the hydrate
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: this moisturizer is my absolute favorite! i have very oily skin and this keeps me matte but i never feel dried out! my skin is baby soft and not shiny <3 i pair it with a glycolic acid toner and my skin has never been better!! a little goes a long way and i make it last even longer by using a little of this and a little aloe to combat my redness! i would recommend it to anyone with oily skin it’s a little pricey for the amount but worth every penny i feel like with skincare it’s ok to spend a little more if u can and nothing has ever worked for me as well as this!
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: This is such a fun product!! I loved mixing the activator with the powder to get the most effective results. The serum is lightweight and not irritating. I did have to use more than just one pump, but overall I think it’s been working well the last week. I do see my skin brighter and more even. Is it worth the $78 - eeeeh I don’t think so.

It doesn’t moisturizes enough in my opinion maybe i need to use more but at the same time it cause my blemishes to appear more red and stingy... Different for every skin type also, the smell is really strong. maybe some will like it but I don’t for sure

My skin was great before I started using this stick serum 2 weeks ago. On my first application, I was a little concerned about the product feeling more like a balm than an thin serum... and I was right. Here I am two weeks later, writing a review while 2 giant zits are sitting on my face in all their redness. Even though I will be returning this, I still want to mention that drier skins than mine might love it – it’s totally fragrance free, mess free and SO quick to apply... It’s just not for me.

I wanted to love this serum, as it has gotten excellent reviews and sounds like a great formula, but unfortunately my skin disagreed with this. I broke out and continued to break out as I used it, which stopped as soon as I discontinued use of the MRC. I also found that, combined with my DE Framboos serum, it pilled big time and I felt like my serum was essentially being wasted by pilling off of my face in large flakes. Not for me. Sad face.
review_title: I wanted you to be the one...
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: I was so disappointed by this product it did absolutely nothing after six weeks of use. i don’t have acne per se, but i have bumps ALL over my forehead. many reviews claimed to help these, so i made the splurge. for being so overpriced im really upset it did so little
product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask

review_text: The texture isn’t as fine/micro as I thought. It does a decent job of exfoliating but I found this to be quite drying for my skin, even after 1 use. Definitely will use it up as a body/hand exfoliant though!
product_name: Exfoliating Revitalizing & Energizing Caffeine Micro Polish

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. I am a huge fan of gel formulas since I am oily/combo (and this formula is best suited for my skin type). I find gel work best for me for daytime (in PM I prefer something a bit heavier since I use acids). This is a fantastic light yet very hydrating moisturizer. It layers extremely well with my other products. Just like the rest of the Farmacy line - the ingredient list is extremely clean and skin friendly. Great addition to this fantastic line!
product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya

review_text: I wasn’t very impressed with the Microderm Exfoliator. For that price I expected a lot lol. I didn’t really notice any real difference to my skin. I did like how fine it was grounded, and it seemed more gentle than other microdermabrasion treatments. Honestly if it was cheaper I would probably be a lot more forgiving but at $150 I expect miracles lol!
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: I was gifted this product complimentary from hourglass cosmetics in exchange for an honest review. So far, I’ve really loved using this product. I noticed my skin looked brighter after using it and will continue to try it.

I really like how smooth and easy it glides on my skin. I have smile lines so I apply it there and under my eyes. It dries fast and I feel like it makes my skin smoother and more plump. I get Botox and filler so I’m not sure if it helps with fine lines. I’m only 36 but I was a smoker and I’ve overused tanning beds for years. But I’ve also been using anti aging products since I was 20, to help retain my collagen and youth... sorta working. This serum feels very luxurious and I will continue to use it after my sample is used up. Been about 4 weeks now. My all time favorite face product though is Loccitaine divine youth oil. Goes on same way, but that one actually made my lines and dark spots disappear.

review_text: This made my skin so soft, smooth, and bright at night.
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I bought the sample size first. A little goes a long way, but after three weeks I hadn’t noticed any results. I decided to finish out the bottle, and lo and behold, right smack at the fourth week, my skin cleared up and my discoloration (mild) disappeared! My complexion has never been better. I’ve stopped buying and trying other skin products. There’s no need!

This is such a great serum!! It’s a pretty good price for a serum and it’s a great size. I’ve been using this everyday for about a month and my skin feels really good, very soft!! I received this item for free for reviewing purposes from Influenster.
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: I really wanted to love this product after reading such rave reviews, but after trying it only two times, my skin was not happy. review_text: I was sent this to try before their launch, I have oily acne prone skin with from texture from breakouts and congestion. I’ve used this daily in the am for about a week and noticed slight improvement in my skin texture and much more radiant skin.

review_text: This eye cream is super super light weight and feels so good on the skin. I was skeptical at first because I am fairly young but, let me tell you, I could tell a difference on my young skin!

review_text: I just keep buying this.

review_text: Has a strong perfume smell and made my sensitive fair skin red + hot. Would not recommend.

review_text: This does nothing for my skin. It doesn’t make my sensitive acne prone skin react in any way but I don’t wake up with any noticeable differences. I don’t know what the hype is about.

review_text: So refreshing and gives the skin a gorgeous glow

This cream actually dries my skin and smells too strong of SPF

review_text: I waited a month or more to try it before I wrote this review. Little bit of a background of me. I have struggled with acne since my teen years. I’m an adult now and still struggle with it. Fast forward today I have horrible awful hyperpigmentation. Deep dark ones to add. I have been trying to find products to help with my issue for a very long time. So when I saw this product and saw what it was for I immediately had to try it. I mean what do I have to lose. Right? When I received in and opened it I liked that I found tons of details literally inside the box . Like how long it would take for this product to work and see results. That same night I received it, I wash my face, did everything I usually do in my normal nightly routine. The scent does smell a little funky but its subsidies immediately. It’s no big deal. Use half a pump because it says to apply a thin layer. So when everything is done I go to bed and go to sleep. HERE IS THE KICKER FOR ME! I saw a difference in my skin the next morning. I couldn’t believe my eyes. The smallest hyperpigmentation scars that I have had there faded. Not a 100% but I would say around the 60% faded. BUT. . . . As soon as I would wash my face with the most gentle cleanser I could feel the product being washed away and then I see the scars again. I don’t understand. Maybe I’m doing something wrong maybe this product isn’t for me but it could be for you. if you have small scars not deep dark ones like me. I am going to finish the bottle and then see what happens.
For some reason, when I apply this, it pills & creates this instant mask of dead skin that is horrifying. Not experiencing that with any other moisturizer ever, it’s so weird

TO USE: I squeeze a little bit of the product into the palm of my hand, then use a finger from my other hand and dab where necessary. **This is the best method for me!** I tried using a cotton swab/q-tip but it’s not as effective as the “lotion” ends up soaking into the q-tip completely. RESULTS: Works effectively for new bumps and breakouts if applied within a day or two. It takes up to four days for anything new to go away on my dry skin. As for my bump on my finger that has been around for a few months: it has drastically decreased in size after regularly using this product a few times a week. Sometimes I apply it several times a day. I’m very happy with the results so far. I have been using it for over a month now and I am only 1/4 way through the bottle.If you can get past the scent and figure out an application technique that works for you, then I think this product is worth every penny and you definitely get your money’s worth and you should see results! review_text: I have been using this moisturizer everyday for a year and a half which is enough time for me to give a proper review. I recommend this for dry-combination skin because it repairs flaky skin/dry patches and doesn’t aggravate acne. I would not recommend this for those with oily skin types because this product does nothing to help minimize the oil on your skin. In other words, there are better moisturizers that will both moisturize your face and keep control of shine/oil. It isn’t the most hydrating moisturizer in Sephora, but it is the most hydrating moisturizer I have used that will not break me out or worsen acne. My skin is prone to clogging too and this product does not clog pores. This month I have started a new skin care regime (that involves retinol) so I do not use this daily anymore. However, when I get hormonal acne, I do switch back to this moisturizer until my acne clears up. This is because I know 100% that I can use this on top of my pimple-covered skin without fear of my break out getting worse.I’m the type of person who prefers to use moisturizers instead of primers. I would only recommend using this under make-up if you have dry skin. For any other skin type, your make-up might get cakey if you don’t give it enough time to absorb into the skin. You can also still use it in the day time (there’s no ingredient that would require you to only apply at night). I used this both day and night with no problem (but made sure to wear sunscreen on top of it during the day).
This really didn’t do much for me. Although I only used it once and it left a small radiance, I couldn’t get past the texture. This was so liquidy to me that I didn’t enjoy applying it to my face.
