I didn’t love the tacky feeling that lingered on my skin for some time after application, and I did notice some extra zits after regular use (I never break out, so I have to think it’s from using this). On the fence about recommending.
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: I hated the smell of this product. The fragrance is so strong and lingers for a long while after use. I usually can get over smells, but I couldn’t for this product. The packaging is nice, the texture of the cream is good, and it does sink into the skin nicely. I don’t think that it is worth the price and I probably wouldn’t buy it again even if it was fragrance free. My skin didn’t look or feel any better using it. I also like my “night” moisturizers to be a little thicker.

Not worth it. Woke up with drier skin then normal and I’m a combination skin type. Not worth the price tag and returned. I did use it three times just to make sure and drier every morning. No thanks! I love DE but this ain’t it.
So far, so good. Goes on effortlessly and is not greasy. Great product!
product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum

review_text: I was gifted by glow recipe the new watermelon glow niacinamide dew drops recently!I honestly have loved these dew drops! They work great even for my oily skin. I add a few drops in my morning moisturizer and it gives me a light with in glow. They never make me greasy looking and my make up seems to last longer through the day. Definitely a new favorite product!

Amazing hybrid product! Sunscreen and moisturizer in one! It has a light sweet melon scent, feels great on the skin, no sticky, doesn’t leave a film. Leaves you with a nice glow! It’s truly great and you can get refills!
product_name: Hydra Vizor Invisible Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 Sunscreen with Niacinamide + Kalahari Melon

review_text: I adore this sunscreen because it gives my face such a lovely glow. I’m not required to wear makeup! I urge you to give it a try and be impressed! It doesn’t clog pores, doesn’t cause breakouts, and isn’t oily. Simply a natural radiance
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: This made my skin so smooth and glowy! It stings when applying it but the results were great. I only use it at night time 1-2 times a week to make sure I don’t dry out my skin. But I noticed slight improvements immediately.
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: I had really high hopes for this product, with very problematic skin I thought hey maybe this would work. It did not. Very drying, sticky and hard to use

This cream has great texture, it absorbs well and keeps my skin feeling supple without being greasy throughout the night. It definitely is a little heavy for warmer months and would probably be best used during the dry winter. I have noticed the overall texture of my skin looks better but it has caused my pores to get a little congested. Smell is herbal and natural and very light. I received this complimentary bottle in exchange for my unbiased opinion.
product_name: The Rich Cream with TFC8 Face Moisturizer

review_text: Worst night cream (or any face product for that matter) I’ve ever tried. I use Shiseido SPF for face and their White Lucent eye cream - love both products, but THIS thing... Ughh I wish I never touched it at all. The texture once you open the pretty jar looks more like gel and almost transparent, which is oh so deceiving - I thought it would be very lightweight but this cream does not absorb at all! And leaves a very unpleasant film all over your face and neck till you finally wash it off in the morning. On top of that it made my skin break out so bad. Incredibly disappointed in this cream. Do yourself a favor and walk away in the opposite direction when you see this on the shelf. It will make your skin feel greasy and clogged and will not absorb, gross.
review_title: Do not even look at it! Walk away!!!

review_text: I expected to like this since I am a big fan of Good Genes and figured this product would perform well. It did NOT. I was left with clogged pores which was the opposite of what I was expecting. I have tried other SR products and all have been good so this one is the outlier.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: 50ml for $90 is not okay. I needed to change my routine from super basic to something more targeted and this seemed to fit the bill. It just doesn’t feel like it’s worth the huge cost. I love the feel of most tatcha products but something about this one just doesn’t thrill me. I will finish it, but I won’t repurchase.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I was really excited to try this tanning water and it showed up with all of this floating white stuff in it? I’m not sure if it’s mold or what but I know this isn’t right because I also ordered the gift set and the tanning water is clear. I would never put this on my body.

really wanted to like this because all of the great reviews i read but i have been using this 2-3 times a week as suggested, and i have noticed no difference after months of using. i personally HATE the smell but at least it doesn’t linger at all
product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: The cleanser is nice. But so lightweight that I felt like it didn’t clean my face. In fact I know it didn’t when I went over with a toner afterwards and found make up residue even after two cleanses! It might be great for someone with sensitive skin that needs something ultra gentle.
review_title: Extremely gentle, to the point of non existent.
product_name: Clean Bee Ultra Gentle Facial Cleanser

review_text: Bought a tube for myself and loved the results so much I bought my daughter one also. It works, my face has never been clearer with any other products. Breakouts are gone within a day. Bought this for a dark age spot on my temple, it has faded some, hoping for better results with longer use. The smell is a bit off putting, just use with a moisturizer & you’ll barely notice. I love how clear and hydrated and smooth my face looks now. I will continue to use this product!
product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: I received a sample size from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. That being said, I wish my skin liked this better. I have skin that is sensitive to fragrance and as soon as I applied this to my skin it became red. It seems as if it may work for many but my skin didn’t like it. I was moisturizing but the sample was used up before I could measure any improvement in my skin.
product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: This primer keeps your skin Matte all day! I have oily skin and this keeps the shine at bay.Love that there is SPF 45 in this.The only negative I have to say is that I don’t know how moisturizing this actually is.
product_name: Oil and Pore Control Mattifier Broad Spectrum SPF 45 PA++++

review_text: As a lip balm addict AND after hearing many rave of this product, I finally ordered. After using almost nightly for two weeks in hopes of improving my seasonal dry lips, I could tell NO difference. Simply not worth $22.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I bought this because my concealer was drying out under my eyes and creasing and this was suggested as something that could help spread it out better. Not only does it not help, I think it makes the dryness worse, and because it’s tinted, if you don’t rub it in just right, it makes your face look streaky.
product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: This product is amazing! I have been using for over a year and my skin looks brighter and this removes small bumps/texture. I have dry skin so I use this with DE Merula oil at night.I had stopped using this for a month and switched to honeymoon glow but realized how much I needed this because my skin had dry patches and bumps all over and within days this made my skin look better!
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I recieved this product as a sample to try and I love it! The packets are so convenient to take with me on the go and fits into my busy lifestyle. It tastes amazing and you instantly feel refreshed and rejuvenated. I will be purchasing more!

I was very skeptical buying this especially because most of the reviews are fake or paid, but I gave it a shot anyway hoping I would see results. Unfortunately this is one of the worst purchased I ever made, I really gave it a shot using it for 2 months but it seems to have only increased my dark spot and acne. If you have clear skin and need a simple hydrating serum, this might be good for you... Otherwise, seriously don’t waste your money and do your research on more effective vitamin c forms.
review_title: An actual REAL review / save your money
product_name: Squalane + 10% Vitamin C Dark Spot Serum

review_text: I am a big fan of this cleanser! After using it for a week, I noticed that my pores had visibly shrunk and skin had become more taut. I have a problem with a lot of congestion (tiny bumps under the skin that will not come out!) This cleanser is bringing everything out and even though it is not the most appealing thing, it has to be done to clear out the pores! I use this in combination with the Murad Acne Spot treatment for any bright red painful spots and overnight it has dried them to be visibly smaller, less red, and less painful. I will recommend trying out a sample but the key to this product is PATIENCE! My skin got worse before it got better - but it is the only product that i have seen any results from. (I have previously tried Clinique, Proactiv, etc) An added bonus - Murad does not test their products on animals! I definitely support cruelty-free companies that support our animal friends

I recieved this awesome color correcting treatment from influenster in return for an honest review. This treatment is awesome, it’s nice and lightweight it just melts into your skin, it minimizes the redness around my nose and cheeks. I wear under my make up or even alone! It feels great and wears all day. It gave me just enough coverage that I didn’t even have to use as much foundation. I love, love , love that it has spf30! Superior product!! You’ll love it too!!!
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I got this in a deluxe sample along with the cleanser and toner and it was not at all compatible with my skin! After I used it, my face felt like it was on fire. It burned and broke out in red splotchy patches all over, which turned to severely dry patches the next day. It seriously felt like chemical burn. I would not recommend this product at all. My skin is sensitive, but not extremely sensitive. I used this sample over a week ago and my face is still messed up.
product_name: Acne Solutions All-Over Clearing Treatment Oil-Free

review_text: Not very hydrating and did not leave skin plum or moisturized. There are many other hydrating masks or balms out there that are more effective and cheaper.

The first difference I noticed was that my skin felt much more hydrated. Other than that I wasn’t too crazy about the product. I don’t have sensitive skin but after two weeks of using the product my face started feeling a bit sore. I didn’t see much difference in my forehead wrinkles. The smell wasn’t appealing and the application process was a tiny learning curve as the product was very liquid.

The consistency is very runny (so you only need a bit). But upon application, it makes your skin look so greasy, and it stays that way for hours! I’ve tried other inexpensive vitamin C serums and I totally regret buying this one. I do not suggest this product!

I bought this because a friend recommended it and i absolutely love it! I exclusively use it as a “first cleanse” in my nighttime routine to remove makeup since it is oil based. twenty seconds of scrubbing and my makeup is completely removed. Cleansing a second time is a must though because it can leave an oily film on the face. overall though, this product is amazing. will be purchasing again.

I really didn’t like this cleanser. despite following the directions, it does not remove all of my makeup, it smells rancid or like bad plastic and it leaves a film on your face. I had high hopes, but that is a really bad product.

Wow! This is MY FAVORITE mask at the moment. I’ve gotten a couple of my friends to buy it also! This mask reminds me of going to the spa for a facial, but at home and cheaper. Lol The tingling was very minimal for me. It leaves your skin soooo smooth and clean. If you apply it at night time you instantly see results, but in the morning however your skin is just glowing. I love it and will def repurchase.
product_name: Pumpkin Enzyme Mask Enzymatic Dermal Resurfacer

review_text: Two stars, mostly for cute packaging. The product itself smells good but does absolutely nothing for dry lips. I’ll probably give it to my daughter.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: Didn’t do anything for my skin. It didnt make my skin any better or worse, just a basic cleanser

I thought I would hate this. It seems so gimmicky. But when Sephora offered a sample with an order it looked better than the other options so I took it. It reminds me of my blush light wand from Charlotte Tilbury. The color and glow cannot be beat. When I use up my sample I’m definitely purchasing the full size. For shade reference I’m a MAC NW15.

Glow Recipe is one of my favorite skincare brands! Each product has a distinct fruit/fragrance and it never irritates my skin. What really stood out to me was the refillable pod. This makes it a lot more sustainable and makes me excited to support such a great company!
product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

review_text: Worst product on the market today! No moisturizer in any of the products, masks are horrible! it does nothing, just a cheap Walmart 5 dollar creams. Walmart creams maybe better then this whole product! Don’t buy waste of money !
product_name: That Jlo Glow Brightening & Firming Serum with Niacinamide

review_text: I use the nighttime eye cream from Shiseido and love it so I decided to try their daily face cream. It’s ok, but I won’t buy it again. I think it is really thick and I don’t like the perfume smell it has. Also my eyes seem really sensitive to it. I like this product line a lot but didn’t see any benefit from this particular product.
product_name: Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Day Cream SPF 23

review_text: I have rosacea and very temperamental skin that reacts differently based on the season. I used to spend $100s changing out my products based on how my skin was acting that month which anyone with sensitive skin I’m sure can relate to! I always say, everyone’s skin reacts differently to any product but this one is worth the trial! I’m telling you that within days I noticed my skin being calmer and less bright red after my face washing rituals and I recommend using it with the face moisturizer as well. I haven’t had to change out this product since it is so mild and keeps my skin much not consistent, no matter the weather! I also sub in the facial radiance wash that has a small amount of natural exfoliates to give the skin a nice all over glow.

My skin had been really dry and irritated, so I thought an all-natural moisturizer would help. I gave this one a few weeks, but it actually made my skin even more dry and flaky. 3 days after switching to Clinique’s lotion (I used to use their gel), my skin is already dramatically better. I won’t be trying this brand again!

I love this product! Can we first just state that this is a genius business move on Evian’s behalf? Everyone saying “it’s just water“ what did you expect? It claims to hydrate, refresh, and tone. Though I can’t say much for toning I can say the most for how refreshing this is! I took this to Thailand with me while doing volunteer work. It was hot and muggy and in a very forested area. I would spray this on my face and feel immediate coolness. Also traveling for 18 hours on a plane to and from Thailand was very tough and this was an absolute must for me! It kept me refreshed the whole flight for welcome home pictures. The newest way I love to use it is when I’m asleep. I get extremely hot at night while sleeping so while I’m half asleep I spray the bottom of my feet and arms and feeling instant relief and I am able to go right back to sleep. Also, in the morning when I’m absolutely exhausted I can spray this cool mist on me and jolt to alertness quickly! I throw the travel one in my bag for hot OK summers too. This product is versatile and AMAZING! I understand that it is honestly just water in a can and I will never try to sell it as anything more but I can’t live without my EVIAN facial spray!
product_name: Brumisateur Natural Mineral Water Facial Spray

review_text: I like the packaging and scent. I don’t find this product very effective for my lips. the product just sits on my lips. doesn’t do anything for me.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: Love this product! I’ve been using it for a year almost, and I can see difference if I don’t use it. Even tho I have very oily skin, and this is more for dry skin (?) it’s amazing! Gives my skin more life, colour and helps with redness!
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: It irritates my skin and it is sticky, I would definitely not choose this product again.I must confess that I was so excited to acquire this product, I had so many expectations created thanks to all the internet videos that I saw where they put it as the best on the market, but... all that glitters is not gold... At least it’s not gold for me!
Very moisturizing cream. I really like that the texture is a rich cream as opposed to gel or watered down cream. This has significantly reduced puffiness and dark circles. I always look well rested!
This stuff smells awful and makes you feel like a big piece of tape for hours and is sooo splotchy

Definitely not a fan of this cleansing balm. I have very dry skin and am not super acne prone. It does not remove makeup, leaves a film on my skin, and leaves my face feeling less clean than before I started. Will absolutely not be repurchasing (such a shame bc this is an affordable option)

This product was gifted by REN Skincare to me and I was really excited for this product, as I have been on the hunt for a good vitamin c serum to replace my Drunk Elephant one. This one seems both not potent enough to really fade my dark spots and acne marks, yet I noticed it clogging my pores and giving me some texture. The scent may have something to do with it as I have extremely sensitive skin, but the scent is so faint that it may have to be some other ingredient irritating my skin. Disappointed this didn’t work out for me, but if you don’t have the same sensitive skin type as me, perhaps it’d be better for you!

Doesn’t reduce inflammation or anything and is honestly a waste of money. I’ve tried them multiple times on different types/sizes of pimples to see if they MIGHT work but no luck thus far. I’ve left them on well over 6 hours which is the recommended time...

This is a great eye moisturizer. It also helps with my puffiness in the morning. I keep it in the fridge and it feels so smooth and soothing going on, morning and night. I put it on before makeup and it absorbs very quickly and helps my makeup not settle in my small creases in the outer corners of my eyes. I love this stuff and totally recommend to ladies in their 20s and 30s who are beginning to notice some puffiness and lines start to show up. I don’t know that it actually does anything to the dark circles, but since it helps with puffiness, I think it makes them less noticeable since concealer looks better with this underneath on me.
review_title: Love it! Reduces puffiness, absorbs quickly

review_text: I didn’t like the smell and didn’t notice a change in my skin’s appearance, except that it was redder than usual. I’m glad I was able to test it out and that I didn’t purchase it.

I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I have really enjoyed this moisturizer. I use moisturizers every morning and night and have tried a multitude of different options. This product is extremely rich and hydrating. It is a thick cream but it wears very comfortably. I apply it at night and notice that my skin not only feels soft in the morning but looks notably healthier. I only knocked off one star because this item performs in a similar fashion to other moisturizers that I have tried at a lower price point.
product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: The taste was okay, I like citrusy flavors but reminded me of the airborne early preventative for colds. It didn’t do much for my skin but that’s probably because I was given two packets to try. I don’t see myself purchasing this due to price tag and I’ve bought plenty of vitamin and collagen powders at a much affordable price point with much more in it. I received this for free but my opinions are my own

I thought this product was wonderful. I’m not a fan of peach so I’m glad I skipped out on that scent. This leaves my lips feeling moisturized, and gives it a slight tinge of color which I adore. If you’re looking to get this product, grab the grapefruit one. You won’t be disappointed!

I have had this mask in my rotation for years! It calms irritation, improves redness, and smooths texture for me. I will say however for my roommate who has more acne (scabbing from picking and beneath the skin) and did not feel like this did her any favors. Everyone’s skin is different and this works great for me consistently!
review_title: smoothing and calming for my skin type
product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

review_text: I didn’t feel like this did anything for me. It feels nice when you initially put it on. You can over apply and it gets crusty :/

I was really hesitant about purchasing this at first, considering all the reviews for it were from people who “received free product“. I caved though, and I have to say this is PERFECT for daytime use. It is everything I want. I live in Florida, where it’s obviously really humid, and I have extremely oily, sensitive, acne-prone skin. Most moisturizers leave me looking greasy and/or irritated. However, I applied this during my routine this morning, and now 12 hours later my skin still feels and looks plumped, hydrated, and balanced without the end result of looking like an oil slick. I’m absolutely in love and will definitely repurchase in the future.
review_title: For all the oily skinned her's, him's, and them's

review_text: Not lying! I have horrible breakouts and this clears huge zits basically overnight! I love that its made clean and all natural too! Will repurchase!
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: This is my go to product! When I am consistently using this product and sunscreen my skin looks absolutely amazing and clear. Their oil is truly worth it’s price point it’s “gold in a bottle for my skin”. I suffer with hormonal acne from pcos , this is one of the only products that has helped me with my hyperpigmentation.
product_name: Mini Phoenix Rosehip Anti-Aging Face Oil - For Dry Skin

review_text: I really enjoyed this product! I love that It is a SPF 30, because a lot of the sunscreen out there is either pretty low or jumps straight up to 50, 75 and 100! This gave me a perfectly natural tan that also protected my skin from the sun! It came in such a pretty packaging which I also loved! I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all opinions are your own.
product_name: Full Spectrum 360° Sun Silk Drops Organic Sunscreen SPF 30

review_text: This essence is amazing! It is so much more moisturizing than I expected it to be because it’s pretty watery. I layer this on top of my regular toner and I definitely noticed a lot more hydration throughout the day and overnight. I use about two layers of this before I put on my other serums and moisturizer and my skin has been thriving for the past couple of weeks. It’s one of the few products that I’ve used lately that I saw it immediate difference in the plumpness and hydration on my skin. I usually try to stick to Korean skin care when it comes to essences because I find them the most hydrating but I would absolutely purchase this on my own even though it is at a higher price point. The quality of Lancôme is definitely present in this product!
product_name: Clarifique Exfoliating & Hydrating Face Essence with Glycolic Acid

review_text: I have been using Kiehl’s Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum for a little over 8 weeks now. I have consistently used it in the morning. To be honest, looking back at the before/after photos I really can’t tell much of a difference. Perhaps my eyes are a little less red? It could also be a different lighting. With questionable results I will finish the bottle but will not be continuing after that. Maybe it worked better for others.
product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum

review_text: felt great but literally made my face appear shiny, almost as if I had put polish on my face. also made my pores stand out, really bummed. should’ve sent it back, but I wanted to see if I used it regularly that things might improve, but no. I’m trashing it now.

I was pretty excited to try this because of all the great reviews but this broke me out something fierce.I washed my face as I always do and then put this on my cheeks and chin. And a tad bit in between and above my eyebrows. Felt great when I put it on.(I have roseacea and a bit of horomonal acne as well. ) This was in the morning. By night time my cheeks were broken out in pustules. :( Went and looked at the ingredients list and sure enough, salicylic acid.My skin is super sensitive and can’t handle benzoyl peroxide, salicylic acid, or alcohol. Or fragrance. D:I can’t understand why they’d put something like this into something meant for people with roseacea. O.o
review_title: Not for skin sensitive to salicylic acid.
product_name: Redness Solutions with Probiotic Technology Daily Relief Cream

review_text: I received this product for free to try from Influenster in a voxbox. I am so glad they sent me this product to try because it has significantly improved my skin texture. My skin is very oily in some spots and dry and flaky in others. This really calmed down my texture issues amd makes my skin feel so soft! I will definitely be purchasing when I run out!
product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment

review_text: I am reading all these great reviews on this product but it did not work for me.The Jojoba beads are too gentle; i think my skin works better wtih more physical exfoliation than this product provides. The AHA/BHA does not seem to work for my skin - the dead skin cells around my nose, chin, and between my brows are not polished away after usage. I followed the instructions and used it 2-3 times weekly but didn’t notice any results.I still use it once a week in between using my other exfoliators (which are more physical exfoliators without the chemicals) just so my skin doesn’t get used to one product but I don’t think I will repurchase this once my bottle is done. I will look for a stronger acid-based exfoliant.

I have used this and the original mousse for YEARS. It has been my absolute favorite self tanner. Everywhere I’d go, someone would compliment me on how natural it looked. Application was always easy, absolutely no streaking... until now. I feel like St Tropez has done something with the formula. It now streaks and fades unevenly in spots. I’ve bought 2 bottles from 2 different places over the past 6 mos and they’ve both done the same. It also seems to have a more orangy tone to it.
Obsessed with this serum pre-bed. Great smell, good texture, feels like I’m giving my skin just what it needs before a good night’s rest.

Ehhh did not do anything for my skin. So expensive for no reason. I would not purchase again- ended up giving it to my mom and she did not like it either. Smells funny and made me break out here and there. Gave me little white bumps all over my cheeks and chin. Tried to like it but just couldn’t.

I’m pretty bummed. I had been eyeing this for a while, as I have their lip collagen and like it. I purchased the trial size, for maybe $18? It’s tiny, but I knew the retail of the full size so to be expected. It’s just SO perfumed, and I’m not someone who usually has problems with scents... unless they’re terrible and overpowering like this one. I do see a glow, but will not be repurchasing.
tried this a long time ago and did not work for my skin at all. if you’re like me and you’re sensitive to everything, i recommend sticking to simpler and non-fragrant cleansers and moisturizers.
I’ve been using this balm for years and I used to have to mail order it. Thankfully I can now get it at Sephora. My husband started using mine a few years back and now he has his own tin.

I received a sample of this with my most recent order. I feel the need to say that I never write reviews, but I am so impressed with what this toner has done for my skin I had to. I have been using a small amount at night and my skin is noticeably smoother, my pores are more refined and it is starting to take on this lovely dewey glow. I read some other reviews and some people complain about the smell. I didn’t even noticed until I read reviews and sniffed it lol. People also say it’s sticky. I may of agreed with that the first night or two but I think I was using too much product. In the end, this is a win. I will be buying this when my sample runs out.
review_title: Thank you may I have another.
product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: I wanted to like this product but i have noticed every time i use this product, I break out particularly on my forehead. Its too strong for sensitive combination skin. I don get too many break outs though.
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: Used this for roughly 2 months, I love the consistency of this serum, it’s super smooth and feels almost like a thin moisturizer on the skin, I think the salicylic acid did a good job as far as my texture and preventing acne but I honestly did not see too much of a difference with my post inflammatory hyperpigmentation. So I like it in ways, but it’s just too expensive to keep going with and wait for possible results. I would skip if your on a budget…
product_name: Even Better Clinical Radical Dark Spot Corrector + Interrupter Serum

review_text: I think this is a line for younger acne prone skin. It left my skin dry and tight which doesn’t suit my age or the arid Arizona climate-
review_title: A good product for acne prone younger skin

review_text: Purchased this because I saw Here For the Tea post it on her instagram! Where do I begin? The packaging is super cute and I love the applicator. I wasn’t sure if I would like the peach because some artificial peach scents give me a headache but this one is extremely light and not very noticeable. It’s none sticky, easy to use and comfortable. It does add moisture to my lips but not like a chapstick or a lip sleep mask would but still very nice and smooth! Overall I think the product is very nice but I’m not sure if I would purchase again!

The only cleanser I’ll use for my face. Kiehl’s products feel natural and don’t irritate my skin, but still leaves my face feeling clean. Been using this for years twice a day and it works great for me.
product_name: Rare Earth Deep Pore Daily Cleanser

I will preface my review by saying that my skin is pretty low-maintenance and aside from the odd pimple here and there or bout of dryness during a particularly cold winter, I don’t have a lot of concerns. I do, however, take good care of my skin and am always curious about trying new products. I like masks in particular because I find they can really make a difference without adding yet another step to a daily routine. The texture of this mask is pretty thick and gloopy (similar to the consistency of marshmallow fluff), and two pumps was enough for me to get coverage for my entire face. Massaging it in for about 90 seconds seems to get the colour from pink to an opaque white. The mask never fully dries down on your skin and stays pretty tacky, so I’m glad that at least the colour change signifies that it’s been applied properly. To me, the scent is somewhat citrus-y and and medicinal — not my favourite, but not terrible either. I experienced a slight cooling / tingling sensation upon initial application as well as after removing the mask. I’ve used this mask a few times now and do notice that my skin feels softer and smoother afterwards, but haven’t noticed any significant effects in terms of fine lines, pores, etc. Definitely not as drying or harsh as a clay mask so it’s a nice and easy addition to a skincare routine or to use occasionally as a self-care treat. -1 star because the directions tell you to remove with a damp washcloth (which I did), and my white face towel was stained pink even after going through the laundry. Also while the pump dispenser is handy, I can imagine there is a lot of product wasted as you get to the end of the bottle. Note that I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

Or at least, not a difference that I would applaud. I had a few pimples that I didn’t have before. review_text: First things first, this is NOT a sunscreen. Though their marketing is not crystal clear, this is a bioretinol serum with SPF. Next thing you need to know is that, like many mineral SPFs on the market, this is actually a hybrid SPF formulation which means it has physical and chemical filters. Butyloctyl Salicylate is listed in the ingredient list, and though not explained in the description, it is a chemical filter. Lastly, it should also be noted this is only PA+++ not PA++++; but as this is not a sunscreen it should be paired with another product with adequate protection in any case. I like the idea behind this product, and I’m impressed the beige tint blends so well into the skin, but I regret to say that I didn’t like this bioretinol fluid and I’m not sure I would recommend it for the price. The packaging feels very flimsy; the texture is goopy and somehow even slightly grainy. It left my makeup looking atrociously patchy and made me breakout badly. I have dry, sensitive, acne-prone skin so maybe this would work at least better for those with normal skin type, but definitely not for me.

review_text: I really, really wanted to like this product. I mean, a setting spray with SPF? My pale, pasty complexion would be set, protected and ready to roll each day!And yet...For some background, it’s fair to say my complexion is “oily“. There are rumors that OPEC has tried to mine fuel directly from my face, in fact. (Negotiations fell through, sadly.) So I use powder-based foundation, along with a clay-based finishing powder to keep the blinding shine of my face at bay, at least for a few hours.Now, I have used Urban Decay’s setting spray with great results; I had hoped this one would be similar with some SPF action in it. Not so. First: the smell. HELLO, CHEMICALS. Truly, it’s a cloying, chemical, 1980’s hairspray smell that sticks in your nose long after you’ve run from your makeup area in terror. Second: the feel. It’s not that sheer, lightweight formula that I was used to with Urban Decay. This one covers you like a film - you can definitely feel where the spray has touched you. (I got some on my chest inadvertently, and it felt gross. Bleh.) But I figured it was a sunscreen-type product, this was to be expected.Then, the third issue: it caused my makeup to pull and pill. And this was a consistent result of several days (I was determined to see if I could make it work. Turns out, not so much.)To sum up:Pros: SPFCons: Beading foundation (UGH), chemical smell, weird filmy textureDefinitely will never purchase this again.

review_text: I have stupidly sensitive skin and struggle with sunscreen. I’ve had good results with Supergoop in the past so I bought a tube of this for a trip I took recently. Even though I was not always as religious as I probably should have been about reapplying, I got no sunburn at all through over a week of extensive amounts of being outside in the sun in and around San Francisco, LA, and Las Vegas, and some days the sun was intense enough I thought for sure I would get burned. (I am pretty fair, although I don’t burn as easily as some fair folks I know, I do definitely burn.) Even with swimming this held up and it never went all white and gross if I got sweaty, which I’ve had some products do in the past. It also rubs in nicely and doesn’t smell too strongly, which meant that my travel companions kept trying to steal it from me because it was nicer than what they had.I’m back at Sephora for a new tube for my final summer adventure. It is a bit expensive but given all of my trials with sunscreen in the past, I’ll deal with the cost.
review_title: Bay Area, LA, Las Vegas, no sunburn!

review_text: super hydrating, def recommended. second time buying this. i recommend using it on a damp face though!!

review_text: The first night I applied this all over my chin, where I tend to get little blackheads and whiteheads no matter how well I cleanse. The pros include the fact that I did not have to ’work’ at the blemish or soak it out, (making my easily-reddened skin irritated), but the skin was smoother and clearer after use. The sulfur odor is not noticeable once the product dries on the skin. The price is hefty, but so worth it. This product is my go-to now for overnight blemish treatment. review_title: no more bleach spots on my pillowcase

I love that its clean beauty but thats pretty much the only thing good about it in my opinion.

review_text: *Kiehl’s refused to post this review after submitting multiple times and strictly adhering to their guidelines so I’m posting here*This is the product that made me realize how irritating fragrant oils and perfumes can be on my face. I decided to take out one product at a time, started with this one and after a week— No irritation! I realized that this is the only product I use with fragrance from Kiehl’s and it has a lot. It’s sad because the lavender and other aromas are mentally calming at night but wrecks my skin by morning.

review_text: If you’re considering this product, I really recommend trying it. It DOES leave your skin feeling soft and plump, the kind of skin you want to touch. I find two pumps (label recommendation) covers my face and neck nicely. I use it in the evenings and don’t mind still “feeling“ it on my face, because it feels lovely. In the morning my skin looks bright and plump, and feels amazing. I’m using this once or twice a week, in rotation with a couple of other active treatments. It compliments these other items nicely.

This cleanser is good but it didn’t wow me. The smell is a little odd. It did leave my skin feeling soft and hydrated. But a better cleanser for me is fresh soy cleanser. That’s my HG cleanser and nothing has come close to it.

I absolutely LOVE this product! I have been using it about a year now. I recently bought a new bottle last week and I noticed it has started to leak everywhere. That is the only reason for the 4 instead of 5 stars. I’m hoping this is just a faulty bottle and it wont happen again.

First let me say I love DE products and use a handful on a regular basis. That being said this product was a huge no for me as it broke my sink out terribly. I am talking almost two weeks to get my skin back to normal. I used a tiny amount just once and that was enough. I highly suggest trying a very small spot first if you have sensitive or acne prone skin. I waited a month and tried again in a smaller area with even less to see if it was fluke, sadly I experienced the same issue. Bummed I cannot use it but it does not change my opinion of the brand. Love it!

I wanted to like this product so badly. my skin is combination oily, sensitive, and acne prone. i received a travel size as a birthday gift from sephora. i tried it for about a week and decided to purchase it. i used it for about two-three months and my face was breaking out horribly. i tried to keep the same routine so i could factor out what was breaking me out. then i decided to start using my other face wash that i was using before this one, and my face cleared up. i’m not sure if it was just an ingredient that didn’t work with my skin, but it did cause me to breakout on my cheeks and chin. but it did do a good job at cleansing.
review_title: Gave it a fair shot, didn’t work for me..

review_text: I love that it isn’t too thick or heavy for your under eyes, but that it provides just the right amount of moisture.

5 stars!! This is my go-to product. After using skinceuticals vitamin C serum, I mix 1 drop of these drops in with an SPF. I no longer use any foundation because this is the perfect blend while also helping your skin! Plus it’s not overpriced because I use it every day and one bottle lasts me over 6 months.
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: I am not sure if this serum is too good to be true or an instant pore reducing firmer. I noticed a slight film on my face this use so either I am using it wrong or it fills the pores and makes me think it’s tightening them or maybe another product in the mix did it. I do notice results within minutes of use. I got this in the Play Luxe Vol 2. I love the spa herbal effect products, but be forwarned- this one is enought to clear your lungs.
Didn’t really like this cream. It moisturized but not as well as some of he other moisturizers I’ve tried. I also couldn’t stand the smell! Returned this product.
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: This product has helped me tremendously! I rarely write reviews but I wanted to convey my experience with adding this product to my nightly regime. I have very sensitive reactive combo skin with some acne and I was very hesitant to add this in, and for the first 4 weeks or so I did break out a bit. I wanted to stop immediately but I stuck it out wanting to give this product a chance. I went back to Sephora and asked about more information on this product to make sure I was using it correctly and they recommended I use this alone at night without a moisturizer on top since I have a solid hydrating one I use during the day. Once I started using this alone (with a hydrating toner first) it completely transformed my skin. All of my texture and bumps disappeared and my acne dark spots are fading very well which is a first for me. I really haven’t had had any additional acne either just one or two and they have been small and dissipate very quickly. I love this product and for me the price is worth it because I’m not using 3-4 products at night to do what this product does handily on its own. My advice would be to stick it out! It’s not going to fix everything overnight but this has helped me more than anything else I have tried.
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I have bad acne and I have been wanting to try this product for a while. I love Origins’ packaging, but I was surprised how small this bottle was considering it’s only 1.5% salicylic acid. I thought it would be more potent, but I was willing to try it because of it’s high rating and the woman at Sephora recommended it. I feel like it didn’t do much for my face. There are probably similar products that can be purchased at Sephora or elsewhere that work better.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I got a mini of O-Bloos in a set with d bronzi and was so excited to try it out! I love a good sun kissed flush and liquid blush. However, the blush was way too thick, shimmery, and the pigment didn’t show up on my pretty fair skin with olive undertones. If you were hoping for a skincare-friendly liquid blush, I’d save your money!
review_title: odd consistency and color doesn’t show up

review_text: Game changer!!!! Used it for a week and saw a huge difference!! This is the best vitamin C I have ever used! My skin looks naturally brighter and dark spots are also diminishing. Definitely recommended this over any other vitamin C!! Price is so reasonable for all the good stuff it does to your skin!
product_name: 15% Vitamin C and EGF Brightening Serum

review_text: I purchased this because I like the lip balm so well. Good and bad news: while I love how it feels on my face, it caused small bumps under my skin, so I discontinued use of it there. My facial skin is just sensitive, I guess, and other posters had better results. The great news, however, is that I love it on my hands, elbows, and in the bath. It’s light and absorbs quickly, plus the fact that it’s a pure organic oil means a lot. Expensive but totally worth the cost.

This is a pretty good spot treatment product! I haven’t noticed a significant change on breakouts but it definitely does not hurt anything. I don’t find it to be overdrying, which is nice, but I do wish I saw more immediate results
No improvement after using the whole bottle. Texture is a little sticky and doesn’t feel good on the face. It just doesn’t feel like it’s absorbing into the skin.
No hassle, irritation, redness. Comes right off every night. Preps for new day

It took me a little bit to be able to tell how I felt about this product. First, the packaging is lovely and he product smells like an orange creamsicle which I enjoy. This is very hydrating and does give the skin a brightening boost. However, I have very oily skin so I only like to use this at night and NOT in the morning. I find if I use it in the morning, I am an oil slick an hour into the day and it only gets worse as time goes on. Overall, I love this product but as a night cream only. I received this product complimentary from Influenster for reviewing purposes.

The Inkey List Vitamin B, C, And E is a great unscented moisturizer for combination skin. I applied two times a day on face and neck (morning and before bed). My skin felt soft, hydrated, and moisturized all day. It is light, creamy, and absorbs quickly into skin. I really like that it doesn’t look or feel greasy on the skin and a small amount goes a long way. Cruelty-free and formulated with clean ingredients is a plus. Highly recommend for any skin type.
product_name: Vitamin B, C, and E Moisturizer

review_text: I really love this face scrub. Immediately after using it your skin feels super soft. The directions say to use it wet but I use it on my face when it’s dry.
product_name: Mini Turmeric BHA Pore & Brightening Treatment Mask

review_text: I Have oily acne prone skin and my new holy grail! I have been seeing ppl post it and decided to go ahead and pay the hefty price tag and went straight to the large bottle (after much research, I hate returning, don’t do it often, and figured if it worked it would be the best value and if it didn’t I would simply return) But wow did it make a difference in lightening the redness from my acne scars after just one use! It didn’t do anything to my current acne, but I did also notice glowing, and more even skin tone when I woke up! I do this twice a week after using a gentle exfoliator. I put my usual topical prescribed clindamyacin but held off on the strong stuff to avoid possible interactions. Put about 1.5 pump worth in dots over my face and spread it w my fingers. Then I used my sunday riley brightening cream over it before I sleep. Lucky to not have anything negative to say abt this product!
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Bailey Sarian used this in her videos, saying it made her dark circles disappear. So I bought it hoping it’d do the same for me. But the more I use it, the worst my skin gets. It’s starting to burn more & more w/ each use. My skin looked good before using this. I only had undereye darkness. Never had sensitive skin. Now my skin has discolored patches (dark grey, red/pink & etc), I’m starting to get visible lines and overall it’s irritated.

I wanted to like this but after the first day I started breaking out in small red blemishes. I kept trying for about a week but it was not improving so I had to call it quits. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
I’m 38 years old and my skin has started to be dry this year. This cream compares to other higher-priced creams but for a lower price. It does an amazing job, and my skin feel silky and smooth.
review_title: Amazing face cream for a great price

review_text: This moisturizer has been a great addition to my skin care. It is late. I love that has SPF in it. And it also lays really well under makeup. This product has not pilled under makeup at all. I have very sensitive skin and this moisturizer was the perfect fit for me. I received this moisturizer free from Influenster for reviewing purposes.
product_name: Full Spectrum 360º Refreshing Water Cream Organic Face Sunscreen SPF 50

review_text: Does nothing to your skin.literally.cant return it now i guess, i threw the box.waste of money!
I’ve been using this product morning and evening everyday for three weeks and have not noticed any change in my dark circles or fine lines. I will not be purchasing again.
LOVE this serum! I ordered it as soon as it came out, it feels so good on the skin and instantly brightens and hydrates. Cant wait to see long term results!!
product_name: CC Me Vitamin C + Niacinamide Serum

review_text: My skin and argan oil do not agree. For the first two days, my skin looked refreshed and fuller, by day 4 I was breaking out like a teenager (I am 48!). Wanted to love it, but had to return it.
review_title: Wanted to love it, returned it
product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment

review_text: I asked for a recommendation for the best product on the market to heal dry, chapped lips, and was told without a doubt that it was the Sugar Advanced therapy Lip Treatment. Although it was pricey, I decided to try it. Unfortunately, it has not shown to be any different than any other lip balm, even those at a fraction of the price. I will not be purchasing this item again.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: I tested the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Supercharged Complex against my regular eye skin care routine (The Ordinary Caffeine Solution and the Verso Super Eye Serum). I used the entire 3mL sample over two weeks. The eye I used the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Supercharged Complex on was visibly brighter and my seemingly permanent dark circles were much less noticeable. The skin in the under-eye area also felt well moisturized. I also tend to have issues with puffiness. As far as I could tell, the Estee Lauder and The Ordinary were both similar at minimizin under-eye puffiness. The Estee Lauder was noticeably worse at minimizing the appearance of my crow’s feet. The Verso Super Eye Serum does an exceptional job reducing the appearance of fine lines around my eyes. If you are concerned about fine lines around your eyes, I would not recommend the Estee Lauder. However, as an overall general use eye skin care product, the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Supercharged Complex performed well at minimizing dark circles, brightening, and depuffing. For now, as I am most concerned about my fine lines, I don’t plan on changing my routine. However, I have to say that as a brightening product, the Advanced Night Repair lived up to its claims.

This is hands down my go-to product when it comes to my hormonal acne....Product description:This ultra-powerful daily treatment gel is powered by Clinique’s four-in-one clearing complex with salicylic acid to start clearing blemishes instantly and help prevent new ones from forming. You can make visibly clearer skin a way of life. This product is allergy tested, non-acnegenic, and free of oil and fragrance. I can say that this Acne Gel lives up to its claims 100%!!!!!!!! This is an AMAZING spot treatment that is ALWAYS in my cabinet because it works so well! It’s the most effective acne treatment I’ve ever used, oftentimes making my pimples go away overnight... The gel is a pretty thin consistency, dries quickly, and doesn’t make your skin flaky. You only need a little bit, and I do recommend moisturizing afterwards because the ingredients can be a tad drying. One bottle lasts me a very long time, so it’s an amazing value on top of how wonderful it is! 5 / 5 stars, DEFINITELY recommend!
Love this product! Leaves my skin so soft and my black heads are gone! It’s so gentle on my skin.

Gifted this product! At first when I tried this products my face burn :( I think it was because my face is super dry and sensitive. I wait a couple days later to try the it again it wasn’t bad. I don’t see a difference yet for my face! I will keep you updated!

This product did nothing for my skin. I mean that in the nicest way possible. It didn’t break me out and it didn’t give me moisture. I really only like this because it’s nice to wear a gel based moisturizer for the gym. Wouldn’t buy it again however.
My pores definitely look a lot smaller and more refined, also helps with improving overall skin texture. Only downside is that it’s very expensive for a very small bottle.
I love this toner! It smells exactly like watermelon and leaves my face feeling so refreshed!
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! This is by far my favorite eye cream. My eyes are brighter, softer and helps with fine lines. I’ve read some reviews about stinging or irritation. Eye cream should not be applied so close to the eyes, but the bone area around your eyes. This product is special. Their packaging is so gorgeous. It makes feel special every time I purchase one of their products.
product_name: Bright Repair Eye Cream – 10% Vitamin C

review_text: I’m surprised this has the reviews it does. Let’s start with the positive. The only one I can think of is it smells really nice. But as far as taking off makeup, I always have to clean my face again after using this. It does nothing for mascara but smudges it all over my face and it slightly blinds me when I use it on my eyes. My vision is usually blurry for about 30 seconds. This is concerning to say the least. I would say get a nice cleanser instead since you’ll need to wash your face again anyways to remove your makeup.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Amazing product! Love the smell of it the texture and that I really have to put less products on my lips throughout the day since I’ve started using this balm.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Absolutely the best eye treatment I ever used and I tried everything. Wrinkles and dark circles are greatly reduced and made the skin around the eyes tight. I also love that it has 1% retinol but didn’t cause any irritation or dryness. Highly recommended

I love this product. It doesn’t leave me oily throughout the day. I’ve noticed that my skin isn’t as red anymore. I also use it at night time after my moisturizer! It’s AMAZING. I feel like I took up my skin care another notch.
product_name: Mini Vitamin C Glycolic Brightening Serum

review_text: I’ve been using this as a lip balm and cuticle cream and it works just ok. My lips get drier faster than when I use a regular lip balm and my cuticles don’t seem to be very moisturized.
review_title: Not sure what the hype is all about

review_text: Too liquidy, greasy, and leaves me shiny and sticky all day, even under additional skin products! Using it up just because I dropped a pretty penny on it.
My daughter used it and she felt really clean afterward. I noticed that she had few blemishes afterward. Since it is expensive, I cannot imagine that she would use it every day.
review_title: Healthy looking teenage skin upon use.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: These eye patches feel great. I love putting them on before bed while watching tv! You don’t see amazing results though. To me, they are mainly for relaxation
Great for nighttime use. A bit too heavy for daytime, it doesn’t seem to absorb quick enough for makeup application. I love the scent, and the way my skin looks and feels in the morning after use.
product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: What can I say? I saw no positive difference after using this for 2 months. Definitely not worth the money. No different from less expensive retinoid eye creams.

I was initially afraid of hurting myself with a naked blade but am no longer fearful! Takes some time to get used to but once you get the angle right, this razor is as easy to use as any other. It left me with a close shave and super smooth skin. The razor blade itself is easy to change.

I had high hopes for this product since I have use MURAD before. But this cleanser didn’t help with my breakouts at all. It feels really good, refreshing and cooling. I used it 2 times a day and it didn’t dry out my skin but I didn’t see any changes on my skin.

This is an excellent serum, it provides just the right amount of extra moisture without feeling heavy. I love that a little goes a long way and it dries to a nice powdery finish, instead of leaving a residue like some other serums I have tried.
I bought this lip balm in the summer of 2014 and i STILL havent run out. The smell is amazing and it has a non-greasy texture, although it isnt incredibly moisturizing.
I don’t recommend because it is a purely chemical sunscreen, not completely coral reef safe and makes me nervous to use chemicals over minerals.

Complimentary from Eadem, but all thoughts are my own This Cloud Cushion Airy Brightening Moisturizer is super nice! I really enjoy how airless and almlsy invisible the formula feels on my skin and I really love that my skin so far looks brighter and feels softer.
product_name: Cloud Cushion Plush Moisturizer with Ceramides + Peptides

review_text: Good powder exfoliant and lasts a long time - this product really smalls bad to me.. it’s smells like baby formula.

Goes on nice but after 10 minutes, you feel tightness all over your face. Also, it does not work well underneath the adaptogen moisturizer, which I love, in addition to the night mask (yellow container). Combined with their other products, it makes you feel a tingling itching sensation. It would be great for someone with oily or combination skin.
product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I loved the INKEY List Hyaluronic Acid Cleanser. My skin felt so fresh and clean. I feel like it did all the things it was supposed to.
Not for combo skin. Broke me out within hours. Absorbed quickly but felt uncomfortable on skin.

I had high hopes for this moisturizer because so many people highly recommend unfortunately it burned the skin around my eyes. When I woke up the next morning my eyes were swollen and I had a patch of redness underneath my left eye and underneath my eyebrows were bright red. Super disappointing because the rest of my skin felt pretty soft the next morning.
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: I like this cleanser. The smell is pleasant and the texture is nice. My skin feels clean and moisturized after use. It is definitely milky. I just find I like the feeling of my skin more with other cleansers. I’ll finish this bottle but I’ll likely not repurchase.

Overpriced, low quality product. I wouldn’t pay $20 for this product. The batteries aren’t protected from water and the batteries corrode. Do not buy this. This company needs to redo the product or just shut down.
I have used acids for over a year now and have never had any issues. I have very resilient skin and rarely ever have break outs. This product caused my entire face to break out.
Didn’t do anything. Still have acne. Waste of money. Why would any employee recommend this product, have they even tried it?

Absolutely love this balm! It’s the only thing that can really truly remove all of my eye makeup. It’s gentle on my sensitive skin and leaves it feeling clean and soft. I usually follow with a second cleanser but occasionally get lazy and I don’t notice any issues when I do.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Unfortunately this product did not work for me. This was the first real moisturizer I ever tried/purchased and I was so excited because I heard so many nice things about it. Upon applying it feels like nothing on your skin (can be a good or bad thing depending on what you prefer). However as I let it dry/sit on my skin I really did not enjoy how it felt. This product also made me break out really bad on my pore areas. Beautiful and thoughtful packaging, but for $70 I could find something better.
review_title: Drying and Hyped up too much
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I got a sample of this in the mail and was excited to try out her serum. Granted I went heavy on the application, but it dried down all the way rather quickly and then started pulling if I touched my face. To the point a good rub had me shedding. This is a big huge NO.
product_name: That Jlo Glow Brightening & Firming Serum with Niacinamide

review_text: This mask is one of my favorites ever! I have been using this for a while now and I am always amazed by the results of it. Last night I had I had some little bumps on my face and I applied this at night. In the morning they were all gone and my face feels really nice. This is one of my holy grail masks!
product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

review_text: so i usually stick to one product but i started noticing that once my skin gets used to a cleanser for a couple months it stops working. so i need to change it up sometimes. i dont like to use anything with a fragrance so i saw this one and it got alot of good reviews . i have very oily skin so i like something foaming and hydrating at the same time so i thought this would be perfect . as soon as i started using this cleanser my skin got bumpy so i stopped using it and tried my cerave foaming cleanser for a week and the bumpiness went away. i tried the skinfix once again and little bumps came back. i had to stop using it .

Um, wow! I’ve only been using this for two days and I can already see a difference. I am 40 and have scars on my face from acne. I swear this has erased them! I’m sure they would come back if I stopped using this so I guess I will never stop. Also my skin has been extremely dry lately. I had been using pure coconut oil before out of desperation but this has already made the dryness go away. I thought about buying this for a couple years because the sticker shock was too much but now that I’ve tried it I am hooked. It is really amazing and truly worth it. I’m in love!
Was excited about this product, but it made my face incredibly sticky. Would not recommend.
product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: Did absolutely nothing to clear out my blackheads or breakouts AND made my skin unreasonably dry and red.
product_name: Mini Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: I bought this after 2 of my friends recommended it. They said it the ingredients are great and is good for my skin. Actually, I didn’t like how it looks on one of my friends (she has oily skin) but still, I went ahead and bought it. I like the texture, yeah, it was creamy and doesn’t dry out my skin but MY GOSH, this foundation!! This DOESN’T stick to my skin at all! First time ever to try a foundation that doesn’t set! (So I actually put a serum on before I put any make up on then LM setting powder over the foundation but I never had any problems with my go-to foundation.) My face got SUPER OILY in less than an hour and my face looked crazy ASHY immediately! It felt and looked like I have a mask on even though the coverage was just light. Not expecting all that after all the good reviews I’ve read! Only good thing was it didn’t break me out. Stay away from this, oily skin girls!
product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40

review_text: I wanted to love this product, but the smell is like sour milk and it didn’t improve my skin. Returned.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I’ve been using samples and the product has made my face feel softer and look more radiant. The smell reminds me of a lemon cough drop, not bad in my opinion. Most likely won’t be buying a full size because it’s so expensive and I can’t justify it.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: This removes my makeup so well! It melts it right off! I actually love coming home just to use this. Really love this stuff!
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I’ve been using Clinique’s 3 step system for more than a decade, and I’m so disappointed with this new formula. The original version was super gentle, but also powerful enough to remove makeup and other impurities. This new version can’t even handle what little mascara I have on after I use their eye makeup remover, which is also awful.
review_title: Why mess with a good thing?
product_name: All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap

review_text: My grandmother purchased this, did nothing for her so she gave it to me... So not impressed!!!! The RAW Sauce does so much more for my wrinkles and it’s forty some dollars for over 5 oz!!!! This is Not even close to being worth it!! Save your $!
product_name: Needles No More Wrinkle Smoothing Cream

review_text: I tried this for about a week or so and it only made me look oiler. It would just sit on top of my face even if I let it dry for over 20 minutes. In the end I had to wipe it off (I’d use a drop or two) and continue with my makeup. For the price you’d think it’s really great but I wouldn’t recommend it if you’ve oily skin. Perhaps the light version it’s better but I just moved on to the Boscia oil...

Initially, I didn’t think it would doing anything other than feel nice to put on. After using it consistently for over a month, my skin tone is even, there is less redness, and I haven’t had a major breakout. I like to use it twice a day since I live in Wisconsin and this is the first winter I haven’t gotten dry flaky skin. It’s a subtle change, but the added hydration really makes your skin happy.
product_name: Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: This toner works well for dry to very dry skin. I use it with a cotton pad in after washing my face in the evenings to remove any residual makeup, and I mist it on my face in the morning after rinsing face with water. It tones and hydrates and feels like it allows my moisturizer to adhere/absorb into my skin better.

This product was truly a disappointment. The oil does absolutely nothing for skin except sit at the surface without absorption. Luckily I did not have any skin irritations or break outs like some others, but this product was a complete dud. I bought because it’s been very cold where I live and i needed something that would moisturize and revive my skin. I should have just returned the product but since i’m stuck with it now i have started to put it in my hair.. just cause. Luckily i only purchased the mini size. This was my first time trying a Drunk Elephant product and after this experience it will probably be my last. If I could I would give no stars but since I am forced to give one, I will say the packaging is nice.

I’m not normally sensitive to smells, but I really hate the scent of this! It smells like a cleaning product, and not in the lemony sort of way that some products do. Regardless, I still wouldn’t use this on my face, as it doesn’t say it’s non-comedogenic and it absolutely seems like it would break me out. It’s not as greasy as other sunscreens, but it’s definitely more greasy than a regular moisturizer, and it feels heavy on the skin. Also this is literally just a sunscreen - for this price point, I’d need a product that at least did more than one thing.
product_name: Invisible Physical Defense Mineral Sunscreen SPF30

review_text: The smell and feel of this is amazing. This is definitely one of my favorite lip products, I just wish it lasted longer. Looks beautiful and isn’t too sticky like others.
great essence. it brightened my skin after a week of nightly use. it smells citrusy and is a bit messy to get out of the bottle
product_name: Clarifique Exfoliating & Hydrating Face Essence with Glycolic Acid

review_text: Okay so this is not horrible sunscreen. I don’t think anything from drunk elephant could be horrible but I bought this because of the allure best of beauty award and I can honestly say- just don’t buy it. It takes forever to sink into my skin and, if I’m not careful, will leave a white cast. It also somehow pills if I don’t wait like a solid 30-45 minutes before applying my makeup primer. The smell isn’t the greatest either but take that with a grain of salt because I’m sensitive to scents. It is a HUGE tube and I will be either throwing it away or trying to find someone who wants to take it cause I just don’t like it. If you want an amazing sunscreen, go get supergoops unseen screen because I wish I had just bought another tube of that instead of this.
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: I’ve been using this product for about a week gifted by dermalogica and I’m loving how my skin feels after use. I use it in the morning and it leaves my skin feeling nice and refreshed. It has the consistency that feels slightly like a thin sunscreen and over all my skin feels less tired looks better.
after blending and blending and blending still left green gray residue? product ended up balling up and messing up my makeup completely 0/5 stars if it was an option
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I think it’s a great product, I love many Clinique products. It does what it promises to do. However, it’s a little up there in prize for a Clinique item. It’s also very small, so I’d probably need a couple more bottles to get rid of these blackheads completely.

I have dry skin and thought that this was very appealing to be able to use on my lips or face fast and discretely. I was hoping it would help my skin after years of sun exposure and generally poor skin care. This product is nothing shy of scam. You can squeeze it from the tube and it begins to clump. None of the “balls“ are actually skin. It is the chemical compounds sticking together. My skin looks and feels the same.

The product ran out fairly quickly. I used up the entire bottle within 3.5 months. To give you prospective, I do not cover my whole face, I do my problem areas, which would be my t-zone. Would most likely have to repurchase another bottle to see an improvement. All in all I would still recommend and repurchase.

I wanted these to work so bad. All the reviews I read made it seem like this was a game changer - but sadly for me they hardly did anything. I put them on the occasional pimple I would see creeping up and keep them on overnight. By morning the pimple was SLIGHTLY less red, but the size and pressure was still the same. Then by mid-day whatever original redness was there previously just came back. I have sensitive, normal oily in my T-zone skin, and while these didn’t make the pimple worse, they just didn’t seem to do much at all to help.

The only reason I’m giving this product two stars is because of the hyaluronic acid- it really plumps the skin and absorbs nicely. However, I didn’t purchase this product for hyaluronic acid.. review_text: I bought this cream based on the reviews and i tried it every night for two months. I gave it to my mom to use maybe it would work better on a 52 year old.

review_title: Really nice lip balm if you can afford to splurge

review_text: I wanted to love this so badly especially after spending $60 on it but my skin was not reacting well to the product. i washed my face with my normal face wash and then dabbed this on and it caused my skin to burn a bit and get red and splotchy in certain parts as you can see in the images, some parts on my cheeks and across my eyebrow. I thought it was a one off but I tried again tonight and again my face got red and splotchy. When I tested it at the store on my hand it did exactly what it was supposed to and felt absolutely amazing which is why I can’t for the life of me figure out why this is happening to my face. It is worth noting I wouldn’t consider myself as someone with “sensitive skin” and it can get a bit on the dry side but I really do take care of my skin so I can’t tell if the next morning it looks great because of or in spite of the product. I will be returning it though and trying hopefully something else that won’t cause my skin to react this way. I give it two stars because on my hand it was beautiful and felt amazing, unfortunately on my face it didn’t.
review_title: Wanted to love but got a skin reaction instead
product_name: Melt Moisturizer with Bakuchiol and Squalane

review_text: I got a sample of this after reading the great reviews. I have sensitive hormonal acne skin so I was hoping this would help fade marks and active pimples. I’m used to glycolic acids, so the slight initial stinging was not an issue. Skin felt really nice after the 20 mins and rinsing off. However, within the next two days I had a whole new crop of acne pop up on the side of my face, and a week later I am still trying to get them under control. I would definitely not recommend using this before an event if you have similar skin. I personally will not use it again because the purge was too bad and not worth the soft feeling for the night of the application. Do a test area first!
product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask

review_text: These actually work really well. My only complaint is that they are so expensive. Each dot is only good for one application on one zit. It’s easy to go through the pack very quickly because they contain only two sets of 10 dots. I think for the price they are asking, it should come with at least 100 little dots.

The packaging on this product is, breathtaking with its angles and colors. The floating gold orbs made me feel rich and luxurious without even opening the bottle. I was so excited to twist the top and was shocked that the scent was as strong as it was. It was almost like a freight train hitting you with a highly antiquated perfume smell. Upon application (and holding my breath), I found the “oil“ to feel more like a serum than an oil, very loose and with no real thickness to it like I am used to with other oils. It absorbed quickly but left a tacky feel to face in an uncomfortable way. The smell that I hated when I open the bottle remained and my skin had no change in luster or glow to be found. My skin also felt heavy in the sense that it didn’t feel comfortable and made me fear for clogging of my pores. I was hopeful that it would be absorbed and that heavy feeling would diminish, but sadly it remained until I washed my face at the end of the day. The only upside to the entire process was how supple my skin felt at the end of the day after scrubbing the “oil“ off. I imagine it was from the fact that nothing was able to leave my face all day give the tacky coating I had. I wouldn’t recommend this for blemish prone folks just in the off chance it caused reactions.
product_name: Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil

review_text: I love how lightweight and moisturizing this face cream is! It has a lovely scent too! I apply a little bit every morning and night after washing my face a d it makes my skin feel hydrated and happy! The size is great for travel and keeping in my bag which is nice because I never want to go without this stuff! “Gifted by La Mer”
review_title: My skin feels hydrated and happy!

review_text: I like this cream. I use it as a moisturizer, and have not had an allergic reaction to it.

review_title: Break out, return back to original one

review_text: I love this product. If I catch a pimple in an early enough stage, I can make it go away all together by using this for a day or two. If I don’t catch it in time, this products significantly reduces the amount of time that I have that pimple. Is it a miracle product that will get rid of all of your acne? No. But does it help reduce acne and reduce the severity? Yes, absolutely! It’s made a huge difference in my skin and helps with things like predictable hormonal acne. I would definitely recommend!
review_title: Not a Miracle, But Definitely Effective

review_text: I absolutely love this product!! Not just because it works exactly like it promises but also because it is a fun product to have. Overall, the packaging is very cool where technically there is one cap where both products are screwed on, on each end. I appreciate the company trying to move towards being more environmentally friendly by minimizing the package. I would highly recommend placing it on the counter where the product name is readable because the gloss side of it is a runnier gel and gets messy if you place it with the letters upside down. The Glass: The company is extremely smart for using a biodegradable PEG particles as the exfoliant instead of the normal synthetic nondegradable particles you find normally. This means that I don’t have to worry as much about polluting the water as I wash it off my face into the drain. I do wish that the particles were a lot finer. Because I am used chemical exfoliants and ultra fine particle exfoliants, this one is a bit on the rougher side but man does my face fee absolutely amazing even if I don’t polish my face for long. The Gloss: this gel is absolutely amazing and so moisturizing. I have find myself using this on the regular as part of my skin routine even if I don’t exfoliate. Love this side and I would recommend that they sell the gloss separately as well because I can see myself using it up faster than the exfoliant. Overall highly recommend to buy and use. I feel more comfortable in my natural skin because I have a beautiful glow after use.
product_name: Glass & Gloss 2-Step Facial Retexturizing & Brightening Treatment

review_text: It exfoliates nicely, but it leaves a greasy film on my face. I use acne medication regularly, so I was looking for something that was a little less harsh...

instead oc hydrating my skin with this product my skin got really dry and it was literally peeling off .

I love these glow drops, I use the face cream and these drops when I want to skip the makeup routine. Makes my skin look refreshed. It gives that perfect natural glowing skin.

review_text: I used this product religiously for 2 and a half months, and saw no improvement, other than moisturizing (which to be honest, i could have gotten with a far less expensive cream).
