It seems as though there are beneficial ingredients, so i still use the cream, but I just wished I could reap those benefits..

I have been trying out fresh products left and right and so far nothing has done anything for my skin. It didn’t break me out (which is why it got two stars not one) but it wasn’t soothing or hydrating either. Maybe this is a product for very very sensitive skin?

I’d definitely recommend this product and buy me a full size.

This product is greasy and the packaging is super hard to use. I got this sunscreen hoping that it will be easy to use during my summer beach trip. It turns out I was wrong. Especially, if you are on the go and do not have the time to delicately push it up every single time. And when you push it up too much, you have to use the plastic cap (yes, don’t throw away that little piece of plastic) to push it back down. After I did this several times (probably also combined with the effect of the heat in my backpack) it started breaking off. I lost a significant part of the sunscreen to breaking and falling off. Other than the bad packaging , the sunscreen itself is greasy. No matter how much I tried to rub it in, it remains greasy. review_text: I have been on the hunt for a mineral sunscreen with 20% zinc that was safe for sensitive skin, was free from irritants, and wouldn’t completely dry out my eczema-prone skin but also stay on my face without sweating off in the sun. I have been using Biossance’s mineral sunscreen for reference. Going on, the sunscreen was a lot “drier“ and spread more like a sunscreen than the Biossance (which spreads more like a traditional moisturizer). It also dried down much more than the Biossance, which had me believing this would be a more ideal product for daytime sweating. It also had a much more matte finish which means if there was a cast, it was more translucent than the dewy finish of Biossance. However, within two days of wearing this, my skin exploded with acne. I NEVER break out unless there’s a combo of factors - sweating, on my period, dirty makeup sponges, touching my face during the day etc. And even then, it’s never more than 1 or 2 zits. This breakout was ALL over my face indicating it was a product reaction. I couldn’t believe it. It took another day for me to realize it was the sunscreen because I seriously never have an issue with products causing a breakout - I never check for oil-free or non-comedogenic products because my skin is so dry and generally loves oils and thick moisturizing ingredients. Looking at the ingredients, the coconut alkanes came up as highly comedogenic. I have to believe there’s some sort of ingredient interaction happening, perhaps with one of my other products that has some lower level of comedogenic ingredients that together with the coconut alkanes exploded my face. Unfortunately, because this sunscreen was the thing that changed my skin chemistry and broke me out, it goes.

review_text: I’ve been using this serum for over 3 weeks now and overall I like it. I can say that I see the difference from before - my skin looks fresher and smoother, I’ll definitely keep using it further - I am a big fan of a Lancôme’s skincare products & have never been disappointed with the results! How to use it : Daily, in morning skincare routine and evening skincare routine. Holding the product horizontally over the palm of your hand or fingertips, press down on the pump until the 3 formulas appear. For one application, dispense 2 pumps into the hand. Mix together in your hand until the three formulas are blended into a single serum texture. Apply the serum on a clean face and neck using outward and upwards motions for a visibly-lifted effect and follow with your usual moisturizer and eye cream. I personally prefer this serum as an evening skincare routine and I don’t apply anything on the top, it’s very rich on its own for me, a bit too oily for the mornings. I usually keep all my serums in a fridge, I just love the feeling of a cold liquid on my skin, face instantly gets this glowing dewy look that I love. The smell is amazing as well! I am not really thrilled with the dispenser but maybe I just need to get used to it. Getting freshly mixed product with every pump is great. The best part is how well it works. I have a new favorite yet again from Lancôme.

review_text: I was really skeptical about DE’s cleansing bars because I was worried it was just going to be an overhyped soap bar. I have very oily skin and I’ve had acne ever since I hit puberty. I’m not sure if this product alone would combat acne (I use the C-Firma mixed with the B-Hydration gel in the morning, and the TLC mixed with 3-4 drops of the Marula oil at night after I cleanse with the Peekee bar,) but it really helps with keeping my skin calm and clean. I recommend using only DE products because a) they work better together and b) I wholeheartedly believe that this skincare brand WORKS. My skin looks and feels calmer and clearer than it’s ever been, no joke. I still get minor breakouts but they’re almost always hormonal. I’m so impressed with this brand so I’d recommend trying it out if you can. All in all, a wonderful product from my new favorite skincare brand. I’ll be using it indefinitely.

review_text: WARNING: This product contains squalene. Squalene is made from shark liver oil. I checked the ingredients and it doesn’t say cruelty free. If you want to save our oceans, don’t buy this product or ANY product that contains squalene. If it is plant-based squalene it is okay. But if they do not specify it, it is most likely from sharks. Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. There are 100 million sharks killed each year, and if we keep using products like this, there won’t be many sharks left to kill. Furthermore, do you want to rub shark liver oil on your face??? I sure don’t. Please be mindful in the products you buy. You can do research to see what products are safe. Thank you!!

I put this product to the ultimate test by hiking in the desert on a windy, dry, sunny day. Overall, I think this could be a wonderful product for certain people. It has mineral SPF (YES!) and really does cover redness and even some deeper imperfections (such as acne scars). I found the coverage to be comparable to a light-coverage foundation or a really good BB cream. It also made my skin feel nice and supple, was non-sensitizing, and it even seemed to have controlled my oil production a bit throughout the day (I have combination skin). With that said, there were also some minor cons. It’s quite thick and can be a bit difficult to spread evenly onto your skin without tugging. To help with this, I recommend moisturizing well beforehand and patting, rather than rubbing, the product into your skin (then rub very gently to evenly blend). It can also cling to dry spots and even pill a little bit -- again, moisturize well beforehand and pat it into your skin. Finally, perhaps due to the SPF, it did make me look a bit pasty (not anything too crazy, but it is noticeable). Bronzer could help with this, if that’s your thing. Like I said, overall, I think it could work great for some people -- it’s a wonderful product with amazing ingredients. It didn’t work wonders for me personally, but I would absolutely recommend that you try it out if you have some redness, perhaps lean more oily, and need a good, gentle SPF.

Why would you even have SPF above 30 when studies have shown anything higher doesn’t make much of a difference? review_title: Great lip treatment for a full beat

product_name: C Beyond Triple Serum SPF 40 Mineral Sunscreen with Vitamin C 10% + Niacinamide

review_text: I am 50/50 on this product. It’s a good face wash but I haven’t notice any other benefits from it. review_text: Love it! It does a great job at removing all of my makeup and it’s soothing to my sensitive skin.

100% a new tatcha obsessed woman! This serum is a miracle worker. I’ve been struggling with my face feeling dry ever since moving to a new state and this stuff has saved me. My skin is so soft and smooth now. So glad I received it from influenster complimentary to review. Tatcha loyal now

product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Not a fan of this product. Sadly it’s really nice at first but not very hydrating. It’s like water gel that drys quickly and doesn’t really do much for my skin. I received this product free for testing purposes from Influenster.

A this price point I suppose I want the product to feel wonderful. I like Clarins facial shaping wrap mask better and its priced at $52. I switch back and forth. Again, the product is okay. The scent is a very subtle cucumber, refreshing.

I truly love this serum. My favorite way to use it is after a microneedling treatment. Because this serum doesn’t have any alcohol or chemical exfoliant ingredients it doesn’t irritate freshly microneedled skin AND right after a microneedling treatment the niacinamides and zinc are able to penetrate deeper in the skin. I also like using this in the morning underneath my very hydrating SPF - I find that this serum helps balance the oils in the SPF and keeps me from getting shiny throughout the day, while also giving me enough hydration in the AM.This will stay a staple in my skincare routine! I love that The Ordinary doesn’t add all of the fillers and fragrance that so many other skincare companies do.

This little helper has solved all of these problems. My lips are soft even without any lip balms/glosses/treatments. I used it at night, but also during the day, after a shower, if I feel like it ;) it has a silky texture, not sticky or uncomfortable. Also on the list of positives: it smells like berries, it comes with a cute little silicone applicator and it lasts forever!

review_title: LOVE the cream, refill doesn’t work.

review_text: I really wanted to love this stuff, but my lips reacted horribly to it and took months to recover fully. The product smells amazing and felt great on my lips at first, but after a few days my lips started to become extremely itchy, and the skin above my upper lip was bright red. I’ve been using the same chapstick for 5 years, and suddenly I could no longer put it on my lips during the day without burning and redness. I picked up some unscented lip balm, and had a less severe reaction, but even when using no lip balm my lips started peeling. I quit using the lip sleeping mask immediately. There was a red, dry patch above my lip for about a week afterwards, and now, TWO months after quitting the product, I still haven’t been able to go back to my regular lip balm, but at least the redness and burning is gone! If your skin is sensitive whatsoever, I would not recommend this product.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Really bummed this didn’t work for my very dry very sensitive skin. I started using this with the skin fix foaming oil cleanser and my face has never felt more stripped. This burned and made my face red the first time I put it on. Got slightly better over the month of use but didn’t hydrate me at all unfortunately. My skin also became so much drier that I’ve started breaking out more. Packaging is really great though love the pump.

This is very nice and nongreasy. Leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized, and absorbs reasonably quickly.However the scent, as many others have pointed out, is intolerable. It smells like dry dust, and the scent lingers for hours.If the scent were improved, this would get a 3 or a 4.
review_title: Nice moisturizer, but not worth the bad smell

review_text: I bought this from recommendations by Skincare by Hyram and Dr. Dray on youtube....and I am really let down. There is a gritty texture to this balm, so it feels rough on my skin. Another reviewer said that the grit may be from ground up oat. Aside from the grit in the formula, the balm portion is extremely thick and greasy, and does not spread easily so you have to use A LOT. It also does not remove regular non-waterproof mascara well, and I’m pretty sure it leaves a film or residue even after a second cleanse with a water based cleanser because I woke up the morning after using this with tiny white heads across my face. Also, the balm is melting in the tube sitting in a medicine cabinet away from the sun and in a 70 degree apartment. When I go to use this product, some oozes out in a liquid while some comes out in a solid balm form. I had high hopes because of the clean ingredients but the experience of this cleanser is a NO. I gave it two stars because I think someone with REALLY dry skin that does not wear makeup could benefit from this, but if you have oily skin or if you wear even just mascara, I would not recommend this. For reference, I have combination to oily acne prone sensitive skin. I also have used the tatcha, boscia, and hada labo cleansing oils and although not all of those were equally as satisfying, I have never had such a poor reaction I felt the need to return a cleansing oil product. This product I am returning.
review_title: Gritty texture, melts in bottle, leaves film

review_text: The best lip therapy I have ever used. Love all the colours.

review_text: I received this product to try through Influenster, but I must say I wasn’t very impressed. I liked the texture, which felt light and thin. It’s simply a hydrating serum and I think for the price there are better options on the market.

Between this and Good Genes at night, my skin is glowing and healthy.

broke within a month don’t waste your money seriously

review_text: I’m really disappointed. I wanted to like this SO badly. I have dehydrated skin that needed a boost. I got nothing out of this mask :( The formula dried oddly on my skin and made it feel more dehydrated.

I was so excited to try this product as I heard so many great things about the brand. But unfortunately, I returned it. It did nothing for my skin, and even gave me a little bit of a breakout which is not something I’m used to at all.

I am one of those poor unfortunate souls who get scars after every majorly great big ugly pimple. No matter what i do even if i do not touch it through out its entire pimple life, after its gone it always leaves a dark scar on my face. I don’t believe in gimmicks and i don’t like to buy too much stuff for my face because i find that people who do that tend to go through a ritual every morning with skin care products, and i work a lot so i really don’t have time for that, but I was so fed up with the many pimple scars on my face and people pointing it out to me all the time ( i know rude right) one day i was like f**k it. Went to sephora and ask one of the beauty experts there what they would recommend for someone like me with all the pimple scars on my face and she recommended me this product. Well i bought it anyways because the pimple scars on my face were getting to the point where i didn’t want to look at myself in the mirror anymore. My first time trying this was at night after i wash my face i put this on then i put a moisturizer on top and let me tell you when i woke up my face was soo smooth and hydrated and i notice that it looked brighter and after a week i noticed an improvement and so did everyone at work and so did my family, this product lasted me two months though but thats only because i would wash my face twice a day once when i wake up and once more when i come back from a long day of work and after washing my face i apply this serum and my moisturizer, but after two months my face looked absolutely flawless! oh and also i have combination skin type there are times when my skin get to oily or too dry but when using this product i found that it really help to just hydrate my face and make it feel normal and smooth it didnt make me feel too oily or too dry. So after this long review i absolutely recommend this product and i believe its worth the money :)

I’ll update this review in a few months with continual use. I can’t justify the price with this product right now.
review_title: not bad but not a miracle
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: I didnt like this product, I felt like it never absorbed on my skin, the tone made me looked dull, and on pictures it looked worse
product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40

review_text: I wanted to love this sunscreen so bad, but when I tried it out twice now I just couldn’t get over the finished look. It seemed to accentuate every pore or line on my face, the pearlescent quality was a bit too much for an everyday look and really made every line and pore look so bad.
review_title: made my pores and lines stand out
product_name: Mini Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: The best mask I have ever used. I followed the recommendation and used it once a day for the first 4 days and the once a week for a few weeks now. It has made my skin smooth and clear. Hands down the best results I have had from any mask. It does what it says it’s going to.
product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

review_text: I️ literally bought this two days ago because of all the amazing reviews and literally the next morning I️ had little tiny pimples around my cheek and chin. I️ checked the reviews with one star (which I️ should’ve done from the start) and that’s how I️ figured this broke me out
product_name: Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Swiss Glacier Water

review_text: Really hydrates my face but leaves it looking kinda greasy. Not a good look for oily skin. Does the job.
product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: It feels nice. But when I wake up after having it on overnight it makes my lips feel rubbery and nowhere near hydrating. It’s really weird.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: My package came all gooey. Product kept spilling. Did not make any difference as well. The only good part about this product is the applicator.

This product has a very strong scent, not horrible but not pleasant. It’s a scent I would rather not put on my face. However, not matter how bad a product smells, if it WORKS, then I can totally deal with the smell. This product has done nothing to my skin. I do not notice any difference just after using or after a week of daily use. I have used many skin care products, and the ones worth keeping in your regime typically blow you away within only a few uses. I’m afraid this guy will be going back to the store.
product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

review_text: After reading all about Josie Maran’s line I was excited to purchase this product. After using about half the bottle, I don’t think its all its cracked up to be. Perhaps I am using more than the recommended 3-4 drops at a time but I do find this to be too oily on my face (I have combination skin). The product does take a while to sink in (at least it did for me) but once it did, my skin was moisturized. Overall its an okay product in my eyes but after reading such great reviews, I been left wanting more.

First of all really luxurious packaging. I didn’t see any immediate changes but after few uses I genuinely felt this cream making my eye skin really dry.I mean whenever I put the cream it’s ok but half an hour later it feels dry and uncomfortable.Specially after a wash my eye area felt way too much dry,then I put back some cream after some time it became even dryer.
review_title: make my eyes even more dry,itchy.even rashes.
product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: I love this serum. Its lightweight but deeply moisturizing at the same time. The slight tint of the serum seems to add a little brightness to my skin, especially during the winter months when skin can be dull and dry. I’ve been using this for about 2 weeks and have noticed my skin seems more supple and hydrated without being overly photosensitive.
product_name: Argan Beta Retinol Pink Algae Serum

review_text: Was not impressed. Very spendy. Blocked pores and got pimples (I am way past that age). Believe you could get a better product at half the price.

I received this product sample to test by Ranavat. To set the scene, I’m almost 9 months postpartum and breastfeeding. My skin and hormones are still recovering and I essentially look like a teenager again with all the breakouts. I was so happy to try this. It’s a postpartum safe alternative to retinol. It feels so thick and luxurious, but my (now very dry) skin drank this up and there was no oily residue. Did not make my skin any more red than it normally looks. Can’t speak to how it would work long term but I would definitely keep this in my arsenal for now. First pic (white top) is with nothing on my face. Second pic (black top) is cleansed skin and using bakuchi crème as my moisturizer.
Love it as my first cleanser. It melts my make up, smells really good and is very gentle
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: This is actually my first review, but I have to share my frustration. I cannot actually review this product because the packaging is so defective. The pump mechanism does not actually function (could be missing a straw?) so in order to remove the lotion from the bottle, you have to shake it with all your might. This product was far too expensive to be worth such a hassle. I was a very loyal Biossance customer (love the squalane oil, but I’m not anymore :(

I was so EXCITED to received this product to test, as I am a big fan of the Genifique serum already! Well, the expectations were definitely not disappointed!! This eye balm is amazing. I have been using for just a week or so and i can see the difference already. My under eye area is the major issue i have right now, as it looks older than the rest of my face, wrinkly and dry, even tho i have been lathering creams and serums over and over with little or no changes. THIS cream tho! it is really making the fine line disappear little by little. Maybe it’s just me dreaming, but it works! It really does. Definitely invest in it! as i will be buying the product as soon as I am done with my free one!
product_name: Advanced Génifique Wrinkle & Dark Circle Eye Cream

review_text: Love this product! The exfoliant is not abrasive on the skin, it smells like pumpkin pie and leaves my skin feeling soft and clarified. Will definitely be buying again!

I didn’t have much expectations beyond these being refreshing eye patches, and they lived up to that. However, they’re a weird shape that made them annoying to wear. No matter how i positioned them, the little tail end always ended up poking me in the eye. Would not repurchase, and don’t think I’ll try any of the other PTR patches if they’re all the same shape.
review_title: Decent eye patches, but uncomfortable shape

review_text: I really had high hopes but I guess its not compatible with my skin. Used it and I started having breakouts even in places I’ve never had breakouts. I would have loved to keep trying but I’m currently fighting acne and hyperpigmentation and wouldn’t want my skin to get worse.
review_title: Didn’t work well with my skin.
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: I am a person who moderate acne and has always struggled with it. Nothing ever worked for me and I gave up on myself with everything until I saw really good reviews on this and decided to give it a try. My mom always told me that an acne product would never work overnight.. But she was surely wrong with this one. I used this treatment with my Panoxyl 10% bar and they seemed to work well together. I used this for one day (overnight) and I woke up with a face like Barbie’s.. I couldn’t be happier with this product. For once in my life I’ll have the clear skin I always dreamed of

I had painful breakouts around my mouth that wasn’t going away. After a few days of just using this with the skinfix face cream, my whole face cleared up. This cleanser is very gentle and non-drying too.

This product is very hydrating but if you have skin that easily breaks out I wouldn’t recommend it to you if you have normal to dry skin this is more suited for your skin type and I could see people love it for that reason
product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: No difference. Waste of money. Used consistently for 3 weeks.

Bought it based on reviews and the fact that I do get a bit red here and there. Returned it. It smells fake and feels sticky. I love a good oily/sticky serum but this one just felt gross on my skin. It’s hard to believe that all the ingredients are “clean“ when it literally smells like a candy. I don’t want candy on my face. Hard pass.
product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides

review_text: If you break out easily, AVOID THIS PRODUCT. It has Isopropyl Isostearate as a higher up ingredient, which has a comedogenic rating of 5 (which is the worst rating, meaning it will clog pores). It also has other comedogenic ingredients. I broke out in places I never breakout using this stuff.

Whyyyyyy did this get reformulated!? This was everything for my sensitive eczema prone skin. Bought a new jar and used it yesterday and it caused the WORST flare up…only to check the ingredients and find eucalyptus oil. This makes ZERO sense for a brand riding on the tails of being good for sensitive skin. No thank you. Very disappointed in FAB.
I have normal to dry skin. I haven’t used this under makeup, but I did use it under my daily moisturizer after washing my face and I live how my bare face has been looking all day!
I honestly love this product. I’ve tried so many acne products and haven’t found any to work.. i use it both morning and night and within a week I saw such a difference in my skin and less breakouts
product_name: Acne+ 2% BHA + Azelaic Acid + Niacinamide + AHA Cleanser

review_text: I tried this several times to give it a chance, but it did nothing for me and left my face red and breaking out each time.
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: This was gifted by Ren skincare in exchange for a review. I have acne prone areas of skin (chin and forehead) and always looking for products to help with hyperpigmentation from acne. This one had a great lightweight gentle texture. It absorbs into the the skin nicely and I am able to layer it underneath my moisturizer and spf. However I did not notice much improvement to my hyperpigmentation and stubborn old acne marks.
review_title: Glowy skin but nothing for Hyperpigmentation

review_text: OH. MY. GLOW. This arrived at the right time, just when I started incorporating retinol in my skin care routine again. I was dealing with some dryness and flaking Skin which is expected. But when I got this Complimentary from Charlotte Tilbury and Influenster, in exchange for my honest review, I used it right away by replacing my current nighttime moisturizer from dr jart. A little bit (dime size) was enough for my face. This is thick and my skin just soaked it all up. Love the glow I get when I use this! The scent is very mild and pleasant. I’ve had this in my Sephora wish list and Nordstrom wish list but could never quite push the add to cart then checkout buttons. I mean, she’s not exactly budget friendly, but wow, after this, I’m SOLD. I haven’t seen any specific changes related to skin tone brightness but it has definitely helped keep My skin hydrated. This cream will be best for Dry skin, and for winter months. I have oily to normal skin, and I haven’t experienced any breakouts for the last two weeks I’ve been using it in my nighttime routine (only). This cream is a splurge but oh so worth it!
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I am a big fan of Farmacy products! I have used the farmacy green clean cleansing balm, honeymoon glow, and honey grail and I really like them! This cleanser HOWEVER was a bummer! I have an oily t-zone with the rest of my face normal. This cleanser strips away all the oils from your face and leaves you feeling tight and dry! My skin even started getting itchy and irritated! I had to stop it right away and things went back to normal. I purchased it along with the cleansing balm from the Farmacy website after all the good reviews on Spehora! I can’t return it anymore since I’ll have to return the cleansing balm as well which I’m actually enjoying! So, unless your skin is SUPER oily, I would steer clear from this cleanser! After digging a bit, I also noticed a bunch of other reviews complaining of the same issue. I really wish Farmacy would change the formula of this cleanser or at least come up with a new formula for normal less oily skins!
product_name: Clean Bee Ultra Gentle Facial Cleanser

review_text: I would say this is a very gentle overnight treatment compared to what I am used to. Seems like a non-intimidating way to get into resurfacing. On the flip side I also feel like I can slather it on without a lot of other steps and still feel like I’m doing something to my skin! Scent is lovely but definitely present, if you try to avoid those types of things.

I got a free sample of this last t me i ordered from sephora and couldn’t wait to try it, i had heard so many good things about it i wanted soo much to love it, but unfortunately i couldn’t get past the smell. I’ve got a sensitive nose and it did not like it. The product worked fantastic on my face, left it smooth and soft. But the nose knows.

I have hereditary eyebags. I agree with some of the reviews that this works great if you don’t wear makeup. It doesn’t mix well with liquid or powder foundation. The instruction said don’t apply lotion before applying the product, but the product makes the skin quite dry. The skin feels uncomfortably tight after it dries. I’ll be returning this.
product_name: Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener

review_text: There has been a need to improve the old nose strips and I was hoping this was it - its not. First off, you have to wear them for hours so be prepared to have all day or be able to sleep with them on overnight - and they are very uncomfortable, thick and sticky. I actually cut the size down to try to make it work better and not pull the skin around my eye area. When you remove them, I’m not even sure if they’ve cleaned the pores versus just suffocated them. Don’t waste your time on this one.
review_title: Not Great As a Pore Cleaner

review_text: This cleanser has done nothing to clear or prevent breakouts on my face. Still get them on a weekly basis even though I wash my face with this stuff daily.

It was very thick like an SPF 50 would be. It went on very white and took about 5 minutes to dry, though when it dried it did not dry white. However, I would prefer the SPF that I put on my face not be so thick since I do put make up on top of it. It smelled nice and it was not greasy at all, just too thick for my liking.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Cream SPF 50+ Face Sunscreen

review_text: This did nothing for me and didn’t seem to really clean the skin like others. It’s gentle but almost too gentle. The scent was annoying but since it’s a cleanser, I would wash off and then use my other toners. Not worth the money in my opinion.

Honestly, I’m not sure how to feel about this product. Throughout the years I have always used glycolic acid because it has helped my acne! I was so excited to receive this product and finally try it out, it’s like a mini facial! I did love how it made my skin feel at first, but the next day my skin was very oily and very sensitive. It would almost hurt to wash my face because my skin felt so thin! I have always had fair combination skin that is somewhat sensitive, so this may be why. I am still glad that I had the opportunity to test this product out, and wish that I can try it again to see if I would get the same affect as the first time!
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: Tastes great with cold water and ice! Great for your skin too! I like the boost of vitamin c for immune support as well. Take in the morning with my morning glass of water. No instant results but a good regimen for sure!
review_title: tastes good & good for your skin

review_text: The only thing that has ever reduced my under eye bags. They aren’t completely gone but much improved. Wrinkles also look less obvious.
product_name: 24K Gold Pure Luxury Lift & Firm Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

review_text: I too agree that something has changed with this cleanser. I have been using it for two years and it was my HG, not it dries my skin to the point where it hurts. It first started in the summer so I know it is not the cold weather.

despite being a face cream i ended up with about 20 little tiny, painful whiteheads all over my chin. thought it was a fluke, tried it again once my skin cleared up, and it happened again. wouldn’t recommend.
product_name: Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Sunscreen Face Cream

review_text: REALLY wanted to love this product but unfortunately this broke me out horribly. I’m so disappointed. The reviews looked promising! To note, my skin has not had a break out in a long time. This was the only product I added to my skincare routine for a hopeful boost but unfortunately I’m now suffering a huge set back after just 3 days of use of this product. Even a week later and my skin has not recovered. I have dry fair skin that is not sensitive to new products. May work great for others but not for me. :(
product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil

review_text: I’ve tried this product for a little over a week and I haven’t seen much of a change. I don’t have super dark under eyes, just a bit of a shadow you can say and I can’t honestly say I’ve seen a big difference in my before and after. I was using the banana eye cream from ole henriksen which I love before this so I may just keep using that. I do like the consistency of the cream though, it has a satin feel.
product_name: Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum

review_text: Gifted by Hourglass. First impression is this serum comes in a sturdy glass/ceramic package. It has a strong smell but not bad. It glides across my face and seems to really Penetrate the skins barrier. It is hydrating as well.

This product would be good for someone looking for a DAY time moisturizer that sits well under makeup. It’s very light. Honestly I can not tell I am wearing it (good and bad thing) Unfortunately I have combo-dry skin and it just was not thick enough. Has a nice light smell. Will be searching for something thicker and more long-lasting.
product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: This La Mer product was the one that impressed me the most. It hydrates and it makes your face matte without taking away the moisture. This sat nicely on makeup and alone. I felt like my skin well taken care of. I just feel like there’s better options out there that can do the same.
review_title: Hydrates and makes you matte, but

review_text: I had a flaky dry patch under my eye from a lactic acid I’ve been using. It was obvious and itchy, and because it was flaky no undereye concealer would work. I had a sample of this and tapped it under and around my eyes before bed. Voila! Overnight no more patch of flaky skin! Since then I’ve taken to using this nightly around my eyes and mouth. My skin looks plumped and my eye area is less crepey, with concealers setting more flawlessly. Definitely picking up the full size!
review_title: Quick healer for dry, flaky skin!
product_name: Pure Argan Milk Intensive Hydrating Treatment

review_text: I have combination skin, and I love the consistency of the SEPHORA COLLECTIONNourishing Moisturizer with Prebiotics. The moisturizer has been a total game-changer to my skincare routine. I love that this product is unscented, and can be used in the am and pm.

I received a sample of this product and after just one use, I bought the full size. It’s that good. It is deeply moisturizing and leaves skin soft and silky. Whether or not it controls oil I have no idea — my skin tends to be on the dry side. But it is wonderful if you have normal or dry skin and want something that soaks into your skin and feels nice and light. I am seriously in love.

this moisturizer is amazing! I’ve bought 2 full size bottles on my own and always choose the drunk elephant minis when I get a free sephora gift! this lotion wears so well under makeup and has never made me break out. the packaging is all so cute and i love the pump on this moisturizer too!
I did everything it told be too. I tried it for 6 days. I saw nothing change. The crest whiting works better. I was hoping this would work. But sadly nope.
product_name: GLO Brilliant White Smile - At Home Teeth Whitening Device

review_text: Not for me. Unfortunately my skin broke out as soon as I started to use this product. I stopped for a few days, and my skin started to clear up. I used it again and my skin broke out again so I returned the product. On the upside, the sales consultant was awesome when I had to return it. So I ended up buying a moisturizer there rather than going to a competitor.

I prefer Tata Harpers clarifying cleanser. Going to return this and repurchase hers. Wanted to try this due to reviews, and it’s a lot cheaper. But this wasn’t as potent. I had no brightening, or clearing of pores with this. After using Tatas AHA/BHA cleanser my skin is NOTICEABLY brighter, clearer, and glowing. It’s just worth it to get what actually works.
product_name: Acne+ 2% BHA + Azelaic Acid + Niacinamide + AHA Cleanser

review_text: Eh not my favorite. It pills off which I hate and just doesn’t stay. I am not a huge fan of how it feels on the skin.
product_name: Mini Mineral Sheerscreen Sunscreen SPF 30 PA+++

review_text: I wanted to love this, but it’s just so watery and runny. Makes me think it’s not working on account of being so watered down.

I’ve just started using this serum so I cannot speak to whether or not it will impact the texture of my skin but I’m loving the initial results! The serum is very silky and goes on very well after my toner and leaves my face feeling moisturized. The scent is mild with floral/grassy/clean notes. It leaves my skin calm and looking fresh!
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: I bought this product after a Beauty guru recommended it and I absolutely love it!! The only downside is that there is a small amount of product but other than that it keeps my lips soft all day.

No way! I bought this product and was very excited to try it but I absolutely hated it. I put it on once and felt so greasy and the tinted color is this weird, thick almost goo-like moisturizer. I’m shocked this has any positive reviews at all. Don’t wast your time or money!
product_name: Argan Daily Moisturizer Tinted SPF 47 Protect + Perfect

review_text: I really wanted to try this product but after using it the first time I broke out but I wasn’t sure if it was this product so I continued to used it and after 5 days of use I had several pimples on my face.

I recently got the sample size version with my points and used it once daily for a little over a week. It might just be my skin but I was not impressed. I have found other creams to absorb better in my skin, this took a lot longer and it didn’t seem to do much for my skin. I am in my 20s so maybe that’s why I didn’t see the effects of it? But I am glad I didn’t spend my money purchasing it

I’ve used this Biossance product for the last 6 months, however my new bottle and face are now feuding (current cyctic breakouts). Not sure if this is from the product yet, but it will be sitting in timeout until my skin heals.
product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil

review_text: Sadly, no. This isn’t a great physical exfoliater. It’s nice that your hands stay clean while you apply - but you may want to use your fingers to rub the product since the stick applying it doesn’t create much friction. When I used it first on my hand - rubbing the stick into my skin left black chunks stuck in my larger pores. I had to scrub to get them out. I didn’t notice this to be a problem on my face but I scrubbed less and have small facial pores. Not worth it. Glad I got the tiny version to try first.

I got this cleanser in the Sephora Favourites kit earlier this year and I love it.I find this cleanser really takes my make up off at the end of the day. It melts away my long lasting foundation and removes any traces of leftover mascara around my eyes. I really like the smell of this too, smells powdery which I love. I probably wouldn’t of looked at this cleanser before if it wasn’t in the Sephora Favourites kit. I feel the packaging isn’t appealing and the price seems a little high. But after trying it out, I shouldn’t judge the cleanser by it’s packaging because it is worth every penny.
review_title: Removes make up and smells great

review_text: I have sensitive and oily skin, the texture of this cream is very thick and seems to sit on the skin for a bit but it does not irritate my skin which is great! I have yet to see results but will continue to use it. I received this product from influencer in exchange for my honest opinion and For now I’m rating it 4 stars

I experienced the worst breakouts all over my face after using this mask two nights. There is an emollient called Isopropyl Myristate high up in the ingredient list which I suspect is the issue because it is known to cause pore clogging for some acne prone skin types. If you have acne prone skin I recommended either skipping this mask or doing a patch test first. I do think it would be lovely for people with normal to dry skin with no acne issues
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: the worst moisturizer ever. It made my skin pill like crazy even with it just being washed and nothing else on. thumbs down for me.

I love using this moisturizer every morning because it smells so amazing. The orange scent is perfect. It’s also a fantastic moisturizer. I can always expect great quality from Origins. Will purchase as long as they make it. Hopefully forever.

I don’t recommend this product. I bought it because of the price, and hearing all the hype about AHA/BHA I wanted to give it a go. I give two stars because it’s very cheap and affordable. But otherwise it dried up and irritated my skin every time I used it and I tried for 6 weeks now - I think it’s safe to say it didn’t work for me. I don’t recommend.
HAVENT seen a difference. One it stinks and two it breaks me out with whiteheads. There are cheaper better options.
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: I just don’t understand. All I see is positive reviews but here I am... my skin has never been this bad. I’ve been on the same skin care routine for about 6 months and I decided to give this a trying because of all of the positive reviews. So I used this before bed and I woke up to the worst skin of my life. My entire face has this weird almost dry texture and little bumps everywhere. I’ve never had this reaction before and it’s now been several days and not much has changed. It’s not even that I want my money back but I want my skin back....
product_name: Advanced Génifique Radiance Boosting Face Serum

review_text: After using for a month, I’m not convinced. It’s feels nice the cooling effect but nothing impressed.
product_name: Glow + Get It Cooling & Brightening Eye Balm

review_text: Formula changed and not for the better. Super disappointed because I used to love the exfoliating wipes. It doesn’t take off all my makeup and the smell is meh.

I purchased this during the VIB sale, and I noticed that I could use my points to get a sample size and returned the bigger size bottle... BIGGEST MISTAKE! This is the smoothest, silkiest feeling cleanser I have ever used and as a chick with oily skin, it does very well. I will be purchasing the full size product along with the moisturizer.. My new skin regime!

This product is highly effective at lightening my acne scars, and helps give a radiant glow. I love how energized my skin feels in the morning when I use it, it has a nice citrusy scent. Also, the pump dispenses just enough product, two pumps covers my entire face to be effective so the bottle will last awhile. The only issue I have is that if you get the product near your mouth or on your lips it has a very off putting taste so just be careful about not getting it near that area. Overall, I’m very impressed with the performance and how much of a healthier glow I have, this is a great product to use in the winter when my facial skin gets a bit dull.
It did not work for me unfortunately. I get couple of pimples a month so bought this product for that after seeing raving reviews. It did not do anything to the acne. Will return the product back.

This product was sent to me complimentary from Glow Recipe. I was excited to try this product since my pores are a major insecurity for me. Despite regular exfoliation, they remain slightly enlarged. The product applied smoothly and left my skin with a soft, velvety finish. Although I didn’t notice any immediate “blurring“ effects, it felt pleasant and didn’t change how makeup applied on top. I’m just not sure about incorporating it into my daily routine. It feels a bit odd to apply a BHA product over my sunscreen. Perhaps I’ll use it on days when I wear lighter makeup. It didn’t entirely blur my pores, but it did provide a subtle softening effect. While I’m unsure how it fits into my personal routine, I appreciate the versatility of this product.
review_title: I don't notice too much of a difference

review_text: I was super excited to try this moisturizer because I absolutely love the smell and it felt great on the back of my hand. It still felt nice on my face but found it did nothing for my dry skin and little for any dulness. I also found it to break me out :( I would recommend this for people with already great skin to begin with. It’s cheaper than most moisturizers but I found it did nothing for me

I absolutely LOVE the Farmacy line! But this was just okay for me. It feels great and doesn’t have an offensive scent, but it feels like it strips my skin just a little too much. I have oily skin with some dryness and this cleanser was no friend to my face. I will say that the other products I have from Farmacy are straight fire.
review_title: Not bad but not great either
product_name: Whipped Greens Oil-Free Foaming Cleanser with Moringa and Papaya

review_text: Does an amazing job at melting my waterproof makeup with very little effort and my skin does feel nice. However, it has a texture that’s hard to wash off. Unlike other balms that immediately washes off like milk, washing this balm just feels like heavy residue.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

this sunscreen is incredibly shiny and greasy on my face. In high heat and humidity it gets worse by getting sticky and stuck to my hair. it is moisturizing, good for the rest of the body but there’s cheaper and better options.

It also doesn’t rinse off as well as the old stuff, so I had to follow up with another cleanser to get the waxy residue gone. My skin does not benefit from this product at all.No idea why brands do this to their loyal customers; I had been buying this scrub for years and now I’m giving up on the whole brand because the flakiness and lack of consistent quality is simply not worth it.
review_title: The new/current formula is utterly terrible.

review_text: This product promises your pores to be clear but for me it only took of the top layer. It didn’t change my skin that much and all the reviews hype it up to much.
product_name: Volcanic AHA Pore Clearing Clay Mask

review_text: My skin is extremely oily. I saw this product and thought it would be perfect for me so I went into Sephora to purchase. Even the skincare rep told me this would be great. WRONG! I do not understand what’s so great about this. There is nothing amazing about it besides the beautiful packaging. It smells ok, gently exfoliates. But I have gone through an entire bottle with no results. Even after washing I don’t see or feel any true difference in my skin.
product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: by far my favorite face product. leaves skin feeling soft and supple! I feel prettier after I use this with NO makeup
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Gifted by Hum Nutrition. Gummies are my favorite way to take vitamins and supplements and this one is super tasty! The gummy shape makes them super portable and great for travel as well. Great way to get some ACV in your life
product_name: PRO ACV Healthy Gut Vegan Gummies with 100% Organic Apple Cider Vinegar and Probiotics

review_text: I have really sensitive, acne-prone combo skin. I live in TX but went up north for the holidays and the weather changes usually make my skin super flaky and dry and very very red. This has been an absolute dreaaaaam. In TX it’s the perfect calmness to my redness and moisturizes enough and give a healthy, awaken glow. Whereas when I was in MI, and the harsh snow and the dry skin issues mix, it was the best out of all the moisturizers I brought up there with me. I had no flakiness, no dry patches, no thick feeling of wanting to wash my face and take the product off. I have liked the Dior and Sunday Riley moisturizers but this one has literally become a staple in such a short amount of time. I hope y’all never stop creating this product!!!

I’m 42 and have tried every pimple hack and treatment in my many years; not one has been as effective as these babies! Put the sticker on clean skin before bed then wake up and be truly amazed. I won’t post a gross photo but you can actually see the gunk that the dot has sucked out of your zit. It clears things up literally overnight. (Minor blemishes; have not tried on any whoppers yet. lol). Love them!

I have tried all of the ones that they have in the line. The feeling is great on my lips. I can’t even begin to count how many I have purchased. The gummy bear one is my personal favorite as the scent is not overpowering like their original (pink) one. I prefer these over their night treatment because I like the ability to squeeze the product out.

I love this essence! It has made my skin feel so soft and smooth after only a week. I noticed a slight difference the first time I used it, but it took the full week to really see my skin glow. I do feel the price point is a bit high, but I can see the value in it.
product_name: Micro Essence Treatment Lotion with Bio-Ferment

review_text: No noticeable difference with use. Somewhat disappointing because typically enjoy Tatcha products.

Not worth the money. I had a sample of good genes and it was nice, but not any better than some other acids I’ve used. Glossier’s toner is much better for a fraction of the cost. But these products together are supposed to be amazing ... based on the hype I was expecting to be blown away by Luna but didn’t really notice much of anything. I have pretty well-behaved skin, needing some anti-aging support and lots of moisture. Going back to my normal products.
product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo

review_text: I wanted to love this oil, but my skin started to itch and a slew of blemishes rose up on clear skin within hours of using it. Once I washed it off the itching subsided pretty quickly. I do have acne prone skin, but this isn’t a normal breakout for me.
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: *Gifted by Farmacy Beauty* but this is my honest opinion. This is a very good cleanser just like their original Green cleansing balm but this one doesn’t have fragrance! It melts makeup away very easily (but I did need to put extra effort into taking off waterproof mascara) and my skin didn’t feel stripped off. I like using this in my ‘double cleanse’ makeup removal routine to make sure I have no trace of makeup left over. Overall this is a very good cleanser!!
product_name: Clearly Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: This moisturizer is super thick, to the point that it’s hard to rub it in, but somehow also not very moisturizing. I do like the mild scent and that it is not greasy. Once it’s absorbed my skin feels nice but a few minutes later will start to feel a bit tight like it needs more moisture. This is going back and I’ll stick to my trusty Youth to the People adaptogen moisturizer.
Amazing chapstick! I like it much better than the Drunk Elephant. Make sure to use your finger to scrape out the remaining product once it’s all the way twisted up. There’s a lot left!!!

Unfortunately this made me break out. I have oily acne prone skin. I would wake up with 2-3 white heads after using it at night. Doesn’t exfoliate as well as a lactic acid, which is what I’m switching to since it doesn’t break me out.

I have just recently started using this, but I am already seeing drastic Improvements to my skin. My skin seems to already smoothing out after only a month of use. I will continue to implement this moisturizer into my daily routine.
product_name: SD Advanced  PLUS Intensive Moisturizer For Wrinkles & Stretch Marks

review_text: Did not like at all. I think the spots on my face actually got darker. Zero stars as it did nothing good.

I received a frees sample of bareminerals Skinlongevity long life herb serum from PinchMe. I really enjoyed this product, it made my skin feel clean and refreshed. I liked the smell and the fact it is natural and cruelty free is such a great bonus!
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: A great hydrating cream that I usually use at night when the ac is on blast, my skin is plumper and happier in the morning. Will see myself using this more in the cooler temps.
product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: After I jumped off birth control, at 27, I didn’t expect breakouts. But, they came full force..all over my forehead & my chin. I have been using this face wash for at least 2 months and I just keep getting new breakouts.. With no changes to the current ones. I will not repurchase unfortunately.
It looks good, this brand is very famous, it is not useful yet, I hope the effect can be good, the packaging is very good, no sample is given, but it doesn’t matter
I love love this! So moisturizing and smells delicious. Will definitely buy more!

Good product formulation - horrible packaging that peels off and ends up on hands/face. I won’t be rebuying this again.. There are superior or equally as good sunscreens out there at a much cheaper price with better packaging. I bought this due to hype of the formulation online. Funny how many people who promoted this product didn’t mention how bad the packaging was. Most likely because they were paid promotions which again I’ve fallen sucker too. :/
product_name: The Silk Sunscreen Mineral Broad Spectrum SPF 50 PA++++ with Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide

review_text: I’ve been using their retinol line on and off for many years now and always had a wonderful experience and result. The serum is one of my favorites from this line. It’s so effective yet gentle since it contains flower extract and hyaluronic acid. I’ve experienced zero negative side effects and skin always looks and feels hydrated, plump and smooth. I prefer to use it in the evening so I can layer on thicker cream on top.

Because I like the actual product I gave it two stars even tho the packaging got me wanting to give it zero stars. I can’t wait for this bottle to be out of my life. I don’t want to throw it away or squeeze into another friendlier bottle. How did the team at tatcha miss this? Having to squeeze really hard a pretty solid bottle, then all the writing on it comes off and gets all over your hands... you have to shake upside down for it to go all the way down before you squeeze ever so slightly so the whole thing doesn’t dump off. Ugh. Please let me know when the packaging changes, before then, NEVER again
product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: I LOVE this moisturizer! Very rich and makes my skin feel soft. I like he smell, citrusy but not offensive. I prefer that to a strong floral scent. A little goes a long way! My skin cane be oily, but this was moisturizing without being greasy.
product_name: Mini Confidence in a Cream Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I have mildly sensitive, normal sometimes combo skin, and this was not good for me. It left an odd sticky feeling on my face, sort of rough. It also made me break out in tiny bumps on my forehead and cheeks!
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: I gave this a pretty fair go and used this product for a year. During that year I saw no difference or change to my eye area. It felt nice and moisturizing going on but there was no noticeable difference even after a year. I love Drunk Elephant products, I use a number of others in my daily skincare routine but this was a total dud for me. Save your money.
review_title: Total Dud Even After a Year of Use

review_text: It cleans and leaves skin feeling fresh. I have acne prone skin and this has helped a lot especially in conjunction with my other products. It is not drying and is very gentle.
I’m a fan of the Jet Lag mask but this was a no go for me. Smells nice, but that was about it.
Nothing has changed so far. I am almost finished one and didn’t see any positive outcome.
product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream

review_text: I was impressed with the silk pillow case, at first that is. I didn’t really notice any significant difference in my skin but did like how my skincare did seem to not stay on my skin more then me pillowcase. Sleeping on a cool pillow was also a plus but, as soon as I washed the pillow case (as instructed on gentle and with a light detergent like method), it was a totally different pillow case. It is warped, will not de wrinkle, and doesn’t even feel remotely the same. What a disappointment after splurging and spending $85 on a pillowcase. I was worried about this because of precious claims in other reviews so I tried to prolong a wash as long as possible but it is what it is

I’ve only been using this for a couple of weeks & I can tell that my skin is clearer. It is a bit pricey but if it keeps up with what it’s been doing then the price tag won’t be an issue for me. Definitely would recommend so far.

I saw so many reviews raving about this and was so hoping this worked for me. After only seconds of applying it immediately started burning my face. I only put it on half my face to test my reaction. The photos are the results of immediately washing this off and it still did this to my face.
I did not see any changes what they have claimed. Its just a hype. Not worth for price.

I got a sample of this and am going to buy the full set, this really changed the look and feel of my face after one use, it went from dry and dull with black heads, to clear, soft, with a really pretty dewy look that I just love. I probably wouldn’t use it as a daily cleanser, but definitely as a treatment once a week.
product_name: Alpha Beta Ultra Gentle Daily Peel Pads for Sensitive Skin

review_text: Great everyday gentle cleanser for sensitive, irritation prone skin. My face reacts poorly to so many cleansers but this is my first nightmare free cleanser in a while! Couldn’t be happier with the results The scent is great and not aggressive which is also a plus.
This is great, but beware there IS peppermint oil in this spray, if you are sensitive to it!
product_name: Facial Spray with Aloe, Cucumber and Green Tea

review_text: I normally don’t write reviews but I just have to say how bad this cleanser is. I had really high hopes for this cleanser since I heard Tatcha was a really good brand. I have acne prone/ oily and sensitive skin. I am 18 and this cleanser was too harsh for me, so I’m not sure if this product will work better on more mature skin despite the fact it’s for “all skin types”. It is especially too harsh for a “daily” cleanser with the luffa fruit as an exfoliant. Right after use, my face felt really clean, but it wasn’t until the next day I found that this product caused my skin to breakout and left it dry, with even in my most oily parts of my face, like my T-Zone, was left dehydrated. After one use my skin has become even more worse than it was before because it become DRY, TIGHT, and EVEN MORE SENSITIVE than ever. I got a facial the following week to try to improve my skin and even the esthetician commented on how tight and dry my skin was. It has been 3 WEEKS from using the cleanser ONCE and I’m still recovering from the damage it has done. DO NOT RECOMMEND
product_name: The Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

review_text: Got this as a sample for my birthday and holy heck I’m going to buy the full size when it runs out! I’m always looking for a good moisturizer and this one is perfect! Pricey but worth it!

Classic product, have used it for years. Very gentle but effective for sure. I love how unique and versatile it is to use as well! Great to travel with, and of course convenient that you can use it daily. Gifted by Dermalogica sampling

Out of all the retinol products I have tried, this product is by far the strongest. It did make my skin look nice, smooth and glowing, but its important to be careful because it also made my skin peel. I like the fact that the product came separated from serum to retinol powder, ready to mix after opening box. I would recommend this for people with oily or aging skin.
product_name: Retinol Fast-Release Wrinkle Reducing Night Serum

review_text: The new formula is horrible. The CC Cream was amazing and I was so relieved to have found my perfect foundation and then they changed it. This CC screen is absolutely horrible, it’s dry, chalky, patchy and the color is also off. At first it’s too light and then it quickly oxidizes to a yellow/orange. I’m just really sad as the CC Cream was amazing and I can’t find a replacement for it. I tried to use this by mixing with moisturizer, but quickly found out that this new formula also makes me break out. It’s essentially cursed.
review_title: Bring back the old formula, most people hate this
product_name: CC Screen 100% Mineral CC Cream SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: This product pills so badly. I wear a minimal amount of skincare products in the morning, toner, HA serum, Vitamin C serum and a moisturizer. This sunscreen pilled so badly as soon as I rubbed it in it started forming into little balls and did not absorb into my skin at all. I tried it again without a moisturizer and the same thing happened. Not able to use it at all just threw it away.
product_name: RESIST Youth-Extending Daily Hydrating Fluid SPF 50

review_text: this is awesome! I use it for some of the dry areas on my face and it works wonders! It also keeps my lips moist for hours!
I got a sample of this cream and loved it so I bought a full sized jar. I really like it, especially with the serum. I have used up the sample serum and will probably by the full size.

I’ve been a glowrecipe fan ever since I tried the watermelon sleeping mask. This serum is light weight and absorbs super quickly into my skin. My first impression is great, I had no reactions or irritations so far. I noticed that my redness was less the next morning too. Definitely will repurchase this.
product_name: Avocado Soothing Skin Barrier Serum with Ceramides

review_text: I wanted to give this product as much time as possible to see the effects. It’s been several weeks now and I honestly haven’t seen much of a change. I’ve always had fine lines, thin, crepey eyelids, and dark circles. I haven’t seen any improvements in the lines or eyelids but according to my husband my dark circles have been reduced slightly (though I guess for him to actually notice it must have been quite a difference!). Another thing I didn’t care for was how it made my skin feel once it dried. It was almost tacky, so if I happened to rub my eye it ended up pulling the skin way more than my usual eye cream does.
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Eye Serum

review_text: Although I found this product effective, the sulfur smell was too overpowering and even after taking a shower I couldn’t get rid of it. I had to return it.
review_title: The smell was too much for me

review_text: IM OBSESSED!! When I saw that milk was coming out with a cleanser, I was ecstatic!! I mean just look at that packaging. I ended up receiving the product as a free tester but I would have spent the money bc it is the best and easiest cleanse I’ve had in awhile. It’s more of a cream base, so a little goes a long way. Also it left my skin so moisturized and soft!! my skin usually feels tight after cleansers so this was great!! thanks milk

The price point is good and I love that it’s all natural. It keeps my eyes moisturized. That’s about where the benefits end. It didn’t help my dark circles, I might be imagining it but they actually seem worse after using this twice daily for two weeks. No improvement with fine lines. My eyes aren’t puffy so I can’t speak to that. All this I can deal with, since it is natural and moisturizes well and since my fine lines aren’t too bad yet anyway, what is making me return it is the fact that it makes me eyes sting and water no matter how little I use even if I stay away from my waterline. Definitely not a fan of that, otherwise it would have been tolerable enough to keep.
product_name: Superfood Hydrate + Firm Peptide Eye Cream

review_text: best lip balm i have ever tried. leaves your lips looking fresh and glossy- and smells delicious. could not live without this.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I’ve tried countless products over the past 9 years, as my lips are dry year round. I gave up and started carrying around petroleum jelly everywhere I went. This product worked after 1 night! After I woke up my lips were super soft and hydrated. I do have to apply lip balm here and there though.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I wanted to test this product as I am entering my 20s and have noticed that I am pretty expressive in my forehead, and it has not disappointed. I’m excited to see the long term results of this product, and learn more about retinols as well! This serum has a great lightweight feel, and was easy to add into my nighttime regime. Here’s to being more youthful!

Pretty disappointed in this moisturizer. At first, I thought it would be my next go-to, but as the days went by I noticed it didn’t hydrate my forehead. My forehead is the driest part of my face, but it’s still oily. I’m not giving it one star ONLY because it felt pretty good going on and smells okay.
product_name: SEA drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer

review_text: I love Dr. Jart products. I bought these hoping they could bring a zit I had to a head. It wasn’t that deep of a zit. Another popular pimple patch had brought similar zits to a head. Anyway, first day I left it on for two hours. The second day I left it on overnight. If anything, it was worse. It was more red and the skin around it where the patch was stuck was flaky. And you only get 6 patches for your money.

I get to try tons of masks as samples and this was one of them. i have used another Origins product - Clear Improvements charcoal mask and love it because it actually works. Coming back to this one, the scent of the mask is amazing. Very citrus like and fresh without being over powering. The mask feels gritty once on the face and I like this because it also acts as an exfoliator while washing off. It left my face clean, glowing and absolutely radiant. I got 3 uses from the sample I received and will be purchasing the full size now :).
product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

review_text: Nope - just sits on top of my skin and never sinks in. I didn’t realize this had coconut oil in it either, which my skin does not agree with. Glad I only bought a mini.
product_name: Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: I am convinced that my prolonged use of this product has made my lips more prone to dryness. I was also on a set with professional makeup artists and they commented that every model they worked with with dry lips used this lip mask. I do not recommend, even though it feels great on your lips, i don’t think its good for you in the long term use. I used this for two years and my lips have never been more dry and trying to find something to heal them has been challenging
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I rather enjoy my roller. I use it lightly gliding over my face repeatedly while watching tv. I used the herbivore Phoenix oil with it. It’s very soothing and my complexion looks great.

So I can’t be the only one, “Tik Tok made me buy it” , BUT I had really high hopes for this . This made me look like an ORANGE walking down the street. It’s no where near bronzed glow, it made me orange. And my skin is already olive skin so I thought it would just make me tanner. Horrible horrible product. And you use half the bottle in one use.
Very streaky. Why hasn’t science perfected a self-tanner!?
It helps with acne scaring and flaky skin but breaks me out like crazy! I wish this worked for me. The smell is weird and it’s an ok product.
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: Didn’t do anything for my acne prone sensitive skin

Love this product definitely helped with my dark spots. I broke out really bad from stress 2018/19 and had lots of ache scars on my cheeks. I never write reviews unless something is really good or really bad, this product is excellent.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: I was using the murad acne cleanser before this and I loved it the only thing it really dried by skin out, and it never took my texture away. I saw the reviews on this product and the other Somerville products and I decided to go for it. My texture has improved overnight I love this product and it doesn’t dry out my skin as much. I would totally recommend this product to anyone with troubled skin. If your sensitive to scents it does have a slight sulfur smell but it’s not bothersome. I would also keep in mind that this is an acne product so you can’t just wash your face and done, it will dry you face slightly. I cant express enough the importance of moisturizing!!
Makes your skin sticky, even made mine itch a little. doesn’t smell great either.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: This is the first eye cream that I ever used, I have really dark circles and very puffy under eyes, so I gave this a try, after a month of using it my concerns are still very noticeable, at least is a good light eye cream before I put my concealer.
product_name: Bye Bye Under Eye Brightening Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: My favourite of their serums and I’ve used them all. Light but moisturizing. No oily or sticky residue. Great to combine with other products.
product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Sensitive skin stay. The heck. Away from this. The exfoliants are ROUGH. It made me break out. And I’m not sure if I’m the only one who experienced this but it also stained my skin! WTF! Never repurchasing. Currently using it as a foot scrub.
review_title: What the heck is the hype about?

review_text: I had high hopes based on the high number of reviews, but this doesn’t do much better for my skin than other moisturizers I’ve used. The dry winter weather caused eczema patches around my eyes and I was hoping this would help, but it did nothing. Just sits on the surface of my skin and doesn’t absorb very well. It’s ok as a regular moisturizer, but I think for the price it’s not worth it. I’m sticking to FAB ultra repair cream.

This stuff is worth every penny! It knocked off at least four years of wrinkles in four days. I used it with the concentrate. Received it free in my Allure bag. It also reduces pore size significantly!
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: This is a very thin product that soaks in to the skin quickly. However, I feel you need to drop directly on your face or it will absorb into your hands before it reaches your face. It also has a strange nostalgic early 90s plastic scent that I don’t love for a ‘cleaner’ skincare item. I have noticed a nice glow, but my fine lines seem more visible? If that’s possible.
product_name: Argan Beta Retinol Pink Algae Serum

review_text: I received this Laneige product from Topbox for free in exchange for a review. I was excited because I don’t currently have an eye cream in my skincare routine. I like using it at night before bed. The cream applies easily and doesn’t smell too strong. In the morning after I wake up, I’ve noticed that the skin under my eyes look better and less puffy. I would recommend the eye cream to anyone looking to improve puffiness and dark circles. #freeproduct #trywithtopbox
product_name: Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Eye Cream

review_text: This is a balmy feeling kind of cream. Its pricey and i did not see much of a change from repeated use of this. I feel like someone with dry skin would enjoy this more.

Its almost unnecessary.... I don’t find any moisture at all. I appreciate the matti flying qualities, but my skin still feels tight and my nose peeled!!!! I even used two full pumps worth for one use. I have used it for two weeks now consistently and the dryness is improving due to my use of primer over top... I think I’ll try something more moisturizing in the future!

I like this product and the size/bottle is great for travel. However, it’s the same as the 100% Pure Jojoba Oil I buy for $5.99 at Trader Joe’s, which is equally a great moisturizer for skin and hair and a whole lot cheaper. I use it at night as my moisturizer because my skin is very sensitive and fair, it breaks out and reacts to chemicals in an unfavorable way. I’ve found my skin is less oily when I use oil! It mimics our own oil so the skin produces less of it. It absorbs quickly and does not bother my face, cause breakouts or do anything unsavory. I’m a big fan of these oils, I just think you can get the same thing with Jojoba Oil for a lot less money and a much larger bottle.
review_title: Nice but can get same results with other products

review_text: I don’t like this product. When i apply it I get a slight burning sensation. I have dry skin and found that this product alone is not hydrating/moisturizing. I see a lot of dry patches the next morning. It’s ok, when i use it in combination with an oil. But overall, it’s not for me.
review_title: Not Good For Very Dry Skin

review_text: I have a miserable cold right now, and my nose and upper lip are in misery! My nose was throbbing because it was so chapped! My normal moisturizer was not touching this, so I opened a sample of First Aid that I received in a sephora shipment and used that. OMGoodness! Imediately my nose is so much better! The pain has gone down so much! I am still sick in bed, but I got on line to order a BIG container of this. It did not even burn and is not greasy and even with all the tissue use, my skin is staying soft and protected. I am hooked and only have a small amount left! But it only takes a tiny bit so I think the sample pack will last. Cant wait to try on my feet.

A total staple product. My lips suffer through the dry and cold Chicago winters. This product was a lifesaver. My lips were ultra hydrated all winter. Now that it’s summer, I use a few times a week overnight to keep my lips hydrated and soft. It’s smooth on application. It seems like such a small amount for the price, but a little goes a long way (definitely lasts).
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This serum definitely gives coastal grandma vibes in the best possible way. The look and feel of the bottle and the smell of the serum is very luxurious. The serum works extremely well and in the last 2 weeks I have had multiple people comment that they thought my teenage daughter and I were sisters!
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Double R Advanced Serum

review_text: Not great for sensitive skin! It’s very drying and shouldn’t be used as a daily cleanser on sensitive skin.

What a beautiful product and I love how it infuses the skin with beautiful ingredients to restore the skin’s moisture barrier. My skin looks smoother and ny pores look smaller as well! It has definitely helped my skin during this winter season!

I’ve used this product for about a month and a half now and can definitely say it is NOT for me. This makes my skin sting and breaks me out. Not sure if it evens out my complexion at all. I’ve gotten better results using other products in a couple of days, whereas this one I maaaayyy have seen a SLIGHT improvement in the course of 6 weeks. Do not recommend for sensitive skin, save your money to put it towards something better!
This product is very moisturizing. I’ve been using it every morning and night for about 2 weeks now. It goes on very smoothly, you don’t need a lot! I would definitely recommend this product!
product_name: Bye Bye Under Eye Brightening Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: I really wanted to like this product, sadly it’s not for me. It does not work well with tan skin tones.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I bought this due to all the rave reviews but this was a no-go for me. Skin did not look dewy and it just left my skin feeling sticky. I promptly returned.
Works really well as a first cleanse and great on sensitive skin. Haven’t tried it as a sole makeup remover yet

I’ve written reviews before on other sites for this product. I buy about 3-4 tubs a year, each lasts 2 1/2-3mos with daily use. This is the only makeup remover I have used for the last 5 years! It is amazing. I wear full face makeup daily. This breaks down my face makeup, as well as my heavy eye makeup easily. I typically wear dark shadows, heavy black liner on lid, waterline and tightline and mascara...even some glitter some days. Nothing works at breaking down and taking off my makeup like this balm. review_text: This leaves the skin super soft after the first use. If you have oily skin beware this makes skin look super oily. When it’s first applied the skin feels great but after you wake up the next day if you know you know.. plus, personally I broke out with this entire line.

review_text: I got a sample of this with one of my online purchases and it feels amazing going on like chugging some water after being thirsty for a while. product_name: Mini Water Drench  Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45

review_text: I really enjoyed the texture of this product. It was very moisturizing and I liked the scent. This product did make my skin break out, but my face is very sensitive
