product_name: SD Advanced  PLUS Intensive Moisturizer For Wrinkles & Stretch Marks

review_text: This moisturizer is absolutely lovely. It’s lightweight but still hydrating- it’s the perfect middle moisturizer between pink juice and banana soufflé. It’s a great morning moisturizer for my skin and my dry skin just drinks it up. I love the gorgeous packaging, too.
product_name: Mini Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

review_text: I have a seen a noticeable difference when I apply the night cream and when I don’t. This is a great product to avoid dark circle and puffy looking tired eyes.

I like the other products from this brand that I’ve tried, but I just can’t get onboard with this one. I have pale skin, and this left brownish-red streaks on my face, like the pigment wasn’t fully mixed into the product. It also feels sticky and doesn’t ever seem to set on my skin. review_title: Left a Slimy Feeling On My Skin

product_name: Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: Having only tried Dr Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel for 3 days/applications, I don’t have much to go on as far as instant results or any obvious differences in my complexion. The 1st step pre-soaked towelette has a strong chemical smell. My face tingled a bit but then began to burn shortly after I started the application. The 2nd step didn’t have the same strong chemical odor. But it still does burn during application. My face hasn’t reacted to the burning by turing red. Can’t expect a miracle in 3 days I guess

review_text: This serum is great for combination skin. It moisturizes any dryness and doesn’t feel too oily when you put it on. It made my skin feel and look smoother overall. product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate

review_text: It’s ok. I’ve just about used the whole bottle now, and it works, but leaves a film on my skin and doesn’t sink in easily. Often I’ll sweat a lot of it off on my commute to work. review_title: an OK sunscreen that leaves an oily film

review_text: I was in search of a new serum. The girl helping me quickly recommended Sephora’s latest and “greatest“ serum by DE. Should be a miracle worker for $90...instead it has set my face back weeks.

review_text: Leaves no color, really rough. Hate this. Do not waste your money. Should have read the other reviews first but bought last min while in line.

review_title: want to love it but waiting still for results

product_name: LUNA 4 Facial Cleansing & Firming Massage for Combination Skin

review_text: I got this through a promo coupon code, and was very excited to try this out. As soon as I opened the container, I could smell the mask. This is before removing the included seal, and having it 2 feet from my face. It smells weird, fruity but with a weird chemical mixed in. Its very similar to an essential oil blend, its impossible to describe but I’m sure I have a candle that smells like it. I put a thin layer on my face, but thick enough that I was an even shade of green. It began to tingle even before I had finished applying. I have sensitive oily skin, so anything that tingles makes me a bit worried. I decided to try and leave it on. After 2 minutes, I was having trouble breathing because of how heavy the scent is. After I rinsed it off, I was pleasantly surprised to see that my skin was smoothed by the gentle exfoliation and was not red at all. That is the only reason that this gets 2 stars and not 1. This mask is still going into the trash, I can literally taste it the smell is so strong. It would be fine if she smell was not so chemical heavy. There are so many fruits and flowers in this mask, it has the potential to smell great, they don’t need to add fragrance to it.

I couldn’t wait to try this product, but for me it is a bit disappointing. Although I did love the cleanser. It is creamy and takes very little to get a good lather. The Fat Water left my skin feeling dry and the moisturizer did too. But I do like the concept of the moisturizer being a sunscreen too, all in one. Maybe this just isn’t right for my skin type. I saw no improvements. Disappointing though.

review_text: The product itself is great, but when it arrived there was more air in the tube than product. Since it’s not cheap and the tube itself is small, I feel cheated and disappointed. Definitely not worth the money.

review_text: Got this as a sample and enjoyed the taste!

review_text: Have been using this product for over 2 months, have not seen ANY improvements. I went by the recommendation of the sales clerk thinking she knew what she was talking about, this product was not cheap! I will not be repurchasing.
In about 2 weeks of use I began to see a difference from the use of this product. It is making my scar smoother by the day.

I really wanted to like this product because it has such high reviews, but it broke me out so badly. My acne has been gone for over a year now and my skin has been clear since then but upon using this product, I noticed a whole bunch of small bumps all over my face. I thought it was something else I was doing but I traced it back to this product every time I would use it. I mean it does moisturize and sink into the skin when applying it, but I can’t continue using it if it breaks me out:(

I don’t see any improvement for my under eyes other than a little brightening effect. After EACH use, every squirt that I press in the morning has a thick dried up glob that comes out first, wasting a lot of my product. I definitely suffer from acne prone skin and I recently wanted to step up my moisturizer game in the cold Canadian winter so I got a trial of this, and wow do I regret it. review_text: If you have acne prone skin or don’t want to deal with breakouts stay away. I never really had issues with acne until using this product. It took me months to get my skin back to normal. Luckily I don’t scar easily. You can get better moisturizers that don’t break you out.

The general consensus is that it’s a great moisturizer for those with combination to oily skin but not hydrating enough for dryer skin types. This applies very elegantly and feels lightweight and non-sticky. I actually quite like this moisturizer especially for the packaging. I’m bummed this didn’t work as well for me as I had hoped. I would need to layer it up with another moisturizer for my skin to feel hydrated enough to last throughout the day. Locking it in with a facial oil didn’t help much either. I noticed they sell it in a larger size now which is awesome because it’s pricy.

So far I have been using this thing for the last 3 days and I just have to say that my skin looks great and glowing. A little bit of this product goes a long way. It’s definitely a keeper. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion

I am sad to say this broke me out pretty badly. It felt wonderful and light going on but I woke up with over 5 pimples. I used this a few times and only got more acne. Sad but I am sure other people love it it just didn’t work for me.

I use this toner in conjunction with the cleanser and hydrator from this same line. I have never used a toner before, so I was concerned that this would overdry my face and make my pores overproduce oil...which then leads to breakouts in my case. I noticed that after using the toner, my face feels cool, fresh, and oil free the majority of the day. I don’t have to blot my face with tissues throughout the day the way I normally would. I love the fresh minty fragrance it has, it is not a strong alcohol scent. I have oily-normal skin. I received this product complimentary from influenster for testing purposes.

This product was fine, but I wouldn’t say I love it. The serum is pretty tacky after application, like a bug would stick to my skin if it flew into me. The tackiness does go away after a few minutes, but I was expecting something smoother and silkier.My other complaint about this product is the pump. It’s a rigid pump which makes it difficult to get a half pump, or anything smaller, out of the bottle. Sometimes I only need a bit more product but I’ve found it really hard to get the amount I want.I don’t think this product magically improved my skin, but it certainly didn’t harm it either. I like the idea of this serum and I’m on the lookout another vitamin C serum (SPF is a plus).
product_name: Daily Dose Vitamin C + SPF 40 Sunscreen Serum PA+++

review_text: This has the ideal texture and consistency you would want for a summer moisturizer. It’s light and smells great. Sadly this irritated my skin severely. I had increased redness and sensitivity. I had to return it.
I was maybe expecting to much out of this.Instead of moisturizing it dried up my skin and made me break out. Not to mention i got some sort of reaction to it on my t zone.Bummer

I am SO dissapointed in this product! I thought this would make my skin glow and really hydrate my skin, and after reading lots of reviews on this product, i thought for sure it would work great. Turns out I was very wrong :( It made me breakout. BADLY. My face looks like a dalmatian now with how many little spots I have. Definitely will not repurchase.
product_name: High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs

review_text: This cleanser works great on days I wear heavy makeup but it does feel like it leaves a film on your face afterward. I had to use another cleanser after using this. I received this free in exchange for my review. I would not purchase this product.
review_title: Does a great job removing makeup…

review_text: Received this product as a part of the birthday promotion and was super impressed with how well it took off my makeup UNTIL I noticed the rash that broke out on my face. I have never had a reaction to a facial skincare product before and do not have sensitive skin. Will not be using again.

I received this product for free from Influenster. This is still an honest review. First of all, the packaging is SO cute. It looks so good on my shelf. Second, this product is so light on my face and leaves it feeling so smooth. Since this is like a sunscreen, I’m going to try and save it for the warmer weather. I think it’ll be absolutely perfect.
product_name: That Big Screen Moisturizer with Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: I must say I have no idea if this product does anything, nor what it’s actually supposed to do. I cannot see a difference immediately after applying it, but I also haven’t seen any remarkable difference in my skin since I started using it (one full bottle, but I’m not very disciplined in applying it every day). I use other Devgan products that I really like (the eye cream and the gold-infused mask), so I even wrote them to ask what this product is supposed to do, and their answer was vague (“some people see immediate results, some only after a while“). My sensitive rosacea skin does not react to it, so I guess that’s good. Aside from that, it’s a bit like putting water on my face.
I wanted to love this but I hate fragrance in my skincare, it’s so unnecessary. Not for sensitive skin
Great product, but the smell makes it unbearable to use!!

I just recently got this and it is truly amazing. The hydration is instant, and I was able to tell a difference in my skin very quickly. It goes on silky smooth, dries fast, leaves the skin soft, and has near no smell which I like. I’m looking forward to using this during the winter as my skin gets very dry and irritated. If you’re thinking about trying this, do it!

Tried the sample size and had to use so much product and rub my eyes for like 5 minutes just for it to even take anything off, and it still left makeup behind! Definitely would not buy a full size product, will be sticking to my Makeup Eraser towel for sure!
Great product alittle goes a long way lasts along time
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I can’t get past the smell. It reminds me of old ladies and potpourri.
The applicator is garbage and barely dispenses any product. The product that does come out is thin and ineffective. I have also started to develop red bumps under my eyes after using this. Hard pass.

I tried it in store. No white cast, awesome! Smelled very heavily of sunscreen. I used to use a Japanese sunscreen but it’s hard to find. So, I tried this. Most american sunscreens aren’t high enough SPF but this one has 50. Well, it pilled all over my face. Which lessens the efficacy of the SPF. And if that wasn’t enough, it burned my eyes so they’ve been stinging all day. It is extremely fragranced. It leaves a nice glow but this is the worst sunscreen I have ever used and will be returning and buying one from a different brand.
product_name: Mini PLAY Everyday Lotion SPF 50 with Sunflower Extract

review_text: Other than smelling gross and unnatural like a creamsicle, I don’t know what else this accomplishes.

I bought this with high expectations and instead I’m left very underwhelmed. From the moment I used it I haven’t been happy. It has a nice pump, but when you squirt it out it splats all over your hand. When it comes out it seems almost like the consistency is breaking up. I’ve used this for about a week and I honestly cannot tell a difference. It seriously is a complete waste of money.
product_name: Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum with Lactic Acid

review_text: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. I was hesitant at first about this product because I’ve used so many other exfoliating products. They promised this or that and didn’t actually do what they promised. Not this product. I love how clean and soft my skin feels after I use it. It is not drying like others. My skin feels fresh and hydrated after each use. I use it twice a week and I have had very promising results. I recommend this product to anyone with any skin concerns. Make sure you follow up with your favorite face lotion.
Doesn’t work very well, similar consistency as Vaseline only it doesn’t work… I will wake up with chapped lips the morning after using it

I bought the Glow Recipe Best Sellers set and this is one of the products in it. I’ve been trying everything separately to see how my skin reacts and this is the only thing I’ve used so far from the set. My skin hates this so much. It dried me out even though I moisturize and have more oily skin than dry and left my skin feeling so sensitive. It feels very slimy and application isn’t easy. I tried using a cotton pad but the pad absorbed most of the product and left nothing for my face. Using fingers is hard because of how slimy it is and it just makes a mess. Maybe that’s the fault of the smaller bottle. Regardless, this product definitely isn’t for everyone. I don’t recommend if you have sensitive skin.
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: For reference, my skin is combination and acne-prone. I wanted to like this so badly. I tried using it every other day for 2 weeks and started getting terrible cystic acne. AT first I thought it was stress, but after I stopped using this, my acne cleared up. I decided to give it another try, and I had another break-out. It was insidious because the acne didn’t flare up immediately after using it, but will flare up 2-3 days after consistent use. I was disappointed, but maybe it’s just not for me.
product_name: Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum

review_text: I wanted to love this product so badly, but after using it three times I wasn’t able to handle the feeling of the weird film it left on my face, and the pilling. Keep in mind this is completely on it’s own without anything overtop, I didn’t dare layer it with makeup. It does make the skin look glowy without being greasy upon application, but it doesn’t feel nice at all throughout the day. I returned it and said the cashier had two people before me return the product with the same complaints within the hour.
review_title: It’s gonna be a no from me

review_text: I’m loving this glycolic cleanser! I’ve been using it for a week and my skin has been feeling so clean and smooth! I have acne as well but it’s clearing up quite well with daily use of this cleanser! I’m really seeing a difference and I love it! Gifted by Dermalogica
This product smells and feels SOOO good but, I put it on overnight and in the morning my lips were so dry and irritated for the entire day. My Carmex works way better for moisture and soft lips.
review_title: Smells so good but made my lips dry after a night
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: First, thank you to #topboxcircle for giving me the opportunity to test this mask and provide my honest review. I did really enjoy the mask a lot. It goes on a greenish color and has the nice herbal scent of the Instant Detox mask by Caudalie. As it dries it gets pretty tight on your face. I actually left it on for a little longer every time I used it and didn’t experience any irritation at all. When I washed it off my skin felt very smooth, maybe a little dry, but that feeling went away pretty quickly. I used it for nearly 3 weeks now and have noticed smoother skin overall using it 2 times per week. I am experiencing a breakout and I am not sure if it is necessarily assisting in clearing it or alleviating any redness. I also got some really strange zits on my forehead when I applied this there, and I never get zits there at all so I did stop applying this to my forehead. Overall pretty good mask and I would recommend for an acne prone individual. I love, love, LOVE Caudalie, they are my favorite skin care brand. If you are debating on trying their products I would highly recommend. I use at least one product from every one of their lines and the brand has never steered me wrong! #freeproduct #trywithtopbox

My skin is dry and suffers from eczema. The dry skin causes wrinkles that make we look older. I was skeptical that this product would help me or be any different than other skincare products. IT DID THE TRICK. I applied it after an evening shower, but I still needed my moisturizer over it. By the third day, I could see and feel a dramatic difference. My skin was smooth and younger looking. So excited that I found this.
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: I really didn’t like this product. It was too heavy for my taste.
There was definitely an improvement in my skin’s texture. downside: the price

I’m fan of this brand Sunday Riley. I got an incredible and instant results with their products. But… this eye cream didn’t do anything for me. No changes after use for about two months. I got after a promo a Sunday Riley kit from my Insider points: vitamin c serum, retinoid serum, good genes and the auto correct eye cream. All the products are excellent incluided my vitamin c and tumeric face oil that I bought in full size. This is the only item that no work for me as I would have liked. Two star because it only hydrates. Too expensive just for that.
product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: I’ve used this product for two weeks now. It’s trash. The Laundry list of ingredients (some are quite harsh) and the perfume is not a happy combo for many skin types, especially not sensitive skin. This stuff feels like a thick moisturizer with a bit of a grit in it and as you rub in it gets an Elmer’s glue texture. Awful. Two weeks and the only result is an itchy face. No thank you. Also as an FYI this has Salicylic Acid which is not recommended for pregnancy. Huda should stick to makeup.
review_title: Would Not Recommend, stick to makeup
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: Not sure I’ve seen firmer, brighter or smoother skin. But this does absorb quickly. Feels nice. Let it sink into skin before trying to apply makeup. Smells a little nutty at first, but it dissipates quickly.

Beautiful packaging, but terrible breakouts! I tried using this product three time, and every time I would wake up with tiny clogged pores all over my face. My skin is at a point where it’s very clear, so it’s alarming to see large areas of tiny red bumps after using this product. I REALLY wanted to love this product, but after a week of use, I had some of the most painful and largest whiteheads I’ve ever had in my life. My skin was not purging like I initially thought it was. Please Patch test, this product is not for acne prone skin.
product_name: Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: Great gloss. Amazing smell. Reminds me of a lip balm I had as a young girl. The scent is strong. I opened it in a car and my friend commented on the smell, confused as to where it was coming from.

I have used a lot of different types of cleanser; this one has been the first to break me out. I was looking for something to cleanse and help with mild acne. This broke me out worse then puberty did :(I was really excited to get this cleanser. I really wanted it to work too. But it just wasnt for me. Clinique is my next investment!

I wanted sooooooo desperately for this to work, bought it because Kathleenlights told me to. My skin has never been worse after using this product, my texture has NEVER been this bad, I shook it before every single use and it still didn’t work for me. I’m so sad because it has so many amazing reviews, and it was SOOOOOOOOO EXPENSIVE. I gave it a try for weeeeeks, and I am just done. not worth it for me and I’m so dissapointed because now I have to deal with the insecurity of having really disgustingly textured skin. I’mGlad this works for others but it did not for me. 90 dollars down the drain. :(
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: Didn’t moisturize my skin. Left it dry and flaky. I don’t understand the hype in this!?

My review would be closer to a 3.75, if I was able to do that. I have oily/acne-prone skin and this cleanser is nice, but I did experience a massive surge in pimples and black heads after I started using this. I’m not sure if this was the “purging period” for it, but, my skin did look nice after it went away. I think that this would definitely be more of a summer cleanser for me because it does an excellent job of taking away my sweat/whatever grime I’ve collected on my face after being outside. Overall, it’s a good cleanser. Not the best and not the worst.
Excellent to use to moisten up before applying hyaluronic acid. Smells a bit like pool water though.
product_name: Mini SOS Daily Rescue Facial Spray

review_text: On first sight I loved the simplicity of the packaging, nice crisp white! Looks very nice on my bathroom counter. Upon holding the product I love the heaviness of jar and texture of how the outside is printed upon the glass. The packaging just oozes luxury! The lid closes tightly on the product which is important to me, if you are paying so much for a product it needs to have a air tight seal to ensure the longevity of the cream within. The face cream texture is light, not greasy and soaks in easily. It does have a light scent but it is very spa like and reminds me of cucumber water. I actual really like the scent! I am very impressed with how it plumps the skin and how long this cream hydrates. I use this cream at night and my skin feels hydrated well into the next afternoon. I was skeptical about this cream because of the high price tag but I understand it a lot more now after I have used it for a prolonged period of time. To put it simply it works and even with the high price tag I would want to purchase this again!

This save my face lordddd thank you so much you gave who ever is the mind behind this launch. I have been breaking out since August when I came to visit Thailand for two weeks when I came back to new York my face just don’t stop breaking out. I tried so many moisturizer most of them itch on my face thennnnnnnn. This came out and I’m one of the first person to try it. I’m soooo INLOVE this is such a great product. First of all no scent at all then it’s all vegan all natural goodness and it calms down my face. Now I’m back to not wearing foundation I’m in the mood with just glow I don’t care if I still have a lot of acne marks I just feel so happy that I don’t have no bumps on my face anymore.
review_title: pick this us you won’t regret it.

review_text: I was excited to try this dry brush, I had high hopes. My main issue is the bristles are really really stiff, even if I press lightly they irritate my skin and make me itch. It’s a bummer because I love the long handle and the curve. I wouldn’t recommend this product to anyone with sensitive skin and will most likely return and find a brush with soft bristles

OMG if you haven’t made your mind about La Mer Creme you shouldn’t think twice, this is an amazing moisturizer. After we one apply I saw the difference in my skin no joke! It’s thick but not that thick like many sais it was, I would definitely get the soft creme as well to try. I bought the 1 oz I should’ve bought the 2 oz at least.
Makes your skin greasy and clogs pores
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: I love this! It really is unseen - it doesn’t leave any of the white cast or streaks like mineral sunscreens, doesn’t alter the texture or finish of my skin, and works well under makeup. People just need to be aware that you have to put chemical sunscreens on at least 15 minutes before going out into the sun! Would definitely recommend, it’s my go-to sunscreen.

First impression was the quality of the bottle. I absolutely love that it’s glass! I always feel like if a company is concerned about their packaging, they’re concerned about their products. The citrus scent is very refreshing, and relaxing without being overpowering. I love that the serum is a lightweight, and non-greasy formula. My skin is noticeably brighter, and hydrated. It’s also gentle enough to use morning, and it. Bonus, it layers great under makeup.
product_name: GinZing Into the Glow Brightening Serum

review_text: Feels good and didn’t cause a breakout but those are the only upsides for me. I bought the lightest shade and it’s way too dark and yellow. I tried mixing it with a light pigment but that made the formula chunky so pretty bad
product_name: CC+ Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40

review_text: This product was given to me by Influenster to try in return for a review. I tried the essence but couldn’t really tell that it did much. It provided some moisture but that’s it.
product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

review_text: I have been loving this product since it lunched! I love that they extended the line and added some other smell to them. I have to say that the original lip sleeping mask smell is my preferred! I guess I just got used to the cotton candy smell. However, the texture is the same as the original and the moisture it delivers haven’t change . Guess what...I love it like that. Good job Laneige! It’s a must for every women and boy out there that loves their lips enough to treat them right. Works as good in summer than in winter. I received this product as complimentary for review purposes but all opinion are mine!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I had to stop using this product after only a few uses. It completely dried out my skin. I had skin flaking off my forehead. I’ve never had dry skin in my life.

This product is not for dry skin. It dried my t-zone area out so bad that my skin was peeling in those areas. I did really enjoy the smell and texture but after two attempts I will not put it back on my face since it dried it out.
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: moisturizing yes but skin is oily and sticky. won’t sink in leaving wet like layer on top.

I got a sample of this after having a makeover and I loved it so much, I decided to buy it! The price tag may seem a bit shocking, but it will last a long time! One of those tiny sample containers lasted me ~10 full-face/partial-neck applications! A little definitely goes a long way, so while it may seem thick in the container, it spreads nicely and doesn’t feel heavy. As for color-correcting, I feel it works very well! I’ve been breaking out recently from stress and while I used to moisturize, then use Smashbox’s green primer to even out my skin tone, that’s no longer cutting it. I still moisturize first (I recently started using Retin-A so I need all the help I can get) and then apply this to provide a bit more coverage. I see the difference immediately, with the beige matching my skin perfectly and giving me a dewy (but not oily) look. Bonus: it really seems to last all day! I also use it as a base when I put on liquid foundation, to further up the chances of a long-lasting, even skin tone. So it’s great for everyday and “special occasion“ use. All-in-all, I am very happy with this product.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Waste of money. Zero benefit. I wish I could return it now. I used religiously twice a day for months
product_name: Squalane + Peptide Brightening & De-Puffing Eye Gel

review_text: This is a great product, easy to use, you can feel the spheres of the mask gently massaging your face, without being too abrasive. I now use twice weekly, you can leave mask on a few minutes longer if you want a deeper cleanse. No waste either, the soft pump at the top, makes sure the bottle gets completely emptied. My skin can be sensitive, this is great for open pores and you can see the difference in a couple of weeks. This exfoliant is now part of my beauty regime.

Holy cow this stuff is amazing. I gave super oily acne probe skin. I do super bad things to it like overexfoliate. This makes my skin feel super firm, plump and deep with moisturized but not oily or even dewy at all. Think of a plump grape or tomato. My skin also did not over produce oily for like hlf the day and my skin becomes oily after 30 min. Ridic!
Wish this came without perfume...

I purchased these because my holy grail (Neogen Dermalogy peeling pads) have not been restocked in any store. FAB is an amazing brand and their cleanser is one of my top choices. Anyways, after using these a couple of days I have not noticed a difference as I did with the Neogen ones after each use. The scent in my opinion smells bad. Also, this product leaves a residue that is noticeable while applying moisturizer. A review I had read was right regarding getting a breakout if not using it twice a day. I forgot to use one at night and woke up with a whitehead the next day. Overall, I do not agree with the good reviews this item received.

These eye patches are the most rejuvenating patches I have for my under eyes. I usually use them cold so I have it stored in the fridge to get that cooling feel. It feels good while using it without it causing any irritation and also makes my under eyes look normal after a long day.
product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

review_text: Never absorbed into skin. Face just looked wet like all the time didn’t really blend well with other products

Amazing texture and beautiful packaging. I’ve tried every lip balm/mask product out there and I can tell you this is one of the best. Ultra hydrating, softens even the crunchiest lips! If you’re on the fence about this one, you have to try it. Blows Laniege out of the water, even at its considerably higher price point. Worth it completely.
Made me break out!! This product was so hard on my face, I might even be allergic to it. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT AT ALL. Don’t waste your money!
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: I am a new mom with normal to dry skin. Thanks to sleepless nights and busy days I haven’t been able to follow my usual 5 step skincare routine. Needless to say my skin has been in pretty bad shape with dry patches and fine lines. I was pleasantly surprised by how the skin fix moisturizer transformed my skin in just a week. The packaging was very hygienic and convenient. I use one to two pumps for my whole face and neck. The formula was really rich and emollient but not at all oily. It just easily absorbed in my skin with any effort. It doesn’t feel like there is anything on my face yet it makes my face super hydrated. I love that it is unscented, made of clean ingredients and does what it promises. My skin looks so much better, brighter and softer. I use it at night and that’s pretty much all I do for skincare these days. Makes me feel silly for having spent so much money on serums and essences and toners when all i needed was one product that hydrates, plumps up my skin and protects my skin barrier. I am definitely repurchasing it and highly recommend it to anyone with dry skin. I am so happy that it is safe for nursing moms. It does contain Gluconolactone which isn’t recommend during pregnancy.
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: I have pretty sensitive under eyes and a lot of eye creams can make my eyes puffy in the morning, this one did that. It is very lightweight and I do prefer a heavier eye cream, it feels nice and I’m sure it’s a good eye cream as the rest of this brand has amazing products. This eye cream just didn’t feel like it really did anything for me? I sadly returned it. Love that it’s a clean product and it feels nice just didn’t really do anything besides slightly hydrate
product_name: Superfood Hydrate + Firm Peptide Eye Cream

review_text: I use a retinol nightly, and this has been a godsend. No irritation or redness, all softness. Will definitely buy again.
review_title: A must if you use retinol or acids at night

review_text: This product is magic. I got it complimentary from Influenster and loved this product after first two days of use. You see a significant difference in your skin texture. As a combination skin, my skin is prone to acne but this product never broke me out. Love the consistency of the product and the way your skin absorbs it completely. Would highly recommend this product.
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: I received this as a sample and used it with my dr dennis gross facial steamer. it was amazing i am in love. left my skin so so smooth and clear! i eve used the other half on my bfs face and the mask completely evened out his skin tone. i put a very hydrating moisturizer on after and was ok but did have a few dry flakes the next day. he has oily skin and had no issues with drying.
product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

review_text: Received this product from Glow Recipe to try out and I will definitely be purchasing. The consistency is great, it mattifies and blurs but is not drying. Love to use with my normal skin routine, but also love wearing it under my makeup as a primer. All of their strawberry products are must-haves.

My skin absolutely DRINKS this moisturizer! This is a really unique lightweight but deep penetrating moisturizer, I love the texture of it, it melts and glides on your face, my skin drinks it up without it completely dissapearing. I tried the very expensive Tatcha water cream and was very unimpressed. People described that one as a drink of water. Nope, This product is 10x better than that one at half the price. THIS product is a drink of water for your skin. I have been dabbling with a lot of product lines Sephora offers, they have a great selection. However this is my second product I have gotten from Farmacy and I got to say that I am very impressed with this brand and will continue to try more products from them!
review_title: got as a sample, immediately bought full size!
product_name: Daily Greens Oil-Free Gel Moisturizer with Moringa and Papaya

review_text: This cream is moisturizing but besides that I’ve noticed absolutely no difference in circles, puffiness, or signs of aging.
product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream

review_text: I thought the cleanser did a great job as my second cleanse. The smell is nice and clean. I didn’t like that the cleanser was very runny and thin. But, I could love with it. I will not be repurchasing because I bought an 8oz bottle and half of the product leaked out through the faulty pump. The bottle was sitting straight up, and cleanser was constantly dripping out in large amounts. It was a waste of product and money.

I enjoyed the Confidence in a Cream moisturizer by IT Cosmetics. My skin is on the oily/normal side, but this moisturizer worked great without making me too shiny. It absorbed pretty quickly and was only slightly tacky afterward, although I don’t have much patience to wait between layers. It was glory and quickly ready for makeup application and made my skin look smooth and firm. It also is noncomdogenic, and I didn’t have any issues with breakouts when I switched from my normal Cerave to this to try. I would probably not buy it again due to the price and because it does not include SPF. However, I do enjoy it and I’m glad I got to try it! I haven’t seen any obvious reduction in my fine lines, but I’ve only tried for about 10 days.
product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: This did nothing for me. I bought it hoping it would help hydrate my skin during the winter. Beyond it causing my other products to pill, I didn’t notice a difference. I used the entire bottle up, but will not buy again.

Gives the best golden glow with only a few drops! This is now a staple! I washed my hands right after applying and didn’t have any issues with orange residue on hands or staining on white sheets. It does not have a strong scent which is appreciated.

These Glow Drips didn’t add any visible radiance, glow or shine to my skin. I also saw no skincare benefits from using them. I’m not sure why this product exists. Disappointing. You could probably use these to thin out high coverage foundation, that’s about it.

One thing I love about this face lotion is how appropriately named it is because it does blend seamlessly like a lotion. Sunscreens always give me an icky feeling because of how heavy it is but not this one. This gave me a perfect glow before packing on that make up!

review_text: Didn’t notice much of a difference. I received complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes. I find this brand to be overpriced with a lot of fluff ingredients.

review_text: This is now a Holy Grail product for me! I have incredibly acne prone and sensitive skin with a lot of sun damage from years of living on a boat. This product completely resurrected my skin! I’ve tried numerous Vitamin C and E products over the years to help heal acne/hyperpigmentation left behind, but nothing has ever given me results like this…let alone in less than 2 weeks!! So you can also observe this magic for yourself, I’ve added bare skin before & after pics. First (before) picture and second (after) picture were taken just 10 days apart with no changes to my routine besides the addition of this serum. Pics were taken in the same room, same place, same time of day and the glow from my skin is just amazing!I apply the serum only in the mornings. Yes, it takes a while to dry down, but once it does there’s no tacky feeling and I haven’t experienced any pilling when layered with my other skincare products. Despite how crazy sensitive and reactive my skin is, this serum didn’t break me out, cause a burning sensation, or leave me feeling slimy all day. And, yes, the bottle is small for the high price point, but IMO it’s SO WORTH IT to feel this confident and happy with the way my skin looks! I seriously can’t recommend this product enough!

I love them, they are so cute and they have helped me with the puffiness around my eyes.

I love this product! It smells sweet and fruity as well as feels immensely hydrating! I put it on before bed, often times I wake up with some of it still on; which I love! I recommend for anyone who desires to make their lips soft and supple!

I have tried everything to get rid of my deep, clogged pores on my nose: masks, cleansers / scrubs, , nose strips. Nothing makes them go away. The Complexion Club group had a question posted about a similar issue, and the skincare experts were singing the praises of BHAs - specifying that though some people will need a 5% solution, most start with 2%. So I figured I’d start with this. Well it has been 2 weeks, and... nothing. No change in my skin. In fact, I’m worried that my moisturizer negated the effects of the serum after application (I felt the same way with the serum from The Ordinary that I tried). So now I’m eyeing the Herbivore Prism Facial (5% BHA)... but if that doesn’t work, I’ll have to bite the bullet and see a dermatologist, I guess.
product_name: Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) Blemish + Blackhead Serum

review_text: Mixed feelings about this one. While it felt moisturizing and like my pores looked tighter / finer, it did break me out. Not whiteheads but actual red painful bumps. I had to stop using them unfortunately.
I have combo skin and this stuff does a pretty decent job. It makes my oily/dry face feel oil-free yet not dry. My only gripe is that it doesn’t do a great job removing make up.
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: Wanted to love this but it was a bit too drying for my sensitive skin and didn’t totally remove all my makeup. For someone who wears little makeup and has oilier skin it seems like a great buy, but for someone who wears more makeup and has sensitive skin, it wasn’t the right fit. Smells great though!!
review_title: Maybe try something else for sensitive/dry skin

review_text: I can’t use it because I can’t stand the smell!

This essence feels light and refreshing. I apply it after cleansing and a toner. It makes my skin feel fresh and moisturized. However I’ve not seen much difference in my skin. The fine lines are still there and I’ve been using this for a few weeks. I received this micro essence in exchange for my honest review. All opinions are strictly my own.
product_name: Micro Essence Treatment Lotion with Bio-Ferment

review_text: I’ve used so many different makeup removers and always go back to this one. It’s efective and gentle
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I like this product. It doesn’t irritate my skin or eyes (if I mistakenly apply it too close to them). Since I’m rather pale, I mix it with a white sunscreen (like Elta MD Physical Sunscreen) to tone it down. It also eliminates white cast from other sunscreens. I wish the bottle were a bit bigger.
product_name: Pep-Start Daily UV Protector Broad Spectrum SPF 50

review_text: The cream is thick and you can feel the lux when you use it. I don’t love the fragrance in the lotion. The moisturizer sits well under my foundation and other makeup. I’d say it a little splurg but worth it.

I tried to love this moisturizer and had really high hopes, but after 3 months it’s not working out. The consistency itself is nice and in the beginning provided good moisture to my skin. Now, my skin is irritated by it. I get itchy and dry around the cheek areas.
This moisturizer pills and leaves your face feeling greasy.
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: It didn’t even feel like it cleansed my skin, it also would literally just fall off my face LOL, it’s a weird consistency.
product_name: So Poreless Deep Exfoliating Blackhead Scrub

review_text: I purchased the smallest they have and I’m glad I did because it has a clumsy texture when applied to my face, the more I rub it into my face I got little balls of the moisturizer on my face...I only used it at night because of that
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I received this product for free for testing purposes from Influenster. I immediately added it into my daily routine and was amazed by it from the very first use. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and bright, and also I can feel it bringing it to life and tightening it everytime I use it. I have been using it as a base for my makeup and have been loving it. I definitely would recommend this product! Excited to continue using it.
product_name: Bright Start Vitamin C Antioxidant Brightening Moisturizer

review_text: Obsessed! Within a few weeks I could see improvements in my complexion. I absolutely love following up this oil with the good genes lactic acid.

This is a nice little serum. I’ve been using it for about a week now and it has a nice consistency that goes on smooth and feels nice on the face. I haven’t noticed a real difference in my skin, but I’ve only been using it about a week. I think with more consistent use over time, that would make a big difference.
product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I honestly don’t get the hype of this lip balm. I have the original vanilla and it’s ok, but that’s it. The consistency is exactly like vaseline, exactly. And that’s what it looks like on your lips, thick and oily. It doesn’t last long and it has no long term benefit. There are so many better options for the price. Skip this.

I’m 26 and have had problems with my skin since puberty. I just finished my first bottle, but I started seeing results within the first week or two. My hair stylist told me that my skin was glowing! The confidence boost was definitely worth the price. 100% recommend!

The best product for those whitehead pimples. I use overnight or put under my mask during the day while I’m out and after a few hours the pimple is either smaller or flat. I always have some on hand. I’ve recommended to so many friends!

I have used this cream every day for over a month and seen zero results. I am using it for hyper pigmentation. It has not irritated me but has done nothing so far. Texture is unpleasant so I used it at night.
product_name: Mini Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: I don’t understand how this product gets such glowing reviews. It’s really just a glorified lip balm that’s not worth the price. It comes in a beautiful box with a cute little spatula to apply it with, but the consistency is thin like petroleum jelly and definitely not like a ‘masque’. I glopped on a bunch like the instructions say and nearly gagged from the slimy slippery texture. I still use it at night as a lip balm but I would not repurchase. I was way more impressed with the Bite Beauty Agave Lip Mask I received in one of my Sephora Play boxes - that one has a true thick texture of a masque and it tastes a lot better (no gagging). I gave it an extra star for the cute packaging but the formula deserves one star for being slimy instead of thick.
review_title: slimy texture, this is a No for me
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Love how my skin felt after using this and I have an amazing glow!!

This cleanser is amazing. I first tried it in the skin bender kit and loved its fresh smell and how soft and clean my skin feels after each wash. I am definitely a fan of FAB! A tiny amount goes a long way!

I have extremely dry and dehydrated skin during the winter. When I try to apply makeup it sticks to the dry patches and truthfully it looks so bad that I generally take it back off. I miss wearing makeup. I miss not being embarrassed about my skin. I went in the store and explained my situation to the staff. Upon her recommendation I bought this, and for me this is not a cheap price tag. It is ok. It make any skin feel soft but it’s still very dry, I still get flakes. If you need occasional hydration and it is more of a surface problem then this should work just fine. There is a very mild natural scent, and the company being certified leaping bunny is huge for me. I just wish that it would have made a bigger difference.

I’ve been using this Dewtopia serum for several weeks. I like the glass pump bottle, and the ability to close the pump. I also like the smell, it has a nice lemon scent. The product itself feels very nice on my skin, and absorbs well. I didn’t feel any tingling sensation at all with this, and have been able to use it daily. I am also new to acid serums like this. I noticed my skin is so much brighter, and I just look better overall. I have no acne, and everything looks more smooth. My forehead lines are still visible, but they are less severe. I have not noticed a change in a couple of pigmentation spots, but like I said it’s only been a few weeks. I recommend this product.
So thick and greasy. I was expecting it to be just like the matte, tinted SPF 30 version, only untinted, but was so disappointed.
product_name: Classic Face Sunscreen SPF 50 White Tea

review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster to test. I love the gorgeous jars. It works well and helped get my gut back on track. I will continue to use.
product_name: Prebiotic + Probiotic Vegan Gut Microbiome Supplement

review_text: This is a good product! I use it as my main moisturizer at night and I like it! I’m not sure it’s worth it’s price though, I have other oils that give me the same effect for half the price.
product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil

review_text: Non oily. Will not break you out and super light weight. Yes all the way. I have combination skin that breaks out.

Perfect for my skin I am so happy that I was able to try this and really experience it on my skin for the past few days. I really like the texture and the touch, but I think the aroma is also very pleasant. This night mask will stand out as my favorite for a while because it is perfect in so many ways. I think this is hydrating and nourishing while still being light and drying to a satin finish on my combination skin. I think this will prove to be a great staple and sleep mask for the next several weeks and will bring great improvements to my skin, mainly in the well-being and hydration of my skin in general. This is a perfect fit for those with combination skin and a great overall mask for all skin types! I really recommend it
product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane

review_text: I really liked this make up primer so I wanted to take the time to write this review! This goes on very smooth and then once you rub it in it doesn’t even feel like you have anything on your face. I guess that’s why it’s called featherweight. I’ve also noticed since I’ve started using us that it makes my pores smaller.
product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer

review_text: They say it;s a good product but in my case I got a little itchy so I really don’t know what to say. A little goes on a long way. Although it is pricey, it can last you about 6-8 months. But always use sunscreen on top of it.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: I wanted SO much to like this and would definitely retry if an unscented version comes out. I actually like a mild smell to my skin care. Unfortunately this has an extremely strong smell that gave me a terrible headache.

I have dry skin with psoriasis and this has been a game changer for my skin! Huge improvement in texture and makes my makeup apply far better. Allow time for products to fully soak in for best results.

I rarely if ever go out of my way to write a review, especially a negative review but this left a big impression on me - and not in a good way. Aside from the horribly sticky/oily texture that I’m assuming might work for some people (hence this product’s hype) the SMELL is horrendous. I like herbal smells and definitely don’t expect all products to smell particularly pleasing, but this actually made me physically ill. Would highly recommend spraying in store first before purchasing.

This face wash is so good. It smells amazing and it never leaves my skin feeling stripped. I wish I could make some outrageous claims like it saved my skin and paid my rent. But it’s simply just a good cleanser and definitely moisturizing.
this product smells amazing and feels amazing when it’s on. however, it leaves my lips dry and chapped. it’s almost as ifit dries it out instead of moisturizing.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: this product is SUPER EASY and CONVENIENT to apply.it is also easy to carry (because of the small size).not mention it can be easily applied over makeups.there is a little sticky feeling at firat 30 seconds, but later on it’s all natural.one star off because it’s not blocking the sunlight entirely (my forehead is slightly darker than before after exposing to the sun for the entire day - in wonderland)
Love this scent and instant smoothness. I miss this product when I don’t use it.
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: There are many five star reviews all seemingly from those that are incentivized. I like the product but I have buyers remorse. The cheaper corded device without the so call blackhead cap would work just as well. The cap seems useless.Yes, my skin feels soft after use but it feels exactly the same after using the much less expensive Silk’n Revit Micro Derm device that retails for $100.00. The fact that PMD needs discs and filters changed frequently and they are more expensive than the Silk’n filters is also a drawback. PMD has flooded social media by giving mass quantities of the devices away for excellent reviews. This makes it seem like it’s the Be All and End All of clear, smooth skin. I’m guilty of drinking the Kool-Aid too. I’m keeping it because I don’t want it to end up in the landfill.
review_title: HIGHLY OVERRATED for the high price tag.

review_text: This product feels really nice on your skin and locks in moisture. I took off a star because as someone who suffers from multiple problem areas, it really only helps with skin texture and I think my acne has gotten worse since using it. If someone doesn’t have acne prone skin, or has a great method of controlling it I would definitely recommend!

Amazing! The texture is rich and creamy and it applies beautifully on the skin. Can use as a night cream during the winter months. I have combination skin and this does not clog my pores or cause me to breakout and is very hydrating. Would definitely repurchase.
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: Don’t get me wrong - I love Tatcha, especially the Deep Polish and Deep Cleanse. But, I sadly noticed no difference with this product. I will use the product up, but not repurchase. Same with the Violet C mask for me.
product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA

review_text: Smells kinda weird but a refreshing mask! Leaves my face smooth and nice.

There had to have been a FORMULA CHANGE because this worked great for my skin before and I loved it but when I got a new one it almost destroyed my skin barrier and my skin started getting super oily. I started getting a ton of acne and I started getting pimples on my nose and cheek where I had never gotten acne before. Theres other reviews too on google too about it.
Did not work for me, I tried using for a couple months and did not work for me, and made my skin worse. Very sad:(

The title sums up my feeling towards all fresh products - they all smell WONDERFUL but that’s pretty much it. The cleansers doesn’t clean much, the masks doesn’t hydrate much (in fact if anything they make your skin looks a bit irritated). The rose petals in the mask is a nice touch, but I feel like it’s more of a marketing pitch...
review_title: Smells nice, doesn't do much else

review_text: I’ve got this product as a sample first and Immediately fell in love with it! It soothes and moisturize my skin really good without making it oily! I use it pm only as I prefer something with spf for the daytime.
I love this. I can use it frequently without it drying my skin out even more. My cheeks are really dry so I use this almost everyday during my morning routine to make makeup application easier.

Honestly, I can’t seem to tell what this is doing. I’ll finish the bottle because it’s not doing harm, but idk that I would rebuy. Perhaps I’ll tell after I stop using it? Seems like just an extra step.

I don’t know what’s been going on down at quality control at Sephora. I have had three in a row returns, with this kit being the latest. Cloudy milky with white bits floating in the unsealed misting spray. Thick dull cloud gel consistency of the sealed drops. This looks like it was fished out of the bin and shipped to me. Ha-yuck!

I’m not sure if I just thought this product was working in the beginning, but after a period of time, it seemed to stop having any effects on my skin. It seemed to dry out my skin too. If you’re really desperate, give it a try. But I say a healthy diet will give you the same results. Overall, I wouldn’t say it’s really worth the price tag.
I grabbed this when I was in line to pay, thought that i would give this a try and loving it.

First off. I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. So this product arrived in time for a two week cross country move. And I’m so glad it did. Theres setting so relaxing about a good face mask, no matter if I’m home on the couch or settled in a hotel room after 8 hours of driving.I’m instantly reminded of watermelon taffy when I first applied the clay. The included spoon and toner were appreciated, making application mess free and complimenting the clay mask results. The clay felt pretty nice and cool when applying, and after washing off my skin looks and feels amazing and smooth.
product_name: Watermelon Glow Hyaluronic Clay Pore-Tight Facial Mask

review_text: This is a great oil, and can be used for more than just your face. The price point is actually quite reasonable compared to the other oils available at Sephora. It is shiny when I first apply it, but it absorbs fully before I go to bed. Hardly any scent, and it dissipates shortly after application. I’ve noticed a slight improvement in skin tone after about a month. It’s slightly thicker than what I’ve used in the past, so I’m not sure if I ’love’ it yet. Will probably purchase again.

I don’t find this hydrating at all. I’ve tried patting it and tried rubbing it, but it doesn’t melt into my skin. It sits on my skin; stick and waxy. And greasy looking. It’s like putting on vaseline -- no hydration at all. I had wanted to use it over make up during the winter months but it doesn’t glide on the skin without disturbing my make up (again, because it’s waxy) but patting it over the make up doesn’t seem to distribute the product onto the skin - definitely need to swipe it on.
product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm

review_text: This was really good for cleaning up dead skin and exfoliating without being too abrasive. I liked it a lot!!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: this stuff is my favorite makeup remover. I like it much better than take the day off - it does a better job of removing makeup and rinses off very well. and the smell is nice!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: The only reason I’m rating this product so low is because when I apply to my skin afterwards tiny balls of gunk or product build up start to pill all over my face. I then end up having to wipe my face off to get rid of the flakes. Not sure if I’m doing my products in the wrong order or my skin is just not vibing with this product, but otherwise I love all of The Ordinary prosucts.

I feel like I have a hard time achieving glow-y skin without feeling oily with the product on (I normal have dry skin) and this works wonders!! I feel so moisturized! I have really sensitive skin so I was nervous to try but no problems at all (and that’s rare) I 100% recommend for a bit of added moisture and an all dah glow-y look and feel
product_name: Green Machine Vitamin C + Green Superfoods Jelly Serum

review_text: This product is everything I didn’t know I needed. I’ve tried both good genes and DE TLC serums and neither worked as well for me as this has. redness is reduced as well as texture and pore size. To me this smells like dandelions and I just happen to love the smell so it’s a nice bonus.

So I’m confused because this is essentially vaseline in a tub; it smells, feels and has the same consistency...it does leave an oily filmy on your face and I had to TRIPLE cleanse to get rid of the nasty, dirty feeling. total fail of a product and anyone that thinks this is great clearly has not tried effective cleansing balms.

Gave this products two starts for two reasons - decent ingredients and a lot of product for your money. But that’s it. Product does not absorb into the skin. Just sits there giving it the illusion that it has done something. Been using for over a month and have not seen any different at all.
product_name: Light Aura Vitamin C + Peptide Eye Cream

review_text: I really wanted to love this primer since a lot of reviewers love it so much. It doesn’t work well for me. It feels really good applied to my skin, but will leave patches on certain parts of my face (looks like dry patches, but these areas aren’t dry), so you really have to rub it in good. even after i rub it in well, and put my foundation on top, the primer will make my foundation look patchy in some areas! it’s annoying and such a disappointment :(. the luminosity is wonderful on this primer though. i’ve just had much better primers in the past that i’ll probably go back to and return this one.
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: Not a fan! The texture is so thick and takes so much effort to remove my make up with this product. I’m returning this and going back to Shu Uemura. It feel so much more luxurious! This stuff is garbage.
This cream made my skin super read and kind of burn. It was recommended for dry winter skin but didn’t do much at all for the dryness.
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Giving this 2 stars because I did enjoy the actual product. But the cap of my bottle broke off while I was on my birthday vacation. I brought this along as a new gift I had been given for my birthday. Unfortunately, Sephora said they couldn’t exchange the bottle without me bringing it back to the store. Obviously since the cap was broken off I had no way to transport this back in a suitcase without the contents spilling everywhere. Pretty bummed because I was excited to test out the product since I love so many items from yttp.
Feels very chemical-y, the scent is pretty strong and gross and it definitely does not hydrate dry skin.

Melt moisturizer is amazing. Ive heard so many great things about their products and couldn’t wait to try it for myself. I’m so glad that I did because I absolutely love it. I can see how it got it’s name of melt, it actually melts into your skin when applying. It’s light weight and non greasy. My face feels so good and soft after applying. It really helps with the dryness I have during the colder months. Gifted by alpyn beauty
product_name: Melt Moisturizer with Bakuchiol and Squalane

review_text: I have super dry skin. I was struggling to find a moisturizer that I liked. When I would put my make up on, it looked horrible because of my old moisturizer. With youth to the people my skin feels amazing, I haven’t broke out since and my make up looks so much better! 100% recommend.
product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I received this free from Influenster for my honest review. This is a pretty good moisturizer. It is not heavy. Absorbs nicely. The smell is clean. It doesn’t leave you feeling oily. It plays well under makeup. I’ve tried it with several different foundations and skin tints. I tried it for about 2 weeks before I formed my opinion.
product_name: DayWear Advanced Multi-Protection Anti-Oxidant Moisturizer, Normal/Combination

review_text: I love this product mainly because it’s both a chemical and physical exfoliator. So it actually feels you’re removing the dead skin from your face. I love the way my skin looks after using it.
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: Amazing!!!! A must buy!! Keeps skin hydrated!! I love it!!
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: Love this stuff. It’s a moisturizer AND a primer for makeup AND a bit of a face lift. Smells great, I love putting this on my face in the morning, it wakes me up. On Bottle #4
review_title: Like Spanx for your face in the a.m.

review_text: I had high hopes for this product; I’ve used Murad products before with great success (LOVE their salicylic acid cleansers). Unfortunately, I have come to the end of this bottle and see no difference. The formula goes on smooth and absorbs well, but for the price point I expected to see better results. This is my main issue, there is nothing in this formula that recommends itself to me over another eye cream that’s less than half the cost. I do not plan to repurchase.

AMAZING. I recently got an eczema flare up on my face (normally I only have it on my upper lip) and applying this has really helped restore my skin to an even better state! It’s even helped calm my eczema on my upper lip. I use it in place of a moisturizer lately while my skin heals and it’s been life changing.

So I will start off saying I love the fact that it’s a clean product but I don’t think it clears up your acne at all. I actually felt like it made my acne worst at times. The smell is alright but a little over powering at times. It does hydrate your skin very well and has a nice consistency. I think that it over all lightens your skin but I don’t think it helped with my acne at all. I received this product as a free sample and was using this for sampling purposes. I personally wouldn’t purchase it because I didn’t see good results for my skin type.
product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: I’ve had a tiny bottle of this stuff for over a year now and have used it on all my blemishes. It does nothing but dry out the spot... I only use it because I hope it might, by some miracle, clear my blemishes but it never does.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I don’t know how these great products keep falling into my lap. I received this product complimentary for testing and review purposes. When I test skin care products, I like to start applying it alone without my usual skincare products just so I can get a realistic idea of what the product is capable of doing to my combination dry skin. My skin looks and feels smooth after using the cream. It did hydrated my skin instantly! However, it didn’t hydrate my skin all day. My skin started to get dry so I added a tiny pump of my VaniCream for an extra hydration boost and worked like a charm. After 2 weeks, I started adding it to my skincare routine. It’s very friendly when using it with other products. For nighttime routine, I do a pump of Augustinus Bader cream and a pump of my Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Night Moisturizer (Retinol). After using doing this for a whole month along with the Augustinus Bader Gel Cleanser, my skin has appeared brighter, even, toned and regenerated and it’s texture has looked smoother and firm.
product_name: The Cream with TFC8 Face Moisturizer

review_text: I really wanted to to like this product thinking it would be a good dupe for Biossance vitamin C rose oil but this oil broke me out each time I used it.

I am obsessed with the matching glow moisturizer and swear by it, but the cleanser is just meh. I wanted to love it as much as the moisturizer but it’s just nothing special, I didn’t have a super fresh clean feeling after using this, but it was also a little too drying for my already dry skin.
Great sunscreen! It doesn’t leave a white cast on your face and works well under makeup.
product_name: PLAY Everyday Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: It breaks my heart to give this product 1 star, as DE is an amazing brand and I absolutely love everything they make. I received this product for free from Influenster to try and write an honest review. E-Rase irritates my eyes and did not remove my makeup effectively. I had to repeat the process several times and ultimately use a different product to finish it up. It’s a thicker formula, so it doesn’t work well with the cotton disc.

All hype no delivery.. Was so excited to try this eye cream I am a 45 year old female.. I do not have sensitive skin. I applied just a Tadd to under my eye area and I begin to swell, burn, itch. I had to wash it off my eyes.. I purchase I cream that I love that I use faithfully every day this one for $76 you heard it here do not waste your money it’s all hype!!!!

I like the concept of this mask, but the execution seems to leave something to be desired. At first glance, it seems like charcoal and honey would be nice together. Charcoal being nice at reducing oiliness, and honey to counteract that effect and add a bit of hydration/soothing. The texture is pretty good in this regard - it’s not chalky from the charcoal, and is actually pretty smooth. It doesn’t dry down too much so that it becomes impossible to remove.Unfortunately, it misses the mark on scent. It doesn’t really smell like honey, more like a strange floral-citrusy smell that is just too strong. There are just way too many potentially irritating essential oils added in this, even ones that I rarely see in cosmetics like spearmint, clove, and wintergreen. This, with limonene, linalool, eugenol, and citral, and no wonder my skin was left irritated after using it.So, while it has a nice texture and works alright, it just goes way too hard with essential oils and smells very unpleasant.
review_title: Nice texture but too many fragrant essential oils
product_name: Clear Improvement Charcoal Honey Mask to Purify and Nourish

review_text: after using for only a few days all the black heads on my nose are 100% gone. great product and I love the minty smell that it has.
review_title: a little goes a long way.

review_text: this left my skin feeling sticky and tight. it also reacted with the khiels ultra toner that i use at night as part of my evening routine - it left my skin red and blotchy. i feel like i’m always giving mediocre reviews, but at the same time it just goes to show the sample products gave gibe waaay downhill. depending on this next box (after the last 4 being lackluster at best) i may jump ship for birchbox.

It’s weird because I’ve tried using this product a few times since I bought it (cause it is expensive af) and the first use I wake up the next day and any break outs I had are almost completely gone, my skin is smooth, and it seems like a holy grail product. Then after the second use, my entire face is covered in red bumps. so... I don’t know what the deal is with this and why my skin is like a baby butt once and then completely broken out, but I guess it is just not for me.

review_text: I was skeptical at first but this works. I notice plump lips after I use this. I put it on every night before a lip mask and my lips are plump and hydrated in the AM.

review_text: I’m pretty hot and cold with this product to be honest. First on the pros is that it looks like you’re wearing a mask of the blood of your enemies. So there’s an anesthetic there. But I have such a hard time not having this product burn the ever-loving crap out of my skin. It says to use on dry skin and I have to emphasize BONE DRY, Mojave dessert in dry season dry. I was using the Herbivore Blue Tansy mask leading up to this, my skin was crystalline perfect, and I would usually use that after getting out of the shower when my skin was going to be the cleanest and most receptive to the ingredients. With this one though, you seriously have to wait for dry skin and you CANNOT have a single break in your skin either. Yes that includes any pimples or even opened/extracted blackheads. Otherwise it will burn, kind of a considerable amount. You should also be very conscious of how long its on your face, I always set a timer (Herbivores mask could just stay on until it dried and no bad side effects from over exposure). With this though, even within the confines of the 8-10 minute suggestion, parts of my face still flaked. And at my baseline, I have super oily skin, so that was new for me! My forehead is now back to its bumpy baseline that it was before I started any sort of regimented skincare routine which I am supremely disappointed about. So while I was hoping that this would be an exceptionally cheap dupe for Herbivore, it just isn’t doing it for me.Other pros are that it lasts a while-- I still have more than half the bottle and have been using it about twice a week for well over a month I’d say.Unfortunately this one was a bit of a flop for me. I’m jealous of all these 5star reviewers who this clearly worked wonders for. But I probably won’t finish my bottle. At least I don’t feel guilty since it was less than $10!

After about a month the lines diminished and my lips looked a little smoother and plump. I no longer spent all day reapplying lip balms and could wear lipstick.I exfoliate as part of my nightly routine and use a generous amount as directed. I apply a thick layer to the lips and a thin layer around them. My favorite scent is the apple lime (limited edition).In the morning I wash my face and remove any residue of the mask. If my lips feel a little dry I will apply a very thin layer and it just sinks into my lips.It has been 4 months and I no longer have cracked, bleeding lips. They are softer, smoother and feel moisurized. My lipsticks apply really well, including liquid matte lipsticks. That is the only time they get a bit flakey, certain liquid lipsticks are more drying than others.This is definitely a product I make sure I don’t run out of.

After the first tube ran out, I thought I’d just use a trial size Origins face wash before buying this again. Bad mistake. I broke out. Two days later, I was on an emergency run to Sephora to buy another First Aid Beauty cleanser.

To star this review I’ll say I have combination and sensitive skin, for me I like more the chemical exfoliator because they are more gentle with my skin type and this one was amazing! So gentle, the smell isn’t strong at all. I fell my skin more soft and clean after using it so I highly recommend it. Although I got this product to try as an example my review personal and honest.
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: I tried to love it, especially since it’s made with all of the good stuff. My face instantly turned red after every wash. I was so sad smh. I honestly think I was just too sensitive to it.

I’ve only tried this for a few nights, in conjunction with their liquid collagen, but I am not a big fan. For my combo skin type, I felt it was too moisturizing. I would wake up in the middle of the night and feel extra oily especially in my nose area. The texture of this cream is really thick, and I had to really get in the jar, but once in the skin it dissolved in nicely. I like that it’s vegan and plant based but even in the winter months, is not for me.
