I love this mask. It leaves my skin feeling baby smooth. I use it weekly.
product_name: Original Skin Retexturizing Mask with Rose Clay

review_text: If you tell me there is another skin care product that actually compares to Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant, (in this price range?!?) then I am gonna insist that you prove it. Truly, this FTW- it’s EVERYTHING... think overall quality & bang for your buck, it’s the most beneficial for the skin (short of spending 5x the $ on multiple products). I have used it for a little over a month now, and going into summer makes for perfect timing that I would have an opportunity to test drive such a powerhouse! I’ve been battling acne-prone, sensitive skin for most of my 42 years, and I have spent countless amounts of money+ time on this effort, which makes me feel qualified enough to make such a confident assessment. Upon receipt, I read the information & directions on the package and bottle, and stuck it in my shower. I have been saving so much time and effort since I began using this, and I should point out that I use on my face, neck, and chest AND everywhere else I want great exfoliation with zero irritation. Best of all is that’s all now taken care of in the one simple and enjoyable step! I am happy to be a new but loyal fan, Dermalogica nailed it!

I have dry skin, so I was very excited to try this product. I tried to use it as a daily moisturizer but the product is a little too thick for that so I started using it before going to bed instead. I have noticed a gigantic difference in the Look and feel of my skin. I will definitely continue using!

Really like how well it absorbs into the skin. I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks and skin does feel bouncier than before. Only reason I gave it 4 starts instead of 5 is because I already use a lot of the YTTP products and my skin is soooo much better hydrated since then, so can’t tell how much more this serum alone is contributing. Will definitely keep using it!
product_name: Triple Peptide Hydrating + Firming Oasis Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Love this essence because it absorbs nicely into my skin and does not leave a sticky residue behind. My complexion looks so refreshed, hydrated and healthy! The formula contains some very beneficial ingredients (Akita rice/Uji green tea/Okinawa algae). I have pretty sensitive skin and this product does not bother it at all. All you have to do is pour a little bit in your palm and press it into your face and neck. It should be used after cleansing and prior to moisturizing. I will most definitely be purchasing this product when I run out. This magical essence has totally redeemed Tatcha for me, as I was not a big fan of their Violet-C brightening serum.
product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

review_text: I have a lot of acne scars and discolouration. This definitely helps.

I had high hopes for this product. I was looking for something that was quick to clean my face at the end of the day when I didn’t feel like taking off my make up. This product did fairly well with the make up removal but smells terrible! It smells like saliva. I tried to power through it in hopes my face wouldn’t stink as it dried. But had to get up and wash my face to get rid of the smell. Back to make up removal wipes for me.

I can not say if I have ever run into a product that I hate more than this one. It left my skin feeling like chalk. It was SO dry and weird feeling that I could not use it but a few times. Plus it left so much makeup on my face that it was not worth using ever again.
product_name: Crème Radiance Gentle Cleansing Creamy-Foam Cleanser

review_text: Extremely sticky and thick, but I did not wake up to plump skin. I’ve tried this product for about 3 months now and it is not hydrating nor helpful in keeping moisture in. Would not recommend.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Sleepair Intensive Mask

review_text: I love me some Lancome, but as someone with oily skin, this may work for me in the winter months when my skin needs a little more moisture, but in this heat it does not work for my oily/acne-prone skin. I am not a fan of the scent, I feel like toners shouldn’t have a smell and if it does, it should smell clean. Before I write this product as a “no-go“ I am going to try it when it’s cooler to see how it holds up. *Disclaimer: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.
review_title: For the oily skin folks, this might not be for you
product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey

review_text: This seems like a pretty nichey product to me. It doesn’t really do anything on its own. It’s intended to help deliver other moisturizer products more efficiently to the skin. I suppose if you have dry skin or live in an arid climate this could be useful, but the price is a lot of dosh for a product that’s essentially just a moisturizer assist.
product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: The coolness of the tip is an added bonus to the long lasting tinted cream. Adds moisture to your under eye area and keeps it moist.
product_name: Even Better Eyes Dark Circle Corrector

review_text: I think I’m the only person here to not highly review this. I bought it solely based on reviews, as my local Sephora didn’t carry it to sample. I don’t like the texture. It’s not smooth and creamy, and I didn’t feel like a little went a long way. To cover my chest and neck I had to take a lot out. The jar is misleading - what is in it is not the size of the jar, at all. I used it for a month and did find it moisturizing, and I’d say it did make an improvement. But, it wasn’t significant enough to buy this again. If I had unlimited funds, and knew I could use a jar a month, I bet it would be fantastic. But not a fan of the texture at all. Fresh Black Tea (from the sample I got) was way better.
review_title: Eh - why does everyone love this?
product_name: Do Not Age with Dr. Brandt Moisturizing Neck Cream

review_text: I really wanted to like this balm because of all the great reviews, but I didn’t find it to be effective at all for me. It turns into a clear oily texture once you start rubbing it into your skin rather than the milky texture they claim on the description. I used my clarisonic after this, and my brush was completely covered in makeup after I finished cleansing, so clearly, the balm didn’t take much off at all. It also wasn’t very effective in taking off my waterproof eyeliner. PLUS it’s unscented, but it still feels and smells like petroleum jelly. product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: just doing the lord’s work and here to warn you that this stuff is garbáge. I’ve been forcing myself to use this for so long, but I get angry every time I apply it because it was a colossal waste of money.

I did like the texture of the cream it was very silky it made me think that it was going to be very moisturizing that’s why I was a bit surprised that it wasn’t at least for my skin. I don’t think I would search this out on my own to purchase.
product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: Not great for eye area, very thick and greasy. Best to be used only on face, but I think other makeup removers could work just as well for less $.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Broke me out and had a really weird texture almost like sunscreen. It didn’t feel good when I put it on my skin and I just knew it would break me out the next day. I didn’t feel particularly moisturizer either so I’m confused with all the positive reviews.
This product minimizes the fine wrinkles and smoothes the lip area. Great after a day out in the sun!!!

This product was pretty expensive and I expected great things but it did not do a great job. Jergens lotion from Walmart works a million times better than this product save your money

Another reviewer said they changed the packaging and possibly re formulated so I caution anyone interested to pick up the white bottle instead? lots of ppl seem to like it but this formula is no bueno!
review_title: save ur pennies and skip this

review_text: I have acne prone skin and I have tried ALL the oil-free moisturizers and this is the best one. It’s light yet my skin stays hydrated. Makes putting on make up afterwards easy. This will stay in my routine for sure.

I absolutely loved this product. It is light, fresh and gave me just the right amount of moisture I needed. It’s perfect to put on before applying makeup b/c it isn’t too heavy. I live the energizing smell it adds as well!I received this product for free, all opinions are my own.

whoever said this product is not greasy.....lied. its so freaking greasy to the point where my glasses slide off my face. i feel like a grease pit all day and yet somehow my skin feel dehydrated afterwards. would not recommend for oily skin types or in general. bought the huge tub thinking it was worth the value, WRONG.
product_name: PLAY Everyday Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: First, you have to apply these on very dry skin or they will continuously slip down you face. And be careful because the sparkles come off and I’ve picked sparkles off my face hours after using that I didn’t even know were there. These were nice at giving the under eye a more plumped look, but nothing special and the recommended time to wear is 20-30 minutes which was too long for me. Unfortunately I wasn’t able to use the whole container before they dried out.
product_name: Party Recharge Hydrating Hyaluronic Under Eye Masks

review_text: Last winter was the worst for my skin, it was the driest my skin has ever been. I even had dry eyelids!! This cream saved me last winter, and I’ve been hooked ever since! Makes my skin feel hydrated and moisturized without feeling oily. Doesn’t sit on top, and actually gets absorbed. Highly recommend it to anyone suffering from dry skin, and eczema.

Fell for the hype. The 4.5 stars are deceiving. Put this on my face and neck and it gave me an awful allergic reaction. My neck began getting very irritated. I don’t have sensitive skin so I’m shocked my skin reacted this way. It’s not really hydrating. I wanted to love it but unfortunately i will be returning it.

I bought this toner—along with a Farmacy cleanser, moisturizer, and serum—to test the effects on my skin. I’m always looking for a holy grail product and this seemed to have great reviews. The packaging is nice (glass bottle). I also like the smell, although I know fragrance can be an irritant. The thing is, this line didn’t really do anything for my skin. After three months of use, I noticed no difference. I suppose I had high expectations based on what others had to say (and the price point). I don’t think I would buy again. The search continues ...
product_name: Deep Sweep 2% BHA Pore Cleaning Toner with Moringa + Papaya

review_text: Much too drying for me, even though I actually have oily/combo skin. I make my own oils for oil cleansing and was hoping this would work as the second cleanse in my double cleansing routine because it’s more convenient to use a bar and Drunk Elephant makes my favourite cream (Lala Retro Whip) plus it’s clean/green and cruelty-free. Alas it wasn’t to be, very tight and dry after washing, I couldn’t tone and moisturize fast enough. Two stars because I think this is probably a great product for some and the quality is clearly excellent.
product_name: Baby Pekee Bar + Juju Bar Travel Duo

review_text: It goes on smooth and is absorbed. I’m lucky I don’t have wrinkles around my eyes. At first I thought I would return the product because I don’t see a big improvement. I keep using 2x day and there are days when I do feel I look refreshed.

This serum felt a little too greasy for me. I don’t like oils on my skin in general although it did feel light. The scent didn’t stand out in a good or bad way. I will not be adding this to my daily routine, I didn’t notice a difference in my skin.
product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

review_text: I’ve had 2 tubs of this cream, the first that I bought and a second that my mom got for me. I honestly just don’t think it’s THAT good and it might be my skin preference. I generally like more watery or gel-like creams rather than a traditional cream. I wouldn’t say that this is a particularly rich cream which is nice, but I don’t find that it absorbs into my skin very well unlike other more watery/bouncy cream textures. It definitely moisturizes but it doesn’t make my skin feel nice which is something I generally look for. I like moisturizers that make my skin look plump and hydrated and this one just doesn’t do that for me even though it does moisturize. It just kind of feels like it sits on my skin rather than fully sinks in.
product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: Loved how this absorbed quickly and felt very hydrating. It has no scent, a light texture, and doesn’t feel heavy. I have oily skin and I appreciated that. However, I am not a fan of the price compared to other moisturizers. If I wanted to splurge a little bit I would give this another try. I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.
I had to return - had an allergic reaction.

I love this clear sunscreen stick! It is great to use before applying makeup. This sunscreen is super convenient and easy to take on the go with you! I love this sunscreen because it goes on smoothly and doesn’t feel sticky. It feels so soft!
Worked ok, but definitely overpriced and does not stick as well as other better and cheaper alternatives I have tried.

I do LOVE the smell and texture but it did nothing for my skin except make it more oily. It smelled really fresh and light like cucumber and freshness. Wished the formula was better. The essence is awesome, now i wish their water cream was better.
Great product. They do a very light exfoliation without irritating your skin. They make your skin softer. I buy these religiously

This is super convenient to throw in your purse and apply whenever you need to. It leaves your face feeling smooth not oily. You can’t even tell it’s there. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is I feel like it’s hard to get in all spots of your face and because it’s clear and absorbs quickly I wasn’t able to tell if rubbing it in was reaching the spots the stick couldn’t.
Best for oily skin and large pores. The smell is natural without being too sweet.

I honestly love this product. It’s not sticky as it’s more of a lotion consistency, which is nice because it doesn’t make your skin feel yucky. Literally cleared up my acne overnight. Definitely would recommend and will be using on a regular bases. Thank you Peter Thomas Roth, & Influenster for the product. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.
product_name: Goodbye Acne   Complete Acne Treatment Gel

I love this set. It’s so Luxurious and feel absolutely wonderful in the skin. It’s been gentle. Abs it looks beautiful in my counter
Loved this but I’ve had it less than a year and it won’t hold a charge anymore :(
review_title: had this less than a year...

I never encountered anything like that, and I’m shocked that this item is still being sold. It happened with both jars that I owned, so it isn’t a fluke. Waste of money.

review_text: This really didn’t do it for me. At first I liked the glass bottle but eventually realized it made things awkward (travel, slippery when wet, etc). The product itself just didn’t seem to make my skin happy, which was a shame since it seems so many ppl love this product and I really wanted to have found my new go to cleanser :(

The eye drop actually came apart when I unscrewed it. You can get hyaluronic acid all over the place these days, and for me this just wasn’t any different. My advice is spend your money on something equally as good, and cheaper.

Oh my, I was really intimidated by this product. I have rather reactive and acne prone skin and applying something oily/creamy on my face was a bit scary. I would believe that it works wonders for regular jet laggers:)
I wanted to love this project, but it literally clogged every pore in my face! Had to return it.
review_title: Ugh. Traded one issue for another!

product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment

My tip is instead of using a cotton pad to apply, try pouring a little bit into the palm of your hand, pat them together and tap onto the face so it absorbs without losing any of the product to the cotton!

I have pretty bad wrinkles and I am struggling to find best solutions for them or at least to make them look better on my face. review_title: Broke me out every single time!

review_text: Bon prix mais ne vaut pas la peine sa fait maintenant deux semaine que je l’utilise et je n’ai vu aucune différence.

Also it has helped with the slight redness I have on my cheeks. I feel like I am beaming everyday I take this. I definitely will continue to buy this and also recommend to anyone who wants to add a boost to their skin. Side note-I feel like this also helped out alot during a time when alot of people around me were getting sick from colds and viruses. Absolutely a part of my daily routine now. Try this out-you will not be disappointed. Plus it is gluten free, vegan, and non GMO.

review_title: A STAPLE TO MY DAILY SKIN ROUTINE

not for me, this is heavily scented and it seemed to dry out my skin. I had to use more than my normal moisture to compensate. I hardly noticed any improvement verse my other serums. not worth the astronomical price.

review_text: This includes fragrance. I’m tired of companies advertising products suitable for sensitive skin when they contain fragrance. review_title: Fragrance - not suitable for sensitive skin

I generally have acne-prone, combo skin. Recently I did a ski trip in Greenland, constantly outside, with temps from -60 degrees Celsius to -5. It has all calmed down so much!

I have no clue what others are raving about, but I have to admit that whatever it is, I wish it had been a part of my experience with this product. product_name: Yo Detox Charcoal Face & Body Enzyme Scrub

review_text: Hardly does the job. Can’t remove mascara well and am not talking about the waterproof kind. I had better results with Tatcha, but wanted to try something new. The search continues!

review_text: I had such high hopes for this product. But it does nothing for my acne. I might as well be dabbing water on my pimples. The only thing that it does effectively, is dry out my skin horrendously. The price is also ridiculous for the small amount of product you get. Very disappointed ):

The combination of Vitamin C with AHAs is effective. After using up the bottle, some dark spots had faded and my skin felt very soft. However, I think the AHAs may be too effective. Dermatologists recommend against using AHAs every day because of the risk of over-exfoliation. In addition, Vitamin C and AHAs work best with different PH levels and may interfere with each other. In combining them, Tatcha seems to be capitalizing on a wide range of PH levels, so the product’s effects may come from either the Vitamin C or the AHAs . Bottom line, you could think you were using Vitamin C, but actually be seeing the effect of the AHAs. So, as much as I liked the feel of my soft skin, I don’t think this is a good product to use on a daily basis.

review_text: First things first, as a general rule I don’t leave negative reviews. Because different strokes for different folks, and all that, y’know? And honestly, there’s enough negativity on the Internet already- I don’t like adding to it. But then I remembered Sunday Riley got caught padding positive reviews. So that, coupled with the fact the full size is only $15 shy of a Benjamin? Here ya go:I received this is my PLAY! box, and really wish I hadn’t. I’m not even sure where to start. It’s thick, and not in a good way because it doesn’t spread easily (or at all). Every single high end product I’ve ever tried just glides on, and I barely have to use any for a full face application. Not this stuff. It’s stodgy af, and refused to thin out and let me spread it on. So I just had to keep applying more.It refused to soak into my skin. I decided not to rush it, hoping maybe if it had some time to warm up it might thin out a bit, and soak in. Nope. After twenty minutes this sludge of a “serum“ was still just sitting on top of my skin. It also has a very tacky finish which made it impossible to put on my moisturizer. I actually had to rewash my face. I have NEVER had to do that before. (That was when I decided to write this.) All that being said, the scent is absolutely lovely.Again, I realize different things work for different people so I’m not saying don’t buy this, I’m just saying don’t buy into the plethora of “I TRIED THIS AND NOW I’M MARRIED TO HARRY STYLES!!!“ reviews. Definitely try a sample/travel size before dropping the full $85. Hey, maybe it’ll work for you and you’ll marry Harry Styles. Or maybe it won’t, and you should try LilyAna Naturals Vitamin C Serum for a fifth of the price.
review_title: I hated it so much I actually rewashed my face.

I was lucky enough to receive this serum for testing purposes from Influenster and Peter Thomas Roth. As I’ve been using it for almost two months twice a day, I’ve managed to give it a good try. So now I’m ready to share my honest review. The serum comes in a sleek and aesthetically pleasing bottle with a pump applicator, which is very convenient and hygienic to use. Besides, it allows you to easily get the needed amount of the product. The formula is a bit creamy yet lightweight. It’s a light-blue color that becomes clear once applied. It glides very smoothly on my skin and absorbs instantly without residue. A little goes a long way – one pump is more than enough for the whole face. The finish is dewy, non-sticky and non-greasy. The smell is not overpowering, quite natural. I don’t really feel it on my skin. The result can be seen from the first application. Normally my skin is on the oily side, but it’s also often dehydrated, especially in winter, when the heating is on and it’s freezing outside. So I’m no stranger to dryness, flaky and tight skin as well as irritations. This serum resolves all of those concerns in a heartbeat.It makes the skin much more hydrated and nourished. It soothes and softens it, so when I touch my face, it feels velvety smooth. It couldn’t be any different with 75% of hyaluronic acid on the ingredients list. Moreover, it looks much healthier and more youthful, as the serum boosts the natural glow and radiance in my skin, makes it more supple and reduces the appearance of wrinkles. Makeup applies easily on it and doesn’t budge. Also, it doesn’t make my face shinier during the day and doesn’t break me out or irritate my skin. The effect from it is long-lasting even when you stop using it. I highly recommend this product to everyone with both dry to normal and combination to oily skin types. I’ll definitely stock up on it as from now on, it’s going to be my Holy Grail serum and I just can’t imagine my skincare routine without it!
review_title: A real game changer for my beauty routine!

Glow Recipe also claims that the quinoa extract contains peptides, but it’s really hard to say how many peptides are actually in a plant extract as that can be highly variable, and I don’t know which peptides are actually in quinoa. Remember that not all peptides do the same things, so it’s really best to look for specific peptides added to an ingredients list to get the most benefit. Overall I don’t think it is an awful product but it’s not my top choice for a chemical exfoliant. Lightweight serums and toners are better for the daytime when I like to use a product like this.

review_text: Alright. To give a little bit of a background, I have had severe cystic acne since I was 11 years old. I have tried everything. I’ve been on Accutane three times. I’ve been prescribed every medicine and topical out there. I’ve been on the pill, gone vegan, cut out dairy, used apple cider vinegar, even tried acupuncture! Not a single thing has given me lasting results. I saw this product floating around on social media and decided to give it a go. I’d used one of the main ingredients, tea tree oil (melaleuca) before. It’s been okay for spot treatment, but not as a preventative. (Pro tip- it works well for ear infections, actually). I had nothing to lose, so I went to Sephora and got a sample. I used it that night, and guys, it was OVERNIGHT. There was a noticeable difference in my skin. I’m gonna get a little bit graphic here. Some blemishes were gone completely, and the others were softer. I had more pimples total, but most were just smooth red dots, rather than raised cysts. The cysts I did have were easier to pop and drain (sorry, I know it’s gross) and significantly less painful. My face felt hydrated and my otherwise oily skin didn’t get greasy throughout the day, even with full coverage foundation and powder on. After a few days of using this, I did notice a purge. I broke out more than usual, and was discouraged, but kept using it and it cleared up. As for the smell, it’s strong, but once rubbed into the skin it’s barely noticeable. If you’ve ever used melaleuca oil, you’ll recognize the scent. it’s not the end of the world. I can’t say enough good things about this product. I am almost getting a little bit teary-eyed talking about this product because of the change it has made. I have never liked my skin and always felt like I HAD to wear makeup every day. I felt ashamed for all of junior high, high school, and even some of college! Last week was the first time I’d left the house (other than the gym or dermatologist) without a single drop of makeup on since I was a child. I mean, think about that. a CHILD. I feel more confident and happy than I ever have. This will be a staple in my collection forever. Thank you, Sunday Riley, for helping me feel comfortable in my skin!! Please never remove this product from your line!!!

review_text: I was originally using Murad Perfecting Night Cream, but found it was not moisturizing enough for the cold, dry winter weather. I wanted to change to a product that had great overnight moisturizing ability but also lightened skin pigmentation and/or had other age fighting benefits. On top of that I wanted something without all the nasties- parabens, sulfates, etc... Well, I could not find a good combo. L’Occitane Immortelle Very Precious Cream seemed perfect, but the smell was just overpowering and it was not that moisturizing. Having had good luck with Murad, I wanted to try this new product. There is no scent, it is thick, creamy and comes with a little spatula. I think the product is over packaged with the use of too much plastic for the container. A little product goes a long way. It does a great job moisturizing overnight. After initial application my skin looks greasy, especially in the T-zone. I have had some acne appear with use, which is a disappointment. Not so bad that I will stop use as I hope my skin will adjust. This seems to be a great choice for winter use and I will probably revert back to the Perfecting Cream in the summer or another, lighter product. I just wish it did more than just moisturize. These products are so expensive!

So I want to start by saying I had super high hopes for this serum. First impression, it has relatively no smell & I personally am a fan of the strong citrus smells of vitamin C serums. Okay though, not a deal breaker. The serum applies and immediately gets sticky/tacky. After a few minutes it dries down. I noticed an INSTANT glow and tightening of my skin with a super smooth feeling. Then a few minutes creep by, and my face turned bright red. I applied this serum at 8AM in the morning, put on light makeup for work, and by the time I showered at 8PM my skin was still red and super irritated. I used this serum for 4-5 days with no improvement on the redness and irritation. I do have sensitive skin but I haven’t had any issues with other vitamin c serums (Drunk Elephant, OleHenricksen, Sunday Reilly). Unfortunately this will be going back.

review_text: I have tried many of Youth to the People’s other products and liked them all, so I bought the full size of this assuming I would like it also--and if I didn’t, well, it’s a wash-off product, so I could use it up and then switch to something else with little harm done. Big mistake. My skin is pretty resilient--in fact, I can’t remember the last time a product caused a reaction like this--but the Superfood Cleanser gave me a bad case of contact dermatitis. I had scaly, dry patches above and at the corners of my eyes, my eyes themselves were irritated, and I had an itchy rash on my chin and around my nose. It had to be caused by this product, because I introduced nothing else new to my routine. I have to wonder if some of the people in the reviews who say this broke them out also were suffering from contact dermatitis, since sometimes it looks like little whitehead pimples. After a few days of using cortisone cream, my previous First Aid Beauty cleanser, and Cerave and Skinfix moisturizers, my skin is finally doing better, but I feel far more wary about Youth to the People as a brand now. I normally steer away from fragranced products like those by YTP and am put off by brands attempting to make money by using trendy but meaningless terms like “superfood,“ but I gave their products a try because I appreciated the mostly glass packaging, which is more recyclable than plastic. I will use up the YTP products I already own but will think again before buying more.
review_title: Try the mini size first! Caused contact dermatitis

My skin in a nutshell: EXTREMELY sensitive, rosacea-prone, acne-prone, combination but more dry in the winter. I also often tend to break out if my routine changes too much. Anyone with rosacea or dry skin will often find themselves with skin barrier issues so products like this are definitely useful. I heard good reviews about this and figured i’d give it a try and..It’s been awesome!!! Not only does my skin tolerate it well but after a few consecutive uses, I could definitely see an improvement in my skin. It looked more clear, brighter and youthful. This product has a light lemon scent that’s reminiscent of the Bobbi Brown Vitamin Enriched Face Base. I don’t love the scent but it doesn’t linger so it’s not the biggest deal tho I hope future iterations of this product come without the scent, it’s an unnecessary ingredient in skincare that can cause sensitivities. This product has an almost wax-like texture at first (like a chapstick) but it conforms to the temperature of your hands/face so it easily ‘melts’ into a lotion/gel texture. If you’re layering skincare, I’d definitely save this for the last step as it is pretty occlusive. I’ll probably use this sparingly in the warmer months and stick to using this regularly in the colder months (Fall/Winter) when my skin barrier hates me the most. It’s important to keep in mind that your skin’s barrier being off can definitely cause A LOT of issues from dry/flaking/dull skin to rashes/breakouts so if you’re suffering from anything like that, it may be worth analyzing your skin barrier to determine if it’s comprised. Totally worth the try!

review_text: Okay, so the first couple of days that I tried using this stuff, I was on the fence about it. I’ve been trying to find products that work well for my oily, acne- and blackhead-prone skin for actual years. I’ve tried so many different products, and wasted so much money, I was losing hope and had just accepted the fact that I would have terrible skin forever. I decided to try this brand after reading up a little more on what actually comprises a good skin care routine, and figured the savings couldn’t hurt either. The first time I used it (paired with the retinol serum from the same brand), I felt like an oiled Thanksgiving turkey. I have three pets, so I had hair stuck to my face, and I just felt gross overall. HOWEVER, that was my own fault, I recalibrated and used less retinol serum the next time. I did find my breakouts got worse after changing my skincare routine entirely, but that only lasted a couple of days. I’ve still got a long way to go before I have the skin I want, but this has made such a huge difference already! My skin feels smoother, my pores appear smaller, I’m noticing less oiliness throughout the day, and my breakouts aren’t nearly as bad. review_text: I’m going to keep it 1000 with you: I legitimately do not understand how this made its way to any list for products that “treat redness“. I have sensitive, acne-prone skin. I sometimes pick at my skin (terrible, I know) which causes redness that naturally I want to cover up. To premise this, there ARE products I have found that calm inflamed skin. However, this product is honestly the worst. The product doesn’t “treat“ redness, it’s a cosmetic color corrector - like a foundation with a green undertone to neutralize redness. Sure, it has cica in it, but it’s not like a redness reducing skincare treatment that you could easily use every day to actually reduce topical redness over time. Basically, this is a very thick foundation. One beauty editor’s review vaguely said they “wouldn’t recommend wearing it to bed as the color can get on your pillow“ - it would be like sleeping in makeup. It has a distinct beige color and is thick enough that it could be worn as foundation - the beige color is pretty light, so even though I have a pretty light skin tone, if I was to wear it alone I would look sickly. It is one distinct skintone color and does not adjust to skin tone or anything - it also definitely turns beige so it isn’t neutralizing green, but rather just putting on a thick foundation. My point being, it’s too thick to wear as just a neutralizing primer. It’s also very sticky, and doesn’t dry or sit on the face well. If you apply this over moisturizer or if you have oily skin, it’s going to feel really thick. If you try to spread it more thin, it really doesn’t cover the redness. I think the best way to use this would be to mix it into a moisturizer - I have mixed it into foundation before because a layer on its own would be too thick with other makeup. All in all: if you are looking for a product to TREAT redness and sensitive skin, this isn’t it; if you are looking for a product to COVER redness, be wary.

I love this product! The smell is divine and it is so hydrating.
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: Honestly, this is the best moisturizer I have ever used - and not just “for the price“. I’ve used $14 drug store brands and I’ve used $70 designer brands and I’m completely addicted to this moisturizer after just two bottles and am struggling with how to manage the small bottles and the fact that this brand keeps selling out everywhere (which is my only complaint). It’s a thick moisturizer but does not leave you greasy/shiny. It’s REALLY helped my acne prone - dry winter skin cope with the change of seasons. I live in the pacific northwest and the humidity changes from winter to spring ALWAYS cause me problems, but since I’ve started using this the flakiness and dry tight feeling have gone away and it’s even helped with the breakouts. The only downside is that it doesn’t have any SPF in it already and I’m outside A LOT for work and for play - so I just make sure I add a sunscreen or am wearing some other product with sun protection in it. It doesn’t have any weird interactions with my other ant-aging products and actually seems to work well as a primer too (I don’t feel like it contributes to mid day makeup melt).

I’ve been dealing with some hormonal acne for a few months now, so I was super excited to try this! I used it a few times throughout the week on some spots, and while it took some time, I did see a difference in the appearances of my blemishes by the end of the week! Basically dries out the pimple really well. A little goes a long way and it’s pretty effective if used correctly! Definitely would recommend!
product_name: Acne+ 2% BHA and Azelaic Acid Acne Spot Treatment

review_text: This stuff is SUPER oily. Even for someone who has dry skin, it was too much. I tried to put some powder after applying the sunscreen but it looks Cakey. Doesn’t work well with some make up products, and tends to pill. You also have to be careful to not apply too close to hairline, otherwise your hair will get so greasy. :(Might use another super hoop sunscreen but this was def not it.
product_name: Mini PLAY Everyday Lotion SPF 50 with Sunflower Extract

review_text: It felt refreshing and my skin was soft but I didn’t see any noticeable difference in my pores or redness. Would give it another try but hard to see results after one or two uses!
product_name: Superclay Purify + Clear Power Mask with Niacinamide

review_text: This smooth lightly scented moisturizer Mochi mochi moisturizer gifted by Damdam was a nice way to start my day. It went on almost like a powder and instantly disappeared into my skin. I used it for a few weeks in the morning as part of my daily ritual and what I noticed was the lightness. Since it’s summer it was nice to use something light and not greasy or heavy. I would use this in the summer but might like a heavier cream in the winter though.
product_name: Mochi Mochi Luminous Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Best moisturizer ever. Makes my skin feel great and smooth.
Love this for my new night cream! Absorbs for a smooth feel! Hefty price for less than 2 ounces though.
I really enjoy using this product! It goes on smooth
product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm

review_text: My skin has never broke out this bad :( I’ve used it for a month now and my face is full of zits and pimples.

I received this product for free in exchange for a review. I love everything about this product. The sleek packaging, the origin story, and its performance. It’s easy to use and not messy and I feel like it was soothing to my skin. Almost immediately, I felt like my skin just looked glowier and more matte. The essence does have a slight fragrance - kind of a fruity and slightly ethanol fragrance to me. But the scent doesn’t linger.

The face wash does froth up and smells wonderful. It was great for my oily t-zone but it made the dry patches on my cheeks even worse. I’ll be using the rest of the bottle but I won’t be repurchasing the product.

review_text: I have been using this for 4 days……I feel like there isn’t a wrong way to use it at all but it really isn’t making a difference. I have a string of large painful pimples perpendicular to my chin and a few on my cheek. Been applying 1-2 times daily…..and nothing has changed. I’m upset.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I wanted to love this product so much!! Everything from the smell to the texture was amazing, however it BROKE ME OUT so badly. So sad it didn’t work out for me. If you have sensitive acne-prone oily skin you might want to skip this product.
Smells great but it’s a little too hard on my lips!! Wish it was more buttery

Not to expensive to break your bank and it’s worth every penny. Love it !

review_text: This is a great product, perfect for fine lines and restoring firmness around the eyes. review_text: I tried this on a whim after Sephora stopped making my go-to green tea makeup wipes and was blown away. It does everything it promises and seems like it actually helps my skin stay away from impurities. I’ve used it with another facial cleanser but also use it alone all the time and it’s a definite game changer. I think this works well for anyone looking for a clean product but also for anyone worried about skin sensitivity!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: My skin feels clean and refreshed but not stripped of important oils.
Purchasing this cleanser makes me want to buy the whole set. It is gentle.smells nice and leaves my face baby soft.
I have acne scars on my upper lip that make me super self concisions. Ive seen results in using this product after a week! 5 stars for sure.

Okay so, I got this whole line from the Influenster app for free but I ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS STUFF! I use it more as a spot treatment or all over the face when I don’t have my normal moisturizer but it is really great!
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Calming Gel Cream

review_text: I have normal/dry skin and acne. I thought this would be good with not breaking me out so I bought it. It was good for that but it constantly left my face feeling tight and lacking moisture. Every time I would open my mouth, you could see that under my eye was pulling down. I do not recommend this product at all unless u have oily skin.
product_name: Superfood Air-Whip Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I bought this on a whim after watching a YouTube beauty guru give it rave reviews. I purchased a travel size first and after the first use I went out and bought a full size one. I have sensitive combination skin. I’ve tried anything and everything to combat my areas of oiliness and my red irritated dry patches that can happen. This stuff is amazing!!!! Within a few days the redness in my skin calmed down, my texture is smooth and my overall skin just feels amazing. It has truly worked a miracle on my skin. It’s a gel texture and doesn’t have too strong of a smell. It takes my makeup off easily and with only one go around. I will be continuing to purchase this.
I haven’t experienced significant or long lasting relief from redness. It helps a little, and the product feels nice, but I don’t find it effective enough to purchase again.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: My skin loves a toner with an AHA + PHA to exfoliate my skin. This toner helped brighten my skin and also tightened my pores! Well the foam is ok to have but I am glad my skin did not feel dry at all. I got this complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics.
product_name: The POREfessional Tight ’n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner

review_text: These are more a toner than a full on peel. The ingredients do help brighten complexion, but the results aren’t going to be seen immediatley. They are little textured rounds with serum/toner in them. There is no worries about it stinging or anything. They really just help even out skin tone and lessen redness. It’s not a peel, but a evening out of the skin. That said, they do a pretty good job helping with the decreasing of redness. These are fine for sensitive skin. It is a lot of money for something you can do with just a cotton ball and some good toner.
All the citrus oils irritated my eyes.

What a holy grail surprise! I have Combination skin, leaning towards oily skin. I was having zero luck fixing my scarring from all the cystic acne I was getting from my IUD. Youth to the people was tacky and took forever to dry and was breaking my bank, Clinique was managing but not fixing. I got a trail size ren toner and it changed my face within a week! My new routine is cheaper and visible results!!! (Clearasil, ren toner and clique ID moisturizer)
product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: i like the different flavors but it doesn’t last long and doesn’t do that good of a job moisturizing.

Not sure if I will buy it again.

review_text: I was very fascinated about trying this serum as I’ve never tried a vegan serum before. I’ve tried it for at least a week now twice a day and these are my initial thoughts. I like how lightweight and fresh feeling it is on my skin. It’s cool and calming and makes my skin appear more youthful in the sense that it makes it appear more dewy and plump. product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: I received the product for free in exchange for my honest review. This product absorbed quickly into my skin and didn’t leave a film. The scent was pleasant and light. It felt refreshing on the skin (very welcome after a hot summer day). I would recommend it especially for summer.
An okay sunscreen but I’ve tried much better for much cheaper.
didn’t do anything, wasn’t even hydrating. I think it actually irritated my under eyes a little bit. You only use a little product so I guess it will last a long time? only positive I can think of.

Is most of my face more brilliant? Yes. Except my chin which immediately broke out in red angry bumps and blemishes. Not the look I was going for. The bergamot and pineapple are my best guess so if you are sensitive stay away.

I’m not sure how this has so many great reviews... the only reason this got two stars is because it leaves your face feeling very smooth and soft after use. HOWEVER, the feeing is NOT because of a thorough and deep exfoliation. It must be because of the other ingredients in this product that smooth over the surface of the skin faking a fresh exfoliated effect...And I don’t even really need to say this but the balled up gooey peeling effect that happens is totally NOT dead skin lol No way!! If it was, I wouldn’t still have visible dry patches of dead skin left on my face the next morning!! I suffer from hormonal breakouts and I wanted a chemical vs physical exfoliant to gently remove all the dead skin on the areas where the breakouts had healed, and the dry skin that accumulates on my chin and nose and sides of face. This totally let me down. After using it ever other day about 4 times total this should have had at least some effect, or even too intense of an exfoliation for the frequency of use! But no...In my honest opinion this was not worth the insanely high price tag, I would maybe pay $10 for this product :( Sorry Peter Thomas Roth, but this was a dud for me.
Works well with my very dry skin. I got a sample of this and think I will buy some very soon.
review_title: You can notice a small difference.
product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

review_text: Used this during my pregnancy as it was recommended by a Sephora Rep for being baby safe. Scent is nice and clean, but the price is kind of absurd for how much you get.I found it makes me break out every single time I use it. Would not recommend for oily/acne prone skin

Lol this smells like a moldy forest... like did they test this on any sort of focus group?! Works just okay as a cleanser, super watery coming out like a rancid green odwalla juice. Thank god I got this as a sample instead of buying a whole bottle, or I would be mad instead of confused.

I heard the hype of this toner gave in and finally purchased a bottle. Initially I was super excited to use it since everyone and their momma on YouTube was paid to rave about it. When I first got the product I was excited to use it and followed all the directions correctly. I used it only at night and in the daytime I used SPF. I went through an entire bottle and still did not see any difference in my hyperpigmentation. I take my skincare routine very seriously so I know for a fact this does not do anything for dark spots. Don’t buy this product and expect it to change your dark spots. It is a good toner but doesn’t do much for hyperpigmentation. And there are better toners that are way more affordable than this one if you’re looking to use it as a toner only.

This product is worth the price! Quality doesn’t have to be expensive!! What I love the most about the serum is that it is vegan and clean which I have been incorporating in my skincare routine for the best skin possible!
review_title: Quality doesn’t have to be expensive

review_text: This cleanser is good but it didn’t wow me. The smell is a little odd. It did leave my skin feeling soft and hydrated. But a better cleanser for me is fresh soy cleanser. That’s my HG cleanser and nothing has come close to it.

I’ve tried a ton and ton of lip balms with SPF and they all were horrible. This one not only makes your lips smell and look good but is super moisturizing and feels amazing on your lips. New staple lip balm!
product_name: Isle Lip Balm SPF 30 with Sea Moss and Aloe Stem Cells

review_text: My favorite toner so far! I bought it because so many people wrote great things about it and I was not disappointed! Will be ordering this again.

If you barely wear makeup and want a soft oil to remove it then this is the product. It’s a complete waste for me since I always wear mascara. I’ve even tried using this twice followed by my YTP cleanser and I still have raccoon eyes

review_text: All you need is one or two drops for the face. It’s not oily or heavy i love the concept of the product and I loved the look it gives me. Because of that I let my friend use some and ended up looking like an Oompa Loompa looking color. It did not blend well into her skin and her face looked very different from her neck. The good news is that it rinses off pretty easily but she ended up breaking out. I don’t recommend this is people who are acne prone or fair in skin color.
product_name: D-Bronzi Anti-Pollution Bronzing Drops with Peptides

review_text: I love this serum! It feels amazing on the skin. I’ve been using it a while now and can already see an improvement in my redness and texture. I also love that there’s no strong fragrance like so many other products have. My only issue is the packaging. I wish there was a stopper of some kind because the dropper gets so messy & when it arrived the serum had leaked out everywhere. *kindly gifted by Sunday Riley

Because I’ve been sitting in front of space heaters all day for the past month trying to stay warm, I’ve been noticing dry, rough flaky skin appearing throughout my t-zone. I’d wash my face and exfoliate to get rid of the dry patches, but my Ultra Repair Cream would burn when I applied it to the raw, red skin, so I wanted to try a more natural routine.I started using an $8 Jamaican Black Castor Oil as a cost-effective and natural cleanser and began using the Josie Maran argan oil as a moisturizer to try to combat my desert-like dryness. I take the dropper and apply a drop or two to my forehead, both sides of my nose where it’s the worst, a drop on each cheek, and then my chin for overkill, and spend the next minute massaging it all in. After that, I forget about it for a few minutes and then when I remember and touch my face, it feels like a baby skin. I’ve only been using it for a few days in conjunction with the castor oil, but already my skin looks and feels better. However, I don’t like the way the Josie Maran oil looks or feels in my hair. It doesn’t absorb well enough and sits on top of my black hair looking weighed down and greasy, so I’ll stick with my Castor oil on my edges and Moroccan Oil in my hair, and this argan oil on my face.
Smells ok (not too fragrant), is not very foaming. Good cleanser overall, is comparable to other generic cleansers if this one is out of you price point (full size $36.00).

I had such high hopes for this product hoping it would help with dry winter lips! This did nothing for me, I get a better result using Vaseline. It feels nice for the first few seconds it is on but that’s about it.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I loved this product when I first started using it. it smells very fresh. After about a month of using this product twice a day my skin got very dry and sensitive :( might be better for an oily skin type.

review_text: This is great for farmers like me, I live on a 40 acre lot and I milk the cows every morning, when I am under the udder the sun protects me. However when I bring the milk back to the production facility, the sun is beaming on my face and I get tan and wrinkle. I use this cream from the constant worrying about whether the cows will be able to produce milk the next morning…so I lie awake most of the night wondering (my income comes from them making milk). This cream has worked wonders because although I am worried, it doesn’t show!! I am amazed…I feel sleepy but I look wide awake. It’s surreal. Even my husband notice, which might not be a good thing because I already got 7 kids.., so if I look any younger…you know what happens right?! No thanks. So I gave this three stars because it can provoke ’thoughts’ in my husbands and I don’t need anymore kids. I definitely recommend this to my friend who lives next door, she owns a cabbage farm and she worries about the rainfall and such!
product_name: White Lucent Anti-Dark Circles Eye Cream

review_text: I prefer their other cleansers. This one was too gritty for me. I love Tatcha but not this cleanser.
too drying for a daily routine. even with oily skin, my skin became red and dry after two uses. had to move to a twice weekly routine for it to be efficient for my skin.
review_title: too drying for a daily routine.

The cost is too much for a bottle of smelly water with a hint of fermented liquid. I wanted to be a believer, but not for this product.

I have pretty sensitive skin and I’m jealous for all the people that this worked for. It made my face grumpy the first day. It was fine for the rest of my body, but it’s too expensive to be a body wash (for me anyway).

I wanted to know what all the hype is about and purchased myself a kit. Good genes which came along with luna oil literally changed my life and I must say my face never looked better. product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: After using it I feel my acne is fading! It’s really impressive . I use it for two weeks and have already being seeing the results. I have dry skin and Absolutely love it definitely recommend.

Other than the good scent and texture of the serum, it is not a good product and definitely not worth the money.

Unfortunately, I’ve noticed a significant difference in the oiliness of my forehead with this product vs. three other gel moisturizers and no other change to my routine. This being said the smell and feeling are great and it’s a delight to apply. It’s perhaps more suitable as an additional moisturizer instead of as a primary.
review_title: I really wanted to love it.

review_title: Meh results with a bad smell

review_text: Had to return. Here’s the thing. I have very sensitive dehydrated skin and this light cream delivered. It is incredibly moist using yet feels light. There is no stinging of any kind. So soothing. BUT I developed gigantic acne spots in all sorts of places on my face. Huge! I have never ever in my life had acne. Ever. I am 52. And when I say acne let me assure you we are talking gigantic zits. Gross. My facialist at my dermatologist also noted my congested skin in general. review_text: I love fragrances in my skincare it makes the experience more enjoyable for me.. however, this moisturizer smells like LYSOL WIPES! It’s soooo bad, I had it on for a while but had to wipe it off bc the smell was making me gag. As a dumb teenager I experimented a lot with terrible cheap products and picked every pimple that popped up. Over the years, these mistakes left many many acne scars + dark marks. I was bummed and sad bc I accepted that they’d always be there. I was recommended this product by the skin consultant/specialist in store and I’m so glad I took her advice. Three weeks in and I’ve noticed a huge difference. So much that I decided to write a 5 star review after such a short time. The consistency is close to a light moisturizer, I use it after my serums and before my Biossance Omega Repair Moisturizer. My confidence in my skin has skyrocketed because of this product alone. It also helped clear up a breakout I had from stress (along w other great products). I feel 100% sure that my skin will be clear before the end of the summer/before fall. Please purchase if you’re looking to get rid of those acne scars for good! I will buy again and again. Disclaimer: I am African American, the skin consultant informed me that Niacinamide is more effective for ridding dark spots for melanated skin, rather Vitamin C (which is what I was using prior to). I put away all of my Vit C products, as the two shouldn’t be used together...they will cancel each other out and won’t work. Also don’t forget your SPF when using this product...or period! The pics attached are a few weeks apart.

When i got the product i was a bit confused on how to use it but when i read the instructions it turned out to be super easy. I used the daily expoliant for a few days and i loved it my skin has felt such a difference i love it. It was gifted by derm alógica sampling and i would definitely buy the full size
Absolutely love this stuff! A little pricey but worth it, absorbs easily, keeps my skin clear.

I tried this because of all the good reviews on the setting spray and I absolutely hated it. My makeup clumped up horribly and peeled off after not even an hour. I had dry looking patches all over my face. Definitely not worth the money!

Makes my moisturizer under it pill horribly and the glow it gives does not look natural. I have dry skin so I love glowy products but this just makes me looks sweaty. It was expensive so I will finish it up on boat/beach days when I don’t need to put anything over or under it and can wear it alone but I definitely won’t repurchase and don’t understand the hype.
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: I have mild rosacea and, after wearing this once, I crossed over into the not mild anymore category. This caused my rosacea to flare up to an extent that has never happened before. And it took 4 days to calm down and clear up. It’s a shame because I love a multitasking product, and this was moisturizing along with the sunscreen without being heavy.
product_name: Daily Dose Hydra-Ceramide Boost + SPF 40 Sunscreen Oil PA+++

review_text: So….this turned my under eyes pink, SUPER soft afterwards tho lol everything felt nice and hydrating, it just it dyed my under eyes pink. I’ve tried the pomegranate one, cucumber one, haven’t tried the coffee one yet. But every other one I have tried has not dyed my under eyes. So idk what happened with this one. A little upset, but it’ll come off. Besides the staining, it smelt nice, felt nice on and did what it was suppose todo, so bummed it stained. I wouldn’t recommend this one, but try the others!
I really didn’t like this. It left a thick film on my face that was hard to get off. I have tried many cleansing balms and oils and this was my least favorite.

I received Your Skin But Better CC Cream Oil-Free Matte with SPF 40 as part of a promotion from IT Cosmetics. I first was surprised by the color I received. I usually am a fair, but chose the light color due to the fact that I have quite a bit more tan from the summer sun. It is much darker than I would have thought or even than what is pictured on the box. I don’t wear a lot of makeup but even still this feels very heavy on my face. I love how much it is supposed to do (foundation, sunscreen, detoxify, anti-aging, etc), but it feels thick and oily on my face. I had to use a powder after application so it wouldn’t feel so tacky. I do love how well it covers and it hasn’t made me break out. I have very sensitive skin and it has not given me any bad reactions which is an A for me.
review_title: Love the coverage, hate the feel.

product_name: Premier Cru Dark Circle Correcting Eye Cream

For something that’s targeted towards sensitive skin, this broke me out like crazy. Little white head pimples everywhere. This was returned.

i really did wanna like these drops since i saw so many great reviews & i was super excited to try them. idk if its cause i’m naturally VERY pale as but unfortunately they did not work for me at all. before applying i exfoliated every INCH of my body to make sure i didn’t have any dry patches, i mixed the drops well with my moisturizer, & i made sure it was applied consistently & i made absolute sure i didn’t miss a single spot. for the first day maybe, i had a nice, golden glow. by the second day it was already fading, patchy, & inconsistent. the patchiness is especially bad on my neck, stomach, & under the boobs. now i’m left looking like a giraffe, desperately trying to get it off.

This is an interesting product for sure. I love skincare infused makeup products. This product has a lovely texture and it blends like a dream! I really enjoy the texture of it on my skin! review_text: Sadly, this one was not fir me. I found the consistency to thick, so it was sitting on my sling rather than soaking in. I also felt like it was drying my sensitive skin around my eyes. I ended up giving it to my sister.

I really love this oil cleanser as a first step in my double cleanse in my evening skincare routine. In both instances, I was wearing eltaMD spf, elf mattifying primer putty, hourglass vanish liquid foundation, Laura Mercier loose setting powder, CT airbrush powder, Natasha Denona Metropolis shadows, etc. In other words, I had a full glam face on! review_title: smells like BLUE CHEESE after a few uses!

product_name: Wake Up Honey Eye Cream with Brightening Vitamin C

review_text: This product has a very strong herbal/medicinal scent which can be off-puffing to some. This also reminds me A LOT of the Cerave moisturizer that comes in a tub. So overall I think save your money and get that one because they have identical textures and sink into the skin the same. This cream also pills like CRAZY so really be careful and try not to rub your face after applying because it will just slip right off. It’s still an ok cream just nothing that special.

I was always a fan of Mary Kay’s 3in1 facial cleanser, but found that it wasn’t sufficient at removing all of my foundation. This cleansing gel is the first I’ve used that is able to remove all traces of makeup. (I even use it on eye makeup in the shower with no irritation as long as I keep them closed.) I do have normal to dry skin and my skin feels a tad dry after use. This being said, it is not unbearable and isn’t anything a good moisturizer can not fix. I’m also a fan of Tarte’s drink of H2O hydrating boost, which I use afterward.
This is a very thick silicone cream. It doesn’t absorb and it tends to ball up under your fingers. It also causes breakouts. Like spreading wood putty on your skin.

It’s kinda pricey but I love it! I’m into my second tub. I still use facial wash after because I’m just used to doing it no matter what. Before, my routine is just facial wash and then toner. But then, the cotton ball picks up a lot of makeup residue even after washing my face. When I tried this makeup remover, it easily dissolves makeup and it’s not tacky. It’s nondrying too. It’s a bit tricky at the eyes though. It’s not irritating at all but some of it make the vision blurry if you don’t wipe carefully. Other than that I have no problems with it. After usage I checked if there’s still makeup and nope! All gone. But I still wash my face out of habit and because I’m more at ease when I wash my face. I feel completely refreshed and there’s no makeup residue. It doesn’t have any scent and the consistency just melts into skin like a cream even though it looks hard in the container.
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I bought this because Dr. Whitney Bowe recommended it and I thought it would work as well as drunken elephant baby facial mask works. It absolutely did nothing at all for my skin. Unfortunately. I will return.

review_text: I do not understand the hype behind this product, there are SO many better options out there. I was surprised at how harsh it was and left my skin feeling dry.

I have been using this product for a couple weeks and I have found that this product does a great job at keeping my lips moisturized and hydrated. It feels really similar to Aquaphor or Vaseline, so if you can’t afford the $20 I’d go for those options instead.

This cleanser will make your skin feel so fresh and clean. It has a light scent, and very gentle. Did not leave my face tight or dry. My skin felt soft after using it. It also removed my light makeup well. I would purchase again for a gentle every day cleanser!

review_text: Only good thing about it is the smell. It’s really not moisturizing at all, feels waxy, sits on top of the lips rather than penetrating moisture. This actually made my lips more dry, and made them peel. Won’t be buying again.

You need this. I need this. We all need this. A must for anyone who experience acne and acne breakouts.I read about these on Bazaar and decided to give them a try. I wasn’t too hopeful, because nothing really works on my breakouts... Benzoyl peroxide, salicyclic acid, whatever, it leaves the zits alone and makes the skin around them flake off.These are amazing! The amount of gunk these little circles pull out is unbelievable. I’ve used them on big, nasty pimples and it cut them in half overnight. I also put them on tiny one that were just starting to develop into whiteheads and it kept them from getting any bigger.
Can’t go anywhere without this!! This is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used, period!

When I received the VoxBox I was so excited to see what the hype was all about! Try not to be fooled by the shininess of this item because it is literally a flimsy shiny tube. This brand is advertised to be a luxury brand, but I did not feel anything luxurious with the product itself or even the packaging. I expected so much more.. Now, on to the review for the actual product. If your skin does not do well with fragrance, turn around and do not bother looking into this item. IT IS SO FRAGRANCED. I could not wait to wash this off of my face right away. If your skin does not like to feel tight or stripped after cleansing your face, this is not for you either. Even after using a cleansing balm, this stripped off everything on my face. This product left my skin so tight and dry before I could even pat my face dry.. I also do not understand why this is called a “gel-cream“ cleanser. THIS IS CLEARLY A LIQUID CLEANSER. Even after watching the demo from the advertisement, the product literally falls out of the tube without having to squeeze it. A little goes a long way and it lathers so much.If these are the things you look for in a cleanser, go and get it. Overall, this is a product that I would not recommend. It is pricey and I know that there are other cleansers out that are better. The only recommendation I would give for this product is to get a sample of it if you find yourself curious. Otherwise, just stick with your favorite cleanser.

review_text: I love using this mask! When I put it on, my face feels tingly, so I know it’s working. I usually leave it on for 20-30 minutes, and then I use a washcloth to remove it. I have tried just rinsing it off, but it would take a really long time to do so. So I just wet the washcloth with warm water, press it on an area of my face and then wipe the mask off. It’s pretty simple! I also recommend that you exfoliate after using this mask, since it brings all the gunk in your pores to the surface. I end by using a toner. I love the way my skin feels after using this mask though. My skin is SO soft it’s unbelievable! I have also suffered from acne for about 7 years now, and my skin has never looked or felt better. The tube is a decent size as well, so it will last you a while! I generally use it twice a week. DEFINITELY worth the price!

product_name: Irish Moor Mud Purifying Black Mask

review_text: I heard such great things about this but the day after I used this my skin was so dry, flaky, and irritated. My cheeks were so red and my skin honestly hurt. A lot of people swear by this though.

Just finished the bottle after using it daily for 2 months. When I started using the serum, I had some hyperpigmentation that had been on my face for about 2 months so I thought it would make a difference but being that I have hormonal acne and always break out, I began to get new marks and this still didn’t help. It has a thick tacky consistency that takes longer than usual to sink into the skin. But once it dried down, it didn’t mess with my other skincare steps.. Definitely wouldn’t repurchase or recommend.

I wanted to love this product SO BADLY. I love the idea behind it in terms of protecting again blue light as well as UVB/UVA like your typical sunscreen. The texture is very runny and spreadable, a little goes a long way.However, I have combo skin which can be on the sensitive side. I typically react best to mineral sunscreens but it’s so hard to find one that doesn’t leave a white cast. I decided I’d give this a shot!Within days I was breaking out all over my chin in small bumps and cystic acne. It never seemed to completely dry down on my skin either. I gave it a good chance, just incase something else in my routine was irritating me, in fact I used 2/3 of the bottle! It might be the non-mineral formula or it may be the various plant oils and extracts that irritated my skin, but sadly this product was not for me.I’m currently using a simple Eucerin mineral spf 30 that is doing the job until I can find something that includes some extra beneficial skin ingredients! I’ve used the Ordinary Ascorbic Acid Alpha Arbutin for a while, but I’ve always found that it oxidizes too fast, even when shut tight and stored in the fridge. I was getting good results and my skin reacted nicely to it, so I wanted to find something similar but more stable. Most other Vit C serums are combined with hyaluronic acid, which tends to break me out. Violet-C had great reviews and although I was concerned about the price tag, I decided to splurge and see for myself. Texture: The serum is not viscous at all. It is just slightly thicker than water so be careful when pumping it out. Scent: None that I notice. I have been using this for just over 3 weeks now (without the essence) and I’ve already noticed a big difference in my skin. It is definitely brighter and the discoloration/scarring has faded dramatically. I also love that it is combine with an AHA, which is really helping the texture of my skin. When my friend first told me about SK-II and especially this product I was highly skeptical, like a watery toner could ever provide enough long lasting effectiveness. Second, the effects, refines pores and fine lines, evens skin texture and helps absorption of other products, particularly serum. Third, works better in combination with the full range of SK-II products but also quite good when used alone. It is not THE most effect product in the SK-II range, for that I’ll default to the Repair C, but it certainly is a great preparatory base and you will notice the effects over time. Lastly, this is not for everyone. Let me be very very clear, some people’s skin flora and chemistry will not respond well to the active ingredients. Try a sample in a spot on your skin that gets sweatier when you are hot. If you don’t get fine pimples or bumps, try it all over your face.I like to use a few splashes into the palm of my hand and patted into my skin, neck and back of my hands day and evening. I would say this is best for all ages, particularly if you’re in your 20’s and 30’s and seeking to maintain well balanced hydration levels and even skin tone.I’m sure you’re pretty curious about what happened to my skin when I switched off of SK-II products. So was I, it was a mistake. My skin wasn’t as luminous, fine or well hydrated and I started developing fine lines around my eyes and forehead. I understand the cost of the complete regimen is quite prohibitive for some, for those, I would recommend that if you have either the SK-II essence or a serum in your skincare routine, you will find good results as well. Also, a little goes a very long way.

I received a sample of this from my local Sephora. I have sensitive, combo, and acne prone skin. Three days is more than enough time for my skin to react to a product.I have clear skin but sensitivities pop up as acne. My skin has stayed clear since using this. I don’t even feel cyst-like bumps forming under my skin, which I typically feel when my skin doesn’t like something. I don’t do well with coconut or coconut-derived ingredients so I’m assuming the caprylyl glycol in this is not coconut-derived. I don’t have a problem with squalane but some people do. Squalane is the third ingredient, so it’s possible that it’s squalane triggering acne for some people. Now for the product: My skin has been brighter and softer since using this. My existing dark spots haven’t disappeared yet. However, the small blemishes I got hours before starting to use this, they healed quickly and with no dark spots left behind. My skin feels supple but it has the tight feeling of dryness, especially on my cheeks and chin. When I exfoliated (italy towel), I noticed I got every single dry spot easily and without harsh scrubbing. Usually, I’m always left with some dry bits that refuse to come off. Caution: I do not use this product in the morning. It contains glycolic acid. Usually, AHAs should not be used during the day because of its ability to make skin increasingly photosensitive. Recommended use for AHAs is for night only AND sunscreen during the day. Feel free to reduce the use to 2-3x a week too (I plan to do this).I would recommend this product only if your skin can handle the ingredients. For the cost, it’s the best vitamin C product I’ve tried. I highly suggest using this only at night and not that often. And absolutely use sunscreen, even if it’s a cloudy day.

So my skin is dehidrated and feels tight and the moisturizer leave my skin greasy. Definitely not for me!

I was reluctant due to the price but I was getting desperate because I couldn’t get anything to cover my pores and age spots ...So I did it I bought this pack...Best skin decision I’ve EVER made! I’m telling you I was the poster child so to speak of LARGE PORES old acne scarring and 2 age spots that were driving me nuts! I now look 10 years younger after only 3 weeks. My skin GLOWS! I can honestly say Dr. Dennis Gross has changed my life!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Smell: it smells like orange creamsiclesTexture: cream/thickPackaging: eh nothing special, but no complaints.Drawback: I used this when my skin was oily/ combo w/ breakouts mainly in my t zone. Since the product consistency was so thick and heavy, I decided to use it under my eyes. I noticed the pores under my eyes looked bumpy and clogged. Needless to say, won’t be repurchasing

I stopped using this cream once and I’ll never stop again. You can find just about anything online that’s positive or negative about it though, and it can make your head spin into trying other things that may be “cleaner“—from its cult following of celebrity users who swear by it, to its too expensive, to it’s not clean (hello mineral oil), blah blah blah. Don’t do what I did and get caught up!! Do yourself a favor and just try it. It’s probably not for everyone’s skin BUT if you have a fair complexion and live in an extremely dry climate, this will become your holy grail. When I stopped using this cream, hormonal acne and rosacea started. I even went to a derm and was put on doxycycline for a couple of months. ZERO improvements in redness, acne, large pores, or pigmentation. After the round of antibiotics not working, the derm wanted to put me on more pills. I went home and decided to go back to basics. I had a small amount of La Mer I found in my drawer and was like ok, what do I have to lose. And boy, was I on the hook to become a lifelong user of this magician of a moisturizer. In about 15 days since I started using it again, all of the inflammation and redness from the rosacea is gone entirely. I had my monthly cycle and only got 1 cystic zit and zero inflammation/redness. The texture of my skin is improving, my pores are way smaller, and the hyperpigmentation on my cheeks is slowly starting to disappear with every use. I am a forever La Mer believer now and this cream will never leave my routine again!
review_title: La Mer is truly a MER-acle!
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: I liked the feel of this when it went on, but it left a film on my face in the morning and I had to wash it off. You get what you pay for, and there is a reason this is so inexpensive. I would not recommend.

worth every penny, looks amazing under makeup. perfect for winter and summer. It literally does it all (except SPF but no complaints here)

review_text: After using this peel last night, I wonder if some of the negative reviews are really based on personal experience or just wild assumption. I wowed again this morning when I was washing my face, which prompt me to write this review. Bottom line, the effect of this peeling gel is not in how many white balls it rolls off your face, it is in how your skin feels after using it. Of course several reviews mentioned that where the face has the most dead skin is where the white balls roll most, and that is also true. If you don’t believe the 5-star ratings, get a sample and test yourself. Another good thing about this gel is that it doesn’t irritate skin at all!

This Mask has genuinely saved my face! I started getting adult acne in my mid 20s out of nowhere (thanks grad school), and tried just about everything to get it to go away from Proactiv to Curology (for >1yr), and nothing really worked to clear anything faster or prevent new pimples from cropping up. I FINALLY found this mask while sifting through skincare in the Sephora app. I used the first jar pretty heavily, applying it every day for at least 20 minutes for a solid 7-9 days straight and then backed down to every other day. About halfway through that first jar my skin was BRAND NEW. Honestly I can’t overhype it enough. Before, my forehead was straight up cobblestone, even when I didn’t have big red pimples, it never felt or looked smooth. And now it’s incredible and perfectly smooth. I haven’t seen or felt my skin this smooth since basically pre-puberty Era (let’s get real though, it’ll never look or feel as perfect as it did when we were kids and couldn’t have cared less about it). But if you’re on the fence about this product and you’re struggling with adult acne (not sure about inflammatory acne-- it may react different) TRY THIS. You absolutely won’t regret it. I put it on right after the shower 3 days a week now, and just chill for 20 minutes while it dries on my face. The smell is pretty strong, but it’s fruity so I got used to it and enjoy it now. I do recommend following it with at least a light moisturizer afterwards but I haven’t found it dries me out super crazy without it.

review_text: thank you we searched the store over and decided this is the one. It is just what I was looking for. thank you.

product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

Loved the previous one I bought, I got a new one today by mail and the container was less than half!! Looks like 1 oz instead of 1.7oz.
review_title: Disappointing, container came in half empty
