I think it needs to be used for longer than one week for a true representation of what it potentially can do, however I do like the feel of my skin after using and my wrinkles seem a bit less evident.
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Cream

review_text: At first I liked this fine. A little slippery like a silicone-based primer, but after a couple of uses, I started to get little bumps all over my skin. I do have a slightly sensitivity to SPF and struggle to find ones that don’t do this to me. Will have to return...

I love anything that makes removing my makeup faster and this product does just that. The pump makes it super easy and fast to get the right amount out and gets my makeup off really well without irritating my skin.
product_name: Hydro Ungrip Makeup Remover + Cleansing Water

review_text: Clogged my pores so badly & left my face greasy. Really wanted to love it but just lead to really unnecessary tiny bumps all around my face. Especially my t-zone
product_name: C.E.O Glow Vitamin C + Turmeric Face Oil

review_text: I’ve been using this every 3 days or so for the past two months and am very pleased to see the brown spots on my cheeks and over the bridge of my nose fading. I’ve had them for years and nothing I’ve tried has worked until this. I use the a very tiny bit on only the spotted areas. I make sure to pat it in and let it absorb before I moisturize. I think it’s best when you use less.

I got a sample of this in my VIB clutch and after using it for about 2 nights, I fell in love with it. It goes on smooth without feeling oily and is very moisturizing. A little bit definitely goes a LONG way and I have barely even made a dent in my sample. I went online to see how much it was and was shocked to see that it was $90!!!! That’s pretty steep!!!! That is why I will only give it 4 stars... I’ll THINK about purchasing this when i finish my sample......

I love this product! I use a lot of different products on my face and this one stands out for sure. Silky smooth and sinks in quickly so it doesn’t leave any residue or anything. Love! Would def order again!
I like this more than the Moisturizer Bomb, but my face was dry again within a couple hours. This is definitely something I will not purchase again.

I’m a big fan of The Ordinary. This is one of my all time favorites I’ll always have on hand. I use it at night after my moisturizer. It helps keep my skin hydrated and overtime helps with acne scaring/dark spots. It doesn’t make your skin oily or break out as long you don’t apply too much.
product_name: 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Rose Hip Seed Oil

review_text: The refill instructions are a joke. They make it out to be a quick three step process but didn’t mention I’d have to remove a separate plastic piece from the lid (the piston) resulting in a significant loss of product from the refill as I pried the extra piston off the refill. I had to google the problem and found a video from the company that mentioned this very issue - suggesting they know about the flaw in their refill process/instructions but haven’t done anything about it. So irritating.
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: This product smells so amazing, just enough sweetness and pink hue to it, but unfortunately I realized I am allergic to this product. Not sure exactly which ingredient, possibly the perfumes. I would buy this again if it was more natural-based.
I found an insect in it this morning! Too disgusting!I’ll not use the facial treatment essence anymore
review_title: i found an insect in it

review_text: I really wanted to love this product. I ignored the negative reviews for a shallow reason--I really liked the packaging and the quantity. But sadly, the primary reason why I give this product a one star only is that the surface texture of the dot is like plastic--shiny and noticeable. On the plus side, I will say that it was very thin and in that way, could be flush to the skin. But I really didn’t like that it felt like plastic. I’ve tried other hydrocolloid products and for now I’ll be going back to my Alba Acne Dote--it is matte, feels skin-like, and disappears nicely on my skin. When I’m having a bad breakout, I don’t need anything else drawing attention to my face.

This product feels refreshing on a hot day. The texture is what you would expect, but it dries down in an unpleasant way. I prefer to use this product right before applying makeup as I don’t find it so so hydrating. I will say that after putting it on, my skin feels soft and smooth! (Please note, I reiceved this product for testing purposes. All opinions are my own.)

This does absolutely nothing for dark circles or fine lines. It did not brighten my eye area. The only plus is that it did not irritate my sensitive eyes and it absorbed quickly (foundation went over it smoothly).
product_name: Bye Bye Under Eye Brightening Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: I don’t understand how this has good reviews. It left my eye area red, flaky, and very irritated. It has been a few days since I stopped using it and my skin is still suffering.
review_title: Horrible!! Left my skin red and irritated
product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: Obsessed with it: such a great oil cleanser. It doesn’t make my skin dry at all.
It’s nice but I have tried better...not bad though, not bad at all

I have moderate cystic acne, so no spot treatment magically gets rid of breakouts overnight for me, but some do work better than others. These are by far the worst option I’ve ever tried. Not only do they not work, they don’t stay on well either. I wear patches like this overnight and I’ve never had an issue with them falling off until I tried this brand. Don’t waste your money.

This moisturizer was not good enough for me because it made my skin sting for some reason. It wasn’t good enough for me and I have more combo/oily skin. Plus this just made my face look shiny (not in a good way).

I have very sensitive, fair, acne prone and botchy skin and in a semi-arid climate. So I am always walking that fine line of wrinkle and acne prevention. Most products are either not hydrating enough (flaky even more red skin) or make my skin oily (and then I get zits!)Just a tiny amount of this silky smooth serum twice a day in the beginning helped my skin get to an appropriate level of hydration, then I cut back to once a day.My skin feels baby smooth and is luminous. I still have to wear foundation to hide my uneven tone, but my skin is definitely improving with the use of this product. Fine lines are reducing and I seem to get less acne too.Another bonus is that I use less night and day cream which is saving me money.Finally, I love that this is a natural product so not only does it make my skin look good but I feel good about this purchase too.Thank you Sephora for labeling these products so I can be a conscious consumer.
review_title: Look luminous and do something for the environment
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: I had a horrible experience with this product. My skin absolutely hated this and broke out like crazy. My dark spots got darker and I had random pimples pop up (and I don’t get pimples often). I don’t know why this happened, but I was very disappointed.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: Not as hydrating as it should be, and broke me out. hyaluronic acid is better in my opjnion, and leaves me skin more hydrated. Leaves an almost mattifying finish, and the packaging is very flimsy.

I’m loving everything about this product from the packaging to the product itself. The packaging is so pretty and the box is too. It is super moisturizing without being greasy. It smells so soft and nice.
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: great neck cream at a reasonable price. I was spending a fortune on neck creams until I tried this product. no need to spend north of $100 when Confidence in a neck Cream works just as well

I received a sample of this with purchase and was very disappointed. Firstly, it has an off-putting chemical smell and it didn’t do well in removing my makeup. I had lots of liner and mascara left. It also stung my eyes! I have used so many other cleansers that have no eye irritation. Another reviewer said they changed the packaging and possibly re formulated so I caution anyone interested to pick up the white bottle instead? lots of ppl seem to like it but this formula is no bueno!
review_title: save ur pennies and skip this

review_text: I really wanted to like this sunscreen, but it is sticky and hard to use. I feel like I have a mask on when I use it. I tried mixing it with b-hydra or the Marula oil, but the results are still the same. For a measly 30spf that is not water resistant, this sunscreen is greasy, uncomfortable, and looks horrible under makeup. I love Drunk Elephant, but this is a miss.
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: I had high hopes for this product because I saw all the good reviews. However I didn’t realize it had so much oil in it upon purchasing. Oily skin girls beware! I feel like this product made my pores noticeably bigger.

I recently took this on a trip along with another sunscreen. Whenever I used this one, I burned more quickly and with way worse affects. I was in the sun for the same amount of time each day and reapplied sunscreen around the same amount —unfortunately this one did NOT work. I was really looking forward to it, too.
product_name: Glow Oil Body Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: Really lightweight moisturizer, that melts on skin in water that I liked a lot. It leaves silicone like feeling after applying. I can’t say that I liked this one a lot but I won’t repurchase it as it wasn’t enough for my combo-oily skin. I hoped it will balance my skin throughout using but it only left feeling that I applied a primer. My oils produced like mad and this was not what I was expecting. A pass for me.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Not sure what to think about this product. I do deal with redness and this seemed to tone the redness down a bit but I felt like it also made my skin look a bit green! Or like it had a bit of a green tinge. Might be better suited for warm skin tones.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I’ve been using this serum for a couple days now and it’s noticeably been making my skin brighter and given it a really natural glow! I like that it’s really lightweight and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy even though there’s oil in the formula. I use it before I put on my moisturizer, and it’s been great for everyday use. They suggest 2-3 pumps but I really don’t need more than 1 (maybe 2).
review_title: Great for glowy skin in the morning!
product_name: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: This made my skin very bumpy and my pores became more enlarged and noticable. I’ve tried it twice in the last two years for a few weeks at a time and have gotten the same results each time.
product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate

review_text: I honestly don’t see any difference since using this product. I think it’s way too much money, forces you to use more than necessary with the packaging. Yes it is a bigger size than most creams, but I can use the amount I want with other creams. Since using this I’ve had pretty much the same skin texture as I had before. And not much more moisturizer . I have used many products of this brand and none love up to the money spent .

I was really excited to try the grapefruit one as I’ve been wanting to try a peeling mask and grapefruit sounded like it would be really refreshing! I was a little concerned about it being irritating (I’m always hesitant when it comes to citrus but I’m not sure that’s based in anything lol) but it wasn’t an issue at all for me. The scent is really yummy but not strong and can only really be smelled when applying and washing off. I would have enjoyed it if the smell lingered while wearing but it’s probably a good thing irritation/sensitivity-wise that it doesn’t. Another positive is the price—it says 5 uses but will definitely last longer. I tried using more product the second time but it didn’t make a difference.The reason for only 2 stars is that this is NOT a peeling mask and it doesn’t seem to do much of anything. I’ve used at least three times, waiting different amounts of time, using more or less product, with and without water, and no matter what it is impossible to “massage” the product or make it “peel”. Usually peeling products combine with the oil on your skin and the product balls up, gently removing dead skin cells. But this mask dries so fast that it creates a rubbery film that won’t budge, peel, or even rinse off without any sort of cleanser. It has what feels like little exfoliating granules but they just sit on your face since you can’t massage them around. I even tried using as a scrub cleanser and it just slipped off and left the same rubbery film. I also didn’t notice any brightening or polishing effects unless the rubbery layer is supposed to be a polish. Luckily it didn’t irritate my skin (except for the excessive scrubbing/washing) or cause me to breakout. Maybe those with oily skin will have better luck?So one star for price, half a star for smell, and half for not being irritating or causing breakouts.

This is a dire WARNING to anyone who wants to use this product. If you have even semi sensitive skin this product could possibly cause a chemical burn to your skin. This is not the worst looking this burn got. I actually Started to blister on my chin the same day I used this product and I am in so much pain. I just spent $80 on aloe lotion, petroleum jelly and hospital grade burn remedies. I could not sleep at all last night because my face was in fire. Luckily this was only on the bottom of my face since I wore a hat yesterday. But if you are even thinking this might irritate your skin run in the opposite direction. I am about to file a complaint with the company because I have never experienced such pain from a product in my life. And in my face is the worst part. I have never had skin issues before and I can only hope this does not scar my face. I am a Rouge Sephora member and I buy TONS of beauty products and have never had anything like this happen before. Hoping this warning and review at the very least can help prevent this from happening to someone else out there. It’s not worth the pain and uncomfortableness this will cause for the next week or so. #Supergoop

I was so excited when I saw this, it’s like my dream product (high physical spf, light coverage, no silicones) had come to fruition! Sadly, I don’t really like this. It’s super thick going on, and looked smeared and cakey with the normal amount of effort I put into blending a CC cream. I had to work harder, but after more blending and a few minutes to settle, it actually looks great. I have oily skin, and this doesn’t break up through the day on me which is impressive, but oh my god the way it feels on the face. Like you’re wearing paste. My hair sticks to it even hours later. Powder helps that part but somehow makes it look much worse. This is going back because I know I just won’t reach for it.
product_name: CC Screen 100% Mineral CC Cream SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: I love skin fix products. It’s summertime and I was looking for a light weight moisturizer. This one left my skin tight and dry. I like their other moisturizer better and will go back to that one. Will not repurchase this product. It also does not sit well with makeup, very patchy.
product_name: Barrier+ Skin Barrier Niacinamide Restoring Gel Cream

review_text: I wanted to like this product but I don’t. The sunscreen comes out in a powerful jet stream and not a mist at all. Once I rubbed it in it was sticky and uncomfortable. Smells like a normal sunscreen and nothing special. Hoping the mist is a defect although there are similar reviews. Also - The sunscreen was on my hands and I touched the black expiration date. Because of the oils it immediately wiped off so you can no longer see the date.
review_title: Not a mist. Would not buy.
product_name: PLAY Antioxidant Body Sunscreen Mist SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: I have always being a little nervous about face products specially because my face tends to be really sensitive! I was so excited when I received this toner on the mail from Influenster. Right off the back the product has a great smell, and after applying I can definitely feel my face soft. It’s like a coat of freshness for your face and it also has a delicate touch! Love It
product_name: Tonique Confort Re-Hydrating Comforting Toner with Acacia Honey

review_text: I really want to love it but it break me out. So disappointed.
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: I was so impressed with this product. It goes on cool, smooth, and gives a blurring effect on my pores. It lasts for several hours and makes my skin look flawless. I highly recommend it! Received complimentary.
product_name: Gradual Tan Watermelon Daily Firming Lotion

review_text: I like it a lot! I got this from the TRENDMOODxTatcha box, and it felt very nice! Very soft, and not as drying as some of the others I’ve felt. Doesn’t foam up as much as I expected, but feels clean.

I was so impressed with this cleanser (and the whole 3-step system) after just one use! I have sensitive, combination skin with fairly large pores and usually don’t put much stock into immediately visible results, but this cleanser-toner-hydrator system left my skin looking incredible, more even, and with smaller pores just after one wash. The cleanser has a nice minty fresh smell and sensation. Check out the non-filtered, no makeup shot I got after first use! I received this set as a complimentary free trial for review purposes. All opinions are my own.
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: I bought this product with high hopes as the employee who recommended it to me with his personal testimonial. I used it for a few months , 3 to 4 times a week. It did nothing to my skin. I continued using it in the hopes, but nothing. I’m guessing salicylic acid is not the winner for my skin.
product_name: Goodbye Acne AHA/BHA Acne Clearing Gel Face Body Spot Treatment

review_text: By luck my Sephora brought this to stores a few days early and I’ve gotten to use it twice since. Stings the tiniest bit but my skin was GLOWING for a full 12 hours after the first use. Leaves skin red for a few minutes after but nothing crazy.

After doing hours of research on creams, I decided to give this cream a chance. I have an oily t zone and I expected this product would help with my oily skin and improve the overall quality of my skin. I used this product on a daily basis as part of my facial cleansing routine. I kept using the cream expecting to see a difference in my skin but I received the same results. I only saw a slight improvement in my skin and the cream only lasted me a little over a month. The spoon located on top of the cream was helpful in getting the product out from the container because it would literally just slide off my finger. The product is overpriced and not effective for people with oily skin.
review_title: Did not significantly improve my skin

review_text: This product smells great and comes in a nice package. I put it on and there was a little tingling initially, but nothing alarming or painful. My issue is the grainy texture. I just don’t enjoy that. After 15 minutes, it came off easily with a damp wash cloth. My skin felt tighter but not dry. If texture is not an issue, I’d recommend this product. It does what it says!
product_name: Watermelon Glow Hyaluronic Clay Pore-Tight Facial Mask

review_text: This product is magic. I use it everyday. It makes my lips unbelievable hydrated and smooth. I’ve shown it to friends who are super particular about chapstick and they were blown away.
product_name: Rose Petal-Soft Deep Hydration Lip Balm

review_text: First, the packaging with Guerlain NEVER disappoints. It’s gorgeous and hefty. Second, the way my skin has been glowing after just a few uses blows me away. The smell is amazing and it feels great on my skin, never sticky. Will be purchasing this once I run out.
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Double R Advanced Serum

review_text: Used this oil for two months and did absolutely nothing for my skin. I have combination dry/oily skin.

I really was looking forward to trying this oil. I have sensitive skin, oily t-zone and my skin can get pretty dry. I really have never had a problem with blemishes. This oil causes me to have multiple whitehead pore clogs whenever I use it. I am a high end skincare product junkie-- this just doesn’t do anything for my skin. Sephora carries other much more hydrating products with more bang for your buck than this product.
review_title: not all it's cracked up to be

review_text: This has youthfull ingredients which is great but at the same time sodium benzoate and methylparabens. That stuff should be taken out. Period.

I have used this for just over a month now and I have to say that I did not enjoy it. It didn’t do anything special and it made my skin feel textured. I will be returning ASAP (the reason I didn’t in the first place is my mom was testing it as well and she didn’t like it either.)

I’ve been using this for about 5 months. Did absolutely nothing for my skin, it smells nice but its basically like smothering water on your face. It doesn’t have a mister either, so the experience is not pleasant and if anything this is very acidic feeling and sensitizes skin. When I stopped using this my skin started looking smoother. There is much, much better skincare out there
product_name: Truth Barrier Booster Orange Ferment Vitamin C Essence

review_text: I already tried the Clinique Gel because I have combination skin and I loved how quickly it absorbed but I still had dry patches on my face. So I tried the lotion - unfortunately it made me break out almost immediately and never felt like it absorbed at all. If my skin was less problematic / oily / acne prone then I bet this would be great for my dry skin but for now it’s not for me.

I received a couple of 100 point perk samples of this product, used them and liked the product. I have tried to purchase the regular size of this product two times now. Both times I have had to return the product because the opening that dispenses the product has not been properly die cut out. This is sealed shut and it’s a poor manufacturing/design feature. I’m not going to keep purchasing and making a second trip to return this product. On to the next thing.

The Origins charcoal mask is good, but not incredible. After reading the reviews, I thought this mask would work wonders on my nose blackheads, but I haven’t noticed any significant change so far (I have been using the mask twice a week for almost a month now).I also noticed that every time I apply the mask to my skin I feel a temporary burning sensation. Thus, I think people with sensitive skin might need to watch out for this. Even though my blackheads are similar, my skin gets really smooth after using this mask. That is a positive point.
product_name: Mini Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pore

review_text: I am really loving this facial oil. It is not irritating to my sensitive skin. I do feel like it makes my skin feel brighter and more hydrated. And the scent? Obsessed! I love light fresh citrus scents, so it is perfect to me! You will love this step in your facial care routine!
product_name: Sunshine Vitamin C + Squalane Face Oil

review_text: I didn’t see any changes in my pimples after using these. The only up side was it prevented me from touching my face. I have purchased other products from PTR that I love but this one is a dud.

So I have darkness around my eyes and I’ve always heard people say eye cream is a waste of money... It’s not. I will never not buy this, I see a difference after just a couple days of using this. Amazing.

I have no clue why this product has such a high rating. I have oily skin but I honestly don’t feel this doing anything for my skin. It’s like throwing creamy water on my skin. Hahaha. Luckily I just had a sample of it and didn’t want any money on it. Worthless!
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I was so excited to receive this product after so many good reviews, but after about 2 weeks of consistent use I’m disappointed. My normal combination skin is dryer than ever and peeling in odd places (aka under my eyes and jawline) After applying a generous amount, my face is soft, but feels like I need to put on two more layers because it soaks in so fast. I do like the texture and the consistency of the product, I just wish the “up to 72 hours“ part was true.

I think this lotion has MANY uses and is extremely soothing. I have used it on sunburns, razor burns and bumps as well as other minor skin irritations, and as a simple after shower moisturizer. I love it. I was unsure at first so I bought the travel size.... I was so sorry I didn’t get the full size! (I immediately purchased the full size as soon as my travel size was gone)! Just be sure to really rub the product entirely into the skin.... I noticed when I applied it heavy to my sunburn, it kind of pilled up, but didn’t have that problem on the second application when I rubbed it completely into the skin.
I bought this for fine lines. It didn’t help at all. Very disappointed!
product_name: TL Advanced  Tightening Neck Cream PLUS for Firming & Brightening

review_text: Love this face wash! My skin has been well exfoliated since using this product, and I feel like my skin is smoother and brighter than before. Super easy to rinse off and takes away the dirt and makeup leftover from makeup wipes!
product_name: Nomad’s Cream Purifying & Exfoliating AHA Cleanser

review_text: I’ve been using this for about 2 weeks and have yet to decide if I’ll go forward with it. I like the idea of the vitamin C and antioxidants, but wasn’t left feeling refreshed or rejuvenated. My skin did feel clean and not “stripped“ as with other toners. Still, I’m not sure if its worth the price.

Heard a million things about GlamGlow and definitely can’t afford to spend so much...this seems to be second best! I have sensitive acne prone skin and this mask definitely helped. Didn’t clear everything up but it did help around my chin, which is my problem area. It’s not too expensive and it lasted about a year for me only using it twice a week.
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I loved this product.... until it separated into an oily mess. It happened once right away and thought it was a fluke, now the second one just started a month or so later. So disappointed in the quality.
product_name: Mini Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: This product was recommended to me and I was very excited to use it. At this point, I feel like toner is a necessary part of my morning routine and have tried out many. This toner didn’t have much of a smell (which I prefer), but made my sensitive skin burn and even more sensitive. I decreased my usage to only twice a week thinking that may help if I was just over-exfoliating my face but it didn’t make a difference. It also left a sticky residue on my skin which just made me want to wipe it off before putting on lotion. I got through about 3/4 of this bottle and dumped the rest down the sink this morning.
Super small package, not a lot if wipes, not very moist and doesn’t really do anything.

After a week of using, the product feels like its tightening my skin and drys every time I use it. It was a great wash the first week but then just started to really show a different texture after using it for a few weeks. I have normal skin and it even made my skin feel overly dry, can’t emphasis that enough.

After using this product for a week I was in love! It applied to my skin smoothly and it felt hydrated it was everything I could’ve asked for!! I guess the problem comes with the product being too thick I’m not sure, but I started to notice little bumps all over my cheeks. I didn’t think it was the moisturizer until I read the reviews. I hope I can return it tomorrow. I have sensitive skin I normally have oily skin but with fall being here it has been under control. I’m on the fence about trying another moisturizer from this brand especially being the price it is.
product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F

review_text: The consistency of the mask (creamy, bright pink) becomes dry, as if you have put your face in the healing mud on a sea shore and it has dried up in the sun ( the consistency changes from ‘wet’ to ‘dry’ fairly quickly, so don’t keep it on for too long !). Before removing the mask, spray your face with Caudalie Grape Water (or rosewater...or just water) and then wash the mask off with a clean muslin cloth and warm water to reveal a rejuvenated complexion that will hopefully draw a smile when you look at your reflection in the mirror. I tend to spray my face with Grape water again, let it dry and then apply my usual serums, moisturizer or face oil, completing my weekly deep cleanse skincare routine.
The cleanser works great but the artificial crayon-like smell is terrible.
review_title: Terrible smell but a good product otherwise

review_text: This serum is so light, it literally feels like water. It feels very hydrating as soon as you apply it, and it works well layered under moisturizer. I’ve been using in the AM and PM and my skin looks overall more supple and glowy. It’s only been a couple of weeks but I’m excited to track results after using for a bit longer.
product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate

review_text: Didn’t do anything for my skin (dry). Tried to use as a primer for foundation and foundation ended up looking patchy
Great for people with sensitive skin and combo skin. Was extremely good as a layering base serum and did well with other brands.
product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

review_text: Light weight, very little fragrance - this essence was gentle and felt expensive!

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I had really high hopes for this product, but I’ve been somewhat disappointed. In fairness to the product, I’ve only been using it for about 3 weeks, when 12 weeks is recommended. It is a very mild Retinol. It was recommended 1-2 pumps 1-2 days per week to start, followed by moisturizer. I was easily able to use it 4 times per week with no irritation. However, I do not like the smell. It is a bit mildewy and the smell lingers for a while after you’ve applied it. I have also not noticed any changes in my fine lines and dark spots. As I said above, I haven’t been using it for the full 12 weeks, but I expected to see some difference in a product at this price point. I will edit this post if I see better results in a few weeks, but right now I’d only give this product 2 stars and that’s mainly because it’s very gently on the skin.

This product has so many good reviews so I had to try it....thankfully I got a smaller size because I don’t love it. It does foam nicely but I don’t think it does much to improve my skin. Since I started using this I have had more breakouts on my chin then ever and I normally have very clear skin.

review_text: Way too orange for my fair skin tone, Might work for darker tones but not fair.

review_text: I don’t feel this did anything for me. I wouldn’t use this again.

I had zero expectation of it actually reducing dark circles or puffiness. But I don’t even think it’s moisturizing at all. I was told about this product in the store, but I didn’t purchase it because I didn’t need a moisturizer at the time. I am in love by day 2 of using this eye cream I seen results I’m now a month in.. review_text: I used at least 6 of them for full size, for years. I think it’s useless for me, probably because I have pretty fair tone skin. product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum

review_text: Read all of the reviews and was really excited for this product. It felt pleasant during but after I didn’t see any difference in my acne. I thought this was going to work but it didn’t.

review_text: It peels I have only used it once. Dissatisfied with the product

product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: It works to remove stubborn waterproof mascara (why I bought it), but I found it really irritating to my eyes - makes them cloudy and red/teary and leaves oily residue all over my contacts when I put them in the following morning.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Best Exfoliating cleanser I have ever used, love have my skin feels after I use it.

product_name: Alpha Beta Pore Perfecting & Refining Serum

review_text: I got this in a sub box and only recently started using it. I only need a little with my foreo, and it foams up, removes all makeup and doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight.

I’ve been taking just two a day for over a year, and I can definitely tell when I run out and stop taking this. I break out! They smell a little funky, but not a big deal. I love what they do for my skin.

review_text: smell so good, soft and subtle

Plus, the company sells refills for the jar which cuts down on waste (and cost).

review_text: This was okay. Nothing special here. Wasn’t particularly hydrating, didn’t really do anything amazing or special. Not worth the price tag. It was light and thin consistency and didn’t irritate my sensitive skin.

review_text: Terrible! It felt so slimy on my skin and it was so thick that it could barely get out of the tube. When I finally squeezed some out it felt like I was spreading butter on my skin. Would not recommend.

Each bottle lasts me about 14 months, so it is totally worth the price.The cleanser gives me such soft skin, people come up to rub my cheeks. Its gentle enough to use every day (even though it says not to) I can’t help it, it makes my skin so soft & clean. Love It.

This DE moisturizer is by far a favorite of mine. I’ve always struggled to find a good, clean, moisturizer that will not make my skin (more) oily. This right here is it. It’s completely worth every penny spent on it.

I have combination skin that’s not really sensitive, but for me, this didn’t work well. I tried it out for a month and in the beginning it was alright (it absorbed quickly, was light and nongreasy), but over time I found that I started getting little bumps under my eyes. When I discontinued using it, the small bumps went away. I was disappointed with this product.

I’ve received LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm complimentary and been testing it for quite a while now so I could write an honest and unbiased review based not on the first impression, which is usually interfered by the excitement from the newcomer, but on a candid opinion. Though, my first impression coincides with all the following ones – this product is amazing! The balm comes in a cute squeezable tube in the color that matches the scent. It’s available in four different flavors. I got mine in Berry and it smells delicious! It reminds of candy or soda – sweet and mouthwatering. Besides, the smell lasts on the lips for some time and it even makes the breath fresher. The beveled applicator allows making precise application and touch-ups on the go. The formula is quite thick but non-sticky. It glides smoothly on my lips and leaves a high-gloss finish. Also, I’ve noticed a cooling effect, which is quite nice. Surprisingly, staying power exceeds what I’d expect for a balm. Although after eating/drinking it requires reapplication, it still looks quite presentable. The balm doesn’t migrate into the surrounding lip area, it just fades away delicately without leaving any flakes or white lines. After application, the fine lines become less visible and the chaps ache less and in the aftermath, heal. It looks as if the balm kind of seals the lips. I believe in this way, it locks in moisture. Its hydrating formula gives a long-lasting effect, so my lips look and feel soft, hydrated and smooth not only right after the use of the balm but for a while longer. Moreover, the LANEIGE Balm protects lips from such weather elements as cold, heat and wind.As this is a color-saturated lip balm with a glossy finish, it gives the illusion of plumper and more kissable lips. It will suit and flatter any skin tone and ambiance. It can be used as a primer to prep the lips for smoother and more even lipstick application and as a topper to add a glossy finish to the lip color. I absolutely love it!

I like this mask a lot! I love the way it feels while it’s on, it’s definitely got a cooling sensation to it. product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: Fantastic! My lips are chronically dry and peeling. I used this before bed not thinking it felt great on my lips but still skeptical. Woke up with perfectly hydrated plump lips!! It’s now part of my nighttime routine and I put a little bit on in the morning so my lips stay hydrated through the morning!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I mainly got this because I needed something to fade hyperpigmentation on my cheeks. It does brighten and it really is an overnight facial in a jar. If you have acne-prone or combination skin, beware. A few small blemishes popped up after using this. It was nothing to freak out about but with consistent use it possibly could’ve gotten worse. Overall good product, just not for me. I’m going to try the pomegranate moisturizer for daytime and see if that works better for me.
Overall, this is great! I liked the light fragrance and I think it works well as a cleanser, but I wouldn’t recommend this to ppl with super dry skin.

Honestly I’m disappointed in this product. I read the review and expected it to be amazing, it wasn’t... My skin didn’t feel any different than when I use much less expensive products. I will definitely not be buying this again.
Best at-home face, no contest! Smooths, corrects uneven tone, heals & prevents breakouts. Makes me GLOW!!The only issue I have with it is the price, for $85 you should be more than 30 apps.
review_title: Awesome, awesome, awesome!! DO NOT discontinue!!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: did not work for my skin at all... tried several different ways...

review_text: I’ve only been using this product for a few weeks now and I love how it makes my skin feel. It does not leave my skin dry or oily and also has a great smell.
product_name: Calendula Deep Clean Foaming Face Wash

review_text: This is a beautiful face oil. I love to use it at night after I put on my face lotion. It is great for an extra kick of hydration. Wish it wasn’t as pricy, but I understand why. I have yet to be disapointed in any drunk elephant products!

I was so excited about trying this product because I wanted to minimize my pores. It was gentle enough on my skin and I love the scent of it. I’ve been using it for a couple of days and I’ve seen a smaller number of pores than usual. I would like to buy this with my own money in the future.
product_name: Watermelon Glow Hyaluronic Clay Pore-Tight Facial Mask

review_text: I have been using this every morning, and now my husband does too, and we both love it! Great natural vitamin c

I got this as a free product from Influenster. It smells great, feels soft and is incredibly hydrating. I have sensitive but oily and acne prone skin but was able to use it every day, I love it as a night cream. My skin feels great!

i love this moisturizer!! the ingredients list is gorgeous first of all. second, it’s super lightweight but it hydrates like a thick cream. it also feels kind of balmy/waxy which i really enjoyed. definitely notice less dullness and an improvement in dark spots and hydration!
product_name: Rich Bitch Cactus + Vitamin C Moisturizer

review_text: really disappointed in this face wash. You have to work really hard to get it to lather and the quality does not match up to the price
product_name: Crème Radiance Gentle Cleansing Creamy-Foam Cleanser

review_text: I was shocked at how much I loved this. My skin is super oily so the name “glow” normally would’ve sent me running for the hills. A small amount goes a long way and it is incredibly hydrating. I wear it under my makeup and I feel like it helps my make up stay on longer.
Pretty spendy, but it does help my skin. I notice it glows more, looks more even and bright! I really do like this, but would almost prefer my Ahava oil.
product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

review_text: Burned my eyes after one use I had to wash my face. Would not even try if you have sensitive eyes. I’m not always sensitive and this was the worst thing I have put near my eyes.
product_name: That Fresh Take Eye Cream with Peptides

review_text: I received this product for free and was very excited to try it because I love Tatcha products. As always, the packaging was beautiful and the product felt very luxe. I would recommend wearing this product at night as it became extremely greasy when I wore it during the day. It was very thick and balmy and I don’t think it made much of a difference in my bags or fine lines.
product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream

review_text: Like a few other reviewers I put it no where near my eyes but it’s so greasy it migrated there and it really does burn. So happy I didn’t waste money on it , as it was just a mini size that came in the sun safety kit
product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45

review_text: I loved this product, it never turned on me as I used it everyday so I remain unsure as to why they reformulated it, Mathew mixing is annoying but doable, but it results in basically really liquid bubbles that I don’t think are doing what they’re supposed to anymore. I adored the original version, but I won’t be be buying this again, I’m diss appointed because this was my holy grail but no more!
I had such high hopes for this product but it just didn’t live up to all the hype. The blackhead stops did nothing for my blackheads and the pore strips made me more oily. Don’t waste your money!
review_title: If I could give it no stars I would!

review_text: I am always looking for the best clean SPF for daily use. I purchased this one for my husband to use every day since it is listed as sheer and had a good price point. It is important to note that it is actually tinted. When it goes on, it sits on top of your pores and did not give the blurring effect that others mentioned. Overall, decent sunscreen but not the best clean sunscreen I have tried. I gave it 4 stars because of the value for the cost compared to other clean sunscreens.
review_title: Good Value for Price - But Not the Best
product_name: Sunvisor Radiant Moisturizing Face Sunscreen SPF 35

review_text: I tried this when a friend was over and I could see a difference in my skin the next morning. I immediately went and bought my own! I’m on my 2nd jar and I still love it. It’s hydrating and calming to my skin. I will definitely repurchase again & again!
product_name: The Afterglow Deep Moisturizing Cream with Hyaluronic Acid & Vegan Collagen

review_text: This is certainly not worth the high price tag. The stars are for the product aside from price. It’s kind of thick going on but doesn’t feel greasy or heavy. It left a protective layer but I did not feel that it moisturized long term as well as products that are a fraction of the price and the texture is glue-y. French drugstore brands are far more effective. This also has a PAINT smell which i am surprised not more people have mentioned. It’s celebrity endorsed and somewhat unique feeling I suppose, but it’s pretty ho hum to be honest. If you’re gonna throw down that kind of cash you could have multiple high quality actives as opposed to a bougie face cream that’s not really amazing.
product_name: The Cream with TFC8 Face Moisturizer

review_text: I superdeedooper love this. I dont know that sorbet is the right consistency. More like Yoplait Whips yogurt...kind of moussey but just as delicious. Medium moisturizing all-purpose face lotion. Not as light as Glow Recipe Pink Watermelon Juice but not as thick as Herbivore Pink Cloud Cream. Has no discernible scent.

Seems to be doing a great job at cleaning the dirt and oil off of the face, would definitely recommend. FYI, I have sensitive combination dry/oily skin and tend to react to products easily but no adverse reaction whatsoever from this!
This looked great on my skin, no white cast and it blended in great. Unfortunately, I still sunburned while wearing this.
product_name: Zincscreen 100% Mineral Sunscreen Lotion SPF 40 PA+++

review_text: This serum smelled great. It worked well as well. I think it was a good value, not too pricey. For an expensive brand, you are definitely getting your moneys worth as it works great! I received this product for complementary from Influenster

This is pretty pricey for such a small container but boy does this make my lips super soft! It just melts in like butter. When I first put it on I noticed a cool, tingling feeling. I put it on a couple hours ago and it’s still there!

I really wanted to light this. Unfortunately, the color did not match at all and the consistency was horrid. Surprisingly thick and heavy, which I didn’t expect based on how light their sunscreen is. Will be returning and just sticking to their sunscreen from now on.
product_name: CC Screen 100% Mineral CC Cream SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: While its a good moisturizer, its not worth the exorbitant price. There are plenty of other anti-aging moisturizers on Sephora.com that are equally good and much cheaper. This product has some highfalutin stuff discovered in some SF lab and it all sounds like a cool story from a movie or something but I don’t think I saw any noticeable changes after using this product.
review_title: Too pricey for what it does

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Dermalogica. This was a wonder product. I loved that it started off as a powder. It was super easy to use. It did my face wonders. I felt like my skin was so soft and smooth. It also cleared up my face a bit.

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment

review_text: The packaging of this moisturizer is very chic. I love that this moisturizer is super hydrating and does not leave a white cast on my face or oily residue as compared to other SPF moisturizers. Little to no scent, which I love and perfect for sensitive skin. Makeup glides right on when applied!
product_name: Essential Energy Hydrating Day Cream Broad Spectrum SPF 20

review_text: This is one of the best balm cleansers Ive used. I started using oils and balm and the first line of cleaning to remove makeup and this green clean is one of the best I have used. It melts away the eye makeup even waterproof(mostly). I then use a clay based cleanser or clarisonic after that for deep cleaning.I have combo skin and don’t have a problem with it over drying my skin or leaving it oily.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I wish I had gotten the sleepmask in black instead of pink since one of my main concerns is that the products stain easily on the silk. Got this from Sephora as my birthday present and this is the best Lip mask I have ever used. Works on my lips just in one day. Will order again whenever finishes.HIghly recommended
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This is a great product for every day use under moisturizer and makeup. A little goes a long way otherwise it can get kinda greasy. I spend a lot of time traveling in brazil and it keeps my fair skin free of sun damage.
product_name: City Block Sheer Oil-Free Daily Face Protector Broad Spectrum SPF 25 Primer

review_text: Doesn’t even hydrate your skin!!!!!!!!! My skin is dry and flakey and well this did make my skin look okay but it was just a layer. I didn’t feel hydrated, I felt dried. Don’t recommend this at all so save your money and buy something else that will actually hydrate your skin.

I read about it in an article on ’What to steal from your boyfriend’s medicine cabinet’ (or something like that). Anyway, I think I ordered it that day. This stuff is amazing! Tastes great :) has an excellent SPF and really hydrates my lips. Couldn’t be better.

I purchased the Mild for my combination skin. This is certainly good enough to wash away makeup and oils, but I think it strips my skin of it’s natural oils because afterwards my face is red and irritated, it usually takes a day to calm down. I don’t want to waste money with the extra mild and risk the same reaction.
product_name: All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap

review_text: This oil is so hydrating without being oily. It has really helped my skin through the winter months.

It’s almost like a balm, but not as emollient as most eye creams. For a retinol product it’s very gentle. I can’t wait to see my results after using for a few weeks.
All day moisture for my dry skin, and is fantastic for blurring under eye fine lines.

Pros: smell good, may faintly see the difference in complexion.Cons: by far the worst package ever. I probably have 1/3 left and barely can take it out. Considering the cost of it.

i absolutely love this product. at first, i think it caused my skin to purge a little bit, but i was kind of expecting that so i wasn’t too worried about that. after like a month or so of continued use every other night, i have noticed a huge difference in my skin. this product helped clear up the little underneath-the-skin acne i was having due to another product. and, i have noticed that this product does wonders for dark spots. i’ll put this on at night, and when i wake up at least one of my dark spots is completely faded, and the rest of my hyperpigmentation has faded. even with the hefty price tag, i think i would repurchase. if you’re having really stubborn skin texture and pigmentation, i would recommend giving this product a fair shot.
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I got this as a gift for Christmas and was super excited to try it. I have VERY red skin and have been searching for years to find ways to combat it. This did the trick but only for an hour or so. It didn’t fully cover up my redness and left a weird hue to my skin. I found if I used just slightly too much it’d start piling up. My skin is VERY oily and it almost made my shine worse while also “melting” off my skin at the end of the day (in some areas you could tell where the product was combating my redness and where it had faded.) For someone with minor redness this might work, but I was less than impressed.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I don’t see how they are allowed to claim “smooths skin, tightens pores...“ because clearly it is just a spritz of revitalizing oil that tingles slightly. That’s it! Other than that it is DEFINITELY not worth $50 for the larger size. NOT WORTH YOUR MONEY and don’t believe that it provides the instant burst of radiance as claimed.
product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist

review_text: In all fairness, I am sensitive to smell, but this is too much for me. I was only able to use it a couple of days because it was too bothersome.

This entire line is extraordinary. This calmed my daily redness problems immediately. I HIGHLY recommend using a toner after this (I use the mildest one), then the Dramatically Different gel moisturizer. The toner exfoliates, and the gel prevents your pores from getting clogged by the moisturizers. The daily moisturizing cream is my favorite step. You will see immediate difference with this line.

This self tanner is AMAZING! It’s easy to apply (I used a mit which I strongly recommend to reduce streaks and to keep your hands clean), it looks natural from day one and fades in a subtle way just as a real sun tan would. The color is not overly dark, so if you’re looking for a dramatic tan, you will not achieve that color in one application with this product. I really like the shade, it looks like I’ve been in the sun for a whole afternoon. The color lasts about one week, and gradually gets lighter and lighter, I can’t believe how natural this looks. I’ve been reapplying weekly, and it goes on just as well as the first time.If you’ve never used St. Tropez before, just be aware that when you apply it, it has a subtle green tint to it, but that is temporary, after the tan develops and you shower the green is gone. One very slight drawback is that I did notice it dried my skin out a bit, nothing that applying lotion couldn’t fix, and besides, when you use self tanner you need to exfoliate and hydrate anyway, so normal maintenance.I 1000% recommend this for a natural, subtle tan.

This was a product I was excited to try as I have had good experiences with other products in the line. However, this was a nightmare for my face. I broke out overnight both times I tried to use it. In addition to the acne, I don’t feel like this did anything for the surrounding skin - it appeared the same as it always does. I almost never return products but this went back to Sephora - it was awful for me.
product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask

review_text: Great product, really helps keep my face moisturized. I use it as a night cream, put a little on before bed and just wash off in the morning, makes my skin feel soft and refreshed. Definitely recommend this!

The best makeup cleanser ever! I do use Origins to do my second cleanse after but this is perfect for acne prone skin and have noticed a change in the texture of my skin after using it at night to remove makeup.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Got this as a part of their holiday brightening kit and it broke me out so bad. Such a shame, I heard so many good things about what a great serum it is.

Makes my face feel tight and dry. Maybe not the best for dry skin.

Ilia should remove it from their lineup as it is way overpriced and not on par with the quality of their other products.

product_name: Vinopure Natural Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Toner

review_text: I’ve tried numerous cleansers, having sensitive skin most products were too harsh or too heavy. First Aid Cleanser is a delightful & refreshing cleanser that gently cleans with no residue or harsh after affects. Leaves my skin with no irrations, just beautiful

Huge fail and waste of a 100 points.

Made me break out really badly :/ would not repurchase, and unfortunately won’t be finishing the bottle I bought.

review_text: Good product, leaves the skin feeling smooth but it does stay on all night for me. It’s like my skin absorbs what it camand in the morning there’s still a smooth film of this stuff on. Lol no I got a sample of this and the Inkey list is better and 1/1,000,000 of the price. Approximately.

I tried this product and I love it! I love how the exfoliation makes my skin feel so smooth and clear. Would definitely recommend!

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I really wanted to love this product. I have loved JLo’s “Glow“ perfume for years & excited to try her new line. The packaging is gorgeous! That gold really makes it feel like a luxury product. PROS: I really love that the mask is 2 piece. I personally haven’t seen that before for masks. I also liked the concept of the ear loops to hold in place. I HATE trying to do a face mask & it falling off, this mask didn’t! The texture of the fabric is easy to smooth on and soft.CONS: As soon as the packet is ripped open the sake smell hits you in the face. I enjoy sake, but the overall smell wasn’t appealing. I’m not sure if that’s what’s supposed to give it the glow, but I’m not a fan. And my skin hasn’t felt like this mask improved anything and leaves an annoying stickiness after removing that sticks around for a while since it doesn’t absorb.

review_text: LOVE these so much! I tried these for the first time and I’m beyond impressed. I had a cystic blemish forming on my cheek near my nose, used these, and the next morning it was completely nonexistent. Only a slight tingle (I’m used to acids and use almost everyday)
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This product had a weird smell did not see any bright big results I would not recommend this product to any one there are definitely better drug store products much cheaper that work better pixie glow tonic .

You can do better for your money. Doesn’t provide enough hydration for my dry, sensitive skin. Also needed like a pump and a half to sufficiently cover my face. It does not last very long, and you can’t tell how much is left in the bottle, so you get a nasty surprise when it runs out! I do like that it’s not fragrances and the dispenser on the bottle is cool. Just wouldn’t buy again because there’s better out there for less.
product_name: B-Hydra Intensive Hydration Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I think this works judging off of the rave reviews. However, the consistency of the product did not work well with the rest of my products in my skincare routine. So, basically it would just dry up and roll off my face. It does not layer well. I tried adjusting the amount I was using and waiting for it to dry before applying next step- and still same thing. I swapped for the INKEY version and that problem was gone.
review_title: Good product, just not for me and my routine.

review_text: Nicely package but that’s about it. It made my face so greasy. Like unbearably greasy that I had to wash my face again during the day. But you know, I stuck with it for two weeks to see if it’ll get better. It didn’t. And it made me breakout. Probably because I was using it in conjunction with the Fresh soy face cleanser. I have combination skin so maybe it’s just not suited for me.

After the first application I woke up and had bumps everywhere and I usually don’t react like that to new moisturizers. Thought it might be stress so tried it one more night and it just got worse. Everything puffy, bumps all over, and just painful. Returned immediately and went back to Drunk Elephant polypeptide moisturizer.
product_name: ICE Ceramide Moisturizer with Vitamin F

review_text: This facial mist is very lightweight and smells good, but overall it didn’t really do much for the quality of my skin. It feels nice to mist it over my face as a part of my skincare routine, but it’s not very hydrating and it doesn’t even leave a glowy finish. Although I really like how the ultra-fine mist feels (and it dries really quickly), unfortunately I can’t vouch for any kind of results. It does not hydrate as advertised, and it’s not strong enough to function as a primer or setting spray for makeup. Definitely not worth recommending, especially since you get a super small amount for such a high price. Additionally, the bottle that I received leaked a lot, so I couldn’t bring it with me while traveling.
review_title: Very expensive price for very little results

review_text: I have been using this product for 2 weeks , and have noticed a smoother texture to my skin, but not so much a fine line or wrinkle reduction. I would not say this is a rapid wrinkle reducing night serum, but will continue to use the rest of the bottle and modify my review if my results improve.
product_name: Retinol Fast-Release Wrinkle Reducing Night Serum

review_text: It was just ok. It smelled great and was nice to use but it’s very overpriced for what it was. The pump is also terrible. It kept leaking so I lost probably 1/4 of the product.

Got this with points based on the reviews to try before purchasing a full size. It was just ok, the hype was so huge that i expected it to be a game changer. At first it does feel very hydrating and soft but it dries up so quickly that my morning it the area i apply it to is so dry that it feels like i washed my hands and didnt apply lotion. Lots of other products out there that do what this claims

I thought the idea was fun to mix up your own serum with the powder and serum base; however, my skin did not like this serum. This serum irritated the corners of my mouth and around my lip area and it gave me little forehead bumps. I was so excited to receive this, but unfortunately did not love this one. I usually LOVE Drunk Elephant products, but this was a no for me.

This eye serum absolutely works like it says it does! After using for several weeks, the most noticeable difference was in my “11“ lines, which significantly relaxed. Additionally, my under eye area looked more fresh & bright in the mornings. I loved this product so much, that I plan to purchase the full size. I used primarily at night in lieu of eye cream.
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: Got this as a sample because I like this brand, but pure chemical, think old 409 cleaner, scent has me questioning what’s actually in this product. Gross!

The texture of the mask was really nice and creamy, but it didn’t feel deeply moisturizing and kind of sat on the surface of my skin. It also broke me out SO bad. I normally never get pimples on my cheekbone area or on my chin, but I woke up with 3 new itchy pimples in those areas after using this the night before. I think the Shea butter might make this mask a little too heavy for sensitive or acne prone skin.
review_title: Not for sensitive acne prone skin

review_text: I was surprised at how much I liked thugs cream since I have a hard time finding one that works with my oily skin but this was works wonders and helps with my redness. If you have oily skin you need this!
product_name: Green Tea Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Genuinely works better than any balm I’ve used but the smell is overbearing. It smells like fake vanilla and brown sugar which does not fade. If you are sensitive to scents skip this.
product_name: Deepwater Nourishing Lip Mask with Sea Moss and Aloe Stem Cells

review_text: I haven’t written a review in a while, but the reformulation of this product is horrendous. This was my go to moisturizer for the last few years, I loved it and it was perfect for my dry sometimes temperamental skin. However I had to return my last purchase. It used to have a light pleasant smell now it smells fermented. The smell is off-putting but doesn’t last long and if that was the only problem I’d still use it. But it burns. I tried to use it for a week and what started as a slight tingling became burning and now hours after my face is still hot and red. As many other reviewers have had similar issues with the new formula I hope Herbivores will try and address the problem. In the meantime I’m on the hunt for a new moisturizer. This is definitely not for sensitive skin and I question if it’s good for anyone’s now.
Loved the smell! But after using on a regular basis I noticed that my face was getting very dry. I feel it would work great for someone who is prone to very oily skin.
I found this sunscreen to be thick
product_name: Super Fluid Daily UV Defense Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+

review_text: This serum changed my skin completely! I have super dry, dehydrated skin...I feel like this gave my skin new life. The consistency is nice too. It’s absorbs quickly rather than just sit on the skin. Definitely recommend
product_name: The Dewy Serum Resurfacing and Plumping Treatment

review_text: i love love love this cleanser. i use the inkey list oat cleansing balm to take off my makeup, and use this as my double cleanse. my skin looks tight and smooth and bright, even before moisturizer and serums!! this brand is amazing, affordable, just awesome awesome!! i’ve noticed that using this with their vitamin c egf serum has reduced my redness and made my skin so glassy! love love love, already bought a backup.
This oil is my obsession. Nothing feels better after a long day - especially when I’m in a very dry or cold climate where my skin takes a beating.
review_title: A must for skin that needs a little TLC
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: I tried Rosebud since it’s so affordable and one of the favorites at Sephora, but I really didn’t like it. This ultimately dried out my lips, and I think the container is really messy. The texture is very waxy.
This stuff feels sooo good on the skin. Can’t believe it actually cleanses AND it feels sooo good. Try it. You’ll like it !

It dries out my skin. I have been using this cleanser lately. I am not sure whether it’s caused by this cleanser or not, but my face has been breaking out lately. I would not repurchase this cleanser.
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: I received as a complimentary product, and I want to say it felt great but not totally impressed. However acne at the time could’ve affected that.
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: You can’t beat it for this price! It absorbs into skin and you instantly look hydrated. It’s been an amazing addition to my routine especially with my super dry skin. My skin looks healthy, hydrated, and more plump!
This cream is amazing. After one week of using, I noticed my face was much brighter and felt more hydrated. The consistency is good and I highly recommend this to everyone!!
product_name: Essential Energy Hydrating Day Cream Broad Spectrum SPF 20

review_text: I have used this cream for only two weeks, it feels good on the skin, and my skin feels soft in the morning just as with any other night cream that I used in the past. I do not notice any change in skin-tone, which is why I got this cram to began with... If spots is what you are concern about this cream wont do it.

Both of these work so good at taking off makeup!! And I loveeee the exfoliating side!! I didn’t break out after using them and they work great as cleansing wipes in the morning just to freshen up your skin and get started for the day!! Would recommend
review_title: bought the charcoal and green tea

review_text: I really like how this product works. Before using these product I had two different sunspots on my face, one on each check from spending time in the garden and after using this for several weeks I have noticed that one of the spots had disappeared and the other spot has significantly faded.
product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution Duo

review_text: I’m in my mid 20s with really oily skin and I usually apply the Mermaid Skin serum under my night time moisturizer. After a week of using this, I have noticed severe peeling (as if I was on a retinol treatment) all over the face including the brow bone. Hyaluronic acid is supposed to be the main ingredient in this serum which serves to pull moisture from the air into the skin, however, this serum seems to do the opposite. I’m curious to learn if some of the other ingredients in this serum are skin drying agents.
product_name: SEA Mermaid Skin Hyaluronic H2O Serum

review_text: DR. ZENOVIA 10% BENZOYL PEROXIDE ACNE CLEANSER Works great. The packaging is nice and very easy to use. The cleanser has a fresh clean scent that’s not over powering. It made my face feel awesome too. Overall I give it two great big thumbs way up and would definitely recommend it.

LOVE! I never used eye cream until this product because most would give me milia under my eyes. This does not!! I use this eye cream in the morning and absolutely love it. I find caffeine and vitamin c are great ingredients to incorporate into my AM routine and this eye cream has both.
product_name: Light Aura Vitamin C + Peptide Eye Cream

review_text: I am so happy with this mask. It makes my skin feel so soft and smooth. I have dry/sensitive/acne prone skin and it did not make me break out. I only use it as a special treat throughout the week so I haven’t seen any changes like reduced dark spots, but I’m a happy camper if I don’t break out and I have baby soft skin!
review_title: Baby soft skin with Violet C mask!

review_text: I was not a huge fan of the product compared with the price. I did not see a huge difference in my dark eye circles and though the product was hydrating and felt smooth on the skin, I was not impressed.
product_name: C5 Super Boost Vitamin C Eye Cream

review_text: I really, really wanted to love this. I have rosacea, broken capillaries, and dry skin on the cheeks with an oily t-zone. I’ve tried to use this in many different ways (as moisturizer, after moisturizer, before primer, after primer, etc.) however no matter what I did with it, it gave me really weird texture issues. It made my skin look so dry and cakey even if I use the smallest dot of product. It doesn’t blend well. I’m so disappointed.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: THIS LIP BALM IS SO $$$$ AND ITS NOT HYDRATING AT ALL FOR THE MONEY YOU CAN BUY A DRUGSTORE LIP BALM MUCH BETTER THAT THIS ONE!!!

I’m new to this brand but having seen it around for quite some time I just looked at it and saw chamomile listed in the ingredients & I was in. I am always drawn to anything chamomile. It’s just a personal favorite scent of mine. I went ahead & got the matching serum to go with it. I’m completely blown away. The moisturizer is very light weight. I can’t say if I would like it on its own but paired with the serum it’s been great for my dry skin. I was actually shocked because of the weight of the the moisturizer but it totally hydrated my skin after the 1st-2nd use. Back to the chamomile, I don’t smell it but it is a very light & pleasant scent. I can be sensitive to scent & this is perfect. Not so keen on the blue color but it works so well I’m ok with it.
review_title: Works Best With the Matching Serum

review_text: I was given this to test by Influenster. I had so much hope and excitement for this product to perform as described. However, for me it pretty much only hydrated. I didn’t get the wrinkle benefits at all
product_name: Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream

review_text: I bought this to sample Sunday Riley and see what the fuss was about. I am not impressed with either product. They don’t work as well as my holy grail products and, as such, are overpriced. I do not enjoy paying for a name...only results.
product_name: Multivitamins 15% Vitamin C + Retinol Mini Set

review_text: Mouisturizes well, but not worth the price for a chapstick that lasts two weeks tops.

product_name: Goodbye Acne   Complete Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I thought I would try these over some other ‘dots’ on the market, in hopes they would provide a deeper treatment for the occasional cystic mark that pops up during the year. It doesn’t work any better/less than other dots I’ve tried, and barely works at all on cystic marks. One plus is that the micro “needles” stay sharp longer than other brands, since each dot is packaged individually.

I thought it was the new face wash I was also using but when I stopped using the face wash, I still saw that my skin did not like this toner. It removed excess dirt and makeup but irritated my oily prone skin.

Came here to say that I am so disappointed they changed the formulation. I loved this product before when it was soft and kept my lips moisturized overnight. Now the stick is really hard and difficult to get on. I wouldn’t recommend this anymore and was so disappointed I returned it.
review_title: Changed the formulation, not worth it

review_text: this was just not for me, it left my skin feeling rly tight. kinda similar to how my hands would feel after using irish springs soap. also it stings my eyes pretty bad everytime i use it so i prolly won’t be using it anytime soon.
product_name: Green Tea Hyaluronic Acid Face Cleanser

review_text: This stuff!!!! I really did not expect it to perform the way it does. i have been using this stuff every night for over a month now and I have not had one zit, it is fading my age spots, and my makeup is going on so much smoother and not showing pores as much. It is expensive but I love this stuff!
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Excellent! I love the lather, the smell, the texture and the clean feel this wash leaves my face. I use a small amount and it’s PLENTY! So you get a lot of uses out of it :) Enjoy the deep face clean!
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: Daily Milkfoliant Exfoliator does a great job of gently exfoliating the skin. Its a powder form making it easy to travel with, you pour into wet hands and create a creamy lather rubbing hands together and massage into your skin tnewhen rinse. So easy and convenient. My skin is left clean, soft and my skins texture looks better. Received complimentary from Dermalogica.

This stuff is amazing! I put it on my dry face and rub all of my makeup around then I add water and do the same then rinse off. Takes everything off and I love the clean smell it has. Another winner from DE!

Love this product! It provides just the right amount of hydration, while also feeling lightweight and not greasy. The scent is light and pleasant (rose and cucumber?). I don’t know whether it prevents fine lines or wrinkles, but it definitely helps to revitalize skin on the short term. One of my only negatives is that the packaging is a bit heavy and overkill for how much product there is.
Great texture, frothy and creamy. Has a light minty scent. I love that after I have rinsed, my skin feels clean but never dry or tight. I would definitely purchase this cleanser again.

review_text: Only thing that has ever actually worked to reduce the visibility of the stains on my teeth.

review_text: i see a clear difference when i use this toner. my skin has much more luminescence after each use & it is mild enough i feel comfortable using it day and night.
product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_title: Best Way to Top Off Your Makeup Look

review_text: I use it before I apply skin care and primer, and I have dry under eyes and this does this trick to making me look awake and bright. My concealer lasts all day with this underneath.
review_title: Worth it for dry under eyes

review_text: I expected better since it’s called dramatically different moisturising lotion. Honestly had to apply many layers to feel less tightening in face and it felt heavy and greasy even if I had applied just one layer. Kept touching my forehead feeling for grease.
So now its approx week since em using this face cleanser ... I love-this cleanser so far . It makes my soft

I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes. All of the opinions are all my own.

product_name: Wrinkle Warrior Eye Gel Visible Dark Circle Eraser

review_text: The dots are mostly invisible when worn, but they don’t do anything. The areas might have even gotten more red from the adhesive.

product_name: Even Smoother Glycolic Retinol Resurfacing Serum

review_text: I walked into my Sephora five days ago and there was a rep from Sunday Riley there. I told her my struggle: I’ve had blackheads on my chin since I was 12 (now 24 y/o) and they will not go away, no matter what scrub, peel, mask, etc. I try. She explained those are “quick fixes“ and don’t CLOSE the pores, just unclog them and then they clog up again. So I bought this in the 15ml per her suggestion. I actually cannot believe the results. Not all my blackheads are gone, but most are and the others are SIGNIFICANTLY much smaller!!!! I am in shock! I use this oil at night after I wash my face, let it sink in for about half an hour, then apply my moisturizer. This oil is a GOD SEND!!!!! (It doesn’t smell good though but the scent fades away!)
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: I purchased this cream by reading reviews. I got very disappointed. This cream didn’t do anything to my skin, it had a zero result. I do not recommend this product to anyone.
review_title: Disappointed, do not recommend this product!

review_text: I got this as a sample in a different package, I tried it and instantly went to buy a full-size one my skin feels amazing! My skin feels so soft, hydrated and glowy. I would definitely recommend!

review_text: I had the opportunity to try the trial size jar, so cute, but this just made me sad. I love trying new products, and was excited for this launch, too! Why couldn’t Sunday Riley spend more time on the ingredients and less on making it smell like an orange? That doesn’t have anything to do with making my skin brighter. :( I maybe could have overlooked the way it smelled and felt, if it actually DID something. My skin just felt dry, waxy not at all brighter. $65 for a vitamin C moisturizer in a jar that’s scented like what a robot thinks an orange should smell like? No thank you.
review_title: Orange you glad you didn't buy the full size? Yes.

review_text: I really wanted to love this as much as the original lip mask, but I didn’t like the fragrance of the Berry. Also, these go on clear, they don’t give you any tint.

I received a free sample of this product from Influenster in my most current VoxBox. I just recently started using the product within the past week. product_name: Potent-C Vitamin C Targeted Spot Brightener

That being said, a little goes a long way...

I came on here to order the full size and it’s already sold out! I will literally be waiting for the email of a restock. Love love love!

review_text: This did not help my lips whatsoever. It smell good and taste good, but i feel like it makes my dry lips even worse. It’s like a thinner version of EOS lip balms, which I do not find moisturizing either.

I love trying out all the newest and coolest releases especially when it comes to cleansers because it’s easy to switch them around often (typically no bad side effects or purging periods) but it looks like I’m stuck with this one lol I can’t imagine switching to a different cleanser now. It has a gorgeous light scent, it really cleans my face (when I go over it with a cotton pad and toner there’s no residue left over), and my face doesn’t feel tight and uncomfortable. Plus the bottle is super cute and when you see how much you get for the price, it completely makes sense. 10/10 recommend.

This serum puffed up my wrinkle lines and made them less noticeable! The dropper was well designed, as the liquid didn’t come out too fast. I appreciate that they are cruelty free and will be rebuying. Gifted by Sunday Riley

I’ve never tried an essence before but I think this got me hooked! I was worried about the packaging and having it dispense too much product, but it is actually super easy to control how much comes out. I gently pat this onto my face and my face feels super clean and light. I can’t tell if it’s made any difference to the efficacy of my other skincare products, but it has definitely helped with hydration overall. I received this product free for review purposes.
