product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: i was i afraid of using this at first because of my sensitive skin, however i’ve used it a couple of times now and i loooooooveeee how my skin looks and feels!

I really love this mist. I enjoy the scent which gives me a pickup. I love how healthy my skin looks when I use it. Very versatile also as I use it before my mositurizer and to set my makeup. Expensive however will worth the splurge. I’m on my third bottle and consider it a staple.

Unfortunately very soon after I started noticing breakouts on my cheeks and forehead, and extreme dryness. I do not have sensitive or acne prone skin so I was super bummed. I used this product for almost three months really trying to give it a chance, but the week I stopped using it the breakouts started to clear and my skin wasn’t peeling anymore. Didn’t work for me and I would never repurchase. Was such a waste especially for the price. There are better options out there!

review_text: I bought this for my dad who has dry lips & uses Chapstick all the time, which doesn’t help enough. I thought I’d give him this to try & he likes it a lot! Smells like lip smackers so it gets a star. Hardly removes makeup and a lot gets left over. Just get some ponds cold cream. Cheaper and works so much better.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Love the product. This is amazing for people who have extremely sensitive skin, and I appreciate that it’s not fragranced since I usually breakout with those products. You get a lot of product for the price you pay - it is an extremely good price point. I don’t mind the packaging, and actually think that it is a lot more sanitary than a tub and it is recyclable. The only con is that it’s kinda difficult to get product out as it’s a thick texture, but with a bit of a squeeze you can get a lot of product.Of note: I wear very thick mascara almost everyday, and this gets it ALL off in one go.
I loved this moisturizer! I received it from Influenster and fell in love immediately! The scent is light and absorbed quickly, both important to me when picking a moisturizer.
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I received this product as a sample and I am in love with it i really a thinking about buying the full size

review_title: Not all I had hoped it would be.
product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Does the basic job of Moisturizing and that is it! Nothing more. Also the comfort of knowing that you have invested in a high end brand cream. But good as primer. As far as anti aging benefits, I have to wait 10 years to write the review!
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I am loving this as my AM moisturizer along side the serum. I use this in place of a primer and it really helps to keep my makeup staying matte but not dry. This is my favorite use for it since I am super sensitive to a lot of products. I find this keeps it simple and doesn’t make my face break out. It actually helps to reduce the redness in my face when I use both the serum and moisturizer together. I am not sure how much I will like this as a night time moisturizer since it is mattifying, but I really enjoy it thus far for the AM. It does have a nice clean floral scent that fades. The texture is quite weird for a moisturizer (gel silicone type texture), which is why I think it works so well as a primer.
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: This serum was so nice to use. It felt luxurious and made my skin feel plump and super hydrated. The texture feels nice and it sinked into the skin almost immediately. I saw improvements in overall hydration but as far as skin texture I would need to use longer. The only thing I didn’t like it’s the fragrance, it took me a bit to get used to.
review_title: Nice texture, would need to use longer for results
product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

review_text: I bought this after it was recommended to me by a Sephora staff member. I let her know I have dry skin during the winter months so I was looking for something to keep my skin moisturized. She swore by this but ultimately it didn’t do much for me. My skin never felt better even after using the whole jar.
I received this serum complimentary from Influenster and I absolutely LOVE it. I have noticed a huge change with my pores already and my face is smoother. The scent isn’t too strong, it’s just right.
I love how creamy this moisturizer is. Not to mention it actually smells like real citrus and not some thing artificial! Very good quality!

I’ve been using the sample I got from Sephora and switched to this really mild cleanser. My skin feels very clean without feeling taut and dry. I also love the tingling feeling it leaves on your skin. I wonder why it took me so long to try this!
review_title: Feels good, skin feels clean without being taut!
product_name: All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap

review_text: I’m in my mid-twenties and have always had clear skin. However, six months ago I began getting acne on my cheeks and I’m desperate to get rid of it. This product came highly recommended to me by a Sephora employee and I was very optimistic about it. However, this product did not work for me at all.
review_title: Optimistic But Did Not Work For Me

review_text: If you have combination skin, please try it before buying it. I wish I had listen to some of the bad reviews. The oil just sits on your skin. I used it on my face for 2 days(only nights) and the area around my nose had 4 pimples within that week.NOT A PRETTY SITE! So now, I only use it on my cheeks now, its been over 2 weeks, and my hyper pigmentation is tiny bit lighter. I hate the way it feels when I apply to it my skin. It gets really hot after few minutes, but that goes away after 10 to 15 mins. I will not be buying this again!
review_title: PLEASE try the product at store before buying it!

review_text: was really excited to try it out. I have normal skin and haven’t had breakout in years but this product caused a sudden breakout on my face after two uses! I threw away the sample tub.

I have combination skin where I get oily fast but I get dry patches on my nose. I waited a week to write this review because I’m acne prone and break out really easily. This product has not caused any breakouts. I tried the OLEHENRIKSEN Counter Balance Oil Control Hydrator before this to help with oily skin but it ended up drying my face out really bad. I had to go to three separate Sephora stores to finally get my hands on this Tatcha Water Cream and it was definitely worth it. product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I choose a deluxe sample of this because of all the hype around the brand. I am very disappointed. It has irritated my skin a lot, leaving my face very dry, red, bumpy. I am sitting here with my face coated in squalane hoping that it will look better in time for work tomorrow. The lesson, of course, is that no matter what others say about a product, you need to do a test. Lesson learnt.

I have been struggling w/ acne since my teens.My acne is under control and I stick to a good skin care routine however, I get cystic acne around “that time of the month“ or when I’m under stress.I use this product to spot treat my breakouts and use it to cover up my breakouts when needed. This product really works and it works fast. It’s a must have in my beauty bag and my go to treat acne breakouts.

The cream is lightweight, moisturizing and blends perfectly with my skin. It doesn’t feel like you have anything on, a little goes a long way. I don’t know what magic Tatcha puts in their products but this one is worth the buy. It leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth.This water cream leaves your skin with a beautiful glow. It completely removed my dry patches. My skin is interesting: it’s sensitive, prone to acne and clogged pores, oily T-Zone but dry everywhere else. This is worth the money, I promise..Work wonders with combination skin ❣ .
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I have really oily skin and this sunscreen is great for daily use and super light weight. I still get oily after using this which is why I took off a star but overall great product. I received these products complimentary for testing purposes.
product_name: UV Expert Aquagel Defense Sunscreen, Primer & Moisturizer SPF 50 Duo

review_text: Great product! I love that it smells light and natural, my skin is noticeably hydrated! My only issue with this product is that if I use it in combination with my makeup my skin looks really oily, as to when I use it alone it makes my skin look dewy and hydrated. Just something to consider if you wear a lot of makeup! Love this product would definitely recommend to anyone with dull, dry skin!
It’s definitely a great product for hydration but without feeling oily after hours. Its super light weight which I love. Recommend it to people with dry & sensitive skin.
product_name: Essential Energy Hydrating Day Cream Broad Spectrum SPF 20

review_text: This is the first time I’ve ever ordered and used this product and I have to say I have not been disappointed at all with it. It’s amazing and leaves my face so clean and my skin looking beautiful.

I had such high hopes for this! I am prone to really dry skin around my eyes and am sensitive to some ingredients, and this looked like a great option. It definitely doesn’t make my skin worse, but it doesn’t make it better. My under-eye dry patches have stayed put. This also doesn’t sink into the skin; it tends to sit on top of the skin. It then pills and needs to be cleaned off the next morning. Putting makeup over this is impossible.Long story short: doesn’t make my skin worse, but is pretty annoying to use.
review_title: Pills badly but doesn't make skin worse

review_text: I really wanted to like this,but it irritated my skin!!

The only reason why I gave it 4 stars is cuz of the price but I’m definitely buying again. That 90 bucks lasted me 7 months so it’s worth the splurge.
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: works good. but for some reason leaks everywhere so a waste of a product

So thick and creamy, yet it doesn’t feel heavy and doesn’t leave you looking like a greasy mess.

review_text: I loved the clean and fresh scent and how thick this moisturizer is. The product absorbs quickly and leaves my skin soft and supple after each use. I like to use it as my new last step in my skincare routine!
product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: Received as birthday mini. I am cursed with sensitive rosacea prone complexion which is also aging, finding the right moisturizers is a hassle but the protini checked all my boxes. Love how hydrated plumped and calm it made my skin!
review_title: Dry sensitive aging skin? Give this a try!

review_text: It’s okaaayy, defiantly not my fav, does leave your skin with a very pretty glow, but when first pumping it out it almost looks expired, it’s all separated until you rub your hands together, it does tend to pull over my moisturizer which I don’t love at all. 2 stars for the pretty glow will not be a re-purchase.

I’ve been using this for over 2 months now and I didn’t do anything at all, don’t see any difference in my dark spots and not even any brightening. I really wished it worked since I spent a good amount of money on it.
product_name: Guava Vitamin C Dark Spot Treatment Serum

review_text: The Summer Fridays Jet Lag Mask is EVERYTHING. I was on the fence about getting it since it is super nourishing and I have oily skin. I am about to repurchase my second tube. It is beautiful. I put on a generous layer before bed as my night time moisturizer. When I wake up in the morning my face is radiant, plump, and so smooth. I would 100% recommend for any skin type.
Too oil, doesn’t like it that much
product_name: All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap

review_text: I adore this stupidly expensive face wash and will continue to spend way too much money on it for years to come. It’s so gentle on my face while still getting me totally clean. review_title: I love this stuff so much, but hate the price

review_text: Love it! It’s easy to apply and doesn’t irritate my skin like other vitamins C serums that I’ve tried!!!!
Has plastic in the balm that washes down the drain into the environment. NOT a vibe ugh. IF you wanna a better dupe, Then I Met You Cleansing Balm has NO plastic in it :)

I am about to run out and buy another bottle!
product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Who is giving this five stars??? This product is a lipgloss only, and I’ve had better from the hair store. Buxom and Too Faced make a better and cheaper product. I returned this. Please do not believe the hype and save your $$. Deserves no stars!
So soft and refreshing It soaked into my skin and there was no left over film

Will not be trying or buying this again.

I will not be reordering it and I wouldn’t recommend it.
product_name: Future Solution LX Intensive Firming Contour Serum

review_text: I received this product free in exchangfe for an honest review. I really love this moisturizer. product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

Overall, I would recommend this product to someone with normal to dry skin for the best results.
review_title: Not for me, but great for people with dry skin

review_text: Great brand and great product I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a Christmas gift or something more luxe for yourself it feels and looks amazing the bottles even looks great sitting on the counter
product_name: Mini Algae + Moringa Universal Face Oil

Love the whimsical hue, can’t detect any scent, very happy with this launch.

Since after my surgery, I have had sleep problems and hormones changed, every night I lay in the bed still can’t fall asleep, I have been suffering for many months and always feel tired, This product works great for me!! It improve my moodand stress, I can feel something different! Wish I knew this product earlier!!

I’ve tried so many different under eye beauty products that didn’t work, so I was very skeptical of this doing anything for me. I can actually go out without applying concealer which is just amazing!!!
product_name: Bye Bye Under Eye Brightening Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: I had high hopes for this but it was all around terrible. Consistency was strange and did not turn into the ‘oil’ they describe when you mix it in your hands. Since it doesn’t foam or get any type of soapy it didn’t really cleanse and took off barely any make up.
Smells soooo good but my skin is oily so it was a no for me after the 2 first uses
review_title: Smells great but not for me

review_text: This product came “highly recommended“ by the salesperson in the store. I hate it. It’s heavy and pastelike to put on and hasn’t done a thing for the dry skin condition it was bought to treat.

I’ve been using this for about a month and i’ve seen a dramatic change in my skin. i used to use clinique face wash then the clinique acne foaming wash. this has replace both of those!! my skin is so smooth and clean and a very little amount goes a long way!!!

Does absolutely nothing for dark circles, but it is hydrating

review_text: I have used this product once now and am in love! At first I was really bummed because I didn’t realize it was a travel size but.....so much goes so such a long way! The smell was light and fresh and I like how it lathers on my face.
This didn’t irritate my sensitive skin, which was a plus. Strangely it felt both not enough hydration and left me oily. Didn’t work for my skin and not in my budget.

Purchased the smaller size from the manufacture to try it out before I committed to the product.. glad I did. Clay in the bar works on drawing out impurities and has a gentle scent. Does not exfoliate very well and it does causes drying leading to a build up of dead skin. I needed to add a glycolic wash back into my weekly skin care regime to help slough off the dead skin with a stronger exfoliation and to break down the impurities drawn out by the JuJu bar. I will continue to use the wash, but probably will not use it everyday. I really hoped for a miracle product... not quite it, but it is a good start. I will try other products from this line, as I am very curious to see how the marula oil works on my usually normal but seasonal changing skin.

Love love love this mask! Perfect for my dry skin and the smell is amazing!

I received complimentary. I do enjoy the extremely low to no fragrance. Leaves your lips feeling very soft when you wake up

review_title: If you have Oily-Acne prone skin don't buy this!:(

review_text: I’ve been using this mask every few months for a few years. I have oily skin & acne. Every time I almost get it under control I seem to get a break out, recently figured out the common denominator: it’s this mask. I normally get a few other things with this mask & kept thinking it was those makeup/skin care items that were breaking me out. But nope! Bought a few over quarantine to just use on spa nights & I’ve had the same kind of break out each time. I get a lot of white-heads & it’s really quite painful. Maybe I have sensitive skin idk! But if you’re worried about breakouts I’d say just skip this one.

This product is good. Not great, but good. It does reduce the redness and dried out my blemishes. It did not reduce the size of my pores or the amount of blackheads I had. If you actually use it like it suggests, you get better results! It doesn’t work quite as good if you ignore the routine. My skin does feel good and smooth with the product but it definitely requires a moisturizer after you apply it.

I purchased a deluxe sample of this with 100 Sephora reward points two weeks ago. I’ve been using this moisturizer in the mornings in conjuncture with my Drunk Elephant C Firma vitamin C serum. I usually prefer no fragrance but I absolutely love the smell of this product. It’s very citrusy. My skin is weird these days, I like to define it as combination. It’s oily at heart but is dry on the surface due to using Retin-A/tretinoin for acne scars. It has a creamy texture that is a little bit on the thicker side. At first I was afraid it might be too heavy but my skin absorbed it right up. For those who are saying it made them greasy because they are on the oilier side, you would probably enjoy Sunday Riley’s Tidal moisturizer more. Everybody’s skin type is different so I always recommend going to the store to test out the product to see if that kind of texture is something that agrees with your skin. I know when I was oily oily oily, I would stay away from thick or rich products. Overall I love this product but I don’t love it enough to purchase a full size at $65 but I would grab it again if I saw it in the rewards bazaar!

I usually use this cleanser at night so that my skin can heal overnight, and I can use my clarisonic for a deep clean in the morning.The brilliant thing about this cleanser is that it balances my skin so perfectly, I never need a toner. My skin feels perfect and refreshed. I then go on with my skincare regime, but using this cleanser I generally only feel the need to cleanse and moisturize most nights. I moisturize sometimes with the actual argan oil, and the combination wakes me up with a glow and no clogged pores. I don’t break out from this cleanser, my skin actually renews itself overnight and my acne scars have faded a bit. (But like I’ve said before, your skin may react differently to argan oil or the other oils in this cleanser. )I will say that although extremely oily, some products I use to treat my hormonal acne will dry my face out to the point where it does burn to work the oil into my face. I think this oil is great for dry skin, but if your skin dries to the point of peeling or you’re looking for a cleanser with moisturizing quality, maybe this isn’t for you. This cleanser BALANCES, but does not moisturize nor does it strip the skin (I find that when my moisturizer is delayed when my skin is that dry is the ONLY time I have a problem with this )REMOVING MAKEUP: Please note that this is designed to remove products used over the skin, it is not designed to be used as an eye makeup remover or for lips. It works incredibly well to remove facial makeup when time is spent working the product into the skin. It’s unrealistic to expect washing your face in thirty seconds will remove ALL of your makeup, no matter what product you use. I wouldn’t say to put this on a cotton pad to use on your eyelashes and remove eyeliner, but it is gentle around the eyes and removes all of my undereye concealer. As for the bad taste, you really aren’t supposed to eat your facial cleanser and it’s surprising to me how much of a dealbreaker this is! I try as much as possible to avoid my lips and as I’ve adjusted to using the oil, I haven’t had the problem of getting it in my mouth for months. As for the chemical smell, I trust Josie Maran products, they work for me, and I believe they are good for my skin. The smell doesn’t bother me, it’s similar to a citrusy pinetree sort of smell but I can see where people may say it smells like chemicals. Like I said it doesn’t bother me and I don’t believe that I’m washing my face with windex, especially with the results I have.Overall, this cleanser is extremely gentle and effective at working WITH my skin -not against it, not to fix a certain problem - but as a general do gooder for the way my skin looks and feels. As always, I do switch my products in and out at times, but nothing comes close to working as well as my Josie Maran.Some other notes: If your skin is DEHYDRATED, as in you don’t drink enough water, having nothing to do with oily versus dry skin, this product may tug more on your skin. I’ve had this problem of the oil feeling heavy only a few times and it’s been when I haven’t been drinking enough. Remember that drinking enough water (and just taking care of yourself internally and externally!) is the most important beauty secret:)

I received these in a Sephora favorites sunscreen box in the shade light. I have to admit, I have had pretty bad luck with self tanners even after researching how to use them correctly.. honestly I thought I would give these away to someone. I decided to read the reviews for this product and got discouraged even more (maybe you are doing the same!). Then I thought about how I end up LOVING products that have way worse reviews and decided to give this a try. Here’s how it turned out: I double cleansed my face as part of my usual skin routine. I use an acid/active every other night and made sure to use these drops on the non acid night. I used my toner, Sunday Riley A+ retinoid serum (retinoids don’t react with other actives and I figured this would still be safe to use), and Lapis facial oil. Then I mixed two drops into a small amount of Lala Retro moisturizer while wearing regular latex gloves. I really rubbed this into my face and down my neck. I tried to “blend” it down my neck as smoothly as possible. I currently have a slight tan but absolutely no tan on my face. I made sure to avoid my eyebrows and hairline. I let the mixture absorb into my face before going to bed. I warned my boyfriend not to be scared if my face was orange in the morning. Haha. I woke up with a WONDERFUL glowing complexion. Honestly, I could have gotten away with no foundation today. The tone looks very natural, but I will say that I have golden yellow undertones. Not sure how it would look on someone with red undertones. I have zero streaks and I can’t even tell where the application ended on my neck. I have to say, this is the best and easiest to use self tanner I have ever used. I had zero irritation and did not notice a smell at all as others had. I will continue to use this every other night because my skin looks freaking amazing. Will probably use three drops next time instead of two on face.

review_text: I never write reviews, but I felt like I had to with this wonderful product. My acne scars have truly faded, my pores have shrunk, and my skin tone is much more even now. This product, paired with YTTP’s Superfood Moisturizer, has completely changed and saved my skin. I’m not saying it cleared it completely, but I can see a drastic difference in just two months. If you are reading this commnent and thinking “I’ve tried everything, there’s no way this will actually help me“, I urge you just to buy a mini bottle and try it, for you won’t regret it.

This was my first time using a skincare system; I incorporated the products into my daily routine (I did not use the set exclusively). The quiz was comprehensive, the products are completely customizable and even takes into account your location. You can opt for SPF which I went for, and can change your preferences or ingredients anytime.The product packaging was great, the set comes with cards that detail what’s in every product. The Proven Skincare system includes a cleanser, daily moisturizer and night cream. My favorite product was the cleanser, it felt super light, foamed up nicely, smelt really good and cleaned throughly- did not need to double cleanse. The products felt ’clean’ and fresh, all fragrances were really nice. The daily moisturizer went on smoothly, I like that it was a bit thicker because I like thicker creams; it absorbed nicely and was lightweight despite being thick, non-greasy and makeup applied nicely on top. My only negative is the products are quite small for the price point (1-1.7 ounces). Using everyday without incorporating additional products, I would finish in month (probably less) and it is quite pricey to replen every month. Other than that, it was nice quality and I would recommend.

review_text: I first tried a small bottle from a set, then decided to order a full size. It does a great job in removing the makeup and is quite easy to be rinsed off. No strong smell which is what I like.

absolutely love it and all the benefits it holds im glad i got one it feels amazing undereye ive tried others that drag or have a not so moisturizing feeling this feels very moisturized. Will definitely be purchasing

review_text: I tried the 5 treatments sample pack and I’ve seen a good difference in addition of the use of 50 fps lotion. I recently bought the regular size and I know i will get results soon. It’s the only product that fades my acne scars and eczema plaque due tu hiperpigmentation
product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I am liking this new mask I received complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics! I have combination skin and have used it twice over the last week, in addition to their new toner. The best gel spot treatment. The only reason it’s not 5 stars is because the bottle is hard to use, especially when it starts to get low. Often a lot more comes out then needed, just wish it was in a better bottle or a tube.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: This was not the best cleanser I have ever used but it wasn’t bad. It’s definitely not worth the price point and I didn’t notice any changes to my skin. I think it’s just an average cleanser and I could get better products from a drugstore.
It’s really good and makes your face feel cool and refreshed. Gets rid of acne and pimples BUT did you notice it used to be 100 ml for that price now it’s LESS! 75 ml for the SAME price!
review_title: GOOD but LESS for the SAME price!
product_name: Out of Trouble 10 Minute Mask to Rescue Problem Skin

review_text: I don’t quite know how to apply stars to this product, because it does exactly what I had hoped for; moisturized my menopausal-wrecked dry skin. But...never have I ever broken out quite like I did with this. Not a normal breakout, but crazy looking bumps that look like mrsa within an hour of applying. It scared the heck out of my husband and he forbade me to use it a second time, demanded that I take it off immediately and douse myself in peroxide followed by colloidal silver. We are both suspecting some sort of bacterial contamination in the product, because I never break out. I have used straight petrolatum on my face, with no break outs whatsoever. Extra virgin coconut oil, with no breaks out whatsoever. I wanted to love this, hey, who wouldn’t, it’s 21 peptides, ceramides, and everything a damaged skin barrier needs. But I won’t risk buying it again. Either Sephora sold me a used product, or the product is contaminated. Whatever the case may be, when it scares my husband, who never comments on anything, it’s gotta be bad. So, five stars for the ingredient concept. Zero stars for whatever is in it that caused the infection on my face. I really wish skincare and makeup companies were forced to seal all products. It would make things much more comfortable for the consumer.

I received this as a gift complimentary from Farmacy Beauty. Being over 40 now, I really struggle with finding something that does not irritate or overdry my skin. So far this stuff is amazing. No burning when I put it on, and my skin feels so soft. I love this brand, have had other products that work also.

I did not like this product. I was really excited because it sounded great. After a week I noticed texture forming on my skin and I stopped using it. If you have sensitive skin I wouldn’t recommend it. I think all charcoal products don’t work well for my skin but if they do for yours maybe try it out. This was provided to me for reviewing by Influenster.

review_text: I really like this product so far! My under eyes felt really hydrated in the morning the next day. The serum has a slight cooling effect and doesn’t have too strong of a smell. The applicator is the perfect shape to fit under your eyes!
absolutely love this! Ive noticed a difference in how my skin feels after two uses, and you don’t need a lot of product.
product_name: The Balance pH Balancing Gel Cleanser

review_text: Okay, feels good, and smells nice. But I find it’s a bit drying. And I have found other masks that just did a bit more for me.

review_text: As so many others stated- the smell was so off putting I got rid of the whole thing. I had quickly dispensed a bit and applied it to my cheek when I gagged at how bad the smell was. product_name: FILLING GOOD hyaluronic acid plumping serum

review_text: I received this product through Influenster and was very excited to try. I have never used a Tatcha product but always wanted to and thought this was a great opportunity. I used this product mainly under my eyes, cheekbones and forehead. The areas I either wanted to accentuate or even out. Product glides on smooth but feels heavy and somewhat greasy when applied. review_text: I received the mini pack of 5 and drank one every morning. Now that I’ve played with it a little bit I really enjoy this primer--the key is that you have to press it into your pores rather than “massage it in“ as I think the directions say, and then letting it sit for like 30 seconds to 1 minute. As long as I let it sit on my face before putting the foundation on, I haven’t had any trouble with it sliding off my face. I use the Tarte Foundcealer most days which is pretty hydrating/slippery. Overall I would definitely recommend this primer and I look forward to buying the big size when I run out of the mini!
product_name: The Silk Canvas Protective Primer Mini

i really wanted to love this product, but. it was harsh on my face. what really did it for me is that product would leak out from the spout (a whatever issue in the long run) but it ATE AWAY my shelf! like there are little rings in my vanity where this cleanser just burned through paint and wood. def don’t want that on my precious little face.

This kit is amazing!! review_text: I received Ilia C Beyond Triple Serum Broad Spectrum SPF 40 Sunscreen free from Ilia and Pinchme in exchange for my honest review. This is unlike any product I’ve used before. It is a tinted serum that contains Vitamin C, Mineral Sunscreen with SPF 40 and Niacinamide. It brightens, smooths and protects skin. It is water-free, made up of weightless oils and Allantoin to smooth and nourish the skin. It comes in 3 translucent tones to neutralize white cast with a sheer glowy finish. The tint I used was extra-light to medium as my skin is very fair. It must be shaken vigorously to distribute the product uniformly for an even application.. It is made of powders suspended in oils. You can hear a ball inside helping to mix up the product kind of like that in a nail polish. The bottle has a pump to apply the serum. I found out the hard way to pat and not rub in the product. If you rub it causes pilling which is highly undesirable. You should wait a full minute for the product to absorb before applying any other makeup. It sort of reminds me of a tinted moisturizer but with the texture of a serum and you have to be delicate in the application. I like the SPF and that it is tinted to prevent white cast. My skin felt good when I applied the product correctly. It was a little bit tacky feeling at first, but it did eventually absorb all the way. When I use a product with SPF that is tinted I am unsure where to stop applying to avoid lines or lack of sunscreen. I guess I need a separate product for my ears for example. I don’t typically apply tinted products to my ears but I always apply sunscreen there. Overall this product is not for me. I find it causes pilling too easily and is hard to blend into my skin. It also is more tacky than I like and takes far too long to absorb.
product_name: C Beyond Triple Serum SPF 40 Mineral Sunscreen with Vitamin C 10% + Niacinamide

They are folded up inside the pack without a plastic backing - I prefer this because it’s less plastic waste and also I always thought that backing wasted some of the juice. The mask itself does have small eyeholes but I love this because then I don’t need to do an eye mask, it already covers my lower eyelids well. The most important part: the serum - I’m extremely prone to clogged pores and close comedones, so far I’ve tried the lychee, watermelon, and spirulina masks and have not had any clogged pores. I won’t be trying the coconut or strawberry however because they contain oil which I think will clog my pores. The SPIRULINA one is hands down my favorite though. Something in this REALLY agrees with my skin. I have post inflammatory hyperpigmentation and after just one use my skin looks so much more even as well as seriously plump and hydrated (even more than the watermelon mask did). My second favorite is the Lychee - smells great, so hydrating and plumping. I don’t think it even out my skin tone like the spirulina, however. Watermelon - still a pretty dang good mask but smells like artificial watermelon bubble gum. I like it but why get this when I can get spirulina. Hot tip - you CAN reuse these. Just use on a clean face, when you’re done fold it back up, place it in the pouch and clip it closed with a hair clip or place it in a ziplock. You can store it in the fridge too if you like. If it’s not wet enough on the second use, you can put it on and then mist with bottled water or a fancy aerosol thermal water. I use these at least twice usually the next day but sometimes a few days apart.
Felt fine going on. Then I broke out. Returned.

Plus, I live in CA and in a day that was like 80 degrees, this stuff started melting all over because, again, is pure oil. So, hard pass!

review_text: The Olehenriksen C-Rush Vitamin C Gel Moisturizer is an excellent cream to use in the daytime. After cleansing and toning, I follow with a vitamin C serum (either Skinceuticals C E Ferulic® or Skinceuticals Phloretin CF or OLEHENRIKSEN Truth Serum®), then a Hyaluronic acid serum before lathering this moisurizer on my skin. (I personally stick to using my vitamin C products in the AM and my AHAs/BHAs at night.) I’ve been using this moisurizer for 9 months now along with the Olehenriksen Banana Bright Eye Crème. The eye cream works wonders – it has brightened my undereye area! This face cream is great too, however a vitamin C cream alone will not change your skin (it is hard to stabilize vitamin C in moisturizers). I would say the cream enhances the results of a great vitamin C serum and overall C skincare routine. I also find this gel cream acts as an excellent makeup base. If you are using this product or are interested in purchasing it, I would highly recommend using the banana eye cream and a vitamin C serum (OLEHENRIKSEN Truth Serum® or other) as part of your routine. And don’t forget a good sunscreen since most vitamin C moisurizers do not contain SPF!

review_text: Received this a sample and I had to purchase the jar. Best non-greasy moisturizer to use right after coming home and washing your face. Don’t use too much because it’s not worth wasting the product ’casue it works using only a little bit.

I absolutely love this product, but I will say for new beginners. Be careful at first my skin felt like on fire the very first couple of times but now my skin has no reaction to it ￼ for people that are not used to putting strong exfoliating skin products on their skin. I strongly recommend to leave it on for at least 60 seconds instead of the full five minutes. ￼

I bought this duo 3 weeks ago and I am now out of the Good Genes treatment. I still have some Luna Sleeping Oil left, but I don’t know how much because both bottles are opaque! Another reviewer mentioned this same problem, and I, too, feel tricked! I will not repurchase this set and I will not purchase Good Genes individually. I liked what it did for my skin, but this was definitely not worth the money for the amount of time it lasted. A product this expensive should last a few months, at least!
product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo

review_text: Very smooth and silky on the skin. I loved the pattern when I bought it but, it does not keep the light out. Also, it doesn’t cover my eyes fully so near the bottom of the mask, there is almost a gaping hole. You have to pull down quite a bit to cover face/eye area fully but not comfortably. Overall, an okay product. Worth the money? Probably not.
I use 4 drops of this product every night, all over my face, before my night cream and it has worked wonders! I haven’t had a pimple in months! Not over drying either.

I’m sure this works for some folks but honestly it’s not worth the price. My lips were dry again within an hour. Please save your money and get the vaseline lip therapy for a fraction of the price. You can get the same amount for $6 and it’s more effective.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I use this mask together with the Lapis Oil Facial Oil. It works amazing! I like how it’s so gentle, you even forget it’s a resurfacing mask. It does tingle a little bit and has a strong scent (which I actually like), I find that after using it my skin feels much softer. Feels like I’ve gone back to my pre-puberty skin! Needles to say, I’m going to be repurchasing when I run out!
product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

review_text: OMG!!! I love it! It helped me to clear my skin a looot !!! Best Tonic I ever had !!!
product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: This cream is amazing. Absolutely amazing. My skin feels so moisturised and plump and fresh within seconds of rubbing it in. But why the 2 stars? The smells is unbearable. It’s a mix of milk-gone-bad sour and old wet socks. If I wasn’t so sensitive to smells I’d keep this cream in in daily regime. The moment I opened the box, the smell of the cream hit me like a ton of bricks. I thought it was something else from outside since my washroom window was open but I smeared a pea amount on my chin and almost threw up. The smell also lingers all day so I found it so hard to concentrate. Having to wear a mask all day long with the smell of this cream stuck in there is terrible. I’d definitely go in-store and try a small dab of a sample of the back of your hand before commiting. I bought it online and sadly had to return it because I can’t bear the smell. I’m so sad because it’s such an amazing formula - for dry, combination, even oily skin, this cream would work wonders especially in the harshness of Canadian winters.
review_title: WORST SMELLING FACE CREAM I'VE EVER USED... so sad
product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: It works if you use it right and is consistent. Works best on pimples after you pop them and works great on dark spots and scars

I am a very outdoorsy person so this product is a MUST have! I apply this to my face and neck before doing yard work or jogging. I have somewhat oily skin and this product goes on smooth and leaves a nice dewy finish. The texture and smell are favorable. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes through Influenster!
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Cream SPF 50+ Face Sunscreen

review_text: This cleanser is really gentle, but great at removing most makeup. It does seem to have trouble removing some mascaras/eyelash glue that may be left on the lashes. For this reason I always remove any significant eye makeup prior to using (for light eye makeup and non waterproof mascara I don’t bother with that step), just so that I am not spending a lot of time rubbing at my eyes which can be irritating. I never find I need a second cleanse after using this.Just a side note - The directions for this product say to use about two pumps but I find I need at least five to thoroughly cleanse, and I do not have a large face by any means.
product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

review_text: I have huge pores and I have been using this product for quite a bit now and I really don’t think it’s working for me. It literally clogged my pores
product_name: Salicylic Acid 2% Anhydrous Solution Pore Clearing Serum

review_text: I wanted something to moisturize, even out my color a little and give me a dewy glow. It does it all!!! Plus enough SPF to let my skin get color yet keeping it from burning. Perfect for year around y’all!!!
product_name: Smart Broad Spectrum SPF 15 Custom-Repair Moisturizer for Dry Combination Skin

review_text: I got this as part of an order as a free sample in a small tube. I wanted to try this thinking it had a very similar formulation as the cult favorite ultra repair with colloidal oatmeal as the first ingredient. I have yet to try that one, but this one burned my face as soon as I applied it. Its a little lighter than a heavy moisturizer (as it should be), but since I have eczema I don’t recommend it, or if you have drier patchier skin on your face. Also the amount of ingredients in this is kind of ridiculous.
review_title: Burned my face as I applied it

review_text: I usually buy products based on other people’s reviews and now I’m glad to leave a review of my own. I love this product. I think it does help in lightening my acne scars and gives good moisture too! I don’t use a separate vit c serum that’s why i chose a vit c moisturizer. Will buy again!

This gel cream is refreshing and effective! I love using this during summer time where my skin doesn’t require a heavy moisturizer. However, my combo skin needs something more hydrating during winter. I will add that compared to other moisturizers, the ratio format/price isn’t the best for this one. If you have the $$ and want something light for summer, go for it!

I used to use this cleanser all the time. Mine was starting to run low so I went to buy a backup and saw a new name and bottle. The salesman assured me it was the same so I bought it. It is NOT the same! It broke me out. I checked the ingredients and I was right it is different! I wish he would have been honest. Please bring back the original!

This stuff is great! Even better...SO affordable! I use it on my face some but actually more for my stretch marks on my stomach (thanks to my kids-they’re lucky I love them ;)). I do microneedling and then apply this after a few times a week and other days just apply to my skin morning and night. It is definitely helping tighten my skin and I am happy with that! I have recommended to several people. One friend said she uses it on her face religiously and it has cleared up dry eczema patches she had been dealing with for years.

I am not sure why there are so many bad reviews for this.... it’s amazing! It absorbs beautifully and hydrates my under eyes really well. I’ve noticed a difference in the “plumpness” of the skin around my eyes since using this. I love the addition of the rose quartz roller, and how convenient the little package is. I will definitely repurchase.

WORTH THE HYPE. i have been trying a lot of luxury high end brands, but this works for me, making my skin look gorgerou​​s and soft.​.try it for a few days you will see the difference, maybe not for everyday routine but using it a week before prom/ wedding/ gala ;)
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: I tried to replace my SR and DE products with Ordinary products. I get hormonal breakouts and have combo skin. This product, along with the buffet serum wrecked my skin: inflammation, breakouts, enlarged pores—awful. Yes I understand purging, it wasn’t purging. My skin just looked and felt terrible.As a beauty nerd I was excited to see that someone was focusing on a consumer friendly version of common and useful ingredients. However these products are harsh and encourage fungal acne. Switched back to SR and my face was healed within about two weeks. SO worth the money, I feel like I had a cheap fling with these products and now I’m back on the wagon.
review_title: shocked this works for so many ? cheap=harsh

review_text: I absolutely love Farmacy products. Let me tell you, you have not lived until you’ve used this makeup remover. When I say it’s mind blowing, I’m not exaggerating. The tiniest amount melts makeup away like magic. My tattoo eyeliner disappears instantly. I have extremely sensitive skin and thing leaves my skin feeling soft, fresh, and clean, without any worries of breakouts. It also has a light pleasant smell with a somehow creamy yet oil free feel.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: This used to be my absolute most favorite moisturizer and hands down worth the price. The formula changed and I thought I would give it a go despite the bad reviews. It’s somehow less hydrating, heavier and makes my skin feel oily which I never had with this product before. It just feels greasy and not hydrating like before. It used to smell amazing previously, like an expensive scent, which is also gone now. I am so sad ☹️
review_title: PLEASE BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL FORMULA!
product_name: Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Cream Moisturizer

review_text: Immediately when I started massaging this into my skin a realized it was a bad idea. It was way too rough for my sensitive skin and felt like I was rubbing my skin with sandpaper. Because of this, I am not sure if the product actually works well or not, but beware if you have sensitive skin, it might be too rough.

While this has a fine texture and absorbs well, it smells awful—like dirt. I’m okay with natural or even medicinal smells, and prefer products without artificial scents, but this was gross I almost could any get past it, but it was expensive, so I kept using. Gave little white and blackheads on my cheeks, so even more texture. When I stopped using they went away; when I began using again they came back. No noticeable improvements, and I used the whole bottle hoping my skin would adjust. I had MUCH better results with the strivectin retinol+vitamin c product.
product_name: Advanced Retinol + Ferulic Texture Renewal Serum

review_text: I got this as a sample with an order, and I’m now ordering the full size jar. My face always hurts during the winter, and this did wonders, especially considering that I started wearing it during a snowstorm! It’s not greasy, absorbs quickly, and seems to have reduced my red patches within a week. I don’t have acne, but I do tend to get little surface zits when I switch creams, and that hasn’t happened with this one. It’s great under makeup and even by itself- no shine! I can’t recommend this product highly enough. If you have dry skin, this is the answer.
review_title: awesome cream for dry itchy skin

review_text: I have dark spots on my chin and I get ingrown hairs. After exfoliating I use it and the hairs are popping out more than going under the skin causing less plucking and picking. Skin is also smoother and dark spots lighting up a little

I received this product from Influenster and I cannot say enough great things about it. I have super sensitive skin and this product didn’t cause a reaction of any sort. I see a huge difference in my pores as well. The smell and the packaging of the product are beyond amazing as well. Such a pleasant experience after trying this and I will definitely be using it all this summer!
product_name: Watermelon Glow Hyaluronic Clay Pore-Tight Facial Mask

review_text: I love this primer. I use it as a moisturizer and a primer since I have oily skin but this is beautiful it does not leave my skin greasy at all and almost seems to help with the oils while leaving my skin luminous. It smells really good too!
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: I wanted to like this, but I was left disappointed. It did slightly reduce redness, but not enough to make me want to purchase the full size.
product_name: Cicapair  Tiger Grass Camo Drops Color Corrector SPF 35

review_text: I used this cleanser several years ago to fight a bad case of cystic acne. Once it was under control, I guess I just returned to drugstore brands. Now, about 4-5 months ago, the cystic acne returned with a vengeance and I fought back with Murad Clarifying cleanser again. It has NEVER failed me. it’s good for hydration & is super light weight — BUT it has coconut in it. i hate coconut and if you have sensitive skin it’ll make you break out. 🤍

This mask is INCREDIBLE for my skin! It’s more of a gel consistency so it’s thick but powerful. I can’t leave it on longer than 5 minutes or I have some redness (this is common for my skin). It’s definitely brightening after I use it and time using the mask around any events for the brightening effect. I am a mask junkie, and this is absolutely a favorite! Highly highly recommend!
product_name: Resurfacing Saffron AHA Masque - Radiant Rani

Amazing product. My skin is definitely glowing!! :) I am on my second bottle right now.

product_name: Sunvisor Radiant Moisturizing Face Sunscreen SPF 35

product_name: Willow & Sweet Agave Plumping Lip Mask

If you have an oily skin, I would only apply this to the area that need extra hydration, and avoid the T-Zone. Overall it is a beautiful moisturizing cream!
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: I don’t hate the product. The finish is a nice matte finish that feels more like a primer than a sunscreen. I’m pale and I didn’t notice white cast but the product is sheer so that might not be a problem. I have issues with the packaging. The pump doesn’t work on my bottle and I have to open it up and scoop it out.
product_name: Invisiblur Perfecting Shield Broad Spectrum SPF 30 PA+++

review_title: Love the color of the Tint

I received this as sample, was hoping for the moisturizing effects, unfortunately this was way too strong a fragrance for me to be able to use. If, however, smells don’t bother you, this might be a really decent product.

product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: I actually bought this peel mask in store before there were any online reviews. I just finished my first bottle and picked up my second. This peel mask is really gentle, so if you have sensitive skin it would be good for you. It has a minty cool feeling when you let it sit on your skin. For more exfoliating power, I actually leave it on longer than what the bottle says. I use it every 3 days and I keep it on for about 30 minutes and then follow my routine with a sheet mask. It’s worked great for me! My pores are not completely diminished but I definitely see a difference in my acne scarring/spots in the days after I use the mask.

I have very sensitive, oily skin and a bit of roseacea. This oil made my cheeks break out horribly. But I put it on my eyes instead of moisturizer/cream at night and it made all the little lines around my eyes go away and my eyelashes have grown soo long! I love it! Will only use this on my eyes from now on.
Streaky & orange. Get the isle of paradise dark mousse.

review_text: Couldn’t be happier with the timing on this product. Around this time of the year I develop some dryness around my eye and this was very handy. I’ve been using it every night before I go to sleep and when I wake up in the morning all the dryness is disappeared leaving my under eye area looking smooth and my concealer doesn’t feel or look patchy either. Highly recommend this product if you struggle with dryness around your eyes.
product_name: 24-7 Power Swipe Hydrating Day & Night Treatment Eye Balm

review_text: Feels hot on my face and it made me break out (I have oily/combination skin) doesn’t exfoliate much no matter how many different amounts of water I used even no water. Sugar crystals dissolve quickly on my face.

I have used Peter Thomas Roth products before and have really really liked many of them. I was not disappointed when I tried this product either! It was very hydrating but incredibly light. I am very picky when it comes to skincare and this exceeds my expectations! Once you rub the solid cream between your fingers it becomes much less dense- almost whipped. It spreads nicely and my skin looks radiant right after applying it. This has helped with my skin in the cold winter months when it becomes dry and flakey. I have been using it for a few weeks and certainly notice a difference in my skins brightness and complexion.
It’s done nothing for my skin but it has a nice scent and texture.

tried this and loved it

light weight, moisture great!

I will say that there are better products on the market , all in the similar process range, that work, smell and sit much nicer.

Not an impactful tint like those lip tints that stains but it adds a light sheen like isn’t too drastically different from the watermelon version. Can’t go wrong with either one! Highly recommend! Complimentary from glow recipe but opinions are my own.

review_text: So, let’s talk about the elephant in the room right off the bat. $25 for lip balm. Really?!? It better be good, as in the best lip balm in the history of the world good. With high prices come high expectations. This delivers on every front. It’s just so pleasant in areas where others are not. It glides on effortlessly and evenly, it smells nice without being remotely perfumey, it has a subtle lemony flavor (like other Fresh Sugar products), and it just plain works. Also, it does not contain SPF, which is important to me as I am very sensitive. Any lip product with SPF ultimately dries my lips out, thus rendering that product useless as a balm. I also really like the packaging - it’s a white, metal lipstick tube with a bottom that screws on and off for added security. No putting your fingers into a messy tub or trying to spread balm evenly with a squeeze-tube applicator. Just apply like lipstick and wait for the magic. It really softens and moisturizes more than any other balm I’ve tried (and I have a drawer full that range from drugstore to high-end). Also, the texture is perfect. Not at all heavy or waxy, but like a layer of silk on the lips. It melts in, but still leaves your lips feeling moisturized and not like you need to reapply. It works well under lipstick and on its own. I guess they know what this balm is worth. I really did not want to fall in love with a $25 lip balm, but it happened. You’ve been warned.

It is not gentle at all, which says it all about the kate somerville brand. Nowadays, products are supposed to be gentle no matter their effects. I will just stick to korean skincare products, as usual. Not only does this product not produce any noticeable benefits, but it noticeably is harsh on the skin. There are so, so so many infinitely better products available on the market. Do yourself a favor and blindly pick and buy any korean cleanser, they will knock this out of the water for sure. I do not understand why so many American brands are unable to formulate products that are exfoliating, but not harsh. The point of chemical exfoliants is that they are supposed to be gentler on the skin than manual exfoliators; however this is not the case for many popular American products. Unless you are Kate Somerville’s relative or friend I do not see why you would buy this disappointing product and do some cognitive dissonance to believe that this is not an absolute flop. Maybe I just have sensitive prone skin and this product is not for me. However, we are living in 2021 and kate somerville is clearly not with the times. Nowadays, skincare products are formulated such that they are suitable for all skin types, especially for sensitive skin. This product meets 2008 standards, very bad but honestly I guess it was my fault for expecting ANYTHING from a brand such as kate somerville.
