Because it goes on so quickly, it makes a great base for other skincare products. It doesn’t bother my skin even though this lotion has acids in it, and it’s actually very relaxing. I’m excited to see how this serum changes my skin over time.
product_name: Strawberry Smooth BHA + AHA Salicylic Acid Serum

review_text: This Black Tea Age Renewal Cream has some of the best ingredient decks I’ve ever seen for anti-aging and hydration. The texture feels very high-quality, and the product feels incredible on my skin. LOVE! I got this complimentary from Fresh.
product_name: Black Tea Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix

review_text: I have an oily skin, and my main skin concerns are oily shine and loss of firmness. It is not easy to find a skincare routine that would address my both concerns. I like Abeille lotion because it makes my skin feel tight and clean, but at the same time hydrated and smooth. The toner has a strong luxury smell, which I love, but if you are scent sensitive, that product may not be right for you.
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Fortifying Lotion Toner

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Murad. And while most of my acne scars have been removed from BBL and Halo treatments, as well as micro-needling, I had a few left over from some recent breakouts. I have just started using this product and it says the results might take up to 8 weeks! For some people with a lot of acne scars, there is no way this 0.5 OZ jar is going to last even a month! I personally think this is a way to get repeat business. I really hope this works! I started using it on my acne scars and will report back in 8 weeks, or as soon as I run out of this cream, which will probably be sooner! I am also not recommending this product yet, because I have no idea how effective it really is!
I like this product but probably wouldn’t purchase again. There are alternatives for a better price. :) This product leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh
Didnt work for me. I normally love tatcha products, but this has been my least fave.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Just wow !! After struggling with breakouts recently, my skin has been so dry and dull from harsh products and over exfoliating. I think that only a few days of using this product has brought my skin back to life ! I have been using it in the mornings with my normal skin care routine. It goes on smoothly and doesn’t feel sticky or flake off and my makeup goes on flawlessly after using it. I definitely have seen a difference in my skin’s tone and texture and I can’t wait to keep using this product.
product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

review_text: I was so eager to try this product out from reading all of the reviews online, however when I got home to use it I was highly dissatisfied! After only using it one time my skin felt like it was on fire! It literally burned my skin where it began to peep! I have quite sensitive and this is definitely not the cleanser for me and am currently trying to repair the damage this cleanser had done!

this product was shocking... first time using I was surprised at how the product came out. I honestly thought it was old, I thought I bought a bad product. it did not remove my makeup well, especially eye makeup. I would not recommend.
It was a little too strong for me. My skin is pretty blemish free and I just wanted to lighten a few areas and it really dried out my skin.
product_name: Potent-C Vitamin C Targeted Spot Brightener

review_text: Such an amazing product! Great smell, great texture. Made my skin feel so hydrated and moisturized. Works amazing with foundation because of its color corrector qualities. Definitely will keep using. My skin looks and feels incredible. I received this product complimentary for sampling purposes but all my opinions are my own!

This oil came in a very nice package, the bottle was pretty as well but that’s about the only thing that really stood out to me about this product. I had very high hopes for this based on the hype I had seen from it on the internet and the price point. However, this left my face unchanged and somewhat worse after a week of using this. It has a terrible smell that I was okay with if the product would have worked. Even though this is an oil it still left my face extremely oily, like too oily... unlike other face oils I have used in the past. It also did not help with any acne and made my skin texture very bumpy and gross. Using this at night also made my skin texture horrible in the morning.
product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil

review_text: I LOVE the Lala retro cream (and other DE products like the Sukari baby facial). I had high hopes for this cream, and bought full size without trying it first. Big mistake - it broke me out. I don’t get breakouts, ever, nor is my skin sensitive, but this product just didn’t work for me. I tried it 3 separate times, after giving about a week break in between, thinking it may work but all 3 times I got 4-5 breakouts (that left marks!). Returned it to Sephora store near me. Definitely try a sample before you buy the full-size. I’ll be sticking to Lala!

I’ve been eyeing this cleanser for months and was excited to finally try it. First couple times I liked it and the fact that it really did foam up. After a couple of uses, I did notice my skin getting very dry and that’s coming from someone who has extremely oily skin. My skin felt very tight and I hate that feeling. I didn’t notice it balancing my skin either. I will use this up but won’t be repurchasing it.
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: Great product but expensive. Feels good on my skin with no residue. I’m sensitive and I don’t react at all. It’s very pricey for a face wash tbh

This biolumin serum gifted me by dermalogica. This daily brightening vitamin serum moisturizered my skin and gives a brighter look. I feel very soft and healthy skin after I started using this gel. Also I noticed my fine lines are disappearing day by day which is great. I love this serum is vegan, curtly free and gluten free. I highly recommend. I use this serum day and night but during day I use SPF for more protection.
Was excited to try CEO Glow. Unfortunately, this product smells like a petting zoo. I couldn’t stomach using it or putting it anywhere near my face. Had to return :(
product_name: C.E.O Glow Vitamin C + Turmeric Face Oil

review_text: As someone who has struggled a lot when it comes to their skin, I have to say that I was a little surprised how well this product worked for me. I have mostly oily skin with a few little dry patches and it is always so hard to find an actual good anti-blemish anything that actually works. I’ve been using this mask for about a week and it is fabulous! I had cystic acne that had been there for almost two years down by my jaw line and have tried countless treatments on it. My first morning after using this, it was almost all gone! I could not believe it. My face felt so smooth and not one blemish in sight! It is by far my favourite product carried by Sephora and if you anyone is suffering from blemishes and acne than I highly recommend this mask. I hope anyone who buys this is as satisfied as I am.
review_title: HEMP IS THE WAY TO GO

review_text: I always double cleanse, but this didn’t take much off from the start. Had to return it.
product_name: Mini GO OFF Makeup Dissolving Mist

review_text: This sunscreen is thinner and rubs in nicely, but it’s very oily. It left an oily but kind of sticky feeling once it dried completely.I received this product complimentary to test.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

review_text: I started using this oil back in February after i had gotten a sample of the Herbivore Lapis oil. I love that oil, but it is way too expensive for my price range right now. The maracuja oil was the first oil I used after that sample and i’m so happy I tried it out because I’M HOOKED. I’m on a skin care routine that involves a lot of acne creams. Eventually the creams started to dry my skin out to the point where I would have so much texture. That’s when I started implementing oils into my routine and I can’t imagine my routine without them. Like I said, I’ve been using this oil everyday for the last 3 months and my skin has never looked or felt better. I haven’t had texture since about the second week I started using it and it has taken down most of the redness in my acne scaring. It’s so worth the buy.

I have combo to dry acne prone skin so I was hoping this would help clear up my skin. But it made me break out even more and made my skin really sensitive. After using it even the FAB repair cream that I use everyday started to burn my skin. I switched to Kale-Lalu-yAHA by Krave and that’s worked a lot better for me.

This moisturizer was great. I liked that it didn’t really have a smell, it was quick to soak in, and a little goes a long way. The only reason I didn’t like it is because once it was on, I felt like I couldn’t wash it off my hands easily. I guess that could be a good thing, though, because it means it’s not going to just come right off my face. I also only gave it 4 stars because it’s a bit pricey for the amount of moisturizer you get. Overall I’m happy I got it, but I don’t think it’s going to be my go to.

It feels like a strong exfoliate. Has a sticky feeling when applied. One might feel it a tad too strong especially if one is not used to chemical exfoliate. It is advised to use it once a week so I guess in terms of value if one uses it once a week a container can last for a year.But I do agree with other reviewers as you can get similar products which might deliver same result without the big price tag. I would definitely wait for the sale to purchase this.
product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask

review_text: If I could give this zero stars I would. It’s thick and doesn’t move or spread easily even when adding water. And to top it off it doesn’t remove makeup very well...not even for a double cleanse routine. There are much better oil cleansers and balm cleansers on the market right now. Skip this one

I used this for 3 weeks, as usual when testing an item it broke me out but instead of going away it got worse not clearing up until after I stopped using it. If you’re prone to breakouts when trying something new I don’t recommend using this item. Maybe if I used it for longer? I just couldn’t handle it anymore because it was a painful breakout
product_name: Micro-Dose Anti-Aging Retinol Serum with Ceramides and Peptide

review_text: This eye cream is super rich and moisturizing, but it doesn’t really ever sink into my skin. It just sits on top looking greasy. At this price point, my eye cream should feel good and look good on my skin, and this just doesn’t. I’ve used it under makeup with ok results (but I prime and set with powder), but I really just don’t see how skincare that doesn’t soak in is doing anything for me.

This is a really great daily cleanser. I had been using the “oil cleansing method“ for awhile but I hated the smell and having to mix it myself. This replaced my system with something that smells divine and works better anyway. It keeps my skin comfortable. Every other cleanser had made my skin feel itchy and raw. I’ve been looking for this for years.

This made me break out so bad. I used it diff ways and my face didn’t clear up will I stopped using it. My skin is normal to combo skin. I’m hoping I can return it. If you have dry skin I think it would be better.
This is an excellent product. Long wear and looks great! No need for lipstick.
review_title: This is may favorite lip product!

review_text: Might be great if you have oily skin. It has too much alcohol for my sensitive skin. And a lot of what’s balling up is the product and not your dead skin. It’s way too harsh for my face and I’ve been using it on my feet instead. I also felt that the video was misleading so will not be buying any Wishful products.
product_name: Mini Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: Thick, greasy and caused breakouts. If you have acne prone skin, I don’t recommend this product.

I have dry, sensitive, acne-prone, scarred skin with massive pores so I’ve tried it all when it comes to skin care. This product was recommended to me in-store for more “instant results“. It delivers! It shrinks my pores, smooths my skin out, and tends to leave me with clearer skin for a few days. A bit pricey, but I’ll definitely make the purchase again!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Meh. It was alright. I wasn’t “wowed” about it or anything. It didn’t sink into my skin. The scent was nice but that’s about it. Nothing special. Luckily I got it for free through Influenster
product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: ive read many reviews about this oil before buying it , so at the end i bought it , i starting using it in the morning with my skin care routine, after two days i started watching breakouts in my face i stop using it and my face calm down but then i tried again and the same happened i wont buy it again tho !

This magic cream from Charlotte Tilbury has been a favorite of mine for years! It’s definitely magic on your skin! I love how it instantly moisturizes without leaving a greasy residue! It feels absolutely luxurious on the skin!
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: Picked up this mini size to try it out since everyone keeps talking about it. Smells good and I like the consistency. It did make my face sting my first time using it. I feels like the mask just sits in top of your face and provides no actual moisture and Im seeing that a lot of the reviews say the same thing. I wore it to bed a couple nights and woke up with my skin being dryer that it was before I put it on. I don’t think this is worth the price you pay, I would recommend saving your coin and investing it in something better.
Living in Alaska..the air is very cold and DRY. This toner is great. Your skin feels moisturized instantly and I like the fact that you can ’spray’ it directly on your face..

It’s a good cleanser but, won’t be purchasing again. The aesthetic of the container is great but, mine kept leaking and coming up through the opening after I used it. Most of the cleanser was wasted down the side of the bottle.
Wasn’t too much of a fan due to the toxic ingredients in it but it smelled good and felt soft on the back of my hand. *I received this product for an honest review.

Haven’t noticed any changes in my skin since taking these but have been more “regular” so they may be helping on the gut aspect. Don’t think I would repurchase as they haven’t done anything special. I received these complimentary for review purposes.
product_name: Skin Squad Pre + ProbioticSupplement for Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: Thia stuff is awesome! Ive only used it once but my skin feels so smooth and looks so clear!
product_name: Mini GOOPGLOW Microderm Instant Glow Exfoliator

review_text: I received a VERY VERY small sample of this to try from Influenster...whether it breaks me out, I don’t know - whether it does anything good or bad at all, I don’t know. With ANY skin care item, unless you have a sensitivity to a certain ingredient, you need to use it consistently for at least 2 weeks to form an honest opinion and if I had received enough product, then I absolutely would have done that. However, since the sample I received was so small, the only opinion I’ve been able to form is I despise the way it feels on my face for the first 10ish minutes; it feels very similar to liquid bandage, but all over my face, until it absorbs - afterwards I don’t feel anything at all. If I could leave 0 stars, I would.
review_title: I’d love to give my opinion but...

review_text: the same stuff in this toner is found in my makeup brush disinfectant... also this toner is great at cleaning pantent leather shoe scuffs.way too harsh for ones face!and it is very drying.

I’ve had the product about a week and my oil feels like an oil field :( I just can’t stand that feeling anymore. I was hoping this would be the product that would help my face but the oily skin is disturbing and I can’t use this with my makeup either it even makes the product slide ☹️
review_title: Not the best moisturizer for acne prone skin
product_name: Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: I was hoping that this serum would replace my Drunk Elephant TLC serum because the price is so steep but I didn’t see the same “wow” results that many other reviewers seem to have experienced. There’s nothing particularly wrong with the serum but I’ve been using it consistently for about 3.5 weeks and haven’t noticed any difference in congestion or clarity of my skin, which sort of defeats the purpose. I experience consistently clear and smooth skin when I’m using the Drunk Elephant TLC serum and will likely just go back to using that, despite the price.
I loved the old formula, but this is just nothing special. Even the change in packaging is a step down! It’s no longer worth the price for me, so I’ll have to find an alternative.
product_name: Mini Water Bank Blue Hyaluronic Cream Moisturizer

review_text: THIS is the best gentle peel I have used in a LONG time. It gives results without having my face look like I’m recovering from a sunburn! Overall, a great product when complemented with the PTR retinol cream! I would definitely use both together if possible for better results
product_name: Even Smoother Glycolic Retinol Resurfacing Peel Pads

review_text: I’m not sure how well this product works, but it doesn’t “warm up” enough to spread on the delicate eye area. I’m tugging on my skin which is exactly what not to do. There are other retinol eye products out there, so I would probably not buy this again.

I got the Sephora rewards silk pillow case and really liked it. So I decided I get this because I thought it would be even better. As much as the Sephora isn’t real silk and many people have complained, I’ve found them to be identical in looks/feel and they function the exact same way. Some reviewers have said you can get cheaper that are the same. I’d agree as the “vegan” silk was the very same in how it kept my hair and face smooth overnight. Gave it 4 stars because I thought a much more expensive one would have felt silkier. Maybe because it’s made “washable” it was closer to a cotton sateen. I wanted something really silky because I’d have loved my air be a tad more sleeker in the morning.

I am just in love for that eye serum! I have dark circles and the skin texture is different from the rest of my face. It is a little dry and has very tiny bumps.. It bothers me because makeup can’t cover it fully. But after 2 weeks applying this serum before bed I can notice a huge difference under my eyes. My skin looks better, more hydrated and smooth. The tiny bumps look better as well. I highly recommend it if you want your under eyes to look rejuvenated!Disclaimer: I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.
review_title: My under eye skin texture is WAY BETTER

review_text: Like the mask, I really wanted to like this product - the smell is amazing! However, it is not hydrating. In fact, shortly after spraying my face with it, my face somehow felt dry after it settled. And I don’t even have dry skin - I’m combo with some dehydration issues, but not full-on dry! Had to return it, I didn’t even have it for a full day.
I used an entire bottle and a half and noticed nothing. Please note, this tingles (almost) burns on the skin but goes away after a while. It also leaves skin feeling very tacky.
Makes my skin feel instantly more hydrated! I use it in the morning and have a nice glow to my skin all day
product_name: Great Skin Instant Glow Serum with Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: accentuated my skin’s texture and left me slightly greasy by the end of the day. nothing special
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: The product feels very light and smells great. I’m prone to breaking out with just about anything that goes on my face but this hasn’t caused any breakouts...yet. Hopefully, it stays that way. It also makes my skin feel very soft. I would recommend this product.

I wanted to love this cleanser, but I couldn’t get past the smell. The formula itself is gentle and feels great on the skin. I did notice that on days I had any amount of makeup on I had to use the cleanser twice (I always use a balm first to remove the makeup). The smell was just too strong for my liking. I was only able to use it for about a week. A mild scent or none would be better.
product_name: Squalane + Amino Aloe Gentle Pore-Minimizing Cleanser

review_text: I got a sample of this recently and had just gotten over a bad cold - the type where my nose had been rubbed raw to the point where the skin was peeling... applied this stuff on my nose at bedtime and the next day my skin was completely back to normal and soft again! Overnight! I’ve tried heavy duty creams, the FAB cream that does work well, but nothing is as good as this product! Highly recommended. I have loved everything from this brand so far- they make amazing and effective products!
product_name: Honey Savior All-in-One Skin Repair Salve

review_text: I’ have been loving the St. Tropez Self-Tan Luxe Whipped Crème Mousse. It goes on so smooth and silky. It has a color guard which is amazing for a seamless application. It will transfer onto your sheets if you apply before bed. I recommend applying in the am to wash off before bed. It smells amazing too!

I have used this product for six years and have loved it but the tube is now poorly made and the tip breaks off. The first time it happened the tube was almost finished and I ignored it. I bought a new tube and the same thing happened after only using it a week. Sadly, even though the product itself is excellent, the quality of the packaging has greatly deteriorated so I won’t be it buying again.
This stuff is awful! Dried my face out. My face was peeling, pustules all over my chin, and what looked like dandruff in my eyebrows. It’s taking me a month to recoup.

I have been a loyal Drunk Elephant users as it seems to be just the right formula for my sensitive skin. I decided to try this new retinol product for my aging skin. After a single use my skin dried up, tight and became very flakey. Knowing that I need to cautiously introduce retinol to my skin but I am slightly nervous to try again due to the initial reaction. Therefore I am not sure that I can provide an official verdict but initially my sensitive skin didn’t react favorably.
review_title: caution for those with sensitive skin

review_text: Love the feel of this cream and it kept my Dry skin hydrated without feeling greasy. Noticed an improvement in my skin as well. Definitely buying a bigger size!
review_title: Best Day Moisturizer for Dry Skin!!

review_text: This product is so highly recommended that I had to try it. I hate to say this but it irritated my skin. Not only that, but the smell to me is overpowering. The spinach/greens smell is too intense. I would use it if it worked for me, but the irritation obviously just isn’t worth it. Somehow, even when keeping my mouth closed I get this nasty taste in my mouth when using the product. I’ll stick to my aveeno calm and restore cleanser. It’s much cheaper and does a better job for my skin.

I bought this product after finishing up another BHA product that really helped my skin, and I wanted to try something else. One of the Sephora employees recommended this product to me for fighting acne and it ruined my skin. I broke out like crazy and had dry flaky patches. I tried using it for little over a month but it continued to cause a bad reaction to my skin.
review_title: Caused my to break out and have dry flaky patches.
product_name: Mini Goodbye Acne  AHA/BHA Acne Clearing Gel Face Body Spot Treatment

review_text: I have been using it every night before bed and sometimes during day time from past two months. No change in dark circles.
product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream

review_text: My order just came today and I was so excited to try this. But reading the packaging, it says to replace the discs every 3 to 4 uses?! The Sephora site doesn’t mention anything about having to buy more discs, which you have to buy from the PMD site directly. Returning this asap. The idea was to not spend more money. I don’t want to buy the discs for the rest of my life. Also, that’s a lot of garbage being produced when you throw out the discs every month. NOPE
I’m not a fan of this product. It didn’t really do anything at all. I ended up returning it.

This was truly so so so terrible. I’ve used so many cleansing balms/oils and I wish I had understood better that the spray and the wipes are intended to be used together. It melted my makeup down well enough but when I wet my face to emulsify the oil and rinse it off to double cleanse the water just beaded up on top of the oil. You literally need a separate makeup wipe to get this garbage off your face before you can actually wash it with a cleanser. I really don’t think I should need to purchase an entire separate product just to make another product function the way it says it should. One Size has designed flawed, low-quality, and wasteful products. I had thought everyone was past aerosol cans and single use wipes but here we are in 2020 with not one, but TWO products that are damaging to the environment. I do not recommend buying this mist unless it’s exclusive purpose is removing swatches, I had to wash my face 3 times to get most of the oil off and it broke me out very quickly after using the mist. I wish I could give this negative stars.
review_title: don’t buy this unless u hate urself!!!!!
product_name: Mini GO OFF Makeup Dissolving Mist

review_text: This product is not for sensitive skin, I had to stop using it.

I received this serum complimentary from Ren Skincare for my honest review. This is such a lovely serum! When I saw it was creamy, I was afraid it would be greasy, but it’s not at all. It sinks right into the skin & leaves a lovely silky finish. I love the smoothing effects it gives & I do believe it brightens your tone over time. This is perhaps not the strongest vitamin C serum I’ve used (I’ve tried all kinds from cheap to most expensive), but I believe it’s more effective in the long run because I’ll actually use it every day, unlike the “stronger“ ones that are either sticky, smelly, or make my skin “tingle“, which I don’t enjoy. I really like this and would repurchase. I also love the citrus smell & pump packaging!

I’ve been using this charcoal mask with my boyfriend over and over again. He LOVES it and always asks when our next face mask session will be. It leaves your face feeling clean and soft. Pores are noticeably smaller and there is a lot in the packaging, allowing you to have face mask parties with lots leftover!
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I’m always on the search for a better primer. Since I use (and love 3 Tatcha products, it seemed natural to give it a try. Did not make even the top 3 in my book. I felt it did nothing that what I expect a primer to provide: Skin Prep for makeup, a soft foundation/finish with make applied and long wearing (at least throughout the day). Sadly, It did not perform.
product_name: Mini Liquid Silk Canvas: Featherweight Protective Primer

review_text: This eye cream is very hydrating and soothing. I have quite sensitive skin, but I had no trouble with this eye cream. It is pretty heavy and would be visibly moist for hours despite using a small amount, so I used it at bedtime mainly. The puffiness under my eyes showed a significant improvement- I really love this eye cream.

#freeproductThis is amazingly lightweight and so soothing on your skin. I use it at night time before going to bed and im in absolute love with it.I used to have dull skin and within a week i see improvement, helps me with my dryness and best thing is it hydrates the skin which is perfect for winter season. so far in love with it
review_title: amazing sleeping mask and light weight

review_text: Using this mask is a lovely experience. I usually use it at night while I’m in the shower. The mask smells great, like rose-infused tea. The texture is wonderful, like a soft gel. When I first put it on, my skin tingles for just a moment, but no stinging or tightness. I wash it off at the end of my shower and my face is unbelievably soft, my skin looks ethereal and the aromatherapy has put me in a happy relaxed frame of mind.I wish Fresh made a body treatment and face wash like this mask.It is a superb product in my opinion.

I use new products with a very suspicious demeanor. There are so many claims of various products and this one is super expensive! I was blown away though. I couldn’t stop looking at my skin that day due to the dramatic difference this made. I put it on before my foundation and wow! It is so amazing!

Look, I love the scent of roses and use a rose-otto moisturizer often. But this has such a strong scent I literally couldn’t get to sleep till i washed it off the first night. Unholy levels of scent! Kinda tweaked my sensitive skin too, and I didn’t use a lot-- tried three times and tossed the rest of the trial size. No matter how little I used it was too much smell to bear. Bummed because I love several other Korres products.

I love interactive products like this. Getting to make my own serum was so much fun. However, the instructions were not as clear as I would have liked them to be, especially when it came to opening the pump, as you have to pull up instead of twist. My pump fell apart but luckily I was able to put it back together. As far as the product itself goes, I love it. The only thing I hate is the smell. It smells like bacon. As someone who doesn’t eat pork, it is a turn off, but once it dries down onto my skin, I don’t smell it. It performs like most vitamin C serums, but I haven’t used it long enough to see the difference it makes in my acne prone and hyperpigmented skin. I notice that, when I use it, my skin is brighter and fuller and plumper. I always wear a layer of sunscreen over this.

I received this from influenster and have been using it for a few weeks now. It has an interesting texture, it looks and feels thinner than it applies. When you apply to skin it gets thicker. I find the scent to be strong and stays around for you to continue to smell it for awhile. Very floral. I feel like the cream sat on my face vs absorbed - which I think would make it a better night cream than night/day cream. I haven’t seen any noticeable results and not sure that I would.
product_name: Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: I am 58 years old and have tried plenty of products over the years that have disappointed. This product (and the Caudalie Vino system) have done more for my skin in the past year than any other products before. My age spots are noticeably lighter and my skin is smoother than ever.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: Decent cleanser but not worth the price, just go with any other drugstore face wash tbh.

There really isn’t much I like about this aside from the price. The texture feels very strange, gritty almost. It also separates very easily in the tube. I use this as a first cleanse, so I always use a second cleanser afterwards, but with this I would have to. It just leaves a greasy residue on the face that does not fully emulsify with water. product_name: Charlotte’s Magic Eye Cream with Retinol

Amazing product. Gentle on skin for daily use and does it’s job perfectly. Foams up and skin feels smooth refreshed Nd cleansed right after. Would buy again.

review_text: Wow I love this stuff! I’m 21 with sensitive, rosacea prone skin and lots of freckles. I’ve been using this for a few weeks now and I really feel like my skin is clearer and brighter. And it’s for sure less red which I love. But I also love the consistency of this! It’s super watery and thin so it’s perfect for mixing it into serums and moisturizers to easily add it into your routine. I use 3-4 drops every night on my face and neck. I highly recommend it because retinol (vitamin A) does so many wonderful things for the skin short term and long term.
It’s hydrating. Leaves the skin smooth and it actually smells good.
product_name: Thirst Trap Juice Hyaluronic Acid & Peptide Hydrating Facial Serum

review_text: I noticed others loving this product but I don’t feel the same. First of all it’s water so putting it on you lose most of the product pouring it into your hand unless you use a lot but it’s way too expensive in my opinion to lose so much of it plus I didn’t see any difference at all!! I like other Tatcha products but this product I just don’t see the benefit.

I really loved this moisturizer till I went to go see my dermatologist and learned that this product had a ton of chemical ingredients that are no good like oxybenzone, avobenzone, octisalate, octocrylene, homosalate and octinoxate which will absorb into your body. If you’re looking for a moisturizer with SPF please opt for one with zinc and titanium dioxide which will give you a protective barrier instead.
product_name: Oil Free Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: This is a super gentle cleanser that removes makeup really well. Doesn’t irritate my eyes, and most things do. My boyfriend has sensitive acne prone skin that he is on medicated creams for, and this is the only facewash that helps calm his skin that we have tried. We buy the value size 400 mL bottle now because it is worth the money for us.

I received a sample of this and really liked it, and then made the big dive and bought a full bottle, using a sale. I used it daily and did not seem to have the results that I had just using the sample, way too much for a skin product.
product_name: Needles No More Wrinkle Smoothing Cream

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Laneige. It is a unique facial cleanser product. It is very gentle and works well in dry and sensitive skin like mine. After washing my face, it leaves a moisterizing feeling.

The initial smell of this cleansing balm was okay, but after rubbing it in, the smell gets worse. I told myself I would get used to it, but nope. I don’t hate myself that much. I was only able to use it twice. The first time to try the product and the second to understand why I hated it the first time. It leaves a residue on my skin afterwards, which I didn’t like. I’m sticking to cleaning oils. Others may love it better than I did. If It did work out the plus side is that it is a large amount of product for a cheap price.

These didn’t do anything for my skin. I didn’t see a glow improvement or anything else. I already have super healthy skin, so it naturally glows. I think this is a gimmick. Take care of your skin and use good acids rather than spending money on “glow.”

I actually really love this mask! The consistency is thick and feels like a fluffy cloud of moisture. I put it on and then leave it, after a while I rub in excess. So far my sensitive skin has not broken out even though it is a heavy cream. The ingredients are great and I notice some plumping due to the moisturizing effect. Will continue to use as a moisture mask for my sometimes dehydrated skin!

review_text: I cannot lie, I gauge all sleeping lip masks by the OG, Laneige, and this one fell a bit short as a sleeping mask. It does, however, work amazing as a throughout the day lip balm. It isn’t as thick as the typical lip mask and wears great underneath lipstick, gloss, particularly liquid lipstick. I mean, my lip kit game is definitely enhanced with a layer of this underneath. One thing I appreciate about Laneige is that there is an exfoliating element to the lip mask that I wish more lip sleeping masks that are getting released would have. One thing is for certain, if you like Belif and are looking for a balm that is hydrating and smoothing, check this one out. For a lip sleeping mask? Possibly look elsewhere.
My skin glows after using this product for only two weeks now. You can feel the product working the second the serum touches your skin.

This cleanser is lovely. I heard about the hype for this brand. I was fortunate enough to receive it to review from Influenster. I get the hype. It gives the skin such a lovely glow. I used it for weeks and can honestly say it’s nice, but I’d prefer to spend the money on the moisturizer over the cleanser.
review_title: Nice, but spend it on the moisturizer
product_name: The Cream Cleansing Gel with TFC8 Gentle Cleanser

review_text: I’m loving that this is a foam like toner and how quickly it absorbs into my skin. This definitely makes my skin look so smooth and toned. I like how comfortable this feels as well. This makes my face feel more refreshed. Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics
product_name: The POREfessional Tight ’n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster for my honest review. I was excited to receive it because I’ve used the water drench moisturizer from this line and love it. review_text: I read and heard such good reviews. Did not live up to expectations. Used the entire box consistently, even upped my routine to morning and night a few times. review_text: I received Shiseido Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen complimentary from Shiseido and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42

review_text: I liked the feeling and finish of this lotion. It’s really smooth.. BUT when I used it for a few days I noticed all the little wrinkles in my skin and it was really dry. review_text: What is good about this product: SPF, Tiger Grass, oil-absorption. I worry about the long term effects of it settling into my pores and perhaps making them worse over time. That being said, if you put foundation over it for special occasions it helps with staying power and oil control. I am happier with this as a date night product rather than a daily product. Which is what I had hoped it would be.If you have larger pores I would still recommend the line, just not this product. Instead get the Tiger Grass Serum, it is amazing.

It breakdowns the makeup so it removes easier when washing is my opinion.Sell Bamboo Booster separately PLEASE!!
review_title: Bamboo Booster is amazing for exfoliating!

review_text: Maybe I got a bad batch because other people seem to love this, but this leaves the worst greasy film on my skin and I’m already prone to breakouts so this is giving me more acne and more texture - two things I was convinced weren’t going to happen from a product like this. It definitely doesn’t feel like I’m putting something of that low a pH on my face, so maybe I did get a bad batch...I’m really confused about it. Yes, it’s affordable, but I would much rather drop the cash on something more expensive that actually works well and doesn’t make my skin worse.
review_title: The worst toner I've ever used

review_text: This product is great. My skin felt new and refreshed. I received a free sample of this product from Pinchme in return for me honest review.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: i love this stuff!!! all the acne and irritation on my skin shrinks overnight when i use this. i recently started on accutane and this balm keeps my skin feeling soothed, and i wake up feeling hydrated!

I usually use Sunday Riley or Herbivore face oils (Herbivore - Orchid is my favorite) and decided to try this on the recommendation from other reviews. My skin is dry and the oils seem to hydrate me only for a few hours; by morning, for instance, my face feels dry again. The quality and consistency of the Clarins oil is great, however it has a really strong “earth“ smell - like patchouli, which I usually have somewhat of a tolerance for (I love Byredo’s 1996 and Gypsy water, for instance) but having it on my face, smelling like a hippie’s armpit for 6 hours is ... too much. It doesn’t seem to be any more hydrating than Orchid, or any other facial oil I’ve tried, so I’m opting to return it. I can deal with a lot in the name of beauty, but not this.
product_name: Blue Orchid Radiance & Hydrating Natural Face Treatment Oil

review_text: I was really excited to try this as it had great reviews, but found it extremely drying. I have dry/oily skin but I thought I would try it even though it does state it’s for oily skin. I will be returning it as my skin is dryer than I originally thought, but I think this would be a great product if you don’t have dry skin.
product_name: Rare Earth Deep Pore Minimizing Cleansing Clay Mask

review_text: I love this serum! When I got into my 30s, I noticed the shift in my skin- it’s not as bright and glowing as it was in my 20s, now I have to work for it. I combined this serum with my typical vitamin C serum in my morning routine and noticed a huge difference in just one week! I haven’t noticed a huge change in the size of my pores yet, but I know that it will probably just take a little bit longer to see that effect.
product_name: Clarifique Pro-Solution Brightening & Dark Spot Reducing Serum

review_text: This didn’t do anything for me. It is green in the jar and it’s supposed to blend to skin tone and have some sort of blurring effect? All I got was grease, no blurring.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Super lightweight face and hair oil. It doesn’t leave a greasy feeling on my face and hair after it soaks in. It’s super light for your hair and keeps it soft and shinny.

I received a full size jar of the Dior capture as part of an #influenster campaign, but this review is my own honest opinion... I love this stuff. I live in Michigan where the weather is currently freezing and my skin is taking a beating. This stuff is so hydrating. I use it day and night and can feel a difference in my skin. There is a fragrance that I don’t mind, and have expected with Dior products. It’s very good and I will repurchase
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

review_text: Unfortunately this didn’t really work out for me. Pros: It felt great and never felt sticky. Cons: Initially it smells like cleaning products but doesn’t linger. I also noticed after each time of using it I had red spots on my face the next day.

This stuff is magic that makes me glowy and it’s super gentle on my temperamental face. I love the lack of unnecessary scents going on here. I bought the sample size just for kicks and now I’m absolutely planning to get the full size version. I need more products like this in my life.
It’s a good mask, but I’m not too sure I see much of a difference in my skin! I’m not too big of a fan of the scrubbing properties in it either. Wouldn’t repurchase but I’ll finish it up.

I used this moisturizer twice a day and I couldn’t be happier with it. I have pretty oily skin and this doesn’t make me feel greasy. I’m a huge fan of majority of Glow Recipe’s products in general and I’d have to say that this moisturizer is very oily skin friendly. It makes my face feel fresh and tacky at first, after it thoroughly soaks in my skin feels super soft. And the smell is a nice touch but not at all lingering or overwhelming. Would definitely recommend.
Granted I have melasma but unfortunately this did nothing for my spots or skin. Not for serious dark spots
product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Solution Duo

review_text: This works, when you put it and dry you can feel how it stretches your skin, the problem is that only dry but not absorbed, when you use any other product after this, like eye primer or concealer this rolls and falls apart
product_name: Capture Youth Age-Delay Advanced Eye Treatment

review_text: This is my 100% honest review, though this was gifted by Fresh. The product has some beautiful ingredients, which I was so excited to try out. But, unfortunately for me, it has an overpowering fragrance that smells like a perfume you’d spray on your body. The scent lingers. I’m not sure why companies in 2022 are electing to add in extra (non-natural) fragrances. They can always lightly improve the scent with plant extracts, or just leave it non-scented. For me, I couldn’t continue using it on my face due to the overwhelming fragrance. It’s also overpriced.
product_name: Black Tea Anti-Aging Moisturizer with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix

review_text: ok, im gonna keep it 100 here, i have been using this serum for about 3 weeks between products- so for example, i would use it either during the day, or night, never both. I have not seen any change to my skin that i should be seeing, i sometimes come here to the reviews to see what it has done for others to maybe compare what it has done for me... so far, I think this is one of the hyped products, the reviews made me do it...lol... I will use it out eventually, but i dont think i will be ordering this one again...
review_title: meh.. I'm recommending because maybe you need it.

review_text: I am allergic to chamomile. This serum makes my face hot and burns. I wanted to like it and use it with my EL moisturizer, but I cannot.
product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

review_text: The formulation has changed, years ago it was made with algae and now they use charcoal, it was much more softer on the skin and really helped with pores. I bought recently and have used it until the tube was completely done and it didn’t do much for my pores, skin, etc. Yes it exfoliates but I don’t see a dramatic change in my skin like I used to with the old formulation. Save your money and switch to more effective exfoliants like Paula’s Choice BHA (get the mini for $10 and it will last for MONTHS depending on how frequently you exfoliate. I use it 1x-2x a week)
review_title: Formula Changed not worth the money anymore

review_text: It is not pleasant to apply. The skin around your eyes is so delicate and it feels like it’s doing more harm than good when applying. I would not recommend.

Was excited to try this but overall disappointed. It was not as cool as I expected and the rubber mask fell off within the first ten minutes, when it is supposed to be on for thirty to fourth minutes. Face sheet masks that cost three to four dollars work better in fifteen minutes. Not worth the money
Really wanted to love it but it was just an unfortunate experience. The one star is for the cute packaging and beautiful colour of the product itself. The actual lip mask however dried out my lips.
I absolutely love this cream for aging skin. It smells yummy and feels so good on my skin. I used it with the serum and I can tell a huge difference in my skin after 3 days

Don’t usually like overtly citrus smelling products,but love this one. Its fresh and subtle. It goes on well,but is a bit sticky. The stickyness goes away with moiturizer,but works well with foundation with the tack. I received this for free for testing

I have really dry skin - to give you an idea I have pretty severe facial eczema (I use protopic twice a day, everyday) and have had this suggested to me by numerous people. I finally gave it a shot, for an extended time too and found it did almost NOTHING for me. It’s super greasy and just sits on top of my skin but it doesn’t feel like it’s actually moisturizing anything for me. For what it’s worth, my mom (who also has dry skin) found it didn’t help her either. Also, I found the packaging to be kinda gross. I know it’s meant to be more sanitary rather than putting your fingers into a jar continuously but I was personally put off by the extra globs that dried up that didn’t get used.
review_title: Didn’t work for my facial eczema
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: Excellent product perfect for getting rid of dark circles under eyes. Take a few days to show that it’s working but it works. Also good for getting rid of oily skin.
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Eye Concentrate Matrix Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I received this product free to try and I must say this product has helped my skin a lot with adding it to my skin routine. My skin now has a healthy glow and I would recommend this product for anyone to try who is trying to get back their glow.

I had no idea what I was missing before I tried the Dior Dreamskin Care & Perfect Skin Creator!As soon as I applied it, I noticed how soft and even it made my skin look and feel. My foundation went on flawlessly and I actually had to use way less foundation since this made it so much easier to apply. It’s like a perfect primer. Throughout the day, I could tell my make up had a nice matte finish to it without appearing dry. I kept getting compliments on my appearance even though I haven’t changed anything else in my make up routine. I haven’t used it long enough to notice a reduction of dark spots and wrinkles but I definitely already notice a decrease in dullness. I’m excited to keep using it to see long term benefits. The package also seems big enough to last a while. I only have to use a little amount when I apply it and a little bit feels like it goes a long way.
Really wanted to like this, but did not. My skin did not feel more moisturized in the morning and had areas of breakout that I haven’t had in over ten years.
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: disclaimer: I have extremely sensitive skin!!!! I used this for a while, felt it working because there was a not unpleasant stinging after application. but, I expected that to go away once my skin got used to it. unfortunately that never happened. my skin felt rougher after use, so I may be allergic to something. there are citrus extracts in here, which may be a problem for some people.
product_name: Mini Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: I’ve gone through the whole bottle now, and I just don’t know that I’ve seen a difference! I have stubborn acne scars from cystic acne and was looking forward to this product. For the price, I thought I would see an obvious difference at some point. I want to rate it higher, but there weren’t any real pros for me.
product_name: Dark Spots No More Triple Acid Spot Minimizing Concentrate

review_text: Felt nice and minty. Was afraid the cool tingly feeling it gave would burn my sensitive skin but it did a good job of exfoliating without overdrying. At first I didn’t know whether to apply on dry skin but I still did it. Then added a tiny bit of water then worked the product in. It felt good during and felt good after.
I can tell absolutely no difference when I use this product or don’t, and I don’t care for the smell.
review_title: Should do more for the price

review_text: When I bought this, I expected an actual nose strip that actually sticked and everything, but it really doesn’t, kinda like those bad stickers that just won’t stick. It obviously didn’t do anything either. Total waste of money.

I had high hopes for this cream, as I needed the depuffing and dark circle minimizing. Unfortunately, after using this product for three months straight, twice a day, I have not noticed any difference. My undereye area doesn’t look any different than it did before. The dark circles are still there, and skin around my eyes is still puffy and baggy. It’s disappointing because finding a good cruelty free product isn’t easy. For the cost I expected a little improvement. I will not use it again.
review_title: Didn't do what it claimed to.
product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles

review_text: I got it because the Fresh sugar advanced therapy balm wasn’t available. Not a good decision. This balm melts on my fingers instead of my lips and feel really, really sticky. It smells like caramel but also with a weird note that almost smell like saliva. It also doesn’t taste as decent as other Fresh lip products. Overall, I don’t like it and will give it away.

I love the packaging and the price point. But you’re pretty much paying what you paid for. The ingredients are great and all, but this product was not as effective as I’d thought it’d be. After application, my skin around my eyes tend to peel and it makes me quite discouraged about it. Used it for 6 months straight with no results.

Umm no, no and no! I literally am convinced this is the dial soap that you can get at your local Walmart in this bottle. It smells and has the texture just like it. Does not lather or cleanse at all! It’s very jelly like so very hard to pump out as you get closer to the bottom. Please DO NOT waste your money on it.

I accidentally got a tube of this cleanser as a free gift during the skin care challenge, thinking it was a tube of the Soy Face Cream I had already been using. What a lucky mistake! I use a 3-piece acne system at night, but have found that cleanser to be a little harsh to use twice a day. I started using the Soy Face Cleanser every morning instead of the acne system cleanser, and it has made all the difference. It thoroughly cleanses without being even the slightest bit abrasive or gooey. The scent is very earthy and “soy-ish.“ On the occasions I have used it at night to take off my makeup, it has worked extremely well and even gently removes eye makeup. “Silky,“ (as it says in the product description) is a good word for it. It’s thin and goes on easily. It doesn’t foam, but it thoroughly cleanses and leaves my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. I get that “aaahhh“ feeling every time I use it. Soy is so good for your skin. This stuff is gentle, and has not caused any breakouts or irritation. It doesn’t take much to cleanse your face, so the bottle lasts a long time. Try it! You’ll get hooked, too!

My skin LOVES this stuff. I always end up coming back to this to rebalance my skin when it gets angry and upset from other products. I love that you can use just a little bit and still get excellent hydration. Absolutely worth it, especially in the value size!
product_name: Mini Ultra Facial Moisturizing Cream with Squalane

review_text: First off, this smells like the original Oil Of Olay. Which is very nostalgic but not necessary. Also I was unable to use it before wearing makeup because mo matter what products I put over it and no matter how long I let it soak in, it pilled on my skin. So I couldnt wear make up with this moisturizer. Even using it at might all my other products cause it to pill. I would not recommend this product even at half the price.I have photos of the pilling but this app wont let me add them.
product_name: Capture Totale Super Potent Rich Cream

review_text: I received this an actually liked the compactness of this case. Its cute and can be tossed in your purse without being clunky. Unfortunately this is going back because upon opening one of the compartments the plastic cracked and can no longer be closed. This just shows it isn’t very durable and I’m glad I found this out within the return policy. I won’t be repurchasing.

It costs an arm and a leg which is why I wait until VIB Sales to purchase it. I’m on my second bottle. I like that this essence gives my skin a glow like I’m glowing from within. This is my Holy Grail!
Not good. I got acne after using two days of this serum.
The top of the dropper comes off. After each use, I have to try to put it in place and today spilled the whole bottle, while doing that.
Hydrating and smoothing! In addition to using this overnight I also use it to complete a day look over lipstick or lip balm. Highly recommend! As always, Alpyn delivers quality products!!
product_name: Willow & Sweet Agave Plumping Lip Mask

review_text: I received this as a sample and did not like it at all. It was extremely oily. I felt like I had baby oil on my face. I felt like a dirty mess using this oily concentrate.. just a Big NO for me. Anyone with extreme dry face may like this. It didn’t even absorb. The oil just sits there. I mixed this with a body lotion and it made my skin soft but nothing new happened.
product_name: Midnight Recovery Concentrate Moisturizing Face Oil

review_text: This product was a game changer for my skin. I have rosacea so it is very difficult to find products that don’t irritate my skin. After using this product along with the beste cleanser / alternating with the facial bars, my skin looks SO much better. My redness is not nearly as bad as it was, and I am not getting the rosacea bumps all over my face. When I am having a flare up, it is much easier to control since using these products. I have now purchased this moisturiser twice and will continue to buy. Skincare is so different for everyone however these products really work for me and my sensitive skin!

I was so excited to try this product after literally every influencer raved about it, but after using it twice, several days apart, each time it somehow made my dry skin even drier. And my sister, whose skin can handle pretty much everything ended up having a reaction to it after her first time trying it. Save your money.

I ordered this product on Sephora’s 20% discount a couple weeks ago, I was so excited to try it but unfortunately, it arrived damaged & of course, this product was out of stock & y’all know how this one ends, you get what you pay for! I might consider it again on the next Sephora sale.
review_title: little engine that probably could but didn't!
product_name: Brumisateur Natural Mineral Water Facial Spray

review_text: Amazing cleaning oil. Very gently Cleanse my sensitive skin. I did not notice and dryness and irritation after I used it as a make up remover . My skin feels clean but still moisturized. I was gifted by Kora
Had high hopes based off reviews. However, for me, it didn’t work at all and was a waste of money.
A bit disappointed in this product as it does not de-puff the eye or show any noticeable change. Nice texture of the product but would not buy again.
I’ve used (and liked) many Ordinary products, but this has been my favourite so far. Goes on easily and leaves my skin feeling plump and moisturized.

This product is just average. The disappointing factor for me is that the sample was much more potent that the actual product. I bought this product based on the sample results and feel I wasted my money. It is upsetting!

I purchased this and use it every day, but to me I feel like if it dries them instead. my lips now are chapped and dry, and you really do have to put it on every 30 min to an hour. to me this is not worth it

I’m always very skeptical when it comes to powdered drinks. In all fairness I tried it twice. I wanted to like it but unfortunately I didn’t. The taste was the biggest turn off for me. While it is citrusy, it has a bad after taste that I couldn’t get over. In terms of what it did formy skin? I’m not entirely sure it benefitted me at all since I only used it twice.
This completely dried out my skin after a few uses. If you already are on the drier side I would not recommend this cleanser.
product_name: Confidence in a Cleanser Hydrating Facial Cleanser Serum

review_text: This is garbage. It does absolutely nothing, it’s overpriced, AND it causes acne. I love St. Tropez products. I’ve used them all. This is a huge miss from them. It imparts NO color- I used it alone, with lotion, maximum drops etc. I got nothing. I’m very fair, and I always pick up a lot of color from self tanner. Not this. Save your money. I had to return.
review_title: Worst St. Tropez product. No tan, causes acne.

review_text: I’ll stick to Dr Jart. I saw no improvements when using these Peace Out and they were a pain to keep on. I bought 3 sets. Nada.

Waaaay overpriced. Thankfully, I received this as a sample. I used it for a month and saw no results. And, my face never turned red, as warned on the product label. For reference, I have normal skin, slightly oily t-zone.
Pilled so bad no matter what was on my skin. Not as glowy as I imagined.. the FENTY spf adds more of a glow & doesn’t pill. Definitely not for make up wearers

I received this cream complimentary to try! I have used it at night and during the day. Works well under makeup! I love how it melts into the skin and is very easy to apply. It absorbs quickly and hydrates. I am looking forward to seeing some long term results from this product. Worth it!
review_title: love how it melts into the skin!

review_text: Nope, just not. It’s a huge headache to get the white cast rubbed in. I would MUCH RATHER use a Supergoop Unseen sunscreen or Missha Sun Milk. After all the rubbing it honestly felt like I was just stretching out my skin and causing premature aging!
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: I was gifted by La Mer and I’m quite surprised that this product contains petrolatum, glycerin and synthetic fragrance with such an elevated price tag. I personally feel this moisturizer is to greasy and requires a larger amount than suggested to cover the face. It’s not very absorbent and I am not pleased with the scent. I really expected so much more from this product. I will continue to use in hopes to see results with fine lines but probably would not purchase.
Deeply cleans the skin. I can feel the skin a little tight after use!
finished a jar and saw no difference. did not help with brightening

Really loved this product for the most part. I noticed a dramatic reducing of pigmentation on acne scars while using this, and a reduction in redness. It also provided a lot of hydration and smells wonderful (love the light grape scent of Caudalie products!) The only downside for me, with oily skin, is that I found this left me a little shiny. Wouldn’t repurchase for that reason, but I’m looking into other Caudalie products that are a little lighter on hydration.
This product is not hydrating at all! I had to moisturize after using it because my face felt as if nothing was applied, and this brutal winter calls for something that actually moisturizes.

This stuff is great I love it so much. The benefit makeup is amazing and im so happy they came out with skin care stuff it’s absolutely amazing. I definitely will be using it a lot more and buy it in the future
product_name: The POREfessional Tight ’n Toned Pore-Refining AHA+PHA Toner

review_text: This sunscreen is just ok. I like the fact that it’s clear and has no white cast whatsoever. It’s is greasy so I don’t wear it on no make up days, I think it works well with makeup because of setting powder. It does have a bit of a strong sunscreen scent, more than other sunscreens I own but it’s not bothersome. Even though it is greasy I haven’t broken out from it which is a plus. I think this would work well for someone with dryer skin.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

review_text: The best lotion in the game, you totally need this in your summer must haves.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

review_text: Just buy a pack of Smackers lip gloss. Thats literally all this is. Wears off very quickly, smells bad, and is far more sticky than an oil should be. It doesn’t moisturize at all. Im not sure who wrote the positive reviews, but this product isn’t worth more than the few dollars for a children’s lip gloss. It’s a cute bottle, thats it. Very disappointing
product_name: Cherry Treat Conditioning + Strengthening Lip Oil

review_text: Hi! I like this product so much, You only need a small amount and it does an amazing job to spread evenly. Highly recommend as it provides a nice glow to your skin and gives it a radiant, thank you!! Gifted By REN Skincare

i’m so happy with this product. Application was super easy. It goes on clear and it’s hard to tell if you’ve missed a spot or not so use a mitt to get even distribution. It was sticky in the first hour or so which was uncomfortable and it also started to develop that tan smell (which i hate) but overall great product!!! Very natural and radiant.
review_title: amazing results for a pale gal

review_text: Superb. Glowy skin and so hydrated. I’ve repurchased multiple times.

for the first time in a while, I no longer need to wear foundation or concealer because of this. my skin is literally GLOWING. this is pure magic in a bottle. can’t say enough good things about this product.

Love love love this product. I had it a while ago and just rebought. And realized that I NEED this always. It’s creamy and makes my undereyes so soft. I have dry under eyes and I haven’t had any patchiness with makeup or anything. Still using to determine if it brightens my undereyes, but I think there has been a slight improvement of my dark circles. Love the packaging and over all it’s been a great product in my routine. It is a bit pricey which is why i rated 4 stars.

I thought maybe it was me, but this suddenly made me very greasy, and was tingly/stung upon application. Now that I see word of a reformulation it makes more sense. Here’s hoping they don’t reformulate me off of the brand altogether.

This really didn’t do anything for me. I have oily skin, acne prone. At times I have dryness on my chin and nose and that may be from acne spot treatments. I came to sephora and I’m assuming the person was a Sunday Riley saleswoman because that’s all she was recommending. She recommended this cleanser when I let her know I was looking for something to cleanse pores, help calm my breakouts, etc. The first day my skin did feel clean and I would use this cleanser alongside my Michael Todd facial brush. But too be honest, after two weeks of using the cleanser it just didn’t feel like it was doing anything extraordinary for my skin and it dried it out just a bit so definitely not for me, I ended up exchanging for the deep cleansing Tatcha cleanser; hopefully that is a better buy.
product_name: Ceramic Slip French Green Clay Cleanser

review_text: I have normal skin, that can get drier in the winter. I wear this sunscreen over my skincare and under primer/makeup during the winter. It stays on, works, and does not make me break out. I purchased another one when my first ran out, because I tried a cheaper option (Eucerin with spf) but that made my face greasy, made me break out, and my makeup didn’t last through the day. I don’t have those problems with the Unseen Sunscreen, and the spf is higher too!

I liked the product, it surely isn’t the best but does provide a bit of an instant moisturized feeling, but also in my opinion leaves the skin feeling a bit sensitive my guess is because of the peppermint and citric acid, I believe that it doesn’t need the peppermint extract in the product and is also why I rated it as a three and if this product was formulated without the mint I think I would have a much better experience with this product.

I’ve been using this cleaning balm for about 8 months, and even when I try new ones I always come back to this one. Has a fresh clean scent that isn’t overpowering. Does a great job at melting away makeup, and doesn’t burn the eyes. This is a perfect cleansing balm for a two-step cleanse routine.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Didn’t work as expected. It is moisturizing but never helped with puffy eyes, circles or anything!! My under eye looks the same after I finished the whole bottle! This bottle is weird too, it is cute but designed to only have so little product inside! Too expensive for the quantity that you get and the quality is nonexistent.
product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: I want to start off by saying that I love the Tacha brand and what they represent. I love the idea of this serum stick because it’s meant to target dry skin, fine lines and wrinkles which are all things that I am all about fighting against. The reason that I am giving this product 2 stars is because it broke me out so much. I used would use this product on my nose, cheeks, and chin because that’s where my skin gets the driest. I even put it on my lips and that worked amazingly! But unfortunately my chin broke out so badly. I would only use the serum stick at night and would be mindful as to not put too much on but none the less. Even though this product didn’t work out for me, this will not stop me from using other Tacha products. I received this product complementary of Influenster
product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm

review_text: Wow this serum is so light and refreshing. It absorbs into my skin so well; leaves skin feeling so soft and smooth. I love how it’s hydrating as too! Love that it has niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, and ceramide!
product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

review_text: Tried it three separate times and each time, I broke out. I’m still dealing with the scarring after a whole year without use. I have dry and sensitive skin but was hoping this would help with keeping breakouts from happening.
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I really don’t know how anyone have given this a good review. It does nothing. No benefits, chapstick is probably just as, if not more, effective. My lips feel no different in the morning than they do the day before. Get a lip scrub if you want soft lips. It will be worlds more effective. Too faced has a great lip scrub IMO but honestly, anything would probably better than this. Save your money, get something else. Also, Sephora’s chapstick is also better which is I think $5. No brainer.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I read the reviews, that’s why I bought the product, I have dry skin, but this product definitely didn’t do what the Good reviews said to me...but it is just not moisturizing enough. review_text: I purchased this item a few days ago. My lips have always been chapped and it seemed as though no lip balm purchased from the drug store could ever cure it. This salve does! I love this cream it firms and evens out my skin tone ! I love how my skin is looking after using this ! I love that it moistures but is not thick and wears well under makeup

This serum goes on like a dream but there are no benefits happening with this that one hopes to get from a Vitamin C- like skin brightening. It smells great and the bottle is in point and very attractive. the pump is great. the ingredients are clean, I just don’t like it for a vitamin C serum. Amazing product!! Beyond satisfied

I got a sample and didn’t realize how little you actually need, rubbed the entire sample on my face and my face was purple and had to remove the excess. But when I woke up the next morning my skin was very glowy. And made the assumption that it was due to this product. So I decided to purchase the full size and try it out. I was expecting to not like it enough to justify the price. And figured I would end up returning. But I wanted to give it an honest chance. At this time I purchased it I happened to go a little exfoliation crazy and exfoliated too much hoping I could get rid of my blackheads and ended up damaging my skin barrier. I spent the next week and a half or so just focusing on repair and locking in hydration. I figured this would be good for my night routine at this time because of how thick it is. And every morning I woke up after I used it my skin was glowy. It def helped with the hydration. And a big concern of mine when I realized I damaged my skin and solely needed to focus on hydration was that it would make my blackheads worse than they were before I exfoliated. And I think I can credit this night mask to preventing my blackheads from getting worse during the two weeks I couldn’t exfoliate. So that was a huge plus for me. Now that my skin is healed, I don’t feel like I need to use this every night anymore. I use a lot of different products to do a lot of different things and decide what I will use based on what I feel my skins needs for that moment. review_text: WARNING: This product contains squalene. Squalene is made from shark liver oil. I checked the ingredients and it doesn’t say cruelty free. If you want to save our oceans, don’t buy this product or ANY product that contains squalene. If it is plant-based squalene it is okay. But if they do not specify it, it is most likely from sharks. It goes on very smoothly, and the dispenser is brilliant - it dispenses just the right amount in order to adhere to the precise application instructions (directly into your palm, and then you dot evenly around your face and smooth in softly). I like how it feels on my skin, especially at application: not greasy at all, and seems to absorb well. I usually follow it with my day or night moisturizer. However, despite all these positives, I haven’t really noticed much that would make me say that it lives up to the product description/hype. My skin tone has remained just about the same, and no demonstrative difference on my age spots. Admittedly, I have a lot of freckles and don’t think this product would change those, but there hasn’t been a noticeable overall effect. Even with combination skin, I found that it didn’t hydrate the dry parts of my face OR the oily parts of my face enough, resulting in flaking in my dry areas and excessive oiliness and breakouts in my oily areas due to the fact that my skin was trying to produce more sebum to overcompensate for the lack of hydration/moisture. I wanted to love it so bad because of how highly rated it is, and I tried to give it time to work, but eventually I had to just face the fact that, at least in my case, this product is no good. THE VERDICT: It’s definitely a product I WOULDN’T try again. Yes, the price point is great for a higher-end moisturizer, but I guess sometimes what you get is what you pay for. I have a hard time thinking this would work for anyone with Dry, Combination, or acne-prone oily skin.

The sunscreen does not mix well with other skincare products and balls up even if I wait over an hour between applying my moisturizer and this sunscreen. I also have very fair skin and this sunscreen needs to be rubbed in really well or it will leave a white cast. I will be returning it.
Not a fan. Texture is good. I’m not sure how I feel about the color dye of the product or on my skin. What I hate... is the bottle is peeling/chipping white paint everywhere. What a mess.
Mentholatum additive makes it feel “refreshing“ but seriously I get the same quality from johnson & johnson purpose face wash... I much prefer Cliniques Bar Soap.

review_text: I bought this cream when it was a part of the weekly wow and don’t regret buying it but wouldn’t buy it again. It smells great and goes on nicely and absorbs very quickly. I have combination skin that is more dry than oily. This cream was too light and made my dry patches feel and look drier than I would expect. Because of the patchy feeling with it I tend to use it at night blended with a couple of drops of my rosehip oil face oil.

This is a light weight moisturizing so it works well under makeup. I didn’t feel like it was heavy enough to really moisturize my skin though. I have pretty dry skin and I didn’t notice that this changed my skin much. Maybe over time it would. I’m curious as to why a probiotic cream would be good for you. Is there benefit to applying topically or just orally.

My new favorite eye cream. After applying this at night I felt a toy tingle, it wasn’t uncomfortable. In the morning I definitely saw my under eye area a bit more hydrated and plump. I received a free trail of this product and I’m so glad I did because this is so far the only eye cream I’ve actually seen major results with. I only wish it was more affordable but a little bit does go a long way.

Usually I use the unseen sunscreen, but I wanted to try something new. For reference, I am dark-skinned. This would not blend into my skin unless I mixed it with my moisturizer. I tried it about 3 times before I finally gave up on it. Waste of my money for sure.
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: Dries sticky and gluey on the lips. Overall I find other balms are more moisturizing than this. The performance is not in line with the high cost for a lip balm.

If you’re in the market for a show stopper, look no further.Let me start off by saying that I am in my mid thirties, have combination-dry skin that is acne prone. I have a solid skin care routine, that involves using gentle cleansers, salicylic acid treatments, nourishing serums and moisturizer/oils. I try to keep my routine to a minimum but I have a few different skin care concerns and am in need of different types of products to help deal with them. The Dermalogica Retinol Acne Clearing Oil is a dream come true. It not only helps to clear acne, but it also helps to renew the skin cells and nourish your skin too. Pretty much everything I need in a single bottle with salicylic acid, retinol and a blend of argon, jojoba, and rose hip seed oils. I know cleanse, use a hydrating serum, moisturizer and then apply this oil in the evenings, saving me time. My skin feels soft, smooth and glows in the mornings. I’ve had no irritation or aversion to this product and will continue to use and repurchase for more long term effects of retinol. I would strongly suggest you give this product a try if you have any of the skin concerns I do, as it is a gem of a product.

It was nice to use while it lasted. But it broke after a month. I’m pretty careful with my things. I even tried to glue it back together but it’s useless. A year later I still can’t bring myself to throw it away.

This stuff amazing for face and hands. I had such dry hands/cuticles (felt like sand paper) from moving and I put this on for a couple days and my hands are back to normal. I also even put it on my brows for that extra shine factor. It also lasts a long time, so don’t be scared by the price. I’ve had my bottle for a year.

Love the texture. Absorbs quickly and not sticky at all. But it broke me out every time I introduced it into my routine. Took a break and tried again x3. Prob too rich for my combo oily skin. Received complimentary from influenster.

review_text: I liked how cool this made my skin feel! It’s a tiny bit sticky, and for me, it didn’t layer well under makeup but if you’re going makeup free then this is a decent moisturizer! You can find cheaper ones that do basically the same thing though.

When I use the toner and hydrazen together, I notice that my skin has a more dewy appearance! I am more of a moisturizer girl though.

Terrible falls apart and separates way too much

I like how this doesn’t make my skin feel dry.
Extremely hydrating, although I wish it lasted longer.
