The formula of these drops is amazing. You can either use them as a serum, a primer under your makeup or to add some glow on top of your makeup! I haven’t tried it over my makeup yet, but I’ve been loving using it as a primer & nighttime serum. It gives me a beautiful glow under my foundation. It absorbs fairly quickly & is a tiny bit sticky but that goes away pretty quickly & I feel like it helps hold my makeup in place. I love the scent too! I’ve been using this nonstop over the last few weeks & my skin is noticeably smoother & glowing! Highly recommend this! (Gifted by Glow Recipe to review)

I got a small sample of this oil when I ordered the tarte Amazonian clay airbrush foundation. I have extremely oily and acne prone skin. Usually I wouldn’t be too excited about an oil because I use to think they were more for aging skin but I was completely wrong! Since the colder months I have noticed extreme dry patches and no moisturizers were helping including my murad and Clinique ones. So I decided to give this a try and after the first day I saw an unbelievable change in my dry patches and my acne scars have dramatically lightened up! I definitely recommend this product to people with scarring and hyperpigmentation.

I ended up breaking out. I used it for almost a month and I had these red ITCHY bumps all over my skin and they were unusually everywhere, in places I don’t usually break out. so I know that my skin did not agree with it, I don’t have sensitive skin but my skin would burn for a couple seconds and I don’t think this product should sting at all. I did notice though that my black heads diminished a little but since my skin didn’t agree with it I stoped using it and ended up returning it.

I received the Jet Lag Mask complimentary from Summer Fridays for testing and review purposes. Also, I have already recommended this amazing Jet Lag Mask to many of my friends and family and several of them have already purchased and used this mask and love their nourished and hydrated skin.

This cleansing balm is amazing at removing makeup. I had on Nars foundation and the Charlotte Tilbury setting spray (both long wear and stubborn to remove), and after using a pea size amount, all my makeup came right off! So glad I tried this product, I will definitely stock up during the sale!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Purchased based upon all the positive reviews. Felt great when first applied but after awhile product gathered in eyelid creases and made my eyes look worse than before. Also caused red, watery, stinging eyes. Had high hopes but just didn’t work out for me. Not for sensitive eyes.

I have been using this for quite a while and love it in conjunction with my vit c in my am routine. i am using tret 3x week on face chest and arms and this seems to bump the benefits of reduction of age spots aka sun damage. i stopped using this for a few weeks and definitely saw a reduction in skin color and tone, back on it for good.
review_title: Great addition to my routine..72 with dry skin

review_text: I just finished my first bottle of this stuff and it’s amazing. I have sensitive skin and it does wonders for it. The first product that has actually gotten off all of my makeup without having to repeat multiple times. Smells great,

I have been wanting to try out the Foreo line for soo long - I was super excited to get my hands on the Bear Mini! (complimentary from Foreo) First off.. how ADORABLE! It is the absolute perfect size for easy on the go access and to even throw in your travel bag. When using, it fits perfectly into all the contours of my face (especially in the hard to reach areas like above lip and chin). I’m still trying to get the hang of the app a little bit, but so far I am loving the app routines and how it shows you exactly everything you need to do step by step for the micro current facial routine! I love using the Bear Mini especially before my makeup routine to really carve out the contours of my face and start my base with a glowy smooth complexion! Definitely is a treat to use, and what I look forward to everyday, it’s like having a spa at home!! If you’re on the fence I would most definitely try it out - you won’t regret it!!!
This product is easy to use. Creamy and lightweight. Very hydrating and feels nice on the skin. Some flaking, even after exfoliating. Could need more exfoliating on my part.

I didn’t like this at all. It was sooo heavily scented and I couldn’t stand the smell. It also was super heavy and made my face oily. Overall just didn’t work for me at all. I recieved it complimentary through Influenster Voxbox.
After receiving a free sample from Sephora I was very concerned about how the vitamin C would react with my skin but to my surprise this product works great! I am sold on ilia products.
review_title: Definitely a must have in my beauty routine

review_text: I’ve been using this for a year now. I opted for bakuchiol because I am breastfeeding. the packaging isn’t great - you have to balance it upside down or else it’ll drip all over your hand when you unscrew the lid. the lid also is difficult to screw on, for some reason. (I think The Inkey List’s main problems are size and packaging.) anyway, after using for a year, I don’t see a dramatic difference. (it’s definitely no retinol and I plan on trying The Inkey List’s retinol after I’m done with this container.) I feel like it helps my fine lines but it does nothing for pores. it feels smooth going on - like a thinner face lotion - soaks in quickly. I use this and another moisturizer, which is perfect for my dry, sensitive skin... I just don’t know if it’s worth it as I march forward 40 years old, haha. like I said, may switch to retinol to experiment. I would recommend if you can’t tolerate retinol/have super sensitive skin, don’t have major wrinkles, or are breastfeeding/pregnant.

I’ve tried every spot treatment in Sephora and this was the only one that worked. You name it, I’ve tried it. This spot treat I put on at night before bed on the developing area and by the next morning it’s either gone or reduced in size by half. It’s not drying and peeling. I love it and will definitely buy again when I’m out! I’ve had this bottle for a month and it’s still full. I just a qtip to apply the application on.

SO GOOD! I received this product from Influenster in exchange for an honest review and wow I’m glad they sent it! I have sensitive and dry skin. This didn’t break me out, left my skin feeling soft and not irritated. I fully plan on purchasing this when I run out

I would give this serum a 3.5 if I could. I have a hate love relationship with this product so it’s hard to really determine how many stars it is worth to me. It does its job, it hydrates my skin, it makes it feel supple and hydrated as soon as I apply it and of course, you cannot beat the price. But the formulation just sucks, it pills up and makes you look like you’ve been shedding once the product dries down. It doesn’t take long to sink into the skin but by the time I get to work, I have to dust off the white pilling that’s this leaves all over my skin and it makes me not want to use it anymore. I have put this in damped skin, on dry skin,after my toner and essence and it behaves the same all the tine. I’ve tried other more expensive hyaluronic acids and you can definitely see the difference in quality. I would recommend it only if you’re willing to wipe off your face every time after application.

i get really dry, cracked lips especially in the winter & i have a terrible habit of biting my lips, so overall my lips are in bad condition most of the time, but this stuff is magic! it makes my lips soft, hydrated, and smooth! plus it smells lovely (but not strong)

Love Clinique products and this cream is amazing. I use this every night. It glides on my skin super smooth and absorbs quickly. Definitely a good cream. #CliniqueSmart

review_text: I like the product and use it as an overnight mask (even though it’s not directed that way). When I wake up, I like the hydrating feel of the mask still on my face. Love this my skin felt smooth right after

review_text: I wanted to like this product because it came highly recommended, but I quickly found that it was similar in consistency to petroleum jelly (like Vaseline) and didn’t really do anything remarkable for my face. I felt like to properly wash it off my face after applying, it required me to tug at my skin, and nearly always left my pores feeling clogged and dry afterwards. Usually I have the opposite problem with products, as I feel like they strip the oil from my face and make my skin too tight and dry. After a wash, my face would feel far more textured by the end of the day. I really disliked this. To make matters worse, when I finished the bottle, the product had started to mold inside the bottle and around the cap. I won’t be purchasing from Inkey list again after this one.

I have oily skin with large pores and I found this “water based“ cream to not have enough moisturizer in it. It made my skin more oily because it was trying to make up for the severe lack of hydration from the cream.

I have occasional breakouts and very oily skin but this would never sink or absorb into my skin and didn’t really help with moisture either.

Love the NuFACE Mini! I feel so fortunate to have this capability right in my own home. My skin looks more toned and a few stubborn wrinkles are beginning to disappear. Can not recommend this product highly enough.

review_text: I bought this cleanser while waiting for my favorite face cleanser to restock. I had been using Fresh’s Soy Face Cleanser for a few months religiously morning and night and LOVED the way it made my skin feel. I liked what this face wash was promising so I picked it up at my local Sephora and used it that night.AT FIRST this face was was okay. It was a very weird texture and I didn’t know how much to use, but overall it cleansed my skin alright. I didn’t notice any ~special qualities~ about it, it didn’t minimize my pores, reduce my redness, make my oily t-zone any less oily, or give me that wow factor I usually get. It felt very heavy and a bit thick, but I kept waiting for the wow moment, using it morning and night.A few weeks later I started to notice that it was increasing my redness and acne, and that my face was considerably oilier. It wasn’t anything absolutely huge- I didn’t have awful breakouts or anything like that, but my skin got bad in every single way to the point that I had to completely stop using this face wash and resort to my drugstore scrub. It has taken me MONTHS of scrubs, moisturizers, face washes, masks, acne treatments and more to get my skin back to what it was before using this product.

review_text: I am a huge fan of this cleanser. I am very picky and find most cleansers dry my skin out, even though I have oily skin. I used to use REN gel cleanser but it was hard to find. This is an excellent substitute.

I have combination skin and was excited to try this. Used it for about 2-3 weeks and it tried out my skin so badly. I thought giving my skin some time to get used to it would help but it never did. Had to return this to the store.

This is not for anyone with oily skin. Its way too thick and sticky. I am all about paying for quality but this just isn’t it. I personally did not see any improvements and I used up the whole bottle. Also, theres very little product for what you are paying for. This might work better for someome with dry skin.
Smells nice and feels good but I’ve broken out like crazy!! So disappointed

review_text: I bought this with some Sephora gift cards I’d been saving for several months. The fine lines are still 100% there and so are the dark circles. My makeup even cakes up over this eye cream and settles in the fine lines causing the makeup to make my eye area look worse. I won’t purchase this again.

review_text: I normally use makeup wipes to break up my eye makeup and my longwear foundation before going in with a cleanser so when I was recommended this I was pretty excited to hear that it should do both jobs and take away those extra steps.Pros: Breaks long wear foundation like a dream, leaves skin feeling healthy and clean, non oily.Cons: Does not break down mascara, after going in with numerous pumps I found a black ring around both eyes still lingered. Also it blurred my vision for about five minutes but I believe it’s because I put so much product on my eyes trying to get it to break down the mascara. After washing my face completely with this I went in with a cotton swab and there was still traces of foundation on my skin.Final thoughts: While it does what it says it does not take off mascara or eyeliner so I would still need to use an eye-makeup remover which really is pointless as this was sold to me to take away those steps. I ended up returning this sticking with an eye makeup remover and facewash.

product_name: All About Eyes Rich Eye Cream

review_text: I love this product. I’m nearing 40 and this is perfect. It freshens my eyes and doesn’t irritate my contacts. It gets rid of dark circles and helps any fine lines.
product_name: Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Boost 360° Brightening Eye Cream

review_text: This is perfect for wearing underneath your makeup because it feels like a primer. it’s pretty smoothing. It has a slight silconey slip to it. Highly recommend.

I wanted to love this. It smells great and that’s about all I can say. I’m very fair and it looked as if I’d applied nothing at all after the first use. So, I thought, okay I’ll try again. Sooooooooo ORANGE. I feel like for st. Tropez, that may be hard to believe, but it was BAD. Concept is amazing if they ever could perfect it. I am dying for something that is non transfer, but this just didn’t hit the mark. Basically choose any other St. Tropez product besides this one and you’ll be set.
product_name: Self Tan Purity Bronzing Water Mousse

review_text: I use this religiously, every morning and every night. Sometimes I’ll switch it up for something else (like my hydrationist lotion) so my skin doesn’t get to used to a certain product so that it wont work anymore but this is the best thing ever. It really rehydrates your skin and makes it incredibly soft and it smells nice too. It also comes in a cute little rectangular glass bottle, so be careful!
product_name: Mini Phoenix Rosehip Anti-Aging Face Oil - For Dry Skin

review_text: I was really excited to try this as I have never heard of a “toner serum“ before. Anything that simplifies my routine will get my attention. Unfortunately, after using over half the bottle and after 2 months of continued use, I have not seen any significant difference. Its slightly hydrating but that’s it. Not a big fan of the scent. Bottle is okay. For the results and price I will not be purchasing again.
product_name: Fat Water Niacinamide Pore-Refining Toner Serum with Barbados Cherry

review_text: I normally don’t leave reviews, but this went viral so I feel like other shoppers may want to know details before they buy. I’ve tried tons of lip oils over the years and and this one isn’t special, the reason I give it 1 star is because it’s very sticky and it has the exact same taste/smell as cherry cough syrup and I can’t stand that, and I usually enjoy regular cherry flavored/scented products, but this one is completely cough syrup scented. It also doesn’t provide enough tint to be worth it when I get a honey lip oil that hydrates my lips better and is way less sticky. Even after you wipe this off your lips are still a bit sticky, and like I said, I’ve had others for an even lower cost that made my lips feel great. If you like that kind of cherry scent and are okay with a product being a bit sticky it may be for you.
review_title: Over hyped in comparison to any regular lip oil

review_text: It’s okay - I’d give it 2.5 stars if possible. I’ve been using in conjunction with the DE Shaba Complex serum for 2-3 months now (morning and night) and I haven’t noticed a difference in brightness or anything else. Works fine under makeup and provides decent moisture (or maybe that’s from the Shaba Complex), but that’s about it. Definitely not worth the price, in my experience.
The only good thing about this product is the smell. It made me twice as oily as I usually am and had to change my whole skincare routine just to adjust to this product. Not worth it.
review_title: Only good thing - it smells good

review_text: This product does not work too well. It is only good when you aren’t wearing other makeup with it. Layering it does not work out at all. There is a build up of product if you attempt to put make-up over it.
product_name: Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener

review_text: My skin did not feel that moisterized at all by morning and it was also very thick. Made me breakout as well.

I did a test patch on my arm and had no traction or anything, colour looked ok. So I tried it on my face, mixed with my usual moisturizer and one drop of the oil. Two days later my skin broke out with the most disgusting cystic acne that I have never experienced before in my life. If you’re thinking about it, just don’t do it.
review_title: SAVE YOURSELF AND DO NOT BUY THIS

review_text: I love this revitalizing moisturizer. First of all it smells amazing, like sweet hints of Papaya and light fresh flowers blooming ( but not overpowering ). It has a gel cream like texture so it looks thick but goes on very smooth and silky. It instantly absorbs into your skin leaving it feeling very fresh. I enjoy how much it makes my skin feel alive.
product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: Left my skin feeling nice and smooth. But it’s very expensive for the size you get, granted a little goes a long way!

I will preface this review by saying I have tried on two separate occasions to make this moisturizer work for me. However, should I have to work that hard to make a nearly $90 moisturizer improve my skin? I am inclined to say no.My skin is dry, and is easily improved by the Saturday Skin water glacier cream. I am trying to use this up currently because project pan is real friends. My skin looks dry and dull, the cream has a bizarre white cast and is not easy to work into the skin. Thoroughly bizarre product.

Oily skin gals fave bronzing drops because they also have spf 30. Long lasting through physical activities and wears beautifully under other spf and makeup. Love DE drops at least 4 years before. These are better!
product_name: Super Gloss Instant Bronzing Face Drops with SPF 30

review_text: My sister gave me this product because it was giving her breakouts. My skin isn’t normally that sensitive so I gave it a try. It also broke me out all over after just 2 days of use. I’m still continuing to get new pimples even though I’ve stopped using it for a few days now.
product_name: Mini Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: Has a refreshing smell when applied and can instantly feel the coolness while the moisture is being taken to the next level. Applies easily and don’t have to use alot. It is currently next to my bed to applied daily.

It was only until recently that I discovered that any toner/lotion containing alcohol or denatured alcohol is part of the seven deadly sins of skincare. To my astonishment, after taking a hiatus from Clinique and repurchasing this bottle, I found that in the ingredients Denatured Alcohol is unabashedly listed! I had been using this lotion for a week and I reflected on my skin. I noticed my skin was breaking out like crazy, fine lines were starting to form all over my face, there were areas of dryness/coarseness that weren’t there before. Sadly, I will no longer use this product. When “Alcohol free“ toners and videos/articles on how alcohol in skincare is the primary for early signs of aging, how can Clinique not get with the program and continue to sell this product?

I’ve been using this product for about a month now and have yet to see any results. I have fine lines around my eyes and on my forehead I was hoping this product would help reduce the appearance of them but honestly all this product has done is make my skin break out. It smells great and it’s super moisturizing, it also leaves your face kind of glittery. I received this product free for reviewing purposes from Influenster and I was super excited to try it but this was definitely a let down.
review_title: Didn’t See Much of a Difference

review_text: This is really a decent mask! A lot of mask bother/burn my face but not this one. I like to use it 1-2 times a week depending on how my face is looking.
product_name: Mini Rare Earth Deep Pore Minimizing Cleansing Clay Mask

review_text: I hate it when people hype up a product, only to try it and be let down. However, in this case BELIEVE THE HYPE!!! This stuff is amazing. It feels like baby oil on your hands so you might think it’s greasy but it sinks into your skin leaving it sooooo soft. I have already received many compliments on my skin since using it and I have also used it on the ends of my hair and my cuticles. I’m hooked!!

Was so excited when I finally found something for my hereditary dark circles. Sadly, it did nothing for me. Been using this for a month and did not see a difference in my dark circles at all. I took this religiously and even took pictures for myself to compare so it won’t just be my ‘wishful thinking’ and no difference. Personally it was a waste of money.
product_name: Wing Man Liver Detox and Dark Circle Supplement

review_text: Really great anti-aging and brightening serum!
Not what I expected in an eye cream. It is not soft and spreadable.
review_title: Texture too stiff for an eye cream

review_text: I had read many reviews on this oil and so I was like let’s give the tiny bottle a try first. I have combination skin and so I was a bit hesitant about it because I thought it would make me super oily. But it does the opposite! It makes my skin be less oily and super smooth! Also works amazing on my hair which I had recently ombred. Just an overall amazing product and I will definitely purchase the bigger bottle!

I received this product as a gift, and I was hesitant about using it. I first used it in the shower. I rubbed it on my face and I thought that there wasn’t much “scratchiness“ of those exfoliating beads so I just assumed that it was a waste. WRONG. I got out of the shower and felt my face. It was as soft as a baby’s butt no hyperbole. My face was glowing. 100% will buy again. A little goes a long way, so this product will probably last a couple of months. Worth the price.

It was okay. I used in when I was in Alaska because I expected that the air would make my skin dry. When you put in on, it makes your skin a bit tacky. That takes a while to dry off and I am not sure I like that feeling. But it sure is hydrating. I got this from Influenster free for purposes of review.

This cream made my skin feel somewhat greasy, and you don’t need to apply much product to cover the whole face, so the greasy feeling wasn’t from to much cream; after 4 hours (without makeup) my face feels sticky and unpleasant.I being using this cream for 4 weeks now and the only change I’ve noticed, is a skin more greasy.I’ve got my free samples from Influenster.
I was actually really exited to get this product, but it was a complete disapointment. It is not cooling, nor does it affect your eye bags at all.
This product did nothing reduce my dark age spots or past acne scars, and it smells horrible
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I received this #freeproduct to #trywithtopbox and, Wow! I have to start with the packaging on this, a small tube, nothing amazing there, right? Wrong, it’s the applicator on it that wins with me right off the bat, a flat metal tip, (can easily be removed for cleaning) to massage the eye area, so soothing, & cooling. This is my favorite eye cream packaging to date, full stop!Now let’s get into what the product actually is, and does, this has multiple patented anti-aging ingredients, along with a pearlescent appearance that instantly makes the eye area appear brighter. This absorbed very well, and moisturized the eye area amazingly well. I used it in both my am & pm routine. I am really impressed with this eye cream, another one I will be holding onto for the long term. The pearlescent’s do such a great job of instantly brightening the under eye area too, which is such a nice addition.
product_name: Premier Cru Dark Circle Correcting Eye Cream

review_text: I received this in my Trendmood box and I absolutely love it. I have extremely oily skin and large pores. I do feel like my texture is less obvious when I use this and it blurs my my pores a little bit

Despite not liking the heavy texture, I resisted the urge to return it. I stubbornly stuck with it, hoping that after enough time I’d see some benefits. The scent was not an issue for me. The problem was the product never really absorbed into my skin. My face felt like a sticky pool of grease no matter how little I applied. Now that I’m at near the bottom of the jar, I can’t say it did absolutely nothing. I have noticed that several old acne scars and a large sun spot have faded significantly. I just think I can find a different product that can do the same without the grease so I will not be repurchasing.
product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: I just got this eye cream and it’s super sticky and way too fragrant for an eye cream. the plaque on it looks pretty crappy for the price. I got the luxury serum when it first came out & loved it but this just seems like a flop
product_name: Bright Repair Eye Cream – 10% Vitamin C

review_text: I am not a lip oil fan, but I am hooked on this. It’s moisturizing, lightly tinted, and not sticky at all. It has a large doe foot applicator to evenly distribute the product. If you’re thinking of getting this, do it!

I’m only a little over 3 weeks in using the product and I’m honestly very disappointed. I was excited to try out Murad because it’s a great brand. And I have very stubborn acne scars some very old and some not so much. Well I first noticed them getting darker, and I was pretty upset... then the spots dried out, like really dried out to where they even look shiny. So I figured, okay great it’ll peel off and my skin underneath will be free of a mark. So I continued using. However when they peeled off they were either the same or white! So now instead of a regular dark spot I have white spot. Which is actually worse because I’m brown skin and the white spot is a lot more noticeable. I’m still using it, and i hope with continued use it gets better.
I love this cream. It seems like the only moisturizer that doesn’t break me out. It leaves my skin supple in hydrated. It also makes my make up last longer and less cakey looking
product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

review_text: The smell is pleasant, but overly intense, especially for a night cream. It started out feeling hydrating my face, but would start mildly burning after a few minutes, as well as drying out? Which is the opposite of the desired effect, I think. Didn’t notice any particular brightening either.

I have acne prone, combo, sensitive skin. This mask did not break me out and felt so good while rubbing in the exfoliation beads and after washing it off. My skin was very soft and glowy. I appreciate this not having any fragrance. My skin didn’t feel tight during the mask but it did feel a little bit tight after washing it off. Nothing too crazy though.
product_name: Cookies N Clean Whipped Clay Pore Detox Face Mask with Salicylic Acid + Charcoal

review_text: This product has now replaced my regular face wash. I have very sensitive skin and worried that the formula, like so many others, might irritate my skin. I used it three days in a row and had no issues. The formula was not greasy or difficult to rinse off and I felt NO tightness , dryness or irritation. I didn’t even feel the need to pile on moisturizer. No strong scent. It passed my test. I am going to be more open minded about this brand in the future.
product_name: Hyaluronic Marine Makeup Removing Meltaway Cleanser

review_text: There are better drugstore balms. I would not repurchase.

I really tried to like this since I’ve had good results with other Inkey List products. Unfortunately, I could not get over the greasy residue this left on my face. Also, the formula began to separate after a few weeks so that when I dispense products I’m left with a pool of oil in my hand. I much prefer the Farmacy Green Clean cleansing balm to this.

Unpopular opinion but not worth the hype.. only had it for a little but the sweet scent is overwhelming beyond belief, it’s thick as heck and the product is sticky as can be! Wanted to love this so bad !
review_title: wanted to love this but it’s a no from me
product_name: Mini Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: Pump is no good. It leaks out and leaves a puddle by my sink. Went to sephora they could not help me. They said it was over 30 days. Waste of money. At least my sink gets a good wash.
sooo worth the money! my dark circles are definitely lighter and refreshed i loveeee these
product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Hydra-Gel Eye Patches

The smell was so strong it left my eyes tearing all day, and unfortunately I broke out like a prepubescent teen. Not a fan!
product_name: Umbra Tinte Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Absolutely not worth the money. Does not hydrate and does not smooth whatsoever. The scent is awful with the hint of menthol. Honestly, you would do better putting Vaseline on your lips.

I received this product from influenster and Being that I live in Florida, this product has become very useful. I love the size, not too big and not too small. It is perfect for ever day use and isn’t too heavy on the face, but does feel like it’s getting every bit of protection in your skin from the Sun. I have been using it and noticed it lasts me almost all day before having to reapply. I don’t exactly like the intense smell it provides and will only leave white streaks if you don’t spread it evenly into your skin. It is 100% effective and has saved me from getting burnt after lying in the sun all day long. 10/10 recommend.
product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen

review_text: I was gifted by Dermalogica Sampling this daily microexfoliant. I find the exfoliant a bit too harsh for everyday but I love using it 2-3 times a week. I notice my skin being a bit smoother and having less breakouts on my skin. I also find it a less abrasive than other physical exfoliants. I would definitely purchase this.
It smells like paste and I still have small amounts of makeup on my eyes
product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I purchased the limited edition apple scent and was not impressed. The fragrance was amazing, it reminded me of the old B&BW County Apple line, but this did not remove stubborn mascara and waterproof eyeliner line the Clinique balm does. Not worth the purchase.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Works immediately for my under eye bags. This is one of my favorite products.
product_name: Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener

Super lovely cleanser. Silky whipped up foaming texture with a light, inoffensive scent. Think soft, vagely fruity & lightly fizzy. Love it and will repurchase.
product_name: Whipped Greens Oil-Free Foaming Cleanser with Moringa and Papaya

review_text: I have dry and sensitive skin and even in the summer my skin and face is really dry so I need a product that has a lot of moisture to it. There is a little bit of tackiness to it and it takes a little while to sit in but my skin in the morning is extremely moisturized and I feel like my make up during the day sits on my skin better because it is more moisturized from this cream.
product_name: Vitamin C Lactic Dewy Deep Cream

review_text: This does everything it says it will, I look pretty in the morning after wearing this. Like to pair with the petal hyaluronic cream
product_name: Sacred Sleep Overnight Repair with Retinol

review_text: I REALLY love this stuff - after the 1st night I used it, the skin around my eyes was amazingly soft and virtually no puffiness. I’ve been using it almost a month now, and although I don’t notice the darkness disappearing around my eyes I’m still satisfied with the product.
This serum did absolutely nothing for me...it has an unpleasant odor to it and it has the cheapest pump that squirts out everywhere. So glad I only wasted $9
review_title: May as well be water in a bottle

review_text: My biggest problem area is dark circle. I don’t think this product did much for that issue (though it doesn’t claim to). I think it’s moisturizing without being heavy, but it is not a must have product for me personally.

I’ve been using this for about a month now and haven’t seen any change in the appearance of my dark circles. I have found however, that this is the best hydrating non greasy under eye cream I’ve ever tried and a little goes a long way. Would recommend.
product_name: White Lucent Anti-Dark Circles Eye Cream

review_text: This is my first product I’ve tried by La Mer. Wow what a luxurious eye cream!!! It really sinks into the skin nicely and I feel like it really helps brighten and hydrate. If it’s in your budget l definitely recommend!!!
Used for the first time tonight and I’m very impressed with the feel of it. My skin felt smooth and goopy right away. Excited to see how this goes.

This moisturizer is the best one I have ever tried! It feels very light on your face, while smelling fresh and minty, and moisturizing your dry face very well. I totally recommend this product to anyone, it is incredible and nothing compares to it.
Not good for sensitive skin, lots of rashes on cheeks after every wash, very very drying too.
I use this to coax out stubborn zits or pustules
review_title: Works SO well as a spot treatment!

You can make it work but there’s such better options.
Not even moisturizing enough for my very oily skin. It also does nothing for pores.
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I am giving 2 stars because maybe it works well, but I can’t pass the consistency/feeling on my skin. it is STICKY, like really tacky. Hours later I could still feel my skin kinda like pulling or something, so weird... I can’t, sorry.

My boyfriend’s acne was just out of control… he tried so many products over the years that didn’t work or just dried out his face that he gave up. After a month of use, he haven’t had much acne showing and most of his blackheads are gone!! Only bad thing, it kind of leaves him a little burning sensation after use but not for long
product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser

review_text: So far so good! Makes my skin smooth and I can see it’s visibly reduced some of the redness I alwayssss have on my cheeks. One star off because it definitely causes some pilling and I haven’t yet found a way for it to not do it. *** I have super sensitive skin and this didn’t make it react.

I honestly don’t like this for a cleansing balm. I’ll use it as a 10min mask but I honestly don’t feel like it is cleansing my skin. And the gritty texture is not good for the eye area. I am super disappointed. I heard everyone rave about this but I prefer farmacy way more even though it isn’t as budget friendly. This won’t stop me from trying other products from the brand but this is just a no for me.

I can’t say enough good things about this product. I have textured skin (acne scarring) and saw improvement after one use. It smells really nice, like a lemon dessert, but it does sting a little when I apply it. My skin is glowy, smoother, and and more even in tone.

I like this peeling gel, you get an instant result and softer skin. However I feel like you can get similar products that do the same thing but for way less money. I really enjoy the Dr. G brightening peeling gel.
review_title: Nice but not worth the cost

review_text: I LOVE this cleansing gel. Not only does it leave you feeling fresh and clean but also helps with your occasional blemishes. I cant confirm whether its anti aging, but its a good daily face wash. It’s worth a try!

I am using this regular twice a day. Not seeing even a slight change. The bottle is about to finish. Not a lot of product in it . Won’t buy again. Also not received the samples I need to with this purchase. They were missing in the package.
product_name: Guava Vitamin C Dark Spot Treatment Serum

review_text: Honestly, I don’t see the hype. It gave me dry patches (and I have naturally oily skin), and made my makeup look horrible. I only used half a pump in the evening. It didn’t do anything for my pores and also made my breakout. It smelled nice so that was a plus. Not worth the $40 imo
product_name: Strawberry Smooth BHA + AHA Salicylic Acid Serum

review_text: I love this! It’s so moisturizing. I got it when my skin dried out this winter and it’s made a huge difference. But I really love it for dry skin! My skin is sensitive and loved this. It doesn’t do a great job with heavy eye makeup; I get that off with a cold cream before using this.
I’ve started using this product for my cystic acne on my face and back and have noticed a huge difference in just three applications. I’m ready to see my face clear after years of suffering.

Ok...I have picked this as one of my samples 3 times...never used it...so today I did..WOW! It softens and plumps just like a previous review said. I mean REALLY softens and REALLY plumps it up...Its not cheap but is it worth it? YES YES YES....before I finish, one more WOW!

I bought this after it seemed like everyone had tried this, so I bought it too. There is nothing wrong with this, it just wasn’t anything to get excited over. I reach for this when I just want to watch my face before bed and I want a no fuss product, just clean my face and be done. I did notice that my fave felt a little tight after I used it, and I needed more moisturizer after this. So I guess if you want a plain Jane, no fuss, sentless, cleanser, this would be great for you. That’s really all this is though.
Love this moisturizer specially for trying other brands this did the work . Truly recommend it to anyone that is suffering from dry skin or patchy areas!
Super oily skin. Didn’t do anything. Returned.

Whoa! A little goes a long way and this works wonders. This huge jar is going to last me ages and I’m thrilled. (I have sensitive acne prone skin and had no trouble with this, so I highly recommend!)
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Save your self money and use coconut oil instead, it does the same thing.

Hyperpigmentation is hard to deal with, both mentally and trying to fix it. After having a bout of awful cystic acne I was left with marks all over my cheeks, some red still and some purple/brown. I am fair skinned BTW. I bought this a month and a half ago and I am a little more than half way thru the tube, so it lasts a good bit. But the PRICE is not justified. I have used this every day, sometimes twice a day. I guess it must have done something but I can’t tell a difference between this and the reat of my skin care. I can not recommend, just due to the ridiculous price. I am going to use it up but I think the PTR exfoliant pads are a MUCH better investment! Save your money and buy those instead!!! I gave it 2 stars because the ingredient list IS good, but I haven’t noticed much of a difference after starting this product. I used this on old and new acne marks.

I had high hopes for this product since I have use MURAD before. But this cleanser didn’t help with my breakouts at all. It feels really good, refreshing and cooling. I used it 2 times a day and it didn’t dry out my skin but I didn’t see any changes on my skin.

This moisturizer is awesome! I don’t normally use moisturizers because they’re too heavy for my oily skin, but this gives the perfect amount of hydration and my foundation applies beautifully over it! And it smells AMAZING.
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: I bought this in-store on a whim to help reduce post acne dark spots. I used 4 of them. 2 on a few older dark spots and 2 on newer dark spots ranging from dark to light. I figured this was a good way to test this product out. I wore it overnight (package recommends at least 2 hours), in hopes this would make a difference. When I woke up, nothing. After you open the main packaging, each pad has it’s own tear packet and then the patches are sealed in a plastic cover, then you have you have to peel off another plastic piece to get to the adhesive. Seems like you pay more for the packaging than the actually product.

Nothing!I have used many other brands of similar treatment patches. These were the most drying & worthless!I like other PTR products, just not this one.

review_text: Not moisturizing at all, give stars for packaging as I love that it’s more hygienic.
MELTS off the makeup!!! Absolutely amazing and moisturizing!!!
product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: This mask is excellent. Stays on as you are about the house, and can be varied to your skin’s needs- use dry for intense exfoliation or use on wet skin for a nourishing experience. You may look like Snooki with this mask on, but it is SO WORTH IT!

I live in Hawaii where the sun is intense and swimming is done in the ocean. The preservation of our islands is very important to us, and chemical sunscreens are polluting our beautiful beaches and snorkeling spots. For this reason, the state has banned the sale of oxybenzone and octinoxate, ingredients found in conventional chemical sunscreens that lead to coral bleaching. So naturally, I was in search of a reef safe sunscreen with a light weight formula for daily use. I soon learned that this is NOT the product I was looking for. While Supergoop’s formulas do not contain oxybenzone or octinoxate, they still contain chemicals such as avobenzone and octocrylene that have been found to be harmful to marine eco health as well. Plus, chemical sunscreens work by absorbing into the skin and have been linked to endocrine disruption and skin sensitivity. The gel went on light and matte upon first application, but there was a distinct acrid chemical smell that followed. The next day my skin, though not burnt, was rough dry and scaly. Mineral sunscreens that contain non-nano zinc oxide or non-nano titanium dioxide are generally recognized as the only safe and effective UVA / UVB protection that do no harm marine ecosystems. I’ve since discovered there are many non-nano mineral sunscreens on the market with excellent light weight formulas that leave no white cast, are safe for your skin, and kind to our oceans. I wanted to share my findings, since this seems to be a popular sunscreen choice amongst Sephora shoppers. Great reviews, labeled clean and reef safe, reasons why you may consider purchasing this product and reasons that convinced me to give it a try as well. But upon further research, I realized Supergoop’s marketing is an example of greenwashing. Please be aware of buzzwords like “reef safe” and “clean” as there are no regulations for these labels, and they are often used to mislead consumers. A good reminder to research ingredients and shop mindfully.

review_text: I have very sensitive skin and more allergies than I can shake a stick at. I’ve also got a number of autoimmune issues, which mean I’m slow to heal. I don’t suffer from a lot of acne, but when I wind up with a problem, it tends to stick around for a fair while and be a pain to get rid of. Masks have made things so much more difficult - as they have for so many others.I’ve tried a number of different kinds of acne patches (COSRX, Rael, Mighty Patch, Liva Clean), and they all have worked to varying degrees, but I do find the Peace Out dots, while more visible, clear things up faster and more thoroughly. Yes, they are more expensive, however, I only need one or two dots vs. 8 or 9 of the others to reach the same point. And it’s gratifying - if a bit gross - to see the white dot of goo show up as it gets pulled out from below.I have found with them, and with other acne patches, that I occasionally do wind up with a red circle mimicking the dot/patch itself. It doesn’t happen every time (nor does it seem to be brand-specific), so I don’t think it’s an allergy. I’ve got thin skin and the one dot I do have now is from a stubborn spot by my collarbone and I think it’s a reaction to the Salicylic Acid drying the area out.

review_text: I was using the Neutrogena hydrating makeup wipes and I continued to feel like they were just drying out my face. I was worried it would leave a filmy feeling behind but it did NO such thing! So awesome.Two things I want to point out: 1. Please don’t let the reviews that say it “broke me out“ sway you from trying this. I have a feeling that those reviewers did NOT do an actual cleanse after they used this. This is the first step (similar to a makeup wipe) to your routine. Use this, then wash your face with your normal cleanser. This is a makeup remover and you therefore still need to go in and do an actual cleanse to get into your pores, which is why people probably broke out, thinking they could just use this and call it a day. 2. The reviews that mention the blurry vision if getting it in your eyes are true. However, it causes no pain and there is a solution to avoid this. I take a bit of the balm and put it on the back of my hand, then take another bit and put it in the palms of my hand. For my face, I use what is in my palms, and only after I completely rub off my face do I go in with the extra balm on the back of my hand for my eyes. That way I never open my eyes during the process. Voila! No blurry vision!Try this! You will not regret it!

review_text: I’ve heard many great things about this product but for me personally it didn’t work. It made my skin breakout.

review_text: This product felt fine, and it did not make me break out. I am 22 and have dry skin. However, it’s vitamin c (Ascorbyl Glucoside) is listed after the fragrance in it. And since in order to be “Clean at Sephora“ fragrance has to be at a concentration below 1% of the total formula, that means that the vitamin c (ascorbyl glucoside) and vitamin e (tocopherol) are less than 1%. While this is fine and may still show benefits to your skin, at $20 for a 1 oz bottle that is pricey for such a low concentration. If you really want to see the benefits, you likely want a concentration of at least 8%, with 20% being the highest.
product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I use this every night as part of my 4-part Barbara Sturm routine. This is my first experience with an Hyaluronic serum but it has been nothing short of eye opening. Like some reviewers mention, the pilling makes it nearly impossible to wear throughout the day. I pat it on like recommended, never rubbing, and the pilling has happened every day for about 8 days since I’ve been using it. Forget makeup; it’s just not a viable option if you’re out and about all day. I love the concept but the product doesn’t match up to the marketing and hype. Sadly, this was not a win.

I love the JM sunscreen and Argan Stick, so I was really excited about finally trying the pure oil. Unfortunately, this wasn’t as impressive as I had hoped. I received it in the Sephora In the Glow kit, so I’ve been trying to figure out different ways to use it. I’ve had a couple of interesting (and sometimes disastrous) experiences.First I tried using it on my face (like most people do). Since I love the Argan Stick and sunscreen on my face, I thought this would be great. Sadly, my face seems to be the one part of my body where this simply won’t absorb. When I put it on my hands/arms/feet it absorbs in moments, but it just sits on my face. Also, since the Argan Stick clears my blemishes, I thought this would too. Instead, it caused a few blemishes, which makes me think the miracle ingredient in the Argan Stick isn’t the argan, but rather than tea tree oil (which naturally clears skin). Since it wouldn’t absorb properly, it didn’t really hydrate and left me with dry, acne-prone skin.Onto my second attempt--I figured I would try it in my hair. This was a bit more successful, although at one point it turned out disastrous. I tried it in dry hair, which was far too greasy. Then I tried it in wet hair as a leave-in conditioner. This worked relatively well, but I have to be incredibly careful about how much I use. One time I put in just a couple of drops too much, and when I woke up the next morning, my hair was so greasy that it looked wet. I had to shampoo it three times (no conditioner) in order to get it out. Fortunately I woke up before my alarm and had time to take a shower; otherwise I would have gone to work with my hair looking like an oil slick. From now on, I may use this as a leave-in deep conditioner on the weekends, but I will never use it immediately before school/work/any major event.I’ve found that the only way for me to really utilize it is as a moisturizer for my body right after I get out of the shower. Since the bottles are so small, I’m sure it won’t last me very long, but I don’t know what else to do with it. I may try putting it in my hair before going to the beach then washing it out after (both to condition and protect it). I really had high hopes for this product, since Josie markets Argan Oil as a fountain of youth. I assumed the argan ingredient was what made me love her other products so much, but now I’m beginning to wonder if it’s the shea butter, jojoba oil, tea tree oil, and other more conventional ingredients that make them work so well for me--after this experience, I think the emphasis on argan oil may be a marketing ploy. It offers a little moisture, but no more than sesame or baby oil (and each of those absorb more quickly on me). I’ll finish this sample and continue to use her other products, but I certainly won’t be buying the full size.

review_text: I used this about every other day for three weeks. As you can see from the images, I don’t think it really did much. I ended up using the device before I washed my face so that I could immediately get the gel off. You have to use *a lot* of the product, too, to keep from getting zapped from the device. The cream has a faint scent that my skin reacted to, but thankfully, I didn’t seem to have an allergic reaction to the gel.Lastly the app. This is a big miss for me. There are only a handful of routines, none of which focus on the forehead (the area I wanted to work on) and did not sync up with the device. You have to turn off the device in between instructions to apply more gel and know what to do next. This could be an easy win if they improve the functionality of the app including more routines, even to broaden the application of how you can use the device (I was thinking of experimenting for summer to see if this could help tone my abs - something I wish they had instructions for in the app).Overall, I think there are a few people who would benefit from this the most:- if you have visibly sagging skin- if you are seriously considering plastic surgery to lift or remove fat from your face- if you have tried a microcurrent facial, liked the results, and are okay with doing this treatment yourself on a daily basisThis is not for people who want an easy-to-use skin care device (like a facial cleaning device) or can’t commit to adding something into their daily skin care routine that will actually take time to do.

review_text: I like Clinique products in general, but this one didn’t do it for me. This product is similar in idea and results as Garnier Nutritioniste Skin Renew Antipuff Eye Roller. I tried Garner’s a while back because it won a Glamour award. They are both 15 mL container with a stainless steel roller to dispense a gel liquid which is supposed to get rid of dark circles as well as puffiness. Both did nothing for me.I was interested in this product for its claims to depuff eyes and minimize darkness, as well as its ability to refresh the eyes. I thought this would be great for those days that I wake up super tired, having a long night out, and/or not getting adequate sleep.True, this did provide a slight cooling effect. But that effect was only the refreshness of putting a cold piece of metal (from the ball) on your eye. A slice of cucumber or ice pack would be just as effective. I don’t have extreme puffiness, I just get it from lack of sleep or having just woken up. I didn’t notice any change to that, as well. My puffiness went away as the day went on, just as it normally does. I also on occasion experience dark circles, mainly due to lack of sleep. Again, this product did nothing to counter the problem. The all about eyes eye roller also did not relieve any pressure from tiredness and fatigue of working odd hours and having a weird schedule.This product also did not do anything for my BF’s chronic dark circle or A.M. puffiness, either.I wonder how this product could work so well on some and fail on others. Perhaps this product may work better for those that have extreme puffiness or more apparent circles. It could also be how sensitive one’s skin is and how able it is to absorb the ingredients in this product, I don’t know.Although Clinique’s ingredients aren’t listed, I’m assuming they may be similar to those in Garnier’s product. The main ingredient and most effective in Garnier’s roller is caffeine which, when used topically, is supposed to reduce dark circles and puffiness. It does this by tightening the skin and improving circulation. That effect is only temporary, however. Other trick ingredients are escin, which is an antioxidant that has shown to reduce puffiness, as well. Another is mica which is a mineral that reflects light, thus giving eyes a brighter look.If you’re looking for a permanent fix for your eye problems, I would look into other products (including Clinique’s all about eyes cream) but this product just did nothing for me.

review_text: I was pretty disappointed with this product upon first use, but I decided to give it a shot and further try it out with different application techniques, trying to see how it works with no makeup, minimal makeup, and full makeup. Basically,it still looks like I have breakouts when really there is just redness left behind from acne that I have picked at or harshly treated in efforts to rid my face of it (harsh treatment DOES NOT work, only making things worse, which I wish I had realized years ago). When I stumbled across this product, I read the reviews and thought that this was JUST what I needed to feel comfortable in my skin, given the fact that I still have acne marks and hyper pigmentation that stand out on my very fair complexion. The fact that this treatment is said to neutralize redness was very appealing to me, as I really do not like to wear a full face of makeup on an every day basis. I thought I would be able to apply only this to my face and be set for the day, my acne marks almost completely cancelled out and barely noticeable. Unfortunately, this was not the case. Whether I applied a hearty amount of the product or a light layer to my face, I really did not see much neutralization of my acne marks, if any change at all. My redness was still alive and well after applying the product to my face, completely contrasting what I thought the product would do for me based on it’s description and all of the positive reviews! Also, I found that this product made my entire face look very shiny and dewy, but not in a flattering way at all. This may partly be due to the fact that I already have an oily complexion, however. For people who simply have a rosy complexion that they would like to cancel out, I feel as though this product might work out. But for me personally, I felt as though the product did not remove any of the redness from my acne marks, which was pretty disappointing.

review_text: I really like this for a subtle tan, never looks orange and most people think I’ve just been sitting out in the sun. The key I’ve found is to work in small sections and only spray directly onto large areas of the body (chest, tummy, upper legs, back) and then spray your mitt with a little product and blend immediately after spraying directly onto skin. For smaller areas like arms I spray this directly onto the mitt and really work it into the skin, passing over each arm, leg multiple times. Then once I’m done applying all over, I’ll spray the mitt with 2-3 pumps and go over my whole body to make sure I’m blended. Note I use the drops with moisturizer for my face not this product. I never leave on over night only for 4-6 hours before I go to sleep usually.
