Otherwise I’m pretty bummed out it didn’t work out for me so I had to return it.

The tint is awful--very yellow/orange. I’m fair complexioned so this did not work. However, I love the texture and coverage and LOVE that it has zinc and titanium dioxide for sunscreen instead of chemicals. Just wish they had a selection of softer, paler tints.
review_title: Nice texture and coverage but awful tint color!
product_name: Argan Daily Moisturizer Tinted SPF 47 Protect + Perfect

review_text: Sorry to say this dried my skin out profusely every time I cleansed! Lovely smell and felt nice on the skin though.

I’m trying to like this product but everytime I use it I’m always welcomed with breakouts all over my face. I hate that so much cause my breakouts always end up leaving a dark spot which kind of defeats the purpose of the product. Like I’m literally going in circles….I just want my skin to be clear honestly:(
product_name: Faded Serum for Dark Spots & Discoloration

review_text: Perfect for locking in moisture. here’s how: wet fingertips then apply product to face. Put moisturizer on - it worked great for me and face was very soft and hydrated.
feels clean and cooling when you first use it, but does not control surface shine or oil very well at all
I don’t get it. I tried this in the store and I felt like I was rubbing glittery Cheeto dust on my hand. If you’re super fair, this is a hard pass.
product_name: Glowscreen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++ with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide

review_text: I have been using this product for over a month, every morning and I don’t see any difference in my skin. When I was in a Sephora store the worker told me it would help with the redness on my face but I see no difference. It smells amazing but not worth the price.
Formula was changed....do not like this one. The previous was silky smooth, this one is NOT a scrub and feels like wax. Disappointed!
I was surprised as there was no makeup on my face after using this product and how clean it was. This is a great product for oil skin with acne. I love it and would definitely recommend this product.
Cleared my stubborn acne in less than two months. I have sensitive skin and have had no problem with using it once a day. It is pretty strong however so if you need you can dilute it.

Giving this 2 stars because it is a lovely cleanser (although, overpriced), however it broke me out in tiny white bumps after just one use. I tried it for another week with similar results. I am not typically acne-prone so this was quite a surprise. If you are considering purchasing this, try a sample first!

I have dry sensitive skin, this stuff literally makes no difference in my skin. I get blemishes if I wear full coverage foundation too many days in a row, so I was recommend this mask. Wish I would have returned it forever ago.
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I LOVE this duo. Most important things to note:1-Buying in this package is cheaper than buying larger sizes individually (I did the math)2-I thought since I have oily/acne prone skin the UFO treatment would be better, but this one is the best.3-Feels amazing and I always wake up with glowing skin. This helped clear up old acne scars and current breakouts, as well as prevent future breakouts. I LOVE it. 4-Good for preventing signs of aging too. I’m 24 years old and was just starting to get a little wrinkle under each eye and this has helped the wrinkles regress and halt their progress!
review_title: One of the only products to truly change my skin
product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo

review_text: Doesn’t dry my lips like some masks. Lasts all night to protect but once it’s gone my lips don’t feel hydrated. Still 4 stars for good texture, lasting and protecting without being sticky.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: After using this product, my lips developed rough patches. Perhaps I’m sensitive to the fragrance and flavoring in this product. When I discontinued use and returned to my usual Burt’s Bees Lip Balm, the rough patches disappeared. My search for a cruelty-free/vegan replacement for Burt’s Bees Beeswax Lip Balm continues.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: So cute, perfect size lasted my friend 2-3 months… that’s a lot for a mini. This makes me glow your gonna regret it if you don’t buy
product_name: Mini Watermelon Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer

review_text: My skin is very sensitive & I bought this with the Clinique Turnaround Concentrate after reading reviews for both. Initially I loved what they did for my skin. However, after about a week of using 2-3 times, I suddenly noticed all these little rashy, white bumps all over my face. These are the only new products I’ve used, so I’ve stopped both for now. Once cleared, maybe I’ll go back and rotate the products to see if the combo or one specific product irritated my face.
product_name: 7 Day Face Scrub Cream Rinse-Off Formula

review_text: Stop with the pointless sparkles!!!!! I would have loved this if it didn’t contain MICA. My fault for not reading carefully enough. If you don’t mind the sparkles I’m sure you would love it
product_name: Vitamin C Dark Circle Correcting Eye Serum

review_text: Very very expensive, but I got a sample of it with another order and it made a difference in my skin so I bought the full size. I’ve been using it now for about 2 months and can’t live without it. I will be repurchasing. It makes my skin noticeably more radiant, even toned (i have some redness on my cheeks and chin), and smoother. I tried a sample of something similar from another brand, zelens youth serum, which I like a bit more, but the zelens serum is ridiculously expensive, more than I’m willing/able to pay. I can’t live without the good genes treatment and would highly recommend getting a sample. I apply it at night only, sometimes skipping a night, and I apply it first thing after I cleanse my face, then I do my moisturizer. It stung a teeny bit for a few seconds for the first couple of uses, but then it went away. I don’t mind the scent at all and it fades fast. I like that they don’t load it up with synthetic fragrance chemicals to cover up smells, yuck, that would be way worse in my opinion.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I received this product as a free sample. I’m in my early 30’s and antiaging is major. Retinol is an ingredient I search for but often find irritating. Not this one. It’s been working to help even out rough texture and in turn, I’ve noticed less discoloration because of the cell turnover. It also applies evenly and doesn’t ball up under my moisturizer.

I tried a sample of this product and thought it was great so I purchased the full size. Again, after a few days of use my skin looked great. The disappointment came after a few weeks where I just couldn’t get my skin right. It became unbalanced, I had breakouts and the product just didn’t seem to moisturise. After three weeks of use I saw a photo of myself and realised how lined my skin had become. It was like the product didn’t actually moisturise at all so over the weeks my skin became more and more dehydrated. I have stopped using it and won’t be going back!

I was a little disappointed with this product. I use the moisturizing soft cream religiously and was hoping this product would be similar but unfortunately this one missed the mark. I wasn’t hydrating like the moisturizing soft cream at all and the smell was very weird—nothing like the signature La Mer scent I’m used to. I’ll stick with my soft cream.

I love this makeup removing balm!! I have extremely sensitive skin and this is the first makeup remover that hasn’t make my skin sting and doesn’t clog up my pores. I first got the little one as my birthday gift & I loved it so much that I immediately bought the large version. It’s a bit pricey, but I absolutely think it’s worth it. It totally melts away all the makeup on my face. Obviously you also have to wipe it all off once you’ve rubbed all the makeup off & wash your face to actually cleanse after. Sometimes I use the balm a couple of times to really get off any eyelash glue and such that might be left over, but it’s way better than any other remover I’ve used. It’s really nice to have a makeup remover that doesn’t leave my face greasy or dry. Sometimes I even rub a tiny bit on my eyelids when they feel a bit dry then wash it off later. I also love that the little spoon thing is magnetic so you don’t lose it. I still store it in the box so it doesn’t get weird & gross after I wipe it off. I haven’t tried the little vial just yet, but the actual remover is wonderful!!
review_title: Best Makeup Remover for Sensitive Skin Ever!!

review_text: For full transparency this was gifted by Sulwhasoo for review purposes! The bottle felt so nice and luxurious. The serum had a like caramel color and had a very earthy scent which I enjoyed! I love how lightweight it was and how quickly it absorbed!
I have used this lip mask many many times over several months. I want to use it up and not waste my $. I have not ever noticed a difference.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I really wanted to like this but it just doesn’t do much for $7. I think it would be nice to seal something moisturizing. Perhaps over a chapstick to make it glossy? Otherwise, it does nothing for hydration or helping with dry and cracked lips, cuticles or skin on its own. I’d rather use Vaseline because they’re basically the same thing. I would also prefer no fragrance since it makes anything I eat or drink taste like roses. I also don’t find the tin hard to open if my hands aren’t slippery from lotion or something like that.

I absolutely love the ordinary serums so when I seen this I had to try it. This moisturizer is very thick, a little goes a long way but I never felt like it really packed the moisture into my skin which was odd to me because I have oily skin and usually with a thicker cream moisturizer my skin is plenty moisturized, but I found myself mixing the ordinary moisturizer with a face oil just to get more hydration. It also didn’t feel very great on my skin and didn’t rub in nicely. I really wasn’t a fan of this.

I have used this for about a month now and I would say for myself I found that this is a very basic under eye moisturizer. I was kind of expecting better improvements and moisture for the price, but unfortunately I think many other eye creams exceed this one.
product_name: The Silk Peony Melting Eye Cream

review_text: A wonderful brightening serum! I love using this in the AM just before sunscreen and makeup. It also has a very fine shimmer that gives you a subtle glow which I personally like.
product_name: Vitamin C & Bearberry Instant Glow Serum

review_text: I am SO picky when it comes to lip glosses and lip oils but I used every ounce of this so fast because it’s THAT good! Go snatch it NOW!
product_name: Cherry Treat Conditioning + Strengthening Lip Oil

review_text: This serum is so hydrating! The Polyglutamic acid is *chef kiss* with the hyaluronic acid! This product was gifted but all thoughts are my own. I have very dry skin and adding this into my skincare routine has really transformed my skin!

This was just another reminder to not fall into the trap of these Instagram hype products. I got minimal hydration from this and found that it easily pilled on my face even after I had just exfoliated. There are TONS of other products that can deliver better results for less money. I will finish this tube but I will not be repurchasing anything from this company. I have tried their entire line at this point and have been mostly disappointed with all their products. Pretty packaging doesn’t equal quality.
It’s moisturizing all right, but I feel like it doesn’t “soak in“ fast enough, and feels like regular lotion on my eye-lids. I wish it were more “cream like“
I live in Colorado and we have very dry winters. This is the only product I’ve used to keep chapped/dry lips at bay overnight. Not too scented but the scent it does have is light and pleasant.

Really wanted to love this because I prefer oil moisturizors. The product itself is great, but the application is tedious because it’s a spray and very little comes out. You’ve got to pump it multiple times to cover a leg and it’s oily so it can get a little difficult to grip. I wish it had a simply pump that released more product at a time.
review_title: Not easy to get out of the bottle

review_text: Loved trying out this exfoliator! Smells and feels like you’re using a sugary strawberry jam. It’s super gentle, so you could even use it daily, but I love how you could customize the intensity of the scrub with the amount of water used. I kept it in the shower for when my skin was feeling dull to revive and brighten. It leaves my skin feeling polished and not over dried in anyway. Preps the skin perfectly!

I will give this balm 4 stars for great removal of all makeup products including mascara. My only issue is they only offer this in a small size which doesn’t take very long to completely use. What a pity. That’s my reason for the 4 stars. I don’t remember if it has a scent.

I am one of those people who always have multiple hand creams/lotions in rotation. My skin is sensitive and dry and my face is acne-prone and sensitive. I tried this on my face and it was too thick and caused some breakout. I used this for a couple weeks as a hand cream though and it performs great. It kept my hands, arms and elbows moisturized throughout the day. I have used similar products that were equal or better in quality at a lower price point.

This is a sunscreen - not a every day face moisturizer. There are other brands who have managed to put SPF into daily face moisturizers much more successfully. If that’s what you’re looking for - I would not recommend. If you want an overpriced sunscreen to wear to the pool/beach then this is the product for you!
product_name: Umbra Sheer Physical Daily Defense SPF 30

review_text: Products like this really show how skin types can vary significantly. I’ve heard good things about this product, so I decided to try the sample out first. As soon as I applied it to my cheek, I felt a powerful, painful burn. I immediately washed it off and put my usual moisturizer on. It’s been a day, and even though I only had it on my skin for no more than 5 seconds, I still have a rough dry patch on my cheek.To give context, I have dry skin with an oily t-zone. I also have mild eczema.
product_name: Ready Steady Glow Daily AHA Tonic

review_text: I have never used any kind of mask before. I like the way my face brightens after using it and my acne isn’t coming back so quickly.

Before buying this product I read a majority of these reviews carefully and considered just about everything! I already swear by the soy cleanser and thought that adding another step to my daily routine would help my skin feel better. Although the reviews were quite mixed, I decided to buy the toner after I smelt the tester at Sephora! I now use it everyday after I use my Soy Face Cleanser from Fresh and I absolutely ADORE the combination and most importantly, what the toner has done to my skin! I have minor break outs, both blemishes and blackheads, and this toner has immediately reduced the look of them on my face! My skin feels and looks better than ever! I also have combination skin - my t-zone gets oily throughout the day. I find that just by spraying this on my face in the morning before a long day of work my skin settles. It feels refreshed, bright and I never feel oily anymore! This toner helps my skin also feel moisturized and healthy. This is for sure one of my new ride or die products!

After reading several reviews, I got this for my dry skin (lower cheek area); however, it didn’t really make a difference. I kind of think that it made it worse! It might be just because I have extremely sensitive skin, but at least I only got the smaller size, and I have other use for it. (treating split ends!)

I really liked the consistency of this gel like cream moisturizer and it is very hydrating. a bit goes a long way but the scent is a tad too strong for me, it smells like roses I guess but it’s a bit too strong. I rather use scent-free skincare. I received this product for free from Influenster for testing purposes.
product_name: Hydra Zen Gel-Cream Oil-Free Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid

review_text: Unlike some other reviewers, I love the smell and don’t mind the color. However, unlike any other product I have ever used, including retinol, AHA/BHAs, salicylic acid, etc., the following day it turns my skin bright red, as if I was sunburned. It stings, as well. I tried it again last night, thinking perhaps it was an anomaly. Nope.
review_title: Glow?  More like the appearance of a sunburn!

review_text: This is an excellent cleanser. Very different, though. It does not foam up. Leaves my skin clean, hydrated and soft! Perfect for my slightly dry, aging skin.
First thing’s first: I LOVE TONERS. My acne-prone, sensitive, Combo Skin has been on the hunt for a clarifying, invigorating toner to tackle my skin concerns without being harsh or drying. Love this!

I use sunscreen everyday and sought out this brand based on Youtuber’s recommendation. A perfect sunscreen for me would have high SPF, non-greasy look/feel, fragrance free and no white cast. The Sephora I bought this at, did not have a tester so I purchased it with high hopes. The first time I used it, I was knocked back by the strong chemically smell.. It is also runny and mildly greasy, but no white cast. I’ll continue the search for my perfect sunscreen since this is “not the one.“
product_name: PLAY Everyday Sunscreen Lotion SPF 50 PA++++

review_text: Honestly, I have never disliked a Sunday Riley product EVER however this was a major fail for me. I liked Tidal when I bought it a few years ago but since I prefer richer, oilier creams this seemed like the way to go. First of all it’s a thick formula that smells like some type of orange in the worst way. Not creamsicle. Not fruity. Like generic Orange flavor, I love natural scents and really any fragrance I’m cool with and this is gross to me and I hate it everytime. That aside the moisturizer itself is super thick but then once you try to spread it it spreads like PEANUT BUTTER. Tugs at your skin horribly and does not melt or do anything luxurious it has a gross waxy/fillery feel once you spread with no hydration. Its horrible just No. But for $65 i’ll be finishing it.
review_title: Love Tidal but This was Bad
product_name: Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: This is a great value since each product is 1/2 of the full size. If you have been wanting to try either of these products, I would select this kit. Both products are worth the investment but this is a wonderful first step for those wondering if this is right for them. Great for travel as well.
product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo

review_text: I received this complimentary from Influenster. This product is very nice. It’s light on my skin, so it makes it perfect to use on my face to layer under my makeup. The scent isn’t too heavy. And can we talk about how cute that bottle is? Absolutely adorable.
product_name: Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Broad-Spectrum SPF 42

review_text: I have combo skin but the toner and the wash were both too harsh on my skin. The moisturizer is good though and you get a good amount of it. Not for sensitive skin.
product_name: Great Skin, Great Deal Set for Dry Combination Skin

review_text: Where has this been my hole life? I honestly can not believe I just discovered this. My lips have never been happier. LOVE, LOVE, LOVE! ! !

This chapsticks is a miracle worker. It will save you from any winter dryness. I use it before bed and in the mornings. One this is that you need to wait sometime before applying lipstick, especially Matte ones
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: Just ok! Hasn’t done anything with improving my skin texture but it feels good putting it on and my makeup looks fine on top of it but I won’t be repurchasing it since I don’t feel like it has done what it claims to do

Great product but it doesn’t really do what the description says-- read the ingredients first!This product would be great for keeping COMBINATION skin to keep it hydrated and clear! There are more ingredients in this than hydrating ingredients such as salicylic acid, making this product irritating and DRYING for anyone with dry or sensitive skin. --- this product is marketed as hydrating and natural but really your best bet is to stick to an HA serum or another company’s marine products (like La Mer). My dry skin broke out into red splotches after just two uses due to the unexpected actives in it, which was disappointing as the Ordinary is usually accurate in their descriptions and marketing.
While it a good exfoliant, I don’t really notice much difference in brightening.
product_name: Mini Turmeric BHA Pore & Brightening Treatment Mask

review_text: I have searched for a comparable moisturizer but nothing is quite like this one. It is highly moisturizing while not being oily, perfect for every day or below makeup. It has no scents which makes it friendly to sensitive noses and sensitive skin. So happy to finally have it at a Canadian retailer!!!
product_name: Priming Moisturizer Lightweight Buildable Face Cream

review_text: I switched for this because of the “ phobia “ generated around skincare that contains alcohol. I was doing quite well with Tarte Knockout for even skin tone and pore size control. I have normal oily combo skin. Was very pleased with that Tarte Knockout Tingling toner. Used this for a full year. I can definitely atest to it’s inefficiency in helping pore size stay at minimum, no glowy feeling skin like before, dullness and insufficient exfoliating power. My make up didn’t look as good all during the time I used this. But I was going with the “ no alcohol “ moviment and ended up setting back my skin wasting a year on this over hyped product. Of Tarte Knockout is too strong for you I started years ago with the Climique ones. Both better than this product.
I used more than half of the bottle but didn’t see any result. It makes my skin look very oily after apply and the text feel very heavy on the face.

It was gifted complimentary from Dermalogica for my review. I have combination skin and I’ve always been fond of Dermalogica’s product. This exfoliator is super effective and I can feel my skin becomes super smooth after a few times

My Favorite Cleanser! The formula quickly foams and gently cleanses the face, which leaves a clean and soft face. I’ve been using this cleanser for the past two months and it has significantly contributed to my skin clearing up. I purchased another bottle just the other day, and would always recommend this product to others.
review_title: Essential Product in my Skin Care Routine

review_text: The day after I first put this product on, my face became really red and was itchy. Really surprised me because my skin has never been sensitive to anything before. However the day after, when the red went away, I did notice that a lot of my acne was gone or substantially smaller. So if you don’t have sensitive skin this might work for you but if your skin is sensitive at all I would not try this.
review_title: Works if you don't have sensitive skin
product_name: Acne Solutions All-Over Clearing Treatment Oil-Free

review_text: This is a really good product for acne prone/oily+combination skin. My face feels clean and fresh without feeling like the moisture has been stripped out of it. I noticed less breakouts as I kept using this cleanser and its safe enough to interact with all my other skincare products.
review_title: One of the best cleansers on the market

review_text: I’m 45 years old and not use Botox or filler‘s. I have melasma and dry skin. This anti-aging cream transformed my skin in two weeks. Gave it the moisture it needed, plumped it up, made me look years younger-hallelujah, decreased the age spots/melasma dark spots, and rejuvenated my skin is texture. It worked extremely well under my make up and provided a very youthful appearance. With initial application my skin turned slight pink as it absorbed the cream and quickly returned back to its normal color. The scent is also very heavenly it’s very organic and reminds me of a spa. I apply this with a moisturizer face brush for even application and gentle light massage. I will be purchasing this again when I run out as I’ve been applying it to my face neck and décolletage since I’ve been noticing dramatic results.
product_name: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I received this item free from Influenster to review. First, I truly appreciate being able to review this item and second I hate to say it’s not for me. I love many scents but not this one is not for me. It is creamy and doesn’t sit on the skin.
This made my skin feel tacky and sticky. It does not smell that great either I was expecting better I would not buy this again even for the price
product_name: Mini Facial Spray with Aloe, Cucumber and Green Tea

review_text: Do not use this mask of you have sensitive skin. I don’t know what all the fuzz it’s about, I tried it twice thinking I did something wrong and it left me with red marks all over my face, I felt like I was having an allergic reaction. Save your money!

I’ve been trying this off and on for a few weeks now and I notice that it breaks me out every single use. Although it leaves my skin beautifully hydrated and glowing, it’s just not worth the blemishes. It also gets tacky when it dries. Aside from that, I quite enjoy its earthy scent. I’ll still be returning due to the breakout situation.

I had doubts when I ordered this because of the less than positive reviews—I have sensitive skin and have used products in the past that have chemically burned my face, so obviously a peeling solution with a few bad reviews was questionable. HOWEVER i am incredibly surprised with this. My skin feels effin fab, pores look smaller, and it generally feels less oily.Two things to note: it says to let your face dry completely before using. When it mixes with water the pinprick-y sensation morphs to a full blown burn. You’ll feel it a little when you wash it off. So don’t put it on damp skin. Second, my skin does well with the Dr. Jart, Korres, and Dr. Brandt brands. Alternatively, I will break out in hives with Dr. Bronners peppermint bar soap and the Simple drugstore line of skin care burns my skin. I don’t know if this will help with your decision, but for me this peel is perfect.

An effective brightening mask with plenty of extra serum in the pouch that I end up using on my hands and arms, but not quite as effective as SKII or some of the other brightening sheet masks I’ve tried. Firstly the serum - there is LOTS of it. I’ve never before found a sheet mask to ’drip’ when I remove it from the packet. This one did! If you are stood over a sink when opening this, you won’t have any problem, not to mention the excess serum in the packet is a bonus - you can use it up on your body whilst waiting for the mask to do its thing, or store away in the refrigerator to use the following night as a hydrating skin serum. Leaving this on for 10 minutes gives me a good boost to my oily-yet-dehydrated skin, it looks plumper, feels more moisturized and it has a nice glow. I can’t say I notice any action on the odd hormonal acne marks mostly confined to my chin, but then I’m guessing it would take many more applications of this to achieve that. The only dislike here is the ingredients list. It is literally a chemical factory! Scanning to find the few botanicals in here is by no means an easy task and just by glancing at that I’d never believe this product would do a thing...but surprisingly it did and it does. Somehow the combination of ingredients works. I just wouldn’t want to use this too often as there are plenty of ’more natural’ sheet mask options available that work just as well.~ My Sephora Top 7 must-have list ~(My top 7 must-have beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Sephora)1. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: ‘Divine Herbal’ - Facial Treatment Serum5. Face Scrub: ‘Sisley’ - Botanical Gentle Buffing Cream6. Lip Balm: ‘Nuxe’ – Reve De Miel Lip Balm7. Lip Liner: ‘Sephora Collection’ - Rouge Gel Lip Liner

This product is a balm so it makes pushing it out of a tube very difficult but not impossible. I would say that is the only complaint I have about it.It applies very nicely and relives makeup nicely. I prefer to use an oil or shae butter to remove make up so I had just recently moved to an oil cleanser (great for make up but I don’t like for normal cleansing). With this product it’s great for removing make up/cleansing and I can use it specifically for that and my normal cleanser.
review_title: Melts the Waterproof Eyebrow right off!

review_text: To begin with, I have a sensitive, dry and acne-prone skin (I know, it’s complex, right?) with noticeable spots of hyperpigmentation. So I was all hyped up to use this PTR gel after reading tons of good, 5-star reviews. Foolish of me; I anticipated some miraculous results out of this product.To my disappointment, it didn’t show me any significant improvement in my skin. Maybe it calmed down new pimples that were just about to grow; nothing more. And simply stunting the growth of new breakouts isn’t what I expected from a $50+ product. I know some other products that do the same but cost a whole less.It was also very drying for my skin. The skin around my lips would get really dry, and I dreaded yawning after using this. I was initially going to use it as my final step of my nighttime regime (for some reason, I think another layer on top of a gel would diminish the clearing effect), but I couldn’t help but use a moisturizer because it was so drying.Consequently, a few days ago, I returned this product. I used it every night for about a month. I waited enough, right?I really wanted to love this PTR acne clearing gel, but it simply did not work. I truly envy those reviewers who said it worked magically on their skins. I wish it did on mine, too.
product_name: Goodbye Acne AHA/BHA Acne Clearing Gel Face Body Spot Treatment

review_text: Did not work for me, and actually made my acne worse but bc it’s so cheap it’s worth a shot to see if it works for you.

This product comes in such nice packaging! The lid is plastic and the jar itself is a heavy glass. It also comes with a little spatula but I felt it was pointless…There wasn’t anywhere on the actual jar to hold the spatula when not in use. I ended up tossing it and using my fingers to gently scoop out the product. The serum cream is extremely thick and creamy with little to no scent at all. I love the concept of the “serum cream”, but my combo skin said “noooooo way”! It’s very heavy on my combination/oily skin and didn’t absorb well no matter how much or how little product I used. I also noticed that because this cream was so heavy, I began to have more breakouts. My skin couldn’t breathe. This cream would be better suited for dry skin. I was disappointed because I absolutely love Tatcha as a brand and have purchased some other products of theirs before and used them with no prior issues. I’ve since used it the past three nights after washing my face/using toner and YUP... I get it now. New staple. Super gentle on my dry, delicate skin and makes my skin look amazingly bright and clear the next day. Great texture, small pores, luminous all-over glow from within skin. 10/10 stars!
I got this as a deluxe sample and it felt a little tacky at first, but after it absorbed it was really great and soothing. obviously it is expensive, but a good splurge for the future.
Love everything about this cleansing balm. Cleans skin without drying it and my pores love it too! The smell is also a plus!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: After reading so many reviews, I was pretty excited about this product but unfortunately it didn’t work for me. Earlier I use to have 1-2 hormonal acnes but now on regular days to my face look like a battlefield. :(

review_title: smells weird and doesn't clean well

review_text: I love this face mask. It’s not too drying and leaves your skin feeling soft and pampered afterwards. Don’t forget to exfoliate as your take it off - that’s really what buffs out the grime. I have fairly sensitive skin and this product works well for me and I would definitely recommend it.

review_text: I am really enjoying this mask, it works on my skin so much. I apply every night. highly suggested
review_title: try it and you won't regret it.
product_name: Floral Recovery Overnight Mask with Squalane

review_text: I received it defective. It spilled everywhere in the box when it came. I asked Sephora customer service to sent me a return label since I didn’t have a printer, but they keep telling me to print it myself???? That was the third time I received a defective packaging from the Inkey List already. The first two weren’t this terrible so I didn’t return it.

It’s a huge plus that this Targeted Pores Serum is 100% clean and vegan. It has become a staple step in my skincare routine morning and evening. I can’t get over how much my skin looks healthier and more radiant just after using for a few weeks daily. This serum doesn’t have a greasy or heavy feeling, it helped even and tone my skin. It does not irritate my sensitive skin. And is a super affordable product!
product_name: Targeted Pores Serum with BHA + PHA

review_text: I tried this for about a month and a half.....it DID decrease the look of wrinkles around the corners of my eyes but it did nothing for moisture :( I have really dry spots in the creases of my eyes where I normally will blend out my eyeshadows and they are still flaky and dry. I wish it did both or I would love it!
Feels good on application but left me super oily. I wouldn’t repurchase.
product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream

review_text: This product smells amazing! I would not consider this product a Hydrating Lip Balm. I can put it on and its literally gone in 30 minuets. My lips instantly go back to being dry in about 45 minuets. I still love the product i just wish it held up better. Not sticky at all and goes on great with a lip brush or finger.

I’ve been loving this eye cream lately. It’s thick and super hydrating without being greasy. It sinks right into my skin so I’m able to apply makeup without any issues. I tend to get dry under eyes during the cooler months and can tell this will be perfect to combat that issue.
product_name: Ceramighty  AF Eye Cream with Ceramides

review_text: I’ve been using this for over a year, it works well. I keep it in rotation because my skin likes it and doesn’t break out. However, you will need a make up balm remover and then follow up with this. It’s good for sensitive skin but it won’t remove make up on the first wash
product_name: Squalane + Amino Aloe Gentle Pore-Minimizing Cleanser

review_text: This is one of the items that complete my 3 step trio and I love it, but be sure to use the full compliment, without moisturizing your skin may get dry (and I have rather oily skin)!
product_name: Acne Solutions Cleansing Bar For Face and Body

review_text: I LOVE this product! Great for dry skin and colder months. The thickness is just right and it removes all my makeup. I use the kale cleanser and my foreo after. Keeps my skin super soft and glowy! I much prefer this to the usual liquid removers that leave my skin dry. Will buy again!

I have very sensitive skin due to rosacea so to say that I was apprehensive using this is an understatement. To my surprise I was left with hydrated, moisturized skin that is glowing and it appears more youthful. I love it.
I had very high hopes for the resurfacing mask.After 10 uses, I see no difference in my skin. Very disappointing.
It wasn’t the best.. hasn’t done much with my skin yet ! But I do like the smell of it and the look of the toner ! I got this complimentary from influenster ! Can’t complain!
product_name: Abeille Royale Anti-Aging Fortifying Lotion Toner

review_text: I wanted to love this so much...but I just couldn’t. It’s WAY too thick, and takes WAY too long to absorb! I like the feel of the product and it goes ok smooth. But my skin is really dry and this was too heavy for me! I returned. :-(
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I was excited to splurge on this cream however it made my skin turn red and I got small bumps all over my face not to mention a nasty pimple by my chin that I’m still working to get rid of after weeks... it was hydrating but I had to take it off as soon as I noticed the redness in my face. I looked up why my skin may have reacted and I believe it was the gold particles in it, watch out if you have sensitive skin or dermatitis
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: I received a sample and used it for about 2 weeks. TEXTURE: the bi-phasic solution leaves an oily residue/shine on the skin which I’m not a fan of. It also has a quite strong acidic scent. RESULTS: it does maintain the radiance of my skin and is gentle enough to use it daily, doesn’t seem to fade my acne scars/hyperpigmentation.

This eye cream is very creamy and just a little goes a long way! It blends very easily under your eyes. I love that it doesn’t have a smell and just the texture when it melts on your skin. I have seen my under eyes even more hydrated than before.The product was not greasy and went into the skin quickly. My wrinkles and fine lines that I do have actually tightened up.
product_name: Squalane + Marine Algae Firming & Lifting Eye Cream

review_text: Y’all. It could be the best thing in the world for pores and I still wouldn’t use it because the smell is so horrific. I can’t even put my finger on what it smells like, except a nightmare. Imagine a bag of trash that’s been left out in the sun for 40 years...yeah, that’s better smelling than this.
product_name: pores no more Vacuum Cleaner Pore Purifying Mask

review_text: I always like to use the best skincare products because skincare is very important to me and this is the best, softest and luxurious feeling luminous cream by Damdam. I love to use it twice a day for better results, it really makes my skin shiny and refreshed!
product_name: Mochi Mochi Luminous Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: I’m so shocked to be writing this review, based on the number of positive reviews I read before trying this, I thought it would be an easy winner.welp, no. not only did it not deliver any results (truly. no hydration, no refining, nothing), but it also made me break out! not horribly, thankfully. just small little white heads that showed up on the 4th day, and went away 2 days after I removed this product from my lineup.It does not layer well - I tried using this under my night cream and it pilled. tried using it under my makeup and it pilled worse!I’m honestly sad about this. I use several other products by Fresh and LOVE them. I’m hoping maybe I just got a bad batch because other people seem to swear by this serum.
review_title: unimpressive. also does not layer well.
product_name: Tea Elixir Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Serum

review_text: I started using this moisturizer about 5 months ago and I absolutely love it! I have mature skin that tends to get tight and is very sensitive. The luxurious texture goes on thick but instantly absorbs into the skin so it doesn’t feel heavy or sit on top of skin. The fragrance is nice (not too heavy) and I love the little paddle that allows you to scoop out the moisturizer without having to put your fingers right in the product. A little pricey but a little goes a long way. Would definitely recommend.

Horrible smell. Smells like Coppertone sunblock mixed with geranium extract. It is such a strong smell that I refused to even put it on my face-- I tested it on my hand (Sephora, please get testers of this) and it was so awful that I had to scrub and scrub to get rid of the smell. It is definitely not a relaxing experience.
product_name: Lotus Balancing & Hydrating Natural Face Treatment Oil

review_text: Returned this stuff a week after purchasing. Very frothy and foamy when washing, but also slightly irritating. After rinsing it off and drying with a towel, it felt like I had a mask on it was so dry. Left a gross film all over my face. Do not recommend. (Also doesn’t smell great)
product_name: Checks and Balances Frothy Face Wash

review_text: Meh. Going to return. Better results with an AHA/BHA nightly serum or vitamin C serum overnight. It didn’t seem to do anything, it’s very very mild. For the price I don’t want to have to go through a whole bottle before I see something change a little

I bought all three products because I have rosacea and minor acne. Within a week I have now had major break outs and my skin will not quit peeling, I have zits in places I never had problems with before! This is the first product I will be returning from sephora. After a few days it does start to burn my face as well.
It sinks in to the skin really well, BUT it burns. The skin around my eyes is very sensitive after using and very red.
I have been using this product twice daily since purchase. I have not seen the any diffrence on my dark spots.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: After using this product from the end of December to now, this product has damaged my skin. I now constantly break out and my skin is much more red and irritated than before. Very disappointed.
review_title: Do not buy this. I wish I could get my money back!

review_text: the product not hydrate as expected, feel like just normal facial oil

This is one of my favorite products ever! I have already used a bottle and am almost out, I truly enjoy this product as it has retinol, but not the “purging” affects. It is a perfect addition to my routine as it builds on top of other products so well! I definitely recommend to those wanting to try retinol for the first time!
I do not see any difference in the color of my teeth. The device goes off and on when I wear it around my neck, with the enclosed cord, while whitening.
product_name: GLO Brilliant White Smile - At Home Teeth Whitening Device

review_text: Initially I really liked it and I loved the consistency but over time it really broke me out. I started getting tiny bumps on my forehead which I haven’t had in over a year and this was the only product that has been introduced into my routine. I was really excited but now I’m disappointed that I have to deal with this breakout when my skin was doing so much better before.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Felt cool and refreshing, but wasn’t very moisturizing like I was told it would be. Also didn’t stay on long, even though I let it “sit“ for 20min. before applying anything on top

La Mer is one of my favorite brands of moisturizer, and I tend to alternate between the heavier cream and the soft lotion based on the time of year. I thought that this cool gel cream would be the one to use during the summer, especially with the heat and humidity where I live. Unfortunately, this product leaves my skin feeling sticky and tacky, and it feels as though the product hasn’t actually been absorbed.
review_title: Not On Par with Other La Mer Moisturizers

review_text: I don’t get the hype, my friends rave and rave about these and I really don’t see or feel a difference. It’s an overrated oxy pad.

I have oily, acne prone skin that sometimes gets dry around the nose and mouth area. This was recommended to me at the Clinique counter, and they said it works great with acne and oily skin types. It just felt really greasy on my face and made my skin even more oily. I much prefer the Clinique Moisture Surge to this. The Moisture surge feels more lightweight and moisturizes without making my oily skin feel greasy and doesn’t cause me to break out. I gave this 2 stars instead of just 1 because it didn’t break my face out so it’s not completely terrible.
review_title: Too Greasy Feeling, Made Oily Skin Worse

review_text: Like all the other reviews, they are affordable but they are pretty dry. I also didn’t see any change on my texture, so for that I am not repurchasing but I like the idea of this product.

I received a sample size of this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. Honestly, the sample size of this product was really only big enough to use for 3 days, only at night. It has a very thick consistency, but it did not melt into my skin really well. It seems like I needed a lot of product just to cover my face and feel moisturized. It also made me totally break out in the 3 days that I used it, so I would not recommend this product if you have sensitive, combination skin.
product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer

review_text: So harsh and zero results. My skin is very used to chemical exfoliants (I was using P50 before this) and I found this makes my skin so irritated. I’ve given it a month or so (using around twice/week) to see if it improves anything, and I see no difference in my skin texture or glow. Probably has just damaged my moisture barrier. :/
product_name: Acid Potion AHA + BHA Resurfacing Exfoliator

review_text: This product is great at taking makeup off and it does not irritate my sensitive skin or cause breakouts. I love it. My only downside is that it completely clogged my sink and nothing in the directions warns about this. Now i make sure to wipe it off with cotton rounds before i rinse, but i feel like they should warn of the drain clogging issue or suggest wiping off before rinsing.
review_title: Great product but it clogged my sink
product_name: Mini Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: I loved this serum without a doubt I would buy it, I tried it and it leaves your skin more hydrated and with a smooth and smooth texture, the lines of expression diminish, it is excellent for the care of your skin.
product_name: Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Duo

review_text: I used both the moisturizer and the serum together since that’s what I usually do when I use maracuja oil. I use moisturizer and then finish up with an oil or serum. The serum was phenomenal. It felt so hydrating and fresh after I put it on and I swear that I could still feel the plumpness in my skin and the hydration the next day at the end of the day even after wearing makeup all day. I would highly recommend this product and I can’t wait to buy the full size. I got this as the October birthday gift and am reviewing for Influenster. Glad I tried it!
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: Hydrate bien par contre très grasse ayant la peau mixte je la déconseille

I received this complimentary from Peace Out Skincare and tried this one a smallish pimple I had on my face and wore it to bed, woke up and it was completely flat and smooth. I’m impressed, I’m lucky I don’t have any other active pimples at the moment so im excited to use on future pimples. I did notice some dryness post removing the patch but I know BHA is supposed to dry out the pimple.
I received this as part of my Voxbox through Influenster. The product does work really well and I noticed how nice skin was looking after about a week. My only downside to it is that it is sticky.
I received a sample and I’m disappointed. It left my skin with a shiny/sticky residue and I also didn’t notice any improvements in my skin from using it.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Started noticing texture on my skin. Purchases this mask and after one use I had smooth soft skin! pores were minimized and my face was bright. Will be repurchasing!
product_name: Blue Tansy BHA and Enzyme Pore Refining Mask

review_text: Did nothing for my super dry lips :-( the search continues
product_name: Sugar Advanced Lip Balm Intense Hydration Treatment

review_text: This is a fast-acting solution for when you have a breakout. Dried my zit out really fast, and it was a big one. It’s best if you can put it on early, before pimples get really big.
product_name: Super Spot Remover Acne Treatment Gel

review_text: I have very sensitive skin. This is so bad I can’t wait for the other soap I ordered to be delivered so I can toss this. It made my skin break out and feel super greasy. It’s like I’m back in high school. Also for the record I’m only using drunk elephant products right now as recommend by the brand. I really like some of them but this is a hard pass.
I was excited to try this because the reviews seemed promising but it didn’t do anything, has sparkles in it and caused milia under my eyes. Save your money!!!!
product_name: Vitamin C Dark Circle Correcting Eye Serum

review_text: This is a wonderful exfoliating product. The texture is a gel that goes on and absorbs smoothly and quickly. I love that this is fragrance free and available in 2 sizes. As for the performance of this product, I think it works very well at handling texture as well as treating breakouts. I’ve been using this for quite a long time and I can most definitely see and feel a difference in my skin from when I wasn’t using this a few years ago. The price is high, but I do find it worth it as it performs beautifully. When you use this in conjunction with T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial, your skin will really be a force to be reckoned with!
product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: Bought this product since I’m loving the Algenist genius liquid collagen. At first I didn’t see any difference. It took a while and it works. I use this every night.
I love DE face moisturizers but this balm dried out my lips more causing them to peel. I am going to try it again since it’s been a month since use but I am not sure I will be able to use it.

I love this brand so when I saw they had a vitamin c serum I was stoked! But when I got it I was disappointed first of all with how exspensive it is and how little you get and having to put it together myself. I’ve been using it for about a month now and I haven’t noticed any difference that I can tell. It’s super sticky hard to evenly distribute on the face and the smell isn’t the greatest. I will not be repurchasing this unfortunately.

I honestly didn’t see any sort of effect with this product. It was just like a gel like product that to me did not do the things that were advertised. I used it many times and it minimally aided in drying out blemishes but only after multiple applications. Was not a favourite but the others in the line are better in my opinion

This is too perfumed for me. And my skin just burned ever so slightly everywhere after I applied it. My skin tends to let me know right away if something is disagreeable. I usually only buy very natural and unscented products, and I’m opening that up a bit to some of the Clean at Sephora products although they still aren’t as “clean” as I’m used to. It isn’t a bad scent, and if you don’t normally buy “clean“ products it probably wouldn’t bother most.
product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer

review_text: One of my holy grail products. I’ve tried so many other moisturizers but nothing compares to this YTTP one!
product_name: Adaptogen Deep Moisturizing Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: Cleared up my skin immediately. What a huge difference. I was taking some medication that made me break out and no other product would heal my breakouts except this product. My breakouts have cleared up within a few days!! Non-drying, made my skin go back to normal. Still use it when I have occasional breakouts! Wonderful product

this stuff is AMAZING, it’s probably the singular product in my skincare routine that makes the biggest difference (if I stop using this for a while my skin starts breaking out & looks noticeably less glowy) !! I have to use it in a particular way for it to work though. I always use it on clean skin at night cus I have more time to work with it. it’s going to feel a bit greasy and almost warming, and I like to let it sit on my skin for 5-10 minutes just by itself, by the end of which everything should feel mostly absorbed. THEN I go in with the rest of my skincare (only 1-2 creams so I know it’s the vitamin C making the difference) and boom I wake up in the morning with baby soft skin. It took a while for my skin to adjust to this (it got a bit red/itchy when I first started using it), but I ended up LOVING this product & my skin is always clear when I have the time to properly use it. And it’s so cheap for a vitamin C serum!! Try it!!
review_title: can't go without this for clear skin

review_text: I received this product from Influenster. Overall it’s a great AHA serum, but I feel like the watery texture (although it feels nice) is kinda messy and hard to apply. It definitely does brighten your skin-- which is what AHA’s are supposed to do, but I think I prefer other products (like Sunday Riley) by a little bit. But it’s safe to use everyday on my sensitive/eczema skin, which is a definite plus! They really put a lot into this product. I just don’t know if it’s worth the full splurge. I love Tatcha’s products otherwise though, and you really can’t beat their packaging.
product_name: Violet-C Brightening Serum 20% Vitamin C + 10% AHA

review_text: I’ve used a couple containers of this, and it did absolutely nothing to improve my skin. It left my skin lacklustre, dull and dry in places as well. I’m giving it 2 stars because at least it didn’t cause eczema or severe breakouts like some other products have for me. For almost $100 though, I absolutely would not recommend this product to anyone. There are so many better and more reasonably-priced options out there. Avoid!
I can’t lie it left my skin very soft and smooth but not even having it for a month it left my face so dry and irritating ! Don’t think I’ll ever try it again

This leaves my skin feeling clean without drying it out. I love the smell and the way it feels on my skin. The only thing I dislike is that it does not remove my makeup very well. I do not wear waterproof mascara and it still does not come off very easily with this face wash.

Really hate the smell (which is why I cut off a star), but it works great! There is no need for retinol and a moisturizer as this is a two-in-one for my routine. It is strong, so I started off using it every second or third night until I built tolerance. This stuff is worth every penny.

Ya hard pass, wish I opened and smelled this thing before the return window passed. It has a bad plastic smell. Yes *if* it did some sort of miracle on my skin I would give it a better rating but did nothing outstanding so there’s that…

Where Do I begin? Well first of all I have very fair skin and have always dealt with unwanted redness, freckles, and brown spots. After trying so many products I have finally found a solution this cured at least 95% of my redness and brown spots. Although this product does burn a little it is SO worth it!!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Girls go to Winners. I bought three $12 silk pillow cases in different colours, maybe not as high quality silk, but has the exact same effect on my hair and skin

This is a GREAT micellar cleanser!! I have very dry/sensitive skin...and this works without drying out my skin (like other micellar waters) I like the smell too. I use this after I wash my face at night to make sure I get all eye and makeup off. Then I use it in the morning before applying makeup/lotion (to save time instead of washing my face) TIP: I do use the Shiseido facial cotton pads. It doesn’t take as much of the product as regular cotton pads. You get about 160 pads for $12 on Sephora. Money well spent. And these pads also don’t leave cotton hairs all over your face!! The whole Mega-Mushroom line is great for dry/sensitive/red skin. I highly recommend.

I got this because it’s paraben-free and I wanted something lighter for the summer. It goes on very smoothly, and I’ve had no skin allergies to it. It just takes a little getting used to something that’s oil free, as I typically have somewhat dry skin.

I started using this morning and night paired with a skin Serum. Love the cool feeling of the roller. Find it really helps my skin absorb the serums and oils much better than just traditional hand application. Soothing in the morning.

I’ve tried a LOT of eyecreams from cheap to expense but nothing has worked like this one. It is moisturizing without causing milia and the retinol is just perfect to firm/even out my fine lines. I can visibly see a difference when I use it. It absorbs like a dream. I hope they never cancel this product.
product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: Literally cured my rosacea. You wake up with smooth and silky, beautiful skin. The formula is literally magic in a bottle. Great for redness. Excellent hydration. I wish I could give it 10 stars!

The moisturization of this product is really great. Skin looks and feels nourished. But I woke up every morning with whiteheads. So bizarre. It took me 1.5 wks to finally piece together what was causing it. Get a sample before you buy the item!

My dermatologist recommended I start using a toner at night and this one feels amazing! Does not dry out my skin and leaves my skin feeling clean after use. Can’t beat the quality for the price. Make sure not to overuse it- I use maximum 5 times a week to not irritate my skin.
Nice product, but shattered into a million pieces.

Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel is a good home exfoliation treatment. It is easy to use and caused me no irritation. My skin felt smoother and my complexion looked brighter. It really did exfoliate my skin well. I am sure with continued use my skin would continue to improve. I recommend giving it a try.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This eye gel feels great going on- very refreshing. It perks up my undereye area and makes it feel hydrated FOR ABOUT 5 MINUTES. Once the gel dries the area looks and feels just like it did prior to application.I bought this when it first came out and I used it because it’s convenient (you don’t have to get it on your fingers) and it does feel nice and provides a little pick-me-up. Since then, I’ve received the mini size a few times as a free gift with purchase. I’ll use it when it’s free, but I would never pay for it again.One concern unrelated to performance- The packaging concerns me a bit. It seems unhygienic to roll this around the eye area, especially over makeup.
product_name: All About Eyes Serum De-Puffing Eye Massage

review_text: As someone that has fairly decent skin with a bit of old acne scarring and the occasional breakout, I found this product to be absolutely useless. It did nothing for my skin whatsoever. I would recommend using a cheap witch hazel toner over this. Also, the packaging is not the best; in the first few uses my bottle just so happened to tip into the sink and about 15$ worth spilled down the sink :/

As soon as this product touched my face, it started burning. My skin has never reacted this way after using any product. If you have sensitive skin beware, I washed it off as soon as I noticed the markings on my face.
product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: Liz at Disney Springs recommended this and it hasn’t disappointed at all. Doesn’t dry skin out, nor is it overly moisturising for my combination skin. I like the subtle scent and will definitely be buying more products from this range.

I don’t get why it’s called a “lip sleeping mask” when it stays on for 30 minutes tops. It needs to be reapplied very VERY often. This is coming from someone who has used TONS of lip balm products ranging from low to very high prices, and this product is definitely not worth it. However, It does smell really good and makes your lips slightly softer for a few minutes before it rubs off, only because it feels like you’re putting grease on your lips.
review_title: A girl who has lip filler
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: The formula changed. It was a more dense, waxy, lightly fragranced formula. Now it’s an oily, slippery, perfume formula. I’m disappointed. I really liked the old formula. Sending back.
Too much fragrance in this one and not as moisturizing which is very sad because I had high hopes and love when moisturizers have a SUBTLE scent that can put you to sleep like lavender
review_title: buy the original lotus youth preserve instead

review_text: This is a great facial cream for those with dry skin. Your face will thank you. After I applied it, my skin felt nourished and was glowing. I highly recommend it.

Ok so, I don’t get the hype. Everyone and their dog has heard of ANR and the hefty price tag that comes with it. People rave about it, swear by it, and claim it’s the fountain of youth serum. But yea, it’s just ok for me. ⁠⁠When I was midway through the bottle, I still had hope. But I finished the bottle this past weekend and I can confirm, it didn’t do much for me. My pores look the same, my skin tone never evened out, and I don’t think I have any fine lines for this to diminish. My skin IS soft but I don’t think it was this product (I’ve been using Snail Mucin). The one thing it did give me was a glow...but for $95, that’s an expensive glow!⁠⁠Maybe my expectations were too high or maybe I’m not the right target for this product. Whatever the reason, I’m not going to be repurchasing this.
product_name: Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex Serum

review_text: I wanted to love this because I’ve heard such raving reviews about drunk elephant everything. I have sensitive skin and this is NOT for those with sensitive skin. Within 3 uses, my skin now has angry red patchy spots ALL over my face. It looks like a chemical burn. I would give this 0 stars if I could.

review_text: Okay, there are good things about this product and then there are some not good things about this. To start, my skin has been looking and feeling great since I started using this. review_text: I never write reviews but this begs for it.I really did try to make this work and have almost used it up. But I’ve had enough of this now. I only use DE products in my morning routine, there’s nothing in my routine that should keep this from performing well or disrupt the formulation. I even tried it with nothing underneath or DE protini cream only or lala cream only. It is pilling no matter how gently I apply it (even followed their instructions on Instagram to not massage it in too hard).Here is what works to help with this mess: 1) use very little product and gently spread... however all this means poor spf coverage (should be using 1ml+) and the application can result in uneven coverage and texture like it is not one with the skin. Or 2) Using a soft brush, brush off the pilling bits after this has dried down for 10min... I personally don’t have the time to mess around with this to examine and perfect the finish while worrying about poor spf coverage.Needless to say that this is not good under makeup. It makes cc or foundation or concealer break down on application or early during wear. DE does say their whole vision for the brand is around no makeup and bare skin but can I just say... how convenient for them. Meanwhile other brands come up with formulations (even clean ones) that work with makeup for the same price of this.. or less.Another thing, the instructions about reapplying “at least every 2 hours”.. thanks DE.. for assuming users are too unintelligent to be further informed. That means 2 hours of exposure to sunlight. I’m not saying anybody is actually applying this 4-5 times per day but I’m commenting for the sake of clarity, it wouldn’t hurt for a brand to reassure their customers that their skin is uv protected during a regular day at home/office without running to get their umbra reapplied every hour. Can we please know, assuming correct application, for how long we can rely on this during a regular day, realistically, since it’s a daily spf.

love the soft vanilla like smell. purchased all in full size.

review_text: This has a lovely luxurious feel to it, skin feels clean but not dry. You feel like you’re doing something good for your face.

I definitely recommend this to anyone looking for an effective eye cream!

review_text: I received this complimentary for review. I was really excited to try this sunscreen, but unfortunately found it pretty disappointing. Starting with the pros, I like that it has vitamin c, as that boosts the effects of sunscreen. I also appreciate that this goes on completely clear and has no white cast whatsoever. That was an issue that I faced with a different shisheido sunscreen previously. Lastly, it’s great that this is broad spectrum SPF 42. The cons, however, outweigh the pros. The biggest con is the texture and finish of this product. At first it’s promising because it feels incredibly lightweight and almost watery, so you’re expecting it to feel juicy and hydrating. Once you actually start spreading it out though, you’ll quickly find that it’s extremely greasy. Despite how runny it is, it ends up feeling really thick and heavy on the skin. I tried waiting for a while to see if it eventually sinks in, but it continues to feel heavy and uncomfortable for hours. It has a slight silicon-y feel as well, but it’s not blurring in any way. If anything it emphasizes my texture because of how greasy it is. It leaves a residue that’s difficult to wash off. Overall, I do not recommend this product for any skin type. Even for my dry skin areas, it felt oily but not nourishing.
review_title: Don’t recommend for any skin type

review_text: I know this isn’t one of the “clean” products, and it’s not advertised as being for sensitive skin—and I even saw one of the reviews pointing out that it has unlabeled sunscreen ingredients, which is true (look it up on incidecoder! Literally 4 ingredients whose only known purpose is as chemical sunscreens—and not the kind that’s reef-safe or legal in HI either, which might be the only explanation I can imagine, since it was apparently developed for models… who might spend a lot of time in places like HI… maybe that’s the “magic”??)! And yet… I’ve been combating insanely sensitive skin since moving to the horrifically dry CO climate 2.5 years ago. Like complete face broken out in a solid bumpy, painful hivey rash at least 3-5 days/week. Zoom filters couldn’t cover it up. And somehow, this perfumed, chemical sunscreen ridden moisturizer is literally the first product I’ve found that actually managed to not set off a reaction—including every one of the top “clean” brands and sensitive skin products I’ve tried. For reference, I made Sephora Rouge status over the course of about 5 months last year—I am NOT kidding around when I say I’ve tried pretty much every facial moisturizer/soother/serum/oil/etc they’ve offered through the bazaar, boxes, samples, mini/travel sizes, or even sold as full size for less than like $80–that’s a lot of products, folks. I was even doing controlled tests for months (different products on different parts of my face, product-free control zone, the whole works) after I first tried it, and it visibly and immediately soothed my skin unlike anything I’ve tried so far. I’ve been using it on its own for the last month or so, and haven’t had a single flare—by far the longest I’ve gone in over two years. I do think it’s on the heavy side for summer, but it absorbs really well. If I can find something else without the secret sunscreen, I’d love to use it—but until then, I’ll just say that “clean” skincare isn’t always the solution for reactive skin.

review_text: The Good: I got this significantly discounted to the point of it costing a few bucks. Charcoal usually works good on my face and I’ve had success with some acne-aimed sheet masks from SC. The overall fit of this felt just off laying on my face and it was significantly drier than what I expect from my usual SC masks which are usually very saturated with serums. I also didn’t feel any pore tightening and minimizing effect from this mask, I truly did not see any results both long or short term. Lastly, this mask somehow left my skin feeling dry which is a really strange experience and result from a sheet mask which is usually hydrating regardless of if it’s aimed at targeting acne or pore minimization. The Ugly/Honest: Even at it’s hugely discounted price, this mask is still not worth it in my opinion. There are better, cheaper and more effective masks out there even within the SC collection. This mask is a total miss in comparison to their usual quality, I was highly disappointed.

I know there’s been some discussion here on whether or not the ’balls’ are actually skin, or product, and I feel it is mostly product, with maybe a little dead skin. I’m so happy I found this, it’s such a great product!

review_text: When this dries down it smells like baby powder, very strongly. I wish Sephora included scent profiles for products other than perfumes, especially products that stay on your skin - as it can be a very important factor. I absolutely despise the smell of baby powder, it triggers a migraine (which in turn triggers nausea). I used this moisturizer and felt sick (very similar to carsickness) all day smelling it in waves. Wasn’t able to wash my face for a handful of hours. I know not everyone is as affected by powdery scents like this, but man - I wish I’d known beforehand. I do like the Dewy Skin moisturizer, and never imagined something with “water” in the name would have a powder scent.

It has more of a watery consistency and it is dark brown and gives me fermented vibes. It doesn’t have any artificial fragrance that I can tell and smells kind of sweet/sour (again, kinda fermented? Idk) before fading quickly. Due to its consistency it absorbs incredibly quickly into the skin. If you layer your serums, this is definitely one of the first ones you should apply. After I applied this, I didn’t really notice much of an immediate difference, to be honest. Visually, it looked like I hadn’t applied anything at all, and although my face felt kind of hydrated, I didn’t notice anything too dramatic. I was hoping this would be more impactful, especially since Sulwhasoo is so influential in the kbeauty market and the product is so pricey. Unfortunately I was left underwhelmed.
Not worth it for the price , does the same or less than Instagram whitening kits. Technology is cool , and convenient but doesn’t do any serious whitening.

review_text: This moisturizer has been a godsend for my dry, sensitive winter skin. It is packed with amazing ingredients like Mango Seed Butter, Niacinamide, Eight Amino Acids, Three Ceramides, Eight Peptides, and more to strengthenand fortify the skin barrier. The texture is thick and nourishing, while still spreading easily across the skin.A little goes a long way, genuinely a pea size amount is all I need for my face and neck. It doesn’t 100% fully absorb into my skin, but I love the finish it leaves as it makes my skin feel so protected and comforted. The product claims to have a Balm to Gel texture and I mostly agree with that; the texture definitely transforms from a balm into a spreadable gel, it just isn’t as lightweight as a gel moisturizer. This product also as a fresh, lemony citrus scent that I like. While this is a tad expensive, since a little goes such a long way and it has so many great ingredients I do feel the price is justified. To stress how little product you need to use; I have been using this for over a month, both day and night for my dry skin during the winter, and am not even half way through the jar which is just wild for Mr. Additionally while I can use it both day and night, I could potentially see combo/oily skin finding it too heavy for the day time under spf. This product makes my skin feel incredible, has a lovely texture, and helps reinforce my skin barriers health and I highly recommend it!
