This was the perfect solution. I love the smell of the product and it only takes a couple drops. I’ve tried squalane and marula but for acne this has got to be the best thing out there. I’ve also used this after doing clay masks and together that combo really calms my skin down while nourishing it and reducing redness. Will def keep buying this in the future.
review_title: Best oil for acne without drying out
product_name: Mini Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: I was recommended this product by a Sephora employee when searching for a hydrating moisturizer. I wanted to love it, but unfortunately, it broke me out terribly and gave me a rash :( if you have acne prone skin, be careful with this!
product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Cloud Rich Barrier Moisturizer

review_text: The product seems like it should work well but I already have dry skin and it made it feel 10x drier! I could barely move my lips. So maybe for someone with oily skin but just not for me. Simply too harsh. I do generally like Keils products though. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.
product_name: Clearly Corrective Dark Spot Correcting Serum

review_text: This product is very creamy & smells great upon initial application. However, it starts to smell BAD after a couple of minutes.. kind of like garbage that’s been sitting outside in the heat for days. I haven’t seen any other reviews that mention the odor, so I might have just gotten a bad batch. I’ve been using this for about 1.5 months now (I know it takes at LEAST a month to see results from different skin care products) but this product doesnt do much for my skin & just leaves me feeling really greasy all night and gross when I wake up in the morning. It never feels like it gets absorbed into my skin. I would not recommend spending your money on this!
product_name: Mini Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Mask

review_text: I have super oily skin and sunblock makes it so much worse. This makes my skin matte and is oil free. Totally recommend.
product_name: Super Fluid Daily UV Defense Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+

review_text: Although this product is easy to apply and scent free-which I enjoy, I do not like the thick slimy feel. With one wash I still feel like it’s not completely off. I wouldn’t recommend this product.

I love this moisturizer! Only downside is it leaves your skin the slightest bit tacky and smells really old school. After using this my skin is very hydrated and glowing and it seems to plump just a little bit. Long term use it’s really amazing and will help repair and soften.

Very good product! I have normal-dry skin and it gets very dry and flaky in dry weather. This product provides deep hydration that stays on my skin even after I wash my face in the morning, and last all day long. Good amount of product as well. 1 jar runs out after 5 months of daily use (I usually apply 1 pump every day before going to bed). Another good thing about it is the pumping system, which keeps the rest of your product nicely inside the jar without contamination. Would highly recommend!

This soap is by far one of my absolute favorites. I Originally loved how the size is perfect for travel. Id always buy a set before Id go on any trip- and I started to notice my skin was so perfectly clear and smooth after every vacation... Better than before I went on vacation, and the only thing in my routine I changed was this soap! It’s now a staple in my routine and I couldn’t be more pleased. If you have skin troubles (I have dry and acne prone skin) and sensitive skin, this is the soap for you!
product_name: Baby Pekee Bar + Juju Bar Travel Duo

review_text: My main concern is dark circles, and this product doesn’t do anything for me besides being a moisturizer that doesn’t make me break out. I know it’s supposed to be a brightening product but it just makes my under-eye look greasy. I have the mini size of this since it was a part of the Clinique Pep-Start set and it’s lasted me 3mo, even though I use it twice a day. Can’t wait to finally finish this off so I can move onto a better product!

Used this product for several weeks to soothe my extremely dry, sensitive skin, and was hopeful based on the reviews. But this product makes my entire face burn very badly every time, and my skin is red for days after. Really mad that I paid this much for a product that literally does damage. Had to stop using. Even though it’s specifically for sensitive skin, I don’t recommend.

This product is for Black or Brown people because if you are lighter than brown, this will end up being way too bronzy and make you look like a shiny penny. This is also for people who simply want a glow and don’t care about sun protection because if you use the adequate amount of this product to actually be protected, you will again, look like a greasy shiny penny. This would look nice on the collar bone area or as a light layer when you’re on vacation. Overall, does not work for me and I don’t think it’s practical but would totally be a hit for people who just want to look bronzy on a warm day.
product_name: Isle Glow Face Moisturizer SPF 45 with Sea Moss and Niacinamide

review_text: It works as a moisturizer but I don’t feel like it’s worth it. It takes a good amount of time to sink in for me and I feel like the hydration does not last a very long time and I have oily-combo skin. I really did not like the scent either. I don’t even know how to describe it, it’s just very artificial smelling. Overall, not a fan :(

This product has helped brighten my skin significantly after a week of use. I have an acne prone oily skin and i am 30 years old and i can testify that this has been beneficial to my skin. I would usually use this in my morning routine. complimentary from Drunk Elephant Ecomm.
review_title: A new AM skin care routine must!

review_text: Loved it! Great primer, moisturizing and smells great
product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer

review_text: i’ve sensitive, oily, and acne prone skin, and it seems like this moisturizer isn’t for me... 1st, the smell is too strong... i don’t exactly mind scent, and i mostly try to use fragrance free products... but if by the time i’m in bed and can still smell the product quite strongly, then we have a problem...2nd, this reminds me of an oil free moisturizer... not only it leaves my skin shiny and feels oily shortly after and overall uncomfortable after application but also quite dry and tight in the morning overall, it wasn’t a good fit for me personally, and i didn’t enjoy using it

I used it for months and did nothing for me. The formula is very guppy and it spills easily out the bottle if you leave it standing up. Its kinda messy and the clay does nothing. Im going to try something else. I wish I could return it.

I got this product after watching an add for it.. I instantly knew I needed it. I work on my phone and computer all the time. So I got this. I started using this at my night time routine and im in love with it. Especially if you have dark circles or eye bags. I highly recommend this product.
i wanted to love this stuff but it made my already bad skin worse it was almost like my skin just constantly purged i used it for 60 days and gave up.
product_name: Goodbye Acne  Max Complexion Correction Pads

review_text: I was so excited to try this product! Got it for my sister for her bday. She did a patch test on her face and in 5 minutes that spot was extremely red and irritated. I decided to try it because I thought the odds were low it would happen to both of us. Sure enough, I did a patch test on my cheek- so bright red and raised skin and itchy! Thank god I didn’t put on my whole face. Really wanted to love this product :(
review_title: Broke out- both me and my sister!

review_text: First thing to say about Glowsetting 100% Mineral Powder SPF 35 is to read the directions–it seems a lot of negative reviewers didn’t do that before testing it out lol. I love that this setting powder is super glowy and reflective like a highlighter, and I think it’s important to point out that it is reflective because I’m sure people don’t expect that. It’s definitely a product that’s more for touch ups than it is for all over the face, in my opinion. I love how it looks but I wouldn’t put it everywhere. Gifted by Supergoop.

I received a free product to try out from, Goopglow my opinions are my own. I have combination skin, with some breakouts even after 30. I was surprised by how effective the product is, my skin was soft and glowing on the next day. I sometimes have rough patches of dryness, my skin was radiant. The overnight peel, wasn’t painful to put on it or remove. It doesn’t leave a residue, and has no chemical smell. If anyone is looking for quality, the should choose Goopglow overnight peel.
product_name: GOOPGLOW 15% Glycolic Acid Overnight Glow Peel

review_text: I love this face wash it actually does what it says!! It leaves my skin feeling so soft and clean and moisturized. I am definitely going to re purchase this once it’s gone but it’s so big it’ll take a while!!
Amazing! I use it in the day because it is pretty light and I have dry skin.
product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I’ve been using this product for about 2 weeks and i really like it. This serum is lightweight, smells good and makes my skin feel amazing! I can’t tell if the product is actually reducing the look of my fine lines as I already have a youthful look, but i can tell how radiant my face looks. I will be adding this serum to my skin care regimen and more than likely will purchase once I run out.
review_title: New addition to my skin care regimen
product_name: Skinlongevity Long Life Herb Anti-Aging Face Serum

review_text: Honestly hands down the best face wash I’ve found. I’ve used different brands before and none of them have done what this face wash has done to my face. I have sensitive skin and I’m prone to breakouts. This is the most gentle face wash I’ve used, yet it’s so powerful. It removes my makeup well without drying my face. I’ve noticed that my face looks brighter and I’ve also noticed that my skin has been softer.
After using this lip mask for a week I can say it doesn’t fix my chapped lips. Does it help a bit? Yes. Does it smell nice? Yes. Is it better than vaseline or beeswax-based chapsticks? Lol, no
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Will not consider purchasing anything with out a full ingredient listing on the web site. Transparency is expected by most of us at this point. Thanks
review_title: No Ingredient List on the Sephora Web Site

review_text: I love this lip balm I recently bought this product because I wanted a lip balm that would last all day and that I would get great results from. I have dry lips and this has been a great product for reliving my dry lip issues. I also have dry skin and since this product can also be used on skin it’s like I get two products in one! The smell is nice too it’s not overpowering at all.

Really disappointed. These are supposed to be flesh colored but not the case for us brown skin girls. I would like the product much more if they made colors that were close to my skin tone seeing as the whole point is to wear it inconspicuously throughout the day. Waste of money.
I love this product! It gives me the most natural tan & since it’s “water” it’s so easy to spread out and get an even application.
product_name: Self Tan Purity Vitamins Bronzing Water Body Mist

review_text: I have one deep wrinkle in my forehead and I have been using this patch and have seen a big difference. Especially after about 3 treatments. I am buying this again to maintain. No irritation and is very moisturizing as well. This is great if you have a trouble area but are not ready for retinol full time on your whole face.
In agreement with the other reviews, this item is EXTREMELY thin, fragile, and easily breakable. Do not recommend.
I love the Josie Maran Moroccan Argan Oil and thought this would be a nice addition but it seems to separate in the tube so I get the oil before the cream.
product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil

review_text: I’ve never used any products of Murad before but oh my gosh.. was very pleased! I used this product on my forehead and around my eyes. I think it helped my skin look better and less puffy around my eyes. The product was super easy to apply as well.

Can’t say my skin is SUPER sensitive, but I was surprised by what this product did to me. While it felt good, after probably two weeks of use, I realized it was making me break out in places I had never gotten breakouts before! Not sure if this is a problem all people experience, but if you have any amount of sensitivity to your skin, don’t do it!
review_title: Had to give it away- this wrecked my skin!

review_text: I really wanted to love this cream because the packaging is so beautiful, and I love the goat milk ingredient as it’s unique. Also I love the Kate Somerville exfolikate, so I thought this would be just as good.Honestly, this cream is horrible! It’s the least moisturizing cream I’ve ever used-and I’ve used A LOT of creams-as I’m a skincare junkie. I have normal skin, and this still wasn’t moisturizing for my skin. My skin hasn’t improved at all. My pores looks the same, my mild acne is the same, my skin doesn’t feel soft or smoother, and my skin doesn’t look glowy, bright, or clear. In fact, this made my fair skin pinkish, and I got a few pesky pimples come up which I usually don’t break out.Over all, this cream is sadly a fail :(

I have combination and a little bit sensitive skin type. I asked and the girl said it fit for all skin type, but I figured out this product is not for all skin type, I should know better before I get it… I can’t use it everyday, 1st time it gave me some fresh feeling but after about 2 days it quit dry the skin then I have to stop using it, because I started breaking out and I might not use it anymore… lol
review_title: Will recommend for oily skin type

review_text: This product isn’t terrible, I’ve used it mixed with my facial cream and now primarily just use it with my body moisturizer. You get a prominent tan after two uses, u just don’t prefer the color this gives on my face. On the body this is beautiful and looks natural. I gave it three because it’s not being used for what I primarily purchased it for. I would consider trying another to see what the shade looks like, this one on the face looked a bit orange and less natural.
Received this as a sample with my last order. I just used it for the first time, and immediately knew I needed to buy the full size. Miraculous!
I was gifted by face gym their new serum. The Hydro-Bound Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide Serum is super lightweight and completely absorbed with no stickiness or residue whatsoever. I love it so far!!

I got this moisturizer complimentary for being part of an Influenster campaign. I absolutely love it though. My skin feels more radiant. I struggle with an uneven skin tone and large pores and this moisturizer definitely has made a difference. I’ve just been using concealer and powder instead of liquid foundation since I’ve been using this. It goes on great and doesn’t have a bad smell.
It dried my skin out and gave me dry patches on my face.
product_name: Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil - For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin

review_text: This cleansing oil does get the job done at removing make up, and emulsifies with water very well; but I feel like it takes way more product than it should to do this. There are many similar cleansing oils for cheaper that would be as effective.
product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

review_text: Tested this product out all week and didn’t notice any difference in lip color or size. Theres nothing special about this lip plump and the packaging is pretty ugly. Of course I bought 3 of them thinking it would be amazing based off of Dr. Laras social media posts, save your money and time.
The product works well, very hydrating. The scent makes my eyes water though, will not repurchase.

Lancôme has always been a innovator in beauty products always delivering an excellent product. Unfortunately, for me this product just couldn’t be all that it was hyped up for, it left my skin feeling sticky and after using as instructed for over 2 weeks daily I couldn’t determine any of its proclaimed benefits or could honestly note any improvement in my facial skins health and appearance. Maybe it was just me!
product_name: Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum: For Plumping & Anti-Aging

review_text: I bought this based on a Sephora reps recommendation. Wow! I noticed a difference right away. It calmed my irriatated skin and left it smooth and silky. Definitely a winner! I highly recommend it.
product_name: Redness Solutions with Probiotic Technology Daily Relief Cream

review_text: I wish I can give zero star or less. It says its moisturizer, which is not true at all.It made my skin super duper dry. Bad Bad bad
product_name: Original Skin Matte Moisturizer with Willowherb

review_text: bought this to replace my shiseido sunscreen stick and bruh this is so much worse. i was super excited as i had just run out of sunscreen but when i opened the stick and pushed up to get some product, it all plopped out onto my lap. i pushed it back in, causing a bunch of product to scrape off the sides onto my hands, and just applied that to my face. it left a greasy cast on my face and now i feel sticky and gross which i hate so much. i also just found out that there is a new design to make it easier to use, but with significantly less product which is insane, so no, buy a different sunscreen i do not recommend this at all.

After one application, my neck turned red and warm like it was sunburned, and my skin was very itchy. Even one day after washing it off, my skin is still itchy but slowly recovering ... Maybe get a sample and try it on a small area first.
review_title: Beware if you have sensitive skin
product_name: TL Advanced  Tightening Neck Cream PLUS for Firming & Brightening

review_text: Im confused about how to use this. I thought I didnt have to rinse it off after washing some videos from the manufacturers. The directions say blot with warm wash cloth if needed. If I try to apply it over my vitamin C serum or glycolic or if I attempt to layer this under a product the jet lag mask balls up all over my skin.
review_title: Im not entirely sure how to use this.

review_text: I hoped this cream would have a better consistency and texture than the Ordinary’s Vitamin C Suspension, but it’s super drying and heavy. It doesn’t really seep into my skin, it just sits on top. Not sure if it’s the Vitamin C that messes with the texture, but I was not impressed. It hardly resembles a cream. This bottle is also a lot smaller than I expected.
Great. This works really well, the price is good for the quality of the product.

I recently got a sample of this and I must my skin feels amazing after using this product. I had to get it in full size. My face feels smooth and clean it also has a refreshing smell. It’s a bit pricey for the sizes but it’s worth it.

Really great lightweight SPF for summer! Has a nice subtle smell and works great under makeup. The packaging is sleek and I really like the pump as well- makes it easy to get the product out and apply! I would recommend trying this out either as a straight SPF or as an SPF primer
product_name: Water Drench Hyaluronic Hydrating Moisturizer SPF 45

review_text: This product is a wannabe serum that is over priced and doesn’t do what it promises. I’ve been using this for a month at night and I still wake up with puffiness and dark circles. I use this along with the rose oil by the same brand which also didn’t prove great results. Not buying again.
product_name: Squalane + Peptide Brightening & De-Puffing Eye Gel

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Influenster. Although I received one, I have purchased before and I absolutely love this mask! I travel often and always have this with me to put on my face while on the plane. I don’t only use it just for flights, I also use it overnight for intense hydration. I love to use after I use harsher products on my face to soothe and moisturize. I highly recommended even with the price, it lasts a long time.
Hated this. It enlarged my pores and gave me blackheads. Few days after I stopped using it blackheads went away and my pores reduced in size. It was quite drastic.
I’m obsessed with skincare products and this one did nothing for me. Will not buy again.
review_title: simply put, not worth the money
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Very hydrating product and didn’t leave my skin feeling sticky, but I feel like there are other serums out there that are just as good at a lower price point.I received this product complimentary to test and review
product_name: Mini Advanced Night Repair Synchronized Multi-Recovery Complex

review_text: I have combination skin and large pores. After the first use I noticed my skin felt very hydrated and more plump. I continued to use it for several days and it has transformed my skin. My pores are visibly smaller and my skin is much smoother, supple, and hydrated. I will definitely keep this in my regular skincare routine.
product_name: Bye Bye Pores 10% Glycolic Acid Serum

review_text: Not sure why this is so highly rated. It smells AMAZING, it smells kind of like henna to me. But the particles in this scrub are WAY too harsh for the skin. I love a good physical exfoliation, but wow this was way too much. I wouldn’t be surprised if this damages the skin. Don’t recommend for anyone! So sad because it was so expensive and I can’t return it :(
product_name: Turmeric BHA Pore & Brightening Treatment Mask

review_text: This serum smells so good and feels like luxury on but I made me breakout like crazy all over my face.
I’ve used this for a week now and like it. The consistency is thick but goes on smoothly and feels like it sinks into the skin. Be careful because it will burn if you get it in your eyes.
product_name: That Fresh Take Eye Cream with Peptides

review_text: I was really hoping to like the increased SPF but this is a completely different formula. This clogs my pores, makes me break out & doesn’t mattify. Was my go to moisturizer but currently looking for something to use besides this.
product_name: Oil and Pore Control Mattifier Broad Spectrum SPF 45 PA++++

review_text: Works but smells like lemony Kitchen cleaner. Would not re-purchase, even though it does work as a good first cleanse. Didn’t irritate my skin.

This product wasn’t for me. Although I was super excited when I purchased, it didn’t do much for my acne... I have been using it for more than 2 weeks now. But it made my acne somewhat smaller, I think, so I’m going to give it 3 stars.

Received as part of a promotion in exchange for my honest review. This stuff is awesome! The jar is nicely sized to last. A little goes a long way. It’s silky smooth and goes on easily. Left my skin so hydrated and soft. I haven’t used it long enough to see all the benefits, but my skin is definitely glowing after just a couple uses! It has zero scent, comes with a cute little applicator. Amazing moisturizer!!
product_name: Indigo Overnight Repair Serum in Cream Treatment

review_text: I never write reviews on products, but I had to for this one, I have adult acne and will breakout near my cycle, but my problem is mostly with acne scarring. I have not changed anything in my skincare routine except for adding the Niacinamide and I have been breaking out all over my face. I have little zits all over my chin and huge pimples all over. I am breaking out in places I never break out in. I am so disappointed because I wanted this to be a holy grail product for me. For reference my skin is not sensitive, just oily and pretty tough.

I received it for free from Influenster to give my honest review and I was really excited to try out this product. Unfortunately it is not for me. The moisturizer kind of sits on top of my skin and is super oily. I would not be able to apply it in the morning ad go to work as it would leave my skin looking really greasy and gross. I have been putting it on at night and rinsing it off in the morning. I’ve also noticed some breakouts starting so I may need to stop using it soon. The one plus is that it smells delicious!
I used this serum for the first time this week, and it caused my face to break out. Sadly wont be able to use it any more.
product_name: Brightening Treatment Drops Triple Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I use this morning & night. It makes my face feel smoother and doesn’t feel dry at all. I have some dry spots under my eyes and so far it has been helping!

I received this product free for testing purposes from Influenster & Kiel’s. I have been using this product for about 2 weeks now & I can say that I am pretty pleased with it. It has made my skin feel so smooth & hasnt caused any irritation at all. I would definitely recommend this product to my friends.

This is my favorite DE product ever! This product is responsible for fixing my skin. If you are going to purchase this and you’re not used to retinol, please follow directions. This stuff is strong! I was not a retinol user before starting this. I started out one night a week and now use it every other night and as suggested only a pea sized amount. I mix mine with B-Hydra. Goodbye texture acne and fine lines!
have you ever applied hot tingle tanning bed lotion on your face? this is what the sample reminded me of- my face feels hot and red after first and only use.
The serum was light-weight and felt amazing on the skin. It left my skin hydrated and glowy. It wasnt sticky or oily at all. My only complaint was the fragrance. I wish it was fragrance free.
product_name: Double Serum Firming & Smoothing Anti-Aging Concentrate

review_text: I love the way this brightening cream makes my skin feel and my face look. I somehow look airbrushed when I wear it, my skin looks hydrated and plump. The scent is nice. I would definitely add this to my collection.
product_name: Aqua Bomb Brightening Vitamin C Cream

review_text: I have more oily/combo skin, but this time of year I’m trying to keep my skin nice and hydrated like most people. This is just too heavy, it feels okay on my skin but I think it’s clogging my pores. Any time I use it I wake up with little white heads around my face the next day.

This product has been gifted to me in exchange for my honest review. These single serve packets of powder are a great way to easily get the nutrients you need! I love that I can take the packets on the go, and it helps me to drink water in the morning. The powder has a strange orange color to it, but it tastes much better than it looks. It makes your water tastes slightly sweet and fruity, which is great for a mid morning drink. I wish the results were quicker, but it does take time to see any results. I’m hoping that if I use this everyday it will really help my skin, because it contains great nutrients.

I am a 29 year old VIB Rouge member and recently ordered this after seeing all of the amazing reviews... I have a light wrinkle on either side of my forehead so thought this would be a good choice before one day going to Botox. I have now been using this day and night after the clarisonic for over a week and am seeing NO noticeable change whatsoever. For the cost of this product, it’s a huge disappointment. I’ve tried so many different products and typically will see SOME sort of results and it’s not the case here. Really makes me question the initial reviews and how “honest“ the customers were really being about their experience with this product. I would not recommend.
product_name: Needles No More Wrinkle Smoothing Cream

review_text: Love this super affordable cleanser just over 10 bucks! Love that it removes make up quick but also need to use more to remove all that. Love the consistency not too greasy just the perfect tool for make up removing

review_title: returned, smells like feet and menthol

review_text: I loved this serum! it’s really light weight, hydrating, non scented and nearly colorless. I have to keep using it for long term results, but so far so good.
product_name: Brightening Dark Spot Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Hydrates well, but doesn’t really brightens or “perks you up“ as indicated on the product. Good cream if you have dry under-eye tho!

I bought this one day on a whim because it had such great reviews and wanted to check it out. I have combination skin where my t zone is extremely oily but my cheeks especially around my mouth area is very dry and flaky. The oil is great for my dry flaky spots and also has not broken me out (something I was concerned about). I purchased the 0.5oz bottle, a little bit goes a long way. I use just 3 drops and this covers my entire face.

I got this for the KP on my arms. Used an entire bottle-applying every night over a period of several months-and it did absolutely nothing at all. Can’t speak to using as a facial toner but for KP this did not work for me

I highly recommend Necessaire Mineral SPF 30! I use it on my face and neck everyday and it’s the perfect protection for me. It glides on your skin well and doesn’t leave a sticky residue. I like that it doesn’t have any scent to it the packaging is very pretty and the pump is convenient and easy to use. Also it’s very hydrating, it gives your skin a beautiful glow
product_name: The Sunscreen - 100% Mineral, Broad Spectrum SPF 30 with 20% Non-Nano Zinc, Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide

review_text: It’s not bad, I can see myself using it for an everyday routine. I received this as a free sample and I would recommend!

I don’t think it’s worth the $15. I just purchased and it stays glossy for a little than dries down to nothing. My lips didn’t feel any softer or hydrated. A drug store lip balm can get the same job done. I did try the sleep lip mask though prior and that actually felt like it did more for my lips than this.
completely takes all of my makeup off, including waterproof eye makeup! leaves skin feeling super soft but not oily. The container of it lasts so long as well!
product_name: Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

review_text: This serum is making my family glow! My mother and I use this serum at night before moisturizing and after toner! We have fairly dry skin and helps repair the moisture in our skin. The super-antiaging serum consists of strong antioxidants that also help the cells regenerate.

I purchased this product earlier this month on the basis of a previous purchase and complete satisfaction with the same product purchased when I was in France. This is not the same! The scent is different, the way it reacts on the skin is different and the beautiful glow that is derived from the product that is MADE AND MANUFACTURED in France is missing altogether. product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist

review_text: Worked like a dream, even on hormonal cystic acne, but the bottle dried up in 6 weeks and I had to toss it. (I am very vigilant about closing my beauty/skincare products properly because it gets very humid in my bathroom)

I didn’t notice any anti-aging benefits but I did like the hydration and good ingredients. If this was more affordable, I’d give this 5 stars for the formula, however, I think there are equally as good moisturizers at more affordable price points.
product_name: Mini Adaptogen Deep Moisture Cream with Ashwagandha + Reishi

review_text: I was using this for a while but I ended up giving it away. I realized my face was getting slightly irritated when I put this on, and it never absorbed into my skin. I like that it has a lot of hyaluronic acid though.

Unfortunately the bottle is very poorly designed - the actual pump on the main bottle did not pump, and when I attempted to open the cap, more than half of the product popped out, so very little product remains. Therefore, I am unable to review the actual product because the poor design of the bottle does not allow any product to last!

I received this product as a sample through the Sephora website beauty offers. The smell of this serum is so strong I cannot bear to use it. I cannot comment on how the serum works because the smell is so bad to me. I understand all ingredients are organic

I received a sample of this in one of my Sephora orders and was super excited to use it. After one use, I broke out into little bumps all over my forehead. Wanting to be sure it was this mask, I used it again two weeks later and the same thing happened. Just didn’t agree with my skin type. Regardless of how my skin reacted, I didn’t feel like it was very hydrating. My skin did not appear plumper or more supple afterwards.

I thoroughly enjoy this product. I got it from my friend’s mother after she heard me talking about another trial-sized vitamin c oil I enjoyed but ran out of (Red Earth brightening oil). I don’t have much acne but I do have pretty sensitive skin and those not pimple forehead bumps, and this has helped clear my skin while adding moisture and plumpness to my skin. It does take a while to fully absorb if that’s something that bothers you, and I wouldn’t say this is a two times a day oil, I use mine at night before bed after I cleanse my face (I use the Andalou 1000 roses foaming cleanser) and it adds just the right amount of hydration to the face without leaving me uncomfortably oily. I would add that I use maybe four drops and that covers mart of my neck. If anything it’s a nice routine, and I am planning to buy this again once I run out of my current bottle.
review_title: Planning to buy again. I like it!
product_name: C.E.O Glow Vitamin C + Turmeric Face Oil

review_text: Honestly, this product was just okay. It has weird smell which I didn’t find particularly appealing and I am always skeptical of products that head up when it immediately hits your face. I think it works fine but is a bit expensive for the amount you need to use and the results.
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: Great makeup remover and cleanser! I have previously tried Bioderma micellar water, Caudalie micellar water and cleansing oil, as well as Josie Maran’s cleanser and the best one for my skin is Farmacy’s Green clean. I have combination and sensitive skin so this product is a real winner for me. All traces of face and eye makeup were removed with this product and my skin feels clean without feeling tight. No stinging or blurred vision or burning eyes with this product. A+++
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Love the way it makes my skin feel. Haven’t had it a week yet but it looks like it’s helping....

This was easily absorbed by my skin! For reference I have normal to dry skin. I feel that my skin is really hydrated, especially if paired with the peptide face lotion. Used alone, it does give hydration, but make sure to still moisturize. Didn’t give me any bad reaction. I just wish the bottle was a bit bigger for its price.
review_title: Please make bottle bigger/have more amount

review_text: This lotion smells awful and is quite runny. Despite it being runny it clogs up pores

I’m not good at remembering to review products I like but I had to leave one for this. This stuff is seriously INCREDIBLE! I have dry skin and in the winter in the desert I could not go for more than a few hours without getting flaky skin all over my face! I tried a million different things when finally I went into Sephora and the worker led me straight to this. My life was forever changed. I put this on my face right after showering and it keeps my skin hydrated all day. I also love that it doesn’t have a smell and it doesn’t break me out. Seriously so amazing, if you’re on the fence, get it, you’ll be so grateful you did!

It’s a good mask for In the winter or summer if your skin is extremely dry. However, I have combination skin. This didn’t make my face oily surprisingly, but it’s not my go too. I think the texture it too thick for my personal taste, and it kinda smells like bananas laughy taffy. I would purchase this if your skin was in desperate need of moisturizer. It’s a good mask for hydration, but you don’t NEED it.
product_name: Superberry Hydrate + Glow Dream Night Mask with Vitamin C

review_text: I really did love this serum but it is really heavily fragranced so I would stay away if you have sensitive skin. The bottle also is gorgeous and feels very luxurious. It does leave your face super plump and radiant, it also is great under makeup! Love this product just wish it didn’t have such a strong scent.
product_name: Capture Totale Le Sérum Anti-Aging Serum

review_text: I am extremely happy with this C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Cream from Sunday Riley. It is very smooth to apply, makes my skin plump and glowy. It doesn’t have any greasy or heavy feeling. It is very soft and moisturizing.
product_name: C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Moisturizer

review_text: Love this product so much. A must have for everyone!
product_name: The Water Cream Oil-Free Pore Minimizing Moisturizer

review_text: Love this product! I have very fair skin, and love the subtle color/ glow this gives me!!! Especially in the winter, this is a lifesaver to keep my skin looking glowy!
i used it for 2 nights in a row and my skin was peeling the next day. definitely be careful with this product and test it out before applying it everywhere under your eyes.

I LOVE this moisturizer and the all-natural ingredients. However I feel like I cannot keep buying it because the packaging is crazy - tons of plastic and none of it can be recycled (and lots of cardboard, which at least can be recycled). What products are similar to this but not so terrible for the environment??
review_title: Recs for similar product with less packaging?
product_name: Lala Retro Whipped Refillable Moisturizer with Ceramides

review_text: I didn’t notice any decrease in the appearance of wrinkles on my face or forehead. I have given this product 2 stars because it does smell nice and work as a moisturizer, however I would say for the price there are better moisturizers you can find at a better price point. For these reasons I wouldn’t recommend this product.
review_title: Doesn't reduce the appearance of wrinkles!
product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer

review_text: These are the best cotton pads out there. They are thick enough to only use one where other brands require 3-4 (such as full nail polish removal). They last forever and feel incredible. So glad these are a part of my skincare routine!

Received this product for free to write a review. All words are my own.I have used this mask twice to really test out how it felt on my face. The first time I used it, my face felt SO oily after washing the mask off. I only kept it on for about 3 and a half minutes as I started to feel a burn. The second time I used it, I broke out SO bad. My face wasn’t red or puffy at all, just broke out unlike usual after it. I didn’t feel like this mask did anything for moisture for my face. Felt like there was an oil barrier between my skin to prevent moisture from absorbing in.
review_title: Not that great, especially for the price.

review_text: I can’t get past the obnoxious perfumey scent. Please, everyone, STOP putting fragrance in makeup and skincare products.

Lightweight and moisturizing! Has a pleasant, citrus-smell that’s reminiscent of fruit loops (but not in a bad way). I have combo skin and usually get dry patches; this moisturizer leaves my skin smooth and hydrated.

Based on all the rave reviews, I was really hoping this would be the solution to my facial skincare problems (combination/senstive skin w/rosacea), but it just didn’t work for me. I tried using it at night and my skin just always felt so greasy, after three days I had to give up because it just felt so gross. I can see that it would be nice on hands/hair.

Gifted by Sunday Riley. This product left my skin feeling and looking young. It is no longer dull or lack luster. It’s full of live and vibrant. I highly recommend this in your skin care routine. You won’t be disappointed.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: This cleaner makes my skin just glow. The gentle scrub gets rid of the troubles of the day and increases the blood circulation under my skin. I have used this product for several years now and I love it.

Did not really do anything for my pimples. However, I have more of dry skin/ combo irritation pimples. The only time I had a big (acne type) pimple, it did help with the redness and it helped the pimple not to grow too big. It did not burn or anything like that and I have sensitive skin!

I have two! Yes! I thought something was wrong with the first one….. it wouldn’t turn on. When I called, they told me that it was out of warranty. Even though I had only used it four times. So I thought, it’s my fault, I waited almost a year before using it. So I bought a second one. Stop working after only three months! Horrible! Absolutely horrible! I called, asked for a supervisor. Nothing! Basically they told me there was nothing they could do. I waited too long. Do not buy this product. The battery is horrible!

works great on skin but the texture is nothing like the sample i got - i don’t know if they changed something? but the one i got was like curdled yogurt. my husband thinks it smells like cintronella (his words - “bugspray“) so that’s a big fail. i smell marshmallows and a hint of vanilla.

I got a sample at first I thought “ok this is great” ...so I ended up purchasing the full size. After a couple uses I started to break out w whiteheads on my forehead, chin and upper lip. There is something in there that my skin doesn’t agree with. As far as the lactic acid it is quite strong bc it does burn, which is not bad. But once I stopped using this my skin started to clear up. Then I decided to try it again just to see if that was indeed breaking me out and I did the next day. This is quite expensive and the bottle is super light. Can’t tell how much is in the bottle.

This cream is light and suitable for wearing during the day. It hasn’t caused any breakouts. The smell is unpleasant, but better than an overpowering fragrance. Clean and simple. I bought this as a 100 point sample.
product_name: Squalane + Omega Repair Deep Hydration Moisturizer

review_text: Very drying and doesn’t help acne.
Been using for 2 months everyday and do not see much difference in my dark circles. Will not buy again.

Huge waste of money. False advertising by Huda - the particles that roll off are NOT your dead skin. Product doesn’t do anything for my skin. There are better products out there. Giving it 2 stars because at least it didn’t break me out.
product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub

review_text: I don’t know which ingredient(s) are responsible, but a few days of testing this resulted in clusters of breakouts and red, scaly patches on my skin. It’s been a few days since I discontinued use and while the breakouts are starting to heal, my skin still looks kind of reddish and unpleasant.I know that this is a beloved product for some people, but if you have sensitive or reactive skin (and you know who you are lol), I’d recommend either avoiding this particular product all together or at LEAST getting a sample first.
review_title: Avoid if you have reactive/sensitive skin

review_text: I have been using this for a couple weeks and have not seen any changes. It has a tint to it, so dark circles are somewhat concealed when you apply it. Maybe I haven’t been using it long enough, but so far no miracles.
product_name: Even Better Eyes Dark Circle Corrector

review_text: The only lotion that I have used that isn’t sticky & works for my eczema. Hands down the most amazing!

I purchased this after trying it at the impulse counter while waiting in line and loved it immediately. I found it had a slight cooling effect and light refreshing natural scent. I typically do not like scented face mists, but I personally found this one light and pleasant. Of course this is difficult to review bc it is a matter of personal preferences. If you are sensitive to smells or really picky w scents, both of which I am, I would try it in store first. I don’t know if it truly “sets” my make-up bc I use primers and great skincare anyway and typically only use a setting spray for special events, but I found I love finishing my makeup with a few sprays of this to set my makeup. This purchase was made on 3/11 and on 4/16 I just used up my last sprays and plan on purchasing again in the full size.
product_name: Beauty Elixir Prep, Set, Glow Face Mist

review_text: I put the mask on exactly as instructed and was met with unholy burning all over my face. I waited a minute to see if it would subside but it only made my face red and irritated. I had to wash it off immediately. After all of the good things I heard, I am severely disappointed and will attempt to return the product.
i like this product but the price is really high even the travel size is expensive

I have never used a cleansing balm and this was recommended by a sales associate at sephora and I am very happy I tried this. I always used a makeup wipe to take off my makeup, but I would notice it didn’t take off my makeup as well. This cleansing balm does an excellent job at removing foundation and eye makeup as well. This lasts me for a while and I have already purchased my second one!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: Feels sticky, not very moisturizing. Smells very sweet like sugar.

This cleanser is so refreshing and actually helps to wake me up in the morning. I love that it’s exfoliating, but not so harsh that I can’t use it every day. I would buy it for the smell alone! I received this product for free, but my honest opinion is that it’s one of the best I’ve used!

This was my first Drunk Elephant product. Honestly, I’m so glad I got the mini of this. I typically use micellar water products to wash my face without water at night time and on lazy mornings, and this just does not make my skin feel clean - and I don’t even wear make up. So it literally just does not make my skin feel clean when I’m using it on just my skin. In fact it dries up into my cotton round and also in my fingers causing me to use more product because otherwise I’m dragging my fingers or the round across my skin. Horrible!It also takes a lot of product to do your whole face. I am halfway through this bottle and I’ve had it for 2 weeks. I’m not impressed. It gets 2 stars for the packaging and for being fragrance free, I would never buy this again. I have to use a second micellar water afterwards or straight up just wash my face - what’s the point?

I love this product! Within a couple of days of using the eye cream, I could tell a significant difference in puffiness and color! My only complaint is the fragrance; not very strong, but unpleasant in my opinion.
Elegant packaging and a wonderful product. I love that it also gives a healthy flush of color to the lips since mine are pretty pale.

This peel is harsh and can cause long lasting skin damage. I applied the peel and kept it on for 8-9 minutes (less time than the 10 minutes recommended) and only used the peel one a week or once every 10-12 days. At first it seemed to work ok, although it made my skin dry and flaky. Ten days ago I used the peel as always and a couple days later my skin showed signs of irritation and hyperpigmentation. I now have two very noticeable brown marks on my skin, one the size of a two quarters and the other the size of a quarter. I’ve had these marks on my skin for over a week now and they don’t seem to be fading, in fact, the affected area seems to be growing larger - I recently noticed pigmentation on the right side of my lip. I am going to give my skin another week to heal and if doesn’t then I will be making an appointment with a dermatologist. This chemical peel is harsh and has some pretty serious side effects. Buyer beware.

I use this every night before bed. My lips are soft and supple in the morning. This line is amazing and creates great lip products. This product is a must during the winter time! Your lips will be thankful! It doe have a heavier consistency than the glowy balm
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: this product literally destroyed my skin for a solid month lol it’s slowly healing but the amount of damage this did to my skin will take some time to fix. i was so excited to try this out after getting it from the birthday bundle since i heard great things about it: made me break out a few days later and i barely have problems with acne
very good product, but made my skin irritated in some places but i did like it. i have reccomend it to some family members who use more of this type of peel.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Is this real life?? After struggling with persistent, stubborn acne for 15 years that I could NEVER fully eradicate no matter how many “holy grail“ products or treatments I tried, this moisturizer finally gave me the results that I previously thought were impossible. I have no idea what fantastic miracle is packed into these jars, but whatever it is, IT WORKS. THE BREAKOUTS COMPLETELY STOPPED. I have tried countless other 5-star products and they either had no effect whatsoever or they made me break out. Just as I started to heal from one breakout, another was already on its way. This was constantly my life for so many years. Then I happened to get a sample of this moisturizer, and after a couple of weeks of using it I realized that I wasn’t breaking out anymore. How was that possible?? The acne came right back when I switched to another moisturizer, so I grabbed the full size of this one, and NOT A SINGLE ZIT EVER SINCE. My face has been been clear for several weeks now and hasn’t looked this good since I was about 12 years old! Of course, it helps with rosacea/skin tone, too; you will likely be very pleasantly surprised when you wake up in the morning and look in the mirror after applying this at night. It sinks in quickly so it’s easy to apply under makeup. There’s no offensive fragrance. It’s incredible. I know that the price point is high, but for me it’s completely worth it if you see results. There’s no going back for me!!NOTE: I have combination skin, so if you have very dry skin, I will say I don’t think this is the best product for hydration purposes. It works just fine for me in several other ways, but is probably not enough for someone whose skin is parched.
review_title: This completely cleared my skin! WOW!

review_text: I love this! Ordered it after trying and loving the lip sleeping mask. I find it very similar in consistency, maybe a little thinner, but I love how its in a tube rather than the tub, so I don’t have to use my fingers. Very happy with this purchase.

So disappointed with this product. It did not improve my skin at all, AND it actually made my skin look worse. I don’t think that I’ve ever purchased a skin product that actually made my skin look worse. I agree with the other reviewer who said skin looked “starved“, “deprived“. I even had people say how tired I looked and guess what, I was not tired at all, I actually just had a very enjoyable relaxing long rested weekend.
This wash is amazing. Cleared my skin. And it truly does get make up off as well, even my waterproof mascara. It can be drying if used daily so I suggest less use for sensitive skin
I really enjoyed that this sunscreen provided great protection and did not irritate my skin. However, I wasn’t too fond of the smell.
product_name: SHIKULIME Color Control Oil-Free Moisturizer SPF 30

review_text: Omg wow I am in love and in shock with howAmazing this product has changed my skin in the most loving way! I feel my skin glows and shows a beautiful side of me I’ve never seen. review_text: Heals my lips overnight. It’s magic.

For the entire month of June I had horrible breakouts. After process of elimination I found out it was caused this product. It broke my forehead out in red almost itchy bumps. No problem with the CEO glow but this product did not agree with my skin.

i had a sample of this and loved it so much that i bought two full size bottles during the Sephora sale! it makes my skin feel so clean, soft and hydrated at the same time! i have rosacea+acne+sensitive skin and i’m amazed with how it has minimized redness and cleared my acne AND texture on my skin! my skin has never felt better and never felt this smooth! this is definitely a staple in my skin care routine now :)

Ridiculously expensive for a mediocre lip balm. It’s smooth and moisturizing, but for about 2 minutes before it wares off. I love the drunk elephant brand, but this product does not outweigh the high price tag like their other products do.

Eh - this is definitely not worth the money. It’s okay, but there are definitely better products out there for the money. review_title: There are much better products out there....

review_text: I bought this a few months ago and when I first got it i used it regularly for a about 2 months but i did not see any changes. I only use it when i remember its there and does give me a spa like feel but it is not worth the price.
The most disgusting moisturizer I’ve ever tried. Feels like dried egg whites on your face. Doesn’t hydrate whatsoever!

Rose Inc has gotten me so much hype, finally able to try their products out and solar powder really new to me. I really love mini sizes as they are perfect for going out and are very nice products. The texture is light and the cutest sun serum ever tried. Works very good on my skin
product_name: Solar Power Luminous SPF 30 Brightening Serum

review_text: I enjoy the subtle scent of this product, and I like how refreshed my face feels immediately after using it. review_title: feels great, but results don't last
product_name: Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

review_text: I went through a whole bottle that I used religiously everyday and did not see any difference at all. The formula is too liquidy, you need a couple pumps to get the job done so it runs out in about 2 months - for this price it’s not worth it given that it makes no difference in the tone or texture. This serum - just like the bloggers who created it - is overhyped but under delivers.
product_name: CC Me Vitamin C + Niacinamide Serum

review_text: Love this stuff - I purchased this a cheaper alternative to Good Genes (which I love!) Super gentle, and helps with overall texture. When I have a breakout, this calms my skin. If you are looking for a night time serum that packs a punch, this is IT.
product_name: Honeymoon Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum

review_text: I was optimistic and excited to get this because it claimed to address literally all of my skin issues, and there’s a lot of them. I tied it on it’s own for a few days/nights and I didn’t notice any reduction of redness or positive results, the only thing I noticed was that it dried my skin out. I used in in combination with my normal skin care stuff and had the same results as before (nothing) except that my skin was even dryer than before. Maybe I used it wrong or something idk but it was kinda disappointing :(

Have only been using for two weeks or so so I can’t speak to long term results but I do notice smoothing and reduced wrinkle lines on my forehead and smile immediately upon application. I love the metal applicator top that feels cooling to the skin. I notice a bit of a mattifying effect especially when applied on my forehead. No complaints just something I noticed!

This product really didn’t thrill me. I didn’t really notice any differences in my skin. I will say that it is gentle because it’s alcohol free so it didn’t burn or irritate. It’s just very pricey so I probably wouldn’t buy this myself. I’d probably pick something similar but at a lower price point.

I didn’t notice a glow & it made my skin a little flaky (that doesn’t go away even with using a scrub exfoliator until a few days later). My pores did appear a little smaller but it didn’t really make an overall noticeable difference.

It’s a good value for whom it works, but this leaves my skin sticky. It’s not at all ideal. It doesn’t dry and become not sticky. It’s just always sticky until you wash it off. I have used other products by this brand, and I like them a loooot. I feel this is just not useful for me.

I was looking for a new moisturizer that included SPF for the summer months. The price point was great on this and as I use the Kiehl’s facial cleanser already, I thought id give it a go. I wasn’t impressed with the product. Personally I felt it wasn’t hydrating enough. The texture almost has a super mild grit to it. Wanted to love it but I wont be buying this again.

Really didn’t see a single change after using this and the dropper has never worked. For such an expensive product, the dropper should work better than my $10 products. Really disappointed.
product_name: Thirst Trap Juice Hyaluronic Acid & Peptide Hydrating Facial Serum

review_text: This is my first review but I had to write.The worst mask I ever bought and not at all worth the money. I just got it today and used it, ahhhh.. just going to return it. review_text: Unfortunately, I was not very impressed with this product. I was excited to try it because I read that it could help with my red, dry, winter-worn, skin. It even has a crisp clean smell. This adopted step will stay in my routine of make removal.
review_title: This step will stay in my routine….

review_text: I did not see any noticeable improvement with these strips.

review_text: 100% worth it. I am on my second jar and love it. Evens my skin out wonderfully and takes away any red.

review_text: I really liked how it felt. It does run out reallllly fast, so if you get addicted than get prepared to spend a lot of money. No one will notice a difference. It’s like a primer in the way that it is not oily and it dries fast but is still kind of wet. And in my opinion the sample sizes are rip offs. They are half priced and 1/5 the product.

The fragrance is so strong and it contains silicone (dimethicone). If you don’t care about that, it does a great job in making your skin look good and smooth throughout the day, but I’ll be going back to my drunk elephant protini.

I never break out and after just a few days of using this, I was appalled at what I saw. I had big red bumps at my jawline and on my cheeks. I don’t have sensitive skin and have never had breakouts from a moisturizer. I love the brand but this was an epic fail for me.

If you have acne prone skin, I would not recommend this toner. This toner caused horrible cystic acne. In the past several years I have had fairly clear skin with the exception of the occasional hormonal pimple or if I use a product that causes me to break out. I made a dumb mistake by trying out new products when I should’ve stuck to my trusted routine (if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it!) For a while I thought I was randomly having a really bad period of my life where my face was completely ridden with acne. It finally dawned on me that it was this product causing the breakouts when I went back to my old routine, but was using this on my chest and back (places I use products that are too harsh on my face but fine on those areas). My chest and back broke out horribly. I gave this to my mom who doesn’t have sensitive skin and I will stick to my trusted Clinique toner!

Ask for sample before buying… I put it on for my brother in laws wedding .. gives you that dewy look but you’ll look oily. Also, the next morning I woke up with tiny whiteheads all over my forehead and couldn’t figure out what was going on. I thought it was the new face wash, but stopped using it and it seems like the whiteheads are slowly disappearing. If you have sensitive skin - STAY AWAY. I have another wedding in 2 weeks, I hope these tiny whiteheads disappear- my makeup looks horrible on top of it.

I got a sample size of this in my March playbox. I was excited to try it, as I’ve used Bobbi’s hydrating moisturizer previously and really liked it. However, as soon as I started applying this to my face, I literally gagged. I don’t know if it’s just my sample, but the stuff I got smelled AWFUL, like sweaty feet that had been in waterproof boots and thick woolen socks all day. It was disgusting. In some sort of wave of insanity I actually put the rancid smelling stuff on my face and instantly regretted it. It was tacky, didn’t absorb into my skin, didn’t give me a glow or anything, and now my face smelled like stinky feet. Had to wash it off and start over with a new cream. I’d recommend literally any other glow product to this.
This stuff is amazing. I use it at night to remove my makeup and apply a cleanser after and it leaves my skin smooth and prepped for my nighttime skin care routine!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I used this product combined with the other 3 Sk-II products I received as a 4-step skincare routine. I was very hopeful for this brand after looking at the prices, reviews, and website claims. I noticed no positive differences in my skin after a few weeks of use and was disappointed in the ingredients. It contains multiple Parabens. I would not recommend and won’t be purchasing.
It smells good and I wanted to like it, but this is so drying. I put it on at night and it dried my lips out worse than they ever have been before.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: After reading all the hype, I decided to give this a try to fight my persistent redness and protect my fair skin from the sun. It does what it says it promises, and goes on THICK! It reminds me of those clay masks we used to wear as teenagers. It soon changes colors to a beige/ivory but if you have medium, olive or dark skin tones, this is not the product for you. This way you’ll avoid looking cakey or dried out since the treatment accentuates dry, flakey skin. Overall, a good alternative to your foundation / concealer.
review_title: Works well for oily / red skin

review_text: So I bought this because it’s known as a good anti-aging cream. But after using it for a month I haven’t seen any change in my skin, it actually seems I have more wrinkles. This does a really good job of soothing redness and irritation though so it is a good product. I’m just not seeing the anti aging claims.
product_name: Mini Crème de la Mer Moisturizer

review_text: Huge fan of Dr Dennis Gross products, but this one did nothing for me. Texture was fine, but I am looking for impactful anti-aging results to see less wrinkles & lines, better overall appearance, less darkness. And I got nothing here.

review_text: Wish this wasn’t so expensive, other wise I would buy it. I really wanted to love this product, as I love most PTR products, but this was simply too strong for my skin. I ended up getting burn-like marks in random areas of my face (eyes, nose, jaw line). As a super pale person, the beige color that this product turns into upon application was not only far too dark for my skin tone, but also had an icky orange tint. This product also made my dry patches look more noticeable, so I needed to apply more primer than usual to ensure my makeup went on smoothly afterwards.
review_title: Not for fair or dry skin

review_text: I have been trying to find a good vitamin c solution for a long time. Most of the serums I’ve tried made me breakout so I would quit after a few weeks. When I started using this, I hadn’t been using any vitamin or acids for awhile. First impression: it does sting a little bit. However, it’s not a painful experience or anything. I started using it a couple of times a week in the morning with a couple of drops of the brand’s resveratrol and ferulic acid serum. I’m definitely more used to it now so I have upped the frequency to a few times a week. The serum I mix it with makes my face feel a little greasy (I like to say glowy) so I stick to using it before work when I’m just doing foundation and not a full face of makeup. Overall I am really impressed and I get a lot of compliments on my skin. Also the price point really seals the deal for me. If nothing else it’s not a huge investment if you don’t like it (which is the case with many vitamin c treatments).

review_text: Okay so one single star. You might think I’m being harsh but hear me out. To start with, the packaging is so cheap looking. It’s drug store cheap. review_text: I like how hydrating it is. I like the benefits on the ingredients tab. Overall I like it but... it smells horrible. I hate the smell. As it is, the smell is agitating and I can’t get it out of my nose.

Tretinoin, gua sha, facial yoga, serums, creams etc. During Black Friday of 2022, I did some skin care shopping with The Ordinary. I decided to grab a bottle of this. I have been consistently using this on my crows feet, under eyes and forehead since the beginning of December. It is March and I am finishing my first bottle. review_text: These are better than the acne patches you get at drug stores, and I find they do work to help reduce pimples and cystic acne that comes up. One star off because they’re all the same size, it would be nice to have a mix of small and large sized patches.

The results were not visible whatsoever and the heavy perfume fragrance made it an unpleasant step in my routine. I went through with threading and I’m so happy I did. The very positive reviews this has on all platforms confuses me. I’m not sure why others seem to get results when I had none though I know we all have different skin and different wants and expectations from our skincare products. Just please don’t expect any miracles with this or at least none within the first 6 weeks. Do yourself a favor and buy the smallest size first! 2 stars only because it did moisturize my skin and you only need a small amount, spreads easily and the heavy scent fades quickly

product_name: The Rich Cream with TFC8 Face Moisturizer

review_text: Since September my lips have been very chapped, crusty and just miserable. I tried so many lip products from Laneige, to Kush lip balm, regular chap stick, the lip balm from Farmacy, burts bees you name it I’ve tried it. My skin routine is all tatcha so I decided to give it a try and I am impressed with week one. I use a lip scrub from Lush every other day and this at night or in the day, since with the masks I’m not using lipstick since it comes right off anyway. 3 days in I started sharing with my boyfriend whos lips are much worse than mine and I have to say we are loving this and 100% will repurchase

The descriptions always make these things sound so exciting, don’t they? Well, lower your expectations because this is not a miracle product. I ended up using it on my elbows because it was not emollient enough for my face.

Honestly, it’s cute. But it’s not doing anything for me. I ordered this because of the high star rating but I’m disappointed. Maybe it’s just me. I don’t know. If you want something that makes a difference, try the Purity pore extracting mask. I saw a huge difference in my face the very FIRST time I used the little sample I received.

I have skin that is hard to keep clear and as long as I didn’t go overboard using this day and night my acne stayed calm and it didn’t cause breakouts. However, I can see how it could if you were over using it! For the price and claim saying that it is ok for acne prone skin I’d say you could find cheaper and better alternatives! But for people with clear skin I’d say this would make it feel amazing!

I had been so excited about this product from reading the reviews, and I was very disappointed when I saw little to no results from using it. I really wish that I had spend the large amount of money that I paid for this product toward a professional chemical peel.
product_name: Vinoperfect Radiance Dark Spot Serum Vitamin C Alternative

review_text: This is such a nice moisturizer. The citrus smell is soft and pleasant, the Vit C definitely brightens my skin. My skin is soft and smooth, I definitely enjoy using this in my daily routine
product_name: Glow Daily Vitamin C Gel Cream

review_text: It is so beyond drying. I have used it several times and every single Time, my face is so dry & tight. I have combo oily skin...

review_text: I love this it’s great for removing makeup also makes my face soft

review_text: Every morning I would use these before applying my primer and foundation to really make sure I had a clean face. I have combination skin and they didn’t dry me out or play into my oily areas.

I’ve been looking for a good cleaner for my oily skin. While I plan on finish my bottle, I do not plan on buying it again. It’s just okay nothing more and nothing less. It doesn’t break me out but it does leave my face slightly dry.

review_text: I wanted a cheaper alternative to the my Farmacy moisturizer, and decided to try it after reading so many reviews. Overall, it’s wasn’t exactly what I needed. I felt that it was a bit heavy, took a longer to sink in, and has a rather off-putting smell. However it is a very affordable option.

I received this product from Murad for review purposes, and it has easily become my staple skincare product. I love the blurring effect it has on my pores and how it keeps my T-zone from becoming too shiny throughout the day. The built-in SPF is a huge bonus, because I like having a very minimal routine. Another thing I love about this product is the light citrus scent-- perfect for summer.
product_name: Oil and Pore Control Mattifier Broad Spectrum SPF 45 PA++++

review_text: Worst cream possible, it gave me a skin reaction which was super itchy and looked gross.(Lasted 4 days)
I’ve been using this product for years and whenever I use something else, I end up going right back to this. It smells lovely, it stays put, and it makes your lips look gorgeous! LOVE this product!

I wanted to like this more but it did not work for me at all. I have oily skin and this cleanser made my face feel really tight and stripped and uncomfortable. Within days of adding this to my routine I had spots all over my face like I was a teenager again. If it works for you, great but it did not work for me. If you can I would try to get a sample of this to see if if is going to work on your skin before you invest in this product

I found it really easy to wash off as well compared to other masks. The results are what really blew me away though! My skin felt so soft and plumped. I couldn’t notice any of my pores, and my smile lines were practically non existent. My skin has never been so dewy and smooth after a mask before! I definitely think this would be a great step in prepping your skin before makeup, and I’m excited to use this mask again! I received this product complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes

I purchased this after watching a video where Hyram recommend this if you have oily skin. I really wanted to love this product, considering the high price point. My skin is on the oily side and this just did not work. Putting it on, it has a nice cool sensation and a nice scent (imo). It absorbs quickly. However, that’s all it did for me. Once absorbed, I didn’t feel that my face was moisturized at all, it felt like I didn’t apply anything to it. In fact, my forehead appeared to have dry flakes on it. I continued to use it for awhile with no luck. If you have extremely oily skin, it may work for you; however coming winter this amount of moisture if any won’t cut it.

I received a free sample of this product from PinchME. I only had enough to use it for one day, but it felt so great going on my skin! The word that came to mind when I put it on the first time was “velvet“. It didn’t leave an oily residue and layered wonderfully with my other skin products.

review_text: This gives such a natural color and it works. I will put this on and it stays for days. Worth the money and this bottle has lasted me much longer than expected. Not streaky! I love it!!!
this product leaves your lips looking great and feeling smooth but it smells and tastes really weird...

I was excited to try this product as I have heard great things about the brand. Maybe my skin is sensitive to one of the ingredients but after using the product my skin got very irritated and itchy. I tried it again 3 days later just incase it was not the product but the irritation happened again. Sadly I will be returning as it wasn’t for my skin type. I did give it two stars for the light texture and no-fragrance , wish it would’ve worked.

One star off for the amount you get for the price, BUT other than that everything about this mask is amazing. I have acne-prone and oily skin. There was also a time when conditions were super windy, and it blew dirt and stuff all over my face…it got super clogged up with little bumps all over. I’ve been pairing this with a cleansing balm for the past two weeks and my skin is looking a lot better.

product_name: Overnight Glow Dark Spot Sleeping Cream

review_text: I’ve had micro needling done a few times. I decided to try this out. Save your money for the real thing. Serious it’s always on Groupon. All this product did was make my forehead line look slightly better for 30 minutes in the morning.

Really feel like this has improved the fine lines on my face and my skin texture. I’m on my second bottle, and I am very pleased with the results.
